Nee. Uit de kaart «Hemelhelderheid» van de Atlas Leefomgeving blijkt dat de Waddenzee en de Afsluitdijk worden beschouwd als een van de weinige plaatsen in Nederland waar nog echte duisternis heerst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Limburg trekt de beurs voor Maaslijn, maar risico’s blijven in hoofdpijndossier'

MPs De Hoop and Van der Plas asked why Limburg must provide extra funding for the Maaslijn rail upgrade, given that the national government should cover remaining shortfalls, and asked about the tender results and financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that cost increases require both co-principals (Limburg and the national government) to cover the gap under the 'samen uit, samen thuis' agreement, that ProRail definitively awarded the contract within the guaranteed amount, and that the government is willing to explore whether project organisation and management can be redesigned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Bagagemedewerkers mogen maximaal 216 koffers per dag tillen op Schiphol, maar zitten vaak aan de 200 per uur’

MPs De Hoop and Kathmann asked the government about a report finding that baggage handlers at Schiphol are exposed to excessive physical strain, and about employer responsibility, liability, enforcement and timelines. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that the Labour Inspectorate has imposed penalty payments and conducts inspections, and that mechanisation will take 8-10 years while interim measures are required now.

With the penalty payments imposed on the baggage handling companies, the Labour Inspectorate is forcing employers to take technical and organisational measures to limit physical strain as much as possible.

Met de lasten onder dwangsom die zijn opgelegd aan de bagageafhandelaren dwingt de Arbeidsinspectie de werkgevers technische en organisatorische maatregelen te nemen om de fysieke belasting zoveel mogelijk te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en De Hoop over de besluitvorming met betrekking tot de motie Klaver-c.s. over het gelijkstellen van potentieel zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (pZZS) aan zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS)

MPs Klaver and De Hoop asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the government did not implement the motion equating potentially very high-concern substances (pZZS) with very high-concern substances (ZZS), and about consultations, administrative burden, benefits, enforcement and the burden of proof. The State Secretary answered that the motion was legally vulnerable, that costs could not be precisely calculated, that no specific consultations followed the motion, and that alternative measures and an updated instrument for competent authorities were announced.
That is why in my letter of 6 October I announced various actions for the instruments of competent authorities.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief van 6 oktober verschillende acties aangekondigd voor het instrumentarium van bevoegde gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Schoolkosten onbetaalbaar, ouders vragen vaker financiële hulp'

An MP asks the Minister about reports that school costs are unaffordable, rising requests to Stichting Leergeld, continued compulsory-in-practice voluntary parental contributions despite the 2021 law, and whether a cap will be introduced. The government answers that it funds child-poverty support organisations, pursues poverty and equal-opportunity policy, says schools must follow the law with the Inspectorate enforcing it, and defers a cap decision to the budget debate.
Schools must comply with the law.
Scholen moeten zich aan de wet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over ruim tweehonderd docenten die achter het net vissen bij hun aanvraag voor een Lerarenbeurs

Two PvdA MPs asked why over 200 teachers were refused Lerarenbeurs funding for 2023 and are forced to wait a year, given that similar shortfalls were fixed by budget top-ups in 2020. The ministers answer that the budget was insufficient, that rejected first-time applicants get priority in 2024, and that the government is pursuing a national professionalisation programme via the Growth Fund.
Teachers who applied for the first time this year and were rejected because the subsidy ceiling was reached will receive priority over teachers applying for the first time next year.

Leraren die dit jaar voor het eerst een aanvraag hebben gedaan en afgewezen zijn vanwege het bereiken van het subsidieplafond, krijgen komend jaar voorrang ten opzichte van leraren die dan voor het eerst aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Hoop over de prijsverhogingen in het openbaar vervoer

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about fare increases in regional public transport, arguing they threaten accessibility and create a spiral of cut services, and asked what the government will do. The state secretary answered that regional fares are set by decentralised authorities, pointed to a EUR 150 million transition fund and ongoing work on a motion, and said fare increases are partly unavoidable given cost inflation.
I have no role or instruments in setting fares in regional public transport and therefore cannot prevent them.
Ik heb geen rol of instrumenten bij het vaststellen van tarieven in het regionaal openbaar vervoer en kan deze dus ook niet voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en De Hoop over de inperking van veerdiensten naar Ameland

MPs Bromet and De Hoop asked about the restriction of ferry services to Ameland, the broken road bridge at Holwert, and compensation for affected residents and businesses. The state secretary defended allowing a temporary force-majeure timetable for six weeks pending MARIN research, said no compensation is currently provided, and said the bridge renovation was not delayed and a second spare bridge section is already in use.
I have decided not to agree to a structural adjustment of the timetable between Holwert and Ameland.
Ik heb besloten niet in te stemmen met een structurele aanpassing van de dienstregeling tussen Holwert en Ameland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Meer giftige zware metalen komen in grondwater dan gedacht door 'staalslakken': 'Het maakt al het leven kapot''

MPs De Hoop and Bouchallikh asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that steel slag releases heavy metals into groundwater, including the Eerbeek case, and about the rules, enforcement and responsibility involved. The State Secretary answered that the rules are being reviewed, enforcement is being strengthened with the regional environmental services, a registration or permit requirement is being examined, the Eerbeek remediation is delayed by protected species and nitrogen issues, and that the Rijk will not pay for remediation that falls on the polluter.
That is why two actions are under way. First, I am reviewing the regulations for secondary building materials.
Daarom lopen er twee acties. Ten eerste houd ik de regelgeving voor secundaire bouwstoffen tegen het licht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het recordaantal uitvallers in het mbo door groenpluk van het bedrijfsleven

An MP asked the education ministers about the record number of early school leavers in vocational education, the causes (labour market, corona, lighter exam rules), the binding study advice, employer responsibility, diploma incentives, and budget cuts to the VSV scheme. The minister attributes dropout to a combination of lighter exam rules, corona-related motivation and mental health problems, and a strong labour market, plans a VSV action plan after the summer, and says the VSV scheme ends in 2024 with funds redirected.
It is therefore not possible to make a breakdown of which share of early school leavers stops for which reason.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een verdeling te maken welk deel van de voortijdig schoolverlaters om welke reden stopt.
Antwoord van het lid De Hoop over het bericht “Deze zomer verplicht reserveren voor treinreis naar Duitsland”

MP De Hoop asked the State Secretary whether mandatory reservations for international trains to Germany this summer undermine stimulating international rail, and why capacity cannot simply be expanded. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the reservation requirement is a temporary crowd-management measure by NS and DB, that capacity expansion depends on rolling stock arriving from 2024-2025, and that work on cross-border rail barriers and the Internationaal Spoor programme is underway, while NS is primarily responsible for implementation.
I regularly hold consultations with NS, both within the framework of the concession and outside it.
Ik voer regelmatig overleg met de NS, zowel in het kader van de concessie als daarbuiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de zorgelijke situatie omtrent de inzet van stagiairs en onervaren personeel bij de afhandeling op Schiphol

An MP asked ministers about the use of interns and inexperienced staff in Schiphol ground handling amid staff shortages and whether this threatens flight safety, pay levels and whether government can intervene. The minister answered that inexperienced staff must be properly supervised, that flight safety remains adequate per the ILT, and that wage disputes and the handling sector are for employers and unions, with government having limited options and monitoring talks.
It is up to employers and employees to jointly make agreements on terms of employment and working conditions.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om gezamenlijk afspraken te maken over arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en De Hoop over de negatieve gevolgen van de brede SPUK-regeling voor kleinere gemeenten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether the bundling of sport and health-promotion grants into the SPUK specific grant harms small municipalities, including the Wadden islands, and how it would be fixed. The government replied that over 98% of municipalities receive more money, that three municipalities (two Wadden islands and Rozendaal) would be topped up to their 2022 level, and that the new allocation key is meant to expand sport and health spending.
For these three municipalities, the specific grant will be increased to the level they received in 2022 from the aforementioned programmes.
Daarom zal voor deze drie gemeenten de specifieke uitkering worden opgehoogd tot het niveau dat zij in 2022 kregen uit genoemde programma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en De Hoop over het bericht 'Krakkemikkige boogbrug over het Julianakanaal wordt ineens niet meer vervangen: Itteren houdt zijn hart vast'

MPs Krul and De Hoop asked the minister why the Itteren bridge over the Julianakanaal will be renovated instead of replaced, the timeline, consultation with the Itteren village council, traffic and noise effects, shipping implications, and the stance on the Maastricht council's letter. The minister answered that replacement costs had more than doubled so renovation was chosen within budget, outlined a consultation process with a target decision in 2024, and said inspections show no short-term safety problem.

In the second quarter of 2023 Rijkswaterstaat will consult the municipality of Maastricht, the Itteren village council and other local parties on the precise scope of the renovation of the Itteren bridge.

In het tweede kwartaal van 2023 zal Rijkswaterstaat in gesprek gaan met gemeente Maastricht, de dorpsraad Itteren en andere omgevingspartijen over de precieze invulling van de renovatie van brug Itteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Terwijl bedrijf uit Kampen stopt, wachten talloze studenten nog op schoolboeken én geld: 'Heel zuur’'

An MP asks the Education Minister about reports that the Kampen textbook distributor TLN is closing, leaving students without books or refunds, and about the risks of dependence on a single distributor, commercial intermediaries, unused materials and bundled sales. The minister answers that orders are being refunded or delivered, that digital licences remain accessible, that alternative supply routes exist, and that he will discuss the distributor dependency and the unused-materials problem with schools and student councils, promising a letter before summer.
I will keep a close eye on developments in the coming period to see whether students get into financial trouble in the short term and whether they actually get their money back.
Ik zal vinger aan de pols houden de komende periode om te bezien of er door deze situatie studenten op korte termijn in de (financiële) problemen komen en of ze daadwerkelijk het geld terug krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over leerlingen van het speciaal onderwijs die noodgedwongen thuiszitten.

MP De Hoop asks the minister about special-education pupils who are forced to stay at home because of waiting lists, including at the Ambelt schools in Zwolle, and about the role of school boards, municipalities and staffing shortages. Minister Wiersma answers that schools must find an interim solution, that waiting lists are being mapped with a monitor, that school housing is a municipal responsibility, and that staffing measures are being taken.
I will inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarover voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog altijd homoseksualiteit afwijzen en identiteitsverklaringen hanteren

MPs De Hoop, Kwint and Westerveld asked why reformed schools still use identity declarations rejecting homosexuality, and how this fits with the Inspectorate lifting extra supervision at Gomarus. Minister Wiersma answered that such declarations are not yet banned, that she finds conditioning admission on signing them undesirable, that the Inspectorate will intervene where pupils are rejected, and that she is studying how to implement the motions to ban such declarations, to be reported later this year.
I do not consider it desirable for schools to express themselves in this way and to make admission conditional on signing such a declaration.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat scholen zich op deze wijze uitdrukken en toelating voorwaardelijk maken op het ondertekenen van zo'n verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over het kamertekort voor studenten naar aanleiding van recente uitzendingen van Pointer en Spraakmakers

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked about the student housing shortage, loneliness among students, the lack of rent allowance for rooms versus studios, and the decline of non-self-contained rooms. The minister responded that the WWSO reform is a step but not sufficient, that a regional housing coordinator is in place, and that a new WWSO proposal is expected around summer 2023.
I aim to be able to present a new proposal for the WWSO to your House around the summer of 2023.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer rond de zomer van 2023 een nieuw voorstel voor het WWSO aan te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en De Hoop over 'En toen was er geen hoogleraar Friese taal en cultuur meer, tegen de afspraken in'

MPs Peters and De Hoop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Groningen university's failed appointment of a Frisian language and culture professor and about legislation to anchor Frisian academic education. The minister said the hiring is the university's own matter, that a legislative proposal is being explored with a letter due in spring 2024, and that the Frisian programme continues within a broader minors programme.

I am currently exploring the possibilities to implement the motion requesting legal anchoring of Frisian academic education and will inform your House further this autumn on the implementation of the motion.

Ik verken momenteel de mogelijkheden om de motie die vraagt om wettelijke verankering van wetenschappelijk onderwijs in het Fries uit te voeren en zal uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Transportsector is blij, dorpen rond A7 zijn niet overtuigd van afname verkeer na opening Prinses Margriettunnel. 'Rijgedrag niet te voorspellen’'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the damage to the Prinses Margriettunnel, the reopening, speed enforcement, the condition of nearby bridges and traffic and accident effects in surrounding villages. The minister answered each question, giving repair timelines, the speed-control arrangement with the Public Prosecution Service, bridge maintenance plans and monitoring by the relevant authorities.
Enforcement of speed and the decision whether to conduct an on-site speed check is a decision that must be taken not by Rijkswaterstaat but by the Public Prosecution Service.
Handhaving op snelheid en het wel of niet overgaan tot een snelheidscontrole ter plaatse is namelijk een besluit dat niet door Rijkswaterstaat, maar door het Openbaar Ministerie genomen moet worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid De Hoop over de gevolgen van de stakingen in het streekvervoer voor leerlingen speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked whether the strikes in regional public transport, which disrupt special-education pupils' travel, will be prevented, whether staff pay and working conditions will be improved, and what the social costs are. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, that the strike is a labour dispute between employers and employees the government cannot influence, and that the social costs cannot be mapped.
Municipalities in the Netherlands are, however, responsible for pupil transport.
Gemeenten zijn in Nederland echter verantwoordelijk voor het leerlingenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid De Hoop over het bijna-ongeval op een onbewaakte spoorwegovergang in Rheden

An MP asked the state secretary about a near-accident at an unguarded level crossing in Rheden and why the 2023 target to close all unguarded crossings (NABOs) will be missed. The state secretary admitted disappointment, explained the delays, noted that the Lentsesteeg crossing may be closed earlier, and committed to temporary safety measures and a plan of action this spring.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Mbo wil financiële steun van kabinet en gemeenten voor student in armoede'

MPs Bouchallikh and De Hoop asked the Minister of Education about reports that vocational (mbo) students face rising poverty, the adequacy of the mbo student fund, budget coaches, free meals, school costs, the energy allowance, dropout and student housing. The minister answered that the government shares the concern, points to income measures and the student fund's adequacy, and promises further studies, consultations and information to the House, but largely refers to existing policies without new commitments on several points.
Early 2023 the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions will commission research among a representative group of municipalities into the use and implementation of the energy allowance.

Begin 2023 zal de Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen een onderzoek uit laten voeren onder een representatieve groep gemeenten naar het gebruik en de uitvoering van energietoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de dreigende stop van nachttochten van watertaxi’s naar en tussen de Waddeneilanden

An MP asks the minister about the threatened end of night watertaxi services to and between the Wadden islands, given a 20 km/h night speed limit and the need for emergency exceptions. The minister explains the existing speed rules, the Natura 2000 permit route for faster night sailing, emergency exemptions, and ongoing talks with local authorities and operators, promising further work on exception practice.
At official level there has been contact with the municipality of Ameland, the province of Fryslân and the Safety Region Fryslân.
Er is op ambtelijk niveau contact geweest met de gemeente Ameland, de provincie Fryslân en de Veiligheidsregio Fryslân.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het bericht ‘Grondwater duwt weg omhoog, A7 tussen Joure en Sneek mogelijk maanden dicht’

An MP asks the minister about the closure of the A7 near Joure and Sneek after groundwater pressure damaged anchors holding the Prinses Margriet tunnel, asking the cause, repair time, and temporary solutions. The minister answers that the cause is not yet known, repair time cannot be given, Rijkswaterstaat is investigating and working with local authorities on detours and possible partial reopening.
The exact cause of the problem at the Prinses Margriet tunnel is not yet clear at this time.
De exacte oorzaak van het probleem bij de Prinses Margriettunnel is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over verlaging van de urennorm

MP De Hoop asked the minister whether lowering the teaching-hours norm for teachers should be pursued to ease the teacher shortage and workload, and how this relates to the sector's proposals and past motions. The minister answered that the matter is being discussed with social partners, noting complex consequences for quality and equity, and promised further information before the 15 December debate.
I will look into this as part of further agreements with the social partners.
Ik ga hiernaar kijken als onderdeel van verdere afspraken met de sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Thijssen over het bericht 'Grote energieleverancier in de problemen; scholen ongerust'

MPs De Hoop and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that energy supplier DVEP had stopped sending invoices and closed to new customers, leaving schools worried. The minister said billing delays were caused by a system upgrade, that the ACM was alerted but does not comment on specific investigations, and that no emergency plan exists beyond general rules for small consumers, with compensation for school energy costs being considered in the budget.
The ACM, however, makes no statements about whether investigations into specific suppliers are ongoing or not.
De ACM doet echter geen uitspraken over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken naar specifieke leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over ongedocumenteerde studenten die eigenlijk niks kunnen met hun diploma als ze hun opleiding hebben afgerond

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked whether undocumented youths who finish vocational training cannot use their diplomas, whether they were overlooked in labour-shortage measures, and how the government views their exclusion from work, including the German 'Duldung' approach. The State Secretary answered that undocumented migrants are not part of the labour-shortage plan, that admitting them to the labour market is undesirable for migration and welfare reasons, and that this changes no existing policy.
The answers have no consequences for the existing policy.
De antwoorden hebben geen consequenties voor het geldende beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Rente over studielening op komst, vooral mbo'ers gaan meer betalen’

An MP asks the education minister why mbo students face a higher interest rate on study loans than hbo and university students, and whether this inequality will be removed. The minister answers that the two regimes will be aligned via the reintroduced basic grant bill, so mbo students will get the same repayment terms, and commits to working toward equal treatment of students.
The basic grant reintroduction bill proposes to adjust the repayment regime for mbo students as well and align it with the regime for ho students.

In het wetsvoorstel herinvoering basisbeurs hoger onderwijs is het voorstel opgenomen om het terugbetaalregime ook voor mbo-studenten aan te passen en dit gelijk te trekken aan het regime voor ho-studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de aanpak van het lerarentekort

An MP from the Labour party asked the education ministers how they would tackle the teacher shortage, including whether pabo students who fail the entrance test may continue, whether school closures and four-day school weeks are stopgap measures, and how these fit the Primary Education Act. The ministers answered that the teacher shortage is a risk to quality, that a strategy and an independent advisory team (Van de Bunt) will propose cooperation, that the pabo entrance-test experiment gives students one extra year, and that four-day weeks are allowed only seven times a year and are not acceptable beyond that, with the inspectorate ordering a remedy plan.

The inspectorate, which has intensive contact with the school, has given the school board a remedy order to come up with an action plan so that children can return to five-day school weeks as soon as possible.
De inspectie, die intensief contact heeft met de school, heeft een herstelopdracht gegeven aan het bestuur om met een plan van aanpak te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Minhas, Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Inspectie: NS heeft onvoldoende zicht op gevaarlijke situaties'

MPs asked the State Secretary about a NRC report that the Inspectorate found NS had insufficient oversight of dangerous situations in trains, following a whistleblower complaint, including questions on maintenance, a possible concealed technical defect, and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that the ILT found no acute risk or violation, is monitoring NS's improvement measures, will share the ILT letters, and found no concealment, though many answers defer to NS's own information.
Such letters are currently not actively made public, but an exception is possible in consultation with those involved.
Dergelijke brieven worden op dit moment niet actief openbaar gemaakt, maar in overleg met betrokkenen is een uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en De Hoop over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden bij bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

MPs Alkaya and De Hoop asked ministers whether baggage staff at Schiphol had for years been required to lift beyond health limits despite a 2009 inspection demand, and what the government would do. The ministers answered that the employers are primarily responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has launched inspections and will report, and that Schiphol and the ministries are pressing for structural improvements including limiting the number of handlers, though no independent new investigation will be set up.
The Minister of SZW sees no reason to set up a new independent investigation on top of everything already underway.
De Minister van SZW ziet geen aanleiding om naast alles wat nu al loopt een nieuw onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht dat er steeds meer tijdelijke contracten worden gegeven in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that temporary contracts in education are increasing and whether this undermines retention amid teacher shortages. The ministers answered that permanent work should be the norm, outlined measures such as tightening rules on temporary contracts and strategic HRM legislation, and provided university and hogeschool contract ratios for 2015-2021.
The cabinet's starting point is that structural work is in principle organised on the basis of permanent employment contracts.
Het uitgangspunt van het kabinet is dat structureel werk in principe wordt georganiseerd op basis van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Thijssen, Peters en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit'

Four MPs asked the ministers about schools forced to cancel energy contracts with Gazprom and face sharply higher costs, including the scale of the problem, scenarios, quality of education, building insulation and inequality. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that schools in acute liquidity problems can report to OCW, that a motion asks for targeted support to be reported by 1 December, and that a subsidy scheme for sustainable public buildings opens on 3 October.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en De Hoop over het bericht Acht boerderijen (deels) dicht voor extra stikstof door verbreding A27 en A12 bij Utrecht

MPs Thijssen, De Hoop, Bromet and Kröger asked why nitrogen capacity is being allocated to widening the A27 and A12 near Utrecht while an alternative is being developed, which other projects could use that capacity, and whether road widening really reduces congestion. Minister Harbers answered that the Raad van State appeal cannot be paused, that other projects such as the A28/A1 junction may need the capacity, that a 2020 traffic study shows congestion more than halved, and that the government is committed to sustainable mobility alongside road investment.
When the region has an alternative ready, I will enter into discussion with them.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, ga ik met hen in gesprek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Hoop over de afschaling van de dienstregeling van de NS

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the planned cut in NS train timetables, the public transport pattern of service reductions, and whether better NS staff pay and state funding are needed. The state secretary acknowledged concern, said the operator and its board are responsible for wages and staffing, and promised continued pressure on NS through concession oversight and talks with the Finance Ministry, without committing extra funds.
As concession grantor I will continue to hold NS to account for compliance with its concession obligations and for limiting passenger inconvenience caused by staff shortages.
Als concessieverlener zal ik NS blijven aanspreken op de naleving van haar verplichtingen uit de concessie en over het beperken van hinder voor de reiziger als gevolg van de personeelskrapte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Mutluer over mbo-studenten die niet worden toegelaten in Utrechtse cafés, andere uitgaansgelegenheden en sportfaciliteiten

MPs De Hoop and Mutluer asked whether refusing mbo students at Utrecht bars and sports facilities, while admitting university and HBO students, amounts to discrimination and whether it is covered by the constitutional non-discrimination clause. The minister condemned the unequal treatment and noted a conversation with the café owner, but said refusal by level of education is not legally prohibited and falls outside the equal-treatment statutes, relying on moral persuasion and a forthcoming mbo work agenda.
In horizontal legal relationships, meaning relations between citizens, citizens can invoke various equal treatment laws
In horizontale rechtsverhoudingen, waarmee de relatie tussen burgers onderling wordt bedoeld, kunnen burgers wel een beroep doen op verschillende gelijke behandelingswetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Paul over Financiële en bestuurlijke chaos op de Amsterdamse As Siddieq scholen

MPs De Hoop and Paul asked the education minister about financial mismanagement and governance failure at the As-Siddieq schools, including roughly €300,000 spent unlawfully, the impact on pupils, whether the board can fix the problems, recovery of funds, publication of the inspectorate report, and linking the case to pending legislation. The minister confirmed the inspectorate's findings, said recovery and sanctions against the board are underway, and declined to link the live case to the pending bill.
The procedure to recover the approximately €300,000 has already been initiated.
De procedure om de circa € 300.000 terug te vorderen is reeds in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en de Hoop over het bericht 'stagiair wordt ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether unpaid internships, which are widespread and may amount to cheap labour, are acceptable, and whether a fixed internship allowance or a reporting point for abuse should be introduced. The minister replied that internships are for learning, that employers are not legally obliged to pay, that he will discuss voluntary agreements with the education and labour sectors, and that the Labour Inspectorate handles complaints about unpaid work under the minimum wage act.
I will therefore enter into discussions with the education and labour sectors to make agreements on how more employers can be ensured to offer an appropriate internship allowance.
Ik zal daarom met het onderwijs- en werkveld in gesprek gaan om afspraken te maken hoe er gezorgd kan worden dat meer werkgevers een passende stagevergoeding bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het bericht dat bovenbouwleerlingen lesgeven aan onderbouwleerlingen

MP De Hoop asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that upper-grade pupils were teaching lower-grade pupils because of teacher shortages, and about safety, monitoring and the wider teacher shortage. The minister replied that the report did not reflect reality since pupils only gave extra tutoring, that the school board is responsible for safety, and pointed to existing monitoring and plans to intensify the approach.

The school board explained that the news report does not reflect reality; upper-grade pupils do not independently stand in front of the class at the school but assist lower-grade pupils who need extra tutoring in specific subjects.
Het bestuur van de school heeft toegelicht dat het nieuwsbericht geen recht doet aan de werkelijkheid; bovenbouwleerlingen staan op de school niet zelfstandig voor de klas
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en De Hoop over het antwoord van de Minister op eerdere vragen over het bericht 'Nog hoop voor pont Breukelen'

MPs Van der Molen and De Hoop asked the minister to explain why Rijkswaterstaat says the Breukelen ferry poses a nautical safety risk despite the OvV finding no structural shortcomings, and questioned the MARIN study, the 1888 and 1942 agreements, and shipping growth. The minister replied that six Rijkswaterstaat reports rate the ferry as medium-to-high risk, that the agreements are legally weak, that traffic has grown, and that he intends to take the ferry out of service while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders.
The original agreement unfortunately is not in the possession of Rijkswaterstaat.
De oorspronkelijke overeenkomst is helaas niet in bezit van Rijkswaterstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over een kwart van de mbo’ers dat recht heeft op een aanvullende beurs, maar deze niet aanvraagt

An MP asked the Minister of Education why over a quarter of eligible mbo students do not claim the supplementary grant, and how this will be addressed in the reintroduction of the student grant. The minister finds it worrying, points to reasons such as not needing the grant, and commits to measures such as pre-ticking the supplementary grant in the application and budgeting for process changes.
I will tackle the non-use by pre-ticking the supplementary grant on the start screen when applying for student finance.
Ik ga het niet-gebruik aanpakken door bij het aanvragen van studiefinanciering in het startscherm de aanvullende beurs standaard aan te vinken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over een dreigende kaalslag in het openbaar vervoer, n.a.v. het artikel  “Brandbrief lagere overheden: zet coronasteun ov niet zomaar stop” van 8 april 2022 in de Telegraaf

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the public transport availability payment will be extended, why clarity came late, and how fewer services and regional impacts will be monitored. The government answers that the payment is extended through 2022, that monitoring continues with the sector, and that service decisions rest with provinces and transport regions.
I will again inform your House this autumn, once the 2023 timetables have been set by the decentralised authorities, about the development of the service level.
Antwoord 11 Ik zal uw Kamerdit najaar, als de dienstregelingen voor 2023 door de decentrale overheden zijn vastgesteld, wederom informeren over de ontwikkeling van het voorzieningenniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de prijzen van het openbaar vervoer

An MP asked whether rail and public transport fares rise yearly with inflation and whether the state will intervene to prevent large fare increases during high inflation. The state secretary answered that NS may correct fares for inflation under the concession, that regional fares follow an index formula, and that he has no power over regional fares.
As the previous answers show, I have no authority over regional public transport fares.
Zoals uit voorgaande antwoorden blijkt, heb ik geen bevoegdheid ten aanzien van de regionale OV tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en De Hoop over het bericht ‘Nog hoop voor pont Breukelen’

MPs Van der Molen and De Hoop asked the minister about plans to remove the Nieuwer Ter Aa bicycle-pedestrian ferry over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, covering costs, safety, the 1888 and 1942 agreements, public participation and cycling detours. The minister answered that the ferry poses a nautical safety risk, that operating costs are 440,000 euro per year, that the agreements can be terminated because their legal value is low, and that a definitive decision is expected shortly after summer 2022.
The intention is to take the ferry out of service by 31 December 2022 at the latest.
Het voornemen is om de veerpont uiterlijk 31 december 2022 uit de vaart te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de verlenging van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs

An MP asked whether the drop in per-pupil funding for primary schools to about €500 would change how school effort and results are assessed, and whether schools can deliver the same interventions on that amount. The minister replied that the allocation was reshaped toward secondary education, with about €500 per pupil for primary and €820 for secondary, and that indicative amounts will be communicated earlier, with more funding directed to schools with greater disadvantage.
My intention is that approximately €820 per pupil will be available for secondary education and €500 per pupil for primary education.
Mijn intentie is dat er voor het vo een bedrag van ongeveer € 820 per leerling beschikbaar is en voor het po een bedrag van € 500 per leerling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over de schades aan huizen na werkzaamheden aan het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the minister about damage to around 400 homes caused by works on the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, including forced relocations, unacceptably long procedures, and who is responsible for the errors. The minister replied that the canal is a provincial waterway managed by Overijssel, that the ministry has no direct role, and that 288 damage claims have been granted compensation or subsidy so far.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway. Its management is in the hands of the province of Overijssel.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg. Het beheer daarvan is in handen van de provincie Overijssel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over medische rijbewijskeuringen

MP De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about overcharging by medical driving-licence examination providers, the NZa's enforcement, CBR referrals, and fee levels. The minister answered that providers must inform consumers of costs and send correct bills, that the NZa handles complaints and takes measures, and that a review of the examination process is ongoing with an update promised by Q3 2022.
It is indeed good that consumers do this and put any questions about the accuracy of the bill to the provider concerned.
Het is juist goed dat consumenten dit doen en hun eventuele vragen over de juistheid van de rekening stellen aan de betreffende zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kröger over het containerverlies van de Marcos V boven de Waddeneilanden

MPs De Hoop and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of 26 containers from the Marcos V above the Wadden islands, including salvage costs, Kustwacht powers during storms, the Julietta D incident, and protection of offshore infrastructure. The minister answered that the shipowner pays for salvage, that the Kustwacht can advise but cannot forbid routes or intervene generically under the Wbmo, and that Dutch-German-Danish proposals to the IMO are underway, with further letters promised before the summer recess.
I therefore cannot apply the intervention power in a generic sense, for example to a certain category of ships or in certain circumstances.
Ik kan de interventiebevoegdheid dus niet in generieke zin toepassen, bijvoorbeeld op een bepaalde categorie schepen, of in bepaalde omstandigheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en De Hoop over de aangenomen motie van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul over het in kaart brengen van belemmeringen voor zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs (Kamerstuk 35 252, n

MPs Kwint and De Hoop asked whether maternity leave for students in higher education would be legally anchored, and how many institutions had adopted the handreiking for pregnant students. The minister replied that institutions are free in how they implement the guidance, several have adopted it or plan to, that few students report problems, and that an official review of legal anchoring is still ongoing.
The previously announced civil-service exploration into anchoring their legal position is still ongoing.
De eerder aangekondigde ambtelijke verkenning naar de verankering van hun rechtspositie is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van Ginneken, Van der Molen, De Hoop en Bouchallikh over toegankelijkheid in het openbaar vervoer

Five MPs asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about accessibility of public transport, including the delayed Bestuursakkoord toegankelijkheid OV, assistance and toilets on regional trains, station counter closures, and the replacement of accessible buses by buurtbus and taxi concepts. The state secretary confirmed the accord was not concluded due to the outgoing cabinet, promised to aim for completion before summer without committing to specifics, and said a study on buurtbus accessibility is underway with results expected in November 2022.
I also consider it desirable that the measures are developed through a careful process.
Ik vind het daarnaast wenselijk dat de maatregelen tot stand komen via een zorgvuldig proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Paul over het voorstel in de Maastrichtse gemeenteraad om het openbaar voortgezet onderwijs af te schaffen

Two MPs asked the minister whether a Maastricht council proposal to abolish public secondary education and centralise schools on one campus undermines the constitutional guarantee of public education, whether a draft covenant overreaches council powers, and whether large-scale schooling harms the human scale of education. The minister replied that conversion from public to special-denomination schools is possible under legal conditions, that the public-education guarantee remains a municipal responsibility and cannot be transferred by covenant, and that evidence does not link school size to human scale.
However, a covenant cannot transfer or set aside (constitutional or statutory) legal tasks.
In een convenant kunnen echter geen (grond)wettelijke taken overgedragen of opzijgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het opheffen van servicebalies op treinstations

An MP asked the state secretary about NS closing staffed service counters at railway stations and how accessibility and personal help for less digitally skilled travellers, and the concession's information obligations, are safeguarded. The state secretary said station operations are NS's responsibility within the concession, that the government is monitoring the issue, that other forms of assistance remain available, and that the next concession will still aim for accessible public transport.

Within the agreements I have laid down in the main rail network transport concession on matters such as accessibility and social safety, it is up to NS to align its service provision and staffing as well as possible with the needs of the traveller.

Met inachtneming van de afspraken die ik heb vastgelegd in de vervoersconcessie voor het hoofdrailnet over zaken als toegankelijkheid en sociale veiligheid, is het aan NS om haar dienstverlening en personele inzet op een zo goede en efficiënt mogelijke manier aan te laten sluiten op de behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Woede en verbijstering, Rijkswaterstaat wil na 130 jaar pontje Nieuwer ter Aa opdoeken: Onacceptabel’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Nieuwer ter Aa ferry is being taken out of service despite heavy use by schoolchildren, whether the route is safe, and whether a bridge must be built first. The Minister answers that the ferry poses navigation risks from larger ships on the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal, that a decision is not yet final, that a safe alternative cycling route exists, and that the municipality is responsible for any replacement bridge.
That is why we intend to take the ferry De Aa out of service, but we are still consulting with the municipality.
Daarom hebben we het voornemen om de veerpont De Aa uit de vaart te nemen, maar we zijn nog in overleg met de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en De Hoop over het bericht ‘Spoorbrug in Maastricht wordt gesloopt: slechts 15 treinen na renovatie van 33 miljoen’

Two PvdA MPs asked why a rail bridge in Maastricht, renovated for 33 million euros, is to be demolished after only 15 trains crossed it, and whether alternatives and municipal consultation were considered. The minister and state secretary answered that freight traffic failed after the Sappi reorganisation, that the bridge obstructs navigation and water safety on the Julianakanaal, that the municipality is the competent authority for the demolition permit, and that future maintenance spending will be assessed for efficiency.

The intention to demolish a disused bridge, saving costs on management, maintenance, renovation and adjustments in favour of nautical and high-water safety, is on balance an efficient use of state funds.

Het voornemen om een in onbruik geraakte brug te slopen en zo kosten uit te sparen voor beheer, onderhoud, renovatie en aanpassingen ten gunste van nautische- en hoogwaterveiligheid is onder de streep een doelmatige inzet van rijksmiddelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over een interne notitie waaruit blijkt dat personeelsleden op het Gomarus in Gorinchem leerlingen én collega’s die relaties aangingen of wilden aangaan met mensen van hetzelfde ges

An MP asked how an internal school directive requiring staff at a Gorinchem secondary school to report students and colleagues with same-sex relationships or interests fits with teachers' legal position and their trust role. The minister condemned the directive as unacceptable and contrary to law, agreed it conflicts with the trust role, and said the government is examining whether teachers' legal position needs further strengthening, including via the Wet Veiligheid op School evaluation.
It is currently being examined whether it is generally necessary to further strengthen the legal position of education staff, as also indicated in the Coalition Agreement.
Er wordt momenteel gekeken of het in algemene zin nodig is de rechtspositie van onderwijspersoneel verder te versterken, zoals ook is aangegeven in het Coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Schiphol en KLM al 15 jaar op de hoogte van gezondheidsrisico’s medewerkers'

The MP De Hoop asks the minister whether Schiphol and KLM knew for 15 years of health risks from exhaust and ultrafine particles for platform workers, why little action was taken, why the Labour Inspectorate only now investigates, and whether affected workers should be compensated. The minister answers that employers bear responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that sector taskforces and an independent steering committee are being set up, that the Inspectorate is investigating since late 2021, and that a compensation scheme for serious occupational diseases is being prepared with a target start of 1 July 2022.
It is the responsibility of the employer to ensure safe and healthy working conditions.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever om te zorgen voor veilige en gezonde werkomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Westerveld en Kwint over de gevolgen van de veranderende bekostigingssystematiek voor het primair onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the new education funding system from 2023 would force primary school boards to draw down reserves by about 500 million euro, and whether this would reduce money for education. The minister answered that the change is a purely accounting adjustment with 100% of funding still paid out, that the inspectorate will treat affected boards leniently for five years, and that no real funds are lost.
As indicated, this is a technical, accounting exercise and in practice no money disappears from school boards.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het hier om een technische, boekhoudkundige exercitie en verdwijnt er feitelijk geen geld bij besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het NPO-fonds

An MP asked the government about the NPO-fonds: the timing of the NPO's review, whether its neutrality and independent working are safeguarded under the new performance agreement, and whether its tasks and budget are balanced. The state secretary answered that the review is due in spring 2022, that the NPO itself must safeguard the fund's balance and independence without a separate foundation, and that financial shortfalls for co-production and speelfilm rights are being covered jointly for 2022-2023 with the government to consider the remaining gap.
However, it is for the NPO to safeguard and organise the balance between the fund's tasks, independent working and associated budget.
Het is echter wel aan de NPO om de combinatie van taken, onafhankelijke werkwijze en bijbehorend budget van het NPO-fonds evenwichtig te waarborgen en te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het artikel 'Experts niet verbaasd over grote legionella uitbraak. Derde in paar jaar tijd in deze regio'

MP De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a legionella outbreak in Schijndel, whether it was linked to stagnant water systems during lockdown, its causes, national trends, prevention steps, monitoring of non-pneumophila species, and research on water treatment technologies. The minister answered that no link to lockdown-related water stagnation was found, the outbreak likely came from a wet cooling tower, prevention rules and a handbook for wastewater plants are being revised, and a research study will be started in 2022 with an update by end 2022.
At the end of 2022 I will inform you about the status of this.
Eind 2022 zal ik u informeren over de stand hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar veiligheid grondafhandeling Schiphol tegengewerkt’

MPs De Hoop and Alkaya asked why a survey of ground-handling workers was replaced by a data analysis in the NLR study on safety at Schiphol, and whether the data and safety-culture findings are reliable. The minister defends the study's conclusions, says the survey was dropped by the researchers themselves, and rejects a new survey while pointing to a sector CAO and other measures without committing to social establishment requirements.
It is up to the contractor to determine how the research is set up.
Het is aan de opdrachtnemer om te bepalen hoe het onderzoek wordt opgezet.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over het traject Delfzijl – Groningen n.a.v. het bericht ‘Boosheid over 'puinhoop' op spoor tussen Delfzijl en Groningen’ van de NOS

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the state secretary about recurring train disruptions and overcrowding on the Delfzijl–Groningen line, including whether longer trains should be deployed during the pandemic and whether operator Arriva would be called to account. The state secretary said that regional transport responsibility lies with the province of Groningen, which regards the incidents as isolated, and that the province accepts the operator's explanation of force majeure.
Responsibility for regional public transport services lies primarily with the regional transport authorities and the operators.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het regionale OV-aanbod ligt primair bij de regionale OV-autoriteiten en de vervoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en de Hoop over de Nederlandse aanvraag bij het EU Solidariteitsfonds naar aanleiding van de overstromingen in Limburg

MPs Ploumen and De Hoop asked the minister about the status of the Dutch EU Solidarity Fund application after the Limburg floods, the intended use of any funds, a commitment that funds go to Limburg public infrastructure, and access to the application. The minister answered that a preliminary damage estimate was submitted, a decision from Brussels is expected early 2022, the Wts compensation is independent of the fund, any contribution will go to public infrastructure in Limburg, and the form will be shared with parliament once final.
Once it is final, the House of Representatives will be further informed.
Zodra deze definitief is, wordt de Tweede Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Met de rolstoel de trein in? In Cuijk en Boxmeer heb je dan een probleem’

An MP asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that wheelchair users cannot board trains at some stations, and whether travellers in wheelchairs should travel independently across the country. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, points to the ongoing ProRail station accessibility programme to 2030, and announces a forthcoming Bestuursakkoord on expanding assisted travel and talks with Arriva and the province.
I agree that wheelchair users should be able to travel by train independently as far as possible.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat rolstoelgebruikers zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig met de trein moeten kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over de activiteiten van NS-dochter Abellio in Noordrijn-Westfalen (NRW)

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the government about NS subsidiary Abellio's losses and insolvency procedure in Germany, particularly the North Rhine-Westphalia contracts, and whether Dutch travellers and taxpayers would bear the costs. The minister explains the losses stem from external factors, that NS-backed restructuring keeps risk within the agreed framework, and that Abellio's NRW concessions will end on 31 January 2022 with emergency tenders.
With this solution NS stays within the risk framework ('Capital at Risk') that I agreed with your House for NS's foreign activities.
NS blijft met deze oplossing binnen het risicokader («Capital at Risk») dat ik met uw Kamer heb afgesproken voor de buitenlandse activiteiten van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Ploumen en Ellemeet over het moedwillig fout informeren van jongeren over abortus

MPs De Hoop, Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education whether he would act against schools giving young people deliberately false information about abortion, and how widespread such lessons are. The minister said the Inspectorate does not track the content of individual lessons, that schools must ensure students' safety and wellbeing, and that the Inspectorate will consider the signals in its supervision, without committing to a specific new step.
There is therefore no overview available of which information is provided, at what frequency, and by which school.
Er is dan ook geen overzicht beschikbaar van welke voorlichting, in welke frequentie, door welke school gegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het inzetten van minder treinen door tekort aan verkeersleiding personeel bij ProRail

MPs Bouchallikh and De Hoop asked the state secretary about train cancellations caused by a shortage of rail traffic controllers at ProRail, including recruitment, ageing staff and a temporary compensation allowance. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described ProRail's short- and long-term measures and an external review to be shared with parliament, and said financial issues had not been reported to him.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de verdubbeling van het aantal thuiszitters op het vwo in de regio Holland Rijnland

An MP asked the minister why the number of VWO pupils out of school in the Leiden region nearly doubled in one year, whether psychological problems and waiting lists are acceptable reasons for keeping children at home, and what the trend says about truancy policy generally. The minister attributes much of the rise to better registration and reporting by the regional truancy bureau, says the problem is complex, and points to ongoing integrated measures and an experiment decree while stating that a budget ceiling alone is no reason to keep a child at home.
When these figures are better mapped, the numbers may rise because a region simply gains better insight into the problem.
Bij het beter in beeld brengen van die cijfers kan het voorkomen dat de aantallen oplopen, omdat een regio simpelweg beter zicht krijgt op de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘De Westereen 'bezorgd, misschien wel boos' over schrappen bushalte bij station’

The MP De Hoop asks the State Secretary about the removal of a bus stop in De Westereen, its importance for pupils, refugees and commuters, the broader cutting of bus services during COVID-19, and when the PBL/CBS study on transport poverty will be published. The State Secretary answers that regional authorities are responsible for such decisions, that the stop is minor (ranked 325th, not 15th), that the province keeps the measure until 2025, that OV-autoriteiten monitor service levels nationally, and that the transport-poverty study is delayed to 2022.
The considerations per concession, or even per bus line, are the responsibility of the decentralised government.
De afwegingen per concessie, of zelfs per buslijn, zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en De Hoop over het bericht 'Twentse student Peter kreeg kanker, maar moet beurs volledig terugbetalen: ‘Je wordt als fraudeur gezien’'

MPs Westerveld and De Hoop asked whether DUO demands repayment of student grants from seriously ill students, how often home visits and penalties occur, and what changes are needed for hardship cases. The minister confirmed that DUO reclaimed part of a seriously ill student's grant, that home visits and penalties have declined since 2016, and pointed to existing hardship clauses and case-by-case review without committing to new rules.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the specific case.
Vanwege privacyredenen kan ik niet ingaan op de specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over "ongelijke toeslagen voor studenten met een beperking"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked why students with disabilities still receive less individual study allowance than promised, what steps were taken to get municipalities to pay 300 euro, which municipalities underpay, and whether funding or the Breed Offensief bill should be split to fix this. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the authority and responsibility for setting the allowance, urged them to pay 300 euro from age 21 within current law, said national government lacks municipal-level data, and declined to split the controversial bill or grant extra funds, saying municipalities have sufficient budget.
The national government does not have information on the level of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en De Hoop over het functioneren van de voormalig minister en voormalig staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gedurende de periode dat zij wisten dat zij lobbyist zouden w

MPs Arib and De Hoop asked the Prime Minister whether former minister van Nieuwenhuizen and former state secretary van Veldhoven could access information relevant to their future lobby-type roles while they knew of them, and whether that was undesirable. The government answered that they may have had access to such information, that the lobby ban and confidentiality duty apply, that the timing of their contacts is not known to it, and that van Nieuwenhuizen's appointment was ultimately judged incompatible with office and she was dismissed.
In principle it is up to the officials concerned themselves to shape a follow-on position with integrity.
Het is in principe aan de betrokken bewindspersonen zelf om op een integere wijze vorm te geven aan een vervolgfunctie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Arib over het ontslag van de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, C. van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en S. van Veldhoven

Two PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister why the two state secretaries of Infrastructure and Water Management resigned early to take new jobs, and about lobbying restrictions for former office-holders. The government answered that the resignations were personal career choices, that a two-year lobbying ban applies to former ministers at their old department unless the secretary-general grants an exception, and that the ban's scope for the cases at hand is for the secretary-general to assess.

This rule is therefore not intended to make taking up such a position impossible, but to prevent a former office-holder from using knowledge and position gained in the previous role for the interests of the new employer during a set period.

Deze regel beoogt dus niet het in dienst treden bij een dergelijke instelling onmogelijk te maken maar wel om gedurende een bepaalde periode te voorkomen dat een oud-bewindspersoon kennis en positie op grond van de vorige functie inzet voor de belangen van de nieuwe werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de dreigende schoolsluiting in de drie grote steden

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that three large cities may have to close schools due to teacher shortages, whether the 116 million euro agreed earlier is sufficient, whether ministers can coordinate cross-domain problems, and whether he will meet city aldermen and cabinet colleagues. The Minister says the convenant measures are taking effect, will review results this autumn, notes housing is primarily a municipal matter, and does not commit to a new meeting in the answer shown.
I expect the results of the first year of the convenants this autumn and will inform the House in December with the annual letter on the education labour market.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van het eerste jaar convenanten dit najaar en zal de Kamer in december met de jaarlijkse brief over de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Piri over het bericht ‘De F-35 fersteurt it libben fan Friezen’

MPs De Hoop and Piri asked the State Secretary for Defence about reports that F-35 noise causes stress, sleeplessness and disturbance for residents near Leeuwarden air base, and whether the noise norms should be reconsidered. The State Secretary acknowledged the nuisance, said the 35 Ke norm is respected and noise measurement networks and local consultation committees exist, but declined to change the norm and only offered to explore operational adjustments.
Defence is certainly willing to look for ways to limit the nuisance, for example by adjusting flight procedures during take-off and landing.
Defensie is zeker bereid om te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om de hinder te beperken, bijvoorbeeld door het aanpassen van vliegprocedures tijdens start en landing.
Antwoord op van het lid de Hoop over gerecyclede grond

An MP asked the government about reports that recycled thermally cleaned soil contaminated dike, road and water projects, including Perkpolder and Westdijk, and whether this endangers public health and farmers. The minister answered that health risks were judged limited, monitoring and remediation are underway, quality controls were tightened, and compensation claims would be assessed case by case.
On the results of this monitoring I will inform your House in due course once the final report is available.
Over de resultaten van deze monitoring zal ik uw Kamer op termijn nader informeren zodra de definitieve rapportage beschikbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over PFAS in voedselverpakkingen

An MP asked the government about PFAS in food packaging, the health risks to children and foetuses, and whether such substances should be permitted, and asked for research on use and effects. The minister answered that a ban on PFAS in food packaging is being prepared to take effect on 1 January 2022, that the NVWA will enforce it, and that further research is deemed unnecessary.
An amendment to the Packaging and Consumer Articles Regulation will end the permission to use PFAS in and on paper and other natural materials for food contact, and to trade or import such products.

Een aanpassing van de Warenwetregeling verpakkingen en gebruiksartikelen zal een eind maken aan de toestemming om PFAS in en op papier en andere natuurlijke materialen voor voedselcontact te gebruiken en dergelijke producten te verhandelen of in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over kapotte bruggen in Groningen

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about damaged bridges in Groningen, including causes of ship collisions, a history of incidents, and repair timelines. The minister gave substantive answers on incident causes, planned safety measures, and rebuilding timelines, but declined to state causes pending a police investigation and deferred some timing questions to ongoing procedures and regional consultations.
I cannot yet make statements about the cause of the collision pending the ongoing police investigation.
Over de oorzaak van de aanvaring kan ik nog geen uitspraken doen in afwachting van het lopende politieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Bouchallikh, Grinwis, Van Raan en De Hoop over de minicargovluchten die worden uitgevoerd tussen Luik en Maastricht

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about mini cargo flights between Liège and Maastricht, including how many occurred, whether the minister still opposes them for environmental reasons, and whether a ban like France's is legally possible. The minister confirmed seven repositioning flights since January (six by Astral Aviation), said the EU framework lacks room for national bans, and promised to monitor France's case and raise the issue in revising EU Regulation 1008/2008.

A concrete legal basis for temporarily banning such flights due to serious environmental problems is absent from Dutch legislation and, given their cross-border nature, could not be unilaterally established by the Netherlands.

Een concrete wettelijke grondslag voor het tijdelijk verbieden van dergelijke vluchten wegens ernstige milieuproblemen ontbreekt in de Nederlandse wetgeving en zou gelet op het grensoverschrijdend karakter niet eenzijdig door Nederland vastgesteld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over het bericht “Schip verliest containers bij Ameland”

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of containers from the Baltic Tern near Ameland, including whether the Coast Guard advised against the northern route and whether the government will strengthen intervention powers. The minister answered that containers were recovered, that the Coast Guard does not warn ships from German waters, that 12 of 14 large container ships followed the northern-route advice, and that further steps on IMO measures and intervention powers will be discussed in a progress report.
I have also spoken personally with my German and Danish colleagues.
Ik heb ook zelf met mijn Duitse en Deense collega gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘De asbestberg groeit, en niemand durft zich te branden aan een oplossing’ in de Gelderlander

An MP asked the state secretary about the growing asbestos waste problem, including whether asbestos can stay in the ground permanently and what can be done about reuse. The state secretary answered that landfilling remains the only option for most asbestos waste under strict safety rules, that reuse is for the market to develop with existing support, and that pilots will map options.
Landfilling asbestos-containing waste is not preferred for future sustainability, but (except for asbestos-containing steel scrap) is currently the only option.
Het storten van asbesthoudend afval heeft met het oog op toekomstbestendigheid niet de voorkeur, maar is (met uitzondering van asbesthoudend staalschroot) momenteel de enige optie.

m: Motie van de leden Keijzer en Potters over disfunctionerende bestuurders in de ouderenzorg en gehandicaptenzorg

Asks the government to prepare a law allowing civil bans on disfunctioning directors in elderly care, disability care, youth care and mental health care, as already possible for bankruptcies and foundations.
requests the government to prepare a corresponding statutory amendment
verzoekt de regering, een overeenkomstige wetswijziging voor te bereiden
Amendement van de leden Volp en Potters over het versterken van professioneel handelen in de langdurige zorg
Shifts budget within the long-term care article to fund research and knowledge development for professional care workers, with zero net amount.
By submitting this amendment the submitters aim to strengthen the knowledge needed for professional conduct of care workers in long-term care.
Met de indiening van dit amendement beogen de indieners de kennis te versterken die nodig is voor het professionele handelen van zorgverleners in de langdurige zorg.
Amendement van de leden Potters en Otwin van Dijk waarmee de voorwaarden voor een zvw-pgb bij AMvB worden vastgesteld
Sets out that conditions for a Zvw personal budget are fixed by general administrative order and adds a prior-submission (voorhang) procedure for that order to parliament.
In addition, a prior-submission provision is introduced for the relevant general administrative order.
Daarnaast wordt een voorhangbepaling voor de betreffende algemene maatregel van bestuur geïntroduceerd.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Potters en Otwin van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 5 waarmee cliënten die op 31 december 2015 een vpt ontvingen kunnen kiezen voor voortzetting van de zorgverlening doo
Allows clients receiving a full home-care package (vpt) on 31 December 2015 to keep that form of care instead of being moved to an institution.
choose to continue care through a full home-care package
kiezen voor voortzetting van zorgverlening door middel van een volledig pakket thuis
Motie van het lid Potters c.s. over persoonsvolgende bekostiging als volwaardig alternatief voor zorg in natura
Asks the government to elaborate person-linked funding as a full alternative to institutional care in an AMvB and send it to the House before summer 2016.
requests the government to further develop person-linked funding as a full alternative to care in kind in an AMvB
verzoekt de regering, persoonsvolgende bekostiging als volwaardig alternatief naast of voor zorg in natura nader uit te werken in een AMvB
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Potters c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 22 over epilepsie-hulphonden
Amendment shifts 1 million euros within the health budget to fund a three-year subsidy for epilepsy assistance dogs, with independent effectiveness research as a condition.
This amendment provides for a three-year incentive subsidy.
Dit amendement voorziet in een driejarige stimuleringssubsidie.
Motie van het lid Potters over een nieuwe norm voor zorginstellingen in de langdurige zorg
Asks the government to develop a new quality norm for long-term care institutions with a two-year transition period and to let the inspectorate intervene when quality is insufficient.
to let the inspectorate intervene when quality is insufficient
de inspectie bij onvoldoende kwaliteit te laten ingrijpen
Amendement van het lid Potters c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over epilepsie-hulphonden
Asks for a three-year subsidy for epilepsy assistance dogs, funded by reallocating money within the health budget article.
This amendment provides for a three-year incentive subsidy.
Dit amendement voorziet in een driejarige stimuleringssubsidie.
Amendement van het lid Potters over epilepsie-hulphonden
Moves funds within article 4 Zorgbreed beleid to finance a three-year subsidy for epilepsy assistance dogs, with a research condition.
The coverage of this amendment is found in the legally non-mandatory part of article 4.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in het niet-juridisch verplichte deel van artikel 4.
Amendement van de leden Potters en Otwin van Dijk waarmee ongeveer 2000 cliënten kunnen kiezen voor voortzetting van de zorgverlening door middel van een vpt
Lets about 2,000 clients who received a home care package on 31 December 2014 choose to continue that care at home, without relocating.
it is proposed to arrange for this group that they can choose to continue care through a full home care package
