Three VVD MPs asked the Finance and Agriculture ministers about the EBA's Basel III updated impact study, including the claimed 21% capital increase for Dutch banks, the effect on agricultural and mortgage lending, and whether the impact is unfairly borne by farm credit. The minister answered that the impact depends on the EU implementation proposal expected in H1 2021, that interministerial talks with banks continue, and that a Commission impact analysis will follow.
Once the Commission presents a legislative proposal, the cabinet will inform the House of its position via the usual BNC fiche procedure.
Zodra de CIE met een wetgevend voorstel komt, zal het kabinet uw Kamer informeren over haar inzet volgens de gebruikelijke weg van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'DNB slaat negatief advies over renteverlaging in de wind'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether he requested DNB to lower the long-term interest rate in the uniform scenario set despite negative academic advice, what the effects are, and why the change was pushed through. The minister answers that signals from pension providers prompted him to alert DNB, that DNB as independent supervisor decided on a temporary adjustment after a due process, and that the change does not affect the transition scenario set or investment policy.
I asked DNB to take measures where necessary within the powers DNB has for this, with the advice of the Commission Parameters 2019 as the starting point.
Daarbij heb ik aan DNB gevraagd zo nodig maatregelen te nemen binnen de bevoegdheden die DNB daarvoor heeft, waarbij als uitgangspunt het advies van de Commissie Parameters 2019 geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over de beperkte dekking van asbestdaken

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether insurers such as Centraal Beheer and Achmea are limiting coverage of asbestos roof damage, leaving homeowners uninsured or underpaid, and whether the government will press insurers to reverse this. The minister (Finance) answered that he has no overview of insurers' conditions, that Achmea phases out coverage of asbestos roofing by 5% a year, that policy terms govern payouts, and that the government is asking the asbestos programme office to talk with insurers.
I have no insight into insurers' conditions.
Ik heb geen zicht op voorwaarden van verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Krotbeleggen: ‘triest’ spel van een beursfonds drijft gemeentes tot wanhoop’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government would act against a listed fund that lets listed monuments decay to gain land positions, and whether exchange listings could be refused. The minister answered that municipalities already have enforcement powers under the Wabo and Woningwet, that Wassenaar has taken action, and that exchange exclusion and new general coercive measures are too far-reaching, so no further steps are planned.
For that reason we see no reason for follow-up steps.
Om die reden zien wij geen aanleiding voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Bankenautoriteit vreest dat de witwasregels doel voorbij schieten’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether anti-money-laundering rules are causing banks to refuse clients such as startups, international organisations, embassies, foreign companies and politically exposed persons, and what the government will do about onboarding problems. The minister acknowledged de-risking signals, argued that banks must assess each case individually, pointed to a planned evaluation by mid-2021 and to a legislative proposal on information sharing between banks, but gave no quantitative data on refusals.
Banks, however, do not keep quantitative data, because each case is treated and assessed separately.
Banken houden echter geen kwantitatieve data bij, omdat elke zaak apart wordt behandeld en beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van der Linde over een tweede betaalpauze door banken

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether banks' refusal of a second generic payment holiday during the second lockdown, and the shift to case-by-case support, endangers viable firms, and how DNB's financial stability warnings and the Tax Authority's payment arrangements are handled. The minister answered that banks now assess clients individually, that the financial sector is resilient, and that the government is extending support schemes and debt-relief measures for entrepreneurs.

The cabinet will make efforts in the coming period to develop joint guidelines with large creditors, including banks, for a more flexible treatment of restructuring requests from entrepreneurs affected by the corona crisis.

Het kabinet spant zich de komende periode in om met grote schuldeisers, waaronder de banken, gezamenlijke richtlijnen te ontwikkelen voor een soepelere behandeling van saneringsverzoeken van ondernemers die door de coronacrisis zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over bepaalde Britse banken die rekeningen van klanten in Nederland opheffen

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the Finance Minister why British banks are closing accounts of Dutch customers after Brexit, whether this can be prevented, and why retail customers have less protection than professional market parties. The government answers that UK institutions must manage their own transition under UK supervision, that existing preparation is considered sufficient so no additional legislation is needed, and that EU rules protect retail clients by requiring proper authorisation for cross-border services.
It is up to British institutions themselves to determine which steps they take in response to the end of the transition period.
Het is aan Britse instellingen zelf om te bepalen welke stappen zij ondernemen in reactie op het aflopen van de overgangsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van der Linde over het experiment van DNB met uitgifte betaalrekeningen

VVD MPs Lodders and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a Dutch bank closing an Accidental American's account under FATCA, where Accidental Americans may lose their bank access, and about the DNB digital euro experiment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to basic payment account options and the Convenant Basisbankrekening, said the digital euro is separate from this problem, and promised to press the US and EU for talks on FATCA.
I cannot go into individual cases in which accounts have been terminated.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'WhatsApp-fraude explodeert: 'Ik snap niet hoe ik erin ben getrapt''

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about the rise of WhatsApp 'friend in need' fraud, its scale, perpetrators, bank liability, prevention and FIU information. The minister replied that reports have surged since 2019 but exact numbers are unknown, outlined prevention campaigns, bank security rules and new financial investigation tools, and said banks are generally not liable for authorised payments.
The exact scale of 'friend in need' fraud is not known, because not all victims report to the police, their bank or the Fraud Helpdesk.

De exacte omvang van hulpvraagfraude (ook wel vriend-in-nood-fraude genoemd), is niet bekend, omdat niet alle slachtoffers aangifte doen bij de politie of een melding maken bij hun bank of de Fraudehelpdesk (FHD).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Amerikaanse Nederlanders kunnen Trumpcheque niet verzilveren’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that tens of thousands of Dutch-American citizens cannot cash US Trump stimulus cheques in the Netherlands, and whether banks or the US ambassador could resolve it. The minister answered that ING offers cheque cashing until end-2020, that Dutch banks have largely stopped the service for commercial and fraud reasons, and that he has raised the issue with the US embassy.

I have already raised this point with the American embassy in the Netherlands and will ask in a follow-up conversation whether, and if so what, options exist to cash a cheque if this is not possible at a Dutch bank.

Ik heb dit punt reeds onder de aandacht gebracht bij de Amerikaanse ambassade in Nederland en zal in een vervolggesprek vragen of en zo ja welke mogelijkheden er zijn om een cheque te verzilveren als dit bij een Nederlandse bank niet lukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat huizenbezitters honderden euro’s extra kwijt zijn aan taxaties

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about reports that homeowners pay hundreds of euros more for valuations, and whether an EBA guideline banning computer-generated valuations was legally binding. The minister answered that the guidelines follow a comply-or-explain principle, that DNB and the ECB will apply them from 30 June 2021, and that a working group is exploring hybrid valuations and reforms to the appraisal process.
For the guidelines the comply-or-explain principle applies, whereby national authorities have room to deviate from the guidelines with reasons.
Voor de richtsnoeren geldt het «pas toe of leg uit» principe, waarbij nationale autoriteiten de ruimte hebben om gemotiveerd af te wijken van de richtsnoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Banken klagen over hoge kosten Geldmaat’

MPs Van der Linde and Aartsen asked why Geldmaat's ATM fee rates are confidential, whether smaller banks pay the same per-transaction fees, and how this fits competition law. The minister answered that the rates are kept confidential for commercial reasons, that smaller banks should keep open and non-discriminatory access, and that the government and ACM are monitoring the issue, with no firm new measure yet.
These mutually agreed rates were not published because of their commercially confidential nature.
Deze onderling overeengekomen tarieven werden niet gepubliceerd vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de uitzending van NPO Radio 1 Reporter Radio over het bericht 'Bitcoinbedrijven sluiten de deuren door te hoge kosten'

MPs Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a radio report that crypto firms are closing because supervision costs of at least EUR 20,000 a year are too high, and why these costs were only announced in May, and how this relates to a motion, the treatment of other sectors, and a European anti-money-laundering supervisor. The Minister replied that supervision is necessary to prevent crypto misuse, that costs for 2020 are about EUR 18,000 per firm, that costs will be allocated by turnover from 2021, and that the Netherlands supports a phased European supervisor.
From next year, supervision costs will be allocated according to capacity to pay.
Vanaf volgend jaar worden de kosten voor het toezicht naar draagkracht verrekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Overheid is te slap tegen witwassen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Justice and Finance Ministers whether the state is too weak against money laundering, citing criticism from the NOB and Transparency International, and questioned FIU capacity (19 FTE), the judicial capacity bottleneck and the implementation of a motion on stricter penalties. The minister replied that capacity has been increased through funding and public-private cooperation, that the extra funds were not used for structural FIU expansion, and that the motion will be considered in an ongoing evaluation of the Wet verruiming mogelijkheden bestrijding financieel-economische criminaliteit.

As also indicated in the progress letter on the money laundering action plan, the implementation of the motion will be taken into account in assessing the outcomes of the ongoing evaluation of the act.
Zoals ook in de voortgangsbrief over het plan van aanpak witwassen is aangegeven, zal de uitvoering van de motie worden betrokken bij de beoordeling van de uitkomsten van de lopende evaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Hof: deelnemer houdt recht op onvoorwaardelijke indexatie‘

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that a participant keeps an unconditional right to indexation of pensions built up with an insurer, and about implications for the new pension contract and collective transfer. The minister said the ruling is consistent with the Pensioenwet, that collective invaren and protection of existing rights will be addressed in a forthcoming policy letter, and declined to answer some questions in detail.
I am not aware of how many collective labour agreements contain arrangements on unconditional indexation of pensions.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeveel cao’s afspraken staan over onvoorwaardelijke indexatie van pensioenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Rekenrentes in andere EU-landen dalen licht’

MP Van der Linde (VVD) asks Minister Koolmees about reports that discount rates in other EU countries are falling slightly, and how Dutch pension funds compare under the EIOPA method, including Denmark, Sweden and Belgium, and the effects of the EIOPA stress test. The minister answers each question, explaining that the discount rate alone does not explain funding gaps, that differences reflect other fundamental factors, that the EIOPA method adds future indexation and a risk margin, and that the stress test has no direct consequences for Dutch pensions.
Yes, I am aware of the article.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de radio-uitzending van AvroTros Radar op 9 november 2019

MP Van der Linde asked the minister whether disabled workers are leaving about two billion euros of pension money unclaimed, whether UWV has an automation or organisational problem, and how pension funds can trace affected members. The minister said he lacks the data for an estimate, placed primary responsibility for claiming disability pensions with pension funds, and saw no reason for further measures.
I do not have the relevant data to give an answer to this.
Ik beschik niet over de relevante data om hier een antwoord op te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het niet verkopen van ABN AMRO en het miljardenverlies op deze aandelen

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister why the state has not sold ABN AMRO shares since September 2017, how the sale procedure and NLFI's advice work, and what the timing criteria are. The minister answered that NLFI advises on strategy and that the minister approves each step, but he declined to disclose confidential advice, the number of sale meetings, and the reasoning behind timing, citing market sensitivity, while promising to publish some advice after transactions.

Disclosing NLFI's considerations, now or in the past, when advising on the share sale strategy and my own considerations, both then and now, could lead to expectations among investors that allow them to anticipate a state transaction.

Het openbaar maken van de afwegingen van NLFI, nu of in het verleden, bij het adviseren over de verkoopstrategie van de aandelen en mijn afwegingen hierbij, zowel destijds als nu, kunnen leiden tot mogelijke verwachtingen bij beleggers waardoor zij mogelijk kunnen anticiperen op een transactie van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een dubieuze afbouwverzekeraar het project in Brielle niet af bouwt

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Linde asked whether a dubious completion insurer leaving a Brielle housing project unfinished leaves buyers unprotected, how often the AFM receives signals about such insurance, how many providers operate, when providers must account, and what specific rules apply. The minister says the insurer lacked a licence and used unusual terms, that buyers may be unable to claim, that the AFM has received very few signals which led to no follow-up, that DNB regulates prudential supervision of 18 insurers offering the branch, and that no specific rules for completion insurance are known beyond general insurance law.
The Minister for Environment and Housing will therefore work with the supervisor to map how the risk of such situations can be further limited in the future.
De Minister voor Milieu en Wonen gaat daarom met de toezichthouder in kaart brengen hoe het risico op dergelijke situaties in de toekomst verder kan beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Maak van onze bankrekening een telefoonnummer’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about making bank accounts portable via phone-number-style aliases and IBAN portability, and about the status of DNB research and the EU payment account directive evaluation. The minister answered that IBAN portability is technically complex and best pursued at EU level, that the EU evaluation may finish by late 2020, and that DNB alias research is expected in Q1 2020.
I expect the evaluation by the European Commission to be completed at the earliest by the end of 2020.
Ik verwacht dat de evaluatie door de Europese Commissie op zijn vroegst eind 2020 wordt afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Drugskartel waste opbrengsten wit: Nederlandse banken hadden moeten ingrijpen’

MPs Van der Linde and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether simple loanback money-laundering constructions are a serious problem, how often they occur, whether authorities have enough capacity, and how cooperation with the prosecution service and gatekeepers can improve. The ministers answered that the scale of money laundering is hard to pin down, that loanback constructions are a known phenomenon without data on their share, and pointed to the anti-money-laundering action plan, public-private cooperation pilots, extra funding and a new multidisciplinary intervention team.
The exact scale of money laundering flows through the Netherlands cannot be determined definitively.
De exacte omvang van witwasstromen door Nederland is niet definitief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Zó raakt de nieuwe benchmarkrente Ester pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about how the switch from EONIA to €STR as benchmark rate affects pensions funds' swap valuations, the EURIBOR outlook, collateral disputes, coverage ratios and swap hedging. The minister answered that EURIBOR remains usable after EMMI's reform and FSMA licence, that the effect on coverage ratios cannot yet be estimated, and gave hedging-ratio figures for the largest funds.
It is currently not possible to make an estimate of this, as it depends on interest rate developments and developments in the swap market.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om hier een inschatting van te maken, aangezien dit afhangt van de renteontwikkeling en de ontwikkelingen in de markt voor swaps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Middendorp over leeftijdsontslag in het licht van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Van der Linde and Middendorp asked how the slower rise of the AOW age under the pension agreement affects civil servants' forced retirement at the AOW age, pension accrual, ABP communication, and whether discretion or exceptions should apply. The ministers answered that early retirement numbers and pension effects were calculated, that employers and employees decide on working on, and that the government stays politically restrained on collective agreement content.
Whether or not to keep working after the AOW age is a decision for the employer and the employee.
Het wel of niet langer doorwerken na de AOW-leeftijd is een beslissing van werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de overheid op één dag meer dan een miljard heeft verloren op de aandelen van ABN AMRO

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that the state lost over a billion euros in one day on its ABN AMRO shares, why no shares have been sold since his appointment, and how democratic control over the holding via NLFI is organised. The minister confirms the regeerakkoord goal of full market sale as soon as responsible, declines to explain sale timing for market-sensitivity reasons, and describes the NLFI governance and ministerial approval arrangements.
This information could be price-sensitive and disclosing it could have a negative effect on intended transactions.
Deze informatie zou koersgevoelig kunnen zijn en openbaarmaking daarvan zou een negatief effect op voorgenomen transacties kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over "automatische waardeoverdracht van kleine pensioenen”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's view that automatic transfer of small pensions is only lawful after a job change, and about pension funds' ability to identify job changes and to transfer small pensions left behind after collective termination. The minister answered that the conditions are set out in law, that exact transfer figures are not yet available, that he is considering in principle a positive response to an industry request to extend automatic transfer to left-behind small pensions while weighing the interests of employees.
I do not currently have exact figures; this will only be addressed in the evaluation of the law planned for 2021.
Ik beschik nu niet over exacte cijfers, dit zal pas in de evaluatie van de wet aan de orde komen die is voorzien voor 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over de berichten “Criminelen wassen 1 miljard wit via export tweedehandsauto’s” en “Autobedrijven frauderen voor miljoenen bij export ex-leaseauto’s”

MPs Van der Linde and Lodders asked about press reports of money laundering through export of second-hand and ex-lease cars, asking about the scale of fraud, reporting figures, FIU access to customs data, and enforcement capacity. The Ministers answered that a criminal investigation into four dealers covers roughly 120 million euro in exports and a 21 million euro VAT loss, that no overall figures exist, and that existing cooperation and a new anti-money-laundering plan are being strengthened, while withholding further details due to the ongoing investigation.
Because this criminal investigation is still ongoing, further details cannot be disclosed.
Omdat dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, kunnen verdere details niet worden vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Tientallen kleine bedrijven failliet door hoge kosten crowdfunding'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small firms went bankrupt due to high crowdfunding costs, and whether existing rules protect SMEs from excessive interest rates. The minister answered that crowdfunding is a valuable financing option, that the government relies on self-regulation codes for business clients, and that the AFM oversees certain crowdfunding forms, with a possible national framework deferred to the pending EU regulation.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, the cabinet is relying on self-regulation to improve protection for small business clients.
Zoals in de beantwoording op vraag 3 is aangegeven, zet het kabinet wat betreft de verbetering van de bescherming voor kleinzakelijke klanten in op zelfregulering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Bosman over de berichten ‘Sint Maarten heeft nog paar maanden voor wetgeving rond witwassen’ en ‘Sint Maarten weigert strijd tegen witwassen en terrorismefinanciering aan

MPs Van der Linde and Bosman asked the government about reports that Sint Maarten was lagging on anti-money-laundering legislation and about the scale of the problem and possible political obstruction. The State Secretary answered that AML is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, that several laws were recently adopted, that a CFATF public statement was withheld as a confidential draft, and that Dutch support and monitoring continue.
The statement in question concerns a confidential internal draft of an international body that was not adopted after CFATF deliberation and therefore was not published.
De genoemde verklaring betreft een vertrouwelijk intern concept van een internationaal orgaan, dat na besluitvorming in de CFATF niet is vastgesteld en daarom niet is gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie een inbreukprocedure tegen Nederland is gestart over de IORP 2 richtlijn

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the European Commission had opened an infringement procedure against the Netherlands over the IORP II directive, including whether implementation was complete and why the EU website showed partial implementation. The minister answered that the directive was fully transposed into force on 13 January 2019, that the notification to the Commission was late and wrongly marked as partial, and that it has since been corrected.
I regret that a late and incorrect notification has caused confusion about the implementation status of the directive in the Netherlands.
Ik betreur het dat door een te late en onjuiste melding onduidelijkheid is ontstaan over de implementatiestatus van de richtlijn in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Ronnes en Van der Linde over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën de beantwoording van Kamervragen over het handelen van het Bureau Kredietregistratie (BKR) met dat bureau

MPs Sneller, Ronnes and Van der Linde asked whether the Ministry of Finance aligned its answers to earlier parliamentary questions on BKR (credit registration bureau) conduct with BKR itself, whether measures were agreed with BKR, and about free access to personal data. The minister replies that BKR was consulted on factual points and a proposed approach was adjusted, that BKR remains independent and decides on measures, and that free access under the GDPR is provided, with no limit on the number of requests.
It is customary that, to answer parliamentary questions, contact is sought with involved parties both inside and outside government.
Het is gebruikelijk dat ten behoeve van de beantwoording van Kamervragen contact wordt gezocht met betrokken partijen van binnen en buiten de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de berichten ‘ING ook in Italië laks met controle tegen witwaspraktijken’ en ‘Hoekstra: affaire ING in Italië verontrustend’

MP Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING was lax in anti-money-laundering controls in Italy and about the Minister's view of the gatekeeper failures, including whether the problem is broader than ING, what the Minister's contacts with other countries revealed, whether ING informs him of progress, and what role ING's supervisory board played. The Minister answered that he finds such signals worrying, that DNB supervises Dutch-based ING and Dutch branches while foreign subsidiaries fall under their home supervisors, that a post-mortem review of several European bank cases is underway, and that the supervisory board backed a recovery programme.
I have worked at European level to carry out a post-mortem review of these money-laundering cases at European banks.
Ik heb mij in Europees verband ingezet voor het uitvoeren van een post-mortem review naar deze witwaszaken bij Europese banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van der Linde over het bericht dat een Russische bank miljarden witwaste, ook via Nederlandse banken

MPs Sneller and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that a Russian bank laundered billions, partly through Dutch banks, and about ING's role and the EU high-risk third-country list. The minister said supervisory information on individual institutions is confidential, outlined DNB's AML enforcement powers, and explained the Netherlands' objection to the Commission's list on procedural grounds while declining to comment on individual cases or diplomatic communications.
Information on individual institutions is subject to supervisory confidentiality. DNB therefore cannot share this information, not even with your House or with me.
Informatie over individuele instellingen is toezichtsvertrouwelijk. DNB kan deze informatie daarom niet delen, ook niet met uw Kamer of met mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over een item in het programma Kanniewaarzijn

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether the government shares concern that older people and people on benefits struggle to get small mortgages, and whether lenders' duty of care and a 'no-fuss' rule for mortgages under 20-30% of WOZ value should be added. Minister Hoekstra answered that lenders choose their target groups, that a bagatelle rule is not responsible because home value does not reveal income, and that the government will raise remaining bottlenecks at the next Platform hypotheken meeting.
From the Platform hypotheken I currently have no signals that people with modest incomes lack mortgage options while this would be responsible.
Vanuit het Platform hypotheken heb ik op dit moment geen signalen dat mensen met een bescheiden inkomen geen hypotheekmogelijkheden hebben terwijl dit wel verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Wörsdörfer over de financieringsmogelijkheden van het midden- en kleinbedrijf en de financieringsmonitor van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about SME financing difficulties, the CBS Financing Monitor, and possible policy responses. The State Secretary answered that SME financing is riskier, that Dutch figures are broadly in line with European surveys, and that the government is supporting schemes such as BMKB, Qredits and financing tables, with a CPB study and a Kamerbrief promised.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Stresstest voor banken moet veel effectiever'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister whether EU bank stress tests are effective enough, following EBA chair Enria's criticism, and about Italian banks and possible gaming. The minister agreed there is room to improve methodology, defended the bottom-up EU approach and the disclosure of results, noted the EBA cannot impose capital requirements itself, and said that further changes are for supervisors and the Council, with the Netherlands pushing for balance-sheet reviews.
I cannot go into the results of individual banks in stress tests.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de resultaten van individuele banken in stresstesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Rabobank en ABN AMRO missen derivatendeadline’

MPs Van der Linde and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about reports that Rabobank and ABN AMRO missed the deadline for compensating SME clients affected by the derivatives scandal, and why the backlog persists. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the AFM is monitoring process optimisations and that banks have been told of parliament's displeasure, and noted that roughly 10,980 SME clients still lacked a definitive offer.
For that reason, I will, together with the AFM, continue to closely monitor that banks do everything possible to provide this clarity as quickly as possible.
Om die reden zal ik, samen met de AFM, goed blijven monitoren dat banken al het mogelijke blijven doen om deze duidelijkheid zo snel mogelijk te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het verhuren van dakruimte voor zonnepanelen

MPs asked whether mortgage lenders' ban on subletting blocks business owners from leasing roof space for solar panels, and whether government will intervene. The minister says lenders may set conditions, that the banking association has drafted a model deed to ease such leases, that existing subsidies suffice and that the matter is a private contractual relationship where government will not intervene.
There is no reason for the government to intervene in this contractual relationship.
Er is geen aanleiding voor de overheid om in te grijpen in deze contractuele relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de opmerkingen van president van De Nederlandsche Bank

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance whether banks' return-on-equity demands are too high and too risky, following remarks by the DNB president, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered that bank profitability has recovered with the economy, that risk-weighted capital rules and buffers already penalise risky activity, that supervision of individual banks rests with DNB, and that Dutch returns (9.1%) exceed the EU average (5.8%).
It is up to DNB, as an independent supervisor, to supervise the risks of individual banks.
Het is aan DNB, als onafhankelijke toezichthouder, om toezicht te houden op de risico's van individuele banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over Brussels gemorrel aan boekhoudregels'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that the European Commission wants to change international accounting rules (IFRS). The minister answered that the Commission is running a broad public consultation on corporate reporting, that Dutch government supports consistent IFRS application for international comparability, and that no formal proposal exists yet.
I cannot answer questions about French positions, since I cannot disclose positions that other member states take in EU meetings.
Vragen over Franse standpunten kan ik niet beantwoorden, aangezien ik standpunten die andere lidstaten in EU-vergaderingen innemen, niet naar buiten kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘banken ontdekken driehonderd mogelijke terrorismebetalingen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a reported bank-government pilot on terrorism financing data sharing, including its results, legal limits (Wpg article 20) and whether the law is too rigid. The minister answered that about 300 unusual transactions were reported in one year, over 60% passed to investigators, the pilot was extended to July 2019, and multilateral private data sharing is still being explored.
Your House is regularly informed about progress on initiatives to combat money laundering and terrorism financing.
Uw Kamer wordt regelmatig geïnformeerd over de voortgang van initiatieven op het gebied van het tegengaan van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Linde over het bericht ‘ING sluit een megaschikking met OM in witwaszaken’

Parliamentarian Van der Linde asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ING settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how it occurred, whether other banks are being engaged, why individuals were not prosecuted, and when the WODC report will be sent. The ministers answered that the case is exemplary for ING's shortcomings, that they will discuss integrity with the sector and will issue a policy response by year-end, and that individual prosecution was not possible under Dutch case law.
The Public Prosecution Service therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Verzekeraars gooien deur dicht voor taxichauffeurs’

MP Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about reports that insurers are refusing or pricing out taxi drivers and other high-risk businesses, and about Van Lanschot dropping certain clients. The minister acknowledges similar problems for recycling and agricultural firms, argues the taxi market is not as bleak as described, points to the Vereende pool and existing market mechanisms, and says competition authority ACM is watching.
I do not recognise the picture that since 1 January 2018 only a single insurer still provides insurance to taxis.
Het beeld dat vanaf 1 januari 2018 slechts een enkele verzekeraar nog verzekeringen verstrekt aan taxi’s herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Recordbedrag aan verdachte transacties gemeld bij FIU’ en het onderliggende jaaroverzicht van de FIU

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about the record value of suspicious transactions reported to the FIU, the FIU's share of undetected transactions, reporting compliance by sector, FIU capacity, and crypto-currency laundering patterns. The minister explained the 2017 rise by more reports and high-value transactions, stated the FIU does not itself detect transactions, pointed to supervisors for compliance, announced capacity expansion, and referred to the upcoming policy response.
Yes, I have hereby done so.
Ja, dat heb ik bij deze gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Becker over het bericht 'Chinese betaaldienst Alipay komt twintig Europese landen veroveren'

MPs Van der Linde and Becker asked about the expansion of Chinese payment service Alipay into Europe, its effects on the market, whether EU and Dutch rules (PSD2, GDPR) safeguard against unfair competition and privacy risks, and any link to China's social credit system. The minister answered that Alipay operates in NL under a UK licence via EU passporting, that PSD2 and GDPR apply equally to non-EU firms, and that Alipay denies involvement in the social credit system.
Whether Alipay intends to also offer the new payment services in the Netherlands is not known.
Of Alipay voornemens is om in Nederland ook de nieuwe betaaldiensten aan te bieden is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Paternotte over het bericht in het FD ‘Fintechs nog langer buitenspel door discussie tussen toezichthouders’

MPs Van der Linde and Paternotte asked the Finance Minister whether the delayed PSD2 implementation, linked to a dispute between the Dutch data protection authority and DNB over supervision, harms Dutch fintechs and what the ministry is doing to resolve it. The minister admitted the deadline was missed, explained a amendment making the AP the supervisor for the privacy consent requirement, and said there are no concrete signals of fintechs relocating abroad.
In addition, to better safeguard privacy protection, I have prepared an amendment to the bill implementing PSD2.
Daarnaast heb ik, om de bescherming van de privacy beter te borgen, een aanpassing van het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van PSD2 voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘ABN Amro stuurt buitenlanders terecht weg’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ABN Amro's refusal to serve clients permanently residing outside the EU, reported in the press, was an intended result of anti-money-laundering rules and whether such low-risk clients could be exempted, and raised questions on Dutch nationals' access to bank accounts, pensions, expatriates and the investment climate. The Minister answered that banks decide their own risk profiles, that EU rules give residents a right to a basic account, that other major banks may still serve such clients, and that the measures do not appear to harm the investment climate, without committing to change the rules.
It is up to the bank itself to decide whether it considers it possible and expedient to comply with the laws and regulations of the third country.
Het is aan de bank zelf om te beslissen of zij het mogelijk en opportuun acht om aan de wet- en regelgeving van het derde land te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Duizenden indextrackers afgesloten voor Nederlanders’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the PRIIP key information document rules, which led many index trackers to stop being offered to Dutch investors, conflict with free movement of capital and whether a foreign-language option should be allowed. The minister answered that the rules are EU-harmonised, that most withdrawn products simply lack a KID, and that the AFM deliberately did not use the option to accept other languages, so no change is planned.
The purpose of the key information document is to give the consumer insight into, among other things, the workings, risks, costs and expected return of the product
Het doel van het essentiële-informatiedocument is om de consument inzicht te geven in onder andere de werking, risico's, kosten en het verwachte rendement van het product
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Groeiend aantal gemeenten weigert contant geld aan balie’

MPs asked whether the government knows of the growing number of municipalities refusing cash at service counters, for a list of those municipalities, and how people who cannot pay by card can still pay. The minister confirmed awareness, gave a 2016 list of 21 pin-only municipalities noting others have since adopted it, and said exceptions are made in practice, such as bank transfers, authorisations or home visits, while affirming access to cash must be preserved.
There is no complete and conclusive overview of all municipalities that apply a pin-only policy at municipal public counters.
Er is geen compleet en sluitend overzicht van alle gemeenten die een pin-only beleid hanteren bij gemeentelijke publieksbalies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Huizenkoper bij bank duizenden euro’s duurder uit dan bij onafhankelijk adviseur’

MPs Van der Linde and Koerhuis asked whether a report showing bank-channel mortgage buyers pay more than those using independent advisers reflects reality, and what the government will do about competition and transparency. The minister said he cannot confirm the survey's findings, sees no signals of insufficient competition or transparency, and will examine how the advisory-cost disclosure document (dienstverleningsdocument) can be improved, with a follow-up letter to Parliament.
I cannot confirm the results of this study.
Ik kan de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘ING Bank wil niet verder met alFitrah vanwege transacties uit Koeweit’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ING Bank ending its relationship with the alFitrah foundation over suspicious transactions linked to Kuwait, and about money-laundering controls generally. The minister answered that banks must monitor transactions and may terminate client relationships under the Wwft and duty of care, that DNB and AFM supervise compliance, that the fourth anti-money-laundering directive strengthens the framework, and that an evaluation by WODC is underway, but declined to judge the specific case.
It is not for me to give a judgement on a specific case, in this case the breach of trust between ING Bank and the Stichting alFitrah.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te geven over een concreet geval, in casu de vertrouwensbreuk tussen ING Bank en de Stichting alFitrah.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Aandelenbeurzen niet gelukkig met nieuwe handelsregels'

Van der Linde (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about reports that stock exchanges were unhappy with new MiFID II trading rules, including a shift of trades from transparent venues to less transparent systematic internalisers, and about monitoring and evaluation. Minister Hoekstra answered that available evidence shows a shift toward transparent venues rather than away from them, that ESMA is working to harmonise tick sizes, and that evaluation clauses require reports from the European Commission.
I will inform your House of the results of the market consultation on the tick size rules carried out by ESMA.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de door ESMA uitgevoerde marktconsultatie van de tick size regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over pensioenopbouw van zwangere huisartsen

Two VVD MPs asked why self-employed doctors lose pension accrual in occupational pension schemes during pregnancy and whether this will be fixed. The state secretary explained the causes (lower income and a fiscal part-time factor, visible three years later), noted that self-employed people can compensate via the third pillar, and committed to removing fiscal barriers in the end-of-year decree 2018.

I intend to arrange that there are no fiscal obstacles preventing these self-employed professionals from accruing pension within their own occupational or sector pension scheme on the same income as before the pregnancy.

ben ik voornemens te gaan regelen dat er geen fiscale belemmeringen zijn om deze zelfstandige beroepsbeoefenaren binnen de eigen beroeps- of bedrijfstakpensioenregeling over hetzelfde inkomen pensioen te laten opbouwen als vóór de zwangerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Maatregelen tegen witwassen weinig effectief'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report calling anti-money-laundering measures ineffective, including the WODC risk assessment's methodology and the lack of rules on virtual currencies. The minister defended the WODC National Risk Assessments as a sound basis for risk-based policy, noted EU agreement to bring crypto platforms under anti-money-laundering rules, and promised further WODC policy monitors and an integrated policy response.
When these policy monitors on money laundering and terrorist financing are available, they will be sent to your House and an integrated policy response will be prepared.
Wanneer deze beleidsmonitors witwassen en terrorismefinanciering beschikbaar zijn, zullen deze aan uw Kamer worden gezonden en zal een integrale beleidsreactie worden voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Van der Linde over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Hermans and Van der Linde asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports of a student intake cap (numerus fixus) for nursing programmes despite a nursing shortage, including its causes, internship availability and the Utrecht case. The minister answered that fixus programmes fell from 56 to 33, that caps protect quality and internship places, that internship capacity has grown, and that the Utrecht university of applied sciences is moving to a cap of 400 full-time students.
The main reason for a programme to introduce a numerus fixus is to maintain the quality of the programme and to offer students sufficient and good-quality internship places.

De voornaamste reden voor een opleiding om een numerus fixus in te stellen is om de kwaliteit van de opleiding te behouden en om voor de studenten voldoende en kwalitatief goede stageplekken te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht dat 62% van de studenten in het dagelijks leven prestatiedruk ervaart

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that 62% of students often experience performance pressure, questioning the methodology and whether high performance pressure is a problem. The Minister defended both surveys as methodologically sound, rejected the inference that 38% experience little pressure, and said she is consulting institutions on a motion and will inform parliament in spring 2018.
I expect to be able to inform your House in spring 2018 about the implementation of the motion.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2018 over de uitwerking van de motie te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Van Oosten en Van der Linde over de viersporigheid van het treinverkeer tussen Rotterdam en Schiedam n.a.v. een werkbezoek op 23 januari jl.

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about keeping intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum and the four-track option between Rotterdam and Schiedam after a site visit. The State Secretary answered that the intercity stop may be kept only if four tracks are built and a study is ongoing, with no negotiations started and no Schiedam Kethel study reopened.
The study commissioned by the MRDH and carried out by ProRail shows that with PHS the existing Intercity stop by the Amsterdam-The Hague-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen service cannot be maintained.

Uit het onderzoek, dat in opdracht van de MRDH door ProRail is uitgevoerd, blijkt dat met PHS de bestaande Intercity-stop door de Intercitydienst Amsterdam-Den Haag-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen niet kan worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Van der Linde, Albert de Vries en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat er chaos dreigt door nieuwe zienswijze van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

Four MPs asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service, on behalf of the Finance Minister, about the AFM's new view that mortgages must be tested against the lending norms in force when the binding offer is issued rather than at application, which could cause chaos for applicants. The Minister answered that a transition period until 1 February 2017 was agreed with the sector and the WEW for applications filed before 2017, that the AFM will take this into account in supervision, and that the timing of tests is a matter of clarifying the MCD-based rules.
For mortgage applications submitted before 1 January 2017 where the creditworthiness test for the binding offer takes place by 1 February 2017 at the latest, the 2016 lending norms may be applied.

Voor hypotheekaanvragen die zijn ingediend voor 1 januari 2017 waarbij de kredietwaardigheidstoets ten behoeve van het bindend aanbod uiterlijk 1 februari 2017 plaatsvindt, er met de leennormen van 2016 mag worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het artikel ‘Wet Doorstroming Huurmarkt: De huurovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd met een minimale huurtermijn, kan dat nog’

MP Van der Linde asks whether the new temporary rental contracts under the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt could undermine minimum rental terms in open-ended leases, and whether the law should be clarified. The minister denies intending any such effect, says no clarification is necessary, and acknowledges that a minimum rental term is understandable for landlords.
No, with the introduction of the temporary rental contracts for a fixed term I did not intend to undermine the common practice among commercial landlords of applying a minimum contract duration.

Nee, ik heb met de introductie van de tijdelijke huurcontracten voor bepaalde tijd niet beoogd afbreuk te doen aan de gangbare praktijk onder commerciële verhuurders van het hanteren van een minimumcontractsduur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "Woonbootbewoners tussen wal en schip"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked about ING ceasing mortgages for houseboats, leaving only one provider, and whether banks should be able to offer tailored products. The minister says the market is commercially unattractive due to complexity and low volume, sees no regulatory obstacles in financial rules, notes a forthcoming houseboat mooring-tenancy law, and will monitor developments.
I have actively followed developments in recent months and will continue to do so in the coming period.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen de afgelopen maanden actief gevolgd en zal dit de komende periode ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Bank straft trouwe klant”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks refuse bridging loans to retirees who no longer need a mortgage, and whether regulation causes this, plus solutions and whether NVB claims regulation hinders tailored service to seniors. The minister says no standard bridging loan exists without a mortgage, regulation does not block it, some banks offer it case by case, and a study and a maatwerk platform will examine the practice.
As far as I am aware, no lender offers a bridging loan as a standard product when no mortgage product is attached.
Voor zover mij bekend biedt geen enkele kredietverstrekker standaard de mogelijkheid om een overbruggingskrediet af te sluiten indien er geen hypotheekproduct aan is verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Amsterdam gaat huurders financieel bijstaan

MPs Moors and Van der Linde asked the ministers about Amsterdam's plan to financially support tenants through rent reductions funded by the municipality and their view on using poverty funds against costly housing. The government answered that existing rent instruments suffice, that the Amsterdam approach is individual case-based and grounded in local agreements rather than the Participatiewet, and that municipalities and corporations each carry defined responsibilities.

Incidentally, it has come to my attention that Amsterdam does not base this policy on the Participatiewet, but is an elaboration of the cooperation agreements between the tenants' association, the federation of housing corporations and the municipality of Amsterdam.
Overigens is mij gebleken dat Amsterdam het onderhavige beleid niet baseert op de Participatiewet, maar betreft het een Uitwerking van de Samenwerkingsafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het artikel ‘Bouw faalt als keurmeester van zichzelf’

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report that construction failed as its own inspector in The Hague, and about how the Den Haag pilot relates to other quality-assurance experiments and the pending Kwaliteitsborging bill. The minister answered that residents have no cause for alarm because municipal oversight and warranty guarantees apply, and described the pilots as tests of instruments for the planned new quality-assurance system.
The municipality of The Hague actively ensures it receives the handover files as quickly as possible and that any repairs are carried out adequately.
De gemeente Den Haag ziet er actief op toe dat zij de opleverdossiers zo snel mogelijk ontvangt en dat eventueel herstel adequaat wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen Van der Linde en Van Vliet over het artikel ‘De Key staat Airbnb toe in sociale huurhuizen’

MPs Van der Linde and Van Vliet asked the Minister for Housing whether he knew of, was consulted about, and would act against a plan by housing corporation De Key to allow Airbnb-style tourist rentals of social rental homes. The minister said he opposes such use, that corporations currently do not permit it, that De Key has dropped the experiment, and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties could intervene if such a plan proceeded.
If the Aw is of the opinion that statutory provisions are at stake through the conduct of a housing corporation, it can intervene by means of an intervention.
Indien de Aw van oordeel is dat de wettelijke bepalingen in het geding zijn door het handelen van een woningcorporatie, dan kan zij door middel van een interventie ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Veldman over vleermuizen die bouwprojecten belemmeren

MPs Van der Linde and Veldman asked about bats (vleermuizen) blocking construction projects and housing for migrants under the Flora and Fauna Act, and whether the upcoming Environment Act could prevent delays. The minister answered that the government commissioned research into the economic effects and will respond, that about 250 exemptions were granted in 2014-2015 without data on stoppages, and that integrated planning, provincial responsibility under the Nature Conservation Act and standardised project approaches can prevent delays.
I have commissioned research into the problem and its economic consequences.
Ik heb onderzoek laten doen naar de problematiek en de economische gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Azmani over het rapport ‘Rotterdamse aanpak statushouders, 2016 – 2020’ van het Rotterdamse college van burgemeester en wethouders

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Rotterdam report attributing its backlog in housing status holders to problems with IND documents, BSN numbers and file completeness. The government answered that it does not share that conclusion, outlined the registration and information-exchange arrangements and existing support teams, and gave the number of permit holders awaiting housing.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, die conclusie deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht «ING stopt met watervilla hypotheken»

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about ING ending houseboat mortgages, the market consequences, and how to attract new providers. The minister confirmed ING is the largest player, that Rabobank will remain the only provider, and that the government will consult the Dutch banking association on new entrants.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and it will be asked what ideas they have to ensure more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en gevraagd worden welke ideeën zij hebben om ervoor te zorgen dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Te hoge hypotheken verstrekt door verwarring over regels’

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked whether lenders wrongly granted NHG mortgages up to 106% LTV based on minimal energy-saving measures, whether homeowners are harmed, and how rules and oversight should respond. The minister confirmed some lenders breached the rules, attributed partial confusion to WEW guidance, said homeowners face no tax loss, and that WEW clarified its norms and the AFM will inventory the problem.
It is correct that a number of institutions granted mortgages with an LTV of 106% without the full additional financing room being spent on energy-saving measures.
Het klopt dat een aantal instellingen hypotheken hebben verstrekt met een LTV van 106% zonder dat de volledige extra financieringsruimte is besteed aan energiebesparende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Oosten en Van der Linde over het boek ““Wat niet mag, kan nog steeds”; kraakhandleiding 2015/2016”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a squatting handbook with tips on illegal occupation should be tolerated, whether its publication is punishable, and whether a Hogeschool van Amsterdam staff member's study time was misused to write it. The minister said the book is inappropriate but that judging free speech limits is not for him, referred the criminal question to the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to local administrative enforcement powers, and said the college's work was an 1 individual student's responsibility after checking that the original paper concerned legal policy.
As the title suggests, the authors of the book are aware that squatting is a punishable offence.
Zoals uit de titel valt af te leiden, zijn de schrijvers van het boek ermee bekend dat kraken een strafbare handeling is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht: ‘Geen voordeel verzekeraar meer bij NHG-lening’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Solvency II rules that deny insurers the risk-reducing effect of the NHG mortgage guarantee, and the late communication of this, will raise NHG mortgage rates and distort competition. The minister confirmed the problem, said DNB rightly sees no legal room to recognise NHG under the current standard formula, pledged to work with DNB to fix it in the 2018 review, and argued the effect on rates and competition would be small.

Once the European Commission starts the evaluation of the delegated acts, expected to be completed in 2018, the Ministry of Finance will work together with DNB to resolve this omission in the Solvency II framework recently identified by DNB.

Zodra de Europese Commissie de evaluatie van de gedelegeerde handelingen opstart, waarvan de afronding is voorzien in 2018, zal het Ministerie van Financiën zich gezamenlijk met DNB inzetten om deze onlangs door DNB geconstateerde omissie in het Solvabiliteit II kader op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over een mogelijke fout in het Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte

An MP asked whether a drafting error caused a discrepancy between the draft and final Besluit huurprijzen woonruimte, and whether amendment is needed. The minister confirmed an administrative error during a redaction change and committed to amending the decree as soon as possible.
There is a difference resulting from an administrative error during an amendment for editorial reasons.
Er is sprake van een verschil als gevolg van een administratieve misslag bij een aanpassing om redactionele redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en De Caluwé over het inzicht van verhuurders in adresinschrijvingen

MPs Van der Linde and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior how landlords can access information on who is registered at their properties, and whether this helps reduce fraud and nuisance. The Minister answered that systematic access is not possible under BRP and data protection law, and pointed to municipal cooperation and landlords' own responsibilities as alternatives.

This is contrary to legislation (BRP and Wbp) and would open the door to the undesirable situation that personal data under government responsibility could be provided to all commercial organisations and private individuals.

Dit is in strijd met wetgeving (BRP en Wbp) en zou de deur openzetten naar de onwenselijke situatie dat persoonsgegevens die vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid, verstrekt kunnen worden aan alle commerciële organisaties en particulieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Huizenbezitters betalen te veel rente voor hun spaarhypotheek"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks charging a risk surcharge on savings mortgages despite substantial savings balances overcharge homeowners, whether banks are transparent about this, and whether the AFM has investigated. The minister replied that the effect depends on savings balance and tax rate, that consumer information rules apply, and that the AFM has not studied risk surcharges structurally but has challenged a few providers on signals and will continue to hold providers to account where needed.
The AFM will also hold mortgage providers to account on this in the future, where necessary.
De AFM zal hypotheekverstrekkers hier – waar nodig – ook in de toekomst op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Linde over het bericht dat de Staat de bouwsector genadeloos uiteen speelt

VVD MPs asked the minister whether the state shifts nearly all project risks onto construction firms under DBFM(O) contracts, whether projects have become too large, and how contracts reflect the Aanbestedingswet evaluation and bankruptcy risk. The minister rejects the criticism, says risks are allocated to the party best able to bear them, and promises to review contracts after the evaluation in summer.
I do not recognise myself in the criticism.
Ik herken me niet in de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "ABN AMRO CFO: Nieuwe kapitaalbodems kunnen buffer hard raken"

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a report that international supervisors plan capital floors per loan type that could hit Dutch banks' capital buffers, and about effects on mortgages, SME lending and securitisation. The minister answered that the Basel Committee is consulting on a new floor based on the standardised approach and a revised standardised approach, that effects depend on final design and are likely to raise risk-weighted assets for large Dutch banks, that the government will watch for disproportionate impacts, and that existing EU securitisation rules remain in force.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Neppérus en Van Oosten over het bericht dat de gemeenten de macronorm voor OZB-stijging weer overschrijden

MPs Van der Linde, Neppérus and Van Oosten asked whether municipalities again exceed the 3% macro norm on OZB property tax increases and how this can be prevented. Minister Plasterk answered that the figures are not yet confirmed (COELO data due end March), that the norm was exceeded in four of the past seven years with limited cumulative effect, and that the matter is a shared municipal responsibility discussed in the annual Bofv consultation without committing to new measures.
Whether or not the macro norm is exceeded is a responsibility of the municipalities together.
Het al of niet overschrijden van de macronorm is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten tezamen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van der Linde over beschikbaar kapitaal voor woningen dat niet geïnvesteerd kan worden

MPs Monasch and Van der Linde asked whether they know that around 650 million euro of investable capital cannot be placed in housing due to a lack of products, and asked about the causes (land prices) and solutions. The minister answers that record investment of about 3 billion euro was made in 2014, that the market should balance supply and demand without a direct government matching role, and points to housing reforms, corporate sales to investors and transformation of vacant buildings.
It is up to the market itself to bring about a balance between supply and demand.
Het is aan de markt zelf om een balans tussen vraag en aanbod tot stand te laten komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters, Van der Linde en Visser over het bericht ‘Social return kost taxichauffeurs baan’

MPs Potters, Van der Linde and Visser asked the State Secretary about reports that social return requirements displaced taxi drivers, including KNV's claim that 5,000 drivers lost jobs, and about the expertise and monitoring of such placements. The State Secretary acknowledged displacement concerns, said she cannot calculate social costs or judge individual firms, stated that re-integration is a municipal responsibility, and that no central data exist on sustainability of placements, while noting that the central government drops social return where displacement risk is real.
With the introduction of the WWB in 2004, implementation of the law became the responsibility of municipalities.
Met de introductie van de WWB in 2004 behoort de uitvoering van de wet tot de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Eis Haagse politiek ontmoedigt vervroegd aflossen hypotheek’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the planned 4% leverage ratio for systemically important banks would discourage early mortgage repayment by narrowing risk-based rate differences and raising mortgage rates. The minister rejected that premise, arguing the leverage ratio is designed alongside risk-weighted requirements, and said he does not expect banks to make early repayment less attractive or to cause substantial unwanted behaviour effects.
The cabinet's vision for the Dutch banking sector explicitly states that it pursues a higher leverage ratio of at least 4% in conjunction with the increase in risk-weighted capital requirements.

In de Kabinetsvisie Nederlandse bankensector is echter expliciet aangegeven dat het kabinet een hogere leverage ratio van minimaal 4% nastreeft in samenhang met de stijging van de risicogewogen kapitaaleisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van der Linde, Verhoeven, De Rouwe en Baay-Timmerman over gouden handdrukken bij woningcorporatie Rochdale

MPs asked the Minister for Housing about severance payments of about 4.5 million euros at housing corporation Rochdale, including whether tenants were effectively paying for them and whether the sums could be reclaimed. The Minister answered that the payments were made under a social plan to five non-top employees, that no legal framework was breached, that no recovery is possible, and promised to look into comparable rules in Germany and Denmark later.
That possibility does not exist, because there is no question of excessive severance payments in relation to the Normalisation of Top Incomes Act or the Housing Act.
Die mogelijkheid is er niet, omdat er geen sprake is van te hoge ontslagvergoedingen in relatie tot de Wet Normering Topinkomens of de Woningwet.
Vragen van het lid Van der Linde (VVD) aan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over een bezoek aan de Margrietstraat in Rotterdam (ingezonden 28 april 2014).

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about foundation damage and possible evacuation of homes in Rotterdam's Margrietstraat caused by nearby demolition, asking about demolition rules, liability, early intervention and a pilot project. The minister answered that the municipality issued permits and set conditions, that liability follows the Civil Code with municipalities liable only for serious negligence, and that the national government has no role, while noting the pilot is for the municipality to pursue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Van der Linde over het bericht dat criminelen zich laten uitschrijven uit de GBA en daarmee belasting ontduiken

Two VVD MPs asked whether criminals deregister from the GBA population register to evade tax, what revenue is lost, whether the new BRP accounts for this, how data is exchanged with other countries, and how emigration of Dutch non-residents is tracked. The minister said losses cannot be quantified since criminal activity is hidden by definition (FIOD research ongoing), explained the BRP's new fines for false registration and non-resident registration, and described limited direct data exchange abroad and municipal verification and reporting mechanisms.
For that reason it is by definition not possible to give concrete figures on this.
Daarom is het per definitie niet mogelijk om hierover concrete cijfers te geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Azmani en Van der Linde over signalen dat Sint Maarten zich bij het verlenen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit niet houdt aan de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs Bosman, Azmani and Van der Linde asked whether signals exist that Sint Maarten grants Dutch nationality in breach of the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap, and whether the Sint Maarten Justice Minister wants to ease passport grants for immigrants, along with related questions. The state secretary answered that such signals are unknown, that the Sint Maarten minister disavowed the newspaper report and said only the Kingdom government may grant nationality, and that the rules should remain uniform across the Kingdom.
Signals as referred to in the first question are not known to us.
Signalen als bedoeld in de eerste vraag zijn ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over leegstand van het CBS-gebouw in Leidschendam-Voorburg

An MP asked the Minister for Housing and Government Service about the long-vacant CBS building in Leidschendam-Voorburg, including fire-safety, vacancy costs (about 2.4 million euro for 2008-2012, 150,000 euro in 2013), book value, budget and sale negotiations with the municipality. The Minister answered each question, confirmed the building is vacant and the sale is open to bids, and gave figures, while stating that no procedural agreements with the municipality currently exist.
The property has been vacant since 1 September 2008. The vacancy costs from 2008 through 2012 amount to approximately € 2.4 million.
Het object staat sinds 1 september 2008 leeg. De leegstandskosten bedragen sinds 2008 t/m 2012 ca. € 2,4 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het artikel «Politiek verslikt zich in bezuinigingsoperatie auditfuncties»

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked the government whether a newspaper article about cuts to internal audit functions, including centralisation into the Auditdienst Rijk and reliance on external hiring, was accurate and how it fits the goal of efficiency. The minister rejected the claims of a duplication and monopoly, said the Auditdienst Rijk remains each department's internal audit function, and explained that framework contracts reduce external hiring costs while no new action is planned.
The Auditdienst Rijk is and remains the internal audit function of the individual departments.
De Auditdienst Rijk is en blijft de interne auditfunctie van de afzonderlijke departementen.

m: Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over alle gemeenten deel laten nemen aan de Benchmark Huishoudelijk Afval
Motion urges municipalities not yet participating to join the household waste benchmark and report results to the Chamber.
requests the government to strongly urge all non-participating municipalities to join the 2017 benchmark
verzoekt de regering, alle nog niet deelnemende gemeenten met klem aan te sporen om deel te nemen aan de benchmark peiljaar 2017
