Motie van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over streefwaarden voor luchtkwaliteit
Asks the government to have the Health Council propose air quality target values to guide a new national air plan.
requests the government to ask the Health Council, based on the study to be completed in November, to come up with target values for air quality
verzoekt de regering, de Gezondheidsraad op basis van het in november af te ronden onderzoek alsnog te verzoeken te komen met streefwaarden voor luchtkwaliteit
Amendement van de leden Dijkgraaf en Van Veldhoven over een overgangsregeling voor lopende contracten
Exempts from the bill supply contracts entered into before publication, until they expire, for up to five years after the act takes effect.
This act does not apply to the supply of goods or services for which the obligation was entered into before the date of issue of the Staatsblad in which it is published.
Deze wet is niet van toepassing op de levering van goederen of diensten waarvoor de verplichting is aangegaan voor de datum van uitgifte van het Staatsblad waarin zij wordt geplaatst
Amendement van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dijkgraaf over een vrijstellingsmogelijkheid voor ondernemingen
Allows general administrative orders to exempt categories of businesses from the child labour due diligence law, without a parliamentary consent step beyond a four-week wait.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order, categories of enterprises are exempted from the provisions of or pursuant to this Act
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden categorieën ondernemingen vrijgesteld van het bepaalde bij of krachtens deze wet
Amendement van de leden Dijkgraaf en Van Veldhoven over geen verplichting voor ondernemingen tot afgifte verklaring in geval van reeds afgegeven verklaring door toeleverancier
Exempts companies that buy only from suppliers who already filed a due diligence declaration from having to file their own declaration.
legal certainty for companies is increased.
en wordt de rechtszekerheid voor ondernemingen vergroot.
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven over het laten vervallen van de gasaansluitingsplicht voor nieuwbouwwoningen
Amendment removing the gas connection obligation for new-build homes and giving the competent authority a say, with the consumer market regulator ACM assessing efficiency.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets assesses the weighing of requesting connections against efficiency
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt beoordeelt de afweging om te verzoeken om aansluitingen aan de doelmatigheid
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Voordewind en Van Veldhoven ter vervanging van nr. 11 over te hanteren leeftijdsgrenzen voor kinderarbeid
Sets child labour age limits in the Labour Act to follow ILO conventions: minimum age 15 with light-work exception from 13, and ban on worst forms up to 18.
This amendment provides that the age limits for child labour follow those set in international conventions.
Dit amendement regelt dat de leeftijdsgrenzen voor kinderarbeid worden gehanteerd zoals vastgelegd in internationale conventies.
Motie van de leden Voordewind  en Van Veldhoven over het op vrijwillige basis openstellen van het register vanaf 2018
Asks the government to open the child-labour due diligence register on a voluntary basis from 2018, ahead of mandatory entry into force in 2020.
requests the government to open the register on a voluntary basis from 2018
verzoekt de regering om, het register op vrijwillige basis al vanaf 2018 open te stellen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Voordewind en Van Veldhoven ter vervanging van nr. 15 over te hanteren leeftijdsgrenzen voor kinderarbeid
Replaces the child labour definition in the bill with a broader one based on ILO conventions and the Wet bestuurlijke boete definition.
This amendment provides that the same definition of child labour as in the Wet bestuurlijke boete will be used in this law.
Dit amendement regelt dat voor kinderarbeid in deze wet dezelfde definitie gehanteerd gaat worden
Amendement van de leden Voordewind en Van Veldhoven ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het via één centraal punt openbaar maken van verklaringen
Requires the supervisor to publish due diligence declarations on child labour in a public, searchable register on its website so consumers can see company efforts.
The supervisor publishes the declarations in a public register on its website.
De toezichthouder publiceert de verklaringen in een openbaar register op zijn website.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven ter vervanging van nr. 12 over de mogelijkheid om de wet bij koninklijk besluit te laten vervallen
Allows the law to be repealed by royal decree at a time to be set, after an evaluation is sent to the Chamber.
This law lapses at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet vervalt op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip
Amendement van de leden Van Veldhoven en Sjoerdsma over aanvullende middelen voor opvang in de regio
Shifts 40 million euro within the development budget from one article to another to fund reception in the region for refugees.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 40,000 euro (x 1,000 euro)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 40.000 (x € 1.000)
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven over de mogelijkheid om de wet bij koninklijk besluit te laten vervallen
Amendment letting the child labour law lapse by royal decree at a time set after the effectiveness evaluation is sent to parliament.
This law lapses at a time to be determined by royal decree
Deze wet vervalt op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip
Amendement van het lid Voordewind c.s. over verhoging van het budget voor de Dutch Relief Alliance
Moves 12.6 million euro from one budget article to the Dutch Relief Alliance humanitarian fund, reallocating within the foreign aid budget.

verzoekt de regering alle projecten uit het programma Ruimte voor de Rivier volledig uit te voeren en gelden die voor dit programma gereserveerd staan, hiervoor te behouden
Motie Van Veldhoven over windenergieparken op zee
Asks the government to extend the lifetime of unused offshore wind park permits to 2020 and make them tradable between market parties.
requests the government to extend the lifetime of the permits in question until 2020 and make them tradable between market parties
verzoekt de regering om de levensduur van de vergunningen in kwestie te verlengen tot 2020 en deze verhandelbaar te maken tussen marktpartijen
Motie Van Veldhoven c.s. over natte infrastructuur
Motion asks the government to allocate part of the 500 million euro to wet infrastructure (water), within the budget.
requests the government to make part of the 500 million available for wet infrastructure
verzoekt de regering een deel van de 500 mln. beschikbaar te stellen voor natte infrastructuur
Motie Jacobi en Van Veldhoven over de normstelling waterveiligheid
Asks the government to finish the debate on new water safety standards before making dike investment decisions based on the 2010 inventory.
requests the government first to conclude the discussion on the new standard and only then take the investment decisions
verzoekt de regering eerst de discussie over de nieuwe normstelling af te ronden en pas daarna de investeringsbeslissingen te nemen
Motie Lucas c.s. over het tweede Deltaprogramma
Asks the government to design a process approach for the second Delta Programme based on the Sneller & Beter approach, with clear phase deadlines and early market involvement.
requests the government to design a process approach in the second Delta Programme based on the Sneller & Beter approach
verzoekt de regering in het tweede Deltaprogramma een procesaanpak te ontwerpen op basis van de Sneller & Beter-aanpak
Motie Van Veldhoven en Jacobi over de drinkwaterketen
Asks the government to take the initiative for a chain-based approach to the drinking water supply chain to make it smarter, cheaper and more sustainable.
requests the government to take the initiative for a chain approach to the drinking water chain
verzoekt de regering om het initiatief te nemen tot een ketenbenadering van de drinkwaterketen
Motie Voortman c.s. over aanpassing van het energielabel
Motion asking the government to adapt the energy label so landlords of non-self-contained housing can more easily qualify for the energy investment deduction.
requests the government to come with proposals to adapt the energy label so that landlords of non-self-contained housing can more easily qualify for the energy investment deduction.

verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen om het energielabel zodanig aan te passen dat verhuurders van onzelfstandige woonruimtes makkelijker in aanmerking kunnen komen voor de energie-investerings aftrek
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over terugdraaien versobering van de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water
Asks the government to reverse the scaling back of Water Framework Directive implementation and find alternative funding to avoid local tax increases.
requests the government to reverse the scaling back of the implementation of the Water Framework Directive
verzoekt de regering de versobering van de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water terug te draaien
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over het aandeel duurzaam gecertificeerd tropisch hardhout

Asks the government to work with the sector in 2011 on a step plan to raise certified sustainable tropical hardwood in Dutch construction to 100% within five years, possibly by excluding uncertified wood in the Bouwbesluit.
requests the government to work with the sector in 2011 on developing a step plan
verzoekt de regering om zich in 2011 in overleg met de sector in te zetten voor het uitwerken van een stappenplan
Motie-Dijkgraaf c.s. over een inventarisatie van overslagplekken
Motion asks the government to inventory available cargo transshipment sites in consultation with municipalities and inland shipping organisations.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities and inland shipping organisations, to inventory which transshipment sites are currently available
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg met gemeenten en binnenvaartorganisaties, te inventariseren welke overslagplekken thans beschikbaar zijn
Motie-Samsom c.s. over maatregelen om overschrijding van Europese luchtkwaliteitsnormen te voorkomen
Motion asking the government to present a costed package of measures by 1 January 2011 to prevent exceedance of European air quality norms.
requests the government to present to the House by 1 January 2011 a costed package of measures
verzoekt de regering om voor 1 januari 2011 een doorgerekend pakket van maatregelen aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over een aanscherping van de Europese doelstelling voor CO2-beperking
Asks the government to work for tightening the EU 2020 CO2 reduction target to 26 percent.
requests the government to work in the meantime for tightening the European CO2 reduction target for 2020 to 26%
verzoekt de regering zich in de tussentijd in te spannen voor het aanscherpen van de Europese doelstelling voor CO 2 -beperking in 2020 tot 26%
Motie-Van Tongeren c.s. over volledige informatie aan de Kamer over de plannen voor nieuwe kerncentrales
Asks the government to publicly release all correspondence from the past five years with third parties on new nuclear plants, placing commercially sensitive parts confidentially before the Chamber.

requests the government to make public all correspondence the government has conducted with third parties over the past five years on building and operating new nuclear power plants, including meeting reports

verzoekt de regering alle correspondentie die de regering in de afgelopen vijf jaar met derden gevoerd heeft over de bouw en exploitatie van nieuwe kerncentrales, inclusief verslagen van gesprekken, openbaar te maken
Motie-Ouwehand c.s. over voorkomen van onherstelbaar biodiversiteitverlies
Asks the government to ensure no irreversible biodiversity loss occurs in state waters designated as Natura 2000 areas.
requests the government to ensure that no irreversible biodiversity loss occurs in the state waters
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat er geen onherstelbaar biodiversiteitverlies optreedt in de rijkswateren
Motie-Van Tongeren c.s. over opstellen van specifieke CO2-reductiedoelen voor de sectoren verkeer, landbouw en bebouwde omgeving
Asks the government to set specific CO2 reduction targets for the transport, agriculture and built environment sectors.
Motie-Van Tongeren/Van Veldhoven over het aanjagen van financiering voor groene projecten
Asks the government to make agreements with lenders to stimulate financing for green projects within its green deal.
requests the government to make agreements with credit providers on stimulating financing for green projects within its green deal
verzoekt de regering om in het kader van haar green deal in elk geval afspraken te maken met kredietverstrekkers over het aanjagen van financiering voor groene projecten
Motie-Jansen c.s. over uitvoering van de motie-Polderman (29675, nr. 54) uit 2008
Asks the government to start in 2011 implementing the earlier Polderman motion by securing spatial claims in the National Water Plan and drafting a starting document for a North Sea spatial plan.
requests the government to start implementing the Polderman motion in 2011
verzoekt de regering om in 2011 te starten met de uitvoering van de motie-Polderman
Motie-Ouwehand c.s. over een meer plantaardig eetpatroon
Asks the government to act on climate policy in line with a shift toward a more plant-based diet and against intensifying livestock farming.
requests the government to act accordingly in its climate policy
verzoekt de regering dienovereenkomstig te handelen in haar klimaatbeleid
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over het opsporen van invoer van illegaal gekapt hout
Asks the government to push in EU channels for stronger joint customs checks on timber imports to detect illegally felled wood.
requests the government to work within the EU in 2011 for a greater joint effort in customs work to check timber imports
verzoekt de regering om zich in 2011 in EU-verband in te zetten voor een grotere gezamenlijke inspanning bij douanewerkzaamheden ter controle van de invoer van hout
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven over het temporiseren van de versobering van de activiteiten ten behoeve van de kaderrichtlijn water
Shifts €10 million within the transport ministry's budget from business support to the integrated water policy article to temper cuts to the Water Framework Directive activities.
The purpose of this amendment is to temper the scaling back of activities for the Water Framework Directive.
De bedoeling van dit amendement is om de versobering van de activiteiten ten behoeve van kaderrichtlijn water te temporiseren.
Motie Koppejan c.s. over een bestuursakkoord tussen Rijk en waterschappen
Asks the government to conclude a governance agreement with the water boards on cost-neutral absorption of the 100 million euro financing shift and annual performance comparison.
requests the government to conclude a governance agreement between the water boards and the central government by 1 March 2011
verzoekt de regering voor 1 maart 2011 een bestuursakkoord te sluiten tussen de waterschappen en het Rijk
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het oormerken van gelden voor de kwetsbare natuurwaarde van de BES-eilanden
Shifts a sum of 600 thousand euro within the budget from the nominal and unforeseen reserve to earmark it for nature protection on the BES islands.
This amendment explicitly aims to establish that these funds benefit the drafting and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven over het oormerken van gelden voor de kwetsbare natuurwaarde van de BES-eilanden
Earmarks 600 thousand euro within the budget for nature protection on the BES islands, to be kept structurally after 2011.
This amendment aims to explicitly lay down that these funds benefit the drawing up and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan.
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven C.S. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het oormerken van gelden voor de kwetsbare natuurwaarde van de BES-eilanden
Earmarks existing funds in the nominal and unforeseen budget item for an integrated nature management plan for the BES islands.
This amendment explicitly aims to establish that these funds benefit the drafting and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven over robuuste verbindingen
Budget amendment moving funds from the general article to nature to repair robust ecological corridor projects, financed by cutting external ICT hiring at DICTU.
Funding is found by cutting back external ICT hiring within DICTU
Dekking hiervoor wordt gevonden door de versobering van de externe inhuur ten behoeve van ICT
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Veldhoven en El Fassed ter vervanging van nr. 12 over robuste verbindingen
Shifts EUR 10 million from general departmental funds to nature policy, financed by cutting external ICT hiring at DICTU, to repair nature-network cuts.
In article 23 Nature, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by EUR 10,000 (x EUR 1,000).
In artikel 23 Natuur worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 10 000 (x € 1 000).
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat fipronilkippen ondanks een verbod toch verkocht zouden zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a report that fipronil-contaminated hens were sold despite a ban, including how many blocked farms sold hens, whether the NVWA's permit procedure was sound, and why a quote was removed from the RTL article. The minister answered that two breeding farms supplied hens to laying farms that were then also blocked, that the exemption to move hens was granted on animal welfare grounds via a NVWA permit procedure, and that the NVWA only corrected factual errors in the article.
The blocked breeding farm submits a request for exemption to the NVWA.
Het geblokkeerde opfokbedrijf dient bij de NVWA een verzoek in voor ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over de brand bij de olieraffinaderij Isla op Curaçao

MPs from D66 asked the government about the fire at the Isla refinery on Curaçao, including health risks from smoke, the cause of the fire, past safety incidents and the refinery's non-compliance with permit requirements per an inspection report. The minister replied that responsibility for the Isla refinery lies with Curaçao, so he cannot answer the substantive questions, though he notes Curaçao has commissioned an inspection and audit and that the Netherlands stands ready to continue assistance on request.
Because responsibility for the Isla refinery rests with the country of Curaçao, the questions have not been answered individually.
Omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de Isla-raffinaderij bij het land Curaçao berust, zijn de vragen niet afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat in nieuwbouw nog steeds vaak aardgas wordt aangesloten

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that new homes are still often connected to the gas grid, including the cost of connections and alternatives, and how this fits the Energy Agenda's plan to end the gas connection obligation. The Minister estimated that over 80% of new homes are still gas-connected, said a law change to remove the obligation will follow via an amendment, and pointed to existing municipal and Green Deal options while giving no firm timeline.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van den Berg, Omtzigt, Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over lekkages bij AKZO-Nobel in Twente

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about new well leaks at AkzoNobel in Twente, the number and effects of leaks, SodM's enforcement and projects, and liability for leak damage. The minister answered that lists of leaks are published and checked by SodM, that the effects appear limited to the immediate vicinity of leaking wells, that enhanced supervision continues with a research programme due by end 2017, and that liability stays with the party responsible at the time of the leak.
SodM urged AkzoNobel to give appropriate urgency to the investigation and remediation of leaks and possible contamination in Twente.
SodM heeft bij AkzoNobel aangedrongen op gepaste urgentie bij het onderzoek en de sanering van lekkages en mogelijke verontreinigingen in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de ‘hoge kosten voor het verwijderen van een gasaansluiting’

An MP (D66) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about high costs for disconnecting a gas connection, asking about tariff ranges, cost transparency, sealing as an alternative, and whether high costs deter the energy transition. The minister said tariffs vary by grid operator, are cost-based and checked by the regulator ACM only on dispute or market signals, sealing is temporary, and the transition costs will be distributed proportionately.
The regulator checks the cost structure of the tariffs charged for removing a connection when a dispute is filed or when market signals give cause to do so.

De toezichthouder controleert de kostenopbouw van de in rekening gebrachte tarieven voor het verwijderen van een aansluiting wanneer daarover een geschil wordt ingediend of wanneer signalen vanuit de markt daar aanleiding toe geven.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de industrie niet daalt

An MP asked the ministers about reports that industrial CO2 emissions did not fall in 2016 and how this affects the Energy Agreement targets, including the 9 PJ industry energy-saving obligation. The government answered that it considers the agreed measures sufficient to meet all Energy Agreement targets and that an industry alternative to the 9 PJ obligation meets its conditions, with a fallback AMvB ready if needed.
For more information we refer to the letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs of 24 April.
Voor meer informatie verwijzen wij naar de brief van de Minister van Economische Zaken van 24 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichtgeving dat in Groningen nog steeds niet aardbevingsbestendig wordt gebouwd (Herdruk)

An MP asked the ministers why the earthquake-resistant building standard NPR 9998 is still not written into the Bouwbesluit, whether buildings are still being erected without it, and who is liable for damage. The minister agrees residents must be safe, says the NPR will be designated once legal clarity exists with an options study due by end 2017 to keep reasonable extra costs with NAM, and states NAM's strict liability under Article 6:177 BW applies to quake damage.
The NPR will be designated in the building regulations once there is clarity on this.
De NPR zal worden aangewezen in de bouwregelgeving, zodra hierover duidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over gesjoemel met de uitstoot van schadelijke stoffen door vrachtwagens

An MP asked the minister about trucks having their AdBlue emission systems switched off with illegal boxes sold by garages and whether controls and enforcement are adequate. The state secretary condemns the practice, cites existing offences, says detection research with TNO and ECN is ongoing and results will come around summer, but repeatedly refers to the same answer and gives no figures on scale.
It is not known on what scale AdBlue systems are being switched off.
Het is niet bekend op welke schaalgrootte AdBlue-systemen worden afgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over inspectie van gevaarlijk RVS in zwembaden

An MP asked the Interior Minister about municipalities failing to enforce the inspection duty for dangerous stainless steel in swimming pools, and whether dwangsom should be imposed and which steel types are allowed. The minister said the enforcement issue is being investigated with results due in June 2017, that municipalities have discretion in supervision, that enforcement including dwangsom is reasonable but a municipal decision, and listed the permitted stainless steel grades.

If this research also shows that the research obligation has been insufficiently complied with, I will hold municipalities and provinces accountable for their responsibility to enforce the research obligation at swimming pools.

Mocht uit dit onderzoek ook blijken dat de onderzoeksplicht onvoldoende is nageleefd, dan zal ik gemeenten en provincies aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid om de onderzoeksplicht bij zwembaden te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de monitoring van klimaat in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about the continuity of greenhouse gas measurements at the CESAR climate observatory in Cabauw, which were reportedly threatened with defunding. The secretary replied that the measurements will continue, that funding was secured through 2018 and a 2017 shortfall was covered, and that talks are underway to continue them after 2018.

I consider it important that the amount of greenhouse gases in the Netherlands is measured, therefore I will engage in discussions with the parties concerned to ensure these measurements continue after 2018.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat de hoeveelheid broeikasgassen in Nederland wordt gemeten, daarom ga ik met de betreffende partijen in gesprek om ervoor te zorgen dat deze metingen ook na 2018 worden voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de NAM de toename van aardbevingen bij Loppersum moet onderzoeken

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the rising number of earthquakes near Loppersum is worrying, when the SodM results are expected, and whether the NAM study will address reducing earthquakes and include an independent second opinion. The minister answered that SodM has requested further NAM analysis, that the seismicity signal value has not been exceeded, that SodM will advise by early April, and that an independent verification by CBS will feed into SodM's findings on 1 May 2017.
I will inform your House of that advice and of the consequences I attach to it.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over dat advies en de consequenties die ik daaraan verbind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Veiligheid Belgische kerncentrale Doel is nog niet op orde'

An MP asked the government whether it would press Belgium to temporarily close the Doel nuclear plant, accelerate interconnector expansion, and request more frequent IAEA follow-up missions. The minister replied that there is no indication Doel is currently unsafe, that the decision on the plant is a Belgian national competence, and that a two-year IAEA follow-up is normal and up to the Belgian regulator FANC.
The judgment on whether it is necessary to keep the Doel nuclear plant open is a national competence of the Belgian government.
Het oordeel of het noodzakelijk is de kerncentrale Doel op te houden, is een nationale bevoegdheid van de Belgische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat Vermilion zonder toestemming gas wint bij Heerenveen

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether gas extraction by Vermilion near Heerenveen (under the Skoatterwâld neighbourhood) was taking place without permission, what the risks to residents were, and whether production must stop. The minister replied that Vermilion's 2012 winning plan remained valid, that TNO and SodM found no direct cause for concern, that the inspector-general has announced a penalty order for one well, and that he will not intervene or direct SodM's investigation.
Under article 128a I cannot give a special instruction on how the inspector-general of mines carries out a specific investigation.
Op grond van artikel 128a kan ik geen bijzondere aanwijzing geven ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de inspecteur-generaal der mijnen een specifiek onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de prestaties van NS

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about NS missing its performance norms for capacity for the second time, whether fines would be passed on to fares, what steps would be taken, and whether crowded trains push people to cars. The State Secretary said fines cannot be passed on to fare prices under the concession, will be placed in a travellers' fund, that she will inform parliament on her assessment of the 2016 performance report, and that NS and ProRail are taking capacity measures, though answers largely restate existing policy.
I will inform your House within the foreseeable future of my judgement on this and of how I enforce the performance agreements with NS.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnen afzienbare tijd informeren over mijn oordeel hierover en de wijze waarop ik de prestatieafspraken met NS handhaaf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Veel grote gemeenten weten niet waar asbestdaken liggen’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipalities know where asbestos roofs are and how removal will be supported before 2023, including for homeowners who cannot afford removal. The State Secretary answered that removal is primarily the owner's responsibility, that municipalities decide whether to map asbestos roofs, and that a programmatic approach with financing arrangements and communication tools is underway, with a progress letter promised before summer.
From 2024 the decentralised government is responsible for enforcing the asbestos roof ban.
De decentrale overheid is vanaf 2024 verantwoordelijk voor het handhaven van het asbestdakenverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Drenthe moet op zoek naar alternatieve locaties voor windmolens’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the wind energy search zones in Drenthe could be expanded and whether the Minister would constructively discuss this with the provincial executive. The Minister declined to widen the zones, citing the agreed 285.5 MW target for Drenthe under the Energy Agreement, and said no request to amend the agreements had been received from the province.
Given the agreements made with the province of Drenthe on onshore wind energy in 2020, I see no possibility to expand the search zones for wind energy in the province of Drenthe.
Gelet op de gemaakte afspraken met de provincie Drenthe over windenergie op land in 2020 zie ik geen mogelijkheid om de zoekgebieden voor windenergie in de provincie Drenthe te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over de ‘bijna ramp’ en illegale oliepraktijken voor de Nederlandse kust

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a near-disaster involving chemical processing on the tanker Franz Schulte off Scheveningen and whether inspectorates can detect such illegal practices. The minister said the ILT found no violations since the 2014 SOLAS ban, that it is considering joint checks with other inspection services, and that international action depends on further information.
Based on inspections of ships in ports, the ILT has found no violations of the ban on chemical processing during sea voyages since 1 January 2014.
Op basis van controles aan boord van schepen in havens heeft de ILT sinds 1 januari 2014 geen overtredingen van het verbod op chemische bewerkingen gedurende zeereizen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Waar blijven de jodiumpillen tegen de gevolgen van een kernramp’

An MP asks why iodine tablets promised in March 2016 for pregnant women and under-18s within 100 km of nuclear plants have not yet been distributed, and why the group excludes residents under 40 elsewhere. The minister says a distribution plan is being drafted with a letter to parliament expected by April, that the age limits follow neighbouring countries and radiation physics, and that predistribution is targeted for 2017.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this by April at the latest.
Ik verwacht dat ik uiterlijk in april uw Kamer hierover kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Ook in nieuwe baden nog gevaarlijk rvs' van de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the minister about news that new swimming pools still contain dangerous RVS (stainless steel), whether the Swimfun pool had the Veilig & Schoon quality mark, and how new use of RVS can be prevented. The minister answered that the 2016 inspection obligation requires removal of dangerous RVS, that the private quality mark is not necessary, and that the Bouwbesluit already prohibits new use, so no amendment is needed.
In June 2017 I will inform your House of the findings of this investigation.
In juni 2017 zal ik uw Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels, Belhaj en Van Veldhoven over de berichten 'Druk aan de Poort' en 'Zelfverrijking normale gang van zaken bij Rotterdams containerbedrijf'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Infrastructure and Environment, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that many containers in Rotterdam port are not systematically scanned for nuclear material and that fraud occurred at a container firm. The government answered that customs uses a risk-based approach, that scanning and inspection capacity was adequate for the Second Maasvlakte, that radiological screening is applied where feasible, and that it cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
However, I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik echter geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de Egyptische ngo-wet en civic space

MP Van Veldhoven asks the government about Egypt's draft NGO law, its restrictions on foreign cooperation and funding, its effect on Dutch NGOs, and the government's response to prosecutions and wider civic space restrictions. The ministers answer that the bill is not yet final, that Dutch concern has been raised bilaterally and in the EU, and that the government views the restrictions as very worrying.
This cannot be confirmed, because the official text of the bill is not yet available.
Dit kan niet worden bevestigd, omdat de officiële tekst van het wetsvoorstel nog niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Grote steden voelen niks voor bouwen in groene zones’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Infrastructure about a report claiming big cities resist building on green zones, and whether the government should steer housing growth towards urban infill. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces hold the regie over housing, that the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation guides the choice between inner-city and edge-of-city building, and that further research and a National Environment Vision are forthcoming.
Municipalities and provinces have the lead role in making spatial considerations in urbanisation and housing construction.
Gemeenten en provincies hebben bij verstedelijking en woningbouw de regie bij het maken van ruimtelijke afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over een conflict tussen het verpakkende bedrijfsleven en gemeenten aangaande het inzamelen van kunststof verpakkingen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a dispute between packaging industry and municipalities over payment for collecting plastic packaging, including non-packaging plastics and PET-trays. The State Secretary answered that talks with the VNG have not yet reached agreement, that the packaging body StAV questions the lawfulness of paying for non-packaging plastic, and that the evaluation of the framework agreement and a plan for PET-trays are pending.
I aim for a solution that is workable for all parties.
Ik streef naar een oplossing die voor alle partijen uitvoerbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de mogelijke krimp van het opgestelde vermogen aan windenergie op land

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether around 1,330 MW of ageing onshore wind turbines risks removal when subsidies expire, threatening the 14% and 16% renewable energy targets, and whether the government will compensate. The minister answered that the figure is a theoretical maximum, that replacement or refurbishment is feasible within current frameworks, that no extra subsidy will be created, and that he will discuss the matter with the provinces at a meeting on 1 December.
I will discuss this further with the provinces at an administrative consultation I have with them on 1 December.
Ik zal hier nader met de provincies over spreken tijdens een bestuurlijk overleg dat ik op 1 december a.s. met hen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het rapport Dirty Diesel

An MP from D66 asked the minister about the Public Eye 'Dirty Diesel' report on high-sulphur diesel exported from Dutch and Belgian ports to West Africa, covering human rights, corporate responsibility, legal instruments, government ties with traders, and aid. The minister answered that no current law blocks such exports, that the Dutch government relies on the OECD guidelines, a NCP investigation and an IMVO covenant effort, and that aid runs mainly through UNEP and the CCAC.
A first scan of existing laws and regulations indicates that there are no legal instruments to prevent the production and/or export of high-sulphur diesel.
Een eerste scan van bestaande wet- en regelgeving wijst erop dat er geen wettelijke instrumenten zijn om de productie en/of export van diesel met een hoog zwavelgehalte tegen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Meer treinen met giftige stoffen dan toegestaan’

Mr Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the State Secretary whether reports of more trains carrying hazardous substances than permitted through Utrecht were accurate, and whether the government would improve oversight and public information on such transports. The State Secretary confirmed the wagon numbers, said there are no legal caps on the number of hazardous-goods trains but risk ceilings were exceeded, announced a package of measures and publication of quarterly transport figures, and said the ILT will report on registration compliance at the end of 2016.
I want to emphasise that the transport of hazardous substances takes place responsibly because of the strict requirements that apply to this transport as a result of international regulations.
Ik wil benadrukken dat het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen op een verantwoorde wijze plaatsvindt vanwege de strenge eisen die gelden voor dit vervoer als gevolg van internationale regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichten ‘Nederland ligt dwars bij aanpak dieselschandaal’ en dat een jaar na Dieselgate blijkt dat alle dieselmerken nog vervuilender zijn dan Volkswagen

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is resisting tougher diesel emissions testing and that most diesel models exceed emission limits, plus the RDW's positions in Brussels on independent testing, peer review and typeapproval for models such as the Opel Zafira. The ministers answered that a letter on the report would follow, that withdrawing approvals during ongoing investigations would be unlawful, and that the Netherlands supports Commission proposals for independent testing and peer review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de verkoop van elektrische en hybride auto’s fors is afgenomen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that sales of electric and hybrid cars fell, whether the 2016 rise in the company car tax (bijtelling) explains it, and how this fits with climate, air quality and energy goals and earlier motions to stimulate electric driving. The minister answered that electric car sales keep growing steadily, that the PHEV decline is partly due to the tax change, that EU-level emission standards are the preferred instrument, and that he will inform parliament further in the autumn on the Groot motion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Veldhoven, Van Helvert en Madlener over het bericht dat Rover vindt dat het Ministerie de verkeerde prioriteiten stelt

MPs from ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and PVV asked the State Secretary about ROVER's claim that the ministry sets the wrong priorities in its ProRail repositioning, including concerns about rushed decisions, missing baselines, and the handling of parliamentary motions. The State Secretary answered that a public-law form for ProRail is already chosen, that an analysis with stakeholder input will be sent to Parliament before year-end, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before debate.
Until I have discussed this analysis with your House, no irreversible steps will be taken regarding the positioning of ProRail.
Totdat ik deze analyse met uw Kamer heb besproken, zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen ten aanzien van de positionering van ProRail worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Sjoemelsoftware Volkswagen: update auto’s helpt niet bij Audi Q5’

An MP from D66 asks the minister about reports that a software update for VW/Audi Q5 cars does not deliver the promised performance, whether Dutch cars should be re-tested, compensation, independent EU oversight, and Renault emissions findings. The minister says RDW and TNO will conduct a second opinion, that the German KBA is responsible for recall verification, that Europe-wide compensation is for the Commission to pursue, and that no Renault recall is indicated.
At the request of your House, I am having the RDW and TNO carry out a second opinion on Volkswagen.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer 2 laat ik de RDW en TNO een second opinion uitvoeren bij Volkswagen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de verleende vergunning voor het vervoer van twee hoogradioactieve bronnen van NRG naar de COVRA en het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk nucleair afval wordt verkeerd vervoerd’

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked why two highly radioactive sources must be transported from NRG to COVRA now, whether certificates have expired, whether the ANVS supervises intact-source checks, and related risks and future special-arrangement transports, and whether the permit will be suspended. The minister answered that NRG must remove the waste within two years, that expired production certificates do not prevent use and are not reportable, that the ANVS oversees integrity checks, that a limited number of special-arrangement transports are expected, and that the permit cannot be suspended because no interim-relief request was filed with the Council of State.
No request for interim relief has been submitted to the Council of State, therefore the permit cannot be suspended.
Er is geen verzoek voor voorlopige voorziening ingediend bij de Raad van State, derhalve kan de vergunning niet worden opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘TU Delft geeft de NAM ervan langs’

An MP asked the minister whether TU Delft's validation of the Arcadis study, which found the NAM damage contours unsound, means the contours cannot be used to sort damage claims, and how claimants outside the contours will be inspected and compensated. The minister confirmed that contours cannot be used to decide claims, that inspections will run through December 2016 with a new expert panel pilot and arbiter access, and that the pilot will be independently evaluated.
NAM now accepts the NCG's conclusion that the damage contour line it set is not tenable and that all reported damage must nevertheless be assessed individually.
NAM conformeert zich nu aan de conclusie van de NCG dat de door NAM vastgestelde schadecontourlijn niet houdbaar is en dat alle gemelde schades alsnog individueel moeten worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat bomen in Twekkelo zijn beschadigd door een leidingbreuk in het zoutwinningsgebied

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a pipeline leak of brine from salt mining in Twekkelo that damaged trees, the delay in reporting, the cause, and oversight of AkzoNobel's pipelines, including whether the regulator SodM was doing enough. The minister answered in detail, describing the leak timeline, the roughly 1,400 cubic metres of brine released, the corroded T-piece and planned replacements, and SodM's decision to place AkzoNobel under intensified supervision.
I therefore think that placing AkzoNobel Salt BV (hereinafter: AkzoNobel) under intensified supervision by SodM is an appropriate step.
Ik denk daarom dat het onder verscherpt toezicht plaatsen van AkzoNobel Salt BV (hierna: AkzoNobel) door SodM een gepaste stap is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval in Petten door falende apparatuur

MPs from D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the minister about reports of a build-up of nuclear waste at Petten caused by failing equipment, including how often the COVRA transfer deadline has been postponed, the VINISH problems, cost estimates and financial risks for ECN/NRG. The minister answered that the deadline was extended three times to 2022, that current VINISH problems are software-related and expected to be resolved, that cost estimates from 2015 remain valid, and agreed to publish the Turkenburg and Holtkamp reports with some passages redacted.
In accordance with articles 10 and 11 of the Open Government Act, a number of passages in the letter and the reports have been redacted.
Overeenkomstig de artikelen 10 en 11 van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur is een aantal passages in de brief en de rapporten weggelakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Van Veldhoven over de verleende vergunning voor het vervoer van twee hoogradioactieve bronnen van NRG naar de COVRA en het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk nucleair afval wordt verkeerd vervoerd’

An MP from D66 asks the minister whether the ANVS permit for transporting two high-radioactivity sources from NRG to COVRA via a special arrangement instead of Type B packaging is safe and justified, and why applicants and external review were not used. The minister answers that the permit and packaging meet ADR and Bvser requirements, that no suitable Type B packages are available, that three safety barriers and additional conditions make transport safe, and declines external second opinion.
Are you prepared to submit the risk assessment for the stated solution to external experts, such as the IAEA, TNO and/or a body that certifies such packaging?

Bent u bereid de risico inschatting voor de genoemde oplossing voor te leggen aan externe experts, zoals van het Internationaal Atoomagentschap (IAEA), TNO en/of een instantie die dit soort verpakkingen certificeert
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Dordste fabriek stoot giftige stof uit

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about reports that the Dordrecht Chemours (ex-DuPont) plant emits GenX, a substance linked to health risks, and asked about the evidence, the regional environmental service's assessment, and whether the substance should be listed as a Substance of Very High Concern. The government answered that RIVM confirmed the substance is persistent and toxic, that bioaccumulation remains uncertain, that RIVM will do further research with a report promised by November, and that it will raise the issue at EU level.
I have therefore now asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Sjoerdsma over de situatie van jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon

MPs Van Veldhoven and Sjoerdsma asked the minister about the hopelessness and reported suicidal feelings among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon, the funding of UNICEF education centres, and what the Netherlands is doing on psychosocial care. The minister acknowledged the situation, said suicide figures could not be verified, described psychosocial care and education funding commitments, and said the government is in ongoing dialogue with Lebanese authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have its own figures on suicidal tendencies among young Syrian refugees in Lebanon or other countries in the region.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt niet over eigen cijfers ten aanzien van zelfmoordneigingen onder jonge Syrische vluchtelingen in Libanon of andere landen in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat er sprake is van een ophoping van kernafval

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the minister about reports that faulty measuring equipment at Petten leaves stored nuclear waste drums uncertain in content, and about delays in transferring the waste to COVRA. The minister confirmed the ANVS knew of the equipment shortcomings since spring 2015, said the waste remains safely stored, and gave partial answers on costs, delays and the NRG safety culture while referring some points to the regulator and the parliamentary debate.
The ANVS has been aware since spring 2015 that the accuracy of the VINISH installation at that time was not sufficient to achieve the characterisation agreed with COVRA.

De ANVS is sinds het voorjaar 2015 op de hoogte van het feit dat de nauwkeurigheid van de VINISH-installatie op dat moment niet voldoende was om de met COVRA afgesproken karakterisering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat NS stopt met het doorgeven van actuele treinposities

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether NS (Dutch Railways) had stopped sharing real-time train positions, and whether this harmed cooperation with travel-app developers and passenger transparency. The state secretary answered that NS only has the feature offline during a test-to-production transition of a few months, that NS is not obliged to supply train positions but is expected to do so, and that no reversal is needed.
The impression that NS has stopped passing on current train positions is not correct.
Het beeld dat NS is gestopt met het doorgeven van actuele treinposities is niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Veldhoven over import en inkoop van steenkool

An MP asked the minister about the coal covenant, the situation of victims of human rights abuses in the Colombian coal sector, Prodeco/Drummond supply relations, European market shares, and an Amsterdam motion on blood coal. The minister answered by describing Bettercoal audits, OECD cooperation, transitional justice efforts in Colombia, DONG's no-longer-current Prodeco purchases, EU import figures, and the government's encouragement of corporate due diligence, while stating substitution effects are unknown.
As laid down in the coal covenant, progress on implementing the covenant will be reported in more detail in the third quarter of each year.
Conform vastgelegd in het steenkoolconvenant zal in het derde kwartaal van ieder jaar nader gerapporteerd worden over de voortgang van de implementatie van het convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de resultaten van de meetcampagne luchtkwaliteit 2015 van Milieudefensie

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands risks breaching EU nitrogen dioxide limits, citing a Milieudefensie measurement report, and what measures would follow, along with questions on speed-limit increases and low-emission zone signage. The State Secretary answered that only a limited number of NO2 hotspots remain, that additional funds were allocated for Amsterdam and Rotterdam, that compliance will be clear from the RIVM monitoring report at the end of the year, and that further measures will be decided then.
The monitoring over 2015, due at the end of this year, will show to what extent the standard was actually exceeded in 2015.
Uit de monitoring over 2015 die eind van dit jaar uitkomt, zal blijken in hoeverre er sprake is van daadwerkelijke overschrijding van de norm over 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de uitspraak van de rechter inzake Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services b.v. ten aanzien van energiebesparende maatregelen

An MP asked the ministers about a court ruling on Amsterdam versus Colt Technology Services concerning the energy-saving obligation under the Activities Decree, and whether municipalities have enough enforcement tools and whether recognised measure lists resolve disputes. The minister answered that the agreements in the Energy Agreement are being implemented, that the recognised measure lists are a voluntary but legally anchored route for companies, and that the system will be evaluated after two years.
It has also been agreed to evaluate the new system two years after the new regulations entered into force (December 2015).
Er is bovendien afgesproken om twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe regelgeving (december 2015) de nieuwe systematiek te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

An MP asked whether the minister was obstructing city low-emission zones by delaying a uniform road sign and extending zones to lighter vehicles, despite a 2012 motion and requests from four municipalities. The minister answered that the sign delay stemmed from a Council of State advisory and redesign, that the passenger-car extension was dropped after a Visser motion, and that municipal zones are a local choice with local accountability.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposed amendment will drop the extension of the environmental zone sign to passenger cars.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit de voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Van Veldhoven over de militaire beveiliging van Belgische kerncentrales en het oordeel van de Hoge Gezondheidsraad dat België onvoldoende is voorbereid op een kernramp

Two D66 MPs asked whether Belgian nuclear plants guarded by the army reflect a terrorist threat, whether the Netherlands faces similar risks, and how the Belgian Health Council's finding of inadequate nuclear emergency preparedness affects Dutch policy. The minister answered that no concrete threat information underlies the Belgian measures, that Dutch nuclear security is standard and in line with law, and that the Council's findings do not change the risk picture; the OVV is still considering an investigation.
No substantive information is given on specific security measures, including whether or when military personnel are deployed.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan, dat geldt ook voor het moment waarop al dan niet militairen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over de verduurzaming van sportcomplexen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether greening sports facilities was an agreed measure of the Energy Agreement, whether the sports energy-savings subsidy is the main instrument, whether its budget will be topped up, and what the added value is if not. The minister replied that the subsidy stems from a parliamentary motion and is separate from the Energy Agreement, that no budget top-up is planned, and that other schemes remain available.
No, both my colleague of Economic Affairs and I see no possibilities within our budgets to top up the budget.
Nee, zowel mijn collega van Economische Zaken als ik zien geen mogelijkheden binnen onze begrotingen om het budget nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over hormoon verstorende stoffen en de relatie met de volksgezondheid

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Health about national and EU measures to reduce exposure to BPA and other hormone-disrupting substances, including prenatal advice, cancer trends and costs. The Minister replied that hospital and industry agreements, pressure on EFSA and the EU, and further research and advice updates are under way, with no firm timelines for some measures.
I have submitted the RIVM report to the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) and urged it to reconsider the tolerable daily intake (TDI) standard in light of the new insights.

Ik heb het RIVM-rapport aan de Europese Autoriteit voor Voedselveiligheid (EFSA) aangeboden en er op aangedrongen de norm voor de toelaatbare dagelijkse inname (Tolerabele Daily Intake, TDI) op grond van de nieuwe inzichten opnieuw te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over het gegeven dat de Rijksoverheid samenwerkt met de tabaksfirma Japan Tobacco International (JTI)

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked whether government co-operation with tobacco company JTI, via the Green Deal Schone Stranden on cigarette litter, complies with FCTC article 5.3. The state secretary answered that continuing the Green Deal in its current form is no longer acceptable and that the government will explore continuing it without the tobacco industry as a party.
I am of the opinion that continuing the GDSS in its current form is no longer acceptable in light of the current interpretation of article 5.3 of the WHO Framework Convention.
Ik ben van mening dat voortzetting van de GDSS in de huidige vorm niet meer acceptabel is gelet op de huidige invulling van artikel 5.3 WHO-kaderverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Veldhoven over de opsporingsvergunning bij Grou

MPs Jacobi and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Vermilion's exploration permit near Grou/Akkrum, including whether the permit could be revoked for delays, the location of the test drilling, the Leeuwarden council motion against new gas extraction, and the relation between gas exploration and geothermal energy. The minister answered that Vermilion met the notification requirement, that the delay is not Vermilion's fault so revocation is not warranted, and that gas and geothermal development rarely compete.
If this did not have the desired effect, I am entitled to revoke the exploration permit.
Als dit niet tot het gewenste effect zou leiden, dan ben ik gerechtigd om de opsporingsvergunning in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mondengebied monddood’

MPs Van Veldhoven, Agnes Mulder and Smaling asked why the ministry's wind park information sessions require barcode registration, ban phones-recording and filming, and whether the personal data register complies with privacy law and was reviewed by the privacy authority. The minister defended the restrictions as protecting privacy and openness, said data will be destroyed after the sessions, acknowledged the registration form lacked a controller notice, and did not seek the privacy authority's advice.

I have noted that the online registration form for the sessions does not state that the Ministry of Economic Affairs is responsible for processing the personal data and for what purpose the data is requested.

Ik heb geconstateerd dat het online registratieformulier voor de spreekuren niet vermeldt dat het Ministerie van Economische Zaken verantwoordelijk is voor de verwerking van de persoonsgegevens en met welk doel de gegevens worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de radio-uitzending ‘Hoogspanning in Zeeland’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a radio broadcast on a new high-voltage route in Zeeland, including whether an underwater Westerschelde alternative had been studied and whether residents' nuisance was minimised. The minister confirmed the alternative was not studied, rejected it as infeasible and inefficient, and described the route's landscape integration and cable-bundling measures.
This indeed has not been investigated.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Opel ontkent gesjoemel met software’

An MP asked the minister whether Opel had secretly modified emissions software after the dieselgate scandal, as reported by Belgian broadcaster VRT, and what the government would do. The government answered that neither it, the RDW nor TNO had prior suspicion, that Opel denies the allegations and the German KBA confirmed the service update was unrelated to emissions, and that it will monitor other brands and raise the matter in an EU working group.
That does not alter the fact that I remain vigilant regarding any other brands that may have applied fraudulent software to meet the European emission standard.
Dit neemt niet weg dat ik onverminderd alert blijf op eventuele andere merken die frauduleuze software hebben toegepast om aan de Europese emissienorm te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Belhaj over mensenhandel in Djibouti

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of human trafficking and prostitution of young girls in Djibouti, including whether Dutch soldiers could contribute, and about Dutch use of the US trafficking classification and its human-rights stance toward Djibouti. The ministers answered that no Dutch soldiers are stationed there, that the Netherlands does not use its own classification system, and that bilateral relations with Djibouti are limited and indirect.
Our country has no classification system of its own.
Ons land heeft geen eigen classificatiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘De kust zou leeg blijven. Toch gaat het volbouwen door’

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister how construction plans in Groote Keeten, Nieuwvliet-Bad and Hollum are legally based and whether they predate the withdrawn Barro expansion for building in dunes. The minister answered that these sites lie landward of the coastal foundation, so municipal and provincial rules under the Wro and Wabo govern them, and that the Barro coastal rules do not apply there.
These fall under the competence of the relevant municipality and province.
Deze vallen onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Veldhoven over de berichtgeving over een enorm gaslek in de Verenigde Staten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether a large gas leak at a US storage field could happen in the Netherlands, what protocols and inspections exist, and what the health and environmental consequences would be. The minister answered that Dutch rules are stricter (mandatory downhole safety valves, stricter cementing), that SodM supervises inspections and emergency plans, and that SodM will assess relevance of the US investigation once available.
Once the investigation into the cause and remedy of the leak becomes available, the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) will examine its relevance for the Dutch situation.
Zodra het onderzoek naar de oorzaak en remedie van de lekkage beschikbaar komt, zal Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de relevantie daarvan voor de Nederlandse situatie onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het subsidiebeleidskader Funding Leadership and Opportunities for Women 2016-2020

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the FLOW II subsidy framework, including the subsidy thresholds, why nine large northern NGOs were selected rather than local women's organisations, and the risk to Southern women's organisations. The minister largely defended the selection as quality-based, outlined local involvement and regranting, and offered a Accountability Fund pathway of at least 5 million euros a year for local women's organisations.
In the selection, quality in light of the FLOW policy framework was the only criterion; the nine best-scoring programmes were funded.
Bij de selectie was kwaliteit in het licht van het FLOW-beleidskader het enige criterium; de negen best scorende programma's zijn gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over kinderarbeid achter batterijen voor smartphones en elektrische auto’s

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour behind cobalt used in smartphone and electric car batteries, citing an Amnesty report, and about traceability, due diligence, supply diversification, talks with the Congolese government, and the EU conflict minerals regulation. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to the OECD Due Diligence Guidance, the IMVO covenant route, a PACT traceability project, planned talks with the DRC, and the EU trilogue, but does not commit to new binding measures.
The cabinet intends to discuss with the relevant Congolese government counterparts what our governments and international business could do to combat child labour.

Het kabinet is voornemens met de relevante gesprekspartners binnen de Congolese overheid te bespreken wat onze regeringen en het internationale bedrijfsleven zouden kunnen doen om kinderarbeid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over het budget voor energie-innovatie in 2016

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked why the Topsector Energie was prioritised over the DEI demonstration scheme in reallocating 2016 energy-innovation budget, which projects receive additional funds, and which DEI projects might fall through. The minister replied that the Topsector Energie budget stays roughly flat, the DEI budget rises slightly, no additional funds go to the Topsector, and DEI tender outcomes will only be known after the tranches close.
There is no question of additional budget for the Topsector Energie.
Er is geen sprake van additioneel budget voor de Topsector Energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven heeft gesteld over het bericht ‘Verplicht duurzaam beton’ en ‘Blog: de betrekkelijke waarheid van duurzaam beton’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary whether the government is failing to invest in sustainable concrete, whether Rijkswaterstaat specifies recycled concrete enough, and whether binding rules should replace voluntary Green Deals. The State Secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat already uses recycled concrete as foundation material, that the Green Deal is progressing slowly and a broader Betonakkoord is planned for 2016, but declined to make recycled aggregate mandatory.

I do not make mixed granulate mandatory as a raw material for concrete, because its technical performance is insufficient for general applications at Rijkswaterstaat and concrete is less readily recyclable in a subsequent lifecycle.

Menggranulaat schrijf ik niet verplicht voor als grondstof voor beton, omdat de technische prestaties onvoldoende zijn voor algemene toepassingen bij Rijkswaterstaat en het beton in een volgende levenscyclus minder goed recyclebaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over het beleid om op basis van de typegoedkeuringswaarde CO2 gedifferentieerde belastingen vast te stellen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Finance Ministry knew of the growing gap between type-approval and real-world CO2 figures used for car taxes, and why no alternative basis was studied, plus the Volkswagen tax impact and planned action. The state secretary answered that the ministry was aware through TNO and Court of Audit work, that alternatives were judged impractical pending the WLTP test, that Volkswagen-related revenue losses are expected to be very limited and clarity is expected in early 2016, and that Autobrief II measures address the plug-in hybrid gap.
The cabinet is aware of the gap between standard and real-world consumption and has informed the House on several occasions.
Het kabinet is bekend met de afwijking tussen norm- en praktijkverbruik en heeft daar uw Kamer bij verschillende gelegenheden over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de vermeende onware claims van Shell aangaande het schoonmaken van de Niger Delta

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that Shell made false or incomplete claims about cleaning up oil pollution in the Niger Delta, whether it will raise this with Shell, and what levers it has to make Shell act responsibly. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the embassy in Abuja is working on strengthening the Nigerian regulator NOSDRA, that the Netherlands has raised the UNEP recommendations with Shell and the Nigerian government, and that it will use mediation (Bodo) and existing CSR instruments.
In this context, the Netherlands among other things urges all parties involved to implement the recommendations of the 2011 UNEP report.
Nederland dringt in dit kader onder meer aan op implementatie van de aanbevelingen uit het UNEP-rapport uit 2011 door alle betrokken partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat Unicef waarschuwt voor het lot van Nepalese kinderen in de winter

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of UNICEF's warning about Nepalese children facing a harsh winter after the 2015 earthquakes, and what the Netherlands was doing on relief, winterization, funding and international follow-up. The minister answered that the Netherlands provided about 10 million euro via the Red Cross, WFP and the Dutch Relief Alliance, described winter preparation measures, and said unearmarked contributions to UNICEF and others could be used for Nepal's needs.
After the earthquake of 25 April 2015, the Netherlands made ten million euros available for humanitarian aid.
Na de aardbeving van 25 april 2015 heeft Nederland tien miljoen euro beschikbaar gesteld voor humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Ontploffing en brand bij Belgische kerncentrale Doel vlakbij Woensdrecht’

An MP asked the ministers about the explosion and fire at Belgian nuclear plant Doel near the Dutch border, the extension of Doel 1 and 2, crisis communication with Dutch municipalities, and how Belgian incidents are prevented. The minister answered that there was no danger to the Dutch population, that the Belgian regulator FANC handles licensing and informs municipalities within 5 km, and that cross-border cooperation and joint exercises exist.
I will also contact my Belgian counterpart myself to discuss further the importance of the safety of the nuclear power plants.
Ook zal ik zelf met mijn Belgische collega in contact treden om nader te spreken over het belang van de veiligheid van de kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over het vermeende manipuleren van de prognoses voor zonne- en windenergie

MPs Jan Vos, Van Tongeren and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about allegations that the IEA manipulated its wind and solar growth forecasts, and whether its outlook is accurate. The minister denied any bias, explained that the WEO presents scenarios rather than forecasts, said the IEA's methodology is careful, and argued the scenarios help inform policy choices.
However, the IEA does not present growth forecasts in the sense of predictions in its annual World Energy Outlook.
Het IEA presenteert in de jaarlijkse World Energy Outlook echter geen groeiprognoses in de zin van voorspellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Milieu ondergeschikt bij inkoop materialen door overheid’

An MP asked the government to respond to a Forest Stewardship Council report finding that much tropical timber used in public works cannot be shown to be sustainably sourced, and asked whether the government's sustainable procurement goals and measures are adequate. The state secretary largely defends existing policy (Green Deal, PIANOo support, monitoring), disputes some of the report's conclusions and promises a study of the causes with a government reaction later in the year.

Because of these signals, after signing the Green Deal in 2013 the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment commissioned a study into why it cannot in all cases be demonstrated that sustainable timber was supplied in central government projects.

Vanwege de genoemde signalen is na het ondertekenen van de Green Deal bevorderen duurzaam bosbeheer in 2013 opdracht gegeven door het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor een onderzoek naar de redenen waarom bij rijksoverheidsprojecten niet in alle gevallen aangetoond kan worden dat duurzaam hout is geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over abortus voor verkrachtingsslachtoffers in conflictgebieden

Parliamentarian Van Veldhoven asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands will champion EU policy on access to safe abortion for rape survivors in conflict zones, including at the UN Security Council debate.
