The Minister confirms Dutch leadership, says the Netherlands will raise sexual and reproductive health and rights including abortion in bilateral, multilateral and EU settings, and commits to ensuring implementation and to speaking publicly at the Security Council.
Yes, the Cabinet will oversee that.
Ja, daar zal het Kabinet op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het gebruik van chroom-6 in treinen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about chromium-6 exposure among NedTrain rail workers, including when the risk became known, oversight by the Inspectie SZW, health consequences, support for affected staff and whether the substance is still permitted. The State Secretary answered that the historical exposure is still being investigated, that the risk was found in June 2015 in old paint layers, that the Inspectorate was informed and oversight continues, that six workers have registered for medical examination, and that an independent expert committee will review the measures, with EU phase-out rules applying to chromium-6 in professional use.
At this moment NS is investigating the extent of the historical exposure and whether, and to what degree, employees were exposed.
Op dit moment doet NS onderzoek naar de omvang van de historische blootstelling en of, en in welke mate, medewerkers zijn blootgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de opslag van vliegassen in zoutkoepels in Twente

An MP asked the ministers about a pilot to stabilise unstable salt caverns in Twente by filling them with residual materials such as fly ash, and about the safety risks, legal basis, and alternatives. The minister answered that the pilot is permitted under the national waste plan, that safety studies are required before permits are granted, and that the risks will be tested in the permit and storage plan process.
For granting the environmental permits and approving the storage plan, follow-up studies must be carried out on the specific caverns for which stabilisation is foreseen within the pilot project.

Voor het verlenen van de omgevingsvergunningen en het instemmen met het opslagplan dienen vervolgonderzoeken uitgevoerd te worden ten aanzien van de specifieke cavernes waarvoor stabilisatie binnen het proefproject is voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van Veldhoven over het bericht "NS-topman had steun voor uitbetalen bonus"

MPs Koolmees and Van Veldhoven asked the Finance Minister about reports that the NS chief executive had support for paying his bonus, and about the timing of the 2014 bonus payment and communication. The Minister explains that the supervisory board and shareholder reached in-principle agreement on 17.5% variable pay for the CEO and CFO, that the payment in March was premature because the overall package and communication were not yet settled, and that he only learned of the payment in June, while criticising the CEO's instruction to HR as contrary to good corporate governance.
Furthermore, I find it remarkable that an NS official gave his HR director the instruction himself to pay out a reward due to him.
Daarnaast vind ik het opmerkelijk dat een functionaris van NS aan zijn personeelsdirecteur zelf de instructie geeft een aan hem toekomende beloning uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over de controle op illegaal hout

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement against illegal timber under the EU Timber Regulation, including staffing, inspection numbers, the use of warnings rather than fines, and due diligence. The State Secretary answered that 3 FTE are deployed, 101 inspections and 29 written warnings have been issued, that enforcement is warning-first and has been effective, and that the NVWA follows EU-coordinated practice on due diligence and document verification.
The NVWA has 3 FTE available for combating illegal timber and this appears sufficient given the required deployment.
De NVWA heeft 3 fte beschikbaar voor het bestrijden van illegaal hout en dit blijkt gezien de benodigde inzet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Afvalgigant kaalgeplukt’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked whether Attero's sale to Waterland drained 183 million euro, including 87 million earmarked for pre-aftercare, and whether closed landfills stay safely financed and provinces accept the cut. The Staatssecretaris confirms the 183 million figure from Waterland's statement, says prior provincial consent was not needed and was not sought, and says legal aftercare and capping guarantees are unchanged while Attero must report to the competent authority.
No prior consultation took place with the provinces of Drenthe, Limburg and Noord-Brabant on this matter.
Met de provincies Drenthe, Limburg en Noord-Brabant heeft hierover vooraf geen overleg plaats gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Weesboten steeds groter probleem’

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the growing problem of abandoned 'ghost boats', including a report projecting up to 35,000 by 2030, and whether central government, a national fund, or a national registration system should act. The State Secretary answered that the central government has no responsibility for abandoned boats on non-state land or water, that responsibility lies with producers, importers, branch organisations and the authorities managing the waterways, and that a new national registration system would add administrative burden without clear effectiveness.
The central government has no responsibility for abandoned ghost ships on or in land or waters that do not belong to the central government.
Het Rijk heeft geen verantwoordelijkheid voor achtergelaten spookschepen op of in gronden of wateren die niet van het Rijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht ‘Bluscapaciteit ontoereikend bij grote brand’

MPs Hachchi, Van Veldhoven and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether insufficient firefighting water capacity in the water mains poses a national risk to businesses, schools and hospitals, whether the government knew of it, and what should be done. The minister answered that he was not aware of such a problem, that the Veiligheidsberaad sees no national issue and deems water supply a matter for municipalities and safety regions, and that no extra action is needed.
The Veiligheidsberaad indicates that the availability of firefighting water is a matter for municipalities and safety regions; the fire service is part of the safety region.
Het Veiligheidsberaad geeft daarbij aan dat de beschikbaarheid van bluswater een zaak is van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's; de brandweer maakt deel uit van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Van Tongeren en Van Veldhoven over subsidiering van biomassa bijstook

Four MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidising biomass co-firing (including 15% cheaper residual streams such as animal meal) risks over-subsidisation, and questioned the basis of the SDE+ base amounts and the withheld ECN/DNV GL reports. The minister answered that the NGO agreement does not fix the SDE+ rate, that the price effect is within calculation margins, and that the preliminary ECN note will not be published though the final version was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over het niet naleven van de meldplicht voor incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Inspectorate (ILT) fails to enforce the duty to report hazardous-substance incidents, whether reporting is too cumbersome, whether carriers are unaware of the duty, whether human error incidents rose, and whether hazard markings should be required for mixed small-package transports. The state secretary denied under-enforcement (eight enforcement actions in 2014, seven reports to prosecutors), described the single reporting desk and outreach, and rejected new marking rules as already covered by international rules.
No, this is not correct. All incidents involving hazardous substances must be reported immediately to the ILT.
Nee, dit is niet juist. Alle incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen moeten direct worden gemeld bij de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over burgerparticipatie bij de A13/A16

An MP asked the minister how the Code Maatschappelijke Participatie was applied in the public participation process for the A13/A16 road project, including the handling of resident proposals in the gebiedstafels, timing of the Oplossingenkaart consultation, and whether the participation process could be improved. The minister defends the process as extensive and intensive, says proposals outside the scope of the Standpunt were not adopted, and states she is discussing with regional officials whether to decouple the ontwerp-tracébesluit from the regional measures package.
I am in discussion with the regional officials involved about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de betrokken bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de verkoop door RWE van gasvelden in het Britse deel van de Noordzee aan de Luxemburgse investeringsmaatschappij LetterOne van Michail Fridman

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about RWE's sale of North Sea gas fields in the UK to a Russian-linked investment company and whether the Netherlands could block it or secure gas supplies, including via a Dutch foundation. The Minister answered that the Dutch government does not share UK concerns for Dutch supply, that the Dutch state can refuse transfer of mining licences on technical, financial and conduct grounds but not on nationality, and that a Dutch foundation alone would not shield assets from EU sanctions.
Under the Mining Act my consent is required for this transfer.
Op grond van de mijnbouwwet is mijn toestemming vereist voor deze overdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over kritiek van de Waddeneilanden op de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof

An MP asked the State Secretary whether objections from the Wadden islands to the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) were known, why a simpler German system and small-scale municipalities were not accommodated, how municipalities are involved, and about alternative emission techniques and the foreign share of nitrogen deposition. The State Secretary answered that 561 objections were received and analysed in a Nota van Antwoord without direct contact with all submitters, defended the Dutch threshold of 1 mol/ha/year, said provinces involve municipalities, and committed to adjusting the programme if foreign deposition causes shortfalls.
As promised to the island municipalities, the municipalities will be involved in implementation.
Zoals aan de eilandgemeenten is toegezegd, worden de gemeenten bij de uitvoering betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over de veiligheid van wegwerkers

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the safety of road workers, including fatal accidents over ten years, whether the union's concerns are shared, trade-offs with traffic, and links to maintenance budgets. The ministers answered that safety follows CROW guidelines, a covenant and inspections are in place, and no link to budgets exists.
At the end of 2014 I concluded a covenant with the construction and infrastructure sector to work more safely.
Eind 2014 heb ik een convenant afgesloten om met de bouw- en infrabranche te komen tot veiliger werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Onderzoek nodig bij windmolens bij Medemblik’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about metal fatigue risks in Nedwind turbines after two blades were lost near Medemblik, including inspection rules and safety measures. The minister answered that the turbine type is unique in the Netherlands, that independent investigation and expanded inspections are underway, and that the Activiteitenbesluit already sets safety rules enforced by the competent authority, with possible improvements being explored with the sector.
The outcomes of these inspections and the follow-up steps will be shared with me.
De uitkomsten van deze inspecties en de vervolgstappen zullen met mij gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven over het bericht dat Valkenburg de ideale plek is voor een ‘Unmanned Valley’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Verhoeven asked the government about a report proposing Valkenburg airfield as a testing site for unmanned vehicles, and whether the land-use plan for housing, work and recreation is consistent with the government's innovation ambitions. The minister answered that the masterplan allows room for smaller drone testing but not larger drones, that a self-driving car test regulation has been sent to parliament, that the central government re-offered an alternative solution to local parties in January 2015, and declined the request for a one-week answer deadline.
In July 2014 the central government offered the solution direction mentioned in the answer to question 4 to the parties involved.
Het Rijk heeft in juli 2014 de oplossingsrichting, zoals genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 4, aangeboden aan de betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Zorgen om lichtere norm voor aardbevingsschade'

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether NAM's lower peak ground acceleration norm for earthquake damage repair was discussed with the ministry and the Dialoogtafel, and what the minister will do about it. The minister replies that NAM stayed within the approved framework, no consultation took place, and a revised NPR norm will be presented and explained to parliament in early February.
NAM did not lower the norms in the design of the pilot scheme and remained within the framework of the decision.
NAM heeft de normen niet verlaagd in de opzet van de pilotregeling en is binnen de kaders van het besluit gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven de import van illegaal gekapt hout

An MP from D66 asked ministers about a report claiming 46% of wood imported into the Netherlands falls outside the EU Timber Regulation, and about steps to stop illegal wood in processed products. The state secretary disputed the 46% figure as a miscalculation (about 6% by weight, 16% by value), acknowledged a 16.8% gap for secondary products, and said the issue would be raised in the Commission's evaluation of the regulation.
In that context I will raise the problem of imports of processed products made from illegal wood, as mentioned in the Probos report, with the Commission.
Ik zal in dat kader de problematiek van de import van bewerkte producten van illegaal hout, zoals genoemd in het rapport van Probos, aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de chemiesector laks omgaat met regels

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the chemical sector is lax in following safety and environmental rules, and about weak, fragmented supervision and public disclosure of risks. The government largely confirmed the picture from earlier investigations, pointed to the companies' primary responsibility and to BRZO+ cooperation and a national enforcement strategy, and promised to send an update before a committee meeting.
The cabinet also acknowledged that picture in its response to the OvV reports.
Het kabinet heeft dat beeld in de reactie op de rapporten van de OvV ook onderkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Veldhoven over de Rijksverkoop van natuur in Nationaal Park

MPs Ouwehand and Van Veldhoven asked whether the sale by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf of the Vafamil nature site in Bloemendaal, which lies within the EHS, Zuid-Kennemerland National Park and Natura 2000, should be stopped or transferred to a nature manager. Minister Blok answered that the site remains protected by zoning and Natura 2000 obligations regardless of buyer, that sales follow state-aid rules, and that zoning changes are a municipal responsibility.
For this reason, in principle it does not matter to whom the site is sold: a large nature manager or another private legal entity.
Om deze reden maakt het dan in beginsel niet uit aan wie het terrein wordt verkocht; een grote natuurbeheerder of een andere particuliere rechtspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht «Ministerie durft info-avonden hoogspanningsmasten Oosterhout, Zevenbergen niet aan: «Te gevaarlijk»

MP Van Veldhoven asked why the information evenings on the Zuid-West 380 kV high-voltage line in Oosterhout and Zevenbergen were cancelled, and whether the route change and the need for the line were justified. Minister Kamp answered that the evenings were postponed for public order and safety reasons, five new evenings are planned, the southern route was chosen to avoid sensitive destinations, and a Ministry report on grid quality norms was sent to the House.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de Isla raffinaderij in verhouding tot internationale milieuverdragen

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked how the government's position that the Isla refinery's pollution and CO2 emissions are a purely Curaçao matter fits with Kingdom-wide treaty obligations, why the refinery is absent from the biodiversity report, and why some environmental treaties apply to the whole Kingdom and others only to the European part. The government answered that each country within the Kingdom is responsible for implementing environmental policy and its treaty obligations, that the refinery was excluded from the CBD report because it concerns green environment and little data exists, and that treaty application depends on extension requests and implementing legislation.
However, within the Kingdom each country is itself responsible for implementing environmental policy.
Echter binnen het Koninkrijk is elk land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het artikel ‘Gemalen kunnen veel energie besparen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about press reports that pumping stations (gemalen) could save considerable energy, and whether this could help meet the 2020 efficiency target. The minister said the studies show savings potential but are too limited to confirm the 20% figure, committed to discussing bemaling with the Unie van Waterschappen, and noted that investments pay back in 7-10 years.
I am certainly willing to do that.
Ik ben daar zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Schouw over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

MPs Van Veldhoven and Schouw asked whether a Nature study linking neonicotinoid pesticides such as imidacloprid to declining farmland bird populations requires action under EU pesticide law and the Birds Directive, whether EFSA should assess it, and whether precautionary measures should be taken quickly. The Secretary of State referred the answers to a separate letter on the Nature publication, indicating no substantive answer is given in this document.
For the answers to questions 1 to 3 I refer you to the letter to the House titled 'Nature publication imidacloprid and decline of bird populations' of 27 October 2014.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 3 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief «Nature publicatie imidacloprid en afname van vogelpopulaties» van 27 oktober 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over windparken op zee

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about uncertainty over offshore wind park construction, including the NWEA proposal for existing permit holders to seek subsidies, the delayed delivery of the route map, the feasibility of the Energy Agreement target, and the choice of Borssele over Hollandse Kust. The minister replies that the NWEA proposal does not speed up rollout, the route map and bill are on schedule, existing permits will not be used, and Borssele is chosen because preparations there could start earliest.
I hope for a swift treatment by the House of Representatives and the Senate.
Ik hoop op een snelle behandeling door de Tweede en Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat ook de opvolger van de Fyra steeds vaker uitvalt

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about rising cancellations on the IC Direct high-speed train (Fyra successor) between Amsterdam and Breda, requesting statistics, causes, remedial measures, and penalties. The government answered with monthly cancellation and punctuality figures, attributed causes mainly to rolling stock shortages and partly to infrastructure and external factors, listed NS and ProRail measures, and noted a penalty regime from 2015.
NS and ProRail have meanwhile taken measures to bring the cancellations down quickly again.
NS en ProRail hebben inmiddels maatregelen genomen om de uitval weer snel omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Twee op de drie Nederlanders steunen windmolens’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether provinces are meeting their Energy Agreement commitments on onshore wind and whether all provincial zoning plans have been received and assessed. The minister states that most provinces meet the agreed targets, that the plans were delivered for the monitor, and that a guarantee on the 2020 target cannot be given, but promises to send the monitor and an overview to parliament.
I will send your House an up-to-date overview of the state of affairs in all provinces shortly.
Ik zal uw Kamer op korte termijn een actueel overzicht van de stand van zaken in alle provincies toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over fraude bij schadeherstel van auto’s

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about widespread fraud in car bodywork repair, reported by the insurers' association, and whether the government would act if the sector fails to fix it. Minister Opstelten said he supports industry measures within legal and proportionality limits, pointed to a convenant and a shared-data approach with RDW and VbV, and described existing police and prosecution arrangements, without announcing new government intervention.
I think it is good that the Association of Insurers has investigated irregularities and fraud in the repair of bodywork damage to passenger cars.
Ik vind het goed dat het Verbond van Verzekeraars onderzoek heeft gedaan naar onregelmatigheden en fraude bij de reparatie van blikschade aan personenauto's
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het bericht “Geen doorstart luchthaven Twente”

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked whether the Twente airport decision procedure should be halted after the regional initiator stopped pursuing a commercial airport, and whether the military airport designation and regulation could still apply. The state secretary replied that talks with the region are ongoing, that the procedure's consequences will be reviewed, and that military designation of Twente will be extended to 1 November 2016 for existing users.
I will consult with the region about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ga met de regio in overleg over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber en Ouwehand over schaliegasboringen Argentinië

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie and PvdD asked the government about Shell's shale gas test drilling in Argentina, including proximity to a protected area, environmental information access, consultation and compensation for local farmers, and OECD guideline compliance. The minister answered that the drilling lies outside the current protected area, that Shell claims legal compliance and denies harm to livestock, that the embassy's 2013 site visit was routine economic diplomacy, and that OECD guideline questions fall to the National Contact Point.
Whether and to what extent the Environment and Information Disclosure chapters apply to Shell's activities in Vaca Muerta, I cannot assess.
Of en in hoeverre de hoofdstukken Milieu en Informatieverstrekking van toepassing zijn op de activiteiten van Shell in Vaca Muerta, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over afvalopslag in zoutholtes

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about plans to stabilise salt caverns in Twente by filling them with waste-based material, covering applicable law, consultation with authorities and residents, leakage risks, liability, alternatives and whether sinkholes are guaranteed to be prevented. The government answered that several laws apply, that a risk assessment and risk management plan are still pending and will be reviewed by supervisory bodies before a decision, and that the mining company is liable for damage.
State Supervision of Mines, TNO and the Technical Committee on Soil Movement assess the storage plan before I make a decision.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen, TNO en de Technische Commissie Bodembeweging beoordelen het opslagplan alvorens ik een beluit neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eerste schip met teerzandolie volgende week in Europa aankomt

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dik-Faber asked whether the first shipment of Canadian tar sands oil reaching Europe would reach the Netherlands, whether consumers could choose non-tar-sands fuel, and how this fits EU climate policy. The minister replied that the government has no insight into individual oil transactions or origin data, that mandatory origin labelling is not required internationally, and that the Fuel Quality Directive rules on crude sourcing will be discussed once the Commission proposal is out.
The Dutch government also does not hold data on the place of purchase and origin of oil.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt ook niet over gegevens over plaats van aankoop en herkomst van olie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het recyclen van luiers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about recycling nappies, the cost of recycling versus incineration, and the government's plans. The state secretary said a study with the waste association NVRD will examine options for incontinence material, with results expected in the first half of 2015, and that no Dutch facility currently recycles it.
Together with the Dutch association for waste and cleansing management (NVRD), a study will be carried out, and other chain partners will be involved.
Samen met de Nederlandse Vereniging van afval- en reinigingsmanagement (NVRD) zal een onderzoek worden verricht, andere ketenpartners worden hier bij betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de situatie bij NRG Petten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the financial distress of NRG Petten, the status of a bridging credit, the future of the planned Pallas reactor and its business case, ECN's role, and economic impact of a possible bankruptcy. The minister said the credit request is under study with a positive stance under strict conditions, decision expected in summer, Pallas is run by an independent foundation with a planning phase of at least four years, and declined to speculate on a bankruptcy that has not occurred.
The credit request is currently being studied.
Het kredietverzoek wordt op dit moment bestudeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (Duitsland, bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onder Ensche

An MP from D66 asked about liability for oil leaks in nature areas, the location and subsurface suitability of planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, alternatives, and risks by substance. The minister answered that the permit holder would be liable, that the planned storage is near several nature and drinking water areas, and that underground storage was chosen for cost, safety and strategic reasons.
Under the Civil Code article 175 and 177, the permit holder is liable for damage to nature and the living environment if oil leaks in nature areas were to occur in the Netherlands.

Op grond van het Burgerlijk Wetboek 6, artikel 175 en artikel 177, is de vergunninghouder aansprakelijk voor schade aan natuur en leefomgeving indien olielekkages in natuurgebieden zich in Nederland voor zouden doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven naar aanleiding van het bericht van 28 april 2014 dat de alternatieve taxidienst Uber wordt verboden in Brussel en Berlijn

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked whether Dutch law accommodates innovative platforms such as Uber and Airbnb, after bans in Brussels and Berlin. The minister answered that existing taxi rules pose no obstacles to intermediaries like Uber, that the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act will be evaluated in autumn 2014, and that the German and Belgian rulings do not affect EU internal market policy.
In autumn 2014 the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act 2000 will be evaluated.
In het najaar van 2014 wordt het taxideel van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) en de problematiek rond de zogenaamde «interim-uitbreiders»

An MP asked the state secretary about the Noordelijke Rekenkamer reports on decentralised nature policy and about 'interim expanders', farms expanded without a Natuurbeschermingswet permit, including the regional response, a national working group, a complete list of such farms, the effect on PAS deposition space, a standstill and a generic solution. The secretary acknowledged the problem, said a generic solution via individual permits could legalise most cases, but gave no list yet, rejected a standstill and only described ongoing exploratory work.
It is not yet clear whether this information is suitable for identifying all interim expanders.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of deze informatie geschikt is om alle interim-uitbreiders te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht “‘Ozonvreters’ in atmosfeer ondanks succes CFK-verbod’’

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that ozone-depleting gases persist in the atmosphere despite the CFC ban, and whether industry transparency and the Montreal Protocol agenda should respond. The state secretary said the findings are minor and known, that existing EU and Dutch reporting duties already cover by-production, and that she will raise transparency in Montreal Protocol discussions while prioritising the largest effects.
Dutch (and European) companies are already obliged under current regulations to report on by-production of ozone-depleting substances.
Nederlandse (en Europese) bedrijven zijn op grond van de huidige regelgeving al verplicht om te rapporteren over bijproductie van ozonlaagaantastende stoffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het ontwerp luchthavenbesluit luchthaven Twente

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked the state secretary about the draft airport decree allowing Twente airport to grow to 22,000 aircraft movements, including the absence of a European Commission state-aid ruling, the withheld business plan and financial figures, passenger forecasts, the operator's inexperience, and the 6-km nature restrictions. The state secretary answered that the decree rests on a tendered concession and a verified low-growth scenario, that the business plan and parts of the financial report are withheld as commercially sensitive, and that the decree will only be finalised after a positive Commission state-aid decision.
The business plan for Twente airport was drawn up by the operating company.
Het businessplan voor luchthaven Twente is opgesteld door de exploitatiemaatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de toepassing van de Warmtewet, naar aanleiding van het Algemeen overleg Energie van 18 februari 2014

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs five questions on how the Warmtewet's maximum heat tariffs, connection cost rules, shared-meter situations and landlord-tenant heat supply are applied and enforced. The minister answered that ACM enforces tariffs, a monitor of parameters is underway, one-off connection fees are left to negotiation, and existing contracts continue, with the government promising to inform parliament in Q2 2014.

In the general consultation of 18 February in which I undertook to map problems in implementing the Heat Act, I indicated that I would inform the House of the findings and conclusions in the second quarter.

In het algemeen overleg van 18 februari waarin ik heb toegezegd knelpunten rondom de uitvoering van de Warmtewet in kaart te brengen, heb ik aangegeven de Tweede Kamer in het tweede kwartaal te informeren over de bevindingen en conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de voortgang van de Structuurvisie Windenergie op Land

An MP from D66 asked the minister why the final decision on the Structuurvisie Windenergie op Land, planned for autumn 2013, had not been taken, what the new timeline is, and what the progress is per province, and whether intervention is planned to meet the 6,000 MW target for 2020. The minister explains that the vision is being updated after consultations and promises the final vision by April, with provincial progress to follow then, while expressing confidence that provinces will fix the remaining capacity.
I will inform your House, when sending the final structuurvisie, about the current progress per province.
Ik zal uw Kamer met de toezending van de definitieve structuurvisie informeren over de actuele voortgang per provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van duurzame energiedoelstellingen voor 2030

An MP asked whether the government still supports leading international cooperation on sustainable energy, how it relates to a letter from eight EU ministers calling for binding 2030 renewable targets, and why the Netherlands did not co-sign it. The government answered that it backs a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% and that, as Green Growth Group members disagree on separate renewable and efficiency targets, the Netherlands took no explicit position and was not asked to co-sign.
In the Green Growth Group the Netherlands, in line with the cabinet's response to the European Green Paper, has argued for a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% compared with 1990.
Nederland heeft in de Green Growth Group conform de kabinetsreactie op het Europese Groenboek gepleit voor een CO 2 -reductiedoel van ten minste 40% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van nota’s en meterstanden voor energie en water

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Infrastructure and Environment about disputes over annual energy and water bills, estimated meter readings, price comparison sites, and smart meter rules. The government answered that disputes are rare and falling, that estimates are used mainly when consumers do not report meter readings, and that it sees no structural overestimation or need for new rules.
The share of annual bills that leads to a dispute between consumer and energy supplier is very small.
Het aandeel jaarnota’s dat leidt tot een geschil tussen afnemer en energieleverancier is erg gering
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de (illegale) aanleg van bedrijventerrein Baanstee Noord in het leefgebied van beschermde diersoorten als de steenuil en de kerkuil

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the alleged illegal construction of the Baanstee Noord business park in habitat of protected owl species, following a court ruling requiring an exemption procedure, and why the government appealed. The State Secretary answered that the municipality's measures (nest boxes and new habitat) guaranteed ecological functionality so no exemption was needed, that appeal was made because of precedent concerns, and that the nature law bill addresses such cases.
According to settled case law, no exemption under the Flora and Fauna Act is needed if measures are taken that guarantee the lasting ecological functionality of a breeding or resting place.

Naar vaste rechtspraak is geen ontheffing op grond van de Flora- en faunawet nodig indien maatregelen worden genomen die de blijvende ecologische functionaliteit van een broed- of rustplaats garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) over de opsporingsvergunningen aardwarmte Friesland en Utrecht – Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether geothermal exploration permits granted to Transmark Renewables could involve fracking near drinking water, a national park and Natura 2000 areas, and how this compares with shale gas rules. The minister replied that the permit alone allows no drilling, further permits and environmental assessments are required, provinces Overijssel, Utrecht and Noord-Brabant have objected, and environmental protection under the Mining Act is limited but covered by other laws.
An exploration permit, such as the one I granted to Transmark Renewables B.V., does not however give me the possibility to attach environmental conditions.
Een opsporingsvergunning, zoals door mij verleend aan Transmark Renewables B.V., biedt mij echter niet de mogelijkheid voorschriften op te nemen ten aanzien van het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over de inzet van het alcoholslot

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about the high number of drivers refusing the alcohol lock programme (ASP), its relation to criminal sentencing, cost hardship, the CBR's automatic imposition without regard to personal circumstances, and measurement errors. The minister answered that refusal reasons are varied, the administrative and criminal tracks run largely separately, the CBR cannot consider personal circumstances while administrative judges can (rarely do), and that the lock is calibrated to near-zero error though it cannot distinguish mouth from blood alcohol; an interim report is promised alongside the letter.
The administrative judge does have room to take the offender's situation into account.
De bestuursrechter heeft wel ruimte om rekening te houden met de situatie van de overtreder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber, De Rouwe en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat NS stations overslaat bij vertraging

Four MPs asked the state secretary about reports that NS skips stations when trains are delayed, asking for figures, justification, passenger information, and whether the practice should be restricted. The state secretary said skipping is in principle unacceptable but may be a last-resort measure to prevent wider delays, provided passengers are informed; NS will report annually on the practice and no new restrictions or overload declaration are planned.

I have therefore agreed with NS that the company will provide me annually with an overview of figures, as NS has now compiled for the years 2010 through 2013, with an explanation of the routes where the measure is most often applied.

Ik heb daarom met NS de afspraak gemaakt dat het bedrijf mij jaarlijks een overzicht met cijfers levert zoals NS dat nu voor de jaren 2010 t/m 2013 heeft opgesteld en daarbij een toelichting geeft op de trajecten waar de maatregel het meest wordt getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over “immer oplopende Fyra-kosten”

An MP asked whether the Fyra train debacle could cost NS and the state up to 300 million euro and how dividend losses would affect infrastructure investment. The ministers said the 0 to 300 million bandwidth is highly uncertain, withheld details of the ongoing settlement with Ansaldobreda, and outlined a 119 million dividend shortfall to be offset by cutting the Infrastructure Fund, with further budget agreements at the Spring Memorandum.
To avoid harming the interests of the State and its holding, I cannot inform you further on the progress of that at this time.
Om de belangen van de Staat en diens deelneming niet te schaden kan ik u over het verloop daarvan op dit moment niet nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het door de Koning regeren “bij de Gratie Gods”

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the royal title 'bij de Gratie Gods' in the promulgation formula is a personal religious statement or a feature of the constitutional order, and why the formula remains in an additional article without a statutory deadline. The government answered that the phrase is a traditional religious expression rather than a constitutional element, that the 'enz.' allows it, and declined to prioritise a bill to replace the formula.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de bijdrage aan luchtvervuiling door houtkachels

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about health and air-pollution risks from wood-burning stoves, citing research that wood smoke can contribute substantially to local fine particulate levels, and whether the government would study this, adopt measures used abroad, or treat it as a problem. The state secretary said the evidence is not conclusive, that the problem is mainly local nuisance best handled by municipalities, and that a stakeholder meeting would be organised in the autumn.
The primary responsibility lies with the citizen who burns a wood stove to do so without causing nuisance.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de burger die een houtkachel stookt om dat zo te doen dat geen overlast wordt veroorzaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de ongezonde lucht in de grote steden

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about Milieudefensie measurements showing unhealthy air in big cities, the causes of nitrogen dioxide pollution, and whether the 2012 raising of the motorway speed limit to 100 km/h should be reversed. The government answered that more measures are needed, that improvement is a shared responsibility of national and local authorities, that a joint action plan with big-city aldermen is being prepared, and that the speed increase has negligible air-quality effects so lowering limits is not warranted.
Yes, more measures are needed. That is why I sat down with aldermen of the big cities.
Ja er zijn meer maatregelen nodig. Daarom heb ik ook om de tafel gezeten met wethouders van de grote steden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid

An MP from D66 asked the government why it lacks a clear vision on raw materials and whether supply shortages and conflict-sourced inputs threaten Dutch agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Minister Kamp answered that raw-material security is primarily the responsibility of business, cited existing initiatives such as conflict-free tin and the planned monitoring and research, but declined to commit to a new overarching strategy or to a partnership with the TNO/HCSS expertise centre.
Raw-material supply security and procurement policy are in the first instance the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid en inkoopbeleid zijn in eerste aanleg de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht 'Tunnel levert ING miljoenen op'

An MP from D66 asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that the Noord tunnel public-private partnership, led by a consortium including ING, yields large profits, and whether returns, renegotiation and oversight by the ACM are appropriate. The minister defended the 1988 contract as reflecting the risks and knowledge of the time, said the passage tariff will be reset in January 2014 within contract terms, rejected seeking extra ACM advice, and promised to keep the House informed through budget debates and progress reports.
Question 9: Are you willing to keep the House informed of developments in this area? Answer 9: Yes, information exchange is arranged through the budget debate and the regular DBFM(O) progress report.
Vraag 9 Bent u bereid de Kamer van de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein op de hoogte te houden? Antwoord 9 Ja, de informatie-uitwisseling is geregeld via de begrotingsbehandeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Belgen tegen lijn Den Haag-Brussel’

An MP asked whether Belgium's rail authority refuses to grant 2014 train paths for the Lage Landen Lijn (The Hague–Brussels) and whether the minister will ask Belgian counterparts for clarification. The state secretary answers that Arriva's Belgian safety certificate application failed, so no train paths could be allocated, is positive in principle about the line, and sees no need to seek further clarification from Belgium.
I am already well informed at official level about the Belgian admission process and on that basis see no need to ask my Belgian counterpart for further clarification.
Ik ben reeds op ambtelijk niveau goed geïnformeerd over het Belgische toelatingsproces en zie op basis daarvan geen noodzaak om verdere opheldering te vragen bij mijn Belgische ambtgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven over de uitvoering van de subsidieregeling voor zonnepanelen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the solar panel subsidy scheme: whether subsidies can be obtained without proof of payment, whether checks are only sampled under the high-trust approach, how many applicants were checked, whether other schemes are run the same way, how the money will be evaluated, and what the scheme means for employment after the China import dispute. The minister replied that a signed purchase agreement is required, that 224 sampled applications were checked with no undue payments found, that the scheme will not be evaluated, and that the employment outlook is uncertain.
That is why it was decided not to request proof of payment at the time of the subsidy application.
Daarom is er voor gekozen om op het moment van de subsidieaanvraag geen betalingsbewijs te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra en Voortman over autisme en rijbewijskeuringen

MPs asked why people with autism must be medically re-examined for a driving licence, whether a standard test and a public list of examining specialists should exist, why examination fees vary, and whether periodic re-examination can be dropped after the Health Council advice. The minister explains the Health Council basis and checklist, notes that the NZa sets maximum fees and plans tariff differentiation from 2014, declines free choice of doctor for now while promising to weigh a list with the CBR and specialists, and intends to adopt the advice dropping triennial re-examination by 1 October.
I intend to adopt this advice from the Health Council.
Ik ben voornemens dit advies van de Gezondheidsraad over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het milieuprobleem veroorzaakt door oude boten in havens

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about abandoned sailing and motor yachts in Dutch harbours, including ownership tracing, a national registration system, a disposal levy and a clean-up fund. The state secretary answered that harbour managers are responsible for records, that existing registration suffices, that disposal levies and funds are for producers and industry, and that abandoned vessels are not currently a significant environmental problem.
I see no need for the central government to introduce a new system in addition to these two systems.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om als Rijksoverheid aanvullend aan deze twee systemen een nieuw systeem in te voeren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de privacybestendigheid van de anonieme OV-chipkaart

An MP from D66 asks the state secretary whether the government's position that the anonymous OV-chipkaart does not involve personal data holds, given the CBP's view and research showing transit data can be traced to individuals, and asks whether the government will take steps to better protect travel data. The state secretary answers that the CBP is the competent supervisor, that TLS does not collect name or address data, that the online transaction overview is popular, and that he sees no reason to change his position.
Supervision of compliance with privacy legislation has not been assigned to me but to the CBP as the independent supervisor.
Toezicht op de naleving van de privacywetgeving is niet bij mij belegd maar bij het CBP als onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over vuilstortplaatsen

An MP asked the state secretary about contaminated waste dumps in The Hague, whether other municipalities should be warned, whether contaminated sites should be inventoried nationwide, and the progress of a motion and a Green Deal on sustainable landfill management. The government answered that The Hague's sites pose no current risk, the GGD is advising, national data is decentralised, and the Green Deal is delayed to early 2014 with a methane study expected around September.
Because of the decentralisation, the ministry has no data available at national level on Navos landfill sites.
Vanwege de decentralisatie zijn bij het ministerie geen gegevens op landelijk niveau beschikbaar over Navos-stortplaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven over het herbestemmen van Rijksvastgoed

D66 MPs asked whether empty Rijksgebouw parking garages could be opened to the public in evenings and weekends to ease city parking problems, and what security obstacles exist. The minister answered that parking is a municipal responsibility, that five Hague garages are already partly public, and listed conditions for opening garages, plus a list of locations with more than 25 spaces.
Parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Het parkeerbeleid is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over de aantasting van de beschermde status van het Mariene Park bij Bonaire

MPs Van Veldhoven and Hachchi asked the state secretary about reports that Bonaire's executive council would weaken the protected status of the Bonaire National Marine Park, the planned pier near Karel's Bar, and whether the national government had enough oversight of coastal development. The state secretary answered that Bonaire is responsible for permits under its own ordinances, that the national minister issued a conditional permit for the pier after assessment, and that a strategic environmental assessment of the coastal zone is being prepared.

The Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is responsible for the good management, conservation and protection of the marine park in accordance with the Bonaire Nature Management Ordinance and the spatial planning framework.

Het Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is verantwoordelijk voor een goed beheer, behoud en bescherming van het mariene park overeenkomstig de Verordening Natuurbeheer Bonaire en de kaders van de ruimtelijke ordening.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over de privacybestendigheid van de anonieme ov-chipkaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether travel histories of anonymous OV-chipkaart holders can be viewed with only the card number and expiry date, and whether this is undesirable. The state secretary answered that only card number and expiry are needed, that TLS holds no personal data on anonymous cards, and that no further action is needed, while pointing to personal cards as a privacy-protective option.
I will not ask TLS to require additional safeguards from TLS when viewing the transaction data of the anonymous OV-chipkaart.
Ik zal TLS niet verzoeken om extra waarborgen van TLS te verlangen bij het inzien van de transactiegegevens van de anonieme ov-chipkaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het toestaan van de vrije vangst van de rivierprik in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary why the river lamprey was moved from the Flora- and Faunawet to the Visserijwet, whether it is a sustainable population, and whether this complies with the Rhine convention. The state secretary answered that the species is now under strict fishing restrictions (closed seasons and a minimum size) following an IMARES analysis, so no negative effect on the stock is expected and commercial fishing will hardly be possible.
Because of the restrictive conditions under which the river lamprey is included in the Visserijwet, no negative effect on the stock situation of this species is expected.
Vanwege de beperkende voorwaarden waaronder de rivierprik in de Visserijwet is opgenomen, is geen negatief effect op de bestandssituatie voor deze vissoort te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Veldhoven over over het gebrek aan voortgang van de doelstelling om in 2015 65%van het huishoudelijk afval te hergebruiken

An MP asked the state secretary why household waste recycling is lagging behind the 65% target for 2015, including which municipalities recycle under 40%, the Den Haag pilot status, and what concrete measures will be taken. The state secretary answered that 27 municipalities collected under 40% in 2011, that municipalities are autonomous in waste collection, and that consultation with municipalities will follow, without committing to binding measures.
I have no control over how a municipality organises collection and which instruments it uses.
Ik heb geen zeggenschap over hoe een gemeente de inzameling vormgeeft en welke instrumenten men daarbij inzet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de Marine wederom ingeroepen moest worden om de watervoorziening op Saba te redden

MPs Hachchi and van Veldhoven asked about the Navy being called in again to supply water on Saba, the adequacy of the island's water supply, and the government's promised structural solution. The minister answered that a drinking water study was launched to produce a durable solution by summer 2013, that imported water is an emergency measure, and that the Caribbean Netherlands water law differs from the Drinkwaterwet.
The study will be ready around summer, after which it will be jointly determined with Saba which measures will be implemented.
Het onderzoek zal rond de zomer gereed zijn, waarna gezamenlijk met Saba zal worden bepaald welke maatregelen zullen worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de zorgkosten als gevolg van luchtverontreiniging door zware bedrijfswagens (zogenaamde heavy goods vehicles, hierna: HGV’s)

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary about health costs of air pollution from heavy goods vehicles, citing EEA estimates, and asked whether HGV fleet renewal, emission shares and stricter EU rules would be pursued. The state secretary answered that Euro standards are being tightened, a Eurovignet and city/Maasvlakte zones exist, the cost figures are broadly accepted though mostly reflect lost life-years, and the government will work on EU-level policy revision.
The RIVM calculates annually the number of premature deaths resulting from acute exposure to elevated air pollution.
Het RIVM berekent jaarlijks het aantal vroegtijdige sterfgevallen ten gevolge van acute blootstelling aan verhoogde luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over asbestsanering in de scholen van Bonaire

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the state secretary whether asbestos removal from Bonaire schools would follow Dutch rules, where the material would go, who is responsible and pays, and whether BES law should be aligned with Dutch standards. The government answered that Dutch rules are used as the benchmark, that the material will likely be shipped to the Netherlands for processing with temporary storage on Bonaire, that the Rijksgebouwendienst is responsible for storage while the Bonaire public body and the education ministry bear the costs, and that full alignment of BES law is deferred to a 2015 evaluation.
Until then, in principle the principle of legislative calm is maintained.
Tot die tijd wordt in beginsel vastgehouden aan het uitgangspunt van legislatieve rust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over luchtkwaliteit

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about air quality: why there are no measurements in Maastricht, whether the government agrees that Dutch air quality remains poor despite policy, whether it accepts RIVM's warning about uncertain input data, and why measures only apply at 'serious' smog. The state secretary answered that the monitoring network is designed for national coverage, that policy has reduced fine dust, that data quality is the responsibility of road managers with steps taken, and that 'moderate' smog does not imply serious health consequences.
I can agree with that statement to the extent that further improvement of air quality is certainly desirable, given the health effects.
Ik kan die uitspraak in zoverre onderschrijven, dat verdere verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit zeker gewenst is, gezien de effecten op de gezondheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sterke daling van de CO2-prijs

Three MPs (Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos, Van Tongeren) asked the state secretary whether the sharp fall in the EU ETS carbon price after the ITRE vote was unexpected, whether confidence in the ETS is structurally at stake, and what the timetable is for backloading and structural reform. The secretary answered that the price drop was foreseeable given the emissions-rights surplus, that the ETS itself is not in question but needs strengthening, and gave a timetable (EP vote on backloading around 15 April, PBL follow-up study in April) and a count of member states' positions.
I recently informed you by letter about the input the government intends to provide
Ik heb u recentelijk bij brief geïnformeerd over de inbreng die de regering voornemens is te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over gebrek aan veiligheid in overdekte zwembaden

An MP asks about a lamp falling in a Dordrecht indoor swimming pool, use of corrosion-prone stainless steel fixings, the status of a 2004 practice guideline, enforcement gaps by municipalities, and whether the national government will re-inspect pools. The minister answers that the guideline remains usable and NEN will update it, that the Rijk no longer has interbestuurlijk toezicht over municipalities since oversight moved to provinces, and declines a new ILT inspection.
Supervision of the municipalities no longer lies with the national government but with the provinces.
Het toezicht op de gemeenten ligt niet meer bij het Rijk maar bij de provincies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Veldhoven over de kwartaalrapportage van het OV loket waarin wordt gesteld dat studenten onredelijk worden behandeld bij een defecte OV-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why students get no replacement OV-chipkaart at counters while other travellers do, citing an ombudsman report calling this unequal and unnecessary. The minister answered that privacy rules prevent carriers from verifying student status, that these rules will not change, and that only faster replacement is being explored.
For students this service is not possible with any carrier, for privacy reasons.
Voor studenten is deze service om privacyredenen bij geen enkele vervoerder mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de constructie van tenten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about tent collapses at events, the inspection of a festival tent in Steenwijkerwold, the division of oversight between the Inspectorate and municipalities, and whether tent safety rules are adequate. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for event permits and oversight, that the Inspectorate has no direct role, that the 2012 inspection report was sent to municipal councils with recommendations, and that the inspectorates will review progress in 2013 while a decree on fire safety of temporary structures is in preparation.
Municipalities are responsible for and authorised to grant permits for events under the General Local Regulations (APV), which are based on the Municipalities Act.
De gemeenten zijn op grond van Algemene Plaatselijke Verordeningen (APV), die gebaseerd zijn op de Gemeentewet, verantwoordelijk voor en bevoegd tot het verlenen van een vergunning voor evenementen.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven met betrekking tot de voortgang van Natura 2000

An MP asked the state secretary about the progress of Natura 2000 designations, management plans, the removal of complementary objectives, nitrogen and hydrological problems. The government answered that 58 sites are definitively designated, management plans are in various stages, complementary objectives are being removed after consultation, and nitrogen and drainage measures are being addressed through the PAS.
I am therefore currently mapping what the policy task is in this regard, what agricultural nature management could contribute, and whether additional effort is necessary.
Ik breng momenteel dan ook in kaart wat de beleidsopgave hierin is, wat agrarisch natuurbeheer daar bijvoorbeeld aan bij kan dragen en of eventueel extra inzet noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het transport van gevaarlijke stoffen over de weg

An MP asked ministers about inspection findings that around 30% of trucks carrying dangerous goods failed safety rules, mostly minor lapses, and about gaps in emergency-services knowledge and incident management. The government accepted the inspection finding, said most violations are minor and the industry is primarily responsible, pointed to ongoing ILT inspections and existing emergency-response arrangements, and disputed that cooperation with emergency services is insufficient.
I endorse the conclusion of the ILT.
Ik onderschrijf de conclusie van de ILT.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de sterke achteruitgang van het aantal vuursalamanders in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp decline of fire salamanders in the Netherlands, whether the species faces extinction, whether it has disappeared elsewhere, and whether legal protection should be tightened. The state secretary called recent developments worrying, said the species is extinct in the Voerstreek in Belgium, is discussing research with nature organisations, and noted that existing Flora- and faunawet protections already cover the issues raised.
I am in consultation with the nature organisations concerned about possibilities for research into the cause of the decline.
Ik ben met de betrokken natuurorganisaties in overleg over mogelijkheden van onderzoek naar de oorzaak van de achteruitgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Alarm over gifalg’

An MP asked why water from the Ouwerkerkse Kreek was pumped into the Oosterschelde after a toxic algae species was detected and a swimming ban issued, who decides on discharge of poor-quality water, and whether water boards can isolate contaminated water. The state secretary answered that discharge stopped on 7 August after joint Rijkswaterstaat and water board decision, that Rijkswaterstaat as waterbeheerder decides on admissibility, and that the water board isolated the creek and adjusted drainage.
Rijkswaterstaat, as water manager of the Oosterschelde, decides whether discharge is admissible.
Rijkswaterstaat beslist als waterbeheerder van de Oosterschelde of spuien toelaatbaar is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de effectiviteit van ecoducten

An MP asked whether the Alterra report's recommended 40 to 60 metre ecoduct width is a binding minimum, which existing Dutch ecoducts fall below it, how far the report's recreation-related recommendations guide design, and whether the narrow De Borkeld ecoduct will still be used by wildlife. The state secretary answered that 40 to 60 metres is a recommendation rather than a prescribed minimum, that six existing ecoducts are narrower, that recreational use is allowed unless the primary wildlife function is impaired, and that De Borkeld is a two-year trial that can be ended if wildlife use is hindered.
Policy aims to allow recreational shared use of ecoducts, unless the primary function of the wildlife passage is impaired.
Het beleid is er op gericht recreatief medegebruik van ecoducten mogelijk te maken, tenzij de primaire functie van de faunapassage wordt aangetast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie en het Europese Milieuagentschap naar de kwaliteit van het open zwemwater in de Europese Unie

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary about EU findings that Dutch open bathing water quality is weak, the role of agricultural runoff, pesticide risks, climate change, and whether Dutch bathing water can meet EU targets given budget cuts to the Water Framework Directive. The state secretary answered that quality improved in 2011, that pollution sources are varied and location-specific, that pesticide exposure is well below the ADI limit, that climate change poses no urgent need for action, and that meeting all EU targets cannot be guaranteed.

Despite the efforts being made, I cannot say with certainty whether the objective in Article 5(3) of the Bathing Water Directive will be met for all official bathing water locations in the Netherlands.

Ik kan ondanks de inspanningen die gepleegd worden niet met zekerheid zeggen of voor alle officiële zwemwaterlocaties in Nederland de doelstelling genoemd in art 5 lid 3 van de Zwemwaterrichtlijn gehaald zal worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dikkers en van Tongeren inzake het verpakkingenakkoord

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the deadline for signing the packaging agreement with industry could be moved to 5 July, and what the legal basis was for refusing. The state secretary answered that the deadline cannot be moved, pointed to the Belastingplan 2012 requirement to report by 30 June, and said the agreement was already signed.
It is not possible to postpone the agreement to 5 July.
Het is niet mogelijk het akkoord te verschuiven naar 5 juli.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over het artikel ‘Gif in kleding is verboden, maar komt toch in grondwater terecht’ en van de daarin genoemde rapporten van Greenpeace en RIKILT

An MP asked the state secretary about reports by Greenpeace and RIKILT on nonylphenol and nanosilver released from textiles into water, and about possible EU import bans and REACH amendments. The state secretary answered that nonylphenol exceedances are rare, that import restrictions are not yet in place and a Swedish proposal is not yet formulated, and that nanosilver risks will be evaluated in 2013 with further steps to follow.
However, it is not known to what extent NF is released into surface and drinking water through import and washing of clothing containing NFE.
Het is echter niet bekend in welke mate NF via import en het wassen van kleding NFE vrijkomt in het oppervlakte- en drinkwater.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over de waterbouwkundige gevolgen van de kabinetsplannen ten aanzien van natuurcompensatie in de Westerschelde

Ms. Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the water-engineering effects of the cabinet's Westerschelde nature-compensation plans: erosion at Saeftinghe, dike maintenance costs, the Hedwigepolder dike length and water levels, and consultation with Flanders. The state secretary answered that the buitendijkse measures are not part of the cabinet decision, that the Hedwigepolder dike length will be about 3.9 km instead of 1.5 km under full depoldering, that a 1-2 cm upstream water-level effect is expected without yet having been discussed in the Flemish-Dutch Scheldt Commission, and that no contribution has been offered to Flanders.
Those buitendijkse measures you refer to are not part of that.
Daarvan maken de door u bedoelde buitendijkse maatregelen geen onderdeel uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over natuurcompensatie in de Westerschelde

An MP asked whether the Raad van State ruling on the Rammekensschor sand depot, which found the Natura 2000 boundary inadequately justified, means estuarine habitat was lost unlawfully, and how and when it would be restored and compensated. The State Secretary acknowledged habitat loss and a flawed boundary but declined to quantify losses or set out compensation until a pending ecological study is complete.
Currently it is being carefully investigated exactly where the boundary of the Natura 2000 area should lie.
Momenteel wordt zorgvuldig onderzocht hoe de grens van het Natura 2000-gebied precies moet komen te liggen.
Antwoord vragen van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Overheden laten 30 procent energiebesparing liggen’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the 15-30 percent energy savings claimed for energy managers and outsourced maintenance are accurate, what low-hanging fruit exists, and what is done on energy management in government buildings. The minister answers that savings of 15-30 percent need more than a manager, that typically 15-20 percent is achievable with cost-effective measures, points to existing legal obligations and the 2011 action plan, and promises to share experience with innovative contracts.
The Rijksgebouwendienst will share its experiences with (innovative) contracts with the market.
Rijksgebouwendienst zullen hun ervaringen met (innovatieve) contracten delen met de markt

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebrek aan Nederlandse ambitie ten aanzien van windenergie op zee (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the lack of Dutch ambition on offshore wind, citing a Volkskrant article and Rabobank and Bloomberg reports, and asked about 2020 project output, the 4 GW gap, cost and subsidy comparisons with other countries, jobs and patents, and industrial policy. The minister responded that the reports' conclusions are broadly consistent with sector views, rejected protectionism, projected about 1 GW of offshore capacity by 2020, said offshore wind has no prominent role in the 2020 renewables approach, and pointed to the topsector policy and a Green Deal with industry.
I have concluded a Green Deal with NWEA on, among other things, innovation and cost reduction.
Ik heb een Green Deal gesloten met NWEA over onder meer innovatie en kostenreductie

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ernstige vervuiling bij teerput in Vasse (ingezonden 28 oktober 20

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked about serious contamination near a tar pit in Vasse, including who manages it, past works, inspection involvement, health risks and broken monitoring wells. The state secretary answered that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority and client, that health risk is very unlikely, that some wells are broken but the groundwater picture is unchanged, and that the sanitation is to finish around 2015 with a new cover in early 2012.
The province of Overijssel is the competent authority under the Soil Protection Act and also the owner of the tar pit and client for the remediation.
De provincie Overijssel is bevoegd gezag in het kader van de Wet bodembescherming en tevens eigenaar van de teerput en opdrachtgever van de sanering.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het nakomen van internationale afspraken ten aanzien van milieubelastende subsidies en belastingvoordelen (ingezonden 6 okt

An MP asked whether the government will confirm its international commitment to phase out environmentally harmful subsidies, which subsidies currently have the heaviest environmental impact, and whether it will phase them out and press other countries. The state secretary confirmed the commitment, said further research is needed on environmental pressure, and said the government favours phasing out such subsidies case by case, pursued mainly at EU level.
The cabinet is in principle in favour of abolishing environmentally harmful subsidies.
Het kabinet is in beginsel voor het afschaffen van milieubelastende subsidies.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de verdwijnende dijk rondom de Hedwigepolder (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about the dike between the Hedwige and Prosper polders, the cost and timing of a new Dutch dike, flood and nature effects, and hunting of smew after the nature law revision. The state secretary answered that excavation on the Belgian side began on 12 October 2011, that a new primary dike of about 15 million euro will be needed on Dutch territory, and that smew is proposed as a huntable species.
On the flood risks around the Antwerp region in a new situation without de-embankment of the Dutch Hedwige polder, I have no information.
Over de overstromingsrisico's rondom de regio Antwerpen in een nieuwe situatie zonder ontpoldering van de Nederlandse Hedwigepolder heb ik geen informatie.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verschillende stekkers en betaalpasjes voor het laden van elektrische voertuigen (ingezonden 1

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the number of charging plugs, charging systems and payment cards for electric vehicles, and whether these would be standardised. The minister said three plug types currently suffice, that type 2 is the intended standard for public charging, and that EU-level standardisation is targeted for end 2011 via CEN-CENELEC.
At public charging points the electricity is currently still free.
Op publieke laadpunten is de stroom momenteel nog gratis.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Gasunie moet 1,7 miljard afwaarderen» (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Gasunie may have to write down 1.7 billion euros, the impact on the state and consumers, effects on gas network maintenance and green gas, and the Gasrotonde project. The minister confirmed a 900 million euro write-down so far, with a possible further 800 million, explained fiscal and tariff consequences, and gave general answers on network investment and green gas.

If the final decisions do not substantially change from the current draft and the estimated repayment obligation of about 1 billion euros remains, Gasunie will be forced to write off another roughly 800 million euros in 2011.

Indien de definitieve besluiten niet substantieel wijzigen ten opzichte van het huidige ontwerp en de geschatte terugbetalingsverplichting van circa 1 miljard euro in stand blijft, dan zal Gasunie genoodzaakt zijn om nog eens circa € 800 miljoen af te boeken in 2011.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Gebruik van roetfilters om fijnstof terug te dringen werk

An MP asked whether Dutch diesel soot filters remove ultrafine particles, whether current fine-dust norms adequately weight ultrafine particles, and what EU and WHO steps exist on PM0.1 standards. The state secretary answered that filters capture over 95% of fine particles, that PM10 and PM2.5 remain the appropriate norm indicators, and that the EU will ask the WHO to evaluate whether soot should be assessed separately, with no new Gezondheidsraad advice planned.
Do you share the view that more research and measurements with new equipment on PM0.1 concentrations are necessary to arrive at a more complete health indicator for fine dust?
Deelt u de mening dat meer onderzoek en metingen met de nieuwe apparatuur naar PM 0,1 concentraties noodzakelijk zijn om te komen tot een volwaardigere gezondheidsindicator voor fijnstof?

Vragen van de leden Jacobi (PvdA) en Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over correspondentie met de Europese Commissie over de afbraak van het natuurbeleid (ingezonde

MPs Jacobi and Van Veldhoven asked the state secretary about correspondence with the European Commission over the rollback of nature policy, including whether an EU information request covered several Natura 2000 issues and whether a formal infringement notice and fines were to be expected. The state secretary answered that the letter was an informal EU Pilot inquiry, not a formal notice, that the EU-pilot letter would be sent confidentially to parliament, and that fines are only possible after a Court of Justice ruling.
I have meanwhile sent the EU-pilot letter to your House on a confidential basis.
Ik heb de EU-pilot brief inmiddels op vertrouwelijke wijze uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vormgeving van de Regeling brandstoffen luchtverontreiniging (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about possible steps at EU level for implementing the fuel quality directive, whether reporting for fossil fuels in the Regeling brandstoffen luchtverontreiniging is less specific than for biofuels, and whether the regulation should be tightened and pushed in the EU for breakdowns of air-pollution values. The state secretary answers that Commission implementing rules are pending but the Dutch rules follow the Commission's consultation proposals, that existing reporting already requires separate reporting by fuel origin, and that no tightening or EU initiative on air-pollutant reporting is planned.
No. The decree and the regulation are a strict implementation of the Fuel Quality Directive.
Nee. Het besluit en de regeling zijn een strikte implementatie van de richtlijn Brandstofkwaliteit.
Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over buxusschimmels (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).
