An MP asks the State Secretaries of Economic Affairs and Education about boxwood fungal diseases (Cylindrocladium buxicola, Volutella buxii), their spread, financial costs, pesticide use, and whether infected plants can legally be traded and exported. The government answers that EU rules do not list these fungi as quarantine pests, that the NVWA has no monitoring role, that it sees no reason for further national or EU measures, and that the sector itself should take responsibility.
In view of the developments mentioned above, I see no reason to draw attention to these boxwood fungi at European level, nor to take further measures at national level.
Gezien de hiervoor genoemde ontwikkelingen zie ik geen aanleiding om in Europees verband aandacht te vragen voor deze buxusschimmels en evenmin om op nationaal niveau verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Winsten op vervuilde olie enorm, actie ondernomen» (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that profits from mixing waste into marine fuel oil are large, asking about enforcement, legal clarity, sanctions and international standards. The state secretary answered that current rules do not clearly exclude blending, detection is difficult and penalties may not deter, while describing stricter sulphur norms from 2015 and ongoing enforcement and research.
No. Under current laws and regulations it is not easy to determine whether certain substances or material flows may be used as blend components.
Neen. Op grond van de huidige wet- en regelgeving is niet eenvoudig te bepalen of bepaalde stoffen of materiaalstromen gebruikt mogen worden als blendcomponent

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat provincies d

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Interior and of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how they respond to a report finding provinces involve citizens in landscape policy only at informing, consulting and advising levels, and what they will do to broaden participation as landscape tasks are decentralised. The government disputes the reading, says provinces use many participation instruments, says involving active citizens is difficult, and points to existing programmes and a forthcoming agenda on civic participation, while leaving the choice of participation methods to provinces and municipalities.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een VN-onderzoek naar de vliegramp in Tripoli (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the ministers whether they would ask ICAO to start an investigation into the 2010 Tripoli air crash, since Libyan authorities had not finished their inquiry after a year. The state secretary replied that ICAO rules put the investigation under Libyan lead, that ICAO can only act with Libya's explicit consent, which seems unlikely given the situation, and that the Netherlands will press for a swift conclusion.
The ICAO Convention provides no possibility to take independent action without consent or a request from the member state responsible for the investigation.
Het ICAO-verdrag kent geen mogelijkheid om zonder toestemming of zonder verzoek van de voor het onderzoek verantwoordelijke lidstaat, eigenstandig acties te ondernemen.

Vragen aan van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de interviews uit de Volkskrant met Ben Bot en Ad Koppejan (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about newspaper interviews with Ben Bot and Ad Koppejan on the Hedwigepolder, including the alternative sites, Flemish funding for Westerschelde compensation, costs of alternatives, and the quality of the Nijpels-led study. The state secretary answered most questions, noting that formal talks with Flanders had not yet begun, that the dike cost would be 15 million euro, and that the requested timing for the cabinet response could not be met.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Plastic kan lucratieve bijvangst voor vissers worden» en he

An MP asks the State Secretaries about a press report and a study on plastic pollution of the oceans, the EU initiative to fund fishers collecting plastic litter, and how it will be financed, implemented and recycled. The government answers that Dutch 'fishing for litter' initiatives exist, that EU co-financing is voluntary, that funding and fraud risks will be assessed through a pilot, and that the sector has been consulted on recycling, without committing to a formal new framework.
I will consult with the Commission to look at the possibilities in the North Sea.
Ik zal in overleg met de Commissie kijken naar de mogelijkheden op de Noordzee.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over het eventueel verbieden van emissierechten afkomstig van Clean Development Mechanism (CDM)- en Joint Implementation-projec

MP Van Veldhoven asked whether the government will support banning emission credits from CDM and JI projects based on HCFK-22 or N2O for non-ETS sectors, as several EU member states propose. State Secretary Atsma answered that he is sympathetic, expects these credits will not be used after 2012, and that Dutch non-ETS sectors would not face competitiveness effects under the current arrangement.
I am sympathetic to that proposal.
Ik sta sympathiek tegenover dat voorstel.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de mogelijkheden voor het verbieden van een boomkorvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden (ingezonden 28 maart 20

An MP asked the state secretary whether bottom-trawl fishing in Natura 2000 areas in the North Sea could be banned immediately, whether predecessors wrongly refused enforcement against foreign vessels, and whether the Netherlands has a duty under EU law to adopt fishing measures. The secretary answered that a ban is justified only if mitigation is impossible, that an appropriate assessment and a permit procedure under the Nature Conservation Act are being prepared, and that enforcement against Dutch and foreign vessels can follow once the permit procedure is complete.
The decision not to enforce is currently the subject of a dispute in an appeal procedure before the Council of State.
De beslissing om niet handhavend op te treden is momenteel onderwerp van geschil in een beroepsprocedure bij de Raad van State.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) en Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Inf

Three MPs asked ministers about a benzene vapour leak and odour nuisance at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao that reportedly forced school evacuations, asking about causes, measurements, enforcement, alternatives and whether the Dutch central government should intervene. The minister said the information falls under Curaçao's autonomous environmental responsibility, declined to give details on the leak, stated the SEI refinery timetable is being met, and said enforcement of environmental norms is a Curaçao matter.
I cannot provide the requested information, and it does not fall under the information covered by Article 68 of the Constitution.
Ik kan de gevraagde informatie niet vertrekken en zij valt niet onder de informatie waarvoor artikel 68 van de Grondwet geldt.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare doelstellingen ten aanzien van het gebruik van antibiotica in de (pluim)

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about measurable, enforceable targets for reducing antibiotic use in (poultry) livestock farming, including indicators, baselines, interim goals, enforcement capacity and EU comparisons. The minister answered that the 20% (2011) and 50% (2013) reduction targets apply across sectors against 2009 use, cited the MARAN monitoring data and planned registration rules and inspection reinforcement, and said other EU countries show little comparable ambition.
Making antibiotic use transparent is an important part of the antibiotic policy for livestock farming.
Het transparant maken van het antibioticagebruik is een belangrijk onderdeel van het antibioticabeleid voor de veehouderij.
Vragen van de leden Grashoff (GroenLinks) en Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bouw van megastallen (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

MPs Grashoff and Van Veldhoven asked whether the state secretary had passed a motion on megastables to provinces and municipalities, whether the 300 NGE size threshold works as a spatial norm, and whether a temporary stop on megastable construction can be achieved. The secretary replied that letters were sent to the provinces and VNG, that NGE/SO is an economic measure not directly a spatial one, and that implementation is left to provinces and municipalities.
As I indicated in answer 1, in line with the adopted motion I have specifically drawn the attention of provinces and municipalities to your request.
Zoals ik in vraag 1 heb aangegeven heb ik conform de aangenomen motie aan provincies en gemeenten nadrukkelijk aandacht gevraagd voor uw verzoek.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de plannen van de Europese Commissie om brandstofheffingen sterker aan energie-inhoud te koppelen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported EU Commission plans to link fuel taxes more closely to energy content, including effects on climate goals, diesel use, air quality and the Mannheim inland shipping excise exemptions. The government answered that it has discussed the Green Paper with the Commission, will assess the effects only once a formal proposal exists, has a CE Delft/Ecofys study underway, and will discuss shipping and vehicle excise issues within the Energy Taxation Directive and Transport White Paper talks.
Should the European Commission submit a proposal, the First and Second Chamber will be informed of it through the so-called BNC fiche, along with the cabinet's initial position.

Mocht de Europese Commissie een voorstel indienen, dan zullen de Eerste en Tweede Kamer door middel van het zogenoemde BNC-fiche op de hoogte worden gebracht van dit voorstel en de eerste positie van het kabinet ter zake.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitspraken van de staatssecretaris over de Ecologische Hoofdstructuur (EHS) (ingezonden 22 november 2010

The MP asks the State Secretary about reported figures on realising the Ecological Main Structure (EHS), the sale of nature land, which biodiversity goals and Natura 2000 targets are at risk, and the basis for the claimed 8-10% reduction. The State Secretary says about 85% of the original EHS is realised, estimates 90-92% achievable within available funds, prioritises quality over hectares, and states that the Robuuste Verbindingszones were dropped due to cost without committing to further studies or publication of calculations.
The percentage I mentioned of 90-92% is an estimate, partly based on the financial resources the Cabinet will make available.
Het door mij genoemde percentage van 90–92% is een schatting, mede gebaseerd op de door het Kabinet ter beschikking te stellen financiële middelen.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een onderzoek naar de effecten van de verhoging van de maximumsnelheid op de CO2-uitstoot (ingezonden 21 december 201

D66 MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CO2 and NOx effects of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, citing an earlier letter to the informateur, and why the measure is in the coalition agreement despite those effects. The minister said the figures are indicative, further research is needed, and details on the approach and the questions will follow in spring.
For a more precise picture of the effects, further research is necessary.
Voor een nauwkeuriger beeld van de effecten is nader onderzoek noodzakelijk.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inzet van Nederlandse CDM projecten gebaseerd op HFC en N20 beperkingen (ingezonden 30 november 2010)

An MP asked the minister whether the European Commission's proposal to ban CDM credits from HFC-23 and N2O projects from the EU ETS from 2013 affects Dutch purchased credits, and whether the CDM Executive Board's review changes Dutch Kyoto compliance. The state secretary said the Commission's reasons are generally valid but credits already bought remain usable for Kyoto, while noting about 2 Mt CO2-eq of HFC credits delivered in 2013 may not be creditable and that the impact will be monitored.

Vragen lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie met betrekking tot de Europese inzet ter bescherming van de blauwvintonijn (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the EU position on protecting bluefin tuna, including support for a hard catch cap and closure of spawning areas. The state secretary replied that Netherlands pushed for a catch limit as close to zero as possible, that the ICCAT summit adopted a recovery plan with a 12,900-tonne catch level for two years, and that the Netherlands took part in the EU delegation.
The Netherlands has long pushed hard for a mandate based on a substantial reduction of the maximum allowable catch.
Nederland heeft zich lang hard gemaakt voor een mandaat dat uitgaat van een substantiële reductie van de maximaal toegestane vangsthoeveelheid

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese onderhandelingen met betrekking tot aanpassingen in het systeem van emissiehandel (ingezonden 18 oktobe

An MP asked the government about the stage of EU negotiations on ETS phase three, the main disputed points among member states, and the Dutch position on free allocation of allowances for process gases. The State Secretary answered that the Commission proposal was just sent to member states, outlined the contested benchmarks and allocation rules, and stated that the Netherlands favours auctioning and treats free allowances as a transitional measure.
The draft Commission proposal was sent to member states on Friday 22 October.
Het ontwerp Commissievoorstel is vrijdag 22 oktober verzonden aan de lidstaten.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Neppérus (VVD), Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66), Ouwehand (PvdD) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de st

MPs from several parties asked whether asbestos, pesticides and herbicides from the Stichting Machinale Landbouw have polluted the Wageningen area in Suriname, whether Dutch responsibility and cancer mortality are involved, and whether Dutch assistance is available. The minister answered that no recent research exists, that Suriname's authorities are investigating and planning awareness activities, and that the Netherlands will consider assistance if Suriname requests it.

Due to the lack of research data, the Surinamese authorities cannot determine the extent to which the operations of Stichting Machinale Landbouw have affected negative developments in the living environment of Wageningen and surroundings.

Vanwege het ontbreken van onderzoeksdata is door de Surinaamse autoriteiten niet vast te stellen in hoeverre de bedrijfsvoering van Stichting Machinale Landbouw van invloed is op negatieve ontwikkelingen in de leefomgeving van Wageningen en omstreken.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Varkensboer onbetrouwbaar over antibiotica» (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on pig farmers under-reporting antibiotic use, the scope of residue violations, whether all meat is tested, and whether sanctions are effective. The state secretary replied that residue exceedances are rare (0.1% of tested pigs), that the sampling system provides sufficient protection, that violations usually stem from farmer error, and that sanctions are being reviewed as part of antibiotic resistance policy.
As part of the antibiotic resistance policy, I am currently examining the effectiveness of the current sanctions regime and will make improvements where necessary.
Ik onderzoek momenteel in het kader van het antibioticaresistentiebeleid de effectiviteit van het huidige sanctieregime en zal zo nodig verbeteringen aanbrengen.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over kinderarbeid bij hazelnotenproductie in Turkije. (ingezonden 21 oktober 201

An MP asks ministers whether they endorse a broadcast finding that large numbers of children do seasonal hazelnut picking in Turkey, how EU accession talks and Commission monitoring address child labour, whether they will raise it with Turkey, and the Dutch role in processing hazelnuts from such areas. The government says it raises human rights and child labour bilaterally and in EU channels, and that a generic sustainable nut trade initiative seems ineffective given the diverse supply chains.
The Netherlands will continue to press this within the EU framework and, where appropriate, ask for specific attention to combating child labour.
Nederland zal hier dit ook in EU-kader op blijven aandringen en in voorkomend geval specifieke aandacht vragen voor de bestrijding van kinderarbeid.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het CBS rapport «Critical materials in the Dutch economy» (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the CBS report on critical materials, Chinese export restrictions on rare earths, wider economic effects of shortages, EU coordination, and recycling initiatives. The minister acknowledged concerns, said there is no acute shortage yet, pointed to WTO consultations and EU resource-efficiency work, and described Dutch recycling initiatives.
I am closely monitoring the situation and developments regarding Chinese export restrictions on rare earth metals.
Ik houd de situatie en ontwikkelingen rond de Chinese exportbeperkingen op zeldzame aardmetalen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het vraagstuk dioxinepaling (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about dioxin contamination in eels, including compensation for fishers, a private quality mark, a possible extension of the catch ban, and how the VWA will control and analyse eel samples. The state secretary refused compensation for fishers, said the catch ban was not extended but stricter controls would start in December, and said the VWA will have eel samples analysed by RIKILT.
From 1 December the nVWA will strictly check the dioxin standard in the contaminated areas.
Vanaf 1 december zal de nVWA in de verontreinigde gebieden streng op de dioxinenorm controleren.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over subsidies voor geitenboeren in Frankrijk (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether French goat-milk subsidies under the EU Health Check (article 68) caused the sharp fall in Dutch goat-milk prices, and whether this fits a free EU agricultural market. The state secretary answered that rising French production and falling imports explain the price drop, that the French schemes were notified to the Commission as EU-compliant, and that no unfair distortion exists.
I am of the view that there is no unjustified distortion of the level playing field.
Ik ben van mening dat er geen sprake is van een onterechte verstoring van het level playing field.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over jaarlijkse verlofreizen van ambassadepersoneel (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the cost of annual home-leave flights for diplomatic staff and families, including business-class tickets outside Europe. The minister confirmed about 3.5 million euro per year, said business class accounts for roughly 90% of leave costs, and estimated economy class would save 25-30%, but noted the arrangement is a secondary employment condition agreed with unions.
Any adjustment of this would therefore require agreement with the trade unions.
Een eventuele bijstelling hiervan vereist daarom overeenstemming met de vakbonden.

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over weinig energiebesparing in de Nederlandse energie-intensieve industrie (ingezonden 12 ju

An MP asked the minister why energy-intensive industry saved too little energy despite receiving energy tax discounts, and whether this affects government policy and the tax differentiation. The minister said firms had not clearly broken agreements, acknowledged efficiency lagged expectations, noted a new 2009 agreement and that the 2010 plans are still to be assessed, and declined to change policy or conclude a causal link to tax rates, leaving tax differentiation to a future cabinet.
Should it appear that certain firms do not keep their agreements, they will be removed from the covenant and lose their exemption for energy use above 10 million kWh.
Mocht blijken dat bepaalde bedrijven hun afspraken niet nakomen, dan zullen zij uit het convenant worden gezet en hun vrijstelling voor het energieverbruik boven 10 miljoen kWh verliezen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het EFSA advies over het welzijn van snelgroeiende vleeskuikens (ingezonden 2 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister about EFSA advice on welfare problems (lameness, ascites, sudden death) in fast-growing broiler chickens, including prevention practices, feed restriction, perches and harmonised data. The minister answered that the problems are largely linked to fast growth, that Dutch data are lacking, that practices like toe and spur removal are limited, and that she will await the Commission report before acting on EU data harmonisation.
I am awaiting the Commission's report before determining my position on this matter.
Ik wacht het rapport van de Commissie af om mijn inzet op dit gebied te bepalen
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven-van der Meer (D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over toegezegde gelden voor Haïti (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether less than 2 percent of the nearly 8 billion euro pledged for Haiti's reconstruction has been paid out, whether only a few countries have fulfilled their pledges, and whether Dutch commitments have been met. The minister replies that about 506 million dollars has been disbursed, that five donors have paid into the World Bank fund, that Dutch relief funds have been transferred to aid organisations and reconstruction funds are earmarked for 2011 onward, and that EU-level figures are not available to him.
I do not have the data of the individual member states.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens van de individuele lidstaten.
qn: Antwoord op vragen de vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de export van giftige benzine

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about the export of polluting, carcinogenic petrol from the Netherlands to poorer countries, including whether companies could be stopped and which countries received it. The State Secretary answered that the ILT has told companies the exports breach the Environmental Management Act, demanded measures by 1 September with a penalty order possible, named West African destination countries where traceable, and described diplomatic and UNEP efforts on fuel standards.
Companies were asked by the ILT to state by 1 September at the latest which measures they have taken and/or will take to fulfil their duty of care.
Bedrijven zijn door de ILT verzocht om uiterlijk per 1 september aan te geven welke maatregelen zij hebben genomen en/of zullen nemen om invulling te geven aan hun zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de oorzaken van de actuele watersnood in delen van Nederland, België en Duitsland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether climate change caused the July 2021 flooding in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, and questioned flood-return-period assumptions and emissions policy. The minister confirmed a link between the extreme rainfall and climate change, said flood-probability estimates are periodically updated, and pointed to a planned policy table and the damage quick scan.
The current expectation is that extreme weather conditions and high Meuse water levels will occur more and more often.
De huidige verwachting is dat extreme weersomstandigheden en hoge waterstanden van de Maas steeds vaker zullen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de oorzaken van de wateroverlast in Limburg

MP Thijssen asked the government whether climate change causes more extreme weather and flooding like in Limburg, and whether the Green Deal and climate targets must be met to prevent such disasters. The government answered that climate change raises the chance of extreme rainfall, stressed reducing emissions and climate adaptation, announced a policy table on the Limburg flooding, and said it supports the EU 55% target and will respond to the Fit for 55 proposals in September.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management announced to the House on 27 July the intention to set up a policy table.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft op 27 juli jongstleden aan uw Kamer het voornemen gemeld om een beleidstafel in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over nieuw gifschandaal in binnenvaart

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about a new phosphine gas incident on three inland vessels, prior warnings, prevention measures, who is responsible, and whether incidents with biocides have occurred. The government acknowledged the incident as unacceptable, explained the cause as non-compliance with existing rules for rail transport of fumigated cargo, and announced international proposals, a chain analysis due end-2021, and a criminal investigation led by police.
A criminal investigation is currently underway on the instruction of the Public Prosecutor, led by the national police unit.
Er loopt in opdracht van de Officier van Justitie nu een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waarin de landelijke eenheid van de politie de regie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked whether the GGD Kennemerland director had improperly removed Tata Steel from a lung cancer report, whether a commercial polluter should have seen the report early, and whether the health service's independence is safeguarded. The state secretary answered that an independent investigation (Heskes) found the report was produced with integrity, that early access for Tata Steel was plausible for media preparation, and that no broader investigation is planned, while committing to balancing health against economic interests under existing law.
The research report, carried out by investigator and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'GGD-directeur laat naam Tata Steel uit longkankerrapport schrappen'

SP MP Leijten asked ministers about reports that a GGD director had removed Tata Steel's name from a lung cancer report in Beverwijk, and whether trust in authorities has been damaged. The government answered that an independent investigation found the director acted with integrity, cited the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a ministerial working group on Tata Steel, and pointed to Tata Steel's own Roadmap Plus, while committing to a nulmeting and possible further measures.
The investigation report, carried out by researcher and former Hague ombudsman Peter Heskes, concluded that the director and his staff acted with complete integrity.

In het onderzoeksrapport, dat door onderzoeker en voormalig ombudsman van Den Haag Peter Heskes is uitgevoerd, is geconcludeerd dat er volstrekt integer is gehandeld door de directeur en zijn medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Von Martels over het bericht 'Haal vervuilde bouwgrond langs N206 weg'

CDA MPs asked about reports that contaminated AEC bottom ash with batteries was used in construction along the N206 near Katwijk, raising health and water risks. The state secretary answered that partner tests and an additional study show the ash meets the Soil Quality Decree, that no health risks are expected, that RIVM research is unnecessary, and that the municipality and province are the first contacts for residents.
I am currently considering options for tightening the Soil Quality Decree in this area.
Ik bekijk op dit moment de opties voor aanscherping van het Besluit bodemkwaliteit op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over ontbossing voor biodiesel uit palm en soja

Two MPs asked the government whether biodiesel from palm and soy oil, which they say has driven deforestation, should be stopped and whether the policy undermines forest protection. The government answered that such crops are excluded in the Netherlands, that domestic biodiesel comes only from waste and residues, and that EU sustainability criteria and phase-out rules for high-ILUC crops apply.
In line with the motion by MP Schonis, the cabinet is working to also have soybean oil classified as a feedstock with a high ILUC risk.
Conform de motie van het lid Schonis 6 spant het kabinet zich daarbij in om ook sojaolie aan te laten merken als een grondstof met een hoog-ILUC risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het inzamelen van blikjes met statiegeld in de supermarkt

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary whether it is inefficient and confusing that beverage cans with deposit are not collected in supermarkets, whether supermarkets should be legally obliged to collect them, and whether the 31 December 2022 start date for can deposit can be guaranteed. The secretary answers that producers are responsible for a 90% collection target, that outside-supermarket collection points are a reasonable option, that the supermarket collection obligation need not be written into law because the target is enforceable, and that the deadline is fixed in regulation with enforcement available if violated.
I expect the packaging industry to keep me informed of progress and I remain in discussion with them about implementation, while continuing to point to their obligations.
Ik verwacht van het verpakkende bedrijfsleven dat zij mij op de hoogte houden over de voortgang en blijf met hen in gesprek over de implementatie, waarbij ik ook blijf wijzen op hun verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over 'RIVM houdt rapport over gezondheid rond Tata Steel nog lang onder de pet.'

MP Leijten asked why the RIVM health report on Tata Steel is not yet public, whether the timing was deliberate, whether it can be shared before the 9 September debate, and which ministries received drafts. The government replied that the provincial and IJmond municipal clients, together with RIVM, decided to publish mid-September, that the minister is not the client and cannot commit to sharing it earlier, and that only the GGD Kennemerland received a draft.
I am not the client. The province of Noord-Holland and the IJmond municipalities are the clients.
Ik ben geen opdrachtgever. De provincie Noord-Holland en de IJmondgemeenten zijn opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel ‘Spoelt granuliet toch weer weg? Wethouder wil verklaring van Rijkswaterstaat’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that granulite is washing up at the Moleneindse Waard lake near Dreumel, questioning the depth of the layer, its circular-economy status, and long-term environmental effects. The government replies that granulite meets the soil quality standards, that Arcadis is reviewing whether the actual situation matches its report, and that the Chamber will be informed once that assessment is complete.
Once the assessment is ready (expected in the autumn), I will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra de beoordeling gereed is (naar verwachting in de herfst), zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Bontrup weigerde steekproeven granuliet op eigen terrein’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister why Bontrup refused soil sampling of granulite, why the parliament was not informed, and why parts of the Arcadis review were altered or deleted. The state secretary answers that the government requested sampling but Bontrup declined, that Arcadis judged sampling no longer necessary, that the textual changes were Arcadis's own decision after a fact-check, and that no new investigation or stoppage of granulite use is planned.
Arcadis, as an independent and expert bureau, concluded that given the results of the research carried out, the need for sampling at Bontrup's production site was no longer present.

Arcadis heeft als onafhankelijk en deskundig bureau geconcludeerd dat – gezien de resultaten van het uitgevoerde onderzoek – de noodzaak voor bemonstering op de productielocatie van Bontrup niet meer aanwezig was.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het artikel in The Guardian van 10 juni jl. over “Take-away food and drink litter dominates ocean plastic, study shows” en berichtgeving van Schone Rivieren op 7 juni jl. “

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that ten plastic product types dominate ocean litter, how the Single-Use Plastics Directive addresses them, and calls for reduction targets, reuse requirements, and bans on disposable cups and packaging. The State Secretary answers that existing and planned measures (plastic bag charges, bottle and can deposit schemes, extended producer responsibility, and later reduction measures) are being implemented, that the directive will be evaluated in 2026, and that further targets and bans will be considered in later letters to parliament.
It is therefore still too early at this moment to judge whether the directive is having sufficient effect.
Het is daarom op dit moment nog te vroeg om te oordelen of de richtlijn voldoende effect sorteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en De Groot over het bericht ‘Chemelot mag 14.000 kilo microplastics per jaar in de Maas lozen’

MPs De Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether the water permit allowing Chemelot to discharge about 14,040 kg of microplastics per year into the Maas is compatible with environmental and health protection, the precautionary principle, the Water Framework Directive and BBT, and how oversight works. The minister answers that the permit is the competence of the Limburg water board, that a research obligation with a report due January 2024 was included, and mostly refers back to earlier answers, committing to no new concrete action.
The competent authority is responsible for supervising the permits issued.
Het bevoegd gezag is verantwoordelijk voor het houden van toezicht op de afgegeven vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat het openbaar vervoer in Utrecht volgend jaar op peil blijft

Questions from SP MP Alkaya ask whether public transport in Utrecht will be maintained next year, and whether transition plans and possible schedule cuts reflect the COVID crisis. The state secretary answers that the availability payment continues, that 2022 plans will keep a service level comparable to 2021, that the plans are being updated, and that the Chamber will be informed in autumn.
The transition plans will be updated this summer, and the Chamber will be informed about this in the autumn.
Actualisatie van de transitieplannen vindt deze zomer plaats en de Kamer zal hier dit najaar over geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de overstromingen in Limburg

PvdA MP Ploumen asked about the Limburg flood situation, adequacy of regional capacity, federal support, compensation under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen, psychosocial care and future flood prevention. The minister described coordination and support by national bodies, announced application of the Wts compensation law with a ministerial regulation to follow, and said a policy table would evaluate the Limburg situation.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Kan zonnebrand koraal aantasten?’

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that sunscreen chemicals harm coral, the Bonaire ban on oxybenzone-containing products, and whether Dutch waters are polluted by UV filters. The minister acknowledged the Bonaire motion and the need for regulation, said UV-filter levels in Dutch surface water were below reporting limits, noted monitoring around the BES islands is planned, and pointed to ongoing EU REACH assessments of octinoxate and oxybenzone without committing to new national measures.
A monitoring programme around the BES islands is currently being prepared and will likely start in 2022.
Op dit moment wordt een monitoringsprogramma rond de BES-eilanden voorbereid dat waarschijnlijk in 2022 van start kan gaan.
Antwoord op van het lid de Hoop over gerecyclede grond

An MP asked the government about reports that recycled thermally cleaned soil contaminated dike, road and water projects, including Perkpolder and Westdijk, and whether this endangers public health and farmers. The minister answered that health risks were judged limited, monitoring and remediation are underway, quality controls were tightened, and compensation claims would be assessed case by case.
On the results of this monitoring I will inform your House in due course once the final report is available.
Over de resultaten van deze monitoring zal ik uw Kamer op termijn nader informeren zodra de definitieve rapportage beschikbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Automobilist betaalt te veel bij laadpaal'

Peter de Groot (VVD) asked whether fast chargers deliver less energy than paid for due to conversion losses, whether this erodes trust in electric charging, and what solutions exist. The State Secretary answered that consumers pay only for energy actually delivered, losses under 1% are moderate, price transparency is already regulated and largely in order, and EV charging is cheaper than fuel, pointing to existing Klimaatakkoord and Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur measures.
The losses of on average less than 1% between charging point and car cited by the operators can be considered small and are difficult to quantify given the multitude of systems in use.

De door de exploitanten genoemde verliezen van gemiddeld genomen minder dan 1% tussen laadpunt en auto zijn gering te noemen en laten zich moeilijk kwantificeren door de veelheid aan systemen die in gebruik zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over PFAS in voedselverpakkingen

An MP asked the government about PFAS in food packaging, the health risks to children and foetuses, and whether such substances should be permitted, and asked for research on use and effects. The minister answered that a ban on PFAS in food packaging is being prepared to take effect on 1 January 2022, that the NVWA will enforce it, and that further research is deemed unnecessary.
An amendment to the Packaging and Consumer Articles Regulation will end the permission to use PFAS in and on paper and other natural materials for food contact, and to trade or import such products.

Een aanpassing van de Warenwetregeling verpakkingen en gebruiksartikelen zal een eind maken aan de toestemming om PFAS in en op papier en andere natuurlijke materialen voor voedselcontact te gebruiken en dergelijke producten te verhandelen of in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'PUR-spuiter Eco Isolatie mag van Reclame Code Commissie niet claimen dat gespoten PUR-schuim milieuvriendelijk is'

An MP asks the government about advertising claims that sprayed PUR foam insulation is environmentally friendly, the health risks identified by the Health Council, and whether it will phase out or regulate the product. The minister answers that the advertising body's ruling suffices, that no new phase-out or campaign is planned, that a practice evaluation and a meeting with the sector will follow, and that the current subsidy and building rules remain in place.
I do not intend to start phasing out sprayed PUR foam.
Ik ben niet voornemens om te starten met het uitfaseren van gespoten PUR-schuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel van Zembla 'Ministerie lakt opnieuw stukken weg in Wob-documenten over granuliet'

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister about Zembla reporting that the ministry redacted documents on granulite under the Wob, including the weakening of a previously released passage and a claim that a document was wrongly marked out of scope. The state secretary answers that the redactions were justified under Wob exemptions, admits one part of a document was missed due to a work-allocation error, and promises a review of the objection and an independent investigation.

The part of the document declared 'out of scope' and not covered by the Rijkswaterstaat Wob decision will be assessed on substance as soon as possible and, expected at the decision on the objection, made as public as possible.

Het gedeelte van het document dat «buiten scope» is verklaard en niet in het Wob-besluit van Rijkswaterstaat betrokken is, zal zo snel mogelijk inhoudelijk worden beoordeeld en bij de eerst mogelijke gelegenheid, dat is naar verwachting de beslissing op bezwaar tegen het besluit van de bestuurskern van IenW, zoveel mogelijk openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'De wereld heeft veel meer grondstoffen nodig om de klimaatdoelen te halen'

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the Netherlands is raising raw material supply for the energy transition in a clean, recycling-focused way, and how it responds to an IEA report on critical minerals. The government answered that it works through EU critical materials and circular economy plans, a circular manufacturing transition agenda, and innovation programmes, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragenvan  de leden Van den Anker en Von Martels over het bericht ‘Rivierenbuurt kampt met rattenplaag: Springen zelfs uit de wc'

MPs Van den Anker and Von Martels asked the State Secretary about a newspaper report on a rat plague in Amsterdam's Rivierenbuurt, covering national action on pest control, oversight of municipalities' public health duties, food safety risks, the handling of pest-control information, a complaints point, rat monitoring, and emergency protocols. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are the first point of contact, that the national government sets the framework and works on IPM and knowledge-sharing, that interbestuurlijk toezicht is applied only restrictively, and that several follow-up steps (working group, monitoring, a motion-based reallocation of information tasks, a revised handbook) are planned.

However, the national government takes a restrained approach to interbestuurlijk toezicht, but such supervision (according to the intervention ladder) is possible if the tasks are narrowly defined and it is reasonably unmistakable that the decentralised authority is failing in its duties.

Vanuit het Rijk wordt er echter terughoudend omgegaan met interbestuurlijk toezicht, maar er is interbestuurlijk toezicht (volgens de interventieladder) mogelijk indien de taken nauw omschreven zijn en het bij taakverwaarlozing redelijk onmiskenbaar is dat de decentrale overheid in gebreke blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat inwoners rond Tata Steel IJmuiden vaker ziek zijn

An MP asked the government about reports that residents near Tata Steel IJmuiden are sicker, covering medical support, a possible compensation fund, short-term protection, RIVM follow-up research, emission monitoring, cumulative exposure and the province's enforcement. The state secretary answered that the province of North Holland is the competent authority for permits and enforcement, that the Rijk advises but cannot order a production stop, and that the ILT is monitoring the province's follow-up on the Randstedelijke Rekenkamer recommendations.
The provincial executive of North Holland is the competent authority here. The national government does not have the power to impose a production stop on Tata Steel.
Gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland zijn hier bevoegd gezag. Het Rijk heeft niet de bevoegdheid om een productiestop aan Tata Steel op te leggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'NS wil kaartjesloket op stations Alkmaar, Hilversum en Hoorn sluiten. De provincie Noord-Holland probeert daar een stokje voor te steken'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government would intervene to prevent NS from closing ticket counters at Alkmaar, Hilversum and Hoorn stations, and what this means for public transport accessibility. The government answers that closures are NS's operational responsibility, that alternative services remain available, and that NS will be held to account under the concession only if accessibility or satisfaction is harmed.
The consideration regarding the ticket service counters is an operational responsibility of NS.
De afweging met betrekking tot de ticketservicebalies is een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het afsluiten van gasboorputten op LUT-5 in Losser

An MP asked the minister about permanently sealing gas wells in Losser, whether cement plugs fit the well integrity system, the cracked ROW-2 injection well in Rossum, and whether independent reviews of other wells are needed. The minister said SodM supervises sealing and post-closure monitoring, the ROW-2 investigation is still ongoing with a result expected by end of June 2021, and no independent investigation of other wells is currently deemed necessary.
No, there are currently no indications that this is necessary.
Nee, er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het rapport ‘Energy Transition Monitor - Critical Metals' van ABN AMRO

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked about an ABN AMRO report warning that electrifying road transport alone will not solve critical-metal dependence, and about the government's plans on scarcity, circularity, hydrogen and biofuels. The state secretary answered that the government supports a mix of electric, hydrogen and biofuel paths, relies on recycling, the European Critical Raw Materials Action Plan and ERMA, and will use an efficiency-based allocation approach rather than a formal allocation framework.
I am aware that there may be scarcity of sustainable fuels. That is why efforts are directed at using the various fuels as efficiently as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat er schaarste kan zijn aan duurzame brandstoffen. Daarom wordt er ingezet op een zo efficiënt mogelijke inzet van de verschillende brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikht over het manifest van artsen en wetenschappers dat pleit voor schonere lucht

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about a manifesto by doctors and scientists calling for cleaner air, including a child hospitalised three times in Rotterdam and whether the Clean Air Agreement is ambitious enough. The state secretary replies that the agreement targets 50% health gain by 2030, that 91 participants have joined, that an implementation agenda and monitoring are in place, and that she will consider faster action if feasible.
Should it turn out to be possible to achieve more health gains by improving air pollution faster or more, I will certainly commit to that.
Mocht blijken dat het mogelijk is om meer gezondheidswinst te realiseren, door de luchtvervuiling sneller of meer te verbeteren, dan zal ik mij daar zeker voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Neef over de Zembla-uitzending dat spoorwerkers al ruim 10 jaar worden blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about a Zembla broadcast reporting that rail workers have been exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over ten years, asking about legal duties, inspection history, ProRail reports and station safety. The ministers answered in detail on the legal framework and past inspections, acknowledging ProRail's reports and ongoing investigations, but largely pointed to employer responsibility and did not commit to new measures beyond referring to existing inspection work.
ProRail had not shared these studies with the Inspectorate SZW until recently, but did so following the Zembla broadcast.
ProRail had deze onderzoeken tot voor kort niet met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld, maar heeft dit naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Zembla wel gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Zembla: spoorwerkers worden al ruim 10 jaar blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof'

D66 MPs asked the government about reports that railway workers were exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over a decade, whether ProRail ignored advice to change ballast stone, whether ProRail should have reported its studies to the Labour Inspectorate, and related questions on enforcement and ProRail's status. The ministers said ProRail has commissioned studies, is following TNO advice to exclude three stone types temporarily, shared the studies with the inspectorate, and that the inspectorate enforces violations without size distinction.
The Ministry of IenW has received ProRail's research reports.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft de onderzoeksrapporten van ProRail ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht 'Faillissement van BOPEC kost overheid Bonaire € 300.000'

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about the bankruptcy of oil company BOPEC on Bonaire, its skeleton crew for safety risks, union involvement, responsibility for safety, the role of government policy, and the Bonaire public body's bridging credit. The government answered that the curator and regulators (ILT, RWS) selected the skeleton crew after a union-agreed list became unworkable, that safety responsibility lies with the licence holder and then the curator, and that the Bonaire body granted a 250,000 USD contribution consistent with the Wet FinBES.
The OLB has in the meantime committed a contribution of 250,000 dollars.
Het OLB heeft inmiddels een bijdrage van 250.000 dollar toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘De asbestberg groeit, en niemand durft zich te branden aan een oplossing’ in de Gelderlander

An MP asked the state secretary about the growing asbestos waste problem, including whether asbestos can stay in the ground permanently and what can be done about reuse. The state secretary answered that landfilling remains the only option for most asbestos waste under strict safety rules, that reuse is for the market to develop with existing support, and that pilots will map options.
Landfilling asbestos-containing waste is not preferred for future sustainability, but (except for asbestos-containing steel scrap) is currently the only option.
Het storten van asbesthoudend afval heeft met het oog op toekomstbestendigheid niet de voorkeur, maar is (met uitzondering van asbesthoudend staalschroot) momenteel de enige optie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Bij recycling van asfalt komt veel te veel kankerverwekkend benzeen vrij’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that benzene emissions from asphalt plants exceed limits, the health risks, enforcement by competent authorities, and calls for relaxed norms. The government answered that 10 of 29 active plants exceed the emission limit, that exposure at ground level has not exceeded the EU limit, that competent authorities are enforcing, and that it will inform parliament after an industry study.

It is important that the competent authority has emission data so that it becomes clear whether there is an exceedance situation and on the basis of which follow-up steps can be determined by the competent authority.

Het is van belang dat bevoegd gezag over emissiegegevens beschikt zodat duidelijk wordt of sprake is van een overschrijdingssituatie en op basis waarvan vervolgstappen kunnen worden bepaald door bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Runderen langs Waal zitten vol gif, verkoop van ‘oervlees’ stilgelegd’

MPs Kröger and Dik-Faber asked about reports of high dioxin levels in cattle grazing along the Waal and whether the sale of their meat, and swimming in contaminated rivers, poses health risks. The State Secretary answered that dioxin in riverbed sediment was not routinely tested, that NVWA-initiated research into grazing cattle is pending (expected mid-2021), that swimming exposure is below health limits, and that no general sales stop or new disposal measures are currently warranted.

After the NVWA-initiated research is completed, the departments involved will assess whether further research into dioxins in the riverbed near the floodplains is needed at locations that are frequently flooded.

Na afronding van door de NVWA geïnitieerd onderzoek wordt met betrokken departementen bezien of nader onderzoek van dioxinen in de waterbodem in de nabijheid van de uiterwaarden nodig is op locaties waar frequent overstroming plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat vleesrunderen op vergiftigde grond hebben gegraasd

The MP asked the ministers about reports that beef cattle grazed on contaminated floodplain land, whether a national overview of such areas exists, whether the meat reached consumers or foreign buyers, whether dioxin and other toxins are tested, whether grazing should be banned, and about granulite dumping and sanitation. The government answered that responsibility is shared across departments, that an NVWA investigation is ongoing with results expected in 2021, that affected meat was sold only to individual online consumers, and that granulite poses no proven harm and does not warrant sanitation.
Following this, NVWA-BuRO carried out a desk study, after which it was decided to start an investigation into dioxin and other contaminants.
Naar aanleiding hiervan heeft NVWA-BuRO een deskstudie uitgevoerd, waarna is besloten een onderzoek te starten naar dioxine en andere contaminanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de rechterlijke uitspraak over het verlenen van een Wnb vergunning ten behoeve van het wijzigen van een melkveehouderij

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling that found the emission factors in the Rav insufficiently substantiated for a Wnb permit to convert a dairy farm, and about the consequences for nitrogen calculations. The Minister answers that the ruling concerned the certainty required for Natura 2000 assessment rather than the Rav factors in general, that an appeal is being prepared, that no immediate changes to the nitrogen approach are foreseen, and that a CBS/CDM study on practical use of techniques will be available in late 2021.
I therefore do not recognise the claim that the emission factors in the Rav are insufficiently scientifically substantiated.
Ik herken mij derhalve niet in de stelling dat de emissiefactoren in de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) niet voldoende wetenschappelijk onderbouwd zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van Eijs over recht op reparatie van apparatuur

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Eijs asked about the right to repair, reparation costs and access to spare parts for volunteer repairers, and about structural funding for Repair Café. The State Secretary said EU Ecodesign rules are a step forward, that a broader study on professionalising the repair sector is pending, and that structural subsidy to a single foundation is not possible under state aid rules.
I will inform your House about the results of the study.
Over de resultaten van het onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Esch over lozingen in de Maas

An MP asked the minister about permitted microplastic discharges by Chemelot into the Maas, precautionary principle, and whether economic interests outweigh environmental ones; the minister replied that the competent authority (Waterschap Limburg) assesses discharges under BBT, that the precautionary principle applies, that economic interests are not a weighing factor, and that no change to the division of powers is needed. Several answers refer to answers given to other MPs rather than repeating substance.
No, I do not recognise the picture sketched.
Nee, ik herken het geschetste beeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Tata Steel overtreedt opnieuw milieuregels: loost zonder vergunning kwik in het riool'

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about press reports that Tata Steel discharged mercury into the sewer without a permit, and about an Omgevingsdienst letter demanding incomplete emissions data. The minister replied that the data are still under assessment by the competent authority, that the discharge is not expected to cause additional harm, and that the company must supply missing data within set deadlines.
I will inform you as soon as a judgement has been made on this.
Ik zal u informeren zodra hierover geoordeeld is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoekstra: NS zal ‘op termijn’ minder moeten gaan rijden’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked why the Finance Minister says NS (Dutch Railways) must run fewer trains when more sustainable public transport is needed, and why Air France-KLM is not held to the same standard, including whether a motion on capacity growth is being implemented. The minister answers that NS faces financial pressure from COVID-19, that a public-transport availability fee has been extended to end-2021, that talks on further support and a post-2021 scheme are ongoing, and that Air France-KLM is not bound by concession obligations, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new steps beyond continued consultation.
In doing so we look at what NS can do itself, and at what the shareholder and concession authority can do.
Daarbij kijken we naar wat NS zelf kan doen, en naar wat de aandeelhouder en concessieverlener kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het nieuws dat varkens overleden bij een val in een gierput

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure whether the cause of a floor collapse causing pigs to fall into a slurry pit was investigated, how stable floors are inspected, and how safety and animal welfare are monitored. The Minister answered that the cause is unknown, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement under the Building Decree with policy discretion, that Inspectie SZW runs a sector campaign, and that welfare and fire safety will be considered as a condition in a subsidy scheme.
The municipality indicated that the cause of the floor collapse was not investigated and is therefore unknown.
Vanuit de gemeente is aangegeven dat de oorzaak van de vloerverzakking niet onderzocht is en daarom onbekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Bospaden worden verhard met plastic bouwafval'

Green Left MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about reports that Staatsbosbeheer surfaces forest paths with plastic-contaminated construction waste, and whether the 1% contamination limit is respected and what harms result. The State Secretary answered that certified suppliers are used, that the limit applies by weight and volume, that the impact on nature is not yet fully known (RIVM research expected early 2022), and that the government will study tighter regulation of recycled granulate and engage stakeholders.
However, I will investigate whether there are possibilities to better regulate the use of recycled granulate.
Ik ga echter onderzoeken of er mogelijkheden zijn om de toepassing van recyclinggranulaat beter te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over verharding Bospaden

MPs asked whether forest paths paved with recycled construction granulate containing plastic breach the 1% contamination limit and whether Staatsbosbeheer chose it for cost reasons. The government confirmed the cost motive, said it will study regulating recycled granulate more strictly by year-end, and will talk with managers and producers about alternatives and lower contamination for path use.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over het gebruik van bouwpuin vervuild met plastic voor wandelpaden

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether building rubble contaminated with plastic, used for forest and nature paths by State Forestry Service (Staatsbosbeheer), can be guaranteed free of harmful substances, and whether its use should be banned. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist on the quantities used, that the EU and Dutch standards cap plastic contamination at 1% but are not otherwise specific, and that the government will examine whether plastic contamination can be better regulated by year-end while supporting Staatsbosbeheer's initiative to explore alternatives.
At national level there is no insight into this. There is no reporting obligation for the application of recycled granulate as a building material.
Op landelijk niveau bestaat hierin geen inzicht. Op het toepassen van recyclinggranulaat als bouwstof rust geen meldingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Subsidieregeling Elektrische Personenauto’s Particulieren’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about the oversubscribed 2021 EV subsidy for private buyers, budget allocation, lottery use, and whether the subsidy should be cut to stimulate more purchases. The state secretary answered that the 2021 budget was EUR 14.4 million, that the rules were changed in 2020 to stop carrying over applications, and that she sees no reason to lower the per-car subsidy before an interim evaluation.
I will inform your House about the results of the planned interim evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de geplande tussentijdse evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'MEPs pressure France and Britain to save Eurostar'

MP Kröger asked the state secretary about the current situation of Eurostar, the state of talks with Belgium, France and Britain, and whether the Netherlands would contribute financially or ask NS to compensate. The state secretary replied that the situation is unchanged, talks on possible state support are ongoing, Eurostar received a NOW subsidy of €20,152, further support is primarily for shareholders, and NS and Eurostar are discussing their cooperation terms.

I am closely following my colleagues' discussions on this matter, particularly where developments could affect the continuity of the direct link between Amsterdam and London, and will act appropriately if necessary.

Ik volg de gesprekken van mijn ambtgenoten over deze kwestie nauwgezet, in het bijzonder waar het ontwikkelingen betreft die zouden kunnen raken aan de continuïteit van de directe verbinding tussen Amsterdam en Londen en zal indien nodig passend acteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de berichten 'Tegenstanders rondweg tevreden, gemeente mag geen damwanden slaan zolang vergunning niet op orde is' en 'Amersfoort wil plafondbedrag Westelijke Rondweg verhogen'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about court-found flaws in the permit basis for the Amersfoort Westelijke Rondweg project, its nitrogen effects, ProRail's financial risk and the municipality's raised budget cap. The State Secretary answered that pile-driving is halted until the permit is in order, that the municipality bears the project's risks and decisions, and that ProRail's role and CEF subsidy timing are as described.
The municipality of Amersfoort may not drive sheet piles for the sunken road and tunnel box on the Westelijke Ontsluiting route as long as the permit for the intervention is not in order.
De gemeente Amersfoort mag geen damwanden slaan voor de verdiepte weg en de tunnelbak op het tracé van de Westelijke Ontsluiting zolang de vergunning voor de ingreep niet in orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Nederland tegen Brussel: schiet op met ban op verbrandingsmotor'

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the state secretary whether a Volkskrant article about a Dutch call for a ban on new combustion-engine car sales from 2030 matches the non-paper, whether a national sales ban is intended, and whether the market should be left to act. The state secretary answered that the government wants 100% zero-emission new sales by 2030, prefers tightening EU CO2 standards over a national ban, supports supplementary national incentives, and disagrees that the market alone should be left to deliver.
The cabinet aims for 100% zero-emission new sales in 2030. It prefers to achieve this through EU legislation.
Het kabinet streeft naar 100% zero-emissie nieuwverkoop in 2030. Het heeft de voorkeur om dit via EU-wetgeving te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de antwoorden op de vragen naar aanleiding van bericht 'Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden'

Two VVD MPs asked why government policy favours zero-emission cars over HVO100 and bioLNG, which they say are costly for businesses, and what the government will do to increase demand. The State Secretary answers that HVO and bioLNG are transition fuels for heavy transport under the renewable energy obligation, that accijns refunds are possible under conditions, and that supply-side measures are being pursued.
I regularly speak with market parties and am always open to talking with parties that switch to renewable fuels.
Ik spreek regelmatig partijen uit de markt en sta altijd open om het gesprek aan te gaan met partijen die overstappen op hernieuwbare brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “Milieuramp in de Berkel: Friesland Campina vervuilde, het Waterschap betaalde”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the 2018 contamination of the Berkel by Friesland Campina, which was partly paid for by Waterschap Rijn en IJssel, including the cost split, secrecy, liability, and environmental impact. The minister confirmed the facts, defended the waterschap's autonomous cost decision and the absence of liability findings, noted that the public prosecutor saw no grounds for prosecution, and reported that the ecosystem has recovered.
The water board has the autonomous authority to weigh the cost allocation itself.
Het waterschap heeft de autonome bevoegdheid om zelf een afweging te maken over de kostenverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Houtkachels, blijken na opnieuw rekenen, grootste bron van fijnstofuitstoot’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that wood-burning stoves are now the largest source of fine particulate emissions, and why condensable particulates were previously excluded, what measures and timelines apply to smoke-free neighbourhoods and enforcement, whether a stove ban during RIVM smoke alerts is warranted, and how manufacturer standards could be tightened. The State Secretary explained the new reporting method, outlined the Clean Air Agreement pilots, a pending enforcement study and an alert-based approach, and noted tighter EU Ecodesign emission standards from 2022.
Therefore, following the TNO study, about which I informed you in June 2020 with a letter to the House, I commissioned a follow-up study.
Daarom heb ik naar aanleiding van het onderzoek door TNO, waarover ik u in juni 2020 heb geïnformeerd met een kamerbrief 5 , opdracht gegeven voor een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat goederentreinen vanwege het winterweer stiltaan in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why freight trains stalled in the Rotterdam port during winter weather, why heating on switches was defective, why the WIRAS switch was not adopted, what compensation freight operators would receive, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is working on maintenance and an evaluation, that the WIRAS switch was judged unsuitable in 2014 and will be re-examined, that damage details are confidential business information, and that a compensation scheme will be shared in spring.
I have no information on the extent of any financial damage suffered by rail freight operators as a result of the restrictions concerned. This concerns commercially sensitive information.
Over de omvang van eventuele vermogensschade die spoorgoederenvervoerders hebben geleden als gevolg van de bedoelde beperkingen heb ik geen informatie. Het betreft hier bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aartsen en Van der Linde over de problemen die vuurwerk-ondernemers ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van voorfinanciering bij banken

MPs asked whether fireworks entrepreneurs face refusals of pre-financing by banks, whether state guarantees could help, and when compensation for storage and transport costs will be paid. The government answered that existing guarantee schemes are available, that only one concrete case of bank refusal is known, and that the fireworks subsidy (TSVC-19) will open for applications from 31 March to 3 May 2021 with payments after the window closes.
I am aware of one concrete case where this was directly related to (im)possibilities for pre-financing in relation to the design of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben bekend met één concrete casus waarbij dit direct samenhing met (on)mogelijkheden voor voorfinanciering in relatie tot de vormgeving van de compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het artikel 'Nederland liet dieselsjoemelaars onterecht gaan'

An MP asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Netherlands wrongly let diesel 'cheat' vehicles pass, and about the implications of a 2020 EU Court of Justice ruling on defeat devices. The government answered that the ruling tightens the rules, that the RDW is reviewing approvals and past investigations against it, that reopening cases will be communicated if needed, and that it will push for stricter EU emission standards.
If reopening of the investigations proves necessary, I will inform your House of this.
Indien heropening van de onderzoeken noodzakelijk is, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het afwijzen van gesprekken over de SUP-richtlijn op grond van artikel 5, derde lid van het WHO-kaderverdrag

An MP asked why the Infrastructure ministry refused talks with tobacco-related organisations on implementing the Single-Use Plastics directive for cigarette filters, citing Article 5(3) of the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control, and whether they would still engage. The state secretary defended restrained contact with the tobacco industry to protect tobacco control policy, said talks on implementation questions would follow with transparency after the ministerial regulation is drafted, and noted consultation would be open to industry.
This ministerial regulation is drawn up in close consultation with VWS, in order to ensure conformity with the tobacco control policy.
Deze ministeriële regeling wordt in nauwe afstemming met VWS opgesteld, teneinde de conformiteit met het tabaksontmoedigingsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber inzake worteldoeken in Nederlandse rivieren,

An MP asked the minister about geotextile root cloth in Dutch rivers, its fragmentation into microplastics, unregistered non-functional material, and alternatives. The minister acknowledged the concern, said geotextile is needed for durable bank protection, that biobased alternatives are unsuitable, that loose material is removed under existing contracts, and declined a dedicated cleanup project or new register.
Rijkswaterstaat's contractors inspect the banks in accordance with the agreements made.
Opdrachtnemers van Rijkswaterstaat inspecteren de oevers, conform de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Duitsland: elk uur een trein Amsterdam – Berlijn (en één uur sneller)

An MP asked the state secretary about German plans to shorten the Amsterdam-Berlin train journey, the Dutch acceleration plans, possible route options and an Amsterdam-Hamburg connection. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the German plans, described a joint acceleration step by 2024 and open long-term route options, and said the Hamburg connection will be considered in a market study due before summer 2021.
I will inform you of the first results of the market study before the summer of 2021.
Ik informeer u over de eerste resultaten van de marktverkenning voor de zomer van 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het EMK-terrein (Exploitatie Maatschappij Krimpen) in Krimpen aan den IJssel toekomen
