An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the condition of the sheet-pile walls around the contaminated EMK site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, the PFAS in groundwater, the scope of contamination, citizen and business participation, the sanitation costs and the cost-benefit of partial cleanup. The State Secretary answered that the walls are in reasonable to good condition and sufficient to isolate contamination, while acknowledging that they do not meet current stricter safety standards and that reinforcement will follow, and gave cost figures and a commitment to consult the working group before any revised plan.

Although the sheet piles may deviate in parts from the original design and do not meet current, stricter safety standards, the measurement results show that the sheet piles together with groundwater extraction sufficiently isolate the contamination

Hoewel de damwanden mogelijk op onderdelen afwijken van het oorspronkelijke ontwerp en niet aan de huidige, strengere, veiligheidsnormen voor damwanden voldoen, blijkt uit de meetresultaten dat de damwanden in combinatie met de grondwateronttrekking, de verontreiniging voldoende isoleren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het op omvallen staan van de snelle trein Eurostar van Rotterdam naar Londen

A D66 MP asked the state secretary about reports that Eurostar, facing collapsing passenger numbers during COVID-19, may be unable to meet payment obligations, and about support and cross-border cooperation to keep the Amsterdam-London rail link. The government confirmed the precarious financial situation, said talks with Belgium, France and the UK on support were ongoing and promised to inform parliament of effects on Dutch rail services, while noting the NOW wage subsidy and the TVL support scheme are available.
I will of course follow these talks and will inform your House should this have consequences for rail transport to and from the Netherlands.
Ik zal deze gesprekken uiteraard volgen, en uw Kamer informeren mocht dit gevolgen hebben voor het treinvervoer van en naar Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis de hinder op HSL ondanks de windschermen en de introductie van de ICNG

An MP asked why wind warnings still disrupted high-speed rail despite the new windscreens, whether the PPS structure makes Infraspeed accountable, and when the ICNG trains and higher speeds would arrive. The state secretary acknowledged the wind-warning norms are being recalibrated with ProRail and the ILT, that ProRail is responsible for the system, and that NS will raise speeds only after full ICNG deployment and trial operation, likely from 2023.
ProRail has been working with the ILT since October on adjusting the norms.
ProRail werkt sinds oktober in overleg met de ILT aan de aanpassing van de normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over vervuilende dieselauto’s

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the government studied the air quality, public health and social cost effects of loosening the emission test rules for polluting diesel cars, including the new APK test and transition period. The state secretary answered that a structural reduction of 121 thousand kg of fine particles is expected, about 7% less than the earlier estimate, with health benefits of 20.6 million euro, that the health effects will be assessed later by RIVM, and that the new test complies with EU rules and the Schone Lucht Akkoord.
The effect of the new APK test on public health will be included in the biennial calculation of the health indicator, which RIVM will carry out under the Clean Air Agreement.

Het effect van de nieuwe APK-test voor de volksgezondheid wordt meegenomen in de tweejaarlijkse doorrekening van de gezondheidsindicator, die in het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord door het RIVM zal worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over onderzoeken naar het veilig houden van asbestdakensanering

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about the safety of the asbestos roof removal acceleration, the Arcadis exposure report, the TNO-based certification exemption and the Productenbesluit asbest. The government answered that certification for asbestos roofs is now proposed in the Arboregeling consultation, that the report was delivered on 1 February 2021 after delay, and that a revised Productenbesluit asbest is in preparation for 2022.

It is now known that the amendment to the Arboregeling put to internet consultation by the Minister of SZW proposes to include asbestos roofs among the asbestos applications subject to the certification requirement.

Inmiddels is bekend dat in de wijziging van de Arboregeling zoals door de Minister van SZW in internetconsultatie is gebracht, is voorgesteld de asbestdaken op te nemen bij de asbesttoepassingen waarvoor de certificatieplicht zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Doorgeschoten overheidsbeleid leidt tot vervuiling in plastic afval'

An MP from the VVD asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that residual-waste reduction policy and rising rejection rates of plastic packaging waste (PMD) in Twente are causing contamination, higher municipal costs passed on to residents, and inconsistent municipal practices. The state secretary replies that residual-waste reduction has not been shown to harm sorting quality, that the rejections reflect stricter quality standards and a local problem being addressed with municipalities, that municipalities are responsible for their own waste policy, and that the government supports them through knowledge-sharing and tools.
Municipalities are responsible for their own waste policy and how they organise it, taking into account specific circumstances.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen afvalbeleid en hoe zij dit inrichten, rekening houdend met de specifieke omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over microplastics in placenta’s van ongeboren baby’s

An MP asked several ministers about reports that microplastics were found in unborn babies' placentas, and about the health risks, product bans and parental information. The government acknowledges the concern, says there is insufficient evidence on health effects, and points to ZonMw research, a knowledge agenda, and planned EU-level and environmental measures without committing to bans or consumer warnings.
There is currently insufficient knowledge to conclude whether microplastic particles pose a danger to the development of unborn babies.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende kennis om de conclusie te kunnen trekken of microplasticdeeltjes een gevaar vormen voor de ontwikkeling van ongeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het fatale ongeluk bij een niet actief beveiligde overgang in Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about a fatal accident at an unsecured rail crossing in Wijster and why unsecured crossings were not being closed faster, including whether ProRail had said blocking them with concrete blocks was legally impossible. The state secretary said the crossing is private, ProRail is negotiating closure, blocking is legally problematic, and an enforcement power (aanwijzingsbevoegdheid) is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snoeren, Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht 'Woonbelasting weer omhoog: uitschieters tot +27%!'

VVD MPs asked the government about reported large rises in local property and waste charges for 2021, the effect of abolishing the macro norm and introducing the local-cost benchmark, and possible caps and measures against rising fees. The minister answered that the national picture awaits the COELO atlas, that the benchmark is too recent to evaluate (evaluation planned for 2025), that local councils decide on charges, and that the rise in the import-waste tax is unlikely to raise local waste fees.
It is still too early to determine the effects of introducing the local-cost benchmark, because the benchmark was only introduced in 2020.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen constateren wat de gevolgen van de invoering van de benchmark lokale lasten zijn, omdat de benchmark pas in 2020 is ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de petitie 'Terug naar schoner gft-afval voor nog schonere compost'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a petition for cleaner green-waste (gft) to produce higher-quality compost, including whether a maximum 2% contamination standard and recycling targets for municipalities should be introduced. The State Secretary says existing tools, the Aanvalsplan and handreikingen, are supported by the chain, that contamination limits are left to contracts, and that recycling targets for municipalities are not the right instrument, while promising to examine measures against misleading packaging logos.
I will investigate which measures, including legal ones, are possible.
Ik zal onderzoeken welke maatregelen, inclusief wettelijke, mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel ‘Pollutionwatch: fine particles affect lungs of those near airports’

An MP asked the government about a study on ultrafine particles near Schiphol, why its results were not shared with parliament, and what follow-up is planned. The minister answered that the interim report was sent to parliament in June 2019, that the study covers short-term exposure only, and that final reports are expected at end 2021.

By letter of 27 June 2019, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, on behalf of the Minister, sent parliament an interim report of the RIVM study on ultrafine particles at Schiphol.

337 ) heeft de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat mede namens de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat een tussenrapportage van het «RIVM-onderzoek ultrafijn stof Schiphol» aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Elektrische auto duurder in onderhoud dan brandstofauto's'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that electric cars cost more to maintain than combustion cars, tyre-wear particulate emissions, and cybersecurity of charging infrastructure. The government disputed the maintenance claim, cited research that EVs emit less fine particulate overall, and said cybersecurity rules for charging points are being developed, with a 2021 advisory report expected.
WESP B.V. is a private limited company and has not given us insight into this data.
2 is een Besloten Vennootschap (B.V.) en heeft ons geen inzicht gegeven in deze data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht ‘Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden’

MPs Ziengs and Lodders (VVD) asked about HVO100 renewable diesel, its CO2 savings, price and taxation, and what policy would promote it. The government answered that HVO is a renewable diesel substitute covered by existing excise rules, that supply is driven by the rising renewable energy obligation, and that a future CO2-chain system (BKE) is planned.
HVO is a high-quality renewable diesel substitute.
HVO is een hoogwaardige hernieuwbare dieselvervanger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en De Groot over het bericht dat er wensballonnen in omloop zijn die niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen.

Two D66 MPs asked ministers whether sales of wish balloons that fail safety rules are rising during the fireworks ban, and what enforcement and public information exist. The government replied that it has no data on rising sales, that the NVWA enforces product safety rules and that municipalities may ban releases, while placing responsibility for safe use on consumers.
I am not aware whether sales of these products are increasing, because the NVWA has not carried out any research into this.
Het is mij niet bekend of er een toename is in de verkoop van deze producten omdat daar door de NVWA geen onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effecten van een slechte luchtkwaliteit voor herstellende COVID-19 patiënten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether people recovering from COVID-19 are harmed by wood-burning smoke, whether ventilation advice conflicts with it, and why the Clean Air Agreement lacks binding measures such as a ban during smoke alerts and enforcement of complaints. The State Secretary answers that the health risks are plausible but not scientifically proven, points to voluntary measures (stookwijzer, pilot projects, complaint routing to municipalities) and declines a stoking ban for now.
As I explained in response to the Van Esch motion, I will ask municipalities to seriously follow up on reports received via the stookwijzer.
Zoals ik in reactie op de motie van Van Esch 4 , heb toegelicht, zal ik gemeenten vragen om serieus opvolging te geven aan meldingen die binnenkomen via de stookwijzer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Export verarmd Urenco-uranium naar Rusland in strijd Europese sancties'

An MP from GroenLinks asks whether exporting depleted uranium from Urenco Gronau via the Netherlands to Russia violates EU sanctions, whether an export permit is required, and how the Netherlands ensures no goods are exported in breach of sanctions. The minister replies that the export is permitted for civil end use under the NPT and NSG guidelines, that the Netherlands cannot take over the German permitting authority's role, and that customs and the ministry supervise sanctions compliance.
There are no indications that Russia does not comply with its international obligations under the NPT.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat Rusland zich niet houdt aan zijn internationale verplichtingen onder het NPV.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de Regeling aanwijzing consumenten- en theatervuurwerk (Ract), het tijdelijke vuurwerkverbod en de handhaving van het vuurwerkverbod door gemeentelijke handhavers (domein 1) bo

MP Van Dam asks whether a 2020 regulation reclassifying F3 and other fireworks as illegal, and the temporary New Year's fireworks ban, leave municipal enforcement officers (boa's domain 1) without power to act on illegal fireworks, leaving only the police. The government replies that boa's can enforce the lighting of fireworks but not possession or transport, may stop people until police arrive, and that the non-intervention in dangerous settings is a deliberate choice governed by local agreements.
That is not a legal gap, but a deliberate and responsible choice.
Dat is geen juridisch gat, maar een bewuste en verantwoorde keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Van Aalst en Wilders over nieuwe rekenregels voor geluid die de woningbouw lam dreigen te leggen

PVV MPs asked whether new noise calculation rules for cumulative noise would stall housing construction, and whether windmill noise would be counted less strictly. The government answered that it is aware of the housing shortage, that the updated aviation noise rule is still under joint impact analysis with local partners and an interim transitional provision keeps the current formula, and that separate noise norms for windmills remain and their noise is included in cumulative assessment without being weakened.
Together with the administrative partners it has been agreed to jointly carry out a further impact analysis of the possible consequences of updating the aviation noise calculation rule.
Met de bestuurlijke partners is afgesproken gezamenlijk een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren naar de mogelijke consequenties van de actualisering van de rekenregel voor luchtvaartgeluid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ziengs over het bericht “Treinterreur door asielzoekers op de Vechtdallijn”

MPs Becker and Ziengs asked the state secretaries about reports of asylum seekers committing violence against rail staff on the Vechtdal line and whether they were from safe countries, which azc they came from, what steps were taken, and whether a travel ban would be imposed. The government condemned the behaviour, said it does not register residence status of offenders, described existing measures such as Top-X lists, travel bans and a pilot regional travel ban in Eastern Netherlands, and gave few individual details.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over het bericht ‘Asbest gevonden in make-up van Douglas en Hema’

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked whether the minister would act after asbestos was found in make-up sold by Douglas and Hema, and whether a broad investigation into talc use in cosmetics would be launched. The minister called asbestos in cosmetics unacceptable, said the NVWA is checking whether further investigation or enforcement is needed, but declined a broad new investigation, citing a 2018 study that found asbestos in only 2 of nearly 300 samples.
The NVWA supervises compliance with the legislation and enforces where necessary.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving en treedt zo nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Betalen ziekenhuizen de rekening van het afval van de kerncentrale Borssele?'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked about reports that hospitals may bear costs of radioactive waste from Borssele and whether COVRA discriminates against small waste producers. The state secretary answers that COVRA applies uniform tariffs for standard waste, that the ANVS withdrew its intended penalty after COVRA provided information, and that a regulatory framework for financing waste management still needs to be developed.
From my department, consultation on this elaboration will be started with, in the first instance, the Ministry of Finance and the ANVS.
Vanuit mijn departement wordt het overleg over deze uitwerking opgestart met in eerste instantie het Ministerie van Financiën en de ANVS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht 'Nieuwe studie: elektrische auto gaat langer mee dan gedacht'

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked the ministers how the TU Eindhoven study showing longer EV lifespans and lower battery CO2 emissions affects climate policy and the cost-effectiveness calculations of the Klimaatakkoord. The Staatssecretaris largely endorsed the study, defended the cost-effectiveness estimates with sensitivity analyses, said the models are kept up to date, and promised to improve consumer information on used EVs.
The ministry will continue to monitor these developments.
Het ministerie blijft deze ontwikkelingen monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Von Martels over de berichten Plasticafval: hoe een Nederlands dropzakje kon eindigen in een Turkse berm en Nederlands plastic illegaal gestort in Turkije

MPs Ziengs and Von Martels asked the State Secretary about reports that Dutch plastic waste, including Dutch exports to Turkey, ended up dumped illegally, and how export and oversight of plastic waste can be tightened. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said Dutch oversight of actual recycling in Turkey is impossible, and pointed to tightened OECD/Basel rules from 2021, planned broadening of producer responsibility, and ILT investigation of exports.
However, the Netherlands has no possibility to supervise the actual beneficial use in Turkey.
Nederland heeft echter geen mogelijkheden in Turkije toezicht te houden op de daadwerkelijke nuttige toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht het bericht 'Provincie vreest subsidie kwijt te raken'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Gelderland risks losing an EU subsidy for hydrogen buses due to ministry delays and whether the DKTI 3 scheme will open in time. The state secretary said the provinces withdrew earlier, the DKTI 3 scheme is planned to open in January 2021 with a budget of EUR 36.62 million, and Gelderland can apply on the same terms as other parties.
Opening of DKTI 3 is, after processing the responses to the internet consultation closed on 5 November, planned for January 2021.
Openstelling van de DKTI 3 is, na verwerking van de reacties op de internetconsultatie die op 5 november is gesloten, voorzien in januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de export van plasticafval en gesjoemel met recyclingdoelstellingen

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about plastic waste exports to Turkey, unverifiable downstream recycling, and possibly inflated recycling statistics, and whether the EU should ban plastic waste exports. The state secretary confirms export volumes rose to 34 kton in 2019, says Dutch oversight stops at the EU border and in Turkey, points to stricter EU measurement rules from 2021, and rejects the claims of deliberate misreporting while rejecting a full export ban as not feasible.
However, the Netherlands has no means to supervise in Turkey the actual useful application on site.
Nederland heeft echter geen mogelijkheden in Turkije toezicht te houden op de daadwerkelijke nuttige toepassing ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Provincie: geen reden om aan te nemen dat Friesenbrücke duurder en later klaar is'

MPs Amhaouch and Van der Graaf asked the minister whether the German Federal Audit Office report on the Friesenbrücke, which reportedly predicted higher costs and a delay to 2030, would affect the planned 2024 completion, and whether he would act. The minister answered that the report is confidential and unknown to him, that German partners confirm completion by end 2024 with no signals of cost overruns, and that he would inform parliament if developments warrant it.
No, the report is confidential and has not been shared with Dutch authorities.
Nee, het rapport is vertrouwelijk en niet gedeeld met Nederlandse overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Intercity tussen Amersfoort en Amsterdam wordt geschrapt’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure why the Intercity between Amersfoort and Amsterdam was being dropped in favour of the Sprinter, and questioned the reduced connectivity for Amersfoort, Almere, Zwolle and the Berlin route. The State Secretary defended the new OV SAAL timetable model as the only feasible option within PHS budget and scope, arguing it yields more passengers overall and that travel time gains outweigh losses, while committing to explore optimisations and discuss the long-term plan with the region.
I stand by the carefully considered decision, taken in close cooperation with carriers, ProRail and consumer organisations, for high-frequency train services on the SAAL corridor.
Ik sta voor het zorgvuldig genomen besluit zoals in nauwe samenwerking met vervoerders, ProRail en consumentenorganisaties voor het hoogfrequent rijden van treinen op de SAAL-corridor genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Tovenaars met rommel’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about reports that failed waste-processing firms caused large public costs and that criminals operate in the sector. The government confirmed cost estimates in general terms, declined to give criminal records of owners, and announced a planned Omgevingsbesluit change allowing authorities to require financial security before granting permits.

This question cannot be answered. The criminal records of the natural persons referred to in the question who are in any way linked to companies prosecuted for environmental offences cannot be retrieved with an automated search.

Deze vraag kan niet worden beantwoord. De antecedenten van de in de vraag bedoelde natuurlijke personen die op enigerlei wijze zijn gelieerd aan bedrijven die strafrechtelijk zijn vervolgd voor milieudelicten, zijn niet met een geautomatiseerde zoekslag op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gif terrein in Krimpen aan den IJssel toekomen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the EMK chemical waste site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, including why it was isolated rather than cleaned in the 1980s, the costs of groundwater management, the sheet-pile condition, and the stalled remediation. The state secretary answered that the IBC isolation approach was chosen for cost and feasibility reasons, that the site is now being reoriented because of additional contamination, PFAS and disposal problems, and that the partners are reviewing options including the stakeholder group.
For that reason, the administrative partners have jointly decided to reorient the implementation of the project.
Daarom hebben de bestuurlijke partners gezamenlijk besloten tot een heroriëntatie op de uitvoering van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat op een bedrijventerrein in Doetinchem zo’n 1300 containers brandblusschuim met het ZSS PFAS staan opgeslagen in lekkende containers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports of about 1,300 containers of PFAS-containing firefighting foam leaking at a Doetinchem industrial estate, and about enforcement, PFAS levels, rules on processing such foam, and similar cases. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is the competent authority and is enforcing against the company, that the rules are adequate, that the national PFAS-foam stream is poorly tracked, and that the VTH system and the municipality's own investigation will be reviewed.
The competent authority in this matter is the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Doetinchem.
Het bevoegde gezag in deze is het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Doetinchem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het exporteren van Nederlands schroot

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the export of Dutch metal scrap for recycling abroad under poor environmental conditions, and whether CO2 and non-financial impacts are considered. The state secretary answered all ten questions, explaining that most scrap is exported because domestic recycling capacity is limited, that CO2 abroad is outside Dutch targets, and that a landfill ban on asbestos-containing steel scrap and support for stricter EU waste shipment rules are planned.
I am committed to a revision of the EVOA that gives the possibility to attach the condition of environmentally sound treatment to the export of metal scrap.
Ik zet mij in voor een herziening van de EVOA die de mogelijkheid geeft om aan export van metaalschroot de voorwaarde van milieuverantwoorde verwerking te verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de toegezegde brief over stalbranden

Lodders (VVD) asks why no agreements on rodent control by farmers have been made, despite the coalition agreement and the fact that rodents may cause about 25% of barn fires, and asks for a letter before 1 April 2020. Minister Schouten answers that integrated pest management is the starting point, that certification and a farmer course for anticoagulant use will be tightened from 2023, that the government sees no direct proof rodents cause fires, and that a letter on barn fires will follow.
With the parliamentary letter on tackling barn fires, your House will be informed about additional measures to further limit the number of barn fires and animal casualties.
Met de Kamerbrief aanpak stalbranden wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over aanvullende maatregelen om het aantal stalbranden en dierlijke slachtoffers verder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de aanhoudende schade van neonicotinoïden in het milieu en voor dieren

An MP asked the minister about persistent neonicotinoid contamination of surface water from greenhouses, the enforcement of greenhouse growers, and risks to birds and insects under EU approval procedures. The minister confirmed exceedances at 9 of 54 Delfland sites, described emission routes and enforcement measures, and noted that EU approvals for thiamethoxam and clothianidine have lapsed while imidacloprid's is expected to lapse.
There are various actions to prevent or limit as far as possible discharges of plant protection products into surface water.
Er zijn verschillende acties om de lozingen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen naar het oppervlaktewater te voorkomen of zoveel mogelijk te beperken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘Subsidie op elektrische auto loopt als een trein’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the rapid exhaustion of the EV purchase subsidy, its expected effects on emissions and future applications, and how it will be evaluated and promoted. The government explained the fast uptake (manufacturer discounts, postponed sales), estimated CO2 and NOx benefits, said it plans to stop carrying unused budget forward, and committed to monitoring in early 2021 and results by mid-2021.
As I recently reported to your House, the cabinet intends to stop this carry-over provision in the scheme (for both new and used EVs) in the short term.
Zoals ik uw Kamer recent heb gemeld, is het kabinet voornemens deze doorschuifbepaling in de regeling (zowel voor nieuwe als gebruikte EV's) op korte termijn stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra  en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Subsidiepot stroomauto’s nu al op’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked whether the EV subsidy budget running out within eight days, the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the limited climate gain and the Court of Audit's criticism of car taxes justify the scheme. The state secretary answered that the costs per avoided tonne fall to about 450 euro by 2025, that the scheme stays within budget and the Klimaatakkoord commitments, and that the carry-over rule for unused budget will be stopped, but gave no definitive per-tonne benchmark.
All calculations that have been carried out have already been sent to you on 3 July 2019.
Alle berekeningen die zijn uitgevoerd, heeft u reeds ontvangen op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht op Spoorpro.nl getiteld ‘Trafikverket publiceert tender nachttrein Zweden-Brussel/Hamburg’

An MP asked the state secretary about a Swedish tender for a night train linking Sweden with Brussels/Hamburg and whether Dutch connections could be explored. The government said it has contacted Sweden, that the route is commercial and open access, and that international connections will be examined in an upcoming market study.
As promised, your House will receive a broad progress letter before the NO MIRT on developments in international passenger rail transport.
Zoals toegezegd ontvangt uw Kamer voor het NO MIRT een brede voortgangsbrief over de ontwikkelingen rondom internationaal spoorvervoer voor reizigers
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Onnodig veel gevaarlijke stoffen in rivieren: lozingsvergunningen flink verouderd’

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that hazardous substances such as benzene, lead and vinyl chloride still enter rivers under outdated discharge permits, asking about drinking water effects, how many permits are outdated, BBT compliance, monitoring, and Rijkswaterstaat's capacity and priorities. The minister answered that the three substances did not exceed EU water norms in 2017-2019, that about three quarters of roughly 800 permits need adjustment, that a multi-year structural approach with periodic review every 4 to 8 years will be implemented, and that the advisory report is attached.
In about 50% of the permits reviewed in the pilot, there were discharges of ZZS.
Bij circa 50% van de vergunningen die in de pilot zijn bezien, was er sprake van lozingen van ZZS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven CS verdubbelen’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that ProRail sought more investment to double Eindhoven Central Station, the planned Eindhoven-Düsseldorf rail link, regional growth ties, and cross-border coordination. The State Secretary answered that needed measures are being assessed within existing programmes, that the Eindhoven-Düsseldorf tender started in June 2020 with service expected by end 2025, and that cross-border talks with Belgian and German counterparts are ongoing.
As I informed your House during the General Consultation on Rail Scheduling (9 September), the tender for the Eindhoven-Düsseldorf connection started in June 2020.
Zoals ik uw Kamer tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Spoorordening (9 september jl.) heb medegedeeld, is in juni 2020 de aanbesteding voor de verbinding Eindhoven-Düsseldorf gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Forse daling Nederlandse autoverkopen houdt aan' en recente cijfers van de ACEA van 22 september jl.

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp fall in Dutch new car registrations, the ageing of the car fleet, the outlook for diesel cars and the role of fiscal and emissions policy. The state secretary answered every question on substance, noting the fleet is ageing, that diesel's share is falling, and that the government aims for 100% zero-emission new car sales by 2030, without any commitment to new oversight or structural changes.
Yes. These figures indicate that the August 2020 decline compared with August 2019 in Dutch new passenger car registrations is slightly stronger than the stated European average.
Ja. Deze cijfers geven aan dat de daling van augustus 2020 ten opzichte van augustus 2019 in Nederland van registraties van nieuwe personenauto's iets sterker is dan het genoemde Europese gemiddelde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

MP Kröger asked the state secretary why the government had not yet committed to investigating the link between air pollution and COVID-19 infection risk, and why the review covered only livestock farming rather than industry and traffic. The state secretary answered that RIVM has been asked to scope research options, that the government will decide on commissioning research and inform parliament in autumn, and that air-quality measures and monitoring under the Clean Air Agreement continue.
Once the research options have been mapped out, my colleagues at LNV and VWS and I will decide whether, and if so which, studies to commission from RIVM.
Nadat de onderzoeksmogelijkheden in kaart zijn gebracht zullen mijn collega's van LNV en VWS en ikzelf besluiten of en zo ja, welke onderzoeken we willen uitzetten bij het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Strengere controle coronaregels in het OV'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how a public transport campaign aiming for 80% of pre-corona ridership fits with government advice to work from home and avoid crowds, and about ventilation and mask measures. The State Secretary answered that the campaign was halted on 25 September, that the 80% target was about ridership rather than vehicle occupancy and is no longer realistic, and that ventilation problems would lead to vehicles not being deployed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Veldman over het bericht 'Grote ov-campagne moet reiziger weer in de trein en bus krijgen'

MPs Ziengs and Veldman asked whether the government supports a public transport campaign aiming to restore 80% of pre-corona ridership, given rising infection numbers and advice to work from home. The state secretary answered that the campaign was run by transport operators, was halted on 25 September, and that the government now asks people to limit travel as far as possible.
As indicated, the campaign has been halted and, with the 28 September call to limit travel movements, the 80% target is no longer realistic or desirable.
Zoals aangegeven is de campagne stilgelegd en met de oproep van 28 september om de reisbewegingen te beperken is de 80% niet meer reëel en wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ''We verzieken ons leefmilieu en daarmee onszelf', artsen starten landelijke campagne'

An MP asked the health and infrastructure ministers whether they accept that air pollution from intensive livestock farming worsens COVID-19 outcomes and whether they will act on the link. The government answered that the link is plausible but not established, that more research is being explored with RIVM, and that existing air-quality policy (Schone Lucht Akkoord, nitrogen and livestock measures) is the response.
As indicated in the answer to question 4, RIVM has been asked to explore the research possibilities regarding the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Zoals aangegeven in antwoord op vraag 4 is het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderij en COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over de financiële consequenties van het Besluit activiteiten leefomgeving en het Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving voor waterspeeltuinen

MPs Laçin and Van Gerven asked whether the Omgevingswet and its AMvB's (Bkl and Bal) would impose disproportionate financial burdens on volunteer-run water playgrounds, and whether the government would investigate and remedy any such effects. The minister confirmed the rules apply, placed monitoring and safety duties on the operator, said costs are not expected to be disproportionate, and declined to commission a study, saying it will monitor implementation and discuss with the sector if problems arise.
I of course monitor the implementation of the new rules and my ministry is in contact with organisations in the field about it.
Ik volg de uitvoering van de nieuwe regels uiteraard en mijn ministerie heeft daarover ook contact met organisaties in het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over ammoniumnitraat

A GroenLinks MP asked the Infrastructure and Water Management ministry about a ship carrying 7,009 tonnes of ammonium nitrate moored in Rotterdam's Merwehaven, including whether it met limits, why it called at Rotterdam, and why the Yara site is not listed as explosive on the risk map. The state secretary answered that the cargo was a non-explosive oxidising substance, that the ship and packaging met legal requirements, that sea transport is governed by the IMDG code, and that no changes to port planning policy were planned.
The ship in question and the packaging complied with the statutory requirements.
Het desbetreffende schip en de verpakking voldeed aan de wettelijke voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen in de plasticindustrie

MP Van Raan asked the government about investments in the plastics industry, including Shell and financial institutions, recyclate requirements, a tax on virgin plastic and OECD guidelines. The government answered that it expects firms to follow OECD and UN guidance, will raise the plastics pact and recyclate use at EU level, sees no national import levy as current, and will not yet decide on additional measures.

The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally, including banks, insurers and pension funds, to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen, waaronder banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen, dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's) naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Omtzigt over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘Autobelastingen als instrument’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the Court of Audit report on car taxes, questioning the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the climate gain, the clarity of policy goals and whether the 'hand aan de kraan' monitoring system prevents overstimulation. The government rejected the report's conclusions, arguing the costs are overstated, promising to send the first hand-aan-de-kraan analysis results to Parliament shortly.
The cabinet will send the outcomes to your House in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten op korte termijn uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Agnes Mulder over het artikel Weilanden vol glas van zonnepanelen na hevige brand: nieuw probleem voor milieudiensten

MPs Geurts and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether glass shards and debris from solar panels released in fires that settle on surrounding land are a known problem, what the health risks are, and whether a national protocol and insurance-sector discussion are planned. The minister answered that RIVM will run fire experiments, IFV will consider a protocol, the farmer bears responsibility for food safety, and the insurance issue is separate, promising further steps after the research.
In consultation with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, I will, on the basis of the RIVM research, examine whether follow-up steps are necessary.
Ik zal, in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, aan de hand van de onderzoeken van het RIVM bezien of er eventueel vervolgstappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht 'De Koegelwieck fan Doeksen alwer oan de kant fanwegen technyske problemen'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked about repeated technical failures of the fast ferry Koegelwieck on the Harlingen–Vlieland and Harlingen–Terschelling routes, its effects on islanders and tourists, contractual rules, and consultation with the municipality and advisory boards. The State Secretary explained the engine problems, that replacement vessels were being arranged, the passenger-rights rules, the concession's quality requirements, and that the concession holder consults stakeholders and that the minister will raise the issue in periodic meetings with the operator.
As concession grantor I monitor compliance and will act toward the concession holder where necessary.
Als concessieverlener monitor ik de naleving en treed ik richting de concessiehouder op als dat nodig mocht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het grotere aantal mensen met longkanker of borst- en buikvlieskanker in Beverwijk, Heemskerk en Haarlem

Dutch MP Laçin (SP) asked the state secretary about the higher incidence of lung cancer and mesothelioma in IJmond towns and Haarlem, and about the role of industry, Tata Steel, permits, monitoring and further research. The state secretary replied that the GGD study does not link causes to industry, that the provincial and municipal authorities are responsible for permits and enforcement, and that further research is planned by the province and RIVM, while declining to investigate the drafting of the report further.
Are you willing, in consultation with the GGDs and provinces, to make a substantial start toward obtaining this insight?
Bent u bereid om, met betrekking tot het verkrijgen van dit inzicht en in overleg met GGD’s en provincies, hiertoe een substantiële aanzet te geven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht: ‘EV’s zorgen in 2030 voor 1.400 extra zwaargewonden’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press claims that EVs will cause 1,400 extra seriously injured road victims by 2030, and whether registration and road safety policy account for this. The minister says the underlying report was not made available, that current crash data cannot support firm conclusions about EVs, that EVs are as safe as combustion cars and that no extra measures in the Road Safety Plan are needed.
The underlying report was requested but not made available by the researchers.
Het achterliggende rapport is opgevraagd, maar niet beschikbaar gesteld door de onderzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de opslag van ammoniumnitraat in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about ammonium nitrate storage in the Netherlands, its safety, inspection history and incidents after the Beirut explosion. The government answered in detail, stating that storage is regulated under Brzo 2015 and PGS7, inspections are conducted annually, and no ammonium nitrate incidents are known.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de buurtbussen die niet rijden

An MP asked why community buses (buurtbussen) remain suspended during COVID-19 while other public transport runs, what measures and timeline would restore them, and what alternatives affected passengers have. The state secretary replied that buurtbus operators stopped in March over infection risk to older drivers, that TNO is assessing ventilation and protective options with results expected in October, and that regional authorities have found alternatives in most provinces.
I have asked the decentralised authorities to look carefully and creatively at the places where no alternative is yet available.
Ik heb de decentrale overheden gevraagd goed en creatief te kijken naar de plekken waar nog geen alternatief beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de buurtbussen die niet rijden

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why neighbourhood buses remain suspended in sparsely populated areas during COVID-19, and whether protective measures, alternatives and urgent action are possible. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said operators and TNO are testing protective measures subject to RDW approval, and pointed to regional alternatives while leaving the responsibility for these services with decentralised authorities.
The decentralised governments are, among other things through concessions, responsible for deploying neighbourhood buses.
De decentrale overheden zijn, onder andere via concessies, verantwoordelijk voor de inzet van buurtbussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht in de NRC getiteld ‘Plan sneltrein staat al jaren stil’

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the Groningen-Bremen 'Wunderline' rail project had stalled, including the status of the Friesenbrücke bridge, obstacles, and next steps. The state secretary replied that the project is on schedule, the bridge repair is planned for end 2024, and the 2024 timetable launch remains achievable, without new commitments beyond existing planning.
The Wunderline project is on schedule.
Het project Wunderline ligt op schema.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het artikel “Eindelijk succes voor Almelose luchtwasser van Jan Waayer”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newspaper report on a biological air scrubber for pig stables that finally succeeded in obtaining RAV listing after years, and about the evaluation, timeline, pending applications and innovation procedures for such techniques. The state secretary answered that innovation is important, that the process took about 4.5 years and was lengthy for reasons withheld as competitive sensitive, that an acceleration taskforce will advise in autumn, and gave counts of pending applications and typical processing times.
Due to the applicant's competitive interests, these reasons cannot be discussed in substance.
Vanwege het concurrentiebelang van de aanvrager kan niet inhoudelijk op deze redenen worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad betreffende de gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif en de kabinetsreactie hierop

An MP asks the government to confirm that the Health Council advises intensifying existing pesticide sustainability plans, to explain the gap with past targets, and to adopt stricter EU approval criteria and spray-free zones. The minister responds that the Toekomstvisie 2030 implementation programme will intensify efforts with annual monitoring, that targets from Gezonde Groei remain in force, and that spray-free zones lack the required scientific basis.
This is provided for in the implementation programme accompanying the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030, which I will send to your House in September.
Hierin voorziet het uitvoeringsprogramma bij de «Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030», dat ik uw Kamer in september zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht 'De aanpak van milieucriminaliteit dreigt vast te lopen'

An MP from D66 asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers how environmental crime enforcement can be given more urgency, whether it is falling into the margins of criminal law, how sanctions relate to subsidies, and when an action plan will be sent. The government agrees more urgency is needed, promises a full action plan by year-end and further information later, but gives no firm numbers on case durations or subsidy recipients and says it does not record that data.
The full action plan on environmental crime will be sent to your House before the end of this year.
Het volledige actieplan Milieucriminaliteit zal voor het einde van dit jaar aan uw Kamer worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Onverkochte ‘kledingbergen’ door corona, maar ook roep om duurzame herstart’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of unsold clothing stockpiles caused by COVID-19, the scale of disposal, the status of research on destruction of unsold goods, and steps toward a circular textile sector. The State Secretary answered that sales fell sharply, that industry bodies deny a stockpile exists and report under 1% destruction, that research is ongoing with results expected before the budget debate, and that policy measures such as recycled-content requirements and extended producer responsibility are planned.
I aim to inform your House about this before the budget debate.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover voor de begrotingsbehandeling te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen in Brabant

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about hazardous-goods trains through Brabant, including tanker volumes exceeding agreed risk ceilings and why routing powers were not used. The State Secretary acknowledged ceiling exceedances, argued there is no unsafe situation since statutory safety norms are met, and pointed to the Robust Basisnet programme, the Betuweroute third track and existing quarterly public data.
Exceeding these risk ceilings does not in itself mean there is an unsafe situation.
Het overschrijden van deze risicoplafonds betekent alleen niet dat er sprake is van een onveilige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de mogelijke ontslaggolf in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a possible wave of layoffs and service cuts in public transport, including whether companies may reduce routes and frequencies, and whether operators should disclose their financial figures before receiving further support. The State Secretary answered that talks with operators and regional authorities are ongoing, that a availability fee covers part of 2020 costs, and that operator financial data is confidential, while stating that the crisis is no reason to change the functioning system.
However, this concerns company-confidential data that transport operators are not required to make public.
Het gaat hierbij echter om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens, die vervoerders niet openbaar hoeven te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Qbuzz gaat inkrimpen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Qbuzz shrinking due to the coronavirus crisis, including job cuts despite emergency support, the effect of the 'only necessary travel' campaign, whether commercial transport firms can unilaterally cut services, transparency of profits and cross-border cash flows, and whether this shows commercial public transport has failed. The State Secretary said concessions are managed by provinces and transport regions, the sector is being consulted in the NOVB, financial data is confidential, and the crisis is no reason to change a well-functioning system.
However, this concerns company-confidential data, which transport operators do not have to make public.
Het gaat hierbij echter om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens, die vervoerders niet openbaar hoeven te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over asbest in drinkwater

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about asbestos in drinking water: the share of asbestos-cement pipes, monitoring, a legal limit, health risks from ingestion and vapour, and whether asbestos victim numbers are underestimated. The minister answered that about 23% of the network is asbestos-cement, that monitoring is voluntary industry sampling with a second round due in 2021, that no legal limit is needed given very low concentrations, and that RIVM and the Health Council will be asked whether to update victim estimates.
RIVM will continue to follow future research.
Het RIVM zal het toekomstig onderzoek blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over 'Bocht in geul naar Ameland blijft om natuur'

Three VVD MPs asked why the Reegeul-Oost bend cut to shorten the Ameland ferry route was abandoned, what alternatives were weighed, and what is being done to reduce ferry delays. The minister answers that a Nature Conservation Act permit cannot be granted because the works would permanently damage the priority habitat 'permanently submerged sandbanks', that the Vloedgeul cut was lawful because it followed a natural channel course, and that other Open Plan Process measures are implemented and monitored, with a longer-term study starting this autumn.

This means that realising the Reegeul-Oost bend cut is not feasible under nature legislation, because the conservation status of this habitat type is at stake and a permit under the Nature Conservation Act therefore cannot be issued.

Dit betekent dat de realisatie van de bochtafsnijding Reegeul-Oost vanuit natuurwetgeving niet haalbaar is omdat de staat van instandhouding van dit habitattype in het geding komt en een vergunning in het kader van de Wet Natuurbescherming daarom niet kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht: ‘Corona jaagt ov-reizigers de deelauto in’

MPs Schonis and Dik-Faber asked the state secretary about reports that COVID-19 pushed public transport users into car sharing, and about how to encourage safe and electric car sharing, its effect on congestion and CO2, and subsidy eligibility for cooperatives. The state secretary answered that car sharing is promoted via the Green Deal Autodelen II and a sector hygiene protocol, that the shift is small and its traffic and CO2 effects limited, and that the electric car subsidy is restricted to individuals for administrative reasons.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the sector about this.
Ik ben bereid om met de sector het gesprek hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Verhoogde concentraties radioactieve stoffen gemeten boven Scandinavië’

An MP asked the state secretary whether elevated radioactive substances detected over Scandinavia, possibly from a reactor leak in West Russia, were a serious concern and when the source would be identified. The government answered that the source is uncertain, the levels pose no health risk and no measures were needed, that the source is not established as West Russia, and that existing international nuclear safety frameworks apply.
It has not been established that the origin of the measured radionuclides lies in West Russia.
Het is niet vastgesteld dat de oorsprong van de gemeten radionucliden in West-Rusland ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over beperkingen opgelegd aan studenten in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Van den Hul asked the Secretary of State for Infrastructure and Water Management about restrictions on students using public transport during the COVID-19 crisis, including whether students were being barred from peak hours, consultation with student unions, and alternatives for students. The government answered that no specific restrictions apply to students, that a general call to avoid peak hours applies to all travellers, and that agreements on school and university start and end times were made with education bodies and carriers, while promising to consider involving student unions in future agreements.
As indicated in the answer to question 3, no restrictions apply to students in public transport.
Zoals in antwoord op vraag 3 is aangegeven gelden geen beperkingen voor studenten in het OV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het meten van luchtkwaliteit nabij drukke wegen in de bebouwde kom

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Dutch air-quality monitoring near busy urban roads, which measures beyond 10 metres from the kerb, conflicts with the EEA interpretation of the EU Air Quality Directive, and what measures follow. The government answered that Dutch monitoring is lawful under the Wet milieubeheer and Rbl, that no limit exceedances occur at the cited locations so no measures are required, and that the Schone Lucht Akkoord pursues further health gains.
At the same time, I do not consider that this statement conflicts with the interpretation of the Air Quality Directive.
Daarbij ben ik niet van mening dat deze uitspraak strijdig is met de interpretatie van de Richtlijn luchtkwaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Winkels van Waddeneilanden willen dat de bootcapaciteit stijgt naar 60 procent: ‘Dit is een noodkreet’’ in de Leeuwarder Courant

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about ferry capacity limits to the Wadden islands, which hurt local businesses under COVID measures, and whether capacity should be raised. The state secretary said that since 1 July seats and designated standing places are available again, that ferry capacity is a matter of safe, responsible use and tourist spreading handled with regional authorities, and gave no commitment to new capacity measures.
I cannot assess whether there is a certain percentage at which ferry capacity is no longer a limiting factor for the economy of the Wadden islands.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of er een bepaald percentage is waarbij de capaciteit van de veerdiensten geen beperkende factor is voor de economie van Waddeneilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de Ecodesign-richtlijn en de reparatie-infrastructuur in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary whether EU Ecodesign rules oblige manufacturers to support repair of household appliances, and whether repair cafés, a national repair registry, and stronger repair-sector policy should be pursued. The State Secretary confirmed Ecodesign requirements on spare parts and repair information from March 2021, said a broader study on professionalising the repair sector will be commissioned, and committed to report back on a registry.
I will inform the House about the results of the study and my consideration regarding the registration platform.
Over de resultaten van het onderzoek en mijn afweging over het registratieplatform zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat plastic afval nauwelijks gerecycled wordt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether recycled plastic has few buyers and is piling up, and whether national mandatory recyclate content should be introduced. The State Secretary confirmed falling demand and prices, described roundtable and standard-setting efforts, but said a binding recyclate requirement should be set at EU level and would only press the Commission to act within a year.
I want to look together with all relevant parties at what can be done.
Ik wil samen met alle betrokken partijen kijken wat er gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Staatssecretaris in de maag met tonnen plastic afval'

An MP asks the state secretary about the collapse in demand for recycled plastic during the COVID-19 crisis, the recyclers' distress call, and possible EU minimum-content rules, export bans and a plastic tax. The secretary answers that demand must recover, outlines measures including pursuing an EU mandatory recycled-content target and an EU-level Basel amendment, and treats the plastic tax as largely a national or EU budget matter.
My aim is for the European Commission to come within a year with a proposal for a mandatory use of a percentage of recycled plastic in European regulation.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht dat de Europese Commissie binnen een jaar komt met een voorstel tot een verplichte toepassing van een percentage plastic recyclaat in Europese regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door van het lid Ronnes over het bericht ‘Coronavirus bedreigt ook bouw van nieuwe woningen’

MP Ronnes (CDA) asked the government about COVID-19 threats to housing construction, including whether an ambitious public-private plan could prevent job losses, whether the 75,000 homes per year target is achievable, NOW wage subsidy eligibility for construction firms, accelerating permits and maintenance, investment plans, NHG and tax measures, and a countercyclical role for housing corporations. The minister answered that a package of measures (doorbouwplan, expert teams, subsidy adjustments, and accelerated public investment) is being pursued, while disputing some premises and promising further measures around Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat "Tata Steel onveilig omgaat met gevaarlijke stoffen en inspecteurs probeert te omzeilen"

MP Van Esch (PvdD) asked whether Tata Steel's handling of hazardous substances is unsafe, whether inspectors are undermined by management, and whether top officials communicate directly with Tata Steel over inspectors' heads. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate's concerns were from 2018, that the company has since improved but intensive supervision continues, and that the inspectorate's coordination and interventions are internally agreed, rejecting the suggestion of improper management interference.
It is up to the Inspectorate SZW to determine how it fulfils its supervisory tasks.
Het is aan Inspectie SZW om te bepalen op welke wijze zij haar toezichtstaken invult.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het rapport 'The burning question' van Tearfund en overige berichtgeving over het verbranden van plastic afval in ontwikkelingslanden en de verantwoordelijkhei

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the government about the Tearfund report on plastic waste burning in developing countries, corporate responsibility of major beverage and food companies, export of plastic waste, and whether Dutch plastic waste is incinerated instead of recycled. The State Secretary answered that companies should map and address risks in line with OECD guidelines, outlined existing pacts, export rules and pilot projects, and said a study on banning incineration of recyclable waste is underway, promising to inform parliament later.
I am conducting an exploration into a ban on incinerating recyclable waste.
Ik voer een verkenning uit naar een verbod op het verbranden van recyclebaar afval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een handicap in het openbaar vervoer in het licht van de coronacrisis

MPs Schonis and Bergkamp asked how people with disabilities can keep access to public transport during the COVID-19 measures, including wheelchair space loss and assistance. The State Secretary answered that the OV protocol applies to all travellers, NS assistance is fully restored from 1 June, and the working group will report later, committing to a letter and involving disability organisations.
How this will be elaborated, I will let your House know in the letter I promised at the committee debate.
Hoe dit uitgewerkt wordt, zal ik aan uw Kamer laten weten in de brief die ik heb toegezegd bij het notaoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Westerveld en Renkema over het openbaar vervoer

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about public transport access during COVID-19, including the OV protocol, student timing, support for people with disabilities, and bicycle policy. The state secretary answered that the protocol protects all users, that Reisassistentie is fully available again from 1 June, and that a further letter on accessibility for people with disabilities will follow.
How accessibility will be further guaranteed for this group is a topic of discussion in the OV protocol working group.
Hoe toegankelijkheid verder wordt gewaarborgd voor deze groep is onderwerp van gesprek in de werkgroep OV-protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Esch over de berichtgeving over het niet tot uitvoering brengen van de pilot in de IJssel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers why the plastic-catching bubble barrier pilot in the IJssel was cancelled as too expensive, and whether environmental costs, polluters, or the Rijk itself would cover the shortfall. The minister confirmed the budget of 400,000 was insufficient, explained that extra funding was sought without success, and said the decision was carefully taken and that lessons from the pilot will be reported.
It was therefore decided not to start this pilot.
Er is daarom besloten deze pilot niet te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het Zweedse rapport ‘Nattågstrafik till Europa’ en 2 deel rapporten met betrekking tot Europese nachttreinen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a Swedish report on night trains to Europe, including whether Dutch subsidies for the Vienna night train extension, a possible Malmo-Amsterdam connection and a future HSL line were considered. The State Secretary answers all twelve questions, noting contact with Sweden, a planned subsidy for the Amsterdam-Zevenaar-border section, and willingness to consider concessions where needed, but largely defers next steps to the Swedish government.
Certainly. Contact has already been made to arrange a conversation with my Swedish colleague.
Zeker. Er is reeds contact gelegd voor een gesprek met mijn Zweedse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Ziengs over recente berichten in de media over gevaarlijke onbewaakte spoorovergangen

Two MPs (Van der Graaf and Ziengs) asked the state secretary about dangerous unguarded level crossings after an accident at Hooghalen, including why the crossing was not yet closed, progress on the NABO programme, budget adequacy, compensation and the reliance on gates. The state secretary answered that closure depends on land and access-road agreements with no timeline, that about 49 of 180 crossings are closed with 76 agreements made, that extra budget has been provided, and that she will report on progress each autumn.
I therefore cannot give a timeframe within which these crossings can definitively be closed.
Ik kan daarom geen termijn noemen waarop deze overwegen definitief gesloten kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de plannen van Leeuwarden en Groningen voor meer betaalbare woningen

An MP asked about investor purchases of homes in Groningen and Leeuwarden, the risk to affordability, and calls for a residence requirement and rent regulation. The minister confirmed rising investor purchases, announced an opkoopbescherming (purchase protection) for municipalities, a rent-increase cap and transparency measures, but rejected experiments with extending the points system to mid-rent housing.
I will introduce the purchase protection for a period of three years and then evaluate it.
Ik zal de opkoopbescherming invoeren voor een periode van drie jaar en vervolgens evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Eijs over het bericht 'Regio vraagt minister om hulp bij verkoop Vestia-woningen'

MPs Ronnes and Van Eijs asked about the stalled sale of Vestia housing in six municipalities and the transfer-tax treatment of corporation takeovers. The minister reported intention agreements signed in May 2020, explained conditions for the transfer-tax exemption for task transfers, and said the Rijk will examine remaining facilitating measures.

Whether the transaction price in the planned transactions in the custom-made municipalities is expected to be at least market value in rented condition cannot currently be assessed, because the planned transactions still need to be worked out.

Of bij de voorgenomen transacties in de maatwerkgemeenten de transactieprijs naar verwachting minimaal marktwaarde-in-verhuurde-staat is, kan op dit moment niet worden beoordeeld, omdat de voorgenomen transacties nog moeten worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over stijgende huurprijzen in het geliberaliseerde huursegment

MP Beckerman asked the minister about rising rents in the liberalised rental sector, whether a rent cap or a tenant right to the rent committee should be introduced, and about a planned 'emergency button' for middle-income rents. The minister acknowledged affordability pressure but said rent increases are easing, estimated about 82,200 liberalised-sector renters wish to buy, argued mortgage and rent affordability tests are comparable, and committed to a bill capping annual rent increases at inflation plus 2.5%, while rejecting broader regulation.
I aim to present the bill to your House as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar het wetsvoorstel zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Amhaouch inzake de voorspelling over toe- en afname van files en mogelijke verschuivingen naar individueel vervoer

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about forecasts of traffic congestion and a shift from public to individual transport after the COVID-19 lockdown, including foreign data, scenario modelling, working from home and parking. The Minister answered that forecasts are not comparable, that scenario modelling is ongoing with monthly-level updates and a promised report before summer, and that advice from the Denktank Coronacrisis and planning agencies is expected on 1 June.
I will inform your House before the summer about the main outcomes.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de belangrijkste uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Onderzoek: Met hyperloop binnen half uur van Amsterdam naar Brussel'

MP Schonis asked whether the government sees prospects for a hyperloop link between Amsterdam and Brussels and about the status of a hyperloop test track in Groningen. The minister answered that such a link is not realistic in the short or medium term, that private investment should lead, and that a new round of talks on a Groningen test track will be held in the coming months.

The aim is, after a new round of talks on the possibilities and scale of private investment in an ecosystem around a test track in Groningen, to review in the coming months whether this changes the situation.

Insteek is om na een nieuwe ronde van gesprekken over mogelijkheden en omvang van private investeringen in een ecosysteem rond een testtraject in Groningen in de komende maanden te bezien of dit die situatie verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er in Zaandam een biomassacentrale zonder vergunning in gebruik is genomen

An MP asked the ministers about a biomass plant in Zaandam that began operating without a permit, asking why this was allowed, who is liable, and whether such plants should be built near schools and homes. The government answered that the plant was permitted under nature and municipal rules, that the permitting authorities (province and municipality) are responsible, that the environmental permit requirement for smaller plants is being reviewed, and that it will work with the other ministry on tighter criteria.
As part of the Clean Air Agreement I am examining whether laws, regulations and permit requirements should be tightened.
Als onderdeel van het Schone Lucht Akkoord ben ik aan het kijken of wet- en regelgeving en vergunningseisen aangescherpt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over veilig schoolverkeer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister how school traffic can be made safe as schools reopen under the 1.5-metre rule, covering extra space for cyclists and pedestrians, public transport capacity, local government support and good practices. The minister replied that a protocol for urban mobility, communication campaigns and temporary measures such as school streets have been prepared with local authorities and CROW, with decisions left to local road managers.
A guide has been prepared for road managers to take measures suited to the local situation.
Voor wegbeheerders is een handreiking gemaakt om maatregelen te treffen passend bij de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de planning van het onderzoek budgetneutrale overstap WLTP

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked why the results of the study on budget-neutral WLTP transition would only be shared in July 2020, who would conduct it, and how independence is guaranteed, following a motion requesting an independent review by early summer. The state secretary answers that the timing was an estimate of the time needed, names Prof. C. Koopmans (SEO, VU) as independent second-opinion reviewer, and sets out the research questions, including macro and top-ten-car budget neutrality, with a request to complete it before 1 June 2020.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans will carry out an independent review, in the form of a second opinion, of the budget-neutral conversion of the bpm table to CO2 emissions under the WLTP test method.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans zal in de vorm van een second opinion een onafhankelijke toets uitvoeren op de budgettair neutrale omzetting van de bpm-tabel naar de CO 2 -uitstoot volgens de WLTP-testmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verbijstering van politici over de totstandkoming van Windpark Spui in Piershil/Nieuw-Beijerland

MPs asked about the impact of the Windpark Spui wind farm on local residents, including noise nuisance, compensation, health effects, minimum distance norms and foreign ownership of subsidised turbines. The minister replied that provincial authorities are competent, that noise norms are met, that no scientific basis exists for 'turbine syndrome', and that further research on low-frequency noise is awaited, without committing to new national measures.
Because the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority for wind farm Spui, I am not directly involved in this wind farm.
Omdat de provincie Zuid-Holland bevoegd gezag is voor windpark Spui, ben ik niet direct betrokken bij dit windpark.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Brenk vragen over het artikel ‘Openbaar Vervoer Nederland: richtlijnen nodig voor wie met ov mag reizen’.

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the state secretary about OVNL's proposals for passenger capacity and rules on who may travel by public transport during COVID-19. The government answered that it has agreed a public transport protocol with the sector, is seeking spreading of travel times, and will work out cost compensation and further arrangements in the coming weeks.
The cabinet has asked the public transport sector to run the full timetable in the Netherlands, while passenger numbers are limited.
Het kabinet heeft de OV-sector verzocht in Nederland de volledige dienstregeling te rijden, terwijl de reizigersaantallen beperkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Ban op vuurwerk vanaf 1 december, ook opslag dan verboden’

An MP asks whether the planned ban on storing and selling fireworks from 1 December is too sudden, harms firework businesses' costs and export options, and whether storage can be allowed longer. The state secretary answers that unclassified fireworks cannot be stored as consumer fireworks, that restocks can be sold or moved abroad until 1 December, and that temporary extended storage at limited sites is being explored with local authorities.

The possibility of temporarily allowing longer storage of banger fireworks and rockets in the Netherlands, at a limited number of locations and after registration of the inventory, is currently being explored.
Momenteel wordt de mogelijkheid verkend om tijdelijk de opslag van knalvuurwerk en vuurpijlen in Nederland langer toe te staan, op een beperkt aantal locaties en na registratie van de inventaris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over plannen voor extra huurverhogingen door Vestia

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about Vestia's plan for extra rent increases of 0.5% above inflation in 2021-2022 in Den Haag, Delft and Rotterdam, and about related financial pressures. The minister answered that such a rent rise fits within the rules if local parties agree, that Vestia's rents remain within legal maxima, that the verhuurderheffing and ATAD questions are under review with results expected by summer 2020, and that tenants can turn to the huurcommissie on disputes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de aanstaande evaluatie Wet doorstroming huurmarkt

An MP asks the minister about reports of rising insecurity among tenants caused by temporary rental contracts, the number of such contracts, their renewal, the absence of a registration duty, and protection against exploitative landlords. The minister answers with CBS monitor figures, notes that temporary contracts are not renewable as a chain, pledges an evaluation of the law before 1 July 2021, and commits to developing a Goed Verhuurderschap approach.
I do not have figures on these cases and cannot say whether, or to what extent, this occurs.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over deze gevallen en ik kan niet zeggen of, en zo ja in welke mate, dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ministerie hield zorgen over Omgevingswet achter’

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of Interior held back an internal quick scan warning that the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) could not be implemented smoothly by January 2021, and whether the scan would be published. The minister declined to share the quick scan, summarised its conclusions and recommendations, and said the implementation date would be postponed.
I am not willing to share the Quick scan with your House.
Ik ben niet bereid de Quick scan met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het feit dat de (maximale) huurtoeslag daalt wanneer een alleenstaande een kind krijgt

The MP asks whether the maximum housing allowance (huurtoeslag) for single parents is lower than for single persons without children, whether this is desirable, and what options exist to reduce the difference.
