The minister confirms the difference (about EUR 47 per month at minimum income and rent at the threshold), explains it reflects the 1997 rationale for singles, points to the single-parent supplement in the child-related budget as compensation, and says a harmonisation option was studied in the IBO and that the IBO part 2 was sent to parliament.
It is correct that there is a difference in the maximum possible housing allowance for single persons and for multi-person households, which also include single-parent families.
Het klopt dat er een verschil is in de maximaal mogelijke huurtoeslag voor alleenstaanden en voor meerpersoonshuishoudens, waar ook eenoudergezinnen onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Te hoge belasting omdat gemeente VvE- reserve meerekent in WOZ bepaling’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether municipalities wrongly include a homeowners' association (VvE) reserve when valuing apartments for WOZ property tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that municipalities use uniform methods, that significant VvE reserves are taken into account in sales analysis, that the Waarderingskamer found no shortcomings, and that no further measures are considered necessary.
No problem is experienced with the way municipalities take into account the share in the VvE reserve when determining WOZ values.
Er wordt geen probleem ervaren met de wijze waarop gemeenten rekening houden met het aandeel in de VvE-reserve bij het vaststellen van WOZ-waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over over tienduizenden appartementeigenaren die een te hoge WOZ-beschikking ontvangen

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked whether municipalities wrongly include the owner's share of the VvE reserve in WOZ valuations of apartments, contrary to a court ruling, and how this interacts with box 1 and box 3 taxation. The State Secretary answered that the reserve share is excluded from the WOZ value, that municipalities only adjust for significant reserves when analysing comparable sales, and that no change to box 3 treatment is needed.
For all municipalities, the (possible) share in the Owners' Association (VvE) reserve does not count in the valuation of the apartment under the WOZ Act.

Voor alle gemeenten geldt dat het (eventuele) aandeel in de reserve van de Vereniging van Eigenaren (hierna: VvE-reserve) niet meetelt bij de waardebepaling van het betreffende appartement in het kader van de Wet WOZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat een slechte luchtkwaliteit de overlevingskans voor mensen met het COVID-19 virus verslechtert

An MP asked the government whether air pollution worsens survival odds for COVID-19 patients, citing SARS and Italian data, and whether a causal link was established and would be investigated in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the cited ecological studies do not prove causation, that the RIVM considers the hypotheses plausible but unproven, and that research is being explored through international networks and the veehouderij programme, with the Chamber to be informed.
Your House will be informed about which research will be carried out within the MCC framework.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over welk onderzoek er in MCC verband uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over opnieuw twee blazers bij ESD in Farmsum in Groningen

An SP MP asked the minister about repeated SiC-fibre emissions ('blazers') from chemical plant ESD-SIC in Farmsum, including what the province can do and health advice for residents. The state secretary answered that the province is the competent authority, has imposed a penalty order and a maintenance measure, that 2019 saw 52 blazers, and that monitoring and health advice are ongoing, without committing to closure.
The province therefore enforces and has imposed an order under penalty.
De provincie treedt daarom handhavend op en heeft een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het niet (tijdig) huur kunnen betalen door de coronacrisis

MPs Smeulders (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about tenants unable to pay rent during the COVID-19 crisis, including a ban on evictions and automatic extension of temporary leases. The minister answered that evictions are postponed by agreement and courts treat them as non-urgent, a legal ban is not possible or desirable under current law, and a bill allowing temporary leases to be extended on request has been submitted.
Under current legislation it is legally not possible to prohibit this at this moment.
Op basis van de huidige wetgeving is het juridisch niet mogelijk om dit op dit moment te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bollenvloerdossier

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether TNO's follow-up research on the bollenvloer (bulb floor) dossier would be finished before summer, and whether the inspection obligation for the highest consequence class could be postponed pending those results. The minister said the TNO research may narrow the obligation for lower classes, that the obligation for CC3 buildings is not postponed, and that she will share the proposal and results with the House later.
I will share the research proposal with you after I have received it and commissioned TNO to carry out the work.
Ik zal het onderzoeksvoorstel met u delen nadat ik het heb ontvangen en opdracht aan TNO heb verstrekt voor de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gevolgen van de Kraanwatercrisis voor de Volksgezondheid

An MP from the Labour party asked the minister about lead contamination in tap water in Amsterdam schools and housing, the health risks, compensation, replacement of lead pipes and the standards used. The minister answered that action plans are under way, that landlords must remedy defects and can face rent reductions, and that a report to parliament will follow.

In the cabinet response to the Health Council's advice, the Minister of I&W, on behalf of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport and myself, announced a large number of actions to tackle the lead problem.

In de kabinetsreactie 2 op het advies van de Gezondheidsraad heeft de Minister van I&W, mede namens de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport en mijzelf een groot aantal acties aangekondigd om de loodproblematiek aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Bijna helft oudere huizen steenkoud zonder gas’

An MP asked the government whether older homes will still need a gas connection because heating demand on cold winter days cannot be met by insulation and alternatives, and how network operators' warnings fit with the Climate Agreement. The minister rejects that claim as a firm conclusion, stating that heating options (heat pumps, heat networks, hybrid solutions) will be assessed per neighbourhood and that municipalities lead the transition with residents' interests protected.
I therefore do not endorse the stated claim.
Ik onderschrijf de genoemde stelling daarom niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Dik half jaar wachten voor plaatsen snellader geen uitzondering’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about reported waits of up to half a year to connect fast-charging points to the grid, and how businesses can be supported. The Staatssecretaris answers that the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure, regional partnerships, grid operator planning and guidance documents are being used to speed up rollout, without committing to a new concrete measure beyond existing plans.

Specifically for speeding up fast chargers at motorway service areas, I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to explore how many fast chargers could be added at service areas (up to 2030) and how the government can facilitate this.

Specifiek voor het versneld plaatsen van snelladers op verzorgingsplaatsen langs de snelweg heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd om te verkennen hoeveel snelladers er op de verzorgingsplaatsen bijgeplaatst zouden kunnen worden (tot 2030) en op welke wijze de overheid dit mogelijk kan faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Provincie Noord-Holland trapt op de rem’ in het Noordhollands Dagblad

An MP asked the minister whether the province of Noord-Holland is again slowing housing construction by restricting overprogramming, rural building and inner-city focus, and whether the minister will re-engage the province. The minister replied that agreements exist with the region, that 130% plan capacity is expected from all provinces, that Noord-Holland already has more than 130% capacity, and that further talks on volume and speed will take place, with specific location choices left to the provinces.
I will periodically talk with the provinces, including the province of Noord-Holland, about building plans and the realisation of housing construction.
Ik zal periodiek met de provincies, waaronder provincie Nood-Holland, spreken over bouwplannen en de realisatie van woningbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over 65 miljard euro aan schade door verzakkende huizen

An MP asked the ministers about reported 65 billion euro in damage from sinking houses, cost drivers, owner obligations, financing options, and whether the government is responsible for groundwater levels. The minister answered that costs depend on foundation area, that owners are responsible for their own foundations with some municipal and national support, that the 65 billion figure rests on uncertain assumptions, and that the government is monitoring the problem and informing municipalities.
Almost all factors involved in foundation problems are uncertain.
Bijna alle factoren die een rol spelen bij funderingsproblematiek zijn onzeker.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Moorlag over stikstofemissie ten gevolge van houtstook

An MP (Moorlag, PvdA) asked the ministers whether Dutch emission limits for NOx and dust from biomass power plants in the Activiteitenbesluit comply with EU rules and whether they should be tightened, citing a Mobilisation for the Environment letter. The state secretary replied that the limits meet EU requirements, that TNO is studying tightening them under the Schone Lucht Akkoord, and that provinces and municipalities will apply Best Available Techniques in permitting.
In the context of the Clean Air Agreement I am having TNO research the possibilities for tightening these emission limit values
In het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord laat ik TNO onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van aanscherping van deze emissiegrenswaarden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Ronnes over het aanwijzen van het gebied Zuid-Limburg tot NOVI-gebied

MPs Regterschot and Ronnes asked the minister how NOVI-areas are selected, what status they bring, and whether South Limburg should be designated as one, given its problems and opportunities. The minister answered that NOVI-areas are chosen on criteria of large integral transitions, that designation adds joint Rijk-region programming without yet deciding on South Limburg, and that governance in Parkstad is being reviewed.
South Limburg will become part of this agenda.
Zuid-Limburg zal een onderdeel worden van deze agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Ronnes over woningbouw in polder Rijnenburg bij Utrecht

MPs Ronnes (CDA) asked the minister about housing development in polder Rijnenburg near Utrecht, including energy use, infrastructure costs, developer positions, regional consensus and whether the government would use its binding instrument (aanwijzing). The minister replied that the region now has 167% plan capacity for 2019-2029, that Rijnenburg is not needed before 2030 and is under review in a long-term urbanisation strategy, and that the government will use its powers only if local impasses persist.
There are currently no calculations available. I aim for them to become available.
Er zijn op dit moment geen berekeningen beschikbaar. Ik streef ernaar dat deze wel beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het gebruik van de sloopregeling door Vestia in onder meer Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the minister whether the rent-free demolition reduction of the landlord levy used by Vestia in Rotterdam (Tweebosbuurt) allows rents of replacement homes to be liberalised quickly, and how many such applications exist. The minister answered that thousands of demolition applications are pending, that no reliable data exists on post-move rent increases, and that RVO can withdraw the reduction if rents rise excessively soon after completion.
No conclusive administration is available on moves and rent developments to answer this question.
Er is geen sluitende administratie beschikbaar van verhuizingen en huurontwikkeling om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over de Woondeal regio Arnhem-Nijmegen

An MP asked the minister about the Arnhem-Nijmegen housing deal, including whether a 50% affordable-housing target was appropriate and whether enough owner-occupied homes would be built. The minister answered that the target concerns the type of new homes needed, not the stock as a whole, and that the deal's aims reflect the commitment to sufficient owner-occupied housing.
As described above, the agreement concerns the type of homes the parties in the region want to add.
Zoals hierboven beschreven gaat de afspraak over het type woningen dat partijen in de regio willen bijbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de voorbereidingen op de implementatie van de Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het Bouwen

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about preparations for implementing the Wet Kwaliteitsborging voor het Bouwen, including pilot projects, the 10% pilot target, information to municipalities, the planned 1 January 2021 start date and the number of certified quality assessors. The minister answered that the 2021 date can no longer be met because of the delay to the Omgevingswet, that a final start date will be communicated before summer 2020, and that pilots are progressing with a shortfall against the 10% target.
My aim is to inform the House of Representatives of a definitive start date before summer 2020.
Mijn streven is om uw Kamer vóór de zomer van 2020 te informeren over een definitieve invoeringsdatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het doorgaan van huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis ondanks haar statement en andere nadelige gevolgen op huisvesting

An SP MP asked the minister why a voluntary landlord statement was chosen over emergency legislation to halt evictions during the COVID-19 crisis, and about evictions, antikraak occupants, campsite residents and double rent burdens. The minister answered that landlords have agreed to postpone evictions except for evident cases, that an emergency law to extend temporary leases is planned, and that municipalities and safety regions are asked to allow residents of campsites to stay.
I will keep a close eye on the situation; if undesirable situations emerge, I will examine the possibilities for targeted further measures.
Ik blijf de vinger aan de pols houden, indien er onwenselijke situaties naar voren komen, zal ik de mogelijkheden voor gerichte, nadere maatregelen onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers about housing and safety of migrant workers during the coronavirus crisis, including infection risks, information provision, and evictions. The government answered that employers share responsibility, that information is distributed in several languages, that municipalities can close recreational sites with exemptions, and that agreements were made to prevent evictions.
No data are known to me on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de e-laadinfrastructuur voor vrachtwagens

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether the lack of public charging infrastructure for electric trucks along motorways would delay the transition to electric freight, and whether subsidies or a sound business case could speed up roll-out. The state secretary acknowledged the gap, pointed to existing logistics charging provisions in the Klimaatakkoord and national agenda, and to the DKTI and MIA/VAMIL schemes, while stating that the business case and RED2 implications will be reviewed.
With the implementation of RED2, the impact on the business case for charging infrastructure will be reviewed again.
Bij de implementatie van de RED2 wordt opnieuw gekeken naar de impact op de business case van laadinfrastructuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over het bericht dat Shell een enorme plasticfabriek in de VS laat bouwen

Two SP MPs asked the government about Shell's plan to build a large plastics plant in the US, its environmental and CO2 impact, and how it fits with the Plastic Pact and climate goals. The state secretary answered that investment decisions are Shell's responsibility, that Shell has not yet stated environmental or CO2 impacts, and that the government will promote recycling, pricing measures and EU-level rules, while agreeing to talk with Shell.
The investment decisions that Shell makes in the US are the responsibility of Shell.
De investeringsbeslissingen die Shell in de VS neemt, zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van Shell.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Zonne-energiesector laat doos van Pandora gesloten: ‘Producent van morgen betaalt recyclingkosten voor producent van gisteren’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether solar panel recycling costs are financed by current producers paying for past panels, and whether a funding shortfall could arise. The state secretary answered that producers and importers bear recycling costs under extended producer responsibility, that the pay-as-you-go system avoids a shortfall, and that an AVV application by Stichting OPEN has been submitted for assessment.
I will assess the application and publish a draft decision for public comment in the Staatscourant as soon as possible.
Ik zal de aanvraag beoordelen en zo spoedig als mogelijk is een ontwerpbeschikking voor zienswijze publiceren in de Staatscourant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Rijkssteun bij overname van Vestia-woningen

Nijboer (PvdA) asked whether the national government would waive transfer tax so that social rental homes held by Vestia could be sold to other housing corporations rather than investors, and what the consequences would be if no sale succeeded. The minister said a sale to non-corporations is not currently on the table, that a new transfer-tax exemption for corporations cannot be reintroduced, and that options within existing exemptions will be explored and reported before summer 2020.

If there is no room within the existing exemptions for a transfer tax exemption, I will examine policy alternatives outside the sphere of transfer tax and inform your House of the outcome around the summer.

Ingeval binnen de bestaande vrijstellingen geen ruimte bestaat voor een vrijstelling van overdrachtsbelasting, dan zal ik beleidsalternatieven buiten de sfeer van de overdrachtsbelasting onderzoeken en rond de zomer aan uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over onduidelijke tarieven bij laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the government about unclear and non-transparent charging tariffs at public EV charge points, and whether the price-transparency agreements with the sector would be met in 2020. The minister acknowledged the need for transparency, described the existing pricing structure and agreements with the sector and ACM, and declined to impose a standard tariff, while committing to further steps such as a legislative change and a sector-wide data exchange by 1 June 2020.
I have made further agreements on price transparency with the industry associations of operators and service providers within the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure (NAL).
Ik heb met de brancheverenigingen van exploitanten en serviceproviders in het kader van de Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur (NAL) nadere afspraken gemaakt over prijstransparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Vanaf 1 januari 2020 alleen euro 6 vrachtauto’s welkom op de Maasvlakte'

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the Maasvlakte Euro VI-only zone for trucks, whether it falls under the harmonised national environmental zone rules, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the zone results from a 2012 package agreed with Rijk, Rotterdam and the port authority, is an exception that is not changed by the 2020 harmonisation, and that it will end on 1 January 2022 when city zones are tightened to Euro VI.
The special and deviating situation of the Euro VI zone on the Maasvlakte, which is incidentally well known to the transport and shipping business, will therefore definitively end on 1 January 2022.

Aan de bijzondere en afwijkende situatie van de Euro VI zone op de Maasvlakte, die overigens goed bekend is bij het vervoerend en verladend bedrijfsleven, zal dus per 1 januari 2022 een definitief einde komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Bizarre wending in bollenvloeren-dossier: inspectie en versterking onnodig’

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked whether buildings with suspect hollow-core slabs would escape inspection and whether a Cobouw report on a reversal in policy was accurate. Minister Knops answered that an inspection duty for the highest-consequence buildings takes effect in April 2020, that the report was incorrect and there is no change of course, and that TNO will study a possible narrowing of later phases.
That is not correct. I refer to my answers to question 2 and question 4.
Dit klopt niet. Ik verwijs daarbij naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 en vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Brenk over granuliet

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Brenk asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the classification of granuliet as soil and the use of granuliet with flocculant (polyacrylamide) in the Over de Maas project, including ecological and environmental risks. The minister answers that granuliet has been classed as soil since 2009 under the Soil Quality Decree, that tests show no harmful effects, and that an independent review will be carried out with the municipality and province.

To remove this concern, I will, in consultation with the municipality and province, have an independent study carried out into the consequences for people and the environment of using granuliet in the Over de Maas project.

Om deze ongerustheid weg te nemen zal ik, in overleg met de gemeente en provincie, een onafhankelijk onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de gevolgen voor mens en milieu van het gebruik van granuliet in het project Over de Maas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitzending van EenVandaag over biomassa uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the ministers about an EenVandaag broadcast on US wood pellets and whether whole trees are used for biomass sold to the Netherlands. Minister Wiebes said he lacked 2019 data, would not name companies citing commercial confidentiality, and argued that sustainability criteria apply regardless of origin and of US Paris Agreement membership.
I cannot say which companies these are, because this is commercially confidential information.
Ik kan niet aangeven om welke bedrijven dit gaat, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de fiscale straf voor woningcorporaties

Parliamentary questions from MP Nijboer asked whether the tax treatment of housing corporations (depreciation limits, the ATAD earnings-stripping rule and the lack of a state-aid-compatible exemption) punishes investment in social housing. The State Secretary answered that corporations are taxed like other companies, that they have sufficient funds for now, that the sector's financial capacity will be examined in a study following the Ronnes motion, and that no exemption from the earnings-stripping rule is possible.
Because of their activities under the Services of General Economic Interest (DAEB) assigned to them, housing corporations receive a number of support measures (compensations).
Vanwege hun activiteiten in het kader van de aan hen opgedragen Dienst van Algemeen Economisch Belang (DAEB) ontvangen woningcorporaties een aantal steunmaatregelen (compensaties).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Universiteit Wageningen ontdekt nieuwe methode onkruidbestrijding spoorbermen‘

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about a Wageningen University method for heat-treating excavated soil to kill Japanese knotweed roots, and whether ProRail's trial could use it and replace glyphosate. The minister answered that the method applies only to excavated soil, is impractical along railways, and that ProRail's pilots will test other techniques, with full phase-out of chemical herbicides by 2025 if pilots succeed.
If the pilots ProRail has underway are successful, ProRail is aiming for full phase-out in 2025.
Wanneer de pilots die ProRail in uitvoering heeft succesvol zijn, zet ProRail in op een volledige uitfasering in 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over het mogelijk maken van het enkelvoudig in- en uitchecken in de treinketen

MPs Amhaouch and Postma asked why the government limits single check-in/check-out to a national app with location, despite a motion asking for broader solutions, and criticised privacy costs and the Ombudsman's concerns about the system. The minister answered that cost-benefit research found single check-in not worthwhile, that new payment methods and an app will be phased in, that privacy is legally protected, and promised a further update via the NOVB progress report.
I am pleased with the work of the public transport ombudsman because it helps individual travellers with incidental cases and increases travel and payment convenience for all travellers.
Ik ben blij met het werk van de OV ombudsman omdat het individuele reizigers helpt bij incidentele voorvallen en het reis- en betaalgemak van alle reizigers verhoogt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over brandgevaar in parkeergarages en onder woningen

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked ministers about fire risks from charging electric vehicles in underground car parks and under homes, and the government replied that NEN is drafting a new fire-safety standard for car parks (expected 2021), that no electric car or charger is known to have caused a car park fire in the Netherlands, and that it will update guidance and consider further measures without committing to specific Building Decree changes now. Several questions (sprinklers, mandatory fire detectors, charger placement) were deferred to the pending NEN standard.
The Dutch Normalisation Institute (NEN), at my request, is working on a new NEN standard for the integrated fire safety of car parks, expected to be ready in 2021.
Het Nederlandse Normalisatie Instituut (hierna NEN) werkt op mijn verzoek aan een nieuwe NEN-norm voor de integrale brandveiligheid van parkeergarage, die naar verwachting in 2021 gereed is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over onbegrijpelijk hoge rekeningen bij blokverwarming

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked about very high bills for communal (block) heating, the Warmtewet's coverage of owner-occupiers and VvE members, the cost of checking heat meters, and how residents can challenge high bills. The minister answered that VvE-supplied heat is now excluded from the Warmtewet, that VvE members have rights under Book 5 BW and access to civil courts, and that the procedure is reasonable.
It is therefore not necessary to open the route to a complaints committee for this.
Het is dus niet nodig om hiervoor de weg naar een geschillencommissie open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het gebruik van warmtenetten

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers why district heating costs differ from gas heating, what legal and technical barriers exist to disconnecting from heat networks, and related questions on tariff linkage, fixed versus variable costs, and temperature-based pricing. The minister replied that maximum heat tariffs are based on the gas reference so costs are on average equal, that disconnection is governed by the Warmtewet and civil law with some exceptions, and that tariff regulation is being reformed.
In my progress letter on Heat Act 2 I concluded that the current tariff system based on a gas reference is not sustainable in the long term.
In mijn voortgangsbrief over Warmtewet 2 heb ik geconcludeerd dat de huidige tariefsystematiek op basis van een gasreferentie op de lange termijn niet houdbaar is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over verworven rechten in de huurtoeslag

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Ronnes, CDA) asked about the Supreme Court-era ruling that lost acquired rights to rent allowance (huurtoeslag) can revive, and why the Tax Administration did not disclose that an automation error had applied a different practice from 2012 to 2017 affecting about 185 households in 2017 and an unknown number elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that the error was discovered and corrected only for 2017, that the figures were not fully known, that communication was late, and that the government will examine how the Council of State ruling can apply retroactively to the remaining households, reporting back by May.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I cannot address individual cases.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Miljoenen koffiebekers Rijk niet gerecycled maar verbrand’

MPs asked whether about 85 million government coffee cups were incinerated instead of recycled, contrary to policy ambitions, and what steps would prevent this. The minister acknowledged this breaches the contracts, said the contractor was contacted, and committed to new contracts from 2021 with direct recycler arrangements.
However, this is not in line with the concluded contracts.
Dit is echter niet in overeenstemming met de afgesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over anti-Israëlstraatnaamborden in Eindhoven

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked whether street-name signs in Eindhoven describing Israeli places as 'in Palestine' are factually wrong, and whether the municipality should be forced to replace them promptly. Minister Knops agreed the descriptions are incorrect, said the municipality now plans to replace the signs this spring and has already updated the register, and rejected the claim that the signs reflect anti-Israel policy.
The municipality is thereby acting in accordance with its 2014 commitments.
Daarmee handelt de gemeente conform de toezeggingen uit 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Tien keer meer lood in water op de Kramatweg (Amsterdam) dan toegestaan: ‘Ik word al jaren vergiftigd hier’'

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports of lead levels in tap water on the Kramatweg in Amsterdam, the health risks, a possible lower lead norm, a landelijk ban on lead pipes, and tenant rights and compensation. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the norm review is pending with the Minister of IenW, noted the landlord has started replacing pipes, and pointed to existing tenancy-law and court remedies, declining to make specific compensation agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verhuurders die weigeren gevaarlijk loden leidingen te vervangen

An MP asked the minister about landlords who refuse to replace dangerous lead pipes in rented homes, and why housing corporations still have lead pipes despite a 2005 sanitation commitment. The minister said landlords must act, outlined tenants' remedies through the rent tribunal and courts, noted that a corporation has started replacing pipes, and promised to examine a ban on lead pipes in existing buildings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Kraanwatercrisis door loden leidingen

MP Nijboer asked the minister whether a urgent investigation into lead pipes in all public buildings, prioritising childcare, schools and hospitals, would be ordered, and what protection tenants and buyers would get given landlords' refusal to replace lead pipes. The minister said municipalities and GGDs should check and replace lead pipes, that tenants and buyers have their own responsibility to investigate, and that a notification duty and a ban on lead pipes in existing buildings are being examined.
I consider it important that for all buildings and dwellings built before 1960 it is established whether lead pipes are still present.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat van alle gebouwen en woningen met een bouwjaar voor 1960 wordt vastgesteld of er nog loden leidingen aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Bewoners van de Iep beide kerstdagen zonder verwarming' en 'Vestia biedt Tweebossers schimmelwoningen aan'

Beckerman (SP) asked the minister about reports of heating failures in Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and mouldy homes offered to Tweebosbuurt residents by housing corporation Vestia, asking about maintenance, compensation and pressure on tenants. The minister acknowledged the problems, said Vestia must meet legal maintenance norms and is funded under its recovery plan, but largely pointed to existing oversight and tenant remedies rather than new action.
This is also explicitly part of Vestia's approved improvement plan and funds have been reserved for it.
Dit maakt ook nadrukkelijk onderdeel uit van het vastgestelde verbeterplan van Vestia en hier zijn ook middelen voor gereserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het afsluiten van de stroom op vakantiepark Anloo en een mogelijke ontruiming van vakantiepark De Groene Heuvels in Beuningen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Environment and Housing about the cut-off of electricity at holiday parks Anloo and De Groene Heuvels, the vulnerable permanent residents affected, municipal responsibility and eviction plans, asking 18 numbered questions. The Minister answered largely that the municipality and the bankrupt park's curator bear responsibility, that consumer protection rules apply, that evictions are municipal choices, and that she expects municipalities to seek housing alternatives for residents.
The municipality has no statutory duty of care to prevent the electricity from being cut off.
De gemeente heeft geen wettelijke zorgplicht om te voorkomen dat de stroom werd afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat bewoners van vakantiepark De Ossenberg eruit worden gezet

MP Dik-Faber asks the minister about residents of holiday parks being evicted, including a family in Hensbroek facing a dwangsom, and whether alternative housing and individual solutions are secured for vulnerable residents. The minister says no national data exist on evictions, that municipalities vary in offering tailored support, and promises a quality and assessment framework for municipalities by year end.
There is no national overview of how many residents had to leave their recreational property as a result of an enforcement procedure.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht van hoeveel bewoners als gevolg van een handhavingstraject hun recreatieobject hebben moeten verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Minister vertraagt woningbouw’

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked the minister whether the Schone Lucht Akkoord (clean air agreement) would slow housing construction and whether it would impose new procurement requirements on construction equipment amid the housing shortage. The minister answered that the agreement's measures support source-based nitrogen policy, that no new binding standards are set yet, and that concrete procurement criteria will be developed with the construction sector over the coming year.

The Schone Lucht Akkoord does not yet set concrete requirements, but states the following agreement: the central government will investigate with partners how a roadmap for clean and zero-emission construction equipment can look and will publish the results in 2020.

In het Schone Lucht Akkoord zijn nog geen concrete eisen vastgelegd, maar staat de volgende afspraak: «De rijksoverheid onderzoekt daarvoor in samenwerking met partijen hoe een ingroeipad («routekaart») voor schoon en 0-emissie bouwmaterieel eruit kan zien en publiceert de resultaten in 2020» .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat 23 ouderen hun huis kwijtraken door een commerciële overname

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked about 23 elderly residents losing their homes after a commercial takeover of their care-housing provider, including the inspectorate's assessment of the building and the legality of the tenant stopping rent payments. The minister said the inspectorate found the building unfit for 24-hour care, that the courts found stopping rent unjustified, and that residents were relocated, compensated for moving, and given tenancy protections, while declining to judge the complex dispute in detail.
I am therefore reticent in my judgement because I do not wish to intervene in the court's assessment and do not know all the details.
Dit maakt dat ik terughoudend ben in mijn oordeel omdat ik niet wil treden in de beoordeling van de rechter en niet alle details ken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de opmars van tijdelijke huurcontracten en de gevolgen daarvan

An SP MP asks the housing minister why temporary rental contracts are spreading, whether government discourages them, and whether they harm tenants in a housing crisis, and asks for data and an evaluation. The minister replies that open-ended leases remain the norm, that temporary contracts serve specific groups, that CBS data show about 8% of private and 3% of housing-corporation lets are temporary, and that the Housing Market Flow Act 2015 will be evaluated by mid-2021 with no cap planned for now.
I am going to evaluate the Housing Market Flow Act 2015 soon.
Ik ga de Wet Doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 binnenkort evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over de bedreiging van de publieke taak van woningcorporaties

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the housing minister whether falling net cash flow at housing associations threatens their public task, citing unrealised property value gains, weak new building, the ATAD1 tax effects and the call to move dead capital to social housing. The minister confirmed most premises, said the lower cash flow is substantial but financial ratios remain sufficient, blamed the cause only partly on factors outside associations' control, and pointed to pending studies and a stronger binding nature for local performance agreements.
I will consult with VNG and Aedes on how this starting point can concretely take shape.
Ik ga in overleg met VNG en Aedes bezien hoe dit uitgangspunt concreet vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de financiële positie van woningcorporaties hun publieke taak bedreigt

MP Nijboer asks whether the 22% fall in housing corporations' net cash flow, driven by the landlord levy and corporate tax, threatens their public housing task and new-build investment. The minister acknowledges the decline but argues financial ratios remain sufficient, cites about 29 billion euro of additional investment room, and promises research on the motion Ronnes before summer.
Before the summer, the House can expect the results of this research.
Voor de zomer kan de Kamer de resultaten van dit onderzoek verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over de gevolgen van de Amsterdamse huisvestingsverordening inzake woningdelen voor de krapte op de huurmarkt

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the effects of Amsterdam's new housing ordinance on shared housing and the rental market shortage, including impacts on students, expats and other sharers. The minister answered that shared housing remains possible in Amsterdam under stricter conditions, that existing legal situations are unaffected, and that the expected effects are limited, while noting that data on sharers is scarce and that a monitor will be published in September.
A monitor on shared housing in Amsterdam will be produced in September. If there is a need for it, it can be shared with the House of Representatives after publication.
In september wordt een monitor gemaakt over woningdelen in Amsterdam. Indien daar behoefte aan is, kan deze na publicatie worden gedeeld met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers for Environment and Housing and for Finance about leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including sudden canon increases, the residual land-value method, unclear information for leaseholders, and consumer protection. The ministers answered that leasehold is a property right rather than a financial product, that Amsterdam offers conversion schemes and a three-expert procedure, and that existing local oversight and dispute mechanisms apply.
Leasehold is therefore not comparable to a predatory insurance policy.
Erfpacht is derhalve niet vergelijkbaar met een woekerpolis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked the government about registration in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including cases where new residents are registered without the main tenant's consent and suffer consequences. Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht in de Telegraaf van 8 januari 2020 ‘Miljoenenroof bij Corporatie’

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about an alleged multi-million euro embezzlement at housing corporation Stadgenoot, including why internal controls, the board, supervisory board, auditor and regulator Aw did not detect it, and about screening for gambling addiction. The minister said a criminal investigation and an external forensic audit are ongoing, deferred questions on controls to those findings, said the Aw does not supervise individual transactions and will take the follow-up into its judgment letter, and said corporations themselves are responsible for staff screening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel 'Hoe Airbnb toch weer aan het langste eind trekt'

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about a newspaper report on Airbnb's influence over the bill regulating short-term rental platforms, including ministry contacts with platforms, the bill's aims and expected effects, and whether platforms can be held liable as in Paris and via EU law. The minister replied that platforms were consulted alongside municipalities, that a registration obligation and national registry were adopted after platform input, that municipalities gain sanction and information-enforcement powers, and that EU-level liability options will be explored, with the bill to be evaluated within five years.
In addition, the platforms have undertaken to prevent as far as possible that advertisements (offers) without a registration number are published on their websites.
Daarnaast hebben de platforms toegezegd zo veel mogelijk uit te sluiten dat er op hun websites advertenties (aanbiedingen) zonder registratienummer worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht dat AirBnB moet worden gezien als informatieplatform

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Environment and Housing whether a CJEU ruling treating Airbnb as an information society service affects the Dutch short-term rental bill and municipalities' ability to regulate holiday rentals. The minister answered that the ruling does not affect the bill, which targets hosts rather than platforms, that municipalities can use registration duties, scraping and an obligation on platforms to cooperate, and that the government is pursuing EU-level measures.
Parallel to the process surrounding the bill, the cabinet is pursuing additional measures at European level.
Parallel aan het traject rond het wetsvoorstel zet het kabinet er in Europees verband op in om tot aanvullende maatregelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de wijziging van historische temperatuurdata door het KNMI

An MP from FvD asked the minister why 1947–1950 parallel measurements at De Bilt were not used in homogenisation, whether KNMI overcorrected warm days, why only Eelde was used as reference, who supervises KNMI and why it would not respond substantively to CLINTEL, and asked for publication of the R code. The minister denied overcorrection, defended the method and Eelde choice, pointed to supervision by a Raad van toezicht and open data, and committed to publishing the R scripts within weeks.
KNMI will make the source code (in the form of R scripts) used for the homogenisation publicly available within a few weeks.
Het KNMI zal de broncode (in de vorm van de R-scripts) die is gebruikt voor de homogenisatie binnen enkele weken publiek beschikbaar maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond windturbines en de onduidelijkheid over de geldende regels, de inspraak en de participatie bij het voornemen tot plaatsing van windturbines

An SP MP asked the Minister about recurring complaints from residents near wind turbines, noise and health concerns, the adequacy of the noise standards, cumulative noise, public participation and profit distribution. The government answered that existing noise and shadow standards are sufficient, that no further research or precautionary tightening is planned, and that participation and local ownership are handled through existing procedures and the Klimaatakkoord.

I therefore see no reason to conduct additional research into the complaints about wind turbines, nor to apply the precautionary principle in the spatial assessment of where wind turbines may be built.

Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te doen naar de klachten rond windturbines, noch om bij de ruimtelijke afweging waar windturbines gebouwd kunnen worden het voorzorgsbeginsel toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Eijs, Kröger en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Onderzoek: in één schep Noord-Hollands compost zitten duizenden microplastics’

An MP asks the minister about a report finding thousands of microplastics per scoop of compost, the role of biobased and biodegradable plastics, verification of packaging claims, and health research. The minister answers that consumer sorting is the main driver, that teabags belong in residual waste and the sector is being approached to move to compostable materials, and that claims are verified through independent certification schemes while health research is due by summer 2020.
It is not checked whether packaging that is biobased, biodegradable or has an organic component actually is so.
Er wordt niet gecontroleerd of verpakkingen die biobased zijn, bioafbreekbaar zijn of een organische component hebben dit ook zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over de berichten ‘Zelfs grote bedrijven hebben geen natuurvergunning, dus weten we niet hoeveel stikstof in de natuur terechtkomt’ en ‘Uitstoot van Gelderse bedrijven o

SP MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked about reports that thousands of businesses, including large ones, lack the nature permits required under the Wet natuurbescherming, so nitrogen emissions are unknown. The minister answered that many firms need no permit for nitrogen, that enforcement is largely a provincial responsibility with no statutory inspection deadlines, that no active enforcement occurs until a collective legalisation scheme exists, and that a decision on the Schiphol enforcement request is expected by 1 April 2020.
It is not known how many businesses wrongly lack a permit under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de gedwongen huisuitzetting van een familie in Elst

An MP asks the housing minister whether the municipality of Overbetuwe should postpone the forced eviction of a family from an unauthorised dwelling in Elst, given a judge's suggestion to wait for a pending zoning decision, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answers that the municipality is legally bound to enforce, that legalisation is blocked by planning constraints, and that intervening is not appropriate given the municipality's powers and the family's pending legal remedies.

Given the municipality's powers, the outcome of the various legal proceedings and the family's remaining legal remedies against the enforcement order, it does not befit me to intervene in this situation.

Gelet op de bevoegdheden van de gemeente, de geschetste uitkomst van diverse juridische procedures en de nog openstaande rechtsmiddelen van de familie om tegen de last onder bestuursdwang in verweer te komen, past het mij niet in deze situatie te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huisjesmelkers aan de Pieter Calandlaan in Amsterdam, Nieuw-West

The MP asks whether renting an 8 m2 room for 700 euro per month on Pieter Calandlaan in Amsterdam is reasonable, whether such rent fits the points system, and whether short six-month contracts are lawful and can be curbed, plus which tools exist to fine landlords who charge excessive rent. The minister answers that such rent is theoretically possible under the points system, that tenants can appeal to the Huurcommissie, that short contracts are lawful and will be evaluated before 2021, and that fining instruments are being developed together with the motion Asscher/Heerma without a concrete date.
To test this, any tenant can turn to the Huurcommissie.
Om dit te toetsen kan elke huurder zich tot de Huurcommissie wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Fire at Norway Airport destroys hunderds of cars grounds planes’

The MP asks whether a major fire in a Norwegian airport car park could happen in the Netherlands, what fire safety rules apply to car parks, and how electric vehicle battery fires and rescue operations are handled. The minister answers that the Norwegian investigation is still pending, that a new NEN standard on car park fire safety is being prepared including alternative-fuel vehicles, that no central incident records exist, and that fire services are developing guidance.
I do not have information on individual incidents involving electric cars that proved flammable.
Ik beschik niet over informatie van individuele incidenten met elektrische auto's die ontvlambaar bleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over het schimmeldrama in aardbevingsgebied

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked about mould and damp in social rental homes in the Groningen earthquake area, including Woongroep Marenland's four years of neglected maintenance, timelines for repairs, compensation for tenants, and corporations' communication. The minister apologised via the corporation, outlined planned repairs and a national approach to damp and mould, but offered no direct compensation and pointed tenants to the rent tribunal.
four years of uncertainty and living in a home with mould is not acceptable
vier jaar onzekerheid en leven in een woning met schimmel is niet acceptabel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over Het bericht ‘Een extra kliko voor plastic: meer scheiden is niet beter’

An MP asks the Minister for Environment and Housing about a newspaper opinion piece arguing that adding plastic to the PMD waste stream is not beneficial and about the new packaging framework agreement that shifts waste collection and recycling responsibility from municipalities to producers. The minister answers that the framework was reached between the VNG and industry, that municipalities retain collection responsibility, and that the government aims to improve sorting quality and a circular packaging chain.
The ministry is not a party to this new proposal.
Het ministerie is geen partij bij dit nieuwe voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden lid Van Eijs en van Meenen over het bericht ‘5000 huizen maar geen scholen of sporthal: vrees voor spookwijk Binckhorst’

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about reports that the Binckhorst district in The Hague will get 5,000 homes but no schools or sports hall. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for schools and that the Binckhorst facilities programme, though self-binding rather than legally binding, guides development, and saw no reason to consult The Hague.

The facilities programme for the Binckhorst, adopted by the municipal executive in November 2019, shows which facilities are needed for a liveable neighbourhood and which locations are available for them.

Het voorzieningenprogramma, zoals dat in november 2019 door het college van burgemeester en wethouders is vastgesteld, geeft inzicht in welke voorzieningen noodzakelijk zijn voor een leefbare wijk en welke locaties daarvoor beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Laçin over het bericht dat de lucht op achterstandsscholen vuiler is

SP MPs Kwint and Laçin asked the government about research showing children at disadvantaged schools breathe dirtier air, and about fine-dust zones, filtration, and school segregation. Minister Slob rejected the general conclusion, said data on fine-dust per school and filtration is not centrally available, and said responsibility for school housing lies with municipalities and school boards, while pointing to a planned integrated housing plan obligation.
No national data on fine-dust concentration per school are known to me.
Er zijn mij geen landelijke gegevens bekend over de fijnstofconcentratie per school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over Vestia

An MP asked the housing minister about Vestia's financial shortfall and poor housing conditions in Bergeijk, including whether Vestia can renovate and whether tenant interests are protected in a planned sale. The minister answered that maintenance is the corporation's duty, that tenant rights to maintenance and renovation are set out in law, and that a regional transfer process and sector investment study are underway, with reports expected in 2020.
Projects concerning renovations and major maintenance involve individual cases handled by local stakeholders, which I as Minister do not get involved in.
Projecten ten aanzien van renovaties en groot onderhoud betreffen individuele casuïstiek onder de zorg van lokale stakeholders, waar ik als Minister niet in treedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het schaarstecriterium in de Huisvestingswet

An MP asks the housing minister about court rulings annulling the scarcity criterion underpinning municipal housing ordinances in Rotterdam and Eindhoven, about investor buy-to-let practices, and about what municipalities can do to regulate conversions and tenant protection. The minister defends the scarcity basis as requiring sound justification, says the rulings concern outdated local justifications, notes Rotterdam has adopted a new ordinance and an appeal is pending, and promises the Huisvestingswet evaluation before summer recess.
An appeal has been lodged against the Rotterdam district court ruling of 13 March 2019.
Tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Rotterdam van 13 maart 2019 is hoger beroep ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over de berichten ‘Trein stilgezet vanwege vrouw met nikab, politie geeft weer geen boete’ en ‘Conducteur aan schandpaal door nikabfans'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers how the NS and police handled a train stopped for a woman wearing a niqab who was not fined, whether the conductor was supported, and whether action was taken against online harassment of the conductor. The government defended the professionals' discretion, said the police acted in line with agreed procedures, condemned the social media campaign against the conductor, and noted that the NS reported no other incidents since the ban took effect.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to decide what criminal follow-up is given to a violation.
Het is aan politie en Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen welk strafrechtelijk vervolg aan een overtreding wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over PFAS houdende grond afkomstig van de verwerking van aardappelen, suikerbieten en cichoreiwortels

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the ministers about PFAS limits threatening processing of potatoes, sugar beet and chicory and the costs for the sector, and about use of manufacturer's declarations and the PFAS taskforce. The minister replied that a temporary national background value and clarified guidance now allow tarra soil to be reused again, that the sector is represented in the taskforce, and that area-specific policy could speed up soil quality maps.
On 1 December 2019 I amended the temporary PFAS policy framework, clarifying the use of tarra soil and setting a temporary national background value.
Op 1 december 2019 heb ik het tijdelijk handelingskader PFAS aangepast waarin het gebruik van tarragrond is verduidelijkt en is een tijdelijke landelijke achtergrondwaarde vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Nieuwe test voor uitstoot diesels’

MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked the minister about a planned particle-count test in the APK for diesel cars with roetfilters, its timing, costs, affected vehicle numbers, compensation and consultation. The minister answered that the test is aimed for 2021, estimated 100,000 to 125,000 vehicles may fail, and rejected compensation for owners, while committing to an impact study and advice from the ATR and consultation.
To make the particle counter test mandatory for the APK, a further amendment of the Regeling voertuigen is needed.
Om de deeltjestellertest verplicht te stellen voor de APK is een volgende wijziging van de Regeling voertuigen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over bladblazerterreur

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers about the health, noise and environmental harm of leaf blowers and whether they should be banned or phased out. The minister answered that a categorical ban is not possible under EU rules, that municipalities should decide on use, and that the national government will not intervene but will raise the topic with the VNG.
I do not consider it the task of the national government to intervene here, but I do want to bring this topic to the attention of the municipalities via the VNG.
Ik vind het niet de taak van de nationale overheid om hier in te treden, maar ik wil wel dit onderwerp bij de gemeenten via de VNG onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Lage overdrachtsbelasting voor kluspand’

An MP asked the housing minister about a Supreme Court ruling on the transfer tax rate for office buildings converted into homes, the number of conversions, the availability of convertible offices and the Transformatiefaciliteit. The minister answered that the rulings apply to all conversions, that conversions added about 10,000 homes a year, that a study of future conversion potential will start, and that the rulings are not expected to have a large effect on output.
Therefore I will start a study into the future availability of buildings for housing conversion.
Daarom zal ik een onderzoek starten naar de toekomstige beschikbaarheid van panden voor woningtransformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Emiel van Dijk over eigen woningen voor Nieuwegeinse statushouders

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is discriminatory that Nieuwegein reserves 30 social rental homes for single refugee status holders, and whether asylum permits should be revoked so social housing goes only to Dutch residents. The minister answered that nationality-based distinctions are not made, that municipalities set their own urgency categories, that the social housing construction claim is disputed, and that revoking permits is refused.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de Vestia-ellende in Honselse burgemeestersbuurt

An SP MP asked the housing minister about Vestia's renovation works in the Burgemeestersbuurt in Honselersdijk, including unclear compensation, consent and information for tenants, and whether municipalities or corporations should take over Vestia housing. The minister expressed regret, said Vestia admitted a planning error and trusts Vestia and the municipality to find a solution, and gave general rules on consent, compensation and tenant information while declining to take a position on individual cases and not committing to a concrete new step.
These questions concern individual case matters under the care of local stakeholders.
Deze vragen betreffen vragen over individuele casuïstiek onder de zorg van lokale stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten aan de TU-Delft zijn opgelicht door nep-verhuurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing and the Minister of Education about students at TU Delft defrauded by fake landlords, including how many were foreign students, and about platform controls, blacklists, licensing and a quality mark. The minister answered that no standard registration or national figures exist, described information campaigns, the Wet toeristische verhuur, ACM action against intermediary fees, pilots on local landlord licensing, and said fake landlords are a criminal law matter rather than housing policy.
There is no standard registration of this available at TU Delft.
Er is geen standaardregistratie hiervan beschikbaar bij de TU Delft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over problemen met de toepassing van thermisch gereinigde grond (TGG)

An MP asked the minister about the halt on applying thermally cleaned soil (TGG) since 2017, its causes, the expected duration, and how the market can resume. The minister answered that quality problems led to the halt, verification by the ILT and the reclaimers is now complete, TGG can be offered again, and a RIVM evaluation of norms is due by end 2020.
Now that the ILT states that the verification inspections of the stored TGG at both cleaners were reliably carried out, TGG can be offered again.
Nu de ILT aangeeft dat de verificatiekeuringen van de opgeslagen TGG bij de beide reinigers betrouwbaar tot stand zijn gekomen, kan TGG weer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de kosten van de gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak

MPs Futselaar and Beckerman asked where the 500 million euro nitrogen reserve comes from, whether it is sufficient, how the 1 billion euro housing boost is divided, and what the costs for municipalities and provinces will be. The minister answered that the reserve is funded from a 2019 budget underspend, that the amount's adequacy is still unknown, that the housing boost is separate and not earmarked, and that the financial impact on local governments is not yet known, with support helpdesks and a team being set up.
At this moment it is not yet clear what the exact financial consequences of the nitrogen ruling are for municipalities and provinces.
Op dit moment is nog niet inzichtelijk wat de exacte financiële gevolgen van de stikstofuitspraak voor gemeenten en provincies zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Over de Maas is transparant, maar alleen tot op zekere hoogte'

An MP asks the minister about the soil imported for the 'Over de Maas' project, including inspection results, the planned municipal investigation, and whether the goals of shallowing deep lakes are defined. The minister replies that imported soil must meet legal standards, that inspections found poor compliance and were intensified for 2019-2020, and that the project goals are set in advance and tendering considers more than price.
It was established that compliance with the regulations was poor.
Hierbij is vastgesteld dat de naleving op de regelgeving slecht was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Laurens Wonen in opspraak is

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the scandal at housing corporation Laurens Wonen, including inadequate oversight of prohibited dual positions, withholding of the Aw's correspondence, and whether misappropriated funds would be reclaimed. The minister answered that the Aw has tightened checks on dual positions, found no other violations, and that the Aw will address the case in its regular public letter, while reclaiming funds is for the corporation's board.
It is up to the Aw, within the legal framework, to decide which documents are or are not made public.
Het is aan de Aw om, binnen het wettelijk kader, te bepalen welke documenten al dan niet openbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis en Ronnes over het bericht dat Utrecht versneld ruim 9.000 woningen en nieuwe OV-verbindingen krijgt

MPs Koerhuis and Ronnes asked why the minister reserved 60 million euros from the housing impulse for Utrecht before the allocation rules (AMvB) were published, and on what legal basis. The minister answered that the reservation is conditional on the yet-to-be-set rules and procedure, gives no guarantee of payment, is not an allocation that can be appealed, and that other regions will be assessed on the same conditions.
There is therefore no allocation of funds from the impulse yet, and so there is no possibility of objection or appeal against the intended reservation.
Er is dus nog geen sprake van een toekenning van middelen uit de impuls en daarmee is er geen bezwaar- of beroepsmogelijkheid tegen de voorgenomen reservering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over antikraak-cowboys die weerloze huurders uitbuiten

MP Nijboer asked the minister about anti-squat agencies exploiting vulnerable tenants, including their rights, the Keurmerk Leegstandbeheer complaints committee, rental rules, contract terms and municipal alternatives. The minister replied that the sector has been professionalised through the certification scheme, its complaints committee and a trade association, that residents can go to court or to the committee for a EUR 25 fee, and that temporary rental is preferred.
If an anti-squat resident believes their rights are being violated, they can ask the court for a judgment.
Indien een anti-kraakbewoner van mening is dat zijn of haar rechten worden geschonden, kan een oordeel worden gevraagd aan de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Von Martels over mogelijk te hoge PFAS-waarden in strooizout

MPs De Pater-Postma and Von Martels asked whether PFAS contamination of road salt could endanger winter road gritting, whether expert follow-up research was planned, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that PFAS contamination of deep-mined salt is very unlikely, that current NEN standards do not include PFAS, that stocks for the coming winter are already purchased, and that no alternatives are needed.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, it is very unlikely that road salt, which is largely extracted from old and deep soil layers, is contaminated with PFAS.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is het zeer onwaarschijnlijk dat strooizout dat veelal uit oude en diepe grondlagen wordt gewonnen, vervuild is met PFAS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het artikel ‘Groene Wende op Duitse Wegen: Wat betekent dat voor Nederland?’

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the minister whether a large German shift to electric cars would hurt the Dutch economy and auto sector, and whether the Dutch market and supply of EVs are at risk. The minister answered that the transition offers opportunities for Dutch firms, that the government's Klimaatakkoord measures and annual monitoring aim for 100% zero-emission new sales by 2030, and that suppliers will need to adapt.
That is why the market and sales of electric cars are monitored annually and the incentive package will be adjusted if necessary.
Daarom wordt de markt en verkoop van elektrische auto’s jaarlijks gemonitord en zal het stimuleringspakket zo nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Toxic PFAS Chemicals Found in Artificial Turf’

An MP asked the government about reports that PFAS chemicals were found in artificial turf, whether Dutch turf has been tested, and the exposure and environmental risks from it and its recycling. The minister answered that no specific knowledge exists on PFAS risks in artificial turf, pointed to ongoing Rijkswaterstaat and Arcadis studies on PFAS sources and products, and said the risks of recycling will await those studies.
Specific risks of PFAS in artificial turf are currently not known in the scientific literature or at RIVM and ECHA.
Over risico's specifiek van PFAS in kunstgras is in de wetenschappelijke literatuur en bij het RIVM en ECHA op dit moment niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Subsidie nachttrein verstoort de markt’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked why a 6.7 million euro subsidy for ÖBB NightJet via NS would not distort the market, whether it is non-discriminatory, a bridging subsidy, and why no lower-cost alternatives were sought. The minister defends a two-track approach: a temporary subsidy to NS/ÖBB for a trial from 2021 while open-access operators are engaged, with compensation capped at net financial effect and limited to the PSO framework.

To reintroduce the night train quickly, a two-track approach was chosen with temporary subsidy to NS alone, while at the same time work proceeds with other interested parties on a non-discriminatory arrangement.

Om de nachttrein op korte termijn al te herintroduceren is gekozen voor een tweeledige aanpak met een tijdelijke subsidiering van alleen NS, terwijl tegelijkertijd met andere geïnteresseerde partijen gewerkt wordt aan een non-discriminatoire regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huurtoeslag en het minimumloon

Two SP MPs asked why the rent-subsidy (huurtoeslag) rent ceiling is lower for under-23s, how many young tenants miss out, and whether the age limit should be lowered to 18 and the youth minimum wage raised. The minister answered that the lower ceiling is deliberate to keep young people's housing affordable, that raising it would push up rents, and that no change is planned, while noting the government's stance on the youth minimum wage.
All things considered, there is currently no reason to lower the age limit of 23.
Alles overziend is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrens van 23 jaar te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels en Van den Berg over het niet exporteren van kernafval naar COVRA maar naar Rusland

MPs Von Martels and Van den Berg asked whether depleted uranium from URENCO is being exported to Russia instead of stored at COVRA, who paid for the storage halls, why exports stopped in 2009, how much is produced and exported, the waste definition, and what Russia does with the material. The government confirmed that URENCO financed the halls, that exports stopped in 2009 with no current plans to resume, withheld export volumes as commercially confidential, explained the waste definition and ANVS supervision, and stated that Russian use is subject to IAEA safeguards and civil end-use guarantees.
The amount of depleted uranium that URENCO Nederland produces and how much of it is exported is commercially confidential information and is therefore not made public.
De hoeveelheid verarmd uranium die URENCO Nederland produceert en hoeveel daarvan wordt geëxporteerd is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en wordt daarom niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Kabinet geeft groen licht voor volledig vuurwerkverbod in Apeldoorn, maar Raad van State twijfelt’

An MP asked whether the Raad van State's advice on the Vuurwerkbesluit allows municipalities to impose a full fireworks ban, and how this squares with its reported doubts. The government answered that the Vuurwerkbesluit is not exhaustive, so municipalities can use their autonomous ordinance powers to ban fireworks in zones or their whole territory, citing the 2016 Raad van State ruling.
The Vuurwerkbesluit does not stand in the way of such a municipal fireworks ban.
Het Vuurwerkbesluit staat niet in de weg aan een dergelijk gemeentelijk vuurwerkverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht dat Actiegroep Niet Te Koop een sociale huurwoning bezet in West

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Stadgenoot reported the occupation of a social rental home in West Amsterdam by activist group Niet Te Koop to police, whether it delayed as before, and whether corporations should always report such occupations. The answer, given partly on behalf of the Justice minister, is only partly responsive, referring to earlier answers and noting the corporation's own responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over consequenties PFAS (poly- en perfluoralkylstoffen)

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes (CDA) asked about the consequences of the PFAS temporary framework for construction and dredging, including project delays, housing construction, jobs and comparison with other countries. The minister says she is in talks with the sector, has organised information meetings and regional working conferences, and is taking measures to unblock projects while noting the national framework is needed for health reasons.
I do not have independent figures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het storten van vervuild baggerslib uit België in Nederlandse zandwinputten

Parliamentary questions from MP Stoffer (SGP) asked how the government would respond to reports that polluted dredging sludge from Belgium and other contaminants were dumped into Dutch sand pits, and about tightening rules and enforcement. The minister replied that the rules are adequate, that enforcement by ILT and Rijkswaterstaat is sufficient, and that she will explore cooperation with Flanders and harmonisation of rules.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the enforcement policy.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het handhavingsbeleid aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over ontploffingsgevaar emissiearme stalvloeren en ruimte voor alternatieve systemen

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked about explosion risk from low-emission stable floors after the Markelo incident, the delayed release of the Omgevingsdienst Twente report, and barriers for innovative systems under the RAV protocol. The government admitted the report was promised but not sent, said a new study on floor safety will be commissioned, and outlined steps to speed up approval procedures.
