That was not right, because that had been promised.
Dat was niet goed, want dat was wel beloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over emissiearme stalvloeren

Two VVD MPs asked whether emission-reducing stable floors have been adequately tested for safety after explosions on dairy farms in Lettele and Markelo, and why earlier warnings and the Technical Advisory Pool's role were not considered. The minister acknowledges the earlier answers should have weighed a 2016 fire-academy warning, and announces a joint study with the Minister for Environment and Housing on the safety of emission-reducing floors, with results to Parliament in early 2020.

Given the remaining questions about the safety of emission-reducing floors for livestock farmers and others involved, the Minister for Environment and Housing and I will commission a study into the safety of emission-reducing floors in practical use.

Gezien de vragen die resteren over de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij veehouders en andere betrokkenen zullen de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen en ik een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij het gebruik in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Dik-Faber over sanering van ernstig vervuilde bodems in gemeente de Ronde Venen

MPs Stoffer and Dik-Faber asked about lead-contaminated soil in De Ronde Venen, the urgency of remediation above 800 mg/kg, the division of responsibilities between state, province and municipality, and financing. The minister answered that the intervention threshold signals possible need for measures, that the Soil Convenant leaves it to competent authorities to decide, that responsibilities shift to municipalities under the Environment and Planning Act, that funding runs to end-2020, and that a joint taskforce is working on scenarios.
It concerns a signal value, which indicates that measures may possibly be necessary.
Het betreft een signaalwaarde, die aangeeft dat mogelijkerwijze maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en De Pater-Postma over de beruchte spoorwegovergang in Castricum

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the dangerous Castricum level crossing, including how often trains passed while people or vehicles were on it, the causes and outcomes, progress on safer crossings, and how many unprotected crossings remain. The secretary said there were six such incidents since 1975 with one collision in 1997, listed programme progress and a joint study with the municipality, and said the target is zero fatalities at level crossings with about 180 priority NABO crossings to be tackled by 2023, 36 done so far.
Level crossing safety is a priority for me.
Overwegveiligheid is voor mij een prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over 'Baggersector ligt goeddeels stil door strengere norm chemische stoffen PFAS'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary why the dredging sector is largely halted by the strict PFAS norm of 0.1 microgram per kilogram, questioning its scientific basis and asking for a workable solution before the definitive framework of end 2020. The State Secretary answers that the limit follows the precautionary and stand-still principles, that a temporary PFAS framework allows reuse for housing and industry, and that she will hold information sessions, regional conferences and a taskforce, while RIVM is asked for provisional background values.
My aim is to reach a workable and safe approach to PFAS-containing soil and dredged material as quickly as possible.
Mijn inzet is om zo snel mogelijk te komen tot een werkbare en veilige omgang met PFAS-houdende grond en baggerspecie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het ontbreken van informatie op verpakkingen t.b.v. recycling

An MP asked the state secretary about Natuur & Milieu findings that packaging is overly complex, poorly labelled for sorting and often not recyclable, and about the effectiveness of the Plastic Pact and industry plans. The secretary largely acknowledged the problems, pointed to tariff differentiation, EU-level tightening of essential requirements and planned higher recycling targets, but declined to make the industry plans binding and gave no firm new national rules.
I have no possibility to declare them generally binding, because a sector is not a recognised entity in the Packaging Management Decree.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheid ze algemeen verbindend te verklaren, omdat een branche niet een erkende entiteit is in het Besluit beheer verpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Randstad bij vuilste gebieden Europa: 'Ik zou wonen in Amsterdam zeker niet aanraden''

MPs Paternotte asked whether residents near Schiphol face three times the health risk from air pollution and noise of residents in Groningen and Drenthe, what measures address this, and whether groei should wait for health measures and a clean-air action plan. The minister answered that the relative risk difference is about 1.6, outlined existing noise and emission criteria, the Hinderbeperking convenant, RIVM ultrafine dust research, and that growth is tied to demonstrable reduction of hindrance in the LVB-2 and an action plan expected by end 2019.
In addition, in 2017 the Ministry of IenW commissioned RIVM to carry out a research programme into the health effects of exposure to ultrafine particles from aviation.

Daarnaast heeft het Ministerie van IenW in 2017 aan het RIVM opdracht gegeven om een onderzoeksprogramma uit te voeren naar de gezondheidseffecten van blootstelling aan ultrafijn stof uit de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht “Supersnelle elektrische fietsen winnen snel aan populariteit”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising speed-pedelec popularity, accident numbers, expected growth, safety of mixed speeds on cycle paths and roads, and the rules applying to them. The minister answered with 2017-2018 accident counts, a commissioned SWOV deep-dive due in 2020, statistics on registrations, and that existing rules and consultations with stakeholders are being maintained, while no separate vehicle category is planned.
To gain more insight into the road safety of speed-pedelecs, I am having SWOV carry out an in-depth study of accidents involving speed-pedelecs.
Om meer inzicht in de verkeersveiligheid van speed-pedelecs te krijgen, laat ik SWOV een diepteonderzoek doen naar ongevallen met speed-pedelecs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het onderhoud aan de vuurtoren te Egmond aan Zee, waarbij mogelijk chroom 6 is vrijgekomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about communication with residents and businesses during maintenance on the Egmond aan Zee lighthouse, where chromium-6 paint was removed, including dust clouds, the absence of notification, and the lack of a protocol. The minister acknowledged communication with the surrounding community was insufficient, said safety was never at risk, and committed Rijkswaterstaat to talks with residents via the municipality.
The residents and neighbouring businesses were not informed about the works.
De omwonenden en naastgelegen ondernemingen zijn over de werkzaamheden niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Ziengs over het bericht 'Massale muizen- en rattenplaag op komst in Nederland'

MPs Weverling and Ziengs asked the ministers about reports of a looming mouse and rat plague, criticism from the KAD that government is complacent, the planned restriction of anticoagulant rodenticides from 2023, and whether adequate alternatives and ongoing research exist. The state secretary answers that integrated pest management and prevention are central, that a RIVM exploratory study is underway with its report expected end 2019, and that alternatives remain available, while the Ctgb is planning to limit anticoagulants to certified professionals.
The cabinet wants to reduce the number of barn fires in line with the reaction agreement.
Het kabinet wil conform het reageerakkoord het aantal stalbranden verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the infrastructure and water management costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, their share relative to population and revenues, and a breakdown over past, current and projected years. The minister replied that Infrastructure and Water Management does not classify costs by migration background, as in 2009, and referred to a covering letter for the sixth question.

In the answer to the questions of 17 July 2009 it was indicated that Infrastructure and Water Management does not apply a breakdown of costs by citizens with a (non-Western/Western) migration background.
In het antwoord op de vragen van 17 juli 2009 is aangegeven dat Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen indeling in kosten naar burgers met een (niet-westerse/westerse) migratieachtergrond hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ’Plastic theezakjes blijkt bron van microplastic’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that plastic tea bags release microplastics, including how many are used, whether plastic should be banned, legal options, other sources, and whether they fall under EU single-use plastics rules. The State Secretary answered that data are lacking, health effects are still under study, existing EU rules on migration limits apply, no new ban is currently considered necessary, and tea bags are not covered by the single-use plastics directive.
The cabinet currently sees no need for that.
Daar ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht het bericht ‘Chemische bedrijven overtreden massaal de regels: 'Veiligheidscultuur moet anders'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about research showing that about 90% of Brzo chemical companies committed a safety violation over 2006–2017, with 7% responsible for a quarter of violations, and about risk-based inspection and safety culture. The state secretary answered that the data show a stable share of compliant firms, that the 'repeat offender' definition needs clarification with the researchers, that existing enforcement tools are considered sufficient, and that a range of safety-culture and cooperation initiatives are underway.
I would like to engage with the researchers to properly interpret the results and see how the follow-up research can offer points of departure for policy.
Ik wil graag in gesprek met de onderzoekers om de resultaten goed te kunnen duiden en te kijken hoe het vervolgonderzoek aangrijpingspunten voor beleid kan bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de verbetering van de spoorlijn naar Zandvoort

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the rail upgrade to Zandvoort would proceed without the Formula 1 race, how it fits with the Council of State's PAS nitrogen ruling, whether nitrogen can be offset or an ADC-test applied, and who pays for the upgrade and nearby residents' noise concerns. The Secretary of State answered that the upgrade responds to a motion and is partly co-financed by the Rijk, that nitrogen permitting will be assessed only once a request is filed, that noise stays within existing limits, and that the Grand Prix organiser pays only event-specific costs.
Nitrogen deposition on rail mainly occurs during the construction of a project, such as from incoming freight traffic.
Stikstofdepositie komt bij spoor vooral voor bij de aanleg van een project, zoals door aanvoerend vrachtverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht: ‘Deelautoproject botst op taaie Woningwet’

An MP asked whether the Housing Act blocks a shared electric car project with housing corporations and whether rules should be changed to let corporations send surplus solar power to shared cars. The minister said the Act already allows corporations to lease roofs to third parties, but will not widen corporations' remit to energy production, while promising to examine further cooperation options.
However, I am willing, when elaborating the policy intention, to examine how the options for corporations to cooperate with such initiatives can be further expanded.
Wel ben ik bereid om bij de uitwerking van het beleidsvoornemen te bezien hoe de mogelijkheden voor corporaties om met dergelijk initiatieven samen te werken verder kunnen worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aangekondigde importheffing voor afval

An MP asked the government about the risk that a planned import levy on waste would push waste to landfill abroad or in the Netherlands, increasing CO2 emissions, and about its revenue, heat supply and renewable energy effects. The state secretary answered that leakage risks were limited, estimated a 4 Mton reduction package, gave a revenue forecast, and declined to reconsider the measure.
A reconsideration of this measure is, as far as the cabinet is concerned, therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van deze maatregel is wat het kabinet betreft dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het in zicht zijn van het spoorplafond

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS's forecast that the rail capacity ceiling would be reached as early as 2027 (or 2025 if the trend continues) is credible, given that the government's NMCA model projects 2030, and asked about rolling-stock investment, double-decker trains and peak-hour spreading. The State Secretary answered that NS's higher-growth model is a company planning tool, that the NMCA remains the government's basis, that NS sees no shortfall in rolling stock for ten years, and that she is working with partners on peak-spreading and minor infrastructure adjustments, with a promised NS letter on double-deckers.

I committed during the VAO of 18 April 2019 to send the Chamber, with the HSL-Zuid progress report (before 1 October), a letter from NS on applying the 'apply-or-explain' principle to double-decker investments.

Ik heb tijdens het Verslag Algemeen Overleg (VAO) van 18 april 2019 aan de Kamer toegezegd om bij de aanbieding van de Voortgangsrapportage HSL-Zuid (vóór 1 oktober) een brief van NS te sturen over toepassing van het «pas- toe-of-leg-uit-principe» bij investeringen in dubbeldekstreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Schonis over het artikel ‘CO2-uitstoot stijgt door populariteit van SUV’s’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report showing rising CO2 emissions per kilometre from larger vehicles such as SUVs in Europe, and about the Netherlands' role, EU fines, incentives and the Climate Agreement. The secretary acknowledged the trend, said Dutch average emissions are low due to fiscal policy on electric cars, and described existing and planned measures without committing to new action.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Gemeenten geven vervuilde compost gratis weg aan bewoners’

MPs Kröger and Gijs van Dijk asked whether municipalities gave away plastic-contaminated compost and whether compost rules are adequate. The State Secretary answered that the compost was certified Keurcompost meeting stricter-than-legal standards, that plastics cannot be fully filtered out, and that the government is pursuing a source-based action plan for garden waste rather than tightening rules.

That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat, the NVRD and the Vereniging Afvalbedrijven to implement the garden waste action plan to reduce the presence of foreign materials through a source-based approach.

Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat, de NVRD en de Vereniging Afvalbedrijven gevraagd uitvoering te geven aan het Aanvalsplan gft-afval om via een brongerichte aanpak onder andere de aanwezigheid van bodemvreemde materialen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Forse rookontwikkeling bij brand afvalverwerker Attero in Wijster'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a fire at waste processor Attero in Wijster, the amount and quality of collected waste, how long waste may be stored, whether processors can refuse waste, who is responsible for waste quality, and how the focus can shift from quantity to quality. The State Secretary answered with five-year tonnage tables, described the acceptance and processing policy framework and storage limits, and pointed to ongoing quality programmes and planned producer responsibility extensions.
I am working on this with stakeholders, within the VANG-HHA implementation programme through the 'action plan for green waste and textiles'.
Ik werk hier samen met stakeholders aan, binnen het Uitvoeringsprogramma VANG-HHA middels het «aanvalsplan gft-afval en textiel».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het Belgisch spoorbedrijf Nationale Maatschappij der Belgische Spoorwegen (NMBS) dat de concurrentie aangaat met de Drielandentrein

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Belgian rail operator NMBS is exploring a half-hourly service between Liège and Maastricht that could compete with the Dutch-operated Drielandentrein, and whether this undermines the 2016 intention agreement. The government answered that NMBS is only conducting an exploratory study, that it has pledged cooperation under the agreement, and that operators are working on ETCS installation and operating arrangements, with ministerial consultation with Belgium deferred until a new Belgian cabinet is in place.
Once a new Belgian cabinet has taken office, I will discuss the progress of the Drielandentrein with my Belgian colleague.
Zodra een nieuw Belgisch kabinet is aangetreden, zal ik met mijn Belgische collega de voortgang van de Drielandentrein bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over stank- en vliegenoverlast in Brunssum en Stein

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Ploumen asked the state secretary about odour and fly nuisance from plastic waste recyclers in Brunssum and Stein, and whether such firms may operate close to homes. The state secretary sympathised, explained that the province is the licensing authority and has started enforcement because the firm has not met preventive obligations, and said she is discussing an integrated sector approach with the industry.
The province is of the view that the provisions are not being sufficiently complied with by the company concerned and has therefore started an enforcement procedure.
De provincie is van mening dat deze bepalingen door het bedrijf in kwestie niet in voldoende mate worden nagekomen en heeft daarom een handhavingstraject in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over ‘Problemen in Amsterdam brengen afvalverwerking in heel Nederland in gevaar’

An MP asked the state secretary about the shutdown of four waste-incineration lines at AEB in Amsterdam and the resulting strain on national waste processing, including vulnerability, public ownership, circular economy and recycling options. The state secretary answered that the problem is mainly local, that the market is responsible for capacity allocation, that an import cap took effect, and that she will inform parliament in the autumn on making waste management more robust, while withholding some company financial information as confidential.
This is company information that is mostly confidential.
Dit is bedrijfsinformatie die veelal vertrouwelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Van der Molen over het niet handhaven van het verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

MPs De Pater-Postma and Van der Molen asked why a bus driver in Limburg was reprimanded and police and employer did not support him after enforcing the partial ban on face-covering clothing in public transport, and how enforcement would be made effective. The minister replied that enforcement under the law rests with police and the Public Prosecution Service, that transport staff only address passengers and escalate, that the driver and police acted per the law, and that police response times and a conduct guideline have been agreed.
In the incident on a bus in Stein, both the bus driver and the police officer acted in accordance with the law.
Bij het voorval in een bus in Stein hebben zowel de buschauffeur als de politiemedewerker conform de wet gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schonis over het bericht ‘Anonieme OV-chipkaart is niet anoniem, betoogt Michiel Jonker’

MPs Verhoeven and Schonis asked the State Secretary about claims that the anonymous OV-chipkaart is not really anonymous, and about what data NS and Translink store and share. The State Secretary answered that the data processing is lawful under the AVG, that anonymous card data is limited, that travellers are informed via privacy statements, and that a voordeeluren subscription is personal and cannot be placed on an anonymous card.
Translink has informed me that it cannot in any way trace the traveller's personal details, even when paying by card to top up the balance on the anonymous OV-chipkaart.
Translink heeft mij laten weten op geen enkele manier achter de NAW-gegevens van de reiziger te kunnen komen, ook niet als er gepind wordt om het saldo op de anonieme OV-chipkaart aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Risico voor NS met grote bestelling van treinmaterieel HSL'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS's large order of ICNG trains for the Amsterdam-Brussels line (IC Brussel) is premature and risks prejudging the HSL tender decision, and what happens to the trains if another operator wins. The State Secretary answered that the trains are covered by the Redelijke Regeling, so NS bears no investment risk, that the decision does not prejudge the 2020 market-ordering decision, and that options for the HSL will be assessed before a decision in spring 2020.
As previously shared with your House, NS is not anticipating the market-ordering decision that I will take next spring with the ordering of ICNG-B trains for the IC Brussel.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 3 loopt NS met de bestelling van ICNG-B-treinen voor de IC Brussel niet vooruit op het ordeningsbesluit dat ik volgend voorjaar neem.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether new PFAS rules for soil and dredged material would further delay road and housing projects, and how the government would address the concerns of municipalities and industry. The state secretary replied that the temporary framework adds clarity rather than new obligations, that the duty of care applies where PFAS is found, that she is consulting with regional authorities and will inform the House in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over dat er mogelijk meer versterkingen nodig zijn door onnauwkeurige metingen

An MP asked ministers whether inaccurate seismic measurements mean more Groningen homes need reinforcement, the timing of NAM risk calculations, interim support for residents, and clarity on KNMI and NAM roles. The government says the reinforcement is not halted or delayed, the SodM audit takes 12 to 18 months, the KNMI/NAM roles await an evaluation, and tenants' safety and compensation are covered through corporation agreements.
As promised in the letter of 10 July, we adopt this SodM advice.
Zoals in de brief van 10 juli jl. (Kamerstuk 2019Z14913 ) toegezegd nemen wij dit advies van SodM over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about lab capacity shortages for PFAS soil analyses that were reportedly stalling construction and dredging projects, and about storage, soil supply and cleaning options. The answers state that the lab delays were temporary and have shortened to one to two weeks, that no extra criteria apply to labs, that storage is primarily the market's responsibility with talks ongoing among competent authorities, and that the State Secretary will consult authorities on enabling soil cleaning.
I will therefore consult with the decentralised competent authorities to see what is needed to provide for such cleaning operations.
Ik zal daarom in overleg treden met de decentrale bevoegde gezagen om te bezien wat er nodig is om in dergelijke reinigingen te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat rubberkorrels op kunstgras wel degelijk een gezondheidsrisico’s voor kinderen kunnen zijn

MP Wassenberg asks whether researchers' criticism of RIVM and ECHA studies on rubber granulate in artificial turf, which they say shows possible health risks for children, is justified, and whether the government will advise parents and tighten PAH limits or ban the use. The minister replies that RIVM's assessment found a practically negligible risk, that the criticism was discussed in the expert group, that the government supports a stricter PAH limit via a REACH restriction dossier, and that it will subsidise measures to limit granulate spread but sees no reason for a ban.
RIVM states that the results of more recent scientific studies do not point in a different direction.
Het RIVM laat weten dat de resultaten van recentere wetenschappelijke onderzoeken niet in een andere richting wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het bericht dat er gevaarlijke stoffen zijn gelekt bij twee chemiebedrijven in Delfzijl

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reported leaks of hazardous substances at two chemical plants in Delfzijl, including whether residents should feel unsafe and for an overview of incidents and supervision. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen, via the Omgevingsdienst Groningen, is the competent authority, that no incidents in 2019 posed a danger to the surroundings, and that inspections found no violations except a warning to Lubrizol for late reporting.
Licensing, supervision and enforcement are carried out on behalf of the province by the Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving worden namens de provincie uitgevoerd door de Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de berichten 'Uitstoot vervuilend lachgas Chemelot jaren niet gemeld' en 'Lachgas: het stille klimaatprobleem van Limburg'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about reports that Chemelot's Anqore plant had emitted large amounts of nitrous oxide unmeasured and unreported for decades, and about oversight and accountability for that. The minister acknowledged the omission, said Limburg province is the competent authority responsible for monitoring, and said the emissions have been corrected in the registry and that a one-off financial incentive of €42 million is being provided to Fibrant to reduce nitrous oxide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked how much of the earlier co-financing budget for drug waste clean-up remained unspent, whether private owners should be compensated for clean-up costs, and what the government will do to provide structural funding. The government answered that EUR 1.2 million remained unspent and is available to provinces, that EUR 1 million per year is now structurally reserved for 2019-2024, and that responsibility for clean-up lies with regional and local authorities, with private owners to be compensated where they bear no fault.
The cabinet now makes available structurally another EUR 1 million per year for 2019 to 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het verhalen van de opruimkosten van gedumpt drugsafval

MP Stoffer asked the government about the Council of State ruling that municipalities cannot recover clean-up costs of dumped drug waste from landowners who did not commit a legal violation, and whether a national compensation scheme would follow. The state secretary answered that landowners will not pay unless they breached a legal duty, that a national scheme is not planned because responsibility lies with provinces and municipalities, and that the cabinet will provide €1 million per year from 2019 to 2024 to co-finance direct clean-up costs.
Given the responsibilities for preventing possible harm to public health and the environment, responsibility lies with regional and local governments.
Gelet op de verantwoordelijkheden in het voorkomen van mogelijke schade voor volksgezondheid en milieu, ligt hier de verantwoordelijkheid bij regionale en lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked whether innocent private landowners should not have to pay for clearing drug waste dumped on their land, following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences the government draws. The Staatssecretaris replied that regional and local authorities are primarily responsible, notes provincial subsidy schemes, and announces a structural 1 million euro per year from 2019 to 2024 so that private owners are fully compensated for direct clean-up costs and municipalities partly compensated.

The cabinet now makes available structurally another 1 million euro per year for 2019 through 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het artikel ‘Energie voor elektrische auto superduur, rijden toch het goedkoopst’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked whether electric car charging, though costlier per kWh than fuel, is cheaper per kilometre than diesel, and what the government will do about fiscal incentives for business drivers and charging prices. The state secretary answered that efficiency offsets the higher per-kWh price, rejected the claim that diesel is generally cheaper, and pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures such as lowering the energy tax on electricity and raising the diesel excise.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, ik deel die conclusie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst en Fritsma over de speciale asielbus in Ter Apel

PVV MPs asked why a special asylum shuttle bus from Ter Apel to Emmen is priced cheaper than regular public transport, who pays for tickets, who protects drivers and whether the government will remove disruptive asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the three-month pilot is priced close to regular line 73, that tickets are paid from the statutory leefgeld, that the operator handles security and no incidents were reported in the first five weeks, and that no total asylum stop is planned.
On the deployment of the various measures and the implementation of adopted motions in this regard, you will be informed in the separate letter on disruptive asylum seekers.
Over de inzet van de verschillende maatregelen en de uitvoering van aangenomen moties daaromtrent wordt u geïnformeerd in de separate brief over overlastgevende asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘Bonaire overspoeld met Sargassum zeewier’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the recurring sargassum seaweed influx on Bonaire, its ecological and economic damage, causes, responsibilities, clean-up means, and circular use. The minister answered that the Openbaar Lichaam (island authority) is responsible for prevention and clean-up, that the Rijk has financially supported some equipment, and that it is willing to consult the island government and STINAPA and to address sargassum in the upcoming nature policy plan.
The actions taken to bring the problem under control fall under the responsibility of the Openbaar Lichaam.
De acties die ondernomen worden om de problematiek onder controle te krijgen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de kritiek van de Algemene Rekenkamer op het plastic afvalbeleid van het kabinet

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to Court of Audit criticism that its plastic waste policy ignores the statutory waste hierarchy, lacks reduction targets, relies on soft instruments and overstates recycling rates. The State Secretary largely rejects the criticism, citing existing legal instruments, planned measures (SUP directive, new recycling norms, statiegeld as fallback) and noting the Dutch recycling figure is comparable under EU rules.
I will inform the House after the summer about the new recycling standards for packaging.
Ik informeer uw Kamer na de zomer over de nieuwe recyclenormen voor verpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Extra spitstrein op Maaslijn, Boxmeer verliest aansluiting’

An MP asked about the removal of an extra peak-hour train on the Maaslijn between Boxmeer and Nijmegen, which students and pupils use, and about ridership, delays and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that only about 11 people use the train daily, that the 8.00 train offers an alternative, that delays are a concern, and that electrification and improvement measures are planned to finish by 2024.
According to data from Limburg and Arriva, an average of 11 passengers use the extra peak train daily.
Volgens de gegevens van Limburg en Arriva maken dagelijks gemiddeld 11 reizigers gebruik van de extra spitstrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Markuszower over de aanpak van een Algerijn die bijna een Groningse held doodstak

PVV MPs Fritsma and Markuszower asked why an Algerian offender who nearly killed a Groningen victim was released rather than deported, and why the victim was given unclear information about the case. The State Secretary acknowledged a Dublin transfer deadline was missed during detention, leading to release after the sentence, and said the offender was later re-detained with a return decision issued, while refusing to rule out an asylum stop and declining to report more on the individual case citing privacy.
Mistakenly, a request for postponement was not made in time to the EU member state responsible, so the transfer could not proceed.
Abusievelijk is nagelaten om tijdig aan de verantwoordelijke EU-lidstaat om uitstel te vragen, waardoor de overdracht geen doorgang kon vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht 'Steeds meer biomassacentrales, goed of slecht voor het klimaat?'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether biomass power plants should be paused, given air quality and sustainability concerns, and when sustainability and cascading criteria will be set. The minister replied that the sustainability framework is expected in Q1 2020, that emission standards for smaller plants are under review, that the government will not intervene in specific projects, and that it sees no legal basis to refuse permits when all rules are met.
The cabinet is not involved in the development of specific projects and intervention is therefore not an option.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de totstandkoming van specifieke projecten en een interventie is dus niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins en Lodders over de doorrekeningen van de subsidie op elektrische auto’s

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins and Lodders asked why PBL's expert reviewers of the Klimaatakkoord analysis could not see the mobility and electricity background documents, why the Revnext calculations were not shared sooner, and how national costs per tonne of CO2 saved differ from the government-perspective costs used by the Algemene Rekenkamer. The state secretary answered that PBL published all background documents after the reviews, that the government will send Revnext calculations and later its own positioning analyses once the Klimaatakkoord is final, and that national costs for electric driving are roughly zero by 2030 while transfers like subsidies are excluded.
It is desirable that background documents become available as soon as possible.
Het is wenselijk dat achtergronddocumenten zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ontbrekende oplossing voor belastingvrijstelling asbestdaken bij tussenopslag

MP Stoffer asked whether the Finance Ministry refuses to guarantee that a wrongly exempted asbestos-roof waste load would be back-taxed to the party issuing the false declaration rather than the landfill operator, and whether this blocks the exemption and an affordable 2025 asbestos-roof ban. Staatssecretaris Snel answered that the statutory safeguards are sufficient, that liability depends on circumstances and that he is willing to consult the sector organisations about concerns raised.
Within this framework I am of course willing to enter into consultation with the relevant trade organisations about concerns they have raised regarding the application of the exemption.
Binnen dit kader ben ik uiteraard bereid om in overleg te treden met de betrokken brancheorganisaties over zorgen die zij hebben geuit over de toepassing van de vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de milieuschade van houtstook die vele malen hoger is dan de milieuschade door aardgas of stookolie

MP Wassenberg asked the government about a CE-Delft study showing wood heating causes far higher environmental damage than gas or oil, and asked whether pellet imports, pellet classification and ISDE subsidies for biomass should be ended. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the ISDE subsidy will be critically evaluated and emission rules tightened, but refused to ban North American pellets (WTO rules) or to label wood pellet heating generically as not climate-friendly.

Because of the effect on air quality, the draft Climate Agreement announced that the cabinet, as part of the evaluation of the ISDE, will critically examine whether further stimulation of small-scale biomass combustion is desirable.

Vanwege het effect op de luchtkwaliteit is in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord aangekondigd dat het kabinet als onderdeel van de evaluatie van de ISDE kritisch zal kijken naar de wenselijkheid van verdere stimulering van kleinschalige verbranding van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring 'blazers' (emission flares) at the ESD factory in Groningen, including carcinogenic particle emissions, public health risks, unclear public information, and what will be done to reduce blazers and stop illegal emissions. The government answered that the province of Groningen, as competent authority, is responsible for enforcement, that health risks from SiC fibres are still under investigation, that a dwangsom (penalty) was imposed for SiC emissions, and that communication was handled by the Veiligheidsregio and municipality.
In this case, the province of Groningen is responsible for enforcement as the competent authority.
In dit geval is de provincie Groningen als bevoegd gezag verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitfasering van fluorescentiebuizen

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked why the mercury exemption for fluorescent tubes under the RoHS directive has been extended beyond its five-year term, citing LED alternatives, mercury content, CO2 savings and WHO concerns. The State Secretary answered that the Commission has not yet decided on the extension requests, that a socio-economic study is nearly ready, and that the government supports a phase-out weighed against overall environmental effects and will keep pressing the Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Reactie Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels op de commotie rondom de risico’s van blootstelling aan asbest’

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked the ministers about an opinion piece from the Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels criticising asbestos policy, including whether the debate has shifted towards cost, whether asbestos is dangerous only with long exposure, and whether the ministers will meet the centre on the roof-asbestos ban and certification of removal firms. The minister answered that health risks remain central, that asbestos is carcinogenic and removal is required where it poses a risk, that officials will make contact with the centre, and that the government will report on implementation this autumn.
However, I also placed an important caveat on the cost calculations made in this report.
Ik heb echter ook een belangrijke kanttekening geplaatst bij de berekeningen van de kosten die in dit rapport gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over blazers van ESD

MPs asked about a RIVM advice on silicon carbide fibres and emissions from ESD-SIC near Farsum, and whether a risk limit for air will be set quickly. The state secretary confirmed SiC fibres should be treated as carcinogenic (ZZS), said the company and province must minimise emissions, and explained that RIVM found too little data for an air limit, so amphibole asbestos is used as a worst-case screening value, with a full standard depending on further information and a timeline not given.
RIVM indicated in its advice that there is currently too little data to derive an MTR for SiC fibres.
Het RIVM heeft in haar advies aangegeven dat er op dit moment te weinig gegevens zijn om een MTR voor SiC-vezels af te kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de vergroening van de auto’s van de overheid

An MP asked whether the government still stands by its 2016 commitment to green its official car fleet, given cases where replacement cars were petrol-powered and only 2% of the fleet is electric. The state secretary answered that the commitment stands, admitted the 2020 target of 20-25% electric will be hard to reach, and promised to push other ministers and a joint improvement programme.
Although I realise it will be difficult to reach the stated target still in 2020, I want to commit to it, especially now that the market for electric transport offers an increasingly better range.
Hoewel ik besef dat het lastig zal worden om het gestelde doel nog in 2020 te halen, wil ik me hiervoor inzetten, zeker nu de markt voor elektrisch vervoer een steeds beter aanbod kent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Rover wil langere treinen naar Noorden'

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary whether passenger numbers to the north are surging and whether more trains are needed, after reports of overcrowding. The State Secretary answered that growth is in line with the rest of the country, that NS keeps seats available in over 99% of Intercity trips, and listed measures such as longer trains during holidays and a seat-finder app.
I assess NS's performance on the basis of the agreements laid down in the concession for the main rail network 2015–2025.
Ik beoordeel de prestaties van NS op basis van de afspraken die zijn vastgelegd in de concessie voor het hoofrailnet 2015 – 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins Slot over het vervoer tijdens de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about transport capacity to Zandvoort for the Formula 1 Grand Prix, including visitor numbers, the mobility plan, and rail upgrades. The State Secretary answered that the organiser and municipality are responsible for the mobility plan, that the line can run about six trains per hour with extra measures, and that ProRail is studying the cost and timeline for further upgrades.
Ensuring a mobility plan and good accessibility for the event is the responsibility of the organiser in cooperation with the municipality of Zandvoort.
Het zorgdragen voor een mobiliteitsplan en een goede bereikbaarheid van het evenement is de verantwoordelijkheid van de organisatie in samenwerking met de gemeente Zandvoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Nieuwe’ geul klaar maar werkt nog niet’

MPs asked about the newly dredged Vloedgeul channel on the Holwerd-Ameland ferry route, which was finished but still showed delays, asking about expected travel-time gains, monitoring, further measures and a second cut-off. The minister answered that the expected saving is 4 to 6 minutes but cannot yet be verified, that weekly soundings and a planned measurement campaign will monitor the channel, that quarterly punctuality data will be provided and reviewed in the 2020 transport plan, and that a second bend cut-off and a long-term vision are in preparation.
The information requested by your House is not available in time for the General Consultation on the Wadden of 26 June 2019.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde informatie is niet tijdig beschikbaar voor het Algemeen Overleg Wadden van 26 juni 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Familie in rouw na drama in stal: dertien koeien komen om in eigen mest na explosie’

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the minister about a barn explosion in Markelo that killed thirteen cows, whether investigations were ordered, and whether emission-free floors and new stall systems are assessed for safety. The minister answered that no direct ignition cause was found by the fire service and insurer, that an Omgevingsdienst Twente investigation is pending and will be shared, and that safety is part of stall assessment though no evidence shows emission-free floors are unsafe.
The investigation by the Omgevingsdienst Twente is expected to become publicly available. I will send this to you as soon as it is completed.
Het onderzoek van de Omgevingsdienst Twente zal naar verwachting openbaar beschikbaar komen. Dit zal ik u toezenden zodra dit gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ziengs over de communicatie door het RIVM omtrent het onderzoeksrapport gewasbescherming en gezondheid

Two MPs asked why the RIVM's report on pesticide exposure among residents was leaked to media and published prematurely, and how the RIVM communicates with other government bodies. The minister regretted the early publications, said the RIVM was addressed on both incidents, and declined to direct the RIVM's communication, saying it has its own legal independence.
I may not direct them in that regard and I do not want to either.
Ik mag daar niet op sturen en wil dat ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten van stimulering van fossiele brandstoffen

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the cost of fossil fuel subsidies, aviation fuel and car tax exemptions, carbon pricing and related environmental damage (34 questions). The government answered that it favours pricing polluting activities, acknowledged existing exemptions bound by international treaties, and promised a study into definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies, but did not provide several requested figures.
To nevertheless implement the motion as well as possible, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate will commission a study into the various definitions of environmentally harmful subsidies.

Om toch zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de motie zal de Minister van Economische zaken en klimaat een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de uiteenlopende definities van milieuschadelijke subsidies
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het Amsterdamse parkeervergunningenbeleid

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked why Amsterdam's parking permit policy excludes older vehicles such as classic cars, whether an emissions-class (RDW) system would be fairer, whether municipalities may regulate this, which Amsterdam streets still exceed the air quality norm, and what legal change would be needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set parking policy within the Gemeentewet, that Amsterdam chose registration-date cut-offs pending RDW emissions-class registration, that municipal autonomy permits such rules, that NO2 exceedances remained on several named streets in 2017, and that changing the Wegenverkeerswet was not appropriate.
Municipalities determine their parking permit policy within the framework of the Municipalities Act.
Gemeenten bepalen binnen de kaders van de Gemeentewet hun beleid ten aanzien van parkeervergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de mogelijke inzet van niet-duurzame biobrandstoffen zoals palmolie binnen het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord

An MP asked how the draft Climate Agreement ensures that palm and soy biofuels are not used in the Netherlands, whether RED II sustainability criteria apply to all transport biofuel use, and how deforestation is prevented. The state secretary answered that the current practice of not using such biofuels will continue, that existing rules apply until 2020, that all transport biofuels must meet RED II criteria, and that post-2020 additional food-crop biofuels will be capped at 2020 levels.
The draft Climate Agreement stipulates that the current practice of not using biofuels produced from palm and soy oil in the Netherlands will be continued.
In het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord is afgesproken dat de huidige praktijk waarbij geen inzet plaatsvindt van biobrandstoffen geproduceerd uit palm- en sojaolie in Nederland, wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Ziengs en Arno Rutte over automatische externe defibrillators (AED’s) in treinen en op stations

MPs De Lange, Ziengs and Rutte asked whether AEDs should be installed in trains and at all stations, whether theft or vandalism justifies not placing them, and whether tender conditions could require them. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail are talking with the Hartstichting about 24/7 access at the 50 largest stations, that operators decide their own first-aid mix, and that a rail concession provision on AEDs in trains is under consideration.
I will have NS inform me about the considerations it makes for providing first aid on moving trains.
Ik zal mij door NS laten informeren over de afwegingen die zij maken voor het verlenen van eerste hulp op de rijdende treinen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Aalst over de asielbus tussen Ter Apel en Emmen

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a pilot shuttle bus between Ter Apel and Emmen rewards asylum seekers who intimidate bus staff, and whether a shuttle to Marrakech should replace it. The State Secretary answered that nuisance is unacceptable and the bus is a temporary pilot within a broader Top-X approach to the most serious nuisance offenders, and refused the Marrakech proposal.
Regarding the arrangement of the transport, further agreements will be made in the short term with carriers and other stakeholders.
Over de invulling van het vervoer worden op korte termijn nadere afspraken gemaakt met vervoerders en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een nieuw onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat het gebruik van landbouwgif kan leiden tot de ontwikkeling van ALS

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a US study linking pesticide-related pollutants to faster ALS progression, and about the precautionary principle, the Gezondheidsraad advice, the RIVM exposure study and a promised meeting with a residents' group. The minister answers that the substances studied are EU-banned POPs, that the EU pesticide regulation allows intervention on new scientific insight, that monitoring found no exceeded limits, and that further research and meetings are planned.
Regulation (EC) 1107/2009 is based on the precautionary principle and provides the possibility to intervene where necessary on the basis of new scientific insights.
Verordening (EG) 1107/2009 gaat uit van het voorzorgsbeginsel en biedt de mogelijkheid om waar nodig in te grijpen op basis van nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport ‘Mogelijkheden stopzetten studentenreisproduct’ (2017) en het niet automatisch stopzetten van de OV-studentenkaart

An MP asked the education minister why the student OV travel product was not stopped automatically via account based ticketing despite a 2017 report, and why operators earlier claimed this was technically impossible. The minister answered that ABT was rejected mainly because at the time it was technically impossible to stop all student products that way, that blacklist capacity was expanded and new communication measures introduced, and gave boete totals for 2017 and 2018.
The main reason for not choosing ABT as the solution for stopping the student travel product was that at that time it was technically not possible to stop all student travel products via ABT.

De belangrijkste reden om niet voor ABT te kiezen als oplossingsrichting voor het stopzetten van het studentenreisproduct was dat het op dat moment technisch niet mogelijk was om via ABT alle studentenreisproducten stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de rapportage gezamenlijk meetnet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in het gebied van het Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta

Two VVD MPs asked the government about pesticide exceedances at Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta, including permethrin and imidacloprid in consumer products, and about the overall pesticide policy approach. The minister answered that consumer use is hard to link directly to exceedances, that policy addresses both professional and non-professional use, and that the government will send further data such as the RIVM sales analysis before the summer recess.
Sales figures for biocide products for consumers are not available at the Ministry of IenW.
De verkoopcijfers van biocideproducten voor consumenten zijn niet voorhanden bij het Ministerie van IenW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over mogelijke geluidsoverlast van een transformatorstation van TenneT

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers whether a TenneT transformer station in the IJmond industrial area could cause noise nuisance in Wijk aan Zee and whether a fully enclosed box should be required. The minister acknowledged concerns, stated the noise contribution is under 2 percent of cumulative noise, and said TenneT will take extra noise-reducing measures including enclosing the transformers with walls and a roof, while the compensation coils remain open at the top.
In these talks the commitment was made to noise-reducing measures, including placing the transformers in a "box".
In deze gesprekken is de toezegging gedaan tot geluidreducerende maatregelen, waaronder het plaatsen van de transformatoren in een «box».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Omtzigt over het verkopen van bespaarde CO2-rechten door autofabrikant Tesla aan Fiat-Chrysler

MPs Lodders, Ziengs and Omtzigt asked whether the EU-permitted pooling of CO2 emission credits between Tesla and Fiat-Chrysler, which may help Fiat-Chrysler avoid EU fines, is acceptable and whether it will persist under the 95 g/km rules, and how much the national EV stimulus would actually reduce EU-wide emissions given possible waterbed effects. The State Secretary answered that pooling has been allowed since 2007, that the pool average must still meet the EU norm, that the government prefers each manufacturer to meet the norm alone, and that the national EV measures yield about 2.4 Mton additional reduction, with the waterbed effect considered small given Netherlands' roughly 3% share of the EU fleet.
The cabinet is not aware of the exact amount involved between certain manufacturers in this arrangement.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van het exacte bedrag dat tussen bepaalde fabrikanten hiermee is gemoeid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het Revnext-model voor de stimulering van elektrische auto's, de merkwaardige aanbesteding, de uitkomsten van dit model en het feit dat TNO de staatssecretaris weer

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked about the Revnext CARbonTAX model used to project electric car uptake, its scientific validation, the non-competitive award of contracts, and TNO's disagreement with the government. The state secretary answered that the PBL tested the model as suitable, that Revnext holds unclear intellectual property rights, that the 2018 contract was awarded via a single-tender procedure because no other model was available, and that the government will consider options for greater transparency.
The cabinet is currently discussing all options to realise this as soon as possible.
Het kabinet bespreekt op dit moment concreet alle opties dit zo spoedig mogelijk te realiseren.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het Revnext-model voor de stimulering van elektrische auto's, de merkwaardige aanbesteding, de uitkomsten van dit model en het feit dat TNO de staatssecretari

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked the state secretaries about the Revnext CARbonTAX model used to project electric car uptake, its validation, the procurement of the model, and TNO's contrary findings, including 37 questions. The state secretary's follow-up answer defers to confidential inspection of procurement documents and addresses the questions in part, without fully resolving the validation and procurement concerns raised.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten ’Deze omstreden afvalberg mag van de provincie blijven liggen. Bewoners maken zich zorgen' en 'Gedeputeerde Tekin geeft verkeerde informatie over af

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the oxykalkslik waste heap at Tata Steel, why it was allowed to remain, the health and environmental risks, and why enforcement lapsed after 2010. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, that monitoring showed no groundwater risks, that the matter was handled through the province, and that a letter to parliament on enforcement at Tata Steel would follow in May.
The competent authority lies with the province of Noord-Holland.
Het bevoegd gezag ligt bij de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over houtstook als grootste bron van kankerverwekkende stoffen (PAK’s) in het oppervlaktewater

MP Akerboom asked whether the government will act on Deltares findings that domestic wood burning is the largest source of carcinogenic PAHs in surface water, and how this squares with ISDE and SDE+ subsidies for biomass. The Secretary of State says she supports reducing wood-burning emissions and lists measures (stove alert, emission measurement, information material, earlier Ecodesign limits), while defending SDE+ biomass support and promising an ISDE evaluation.
Based on this evaluation, a decision will be made on whether it is desirable to continue the subsidy for renewable heat based on biomass after the current scheme ends (2020).
Op basis van deze evaluatie zal de afweging worden gemaakt of het wenselijk is om de subsidie voor hernieuwbare warmte op basis van biomassa na afloop van de huidige regeling (2020) voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Sportclubs moeten verduurzaming aantonen’

MPs of the VVD asked the ministers about a requirement that large sports clubs report energy-saving measures by 1 July 2019, with possible fines, and whether clubs run by volunteers should be exempted to avoid higher membership fees. The minister confirmed the reporting duty and its enforcement by municipalities, pointed to support from sports federations and De Groene Club, and said municipalities decide on fines and usually give time to comply.
Sports clubs with questions about the reporting duty can turn to their own sports federation or to De Groene Club.
Sportverenigingen met vragen over de informatieplicht kunnen terecht bij de eigen sportbond of bij De Groene Club.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over de grafietregen bij Wijk aan Zee

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked the state secretary and ministers about graphite dust nuisance from Tata Steel and Harsco near Wijk aan Zee, the status of the criminal investigation, and what could be done to end the nuisance. The government answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority with enforcement instruments, that Harsco was ordered under a penalty to stop the emissions, that it will not comment on ongoing criminal investigations, and that it will send a letter to parliament around May.
As you know, the cabinet does not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Zoals u bekend is doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over opnieuw geen treinen vanwege storing Maaslijn

An MP asks the state secretary about recurring train disruptions on the Maaslijn, overcrowding, staff safety concerns, financial shortfalls for electrification and doubling, and passenger compensation. The secretary acknowledges unreliable service, says the Rijk will take over project leadership from Limburg, and commits to letters and joint measures with the province and operator, while deferring compensation to the concession grantor.
The Maaslijn project has been subject to various changes that led to delays and additional costs of approximately €55 million.
Het project Maaslijn heeft te maken gehad met diverse wijzigingen binnen het project, die hebben geleid tot vertraging en meerkosten van circa € 55 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport 'Circulaire economie in kaart' van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the PBL report on the circular economy, including whether policy should shift toward higher R-strategies, design for repair, support for repair businesses and Repair Cafés. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, pointed to the Uitvoeringsprogramma circulaire economie, the CIRCO programme, the Versnellingshuis and the RepairMonitor, but gave mostly general commitments without new concrete measures.
By summer 2020, an update of this implementation programme will be sent to the House, incorporating new insights from the forthcoming PBL progress report.

Voor de zomer van 2020 zal er, ook naar aanleiding van de in de tussentijd te verschijnen voortgangsrapportage van PBL, een actualisering van dit Uitvoeringsprogramma aan de Kamer worden aangeboden waarin nieuwe inzichten meegenomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het vervangen van asbestdaken voor zonnepanelen

PvdA MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether projects like Essent's 'Dakvrienden', where an energy company funds asbestos roof removal in exchange for solar panels, should be encouraged and extended to farms and private homeowners. Minister Wiebes replied that the government supports combining asbestos removal with sustainability, will examine whether support is needed, and that such private-homeowner models are for energy companies to consider, noting solar is not profitable on every roof.
Initiatives that combine the removal of asbestos roofs with sustainability are shared as good examples within the programmatic approach, and it is being examined whether support is needed.

Initiatieven die het saneren van asbestdaken combineren met verduurzaming worden in het kader van de programmatische aanpak gedeeld als goed voorbeeld en er wordt onderzocht of ondersteuning nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over treinstop Thialf bij schaatswedstrijden

An MP asked why Heerenveen station does not stop for skating events at Thialf, whether bus links for people with disabilities are adequate, and whether the minister will convene a meeting with NS, ProRail, the municipality and the province. The minister replied that transport to Thialf is the province's responsibility, that NS dropped the event stop in 2015 for commercial reasons, and that NS is willing to join a possible meeting convened by regional authorities.
Ensuring accessibility of Thialf during skating events is the responsibility of the province of Fryslân and the municipality of Heerenveen.
Het zorgdragen voor de bereikbaarheid van Thialf tijdens schaatswedstrijden is de verantwoordelijkheid van provincie Fryslân en de gemeente Heerenveen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over de afwijkende metingen bij de versnellingsmeters van KNMI

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked why the KNMI kept quiet for months about deviating accelerometer readings in Groningen, what the errors mean for the HRA model, damage assessment and public trust, and whether the measurement network will be expanded. The ministers say the errors were reported late, that KNMI's hazard maps are not affected, that an evaluation, a working group and an audit are underway, and that they cannot answer by 5 March.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de belastingsubsidies op elektrische auto’s, de modellen die aangepast lijken te zijn (en geen rekening meer houden met de CO2-uitstoot die gepaard gaat met he

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked about tax subsidies for electric cars, the CARbonTAX model used for forecasts, its validation and emissions accounting, and cost-effectiveness compared with other CO2 measures and foreign countries. The State Secretary answered at length, defending the model and tank-to-wheel accounting while conceding that fiscal stimulation of electric cars is relatively costly per tonne of CO2 avoided, and offered a technical briefing on the model without providing validation evidence.
The model is the intellectual property of research bureau Revnext. The model is not 'secret' but it is not up to the central government to make this model public.
Het model is intellectueel eigendom van onderzoeksbureau Revnext. Het model is niet «geheim» maar het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om dit model openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het bericht ‘Reactie PBL op gebruik NEV-cijfers en modellen’

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether ministries and the PBL can inspect and run the private Carbontax model, whether it has been externally validated, and what the government has spent on it. The government answered that ministries and PBL have only general knowledge of the model, that it is owned by Revnext and cannot be made public, that it is the only suitable model for the analysis, and it offered a technical briefing while listing the commissioned studies and costs.
The CARbontax model is not owned by the state but is intellectual property of Revnext, therefore it is not for the state to make it public.
Het CARbontax-model is geen eigendom van het Rijk maar is intellectueel eigendom van Revnext, daarom is het niet aan het Rijk om het openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de manier waarop het KNMI in 2016 de temperatuurmetingen van voor september 1951 corrigeerde

An MP asked the State Secretary whether KNMI's 2016 homogenisation of pre-1951 temperature records, which lowered some warm-day temperatures and reduced recorded heatwaves, was an incorrect representation and whether it was done deliberately to support climate policy, and demanded dismissals and reversal of the correction. The State Secretary answered that homogenisation is standard, methodologically sound, transparent and peer-reviewed, that the trend findings are consistent across five stations, that no dismissals or data corrections are warranted, and that both original and adjusted series are published.
There is no reason for dismissals or for correcting the research data.
Er is geen aanleiding tot ontslagen of tot het corrigeren van de onderzoeksdata.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over Uber

The SP MPs asked the government about a series of accidents involving Uber drivers, driver age and insurance, and whether Uber's safety measures and competition rules are adequate. The state secretary answered that police investigations are ongoing, that SWOV research on taxi accidents was commissioned, that Uber's measures are a good first step, and that existing rules apply equally to all taxi operators.
The police are currently investigating the various accidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes of that.
De politie onderzoekt momenteel de verschillende ongevallen. Op de uitkomsten daarvan kunnen wij niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Heerhugowaard blij verrast met opstelterrein’

An MP asked the state secretary why the rail siding was moved from Uitgeest to Heerhugowaard, whether a ministerial decision and additional traffic research were involved, and about level-crossing closure times and safety under the PHS programme. The secretary explained that a cost-driven variant study led to dropping Uitgeest, that the crossing-safety impact was reassessed and found not significant, and committed to further traffic research for three municipalities and to resolving the Castricum crossing.
At the request of three municipalities, additional traffic research is now being carried out for the local connecting roads.
Op verzoek van drie gemeenten vindt nu aanvullend verkeersonderzoek plaats voor de lokale aansluitende wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de voortgang van de reactivering van de spoorlijn Veendam-Stadskanaal

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about progress on reactivating the Veendam-Stadskanaal rail line, including talks with the province, ProRail's plan and the buyout of maintenance costs. The state secretary replied that talks with Groningen took place, that ProRail is preparing cost estimates and a plan of action, and that the Chamber will be informed as soon as possible.
I will inform your Chamber about this as soon as possible.
Ik zal uw Kamer daarover zo snel mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over minimumleeftijd voor taxichauffeurs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether taxi drivers under 23 with little driving experience cause more accidents and whether a minimum age of 23 should be introduced. The government answered that no research yet shows this specifically, that SWOV is analysing taxi accidents, and that it sees no reason to change the minimum age for the professional exam for now.
But following the recent accidents, I have asked the SWOV to further analyse the number of accidents involving taxis.

Maar naar aanleiding van de ongevallen die recent hebben plaats gevonden, heb ik de Stichting Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek Verkeersveiligheid (SWOV) gevraagd om het aantal ongevallen met taxi's nader te analyseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Locomotief ontspoord op Sloelijn bij Nieuwdorp’

MP Schonis (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether a locomotive derailment on the Sloelijn near Nieuwdorp could have been prevented given earlier incidents on the same line, and whether the incidents will be evaluated together and whether measures are needed. The State Secretary answered that each incident is investigated individually, that ProRail's preliminary view points to a human factor differing from the December 2018 incident, that the track was found in good condition after December 2018, that results are expected in spring, and that no structural cause is currently apparent.
Each incident is investigated individually. The outcomes of these investigations will be compared with each other and with other incident investigations.
Ieder incident wordt individueel onderzocht. De uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zullen met elkaar en met andere incidentenonderzoeken worden vergeleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht dat de metingen in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management how KNMI measurement errors in Groningen went unreported from August 2018 until February 2019, and what will prevent recurrence. The government answered that the KNMI delayed reporting, announced an evaluation, a working group, and an additional SodM audit, while stating the hazard models and damage decisions are not affected.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over landelijk meldpunt en onderzoek naar giftig chroom-6

An MP asked whether chromium-6 is used in more sectors than known, whether a national reporting point and investigation should be set up, and whether a claims assessment body should be created for victims. The government said the Inspectorate SZW works risk-based and will inventory known risky uses, that complaints can go to the Inspectorate and a central reporting point is under discussion with social partners, and that a commission will be set up to facilitate future compensation for occupational diseases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over meer treinen naar Deventer, minder naar Amsterdam

An MP asked the state secretary about a new timetable that adds trains between Harderwijk and Amersfoort but removes the Utrecht connection for northern travellers to The Hague, and whether a third track near Harderwijk could help. The state secretary answered that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that the Hanzelijn is the preferred alternative for most northern travellers, and that a third track would not undo the lost connection, with further insight to come in a later phase of the Toekomstbeeld OV.
The drafting of the timetable is up to NS.
De totstandkoming van de dienstregeling is aan de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over schimmige handel in Uber-accounts

An MP asked the state secretary about the trade in Uber driver accounts exposed by a TV report, including the risk to passengers, whether the ILT inspectorate would act and expand capacity, and whether Amsterdam's wish for stricter rules on on-call taxis would be granted.
