The secretary said Uber bears primary responsibility, the ILT is already requesting data and focusing on Amsterdam within its risk-based capacity, Uber has added a driver-app break lock and is considering face verification, and a joint analysis with Amsterdam is underway.
Following the report, the ILT has demanded data from Uber that allows it to establish which accounts are being misused and whether legal norms are being breached.
Naar aanleiding van de reportage heeft de ILT bij Uber de gegevens gevorderd op grond waarvan vastgesteld kan worden welke accounts misbruikt worden en of daarmee wettelijke normen worden geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over het bericht 'Demonstranten in Harlingen willen sluiting afvaloven'

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked about frequent malfunctions at the Harlingen waste incinerator (REC), whether these threaten health and the environment, and whether monitoring, emission norms, or the permit should be tightened. The state secretary answered that emission rules and the 60-hour annual malfunction limit apply, that the province of Fryslân enforces the permit, and that new BAT conclusions and a RWS-Infomil study on malfunction management are forthcoming, but declined to pursue permit revocation.
I am having RWS-Infomil examine whether, when the final BAT conclusions are implemented, the obligation to draw up a malfunction management plan is feasible and desirable as a general rule.

Ik laat door RWS-Infomil onderzoeken of bij implementatie van de definitieve BBT-conclusies de verplichting om een management plan voor storingen op te stellen in algemene regels haalbaar en wenselijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Kringloopeconomie komt nog niet van de grond’

MP Ziengs asked whether the minister knew of a PBL report saying the circular economy is not taking off, whether PBL commissioned it, and whether PBL could share its top 25 most restrictive regulations. The state secretary answered that PBL started the study on its own initiative, but said PBL cannot provide a top 25 of regulations, pointed to existing programmes and a taskforce reporting later in 2019, and promised a response to the taskforce report before year end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Ministerie wil gevaarlijke stoffen over Twents spoor legaliseren’

An MP asks whether risk ceilings for hazardous goods on Dutch rail were exceeded and whether the government plans to relax the risk norms to legalise these exceedances. The state secretary confirms exceedances on some diversion routes, refers to annual reports and a separate letter for detailed figures and enforcement, and denies that the safety norm (1 in a million per year) will be relaxed.

No, the safety norm remains the same: this means no housing in places where the risk of death from an accident with a freight train carrying hazardous substances is greater than 1 in a million per year.

Nee, de veiligheidsnorm blijft gelijk: dit betekent geen woningen op plaatsen waar het risico op overlijden als gevolg van een ongeluk met een goederentrein met gevaarlijke stoffen groter is dan 1 op een miljoen per jaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Schonis over het bericht dat de risicoplafonds voor vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen per spoor wordt verruimd

MPs Amhaouch and Schonis asked the State Secretary about reports that risk ceilings for rail transport of hazardous substances would be loosened, how this fits with legal norms, and the effects on residents along the Twente line. The State Secretary largely referred to a separate letter on the ceiling exceedances and gave substantive answers on Dutch-EU alignment, the legal basis for adjusting ceilings, quick-scan follow-up, noise and pilot timelines.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter 'Explanation of exceedances of risk ceilings on the railways and my approach', which is being sent to your House parallel to these answers.

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief «Toelichting op overschrijdingen risicoplafonds op het spoor en mijn aanpak» die parallel aan de beantwoording van deze vragen aan uw Kamer is aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Te veel gevaarlijke stoffen per trein langs Amersfoort’

MP Ziengs (VVD) asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about exceedances of risk ceilings for hazardous-goods trains near Amersfoort, including how the limits were set, enforcement, whether diversions via the Betuweroute works will last until 2023, and consultation with provinces and municipalities. The State Secretary answers largely by referring to a separate letter, says the Betuweroute third-track works and German permitting cause the diversions, that decisions on specific routes are premature, and that decentralised governments are involved through a risk platform and administrative consultation.
For the answers to the above questions, see my letter 'Explanation of exceedances of risk ceilings on the railways and my approach', which has been sent to your House in parallel with these answers.

Zie voor de beantwoording van bovengenoemde vragen mijn brief «Toelichting op overschrijdingen risicoplafonds op het spoor en mijn aanpak» die parallel aan de beantwoording van deze vragen aan uw Kamer is aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Von Martels over de bestrijding van de Japanse duizendknoop

CDA MPs asked about the spread of Asian knotweed, its damage costs, EU and national listing as an invasive species, and support for a national protocol. The minister said damage costs are not tracked, control is difficult with no single effective method, she supports a protocol and will approach parties, but declined EU listing and national designation under article 3.19 of the Nature Conservation Act.
No data are kept by the managers on the damage caused by Asian knotweed and the associated costs for residents, businesses and governments.
Er worden door de beheerders geen gegevens bijgehouden over de schade door Aziatische duizendknopen en daarmee gepaard gaande kosten voor inwoners, bedrijven en overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Brand bij kerncentrale Lingen: brand geblust, geen gewonden'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a fire at a fuel fabrication plant about 1 km from the Lingen/Emsland nuclear plant in Germany, and whether Dutch authorities were informed promptly. The government answered that no radiation escaped, no Dutch notification duty arose under the bilateral arrangements, the incident is being evaluated, and the topic will be discussed in the Dutch-German commission.

Because the fire was handled operationally in line with procedures and there was at no point a risk to the Dutch population, there was no obligation for the German authorities to immediately inform the Dutch authorities.

Omdat de brand operationeel is afgehandeld conform de procedures en er (mede door de heersende Westenwind) op geen enkel moment een risico voor de Nederlandse bevolking is geweest, was er voor de Duitse autoriteiten geen verplichting tot het terstond informeren van de Nederlandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Omtzigt over de brand bij een Duitse kerncentrale vlakbij de Nederlandse grens

MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government and safety regions were not informed about a fire at a nuclear fuel plant in Lingen, Germany, and how the incident was classified and would be evaluated. The state secretary answered that the fire was not at the Emsland plant, no radioactive release occurred, it was provisionally classed INES-0, and the Veiligheidsregio Twente will evaluate it and share the findings with parliament.
The Veiligheidsregio Twente has indicated that it will evaluate this incident and involve the ANVS, the DCC IenW and the NCC (JenV).
De Veiligheidsregio Twente heeft aangegeven dit incident te gaan evalueren en daarbij de ANVS, het DCC IenW en het NCC (JenV) te zullen betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over grensoverschrijdende oefening in verband met een kernongeval

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether cross-border exercises with Germany were needed after a fire at a fuel fabrication plant near the Emsland nuclear plant, whether information to residents was adequate, and whether border crisis plans address cross-border issues. The state secretary answered that the fire posed no risk to the nuclear plant or the Dutch population, that cross-border exercises take place regularly with a major GEDEX exercise planned for 2020, and that the crisis plan is being updated with cross-border liaisons.
Both good information provision and cross-border exercises by emergency services and other involved bodies are of great importance.
Zowel goede informatievoorziening als ook grensoverschrijdende oefening van hulpdiensten en andere betrokken instanties is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over luchtvervuiling en overlast door Tata Steel

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about dust and air pollution from Tata Steel and Harsco, including whether the province granted permits after the fact and whether oversight and enforcement are adequate. The state secretary said oversight of provincial permitting falls to provincial states, that the ILT plays an advisory role, that the province is responsible for enforcement, and that the RIVM will study health effects.
Oversight of the province's permit granting runs through the provincial states.
Controle op de vergunningverlening door de provincie verloopt via de provinciale staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the state secretary about financial and operational problems on the Maaslijn rail line, including provincial disputes, responsibilities for funding and rolling stock, and the impact on students. The state secretary said responsibility for the project and concession lies mainly with the three provinces, that the Rijk's contributions are fixed, and that she is monitoring the situation and in talks with the provinces, without committing to a formal mediating role.
Responsibility for implementing the project and the agreed measures lies with the three provinces, with the province of Limburg as the first point of contact.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het project en de afgesproken maatregelen ligt bij de drie provincies, waarbij de provincie Limburg het eerste aanspreekpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de aankoop van grond langs het spoor door ProRail

MP Van Aalst asks why the ministry advised negatively on ProRail's purchase of rail-side land later sold to RailSide, whether this was a miscalculation, whether an investigation will be held, and whether remaining land is inventoried. The State Secretary replies that the 2011 refusal was based on rijksvastgoedbeleid, that the later-sold land was reserved by NS rather than bought, that the relevant information was provided to the House, and that a full inventory is not practical, but ProRail and NS will agree to share land-sale lists.
On behalf of the Minister of Finance as well, I have asked NS and ProRail to provide me with all relevant information, which I have sent you as an annex to my letter.
Ik heb mede namens de Minister van Financiën NS en ProRail gevraagd mij alle relevante informatie te verstrekken die ik u heb doen toekomen als bijlage bij mijn brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘De oplossing: én-en!’

An MP asked the state secretary why introducing E10 petrol in the Netherlands is taking so long, its CO2 benefits, prices, foreign experience, and which cars can use it. The state secretary said introduction is planned for 1 October 2019 pending procedural steps, that E10 is about 2 cents cheaper, and that about 1 million older cars are unsuitable.
I want the introduction of E10 to take place as quickly as possible and for motorists to be properly informed.
Ik wil dat de introductie van E10 nu zo snel mogelijk plaatsvindt en dat de automobilist op de juiste manier wordt geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het gemeentelijk beleid ten aanzien van de circulaire economie

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked the ministers about a StartCirculair/SUBtracers study finding many municipalities state circular economy ambitions without concrete implementation, and about knowledge gaps, support measures, regulatory obstacles and procurement progress. The government answered that it has noted the study, supports municipalities through workshops, networks, procurement programmes, the Versnellingshuis and the Omgevingswet, is reviewing regulatory obstacles via a taskforce, and will report on procurement progress in the first half of 2019.

Regarding the first two recommendations, which call for raising awareness, creating knowledge and facilitating networks of entrepreneurs and organisations, the cabinet supports municipalities, provinces and water boards by organising a series of workshops

Ten aanzien van de eerste twee aanbevelingen, die oproepen om bewustzijn te vergroten, kennis te creëren en netwerken van ondernemers en organisaties te faciliteren ondersteunt het kabinet gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen door middel van het organiseren van een reeks workshops
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de besluiten en het proces rondom de rol van biomassa en de duurzaamheidscriteria binnen het Klimaatakkoord

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister how biomass policy and sustainability criteria are being shaped within the Climate Agreement, who decides, and how biomass is prioritised and how much it will be used. The minister answered that the Visie Biomassa 2030 was translated into the draft Climate Agreement, that an independent sustainability framework will first be drafted technically and then advised on by the SER, that the cabinet decides after consulting stakeholders, and that PBL estimates additional biomass demand of 340–570 PJ by 2030, while the timing of some answers could not be met.
The cabinet decides on the sustainability criteria for biomass.
Het kabinet beslist over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over regels en procedures die mogelijk onderzoek van gentherapie hinderen

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked whether outdated EU and Dutch environmental-risk rules (GGO directives, implemented in the Besluit GGO 2013) hinder gene therapy research, and whether the Netherlands interprets EU rules more strictly than Belgium. The minister explained the permit procedure, denied stricter interpretation, defended the environmental risk framework as necessary, and said the government pushed the Commission for harmonisation and reduced burdens, though the Commission ruled out amending the GGO directives.
The Netherlands does not apply a stricter interpretation of the EU regulations.
Nederland hanteert geen striktere interpretatie van de EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland investeringen in gentherapie misloopt

MPs Dijkstra and Van Eijs asked whether the Netherlands applies an extra environmental procedure and stricter interpretation to gene therapy, whether Dutch patients treated abroad need an import permit, and whether Dutch procedures are slower and could be streamlined. The minister replied that gene therapy falls under the GMO environmental release directive as in other states, that no import permit is needed, that procedural differences stem from EU rules, and that two rounds of streamlining already removed national bottlenecks, with an evaluation due in 2019.
The Netherlands has no extra environmental procedure for gene therapy and likewise does not choose to interpret the European rules for gene therapy more strictly than other member states.
Nederland kent voor gentherapie geen extra milieuprocedure en maakt evenmin voor gentherapie de keuze om Europese regels voor gentherapie strenger te interpreteren dan andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Uber opnieuw in opspraak: 'Het is wachten op de volgende dode''

An MP asks the state secretary about a fatal accident involving an Uber driver, whether Uber should be held responsible for driver rest times, whether ILT enforcement will be increased, and whether municipalities can limit taxi numbers. The government says the criminal investigation is ongoing, Uber has introduced a 10-hour offline rule and age/experience measures, ILT will run a taxi oversight programme in 2019, and it will study municipal volume-control options with municipalities.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the criminal investigation into the accident.
Op de uitkomsten van het strafrechtelijke onderzoek naar het ongeluk kan ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over de kosten van stimulering van elektrische auto’s en de totaal onderschatte vooruitgang in batterij technologie

MPs Omtzigt and Agnes Mulder ask whether EV tax subsidies (company car supplement, BPM, MRB, MIA) are cost-effective, how much they cost over five years, and how battery price assumptions in the CarbonTax model compare with forecasts. The government answers in detail, defending EV incentives as necessary for the transition, admitting past forecasting errors, and giving battery price figures while promising monitoring and an evaluation in 2023.
The cabinet is currently awaiting the costing of these proposals.
Het kabinet is op dit moment in afwachting van de doorrekening van deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Von Martels over zorgvervoer en privacyregels

MPs Slootweg and Von Martels asked whether online booking of patient transport is becoming more common, whether strict GDPR privacy rules force two-factor login that burdens users, and whether booking confirmations can show reserved wheelchair space. The minister answered that internet communication is increasing, that GDPR and existing national rules apply, that two-factor login is separate from the booking confirmation which is the transporter's responsibility, and that no concrete change or action was promised.
Without further information about the reason for your question, or without further explanation, it is not possible for me to answer this question precisely.
Zonder nadere informatie over de aanleiding van uw vraag cq. zonder nadere duiding, is het voor mij niet mogelijk deze vraag precies te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de met perfluoroctaansulfonzuur (PFOS) en perfluoroctaanzuur (PFOA) verontreinigde grond bij Schiphol

An MP asks the State Secretary about PFOS and PFOA contaminated soil stored near Schiphol and Rijsenhout, the municipal soil policy, national risk limits, and drinking water monitoring. The answers say the soil is lightly contaminated, stored temporarily pending reuse or cleaning, that soil policy is decentralised, and that the Rijk will work with local authorities on a national method for substances of concern.
I have asked the RIVM to derive risk limit values for PFOS and PFOA.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om risicogrenswaarden af te leiden voor PFOS en PFOA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Meer NS-treinen stranden op hsl’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary about reports that more NS trains were stranding on the high-speed line due to a software fault introduced in a mid-2018 update. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, attributed it to a software synchronisation fault, described a corrective update completed in January 2019, and said effects on performance indicators and the 2021 outlook would be reported later.
I will inform your House more about this in the spring.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Goederenlocomotief blokkeert weg na ontsporing’

An MP asked the state secretary about a freight locomotive derailment at a Vlissingen port track on 24 December 2018 and whether it could have been prevented given a 2017 derailment there. The answer attributes the incident to the remote operator braking too late without using the available distance-signalling aid, says the 2017 causes (rotten sleepers) were absent, and states an ongoing investigation will review the incident.
After thorough investigation it was established that a combination of factors, including rotten wooden sleepers, played a role in this incident.
Na grondig onderzoek is vastgesteld dat een combinatie van factoren, waaronder verweerde houten dwarsliggers, een rol speelde bij dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland na de Duitse vuile dieselauto’s nu de vervuilende houtkachels importeert

An MP asked whether Dutch wood stoves that are banned in Germany and Belgium can still be sold in the Netherlands, and why stricter emission norms are not introduced sooner despite industry and NGO calls. The state secretary answered that most stoves sold follow German standards, and committed to a regulation bringing the EU Ecodesign requirements into force by 1 January 2020 at the latest.

I therefore want to introduce a regulation so that as quickly as possible, but no later than 1 January 2020, the new Ecodesign Directive requirements also apply in the Netherlands, as in our neighbouring countries, to newly sold stoves.

Ik wil daarom komen tot een regeling om zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020, de nieuwe eisen van de Ecodesign-richtlijn ook in Nederland net als in onze buurlanden van kracht te laten zijn voor nieuw verkochte kachels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat gratis grond ProRail miljoenen kost

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that ProRail had to pay millions for land it earlier declined when NS offered it for free, and whether more such land could be sold to ProRail, and what the ministry advised. The state secretary confirmed the purchase, said the ministry had rejected acquisition in 2011 pending need, that no further problematic offers are known, and that ownership and land-transaction rules will be reviewed in the ZBO conversion.
Following ProRail's reported intention to buy the land, I indicated, given the situation that had arisen, that I could go along with the choice.
Naar aanleiding van de door ProRail gemelde voorgenomen aankoop van de gronden heb ik, gegeven de ontstane situatie, aangegeven de keuze te kunnen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht dat ProRail miljoenen betaalde voor grond aan ‘handige jongens'

An MP from D66 asked whether ProRail overpaid about 18.1 million euros in 2017 for land it could have obtained from NS earlier, and whether a stricter pre-approval test for ProRail land purchases is needed. The State Secretary explained that ProRail followed its own strategic-interest test then in force, that the 2017 full purchase ended costly legal disputes, and that the parties will review the framework and the minister's approval threshold, though no legislative change is committed.
With ProRail I have moreover agreed that the land ProRail does not need now or does not expect to need in the future will be sold again by ProRail.
Met ProRail heb ik bovendien afgesproken dat de gronden die ProRail nu niet nodig heeft of niet in de toekomst verwacht nodig te hebben, door ProRail weer zullen worden verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de bloemenveiling in Aalsmeer die een gigantische plastic afvalberg produceert en daar jaarlijks miljoenen euro’s aan verdient

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the Aalsmeer flower auction's use of single-use plant trays, which generate large plastic waste, should be replaced by a deposit system or reusable trays. The State Secretary answered that Flora Holland and the VBN are working on a plan to promote reusable trays and recycling and that the government will assess next steps after consultation with the sector.
I have invited Flora Holland and the VBN to lay down their ambition to phase out single-use trays in a pledge through which they can join the Plastic Pact being concluded.
Ik heb Flora Holland en de VBN uitgenodigd om hun ambitie om eenmalige trays uit te faseren neer te leggen in een «pledge» waarbij zij zich kunnen aansluiten bij het te sluiten Plastic Pact.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring disruptions and overcrowded trains on the Maaslijn railway line. The government answered that improvements depend on provincial concession measures and electrification planned for later, attributing the problems to infrastructure repair delays, a lack of rolling stock, and hard-to-detect signalling faults, while assigning responsibility to the concession holder, ProRail and the provinces.
It is the responsibility of the concession holder and concession grantors to take action on this together with ProRail.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de concessiehouder en concessieverleners om daar samen met ProRail actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel 'Akkers vervuild door plastic in compost: 'Te veel rotzooi in de gft-bak''

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports of plastic contamination in compost, including whether a plastic norm exists, health and environmental risks, and who is responsible for preventing contamination. The state secretary answers that preliminary Rijkswaterstaat findings vary, that the legal limit of 0.5 percent non-biodegradable foreign matter applies, that private quality marks are stricter, that it sees no signs of large-scale serious contamination, and that a plan with stakeholders is being developed while municipalities can help by communicating what belongs in the green-waste bin.
The preliminary, not yet published, results give a varying picture of the extent to which compost contains plastic particles.
De voorlopige, nog niet gepubliceerde, resultaten geven een wisselend beeld van de mate waarin compost plastic deeltjes bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat de veiligheid van vuurpijlen niet gegarandeerd kan worden

MP Teunissen asked about reports that firework launch stands failed safety tests and whether the sale of rockets should be banned if no safe stands are found. The Staatssecretaris confirmed the test failures, said TNO is researching alternative stands and that the trade must supply safe ones, and declined to commit to a ban for now.
Firework sellers bear a statutory responsibility for a launch stand that meets the requirements.
De verkopers van vuurwerk dragen een bij wet vastgelegde verantwoordelijkheid voor een lanceerstandaard die voldoet aan de eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Asbestvezels ontdekt op metrostation Stadhuis; voorlopig geen metro’s’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about asbestos fibres found at Rotterdam metro station Stadhuis, including exposure of passengers and staff, how the 2009 survey missed it, and the investigation scope. The government answered that the municipality found no health risk, exposure duration is unknown, RET has started a broader investigation, and certified contractors and the inspectorate oversee remediation.
Commissioning such an investigation is the responsibility of the competent authority or RET.
Het opdracht geven voor een dergelijk onderzoek is de verantwoordelijkheid van bevoegd gezag dan wel de RET.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked how innovators outside livestock farming can get new ammonia-reducing stall systems onto the Rav list, and about procedures, cooperation with other countries, TAP composition and the motion on testing barriers. The government explained quick scans, a maximum 20-week assessment, VERA cooperation, and that it is mapping barriers and will inform the Chamber early next year.
I will inform the Chamber early next year about the steps I will take to remove these barriers as much as possible.
Ik zal de Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de stappen die ik zal zetten om deze belemmeringen zo veel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het nieuws dat een lek in de persleiding van FrieslandCampina tienduizenden vissen het leven heeft gekost

An MP asked why a leak in a pipeline carrying FrieslandCampina wastewater killed large numbers of fish in the Berkel, why the response took days, who is responsible and whether the factories should have been shut down. The minister answered that the water board handled the leak as quickly as feasible, that the cause is still under investigation, and that liability and cost recovery cannot be determined until then.
The cause of the breach is currently being investigated. I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
De oorzaak van de breuk wordt momenteel onderzocht. Ik wacht de resultaten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de onbewaakte spoorwegovergangen in Santpoort-Zuid

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management for an update on the unguarded level crossings at Santpoort-Zuid, why the planned parallel road is delayed, its completion timeline, and how the project will be concluded quickly. The State Secretary answered that the parallel road is delayed by a landowner refusing cooperation and pending objections against permits, with a building-road target of summer 2019 and final road summer 2020, and that ProRail is pursuing legal options and a possible temporary route while hoping for an amicable settlement.
I share the conclusion that it is dangerous to cross these level crossings.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het gevaarlijk is om deze overwegen te kruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Spoor in plaats van vliegen kansloze missie’

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister and State Secretary about cost comparisons between rail, road and aviation infrastructure, government spending and revenues by mode, and whether all costs should be weighed in modal choices. The government answered that it funds infrastructure mainly via the Infrastructure Fund, that full per-kilometre cost comparisons are complex, commissioned KiM research, and committed to outputs for the Mobility Fund in early 2019.
We will also use the outcomes of these studies when developing the Mobility Fund.
We zullen de uitkomsten van deze studies ook benutten bij de uitwerking van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Chemieconcern Ineos overweegt miljardeninvestering en fabriek in Rotterdam’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a possible INEOS plant in Rotterdam linked to shale gas, citing environmental, climate and plastics concerns and asking whether the government would oppose it. The minister said the plant would process imported ethane and propane (shale-derived byproducts) into ethylene and propylene, estimated about 0.8 Mton CO2 per year, acknowledged the plastics problem, and said the government would not oppose the investment but would apply climate agreements, with talks with Dutch authorities ongoing.
The cabinet wants to promote CO2 emission reduction in existing industry and stimulate the development of new industries, companies and business activity.
Het kabinet wil CO 2 -emissiereductie in de bestaande industrie bevorderen en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe industrieën, bedrijven en bedrijvigheid stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Beckerman over het dreigende tekort aan stroom in België vanwege uitgeschakelde kernreactoren

MPs Wassenberg and Beckerman asked whether the Netherlands would supply emergency electricity to Belgium amid nuclear reactor shutdowns, raising CO2, price, reactor safety and parliamentary consultation concerns. The minister answered that Belgium seeks optimised interconnector capacity rather than extra power, that CO2 emissions cannot be excluded, that FANC is responsible for nuclear safety, and that the operational measures fall within TenneT's competence.
Question 11: Are you willing to avoid irreversible steps and submit decisions on supplying electricity to Belgium to the House?
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen en besluiten over de levering van stroom aan België voor te leggen aan de Kamer?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over tankers die elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas lozen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about tankers that vent benzene and other carcinogenic vapours on the Waal and Rhine, including near inhabited areas, and about enforcement gaps between provinces and the state. The minister answered that venting is banned only for petrol, that a national ban on venting other dangerous substances will take effect around 2020 under a revised Rhine convention, that enforcement lies with the ILT and Rijkswateren authorities, and that no change in provincial responsibility is warranted.
Nevertheless, my aim is to ban venting of all dangerous substances while sailing as quickly as possible.
Niettemin is mijn streven gericht op het zo snel mogelijk verbieden van het varend ontgassen van alle gevaarlijke stoffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele in strijd met verdrag van Aarhus’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether the Aarhus Committee's finding that Borssele's lifetime extension breached the Aarhus Convention, and related questions on public participation, environmental impact assessment and the safety benchmark, were accepted. The State Secretary rejected a general Aarhus breach, argued the 2013 licence update required no MER, and said the second safety benchmark report is expected by the end of the year.
That is why I will study in the coming months whether additional (legal) measures need to be taken to increase citizen participation.
Daarom zal ik de komende maanden nog bestuderen of er aanvullende (wettelijke) maatregelen getroffen moeten worden om inspraak van burgers te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over financiële problemen NS op het Britse spoor

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked about NS's financial problems on its British rail activities, including a £80 million PCS guarantee draw for East Anglia, the CLE risk-sharing mechanism, and whether Dutch fares could rise. Minister Hoekstra answered that Abellio UK has been profitable overall, that the PCS guarantees are capped by a €500 million ministerial ceiling and that the CLE index is no longer applied to new concessions, while declining to comment on ongoing negotiations with DfT.
We do not wish to anticipate the outcomes of those discussions and their consequences for the remainder of the concession term.
Wij willen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van die gesprekken en de gevolgen daarvan voor de rest van de looptijd van de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over het onderzoek ‘Aanwijzingen voor herkomst onbekend deel plastic soep’ uitgevoerd door het Burgercollectief Dreumelse Waard

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a citizen-collective study tracing orange plastic waste along the Maas to the Over de Maas project, and whether polluters should pay and verondiepingsprojecten be investigated. The State Secretary acknowledged the plastic likely came from the project, said the initiator cleaned up the banks, and promised a review of the rules and supervision by the regulators, with evaluation results due end of November.
I will ask the supervisory bodies Rijkswaterstaat, the water boards and the ILT to what extent there are problems with plastics and, if so, how they act against it under the duty of care.
Ik zal aan de toezichthouders Rijkswaterstaat, de waterschappen en de ILT vragen in welke mate er problemen met plastics zijn en zo ja hoe zij hiertegen op grond van de zorgplicht optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over blazers bij chemiebedrijf ESD-SIC in Delfzijl

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the State Secretary about recurring 'blazers' (sulphur dust clouds released with a bang from smelting furnaces) at chemical company ESD-SIC in Delfzijl, and whether the government can end them, fine the company, and acknowledge local health and odour nuisance. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen is the competent authority responsible for permitting and enforcement, that Rijkswaterstaat-Infomil can advise it, that blazers are not prohibited under the current permit, and that the province adopted a maatwerkbesluit requiring a study into avoiding them, while acknowledging the nuisance for residents.
Naturally, the province remains responsible for granting permits and supervising the company.
Uiteraard blijft de provincie verantwoordelijk voor de vergunningverlening en het toezicht op het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de moeizame recycling van textiel vanwege de slechte kwaliteit

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about poor textile recycling due to low-quality clothing, unreliable fibre labels, and the case for mandatory warning labels on synthetic clothing. The state secretary agrees textile recycling must scale up, promises talks with the sector, an Extended Producer Responsibility scheme, a RIVM discussion paper on microfibres, and further exploration of recycled-content minimums, without committing to a labelling mandate.
I will enter into discussion with the clothing industry, after which I will consider whether and how further research should be initiated.
Ik ga in gesprek met de kledingbranche, waarna bezien of en zo ja hoe nader onderzoek dient te worden geïnitieerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Mooi maar gevaarlijk’

An MP asked the government whether wish balloons pose a fire hazard, especially in dry periods, and whether a national ban should be imposed following fire brigade warnings. The minister answered that product safety is regulated and users are responsible, that local municipalities may decide on bans, and that no national prohibition is needed because municipalities already have legal options.
I see no reason to legally prohibit the release of wish ballons at national level, since municipalities already have legal options.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het oplaten van wensballonnen op landelijk niveau wettelijk te verbieden, aangezien er reeds wettelijke mogelijkheden zijn voor gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “illegale en giftige mengsels in stookolie”

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary about illegal and toxic waste mixed into heating oil by fuel traders, the enforcement failures that allowed it, and plans to tighten control. The State Secretary confirmed the findings, attributed past lapses to sector unawareness of REACH and to inspection priorities, and committed to more inspection capacity in the fuel sector from autumn 2018.
From autumn 2018, the ILT will make more capacity available for supervision of the fuel sector.
Vanaf najaar 2018 stelt de ILT meer capaciteit beschikbaar voor het toezicht op de brandstofbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bijmengen van afvalstoffen aan brandstoffen en het ILT-rapport ‘Stookolie voor zeeschepen - Autobrandstoffen voor West-Afrika’

An MP asked the State Secretary about ILT findings that fuels blended with harmful substances are exported to West Africa, the health impact, enforcement, and why action has been slow. The government says REACH and Basel/Rotterdam rules largely do not reach such exports, that enforcement and prosecution referrals are underway, and that it will press for stricter norms in African countries and through international and EU channels.
I cannot provide further information about these signals.
Over deze signalen kan ik geen nadere mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Inspectie: kankerverwekkende stoffen gemengd in benzine voor West-Afrika’ en de brief naar aanleiding van het ILT-rapport ‘Stookolie voor zeeschepen – Autobrandstoff

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that carcinogenic substances were blended into fuels exported to West Africa, asking whether the sector is held sufficiently accountable and whether enforcement against the blending is adequate. The State Secretary said the government expects firms to implement UN and OECD due diligence standards, that the ILT found no illegal blending of waste substances, and that enforcement under REACH and waste law is applied with stricter measures for higher risk, while acknowledging the ILT's capacity is a recurring question.
The cabinet has asked the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines to examine the extent to which the oil and gas sector complies with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet heeft het Nationaal Contactpunt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen verzocht te kijken naar de mate waarin de olie- en gassector de OESO-richtlijnen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over illegale praktijken rondom recycling van kunstgras

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Justice Minister about illegal artificial turf recycling practices, including municipalities paying recyclers who leave pitches unprocessed, lack of enforcement, and bankruptcy used to dodge costs. The State Secretary answered that enforcement and permitting lie with provinces and municipalities, that the ILT issued warnings to inspected firms, and that no additional national measures are planned while monitoring the local follow-up.
It is the responsibility of provinces and municipalities to take these requirements into account when granting permits to waste companies.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van provincies en gemeenten om bij vergunningverlening aan afvalbedrijven rekening te houden met deze voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over de uitzending van Zembla getiteld “De Kunstgrasberg”.

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on illegal handling and stockpiling of artificial turf waste, inspection frequency, responsibility for disposal, and sustainable alternatives. The state secretary answered that municipalities and provinces are the competent authorities for licensing and enforcement, that the ILT inspected three firms and issued warnings, and that ownership of the matter remains with local authorities, while committing to follow up with Gelderland and Dongen and to work on sustainability through the sports accord.
I have asked the Province of Gelderland and the municipality of Dongen to keep me informed of the follow-up steps and will actively monitor their implementation.
Ik heb de Provincie Gelderland en gemeente Dongen verzocht mij op de hoogte te houden over de vervolgstappen en zal de uitvoering daarvan actief volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Ongeplande uitval kerncentrale Borssele kost zeker tien miljoen’

An MP asked about the unplanned outage of the Borssele nuclear plant, the decommissioning fund, cost estimates, ageing risks and the finances of the shareholders. The government answered that the decommissioning fund is on schedule (EUR 201.4 million by end 2017), that the plant's reliability is not expected to decline, and that closing early would cost more than the planned 2033 closure.
I do not have the requested information for each central plant in Europe.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie per centrale in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Tritium in het Maaswater

MP Beckerman asked whether the 100 Bq/l tritium drinking-water limit would force a halt to Maas water intake, what dose is safe, whether any safe dose exists for chronic low-dose beta exposure, and whether an intervention value of 19 Bq/l should be set. The minister answered that the 100 Bq/l value is a screening threshold not reached in practice, that no safe low-dose value can be scientifically established, and that no lower intervention value is warranted, citing continuous monitoring at Eijsden.
I see no reason to include an intervention value (i.e. a signalling value) for tritium for intake surface water in the Drinking Water Regulation.
Ik zie geen reden om een interventiewaarde (i.c. een signaleringswaarde) voor tritium voor in te nemen oppervlaktewater in de Drinkwaterregeling op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Shell krijgt subsidie voor bouw waterstofstations’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why Shell received about EUR 4 million from RVO's DKTI-Transport subsidy for four hydrogen stations, whether hydrogen from natural gas is sustainable, and why battery-electric charging stations received less support. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is technology-neutral, that the four stations received EUR 3.28 million in cofinancing under the programme's rules, and that both hydrogen and battery-electric vehicles are needed for climate goals.

The DKTI-Transport is a technology-neutral scheme that supports solutions for the development of climate technologies and innovations in the transport sector as well as the rollout of infrastructure for alternative fuels.

De DKTI-Transport is een technologie-neutrale regeling die oplossingen ondersteunt van de totstandkoming van klimaattechnologieën en -innovaties in de sector transport alsmede de uitrol van infrastructuur voor alternatieve brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Man smokkelt wapenonderdelen uraniumfabriek Gronau binnen’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether a smuggled weapon part at Urenco's Gronau enrichment plant could happen at Almelo, whether Almelo has been checked, what extra measures were taken, and what the regulator ANVS did. The state secretary answered that Almelo has had no weapons or parts found, daily checks are done, no extra measures were needed beyond awareness programmes, and ANVS asked all nuclear sites to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Following the Gronau incident, the ANVS asked Dutch nuclear facilities to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenis in Gronau heeft de ANVS de Nederlandse nucleaire inrichtingen gevraagd extra aandacht te besteden aan detectie van ongeoorloofde voorwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over afvalscheiding op NS-stations

An MP asked the state secretary about NS breaking its 2020 promise to separate three-quarters of station waste, including too few combi-containers and separated waste being recombined. The state secretary denied NS was failing its commitments, pointed to ongoing Green Deal pilots and planned combi-container tests, and said no conclusion on final realisation can yet be drawn.
I therefore do not share your conclusion that NS would not be keeping its agreements.
Ik deel daarom niet uw conclusie dat de NS haar afspraken niet zou nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘EU blijft streng op nieuwe veredelingstechnieken’ en ‘Europees Hof remt kwekers vanwege genetische modificatie’

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the EU Court ruling on new plant breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas9 (subject to GMO rules) affects policy, import controls, and the coalition goal of promoting these techniques in Europe. The minister answered that the ruling keeps such products under GMO authorisation, that detection is difficult, and that the government will address the policy consequences in a separate letter to parliament.
We will shortly inform the House by letter about the Dutch position on applying new plant breeding techniques and the policy consequences of the European Court of Justice ruling.

Wij zullen uw Kamer spoedig per brief informeren over de Nederlandse inzet voor de toepassing van nieuwe plantenveredelingstechnieken en de beleidsconsequenties van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de treinchaos rondom Amsterdam

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the August 2018 train chaos around Amsterdam caused by a software fault, why NS did not deploy replacement bus transport, and whether ProRail and NS would be held to account and agreements made to prevent such disruptions. The State Secretary explained the software fault and the reasons replacement transport was limited, and committed to including the incident in the 2018 disruption report and reviewing whether additional measures are needed.
As part of the 2018 disruption report, I will consider whether additional measures are necessary.
In het kader van de verstoringenrapportage 2018 zal ik bezien of aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er meer afval naar de stortplaats verdwijnt

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that more waste is going to landfill, including permits for 130 kton more this year, and about recycling by households. The state secretary said the increase is about 30 kton, that landfilling uses existing capacity, and cited economic growth and a 57% household separation rate, promising to strengthen circular economy measures and raise landfill taxes.
It concerns landfilling at existing landfill sites and within existing capacity.
Het betreft hier storten op bestaande stortplaatsen en binnen bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over plastic als belangrijke bron van broeikasgas

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether litter plastics are a significant greenhouse gas source and whether emissions from them are estimated or monitored in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed the research finding, said no estimates exist and that the RIVM will follow international research, and stated that litter plastics are not yet included in climate policy.

Climate policy currently does not take into account greenhouse gas emissions from litter plastics, because until now these have not been considered a relevant emission source with substantial emissions.

Er wordt in het klimaatbeleid momenteel geen rekening gehouden met de uitstoot aan broeikasgassen door zwerfplastics omdat dit tot nu toe niet beschouwd is als relevante emissiebron met een substantiële emissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de storing in de kerncentrale Borssele

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a third shutdown of the Borssele nuclear plant within a year, whether a pattern exists, the INES level, and why the latest incident was not on the ANVS timeline sooner. The government answered that no pattern is evident across 15 unusual events since 2015, all rated INES-0, and that EPZ reported the event and ANVS published it on its website, with the timeline entry added on 7 August once details were clear.
From both the nature and the number of unusual events and shutdowns at the Borssele nuclear plant, no pattern can be inferred.
Uit zowel de aard als het aantal ongewone gebeurtenissen en afschakelingen bij de kerncentrale Borssele is geen patroon af te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de brief ‘Voortgang onderzoek asbest in cosmetica’ en het bericht ‘Johnson & Johnson moet schadevergoeding van 4 miljard euro betalen’

Lid Laçin (SP) asked whether the 296 talc-containing cosmetics tested for asbest should be retested with a more sensitive method (Fitzgerald method) and whether Johnson & Johnson products should be further investigated after a US damages ruling. The government declined to retest, saying the prescribed NEN 5896 method is adequate and it awaits an ISO decision, and said no further investigation of Johnson & Johnson products is warranted.
No, I am not willing to have the 296 products retested.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de 296 producten opnieuw te laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Slechts 3 procent nieuwe auto's elektrisch: de schuld van autodealers?’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about the low share of electric car sales in the Netherlands, dealer behaviour reported in Scandinavian research, and what government will do to support the transition. The secretary confirmed roughly 3% EV registrations in 2017, said she knows of the Nature Energy study but not whether it applies in the Netherlands, and committed to discussing the issue with the sector and the mobility table, with a joint measures package to be agreed in the climate agreement by year end.
By the end of this year I want to record a joint package of measures with them in the climate agreement.
Eind dit jaar wil ik met hen een gezamenlijk maatregelenpakket vastleggen in het klimaatakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Ellemeet en Dik-Faber over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over wirwar van reisproducten in het OV en de noodzaak van tariefintegratie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the patchwork of public transport fares across concession boundaries and whether a northern multi-province subscription and nationwide fare integration should be pursued. The State Secretary answered that regional authorities hold the competence, that cross-concession products are being explored via the national OV forum, and that full fare integration is neither necessary nor desirable given decentralisation.

Tariff integration (that is, reducing or eliminating price differences) is not necessary for bringing more coherence to travel products and, given the decentralisation of regional urban and regional transport, is also not desirable.

Tariefintegratie (dat wil zeggen het verkleinen of elimineren van prijsverschillen) is voor het aanbrengen van meer samenhang in de reisproducten niet noodzakelijk en gelet op de decentralisatie van het regionale stads- en streekvervoer ook niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over hogere reiskosten voor leerlingen door aanpassing van de scholierenlijn naar Gouda

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked whether the government is aware that shortening school bus line 646/647 to Woerden would more than double travel costs for about 150 pupils travelling to Driestar College in Gouda, and whether it considers this unreasonable and will press for fare integration. The State Secretary said the matter is a regional responsibility of the province of Utrecht, that fare integration is not desirable, and that the concept transport plan will be decided by provincial executives on 11 September.
However, it is not for me to judge the reasonableness.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te oordelen over de redelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de sanering van tritium gelukt is

An SP MP asked whether the tritium remediation at Petten is nearing its end, whether the plan of approach was approved with monthly and semi-annual monitoring, and whether the groundwater remediation norm being raised from 100 to 5000 Bq/L makes further remediation unnecessary and endangers crops and food. The State Secretary confirmed approval of NRG's new plan on 15 June 2018, explained the norm change was based on a RIVM risk analysis finding negligible risk (below 10 microsievert per year), and described the monitoring regime.
On 15 June 2018 I approved the new Plan of Approach of NRG for the remediation of the tritium contamination in the soil of the Petten research site (OLP).

Op 15 juni 2018 heb ik het nieuwe Plan van Aanpak van de Nuclear Research and consultancy Group (NRG) voor de sanering van de tritiumverontreiniging in de bodem van de Onderzoekslocatie Petten (OLP) goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Geen landelijk systeem voor aanpak agressie in het openbaar vervoer (OV)’

An MP asks whether a national incident-data system linking public transport operators and police is needed to tackle aggression on public transport, and whether NS data should be shared with regional operators. The State Secretary says the research supports one system but operators lack commitment, so information sharing will be explored through standard reports and structured consultation instead.
As an alternative, the research bureau proposes exchanging incident data and figures through national and regional standard reports and structural consultations.
Alternatief geeft het onderzoeksbureau het uitwisselen van gegevens over incidenten en cijfers in de vorm van landelijke en regionale standaard rapportages en structurele gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht “Spoorwegdoden door schuld laks ministerie”.

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a report on railway crossing deaths, including the OVV's findings on recklessness, whether the ministry is responsible and should steer ProRail, whether cost should matter for safety, and when unguarded crossings will be secured or closed. The State Secretary said she will study the OVV report before drawing conclusions and respond in a policy reaction, called crossing safety a shared responsibility of rail and road managers, stated that cost is weighed against safety benefits, and committed to closing or securing all open unguarded crossings and private connections as quickly as possible with ProRail.
It is good that the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) thoroughly investigated the safety situation at level crossings and also looked at the underlying causes of accidents.
Het is goed dat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) de veiligheidssituatie rond overwegen grondig heeft onderzocht en daarbij ook heeft gekeken naar de achterliggende oorzaken van ongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Giftige stof PFOA gevonden in recreatieplas Berkendonk in Helmond’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about PFOA found in the Berkendonk recreation lake in Helmond, how it got there, whether swimming is safe given concentrations above the advisory standard, and what rules and transport checks apply to Chemours. The minister answered that the contamination is likely historical, that the municipality and water board will monitor it, that RIVM sees no swimming risk since exposure is far below the tolerable daily intake, and that no signals of rule violations by Chemours are known.
I will inform your House if there are relevant developments.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren indien er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Sterk verhoogde concentratie GenX in slootwater omgeving Chemours’

An SP MP asked the government about GenX and PFOA contamination found in ditch water near Chemours, including whether Chemours still discharges PFOA, health risks from garden produce and livestock watering, EU regulation, and enforcement against Chemours. The minister answered that RIVM is studying the contamination, the province has issued an order under penalty against Chemours and tightened discharge limits, and the government will propose GenX as a substance of very high concern.
On the basis of this finding, the province imposed an order subject to a penalty on Chemours on 23 April 2018.
De provincie heeft op basis van deze constatering op 23 april 2018 een last onder dwangsom aan Chemours opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het rapport 'Hoogspanningslijnen en gezondheid deel I: kanker bij kinderen'

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the Health Council report linking long-term exposure to magnetic fields with childhood leukaemia and brain tumours should prompt precautionary measures extended to underground cables and existing housing. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said magnetic fields cannot be shielded, and committed to an evaluation of the current precautionary policy and an exploration of extending it, without prejudging outcomes.
It will be evaluated how the precautionary policy for overhead lines has been implemented so far and what its societal effects are.
Er zal worden geëvalueerd hoe het voorzorgbeleid voor bovengrondse lijnen tot nu toe is uitgevoerd en wat hiervan de maatschappelijke effecten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het project Over de Maas en Vonkelplas

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the Over de Maas and Vonkelplas sand-extraction projects, concerning oversight of deep lakes, soil-quality rules, imported contaminated soil, and archaeological risks. The government answered that it will evaluate the framework for deep lakes and oversight, that municipalities bear responsibility for private agreements while Rijkswaterstaat supervises the soil-quality rules, and that the extraction permit extension poses no archaeological threat.
The content of any private-law agreements is the responsibility of the municipality.
De inhoud van eventuele privaatrechtelijke afspraken is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel “Reductie van broeikasgas blijft achter, biomassa is slechte energiebron”

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the Ministers whether they share concerns that growing biomass energy use worsens air quality and health, and asked about integrating climate and air quality policy and tightening emission rules for medium-sized boilers. The government answered that biomass does not necessarily worsen air quality, referred to the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a stookalert under development, said emission rules are already in place and to be reviewed in the 2019 ISDE evaluation, but declined to fully integrate climate and air quality policy.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include the effects on (local) air quality as one of the criteria in assessing the scheme.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de stook van biomassa zorgt voor een flinke toename van fijnstof

An MP asked the government about reports that biomass burning raises fine particulate levels, the WHO guideline gap, climate effects, whether biomass is sustainable, and whether subsidies for wood stoves should end. The minister answered that biomass is renewable, promised attention to particulate emissions in the Clean Air Agreement, and said the ISDE subsidy scheme will be evaluated in 2019 including its effect on local air quality.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include its effects on (local) air quality as one of the assessment criteria.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van den Berg over het bericht dat Noord-Holland opheldering eist over uitspraken Wiebes over Pallas-reactor

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will act quickly so that Noord-Holland's final 40 million euro loan tranche to the Pallas reactor foundation is released and isotope supply delays are avoided. Minister Bruins answered that a go/no-go decision is expected soon, that the province is responsible for the loan decision, and that intensive contact with Noord-Holland is ongoing, without committing to a specific new step.
I am not responsible for the decision-making of the province of Noord-Holland.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor de besluitvorming van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Nieuwe diesels stoten veel te veel stikstofoxiden uit’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that new Euro-6 diesel cars emit too much nitrogen oxides on the road, about the causes, enforcement options, air quality effects, and the lawful switching-off of emission controls. The State Secretary answered that the ICCT tests are not type-approval tests, that EU Real Driving Emissions rules now apply, that enforcement via type-approval authorities is possible, and that emission-control switch-offs should be limited, while committing to tighter RDE rules expected in January 2019.
I share your view that it is undesirable for manufacturers to switch off emission-limiting systems.
Ik deel uw opvatting dat het onwenselijk is dat fabrikanten emissiebeperkende voorzieningen uitschakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Remco Dijkstra over harmonisatie van milieuzones

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the growing patchwork of municipal low-emission zones and the need for uniform national rules before 2020, including questions on communication, proportionality and judicial review. The State Secretary agreed harmonisation is desirable, outlined the planned Euro-class system for 2020 and said municipal zones and their traffic decisions remain open to appeal.
The traffic decision underlying the environmental zone is open to objection and appeal.
Het verkeersbesluit dat ten grondslag ligt aan de milieuzone staat immers open voor bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Bijna 3000 waarschuwingen voor scooters in milieuzone’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about warnings issued to scooter riders entering Amsterdam's environmental zone, including enforcement methods, the age-based cut-off, and where fines go. The state secretary answered that municipalities set zone rules, enforcement uses ANPR cameras and officers, fines go to the CJIB, and no change to Amsterdam's zone for mopeds is planned.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to determine which rules apply to entering the environmental zone.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om te bepalen welke regels er gelden voor het betreden van de milieuzone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de internetconsultatie Regeling tot wijziging van de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) en de Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij (Rgv)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about the internet consultation on amending the ammonia and odour regulations for livestock farming, questioning the WUR study underlying the change, its financial effects, and whether consultation should have waited for pending questions and parliamentary debate. The government answered that combi-scrubbers perform worse than assumed, that the study is statistically robust, that expansion possibilities will be restricted for affected farms, and that no cost-benefit analysis is available; it deferred some questions to a separate reply.
A cost-benefit analysis is not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Evaluatie geurverwijdering door luchtwassystemen bij stallen

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked about differences in air-scrubber performance and standards between the Netherlands and Germany, and about the planned adjustment of odour-reduction percentages for combi-scrubbers following a WUR evaluation. The government answered that no EU or Dutch standards exist for scrubbers, that Dutch and German lab measurements differ due to methodology, that combi-scrubbers underperform relative to permit assumptions, and that it will adjust emission factors, while noting the impact on farmers is limited for existing farms.
The study shows that combi-scrubber systems in practice do not deliver the emission reduction assumed in permits.
Het onderzoek toont aan dat de combi-luchtwassystemen in de praktijk niet de emissiereductie geven waar in vergunningen mee wordt gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten “NS waarschuwt voor verbouwing Amsterdam CS” en “Iedereen wil openbaar vervoer, niemand wil het betalen”

An MP asked the state secretary about cost overruns of roughly €200 million for rebuilding Amsterdam Centraal and whether a track should be dropped. The state secretary answered that €150 million extra will be added from the rail investment room, with nine instead of ten through-tracks and a possible later tenth track, and that the government committed to a decision on the Amsterdam rail infrastructure.
I have asked ProRail to get a better grip on the cost developments and to map what can be learned from the cost increase that occurred.
Ik heb ProRail verzocht om beter grip te krijgen op de kostenontwikkelingen en in beeld te brengen wat men kan leren van de opgetreden kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Smart Maintenance

MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the minister about signal faults and delays on the Amsterdam-Utrecht rail line, the number of signal faults in 2017 and 2018, diagnosis and repair times, and the role of Smart Maintenance. The state secretary answered that the May 2018 fault was caused by a defective ES-las, gave fault statistics and repair timings, and said ProRail is expected to pursue smart technologies and that a conditional fine was imposed on ProRail.
I note – based on the report on high-impact disruptions 2017 from NS and ProRail that I recently sent to the House – that
Ik constateer – op basis van de rapportage impactvolle verstoringen 2017 van NS en ProRail die ik onlangs naar de Kamer heb gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked why Amsterdam Centraal was chosen for nine tracks rather than ten or nine-and-a-half, what a future tenth track would require and cost, and how the Zuid station and the Noord/Zuidlijn handle demand. The state secretary answered that nine tracks plus six at Zuid free the western line for high-frequency service, that a tenth track would cost about €100 million more now and similar costs later, and that the chosen layout is expected to suffice to 2030 and largely 2040 with room left for a later tenth track.
The decision does leave room to take a later decision on this in order to respond to any changed insights.
Met het besluit wordt wel ruimte gelaten om hierover later een besluit te nemen om in te kunnen spelen op eventuele gewijzigde inzichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Ander reisgedrag vermindert files’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a report that changed commuting behaviour reduces traffic jams, including whether behaviour-change schemes like Low Car Diet are cheaper than infrastructure and how they are factored into budgeting and the NMCA. The state secretary answered that behaviour-change measures are a promising method, that further research is being explored, that Beter Benutten and employer programmes are being continued, and that alternative non-infrastructural solutions are considered in MIRT studies.
Yes, together with those involved I am currently exploring the possibilities for a follow-up to the CPB note.
Ja, samen met de betrokkenen onderzoek ik momenteel de mogelijkheden voor een vervolg op de notitie van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Dit keer dumpen de boswachters zelf afval, als statement’

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security, Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and Infrastructure and Water Management about fly-tipping in rural areas after rangers dumped waste as a protest. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a joint plan of action on supervision and enforcement in rural areas would be sent to parliament before the budget debates, and noted that cleanup costs and enforcement capacity are burdens but gave no national data on causes or environmental damage.
As promised in the Nature committee debate of 8 March 2018, I am working with the Minister of LNV on an action plan to improve supervision and enforcement in rural areas.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuur van 8 maart 2018 werk ik samen met de Minister van LNV aan een plan van aanpak om het toezicht en de handhaving in het buitengebied te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de vergoeding van kosten voor het opruimen van gedumpt drugsafval

MP Stoffer asked why landowners must bear clean-up costs for illegally dumped drug waste, what the past subsidy scheme provided, and whether a structural or higher-percentage scheme is planned. The State Secretary replied that the ministry's temporary co-financing scheme for 2015-2017 has ended, that no structural scheme from the ministry is planned, and that a sustainable solution must be explored by provinces and municipalities in a working group.
A structural subsidy scheme from the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not on the table.
Een structurele subsidieregeling vanuit het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten- Arissen over “de verkoop van een giftige aanslagreiniger, gevaarlijk voor mens, dier en milieu”

MPs Wassenberg and Arissen asked whether a green-mould cleaner sold by Action, containing the toxic substance DDAC, is safe and whether it should be recalled or banned for consumers. The state secretary answered that the product is authorised by the Ctgb and meets legal requirements, but a warning label on pets will be added, and no recall or sales ban is planned.
A warning sentence on the label is a proportionate measure for this problem.
Een waarschuwingszin op het etiket is voor dit probleem een proportionele maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Den Boer over het bericht ‘Veiligheidsregio verzweeg fout jodiumpillen in Limburg’

Two D66 MPs asked the government whether errors in distributing potassium iodide tablets left some families without them, why the error was not communicated, and whether distribution and registration methods should change. The minister acknowledged distribution problems could not be fully traced, described a remedial scheme for affected Limburg households, and promised an evaluation by RIVM due in 2019 while rejecting a registration system.
Unfortunately I cannot determine where errors may have been made or how many families did not receive the tablets.
Ik kan helaas niet achterhalen waar mogelijk fouten zijn gemaakt en hoeveel gezinnen de tabletten niet hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op van de leden Ziengs en Van der Graaf over de problemen met de Kamperlijn

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about soft-soil problems on the Kampen railway line, which force a speed limit of 100 km/h and threaten the skipping of Zwolle Stadshagen station, and who bears the costs. The State Secretary said an independent investigation is ongoing, that the costs and risks lie contractually with the commissioning third party, and that she has no formal role and is leaving solutions to ProRail and the regional authorities.
I have no formal role but I call on the parties to keep talking with each other about a solution for travellers.
Ik heb geen formele rol maar roep partijen op om met elkaar in gesprek te blijven over een oplossing voor de reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Britse bedrijven gaan onnodig plastic aanpakken'

A 50PLUS MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a UK Plastics Pact and how Netherlands could follow it, including whether a similar pact is feasible. The State Secretary called the UK initiative a good example to monitor, noted Dutch plastic packaging recycling of 51% already leads the EU, and said a Dutch pact would be part of the circular economy transition agendas.
I see such a Pact as part of the transition agendas and the cabinet's concrete plans to achieve a circular economy.
Ik zie zo’n Pact als onderdeel van de transitieagenda’s en de concrete plannen van het kabinet om te komen tot een circulaire economie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht “Companies sign up to pledge to cut plastic pollution” en “UK supermarkets launch voluntary pledge to cut plastic packaging”

An MP asked the state secretary whether the UK Plastics Pact targets are achievable for the Netherlands and whether comparable targets for single-use plastics can be set.
