The state secretary said Dutch recycling rates are already higher than the UK's, pointed to the existing packaging framework agreement, and said single-use plastic measures should preferably be developed at EU level, with a broader policy response to follow in the cabinet reaction on transition agendas.
In the context of the cabinet's response to the transition agendas, I will address policy to reduce the use of disposable products.
Antwoord 7, 8 In het kader van de kabinetsreactie op de transitieagenda’s zal ik ingaan op het beleid om het gebruik van wegwerpproducten te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maasvlakte: buitenlanders vrijuit op milieuzone’

An MP asks whether foreign trucks entering the Maasvlakte environmental zone face unequal treatment because their Euro emission class cannot be checked from the licence plate, and whether enforcement and fine collection abroad are assured. The government admits foreign vehicles can only be checked by roadside inspection, says it is exploring cross-border data exchange with the EU and other states, and promises to pursue a structural solution.
I would like to arrange the international exchange of vehicle data and keeper data.
Ik wil de internationale uitwisseling van voertuiggegevens en de gegevens van de kentekenhouder graag regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel ‘Hout stoken in woonwijken moet aan banden worden gelegd’

An MP asks the state secretary and minister about the health, climate and environmental effects of residential wood burning, and whether national rules and subsidies for wood and pellet stoves should be restricted. The government acknowledges that wood smoke causes pollution and local nuisance, says it will work with municipalities on feasible measures, but defends biomass as renewable and keeps subsidies for pellet stoves in place.
I consider it important to give municipalities tools to address actual nuisance situations.
Ik vind ik het belangrijk om gemeenten handvatten te geven om daadwerkelijke overlastsituaties aan te kunnen pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over onderschatting van de asbestsaneringsopgave

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether asbestos roof inventories in Gelderland, Overijssel and Limburg imply underestimated remediation targets elsewhere, and how realistic the 2024 asbestos roof ban is given reported staff shortages. The state secretary answered that the regional inventories cannot be extrapolated to other provinces, that no reason exists to correct the monitoring figures, that a 2024 ban is ambitious but feasible, and promised further letters to parliament before summer and in the second half of 2018.
It is not possible to make a more accurate estimate of the remediation task in the other provinces based on these new inventories in Gelderland, Overijssel and Limburg.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van deze nieuwe inventarisaties in Gelderland, Overijssel en Limburg een nauwkeuriger inschatting te maken van de saneringsopgave in de overige provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over een mogelijke aanval van taxichauffeurs op het hoofdkantoor van Uber

An MP asked about a reported plan by taxi drivers to attack Uber's Amsterdam headquarters, prior warnings, illegal taxi complaints, and ILT inspection capacity and enforcement in Amsterdam. The government answered that police are alert, the ILT has 25 inspectors working on a risk-based approach, and cooperation with the municipality, police and prosecutors is set out in a convenant.
Do you think the ILT has sufficient capacity to ensure in Amsterdam that entrepreneurs and drivers in the taxi sector comply with the rules?
Bent u van mening dat de ILT voldoende capaciteit heeft om er in Amsterdam op toe te zien dat ondernemers en chauffeurs in de taxibranche de regels naleven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Von Martels over het bericht ’Vieze’ auto parkeren fors duurder

MPs Ziengs and Von Martels asked whether a proposal to let municipalities charge higher parking fees for polluting cars would unfairly burden motorists with older cars and modest incomes. The State Secretary answered that the measure is a incentive for zero-emission vehicles, not a penalty, that categories will be fixed in law to prevent misuse, and that the proposal is still being developed with municipalities.
The categorisation will be legally anchored and there is no room for municipalities' own interpretation.
De categorisering wordt juridisch verankerd en daarbij is geen ruimte voor eigen interpretatie door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van de groeiende luchtvaart op de luchtkwaliteit rond Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about the air-quality effects of growing aviation around Schiphol, including RIVM projections of NO2 exceedances in 2030 and whether environmental impact assessments adequately cover health and climate effects. The minister answered that the exceedances stem from Schiphol-related traffic, pointed to planned measures and the ongoing ultrafine particle research, and defended the scope of the MERs as adequate, while committing to take the Commission's suggestion into a future aviation strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht "Streekvervoer in drie regio's verstoord door stakingen"

An MP from the CDA asked the Staatssecretaris of Infrastructure and Water Management how people dependent on regional bus transport are protected during strikes in several regions, whether all hospital and care access remains possible, and whether passengers are adequately informed and have a reporting point. The state secretary regrets the disruption, says a general answer on reachable destinations cannot be given because strikes differ, notes that providers inform passengers via social media and stop displays, and states that there are no reporting points other than the operators' service desks, with legality of strikes reviewable by a court.
I therefore cannot state in general terms which destinations remain reachable by public transport.
Ik kan daarom niet in algemene zin aangeven welke bestemmingen wel en niet bereikbaar blijven met het openbaar vervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de afhandeling van de asbestbrand in Wateringen

An MP asked the state secretaries about how the 2015 Wateringen asbestos fire was handled, including whether inventory reports were public, whether areas were properly cleared and re-checked, and whether inspection capacity is adequate. The government answered mostly by pointing to COT and Wob-disclosed documents, concluding that municipal measures were lawful and that inspection capacity appears sufficient, while committing to no new concrete action beyond noting the 2016 guidance update.
I will therefore not press for publication of these documents because the municipality has already made a consideration under the Wob request.
Ik zal derhalve niet aandringen op openbaarmaking van deze stukken omdat de gemeente in het kader van het Wob-verzoek al een afweging heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over de berichten dat asbest in make-up is aangetroffen

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked how many shops sold make-up containing asbestos, how many products were sold, the health risk for children, why no consumer warning was issued sooner, which products tested clean, whether Claire's US test results would be shared, and the scope of a broader investigation. The government answered that 22 and 25 shops sold the two affected products, the health risk is probably limited though asbestos levels were undesirably high, a warning was issued within a reasonable time, the ILT obtained but cannot publish Claire's test results, and the NVWA and ILT are testing over 250 talc-containing cosmetics.
Claire's commissioned this research and is not obliged to make this research public.
Claire's is opdrachtgever van dit onderzoek en is niet verplicht om dit onderzoek openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar paasvuren

MPs Von Martels and Omtzigt asked why RIVM is studying Easter bonfire emissions, who commissioned it, its cost, and whether Easter fires are intangible heritage. The government answered that RIVM is updating the national emissions register under international obligations, estimated Easter fire PM10 emissions at about 10% of stove emissions, and budgeted 6,800 euro for a sizing study before any decision on inclusion.
Therefore it was decided to further determine the size of the source in 2018.
Daarom is besloten om in 2018 de grootte van de bron nader te gaan bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het aangekondigde Britse verbod op plastic rietjes, roerstaafjes en wattenstaafjes

An MP asks the government about the UK plan to ban plastic straws and stirrers, their share of marine litter, and whether the Netherlands will ban such single-use plastics. The state secretary welcomes the UK initiative, says the Netherlands does not track straw sales, and defers concrete measures to the forthcoming circular economy response.
In the cabinet response to the circular economy transition agendas I will go further into how I intend to deal with disposable products.
In de kabinetsreactie op de transitieagenda's circulaire economie zal ik nader ingaan op de wijze waarop ik met wegwerpproducten wil omgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “OV-chipkaart op mobiele telefoon totaal mislukt”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the mobile OV-chip pilot failed, including its cost of 2.2 million euros, the complexity of the sign-up process and the lessons learned. The State Secretary answered that the pilot cost 2.2 million euros, that telecom costs are unknown because the companies cite confidentiality, that the pilot was an acceptable innovation investment, and that lessons were drawn for future payment methods.
I have no data on possible additional costs that the telecom companies KPN and Vodafone incurred.
Ik heb geen gegevens over mogelijk aanvullende kosten die telecombedrijven KPN en Vodafone hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Proef met OV-chip op mobiel mislukt’

Two MPs (Jetten and Van Brenk) asked the state secretary why the mobile OV-chip pilot failed and what consequences follow for mobile payment in public transport. The state secretary answered that the pilot was ended because the Mifare-based system was too complex for large-scale rollout, that the NOVB is preparing a switch to an open standard, and that mobile payment remains a goal, though no concrete follow-up is yet agreed.
The pilot is not being ended because of insufficient technical cooperation between the parties, but because OV-chip mobile in its current form is too complex for large-scale rollout.
De proef wordt niet beëindigd vanwege onvoldoende technische samenwerking tussen de partijen, maar omdat OV-chip mobiel in de huidige vorm te complex is voor grootschalige uitrol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verzet van de Duitse deelstaat Rijnland-Palts tegen het langer openhouden van de kerncentrales in Doel en Tihange

An MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate's opposition to extending the operating life of the Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including joining a Greenpeace lawsuit and a regional anti-nuclear alliance conference. The State Secretary answered that Belgian nuclear decisions are Belgium's responsibility, that the Belgian regulator deems the plants safe, that the Netherlands will monitor and seek information on safety, and that the Netherlands will not join foreign court cases.
I have no reason to doubt the judgment of FANC.
Ik heb geen reden aan het oordeel van FANC te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gelekte water uit kernreactor Doel 1 dat radioactief kan zijn

An MP asked the state secretary whether leaked water from Belgian reactor Doel 1 could be radioactive, why the Netherlands was informed late, and whether the Belgian lifetime extension should be opposed. The government answered that the water is slightly radioactive but contained with no impact on people or environment, admitted the initial communication was inadequate and will be tightened, and said Belgian lifetime extension is a Belgian competence that it will monitor closely.
The existing agreements on mutual information exchange and communication to the public will be tightened as a result.
De bestaande afspraken over onderlinge informatie-uitwisseling en communicatie naar het publiek zullen naar aanleiding hiervan worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over berichtgeving over een lek in het nucleaire gedeelte van kernreactor Doel 1

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported leak in the nuclear part of Belgian reactor Doel 1, the risks to Dutch citizens, and whether the Netherlands would oppose life extension of Belgian reactors. The state secretary answered that the Dutch regulator was not informed in time due to an administrative error, that Belgian authorities found no safety impact (INES-0), and that life-extension decisions belong to Belgium though the Netherlands will monitor them closely.
Due to an administrative error, the ANVS was, contrary to agreements, not actively informed by the Belgian authorities about the leak at the Doel-1 nuclear plant.
Door een administratieve vergissing was de ANVS, tegen de afspraken in, niet actief door de Belgische autoriteiten geïnformeerd over het opgetreden lek in de kerncentrale Doel-1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over de bevindingen van de onderzoekscommissie Gezondheidsklachten Ter Apel

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked whether the government would answer earlier questions on health complaints among COA staff at Ter Apel now that the investigative commission has reported, and whether it endorses its conclusions and what technical and psychosocial measures will follow. The Secretary of State endorses the commission's conclusions, reports that COA has begun cleaning, ventilation and lighting fixes with monitoring planned, and describes conversations with staff to restore trust.
I endorse the recommendations and conclusions of the investigative commission.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen en conclusies van de onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de douane controle Eurostar

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked why preparations for border controls at Dutch stations for a direct Eurostar service to London were not started sooner, what faster bilateral options exist, how much Marechaussee capacity is needed, and why a transfer in Brussels is safer than Dutch controls. The government replied that a Four-Party Treaty and related agreements are being pursued with a target of 2019 and a direct service from the 2020 timetable, with Marechaussee staffing still to be recruited and passengers transferring in Brussels until then.
The Dutch government's aim is to have all international agreements realised by the end of 2019, so that Eurostar can expect to offer a direct Amsterdam-London connection from the 2020 timetable.

De inzet van de Nederlandse overheid is alle internationale afspraken eind 2019 gerealiseerd te hebben, zodat Eurostar naar verwachting vanaf dienstregeling 2020 een directe verbinding van Amsterdam naar Londen kan gaan aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het dumpen van vervuild slib uit het buitenland in een Nederlandse recreatieplas

MP Dik-Faber asked the minister whether foreign contaminated sludge dumped in a Dutch recreational lake meets Dutch standards, how it is monitored, and whether Rijkswaterstaat can enforce it. The State Secretary replied that foreign material must meet the same Besluit bodemkwaliteit standards, that Rijkswaterstaat and water boards supervise and inspect via notification and sampling, and that the framework will be carried into the Omgevingswet.
I intend to incorporate this assessment framework into the Environment and Planning Act through general rules.
Ik heb het voornemen om dit toetsingskader in de Omgevingswet op te nemen door middel van algemene regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er veel meer afval in de Stille Oceaan ronddrijft dan werd aangenomen en dat bijna de helft van deze vervuiling bestaat uit visnetten

An MP asked the government about a Nature study showing far more ocean plastic in the Pacific than assumed, with fishing nets making up nearly half, and whether this implies similar underestimates in the North Sea, what fishing-gear waste is found on Dutch beaches, whether the Green Deal on clean fishing is working, and what further measures are planned. The minister answered that North Sea findings cannot be translated directly, that net and rope waste is the largest category on Dutch beaches, that the Green Deal shows progress, and that new EU port reception rules and international initiatives are planned, but gave no new binding measures.
I acknowledge the need for a vigorous approach to reducing plastic litter in the marine environment.
Ik onderken de noodzaak van een voortvarende aanpak om plastic zwerfvuil in het mariene milieu terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de nieuwe tariefstructuur van de IC Amsterdam – Brussel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the new fare structure for the Intercity Amsterdam–Brussels, including price changes by booking time, timing, the seven-day early-booking window, effects on spontaneous trips, and cross-border rail options. The State Secretary answered that NS sets the fares within concession frameworks, that she has reservations about the seven-day window and asked NS to bring the evaluation forward to three months after introduction, and that she will assess the effects on travel behaviour in that evaluation.
NS cannot currently say whether most travellers will face a price increase or decrease, because this depends on how far in advance the trip is booked and when it takes place.
NS kan op dit moment niet zeggen of voor de meeste reizigers sprake is van een prijsstijging of een -daling, omdat dit afhangt van de termijn van het boeken van de reis, en van het moment van reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Luchtwassers werken veel slechter dan gedacht'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government whether odour and air scrubbers perform worse than assumed, why the research report had not been published, and whether it would be released immediately. The government confirmed the study was finished, said single scrubbers met regulatory values while combination scrubbers performed considerably lower, and stated the report and a policy response had been sent to parliament on 3 April 2018.
The performance of the single-stage air scrubbers was in line with the values set out in the regulations.
De prestaties van de enkelvoudige luchtwassers kwamen overeen met de in de regelgeving opgenomen waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten over verontreinigde grond met PFOS en PFOA bij Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of PFOS and PFOA contaminated soil at Schiphol, including why it was not treated earlier, the risks, whether a national norm is needed, and whether firefighting foam with PFOA is still used. The state secretary answered that the contamination is mostly light and below RIVM risk limits, that soil policy is decentralised to municipalities and provinces, that a national norm was not pursued, and that EU rules will ban PFOA in foams from June 2020.
In the 2008 incident a leak releasing firefighting foam was the cause of the contamination, not the use of firefighting agents.
Bij het incident in 2008 was een lekkage waarbij blusschuim vrijkwam de oorzaak van de verontreiniging, en niet het gebruik van brandblusmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat asbest is vrijgekomen uit een vrachtwagen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a spill of asbestos from a truck that closed the A4 motorway, including the rules for transporting asbestos and whether the transport complied. The State Secretary answered that the transport could not be traced to a private or professional carrier, that the waste was packed in suitable film, and that the rules and information are adequate.
By the time the report reached Rijkswaterstaat, it could no longer be determined which vehicle the asbestos came from.
Op het moment dat de melding binnenkwam bij Rijkswaterstaat was niet meer te achterhalen van welk voertuig het asbest afkomstig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat perfluorisobuteen (PFIB) is vrijgekomen bij Chemours

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the release of PFIB at Chemours, the adequacy of the reporting regime after supervision moved to DCMR, the safety of emissions near residential areas, worker exposure, and the status of municipal cost claims. The government answered that the release was very small and likely harmless outside the site, that the reporting regime was unchanged, that emissions meet the minimisation duty and MTR, and that no lawsuit yet exists.
The company has a few weeks to supply this data.
Het bedrijf heeft enkele weken om deze gegevens aan te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verhoging geluidswal langs A20 bij Maassluis in zicht’

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about persistent noise nuisance from the A20 near Maassluis, whether Rijkswaterstaat's compliance calculations account for the 130 km/h limit, and why no mitigation has been taken. The minister answers that noise stays within the statutory production ceilings based on prescribed calculations validated by RIVM, that the municipality owns the noise wall and must initiate raising it, and that Rijkswaterstaat will then cooperate.
If the municipality takes the initiative to raise the noise wall, Rijkswaterstaat will cooperate with it.
Indien de gemeente het initiatief neemt om de geluidswal op te hogen zal Rijkswaterstaat medewerking hieraan verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over asbest bij onderhoud en renovatie van huurwoningen

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked about tenants' rights during renovations of rental housing, including asbestos removal, relocation housing, and whether asbestos removal in Utrecht Overvecht was done without adequate protection. The government answered that tenants have a strong legal position, that landlords must ensure safety and assess asbestos, that disputes can go to court, and that it declines to share inspection reports, which the municipalities or housing corporation control.
It is up to the municipalities or housing corporation Portaal to share the reports with third parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten of woningbouwcorporatie Portaal om de rapporten met derden te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Wörsdorfer over het bericht  ‘Wirwar van gemeentelijke milieuzones groeit: automobilist kan Maastricht straks alleen nog met milieusticker in’

MPs Ziengs and Wörsdorfer asked about the growing patchwork of municipal environmental zones, including Maastricht's sticker system that affects motorists and entrepreneurs. The State Secretary agreed a uniform system is undesirable, deferred the balancing of interests to municipalities, and committed to a meeting with municipalities and the VNG and to uniform signage by 1 January 2020.
I have invited the new municipal executives and the VNG to sit down together on this matter.
Ik heb de nieuwe gemeentebestuurders en de VNG uitgenodigd om hierover om tafel te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de berichten dat oude diesels niet meer welkom zijn in Arnhem en Maastricht

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about Arnhem and Maastricht introducing municipal low-emission zones that exclude old diesels, and whether this fits the coalition agreement and risks a patchwork of local zones. The state secretary replied that she will agree nationwide harmonisation with municipalities and the VNG before summer, that municipalities keep the power to set zones, and committed to improving collection of foreign fines.
It remains the municipality's competence to decide whether and where a low-emission zone is introduced and to what extent it is proportionate as a measure to improve air quality.
Het blijft de bevoegdheid van de gemeente om te bepalen of en waar een milieuzone wordt ingevoerd en in hoeverre deze proportioneel is als maatregel om luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over trillingsoverlast door het spoor bij Rosmalen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about vibration nuisance from the raised railway line at Rosmalen, which residents say was caused by the 2010-2012 Zuid-Willemsvaart realignment works. The government answered that a postdiction study found it unlikely that vibrations rose by more than 30% overall, but that three homes may be affected, so mitigation options are being examined, and that the ministry remains in talks with residents.

Based on the postdiction study, I want to examine for three homes whether effective measures can be taken, because it cannot be ruled out that a noticeable increase in vibrations occurred due to the adjustment of the railway.

Op basis van het postdictie-onderzoek wil ik bij drie woningen onderzoeken of er doelmatige maatregelen te treffen zijn omdat niet is uit te sluiten dat hier een voelbare toename van trillingen is opgetreden door de aanpassing van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over geluidsoverlast door verouderde geluidsschermen langs de A28 bij Harderwijk

An MP asked about noise and fine-particle nuisance from the A28 at Harderwijk, including whether noise ceilings are exceeded, why new barriers must be much higher than old ones, and whether replacement can happen sooner and be coordinated with local authorities. The minister said ceilings are not exceeded, explained the different legal regimes, said replacement is planned after 2020 at the same height pending a sanering study, and offered to consult with the municipality and province while the MIRT study focuses first on traffic issues.
Furthermore, I am certainly willing to think along with the municipality and province about the local situation.
Verder ben ik zeker bereid om mee te denken met de gemeente en provincie over de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Groningen en Drenthe in gevaar door falende aanpak bij catastrofe kerncentrale Lingen Case’

MPs Van Tongeren and Moorlag asked the Dutch state secretary about reports that emergency plans for the Lingen nuclear plant in Germany were outdated and that evacuation planning did not cover Dutch residents. The government answered that the German plan is being updated (expected 2019), that evacuation zones lie entirely on German territory, that bilateral consultation continues, and that Dutch national plans were updated in 2017 with the Lingen plan revised in 2015 and a new version due end 2018.
Coordination with our neighbouring countries on cooperation in crisis management of nuclear accidents is of great importance to me.
Afstemming met onze buurlanden over samenwerking bij de crisisbeheersing van kernongevallen vind ik van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het rapport 'OPERA Safety Case'

An MP asked the state secretary about the OPERA Safety Case report on final disposal of radioactive waste in Boom clay, questioning whether safety had been demonstrated, whether COVRA should coordinate follow-up research, and who bears the cost. The government answered that the report is an initial safety case, that full safety assessment will come later under ANVS, and that polluter-pays principles and COVRA's cost structure apply, while an integrated policy response is promised later this year.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, the OPERA Safety Case is an initial Safety Case in a series of Safety Cases that will follow up to the moment of licence application.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is de OPERA Safety Case een initiële Safety Case in een reeks van Safety Cases die gaan volgen tot het moment van vergunningaanvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Producten van nieuwe genetische modificatietechnieken moeten strikt als GGO gereguleerd worden’ van het European Network of Scientists for Social and Environmenta

An MP asked the government to comment on an ENSSER article calling for strict GMO regulation of new genetic modification techniques, including off-target effects, biohacking, miniaturisation and bioterrorism risks. The government welcomed the scientific debate, said existing licensing and risk assessment cover these risks, and announced a separate letter on modernising biotechnology regulation.
Your House will shortly be informed in a separate letter about the progress of the modernisation process.
Uw Kamer wordt binnenkort in een separate brief geïnformeerd over de voortgang van het moderniseringstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over een fiscale regeling voor (elektrische) fietsen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Infrastructure and Finance about encouraging cycling for commuting, the tax treatment of company leasing of bicycles versus cars, and whether tax rules would be changed. The government answered that it supports cycling promotion with employers, that the valuation of private use of company bicycles lacks a flat-rate rule, and that a simpler rule is being examined with the industry for inclusion in Belastingplan 2019.
For this reason, the government is currently examining, in consultation with the industry (including RAI Vereniging), how a clear and simple tax scheme can be designed.
Daarom wordt momenteel in overleg met de branche (waaronder RAI Vereniging) onderzocht op welke wijze een duidelijke en eenvoudige fiscale regeling kan worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de slechte bereikbaarheid van Ameland via de veerverbinding Holwerd-Ameland

An MP asked about poor ferry reliability between Holwerd and Ameland, including progress on the short-term measures agreed in the Open Plan Process and a permanent solution after 2029. The minister replied that the measures are being implemented, with the bend cut expected in 2019, the second bend study delayed to Q2 2018, and a long-term options study still pending.
RWS expects the study and any decision on next steps to be completed in the second quarter of 2018.
RWS verwacht dat het onderzoek en het eventuele besluit over de te nemen vervolgstappen in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over ‘milieu-overtredende bedrijven die hiermee wegkomen’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the state secretary whether polluting companies escape accountability and influence government, and whether the ministry consults convicted firms on environmental law. The state secretary rejected the documentary's picture, said prosecutions followed in nearly all major incidents, defended consultation practice without a registration policy, and promised stricter checks that invited firms hold valid environmental permits.
The cabinet has no policy line for dealing with convicted (directors of) companies in consultations on policy and legislation.
Het kabinet kent geen beleidslijn voor het omgaan met veroordeelde (bestuurders van) bedrijven bij consultaties voor beleid en wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Laçin over de toegankelijkheid van het station in Winsum

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why ProRail reversed its earlier plan for a ramp at Winsum station, which was presented in June 2017, and whether the higher cost estimate was credible. The state secretary replied that detailed design showed a ramp needed a costly new foundation (about €2 million), so ProRail chose a new lift (about €500,000) with similar accessibility, and that the cost estimate followed a standard, checked procedure.
ProRail therefore decided in September 2017 to improve accessibility at Winsum station by installing a new lift.
ProRail heeft daarom in september 2017 besloten om de toegankelijkheid van station Winsum te verbeteren door het plaatsen van een nieuwe lift.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de evaluatie van het project Schoon Belonen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the evaluation of the Schoon Belonen litter pilot, including its monitoring, municipal participation, scalability and whether it replaces a statiegeld (deposit) system. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the pilot failed the Chamber's conditions, pointed to independent Rijkswaterstaat monitoring and referred questions about participants' motives to the initiating organisations, while saying the pilot alone is insufficient for the petition motion and referring to a separate letter on the Raamovereenkomst.
For questions about participating organisations or municipalities and their motives, I refer you to the organisations named.
Voor vragen over deelnemende organisaties of gemeenten en hun beweegredenen verwijs ik u naar de genoemde organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat ProRail supersnelle treinen tussen Maastricht en Leeuwarden en de Randstad, zonder stops, wil realiseren

MP Amhaouch asked the State Secretary about press reports that ProRail wants non-stop superfast trains between Maastricht or Leeuwarden and the Randstad, asking about the basis, funding, business case and timeline. The State Secretary answered that the ideas were floated by ProRail in a press interview, that no concrete business case exists, that they will be assessed within the Toekomstbeeld OV 2040 process, and that no concrete plan or timetable is known.
A concrete business case for a non-stop train between the Randstad and Maastricht or Leeuwarden has not been developed by ProRail.
Een concrete businesscase voor een non-stop trein tussen de Randstad en Maastricht of Leeuwarden is niet bij ProRail ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Cijfers NRG: Pallas-reactor overbodig voor 98,8% nucleaire geneeskunde”

MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether the Pallas reactor's business case, based largely on technetium-99m, is undermined by alternative production methods such as accelerators and ASML's Lighthouse project, and what total subsidy is expected. The government answered that Pallas also targets therapeutic isotopes, that the business case is being re-examined before the final loan tranche, that a reactor remains needed for supply security, and that the Pallas loan is capped at 40 million euro for phase 1 with construction and operation intended to be privately financed.
For the decision on the last tranche of the loan that the State and the province of North Holland grant to Pallas, the business case will be reviewed again.
Ten behoeve van de besluitvorming over de laatste tranche van de lening die de Staat en de provincie Noord-Holland verlenen aan Pallas wordt de businesscase opnieuw bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Özütok over “de oproep van een toxicoloog dat werknemers van Custom Powders moeten worden getest op omstreden stof GenX”

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Custom Powders employees exposed to GenX should be tested, and whether the labour inspectorate had engaged the company. The State Secretary answered that exposure assessment and any blood testing are the employer's responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that the inspectorate visits such firms on a risk basis without discussing individual inspection results, and that it sees no reason to raise blood testing with the employer.
I will not go into the results of individual inspections.
Ik ga niet in op resultaten van individuele inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het 'groenste' kabinet nogal vuil rijdt

An MP asked why most ministers of the Rutte III cabinet are driven in fuel-inefficient cars despite the government's commitment to lead by example on sustainability. The government replied that six ministers currently use hybrids, that a Green Deal targets 20-25% electric vehicles in the central government fleet by 2020, and that it will accelerate the fleet transition, though each ministry is responsible for its own choices.

In consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (responsible for the civil service) and the State Secretary for Defence (responsible for the civil service vehicle procurement category), I will work on accelerating the transition to zero-emission vehicles across central government.

Ik zal in overleg met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid voor de Rijksdienst) en de Staatssecretaris van Defensie (vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid voor de inkoopcategorie civiele dienstauto's) werken aan het versnellen van de transitie naar zero emissie voertuigen door het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden voor een intercity-stop in Harderwijk

An MP asked whether the Royal HaskoningDHV study on an intercity stop at Harderwijk could be sent to parliament and how the government views its conclusion that such a stop is not feasible. The State Secretary said the report is not yet public and the government is not its owner, so it cannot be sent, and that NS, which decides the timetable, has no plans for intercity stops at Harderwijk.
I am not the commissioning party or owner of the report. It is therefore not possible for me to send the report to the House.
Ik ben niet de opdrachtgever of eigenaar van het rapport. Het is voor mij daarom niet mogelijk het rapport naar de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten in de media “GenX aangetroffen in afvalwater ATM Moerdijk” en “Bron GenX op zuivering Bath gevonden”

An MP asked about media reports that GenX was found in wastewater from ATM Moerdijk and at the Bath treatment plant, asking when ATM reported it, whether it may continue discharging, whether air and soil research is done, sanctions, worker protection and Chemours' disclosure of recipients. The minister answered that concentrations were very small, ATM voluntarily stopped accepting Chemours waste, the permit allows discharge, air/soil research is underway elsewhere, and the ILT requested Chemours' data.
The competent authority sees no reason to prohibit ATM from using this permit.
Het bevoegd gezag ziet geen aanleiding om ATM te verbieden gebruik te maken van deze vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Nijkerken-de Haan en Bosman over het bericht ‘Voorbereiding op kernramp kan beter’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about an OVV report finding that Dutch nuclear-disaster preparedness is largely on paper and little exercised, and about cooperation, iodine tablet distribution and evacuation planning with Belgium and Germany. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is constructive, that joint exercises are a priority (including a planned exercise with Belgium), that iodine rules were harmonised but differ in practice, and that regional safety boards will be consulted on cross-border risks.
The Dutch Safety Board finds in its report that the approach to a possible nuclear crisis is largely set down on paper but has been exercised only to a limited extent.

De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) stelt in haar rapport vast dat de aanpak van een eventuele nucleaire crisis goeddeels vastligt op papier maar dat de aanpak slechts in beperkte mate is geoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over de berichten dat make-up asbest bevat

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked the state secretary about reports that Claire's children's make-up contained asbestos, including whether ILT and NVWA had tested the products, how they relied on FDA and Health Canada data, and whether talc-related products are monitored. The government replied that ILT tested 28 Claire's products and found no asbestos, that NVWA relied on FDA findings and manufacturers bear primary responsibility, and that it would not request the private analysis reports but would act if asbestos-contaminated talc products were found.
I therefore see no reason at this time to request these reports.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om deze rapporten op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de wijzigingen van de prestatie-indicatoren voor NS

An MP asked the state secretary about NS (Dutch railways) changing its key performance indicators for seat availability on the HSL, and whether the change avoided a third strike under the concession. The state secretary answered that the old indicator scores were below the floor value in 2015 and 2016, that 2017 data under the old method were not calculated, and that the new indicator (91.2% floor) was the basis for judgment from 2017 onward, with the official 2017 figures to follow by 1 March 2018.
I assess NS from 2017 on the performance indicator 'seat availability in the HSL peak'.
Ik beoordeel NS vanaf 2017 op de prestatie-indicator «zitplaatskans in de spits HSL».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het goederenvervoer tussen Hamont, Budel en Weert

An MP asked whether the Hamont-Budel-Weert freight line meets safety requirements, whether unguarded level crossings there will be included in the dangerous-crossings programme, and when the line will be reactivated for passenger transport. The state secretary answered that the line meets applicable safety rules, that ProRail found no extra crossing measures needed given the very low train frequency, and that a decision on passenger reactivation is targeted for 2018 pending cost clarity and operator consultation.
I will inform the House in the spring about the implementation of the Van der Graaf et al. motion.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Jetten over wisselstoringen op het spoor door het winterweer in december

MPs Amhaouch and Jetten asked the state secretary about rail switch failures during the December 2017 winter weather, including preparation, back-up plans, evaluation, information provision and oversight of ProRail and NS. The state secretary said the cause cannot yet be determined pending the evaluation by ProRail and NS, committed to sending evaluations to parliament, and argued that internalised winter practices make ministerial steering a premature conclusion to draw.
I think it is premature to draw this conclusion. I will first await the evaluation by NS and ProRail, the lessons they draw from it and the changes they will make to their approach.

Ik vind het te voorbarig om deze conclusie te trekken. Ik wacht eerst de evaluatie van NS en ProRail af, de lessen die ze op basis daarvan trekken en de wijzigingen die ze in hun aanpak gaan doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Geen OV op Oudejaarsavond’

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that public transport largely stops from 20:00 on New Year's Eve, including at Schiphol, and what steps will be taken. The state secretary acknowledges the wish to reconsider the longstanding arrangement, says there is no data on demand, and will raise the issue at the national public transport table with other authorities and operators, promising to report back.
I am therefore willing to explore whether travellers would be helped by public transport during the New Year period.
Ik ben dan ook graag bereid te verkennen of de reizigers geholpen zouden zijn met openbaar vervoer tijdens de jaarwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de enorme vertraging van de ombouw van de Hoekse Lijn tot lightrail

An MP asked the state secretary why the conversion of the Hoekse Lijn to light rail was delayed beyond the promised September 2017 opening, who is accountable, and about secrecy and cost overruns. The secretary answered that the regional authority MRDH is responsible for the line, that the new target is Q4 2018 due to late software and cable delays, and that the MRDH, not the ministry, bears the extra costs (up to 90 million euro).
I have no special responsibility for the Hoekse Lijn.
Ik heb geen bijzondere verantwoordelijkheid voor de Hoekse Lijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Jetten over het gebruik van de OV-fiets

MPs Sienot and Jetten (D66) asked the state secretary about low OV-bike use after bus and metro trips and whether NS should expand OV-bike rental beyond stations. The state secretary attributes low use to short walking distances, supports broader OV-bike availability, and commits to talks with concession holders and pilots on station bicycle parking.
Yes. I am happy to talk with public transport concession holders about the opportunities for shared bicycles as part of a smooth door-to-door journey for travellers.
Ja. Ik ga graag met ov-concessiehouders in gesprek over de kansen voor deelfietsen als onderdeel van een soepele deur-tot-deur-reis voor reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over pvc in verpakkingen

An MP asked the state secretary why PVC packaging still appears in household waste despite its known harms, and what can be done to phase it out and make packaging more recyclable. The government answered that there is no legal ban, that supermarkets have agreed under the Raamovereenkomst Verpakkingen to phase out PVC packaging, and that producer responsibility and essential requirements are the main tools, with some innovation commitments but no new binding measures.
There is no ban or any other legal obligation to phase out PVC, but the aim is of course to keep poorly recyclable packaging on the market as little as possible.
Er is geen sprake van een verbod of enige andere wettelijk verplichting om pvc uit te bannen, maar de wens is uiteraard om slecht recyclebare verpakkingen zo min mogelijk op de markt te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de detectieproblematiek op de trajecten tussen Gouda en Alphen aan den Rijn en Oldenzaal en de Duitse grens

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary about detection problems for new trains on the Gouda–Alphen aan den Rijn and Oldenzaal–German border lines, including a binding commission ruling that ProRail must bear infrastructure detection costs on Gouda–Alphen and whether the same applies to Oldenzaal. The State Secretary confirmed the binding advice, stated it does not automatically set precedent for other lines, and said the Oldenzaal costs remain for the province of Overijssel under a 2014 agreement.
I therefore want to emphasise that no automatic conclusions can be drawn about how any infrastructure detection measures on other routes will be financed.
Ik hecht er daarom aan te benadrukken dat er niet automatisch conclusies getrokken kunnen worden voor de wijze van financiering van eventuele infrastructurele detectiemaatregelen op andere trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuws dat inwoners van Warmenhuizen al 25 jaar op sterk vervuilde bodem leven

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that residents of Warmenhuizen have lived on heavily contaminated soil for 25 years, asking how authorities missed it, whether laws are deficient, whether other sites are unnoticed, and whether RIVM should study health links. The state secretary answered that the site was remediated and deemed suitable for housing, that a new study found no unacceptable risks, that existing law gives authorities adequate tools, and that no new national inventory or RIVM study is currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to carry out a further inventory of contamination.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om een nadere inventarisatie naar verontreinigingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat asbest is vrijgekomen bij een brand in Goeree Overflakkee

An SP MP asked about asbestos released by a warehouse fire in Melissant, the extent of spread, the municipal information efforts, demolition and sanitation, national registration of asbestos fires, and whether high costs of certified asbestos roof removal could cause evasion. The government said the spread was limited, the municipality followed guidelines and is supervising demolition, no national registration exists, and it does not share the fear of evasion given municipal enforcement powers and a subsidy scheme.
Such a national overview is not available.
Een dergelijk landelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'De overheid is de regie kwijt in het bestrijden van overlast van ratten'

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about reports that government has lost control of rat control, including the health risks, the RIVM rat monitoring, WHO advice, the status of an initiative group, the effectiveness of integrated pest management and public information for households. The ministers answered that three ministries share responsibility, that no national plague or clear rise in rat-related disease is visible, that existing legal frameworks cover prevention, and that monitoring, a planned effectiveness study and consumer information are under way.
Three ministries jointly lead the control of rat nuisance.
Er zijn drie ministeries die gezamenlijk regie voeren op het bestrijden van overlast van ratten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Greenpeace beschuldigt Nederlandse bedrijven van handel in 'bloedhout''

MP De Groot (D66) asked the ministers whether Brazilian timber from Para, Mato Grosso and Rondonia should be treated as high risk, whether NVWA enforcement will be strengthened, and how illegal timber can be kept off the Dutch market after Greenpeace accused Dutch firms of trading illegally logged hardwood. Minister Schouten answered that illegality is widespread in Brazilian forestry, that the NVWA is sharpening its intervention policy from early 2018, that enforcement capacity will be reviewed without firm commitment, and that the primary responsibility lies with importers, so illegal timber cannot be fully excluded.
Instead of always warning first, the NVWA will directly impose an order subject to a penalty for certain serious violations.
In plaats van altijd eerst waarschuwen zal de NVWA bij bepaalde, zware overtredingen direct een last onder dwangsom opleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht ‘Driekwart gemeenten koopt nog vervuilend vervoer’

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked whether municipalities have the expertise and priority to buy sustainable vehicles, after a Natuur & Milieu benchmark found most municipalities lag behind national procurement criteria. The State Secretary attributes gaps to limited knowledge, priority and divided responsibility, points to existing MVI support tools, and says she will discuss stimulating municipalities with the VNG and PIANOo without making binding commitments.
I am happy to discuss with the VNG and PIANOo how we can further encourage municipalities to improve this.
Ik ben er graag toe bereid om met de VNG en PIANOo te bespreken hoe we gemeenten nog meer kunnen stimuleren om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het rapport Breaking the Barriers to the Circular Economy

An MP asked the state secretary about the report 'Breaking the Barriers to the Circular Economy', including low virgin-material prices, consumer knowledge and behaviour change, and how the Grondstoffenakkoord reduces total material use. The state secretary said the bottlenecks are taken seriously, pointed to forthcoming transition agendas, a monitoring system and annual progress reports, and described government circular procurement efforts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de concurrentie op het spoor

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a Telegraaf report on German operator Arriva's call to liberalise all Dutch public transport, and how this squares with a 2011 study finding that splitting rail services from the main network harms passengers. The State Secretary answered that stakeholders may voice their interests, that the 2020 choice on rail market structure will be made carefully and in consultation, and that passenger interests come first while taxpayer interests also matter.
I view the Arriva director's statements as a wish from one of the stakeholders to liberalise public transport.
Ik zie de uitspraken van de directeur van Arriva als een wens van een van de belanghebbenden om het openbaar vervoer te liberaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de verbinding tussen Groningen en Bremen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the German coalition agreement mentioning the Wunderline rail link between Groningen and Bremen, EU funding, and weak soil along the route. The State Secretary answered that a joint steering group will decide on improvement measures by end 2018, that the EU has committed EUR 8.3 million for preparatory work, and that alternative solutions may be needed depending on a soil second opinion.
The intention is that the steering group will take a decision on the improvement measures by the end of 2018, based on the decision information then to be delivered.
Het is de bedoeling dat in deze stuurgroep eind 2018 een besluit wordt genomen over de verbetermaatregelen op basis van de dan op te leveren beslisinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat de Belgische kerncentrale Doel opnieuw stil is gelegd

MPs asked the state secretary about the extended shutdown of Belgian nuclear reactor Doel 3, whether concrete degradation is the cause, which safety regions have emergency plans for nuclear incidents, and whether the government will press Belgium to close the plant. The state secretary answered that the shutdown was extended for concrete reinforcement work, that safety oversight lies with Belgian regulators, and that the government will focus on cooperation and better information for residents rather than demanding closure.
That is why I currently prefer to focus on cooperation with Belgium, on improved information provision and on involving residents on the Dutch side.
Daarom richt ik mij op dit moment liever op de samenwerking met België, aan verbeterde informatievoorziening en betrokkenheid van omwonende aan Nederlandse kant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat er een lek is geweest bij een Duitse kerncentrale

An SP MP asked the Dutch government about a reported leak at the German Emsland nuclear plant near Emmen, including its safety classification, whether ANVS would investigate, cross-border cooperation and whether the plant should be closed early. The state secretary answered that the leak was a minor INES-0 event affecting non-radioactive cooling water, that ANVS would not conduct its own investigation as the incident occurred abroad, and that nuclear safety is a German national responsibility.
No. The ANVS indicates it does not have the impression that the German supervisor and the license holder are failing to fulfil their responsibility in this unusual event.
Nee. De ANVS geeft aan niet het beeld te hebben dat de Duitse toezichthouder en de vergunninghouder in deze ongewone gebeurtenis hun verantwoordelijkheid niet goed invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sjoerdsma over bureaucratie bij het aanvragen van een genderneutrale ov-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why applying for a gender-neutral OV-chipkaart involved bureaucracy, and whether such a card should be offered. The state secretary answered that the sector committed to dropping the m/v gender marker on all new cards from 1 January 2017, with NS cards following by 20 December 2017, and that she welcomes this and supports gender-neutral cards.
That is why I am glad that very soon, without bureaucratic obstacles, no m/v marking will be visible on any new OV-chipkaarts.
Daarom ben ik blij dat er zeer binnenkort zonder bureaucratische drempels op alle nieuwe OV-chipkaarten geen m/v vermelding meer zichtbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over elektromagnetische velden en elektrohypersensitiviteit

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands takes fewer precautions on electromagnetic radiation than other countries, how the health council's advice on mobile phones is implemented, whether guidelines are possible, whether non-thermal cellular effects are considered, whether electrohypersensitivity is rising, and whether stakeholders can be brought back to the knowledge platform. The state secretary answered that Dutch policy follows the EU recommendation and ICNIRP limits, that a cohort study continues, that no binding measures are planned because evidence is weak, that electrohypersensitivity is not tracked in recent health outlooks, and that the platform aims at a broad public rather than one stakeholder group.
Following the health council's advice, I have decided, together with the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate, to continue the ongoing cohort research in this field after 2017.

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Gezondheidsraad heb ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, besloten om het lopende cohortonderzoek op dit terrein na 2017 voort te laten zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraken van de president-directeur van ProRail over spoorlopers

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether ProRail's chief executive's remarks that train drivers should brake less quickly for track trespassers were irresponsible, whether he would ask the CEO to retract them, and what measures would reduce trespassing. The state secretary said safety comes first, that driver instructions are the responsibility of operators, that ProRail alone must decide on retracting its CEO's statements, and pointed to existing enforcement and anti-trespass measures.
The chief executive of ProRail decides for himself whether or not to retract his statements.
De president-directeur van ProRail gaat zelf over het al dan niet terugnemen van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oude dieselauto’s niet meer welkom in Arnhemse binnenstad’

An MP asked the state secretary about Arnhem's plan to exclude older diesel cars from the city centre, questioning the measurement basis, the lack of uniform low-emission zone signage, and the proportionality of local measures. The state secretary replied that the Arnhem council has asked for further study of the measure's effectiveness, that a uniform national zone system will be decided before summer 2018, and that a bottleneck analysis of NO2 sources is underway.
It is my express aim to give clarity as soon as possible (before summer 2018) on how I intend to give substance to this, so that municipalities can take it into account.
Het is mijn nadrukkelijk streven zo snel mogelijk (voor de zomer van 2018) uitsluitsel te geven op welke wijze ik hier invulling aan wil geven, zodat gemeenten hier rekening mee kunnen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de opkoopregeling van Groningse huizen niet eerlijk is verlopen

MP Van Veldhoven asked whether the Minister recognises the National Ombudsman's finding that the Groningen home buy-out scheme was not handled fairly, and what will be done about unclear complaint handling and communication. The Minister said he takes the Ombudsman's recommendation seriously but does not share the conclusion on complaint handling, points to a TU Delft evaluation of the pilot, and says the recommendations will be incorporated into the follow-up buy-out scheme.
I take his recommendation very seriously and will ensure there is sufficient clarity for residents in any follow-up.
Ik neem zijn aanbeveling dan ook zeer serieus zal er op toezien dat er bij een vervolg voldoende helderheid is voor bewoners.

m: Amendement van de leden Tang en Irrgang betreffende een aanvulling op de bepaling die tegenstrijdig belang tegengaat
Requires executive directors to freeze the value of their company shares around mergers or takeovers and pay any gain back to the company.
This amendment aims to supplement the provision that prevents conflicts of interest
Dit amendement beoogt een aanvulling te zijn op de bepaling die tegenstrijdig belang tegengaat
Amendement van de leden Tang en Sap over het beperken van de teruggaafregeling voor taxi's en het stimuleren van bedrijfsmatige verhuurders tot energiezuiniger maken van bestaand woningbestand
Limits the BPM refund for taxis by withholding part of the CO2-based tax and redirects the proceeds to an energy-investment deduction for landlords.
Firstly, a restriction of the BPM refund scheme for taxis is provided for in the Motor Vehicle Tax Act 1992.
In de eerste plaats wordt een beperking van de teruggaafregeling voor taxi’s in de Wet op de belasting van personenauto’s en motorrijwielen 1992 (BPM) geregeld.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Tang en Sap ter vervanging van nr. 48 over het beperken van de teruggaafregeling voor taxi's en het stimuleren van bedrijfsmatige verhuurders tot energiezuiniger make
Limits the BPM refund for taxis by withholding part of the CO2-based tax and changes the energy investment deduction for landlords.
For taxis, there has so far been no incentive to purchase fuel-efficient cars.
Bij taxi’s ontbreekt tot nu toe nog de prikkel om zuinige auto’s aan te schaffen.
Amendement van de leden Tang Omtzigt ter vervanging van nr. 15 over een vrijstelling in box 3 voor de belastingplichtige met beleggingen in startende of doorgroeiende MKB-ondernemingen
Adds a box 3 tax discount for investments in SME shares and SME funds, with a matching levy on later sale.
The discount for SME investments amounts to 7.5% of what the taxpayer has paid in on shares issued in the calendar year
De korting voor MKB-beleggingen bedraagt 7,5% van hetgeen door de belastingplichtige op de in het kalenderjaar geëmitteerde aandelen is gestort
Amendement van de leden Tang en Omtzigt over een vrijstelling in box 3 voor de belastingplichtige met beleggingen in startende of doorgroeiende MKB-ondernemingen
Adds a box 3 tax discount for investments in SME shares, with eligibility for SME funds set by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute.
By ministerial regulation, rules are laid down on the designation and withdrawal of the designation.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de aanwijzing en de intrekking van de aanwijzing.
Amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Tang over een extra korting voor aardgasauto's
Amendment changing vehicle registration tax (BPM) reductions for natural gas and diesel cars in the Tax Plan 2010.
The tax amount under the table is reduced by 500 euro for a passenger car whose CO2 emissions are measured with natural gas as fuel
Het bedrag van de belasting op grond van de tabel wordt verminderd met € 500 in geval van een personenauto waarvan de CO 2 -uitstoot met aardgas als brandstof is gemeten
Amendement van de leden Tang en Omtzigt over het afschaffen van het lage tarief voor gevaarlijke afvalstoffen
Abolishes the low tax rate for hazardous waste dumping and uses the provision for a new facility to dig up old landfills.
To make dumping hazardous waste more expensive, the low rate for hazardous waste is abolished.
Om het storten van gevaarlijk afval duurder te maken, wordt de toepassing van het lage tarief voor gevaarlijke afvalstoffen als bedoeld in artikel 1.1, eerste lid, van de Wet milieubeheer afgeschaft.
Motie-Omtzigt c.s. over inventariseren van belastingen en toeslagen die de keuze om te trouwen of te scheiden beïnvloeden
Asks the government to inventory cases where taxes, allowances and income-dependent schemes affect the choice to marry or register a partnership, and propose fixes by 1 May 2010.
requests the government to inventory all cases in which taxes, allowances and other income-dependent schemes could influence the purity of the choice
verzoekt de regering alle gevallen te inventariseren waarbij belastingen, toeslagen en andere inkomensafhankelijke regelingen de zuiverheid van de keuze zouden kunnen beïnvloeden
Motie-Tang c.s. over bij succes na 1 december 2010 voortzetten van de energie-investeringsaftrek voor verhuurders
Asks the government to continue the energy investment deduction for landlords after 1 December 2010 if the scheme proves successful, funded from the hazardous waste tax revenue.
requests the government, if the scheme is successful, to continue it after 1 December 2010
verzoekt de regering als de regeling succesvol is, deze na 1 december 2010 voort te zetten
Motie-Omtzigt c.s. over voorstellen om SBBI's zo veel mogelijk te ondersteunen en zo min mogelijk te belasten
Asks the government to consult umbrella organisations of charitable social-benefit institutions and present proposals to support and minimise burdens on them by 1 April 2010.
requests the government to consult relevant umbrella organisations of SBBIs and come up with proposals in consultation.
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met relevante koepelorganisaties van SBBI’s en in samenspraak met voorstellen te komen
Motie-Tang c.s. over een eventuele schuif met de energiebelasting op aardgas
Asks the government to consider, if the evaluation of Schoon en Zuinig shows extra measures are needed, a macro-neutral but substantial shift of the energy tax on natural gas in 2010.
requests the government, if the evaluation shows additional measures are needed, to consider a macro cost-neutral but substantial shift in the energy tax on natural gas as a serious option in 2010

verzoekt de regering indien blijkt bij de evaluatie dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn, een voor de burger macro lastenneutrale maar substantiële schuif met de energiebelasting op aardgas als serieuze optie nog in 2010 te overwegen
Motie-Koser Kaya c.s. over de consequenties van een leefvormneutraal belastingstelsel
Asks the government to investigate how to make the tax system neutral regarding living arrangements and what the consequences would be.
asks the government to investigate what is needed to make the tax system living-arrangement neutral.
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken wat er moet gebeuren om het belastingstelsel leefvormneutraal te maken
Amendement van het lid Tang c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 26 over het afschaffen van het lage tarief voor gevaarlijke afvalstoffen
Replaces an amendment to abolish the low tariff for hazardous waste dumping and reuses the provision to introduce a facility for excavating old landfills.
Replacement due to change in signature.
Vervanging in verband met wijziging van de ondertekening.
Motie-Tang c.s. over op nihil stellen van het rentevoordeel van een personeelslening in de werkkostenregeling
Asks the government to set the interest benefit on staff loans for bicycles and e-bikes to zero within the employer expense regime and evaluate bicycle use.
requests the government to set the interest benefit of a staff loan in the employer expense scheme to zero for these means of transport
verzoekt de regering om het rentevoordeel van een personeelslening in de werkkostenregeling op nihil te stellen voor genoemde transportmiddelen
Motie Omtzigt/Tang over vaststellen van de standaardboete bij aangifteverzuim op €227
Asks the government to keep the standard penalty for failure to file tax returns at no more than 227 euros rather than raising it to nearly 500.
requests the government not to set the standard fine for failure to file above 227 euros in the administrative fines decree
verzoekt de regering de standaardboete bij aangifteverzuim in het Besluit Bestuurlijke Boeten Belastingdienst niet hoger vast te stellen dan € 227
Amendement van de leden Omtzigt en Tang over de correctie van de accijns op duurzame E85 op basis van de gemiddelde energiewaarde van E85
Amends the excise act to refund part of the excise on sustainably produced E85 to correct for its lower energy content.
With this amendment the excise on sustainable E85 is corrected for this difference in energy content based on the average energy value of E85.
Met dit amendement wordt de accijns op duurzame E85 voor dit verschil in energie-inhoud gecorrigeerd op basis van de gemiddelde energiewaarde van E85.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Tang c.s. ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 56 over het gelijk behandelen van (stief)kinderen
Amends the Succession Act and excise rates so that stepchildren of cohabiting partners are treated like stepchildren of married couples, with lower bracket threshold and higher wine excise.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Cramer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 53 om in de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling een drempel op te nemen
Amends the business succession exemption in the inheritance tax, raising the full exemption for business assets up to a threshold and adjusting the objective enterprise rules.
This amendment is amended in connection with a legislative-technical adjustment.
Dit amendement wordt gewijzigd in verband met een wetgevingstechnische aanpassing.
Amendement van het lid Cramer c.s. dat regelt dat de grondslag voor auto’s die jonger zijn dan 25 jaar, maar ouder dan 15 jaar, de waarde in het economische verkeer van de auto blijft
Restores the valuation basis for company cars aged 15 to 25 years to their market value, reversing a tax change; a fiscal rule affecting taxpayers, not executive checks.
Amendement van het lid Tang over het mede van toepassing laten zijn van de defiscalisering als bedoeld in artikel 5.4 van de Wet op de inkomstenbelasting 2001 op bepaalde personen
Amendment extending the tax treatment under art. 5.4 IB 2001 to a cohabiting partner who kept a common household with the deceased, for estates before 2012.
After all, the cohabiting partner of the testator referred to there could not have taken into account the introduction of article 1a, fourth, fifth and sixth paragraphs, of the Successiewet 1956.
Immers, de aldaar bedoelde samenwonende partner van de erflater heeft geen rekening kunnen houden met de invoering van artikel 1a, vierde, vijfde en zesde lid, van de Successiewet 1956.
Motie Tang over onmiddellijke werking van een samenlevingscontract
Asks the government to give a notarial cohabitation contract the same immediate effect for inheritance tax as marriage, removing a six-month waiting period.
requests the government to give a cohabitation contract with duty of care the same immediate effect for inheritance tax
verzoekt de regering om een samenlevingscontract met zorgplicht voor het successierecht eenzelfde onmiddellijke werking te geven
Motie Koser Kaya c.s. over betrekken van de positie van alleenstaanden in het onderzoek van de belastingscommissie
Asks the government to explicitly include single persons and other modern living arrangements in the Van Weeghel tax committee study and examine how the inheritance tax law fits them.
requests the government to explicitly include the position of single persons and other modern living arrangements in the study of the tax committee
verzoekt de regering de positie van de alleenstaanden en andere moderne samenlevingsvormen expliciet mee te nemen in het onderzoek van de belastingcommissie
Motie Tang en Omtzigt over een goedkope manier om een partnerschap aan te gaan
Asks the government to contact the VNG and develop a low-cost, low-threshold way to register a partnership with public notice.
requests the government to contact the VNG promptly and draft a proposal for a low-threshold, cheap way to enter a partnership

verzoekt de regering op korte termijn in contact te treden met de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten en een voorstel uit te werken voor een laagdrempelige, goedkope manier om een partnerschap aan te gaan
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over een register voor toegelaten instellingen

Asks the government to set up, in consultation with the sector, a register of approved institutions by March 2010 so donors are assured of no inheritance tax, and to propose further support for such bodies.
requests the government, in consultation with the field, to provide such a register by 1 March 2010

Requests the government to introduce a regulation that lays down this responsibility.
verzoekt de regering een regeling in te voeren die deze verantwoordelijkheid vastlegt
Motie Voordewind c.s. over vroegtijdige juridische bijstand
Asks the government to provide legal aid to Dutch citizens facing a real risk of the death penalty abroad who lack funds, before any sentence is passed.
requests the government to immediately provide legal aid to Dutch citizens facing a real risk of death sentence in Iran without sufficient funds

verzoekt de regering om Nederlandse staatsburgers die in Iran een reële kans lopen ter dood te worden veroordeeld en niet over voldoende financiële middelen beschikken, per direct juridische bijstand te verlenen
Motie Van Bommel over consultatie van de Nederlandse ambassadeur
Asks the government to invite the Dutch ambassador in Iran to come to the Netherlands for consultation at an appropriate moment in the Bahrami case.
requests the government to have the Dutch ambassador in Iran come to the Netherlands for consultation at an appropriate moment
verzoekt de regering de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Iran op een gepast moment voor consultatie naar Nederland te laten komen
Asks the government to deliver by 1 March 2011 a plan to restructure the diplomatic post network along the lines of an earlier motion.
requests the government to come up with an elaboration as requested in that motion
verzoekt de regering met een uitwerking te komen zoals verzocht in die motie
Asks the government to recognise 17 August 1945 as Indonesia's independence date.
requests the government to proceed to recognise 17 August 1945 as the date of Indonesia's independence
verzoekt de regering over te gaan tot erkenning van 17 augustus 1945 als datum van de onafhankelijkheid van Indonesië
Motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to seek open dialogue with Indonesia in international fora to stop human rights violations in Papua and report back.
requests the government to take initiatives in international fora leading to open and constructive dialogue with Indonesia on the situation in Papua
verzoekt de regering in internationaal verband initiatieven te ondernemen die moeten leiden tot een open en constructief overleg met Indonesië over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to press Middle Eastern states to take part in the proposed conference on a Middle East free of weapons of mass destruction.
Asks the government to resume negotiations on the Toescheidingsovereenkomst with Suriname and report to the House in the first half of 2011.
requests the government to promptly resume consultations on the Toescheidingsovereenkomst with Suriname and report to the House in the first half of 2011
verzoekt de regering spoedig het overleg over de Toescheidingsovereenkomst met Suriname te hervatten en de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2011 te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Nicolaï c.s. over beveiliging diplomatiek verkeer
Asks the government to review the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to consider the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and to inform the House about it before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering zich te beraden op de technische beveiliging en classificatie van het Nederlandse diplomatieke verkeer en daarover de Kamer voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Motie-El Fassed c.s. over het Shelter City Initiative
Asks the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce emergency visa procedures for human rights defenders at risk.
requests the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce related emergency visa procedures
