verzoekt de regering aan te sluiten bij het Shelter City Initiative en bijbehorende procedures voor noodvisa in te voeren
Motie Van Bommel en Waalkens over het faciliteren van initiatieven inzake de betrekkingen tussen Suriname en Nederland
Asks the government to facilitate initiatives from the population to shape the future relationship between Suriname and the Netherlands.
requests the government to facilitate initiatives from the population aimed at formulating the future mutual relations between Suriname and the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering initiatieven uit de bevolking, met als doel het formuleren van de toekomstige onderlinge betrekkingen tussen Suriname en Nederland, te faciliteren
Motie Van Bommel over een internationaal moratorium op wapens met witte fosfor, zware metalen en verarmd uranium
Asks the government to launch a diplomatic initiative for an international moratorium on white phosphorus, heavy metal and depleted uranium weapons.
requests the government to take a diplomatic initiative toward an international moratorium on the use of white phosphorus weapons
verzoekt de regering te komen tot een diplomatiek initiatief om te komen tot een internationaal moratorium op het gebruik van wapens met witte fosfor
Motie Van Bommel over strengere regels voor doorvoer van wapens
Asks the government to propose stricter EU rules on the transit of weapons through European infrastructure.
requests the government to propose stricter EU rules on the transit of weapons
verzoekt de regering in de EU strengere regels inzake doorvoer van wapens voor te stellen
Motie Van Bommel over sluiting van de geheime gevangenis in Baghram
Asks the government to press the Afghan and US authorities to close the secret detention facility at Bagram.
requests the government to urge the Afghan government and the American authorities to close this secret prison
verzoekt de regering er bij de Afghaanse regering en bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten op aan te dringen, deze geheime gevangenis te sluiten
Motie Van Bommel over opheffen van de Raadgevende Interparlementaire Beneluxraad
Motion asking the government to propose abolishing the Benelux Interparliamentary Consultative Council and returning parliamentary oversight to national parliaments.
requests the government to propose within the Benelux framework abolishing the Benelux Interparliamentary Consultative Council and returning parliamentary control to the national parliaments
verzoekt de regering in Benelux-verband voor te stellen de Raadgevende Interparlementaire Beneluxraad op te heffen en de parlementaire controle weer via de nationale parlementen te laten verlopen
Motie-Van Bommel/Peters over aandringen op openheid over de aanwezigheid van kernwapens in lidstaten van de NAVO
Motion asking the government to press NATO for openness about the presence of nuclear weapons in member states.
requests the government to press NATO that openness can be given about nuclear weapons in NATO member states
verzoekt de regering er bij de NAVO op aan te dringen dat openheid kan worden gegeven over de aanwezigheid van kernwapens in lidstaten van de NAVO
Motie-Peters/Van Bommel over beëindigen van het gebruik van verouderde kernwapens
Motion asking the government to push NATO to stop using outdated nuclear weapons and to end Dutch participation in storing them.
requests the government to end any own participation in the storage of outdated nuclear weapons
verzoekt de regering eventuele eigen medewerking aan de opslag van verouderde kernwapens te beëindigen
Motie Van Bommel over een onafhankelijke en volledige evaluatie van de rol van politieke partijen in het NIMD
Asks the government for an independent and full evaluation of the role of political parties in NIMD, a government-funded democracy programme.
to commission an independent and full evaluation of the role of political parties in NIMD
een onafhankelijke en volledige evaluatie uit te laten voeren naar de rol van politieke partijen in het NIMD
Motie Van Bommel een onafhankelijke en volledige evaluatie van het beheer van het NIMD
Asks the government to commission an independent and full evaluation of the management of NIMD, after the Court of Audit found serious shortcomings despite ministry supervision.
requests the government to have an independent and full evaluation of the management of the NIMD carried out
verzoekt de regering een onafhankelijke en volledige evaluatie van het beheer van het NIMD uit te laten voeren
Motie Van Bommel / Boekestijn over geen grote Nederlandse missie in Afghanistan na 2010
Declares that no new large Dutch military mission will be undertaken in Afghanistan after 2010, citing the strain on the armed forces.
declares that there will be no new large Dutch mission in Afghanistan after 2010
spreekt uit dat er geen nieuwe grote Nederlandse missie in Afghanistan zal zijn na 2010
Motie Van Bommel over de veroordeling van de collectieve bestraffing van een Palestijnse theatergroep
Asks the government to condemn Israel's travel ban on Palestinian theatre actors as collective punishment.
requests the government to condemn this collective punishment of the theatre group
verzoekt de regering deze collectieve bestraffing van de theatergroep te veroordelen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over vrijlating van de Birmese politieke gevangen
Motion asks the government to press for release of Burmese political prisoners via a binding UN Security Council resolution and raise it at the EU-China summit.
requests the government urgently to pursue a binding resolution in the UN Security Council before the UN Secretary-General's visit
verzoekt de regering met spoed, dat is vóór het bezoek van de SGVN, in te zetten op een bindende resolutie in de VNVR
Motie Van Bommel over de aanwezigheid van de Nederlandse ambassadeur op de herdenking in Rawagade
Asks the government to ensure the Dutch ambassador attends the Rawagade commemoration on 9 December.
requests the government to have the Dutch ambassador present at the Rawagade commemoration on 9 December
verzoekt de regering op 9 december a.s. de Nederlandse ambassadeur aanwezig te laten zijn op de herdenking in Rawagade
Motie Van Baalen c.s. over de erkenning van het lot van troostmeisjes door Japan
Motion asks the government to keep recognition of the comfort women issue in Japan relations and to press Japan for an additional gesture, raising it during visits.
requests the government, in line with the letter, to raise recognition of the comfort women and pressing Japan for an additional gesture with the Japanese government, including during future visits

verzoekt de regering overeenkomstig het gestelde in de bovengenoemde brief, de erkenning van het lot van de troostmeisjes en het aandringen op een aanvullend gebaar van Japan in de richting van hen, ook bij voorkomende bezoeken onder de aandacht van de Japanse regering te brengen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over het aan de orde stellen van eerbiediging van de mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top
Asks the government to press China on human rights such as press freedom, housing compensation and labour rights at the EU-China summit.
requests the government to vigorously raise respect for the aforementioned human rights during the EU-China summit
verzoekt de regering om de eerbiediging van bovengenoemde mensenrechten tijdens de EU-China-top sterk aan de orde te stellen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanleg van een pijpleiding in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the government about bank financing for the Dakota Access pipeline, the status of the project, concerns of the Sioux tribes over environment, drinking water, sacred land and treaty rights, and whether ING remains involved. The government answered that the permitting is a US sovereign matter with courts open to objectors, that the Dutch government respects indigenous rights, and that ING has agreed to sell its loan following dialogue with the Standing Rock Sioux.
The decision to grant a permit for the construction of infrastructure projects is a national and sovereign competence of the United States.
De afweging om een vergunning te verlenen voor de aanleg van infrastructurele bouwprojecten is een nationale en soevereine bevoegdheid van de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de situatie in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about alleged human rights abuses and a curfew in Korukoy, southeast Turkey, and whether the government would press Turkish counterparts to admit independent observers and investigate. The minister confirmed a curfew and communications cut from 11 February to 2 March, said the abuse reports cannot yet be verified, and said the government is concerned and has urged that Turkish counter-terrorism measures be proportionate, without committing to new contacts or an investigation.
Reports from human rights organisations and Kurdish politicians about torture, killing, destroyed homes and other human rights violations are cause for concern, but cannot yet be verified.

Berichten van mensenrechtenorganisaties en Koerdische politici over marteling, moord, vernielde woningen en andere mensenrechtenschendingen zijn reden tot zorg, maar kunnen nog niet worden geverifieerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de indirecte bijdrage aan Bridge International Academies

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development funds indirectly invested in Bridge International Academies, a low-cost private school operator, and whether this should be reclaimed given school closures and quality concerns. The minister confirmed about USD 1.51 million indirect investment via Novastar, refused to reclaim it, and argued that private education can complement weak public schooling while committing to monitor the Ugandan and Kenyan situations.
The cabinet sees no reason to reclaim this indirect support because the investment is a good complement to the deficient public education in these countries.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen omdat de investering een goede aanvulling vormt op het gebrekkige publieke onderwijs in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de positie van de Ahmadiyya gemeenschap in Algerije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Ahmadiyya members in Algeria for promoting their faith and the community's treatment there. The minister confirmed the arrests of 12 members on grounds including an unlicensed religious association and distribution of publications harming state interests, said the government shares concern over the situation, and pledged to raise human rights and Ahmadiyya protection in bilateral talks, EU forums and the UPR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de gang van zaken in de nasleep van de moord op drie vrouwen in Parijs

The MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch authorities knew that suspect Ömer Güney had died, what information was exchanged with France and Turkey about the Paris murders, whether he was a Turkish infiltrant, and how information misuse can be prevented. The government answered that it did not know of his death until media reports, declined to discuss the information exchange or the French indictment, said it had no information about an infiltrant, and deflected questions on Turkish use of shared information.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders

SP MPs asked whether hundreds of North Korean forced labourers work at a Polish shipyard of CRIST S.A. that repairs Dutch civil vessels, whether such labour occurs elsewhere in Europe or the Netherlands, what Dutch and EU action is taken, and how much of their wages go to the North Korean state. The minister replied that Polish inspections found no forced-labour indicators, that Dutch firms are expected to apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and the 2014 ILO Protocol, and that Netherlands has raised the issue in EU and UN fora.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Eijsink, Van Bommel en Belhaj over het gebruik van een door Nederland gefinancierd mortuarium in Afghanistan als jongensbordeel

MPs asked whether the government knew that a mortuary it helped fund near Kamp Holland in Tarin Kowt, Afghanistan, was used as a brothel for boys (bacha bazi), when it was discovered, and what measures followed. The government answered that it had no information during ISAF that the building was misused, learned of it from the Brandpunt broadcast, raised child abuse with local leaders regularly, and confirmed it financed the mortuary (about EUR 15,000) in 2008.
During the ISAF mission the cabinet had no information showing that the mortuary was being used for other purposes.
Het kabinet beschikte gedurende de ISAF-missie niet over informatie waaruit bleek dat het mortuarium voor andere doeleinden werd gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over de verdergaande ondermijning van de rechtsstaat en de democratie in Polen

Two SP MPs asked the government about the erosion of rule of law and judicial independence in Poland, EU sanctions under Article 7, judicial cooperation, and Kaczynski's remarks on a two-speed EU and refugees. The government answered that it follows developments closely, pursues dialogue bilaterally and in EU fora, considers Article 7 not currently at issue, and that judicial cooperation continues as no grounds to refuse were found.
Triggering the Article 7 procedure is not currently on the table.
Het in werking stellen van de artikel 7 procedure is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de slag om Chora

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers whether they would revise the official civilian death toll from the 2007 Chora operation after a documentary with eyewitness claims, whether Australia objected to artillery use, and whether a COMISAF report and NATO's response can be shared. The government declined to revise its position, pointed to several prior investigations, said Australia raised no objection and was not involved in the fire decisions, and withheld the COMISAF report and NATO response as operationally sensitive.
The COMISAF report and the reaction of SACEUR and the NATO Secretary General contain operationally sensitive information.
Het rapport van COMISAF en de reactie van SACEUR en de Secretaris-generaal van de Navo hierop bevatten operationeel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over wapenhandel met Turkije

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the government would suspend arms exports to Turkey given Turkish airstrikes in Syria and Iraq, whether F-35 parts supplied from the Netherlands were acceptable, and whether they would raise the issue in the EU. The government answered that exports are assessed under the EU Common Position, that the F-35 parts are for a multinational production chain, that four Turkish export applications were refused last year, and that it opposes a unilateral embargo and sees no EU support for changing policy on Turkey.
The Netherlands applies the Common Position very strictly and will refuse an export application when it considers the proposed export not in line with the criteria of the Common Position.

Nederland is zeer strikt in de toepassing van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt en zal een vergunningaanvraag afwijzen wanneer het de voorgenomen uitvoer niet in overeenstemming acht met de criteria van het Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een ter dood veroordeelde in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Belgian-based Iranian researcher Ahmadreza Djalali had been sentenced to death in Iran after an unfair trial and whether the government would press Iranian authorities. The minister answered that the trial had not yet taken place and no official charge was known, but that the Dutch ambassador, on behalf of the EU, urged a fair trial, medical care and abandonment of the death penalty.
As acting local EU chair, the Dutch ambassador in Tehran urged the Iranian judiciary's human rights council on behalf of the EU that Mr Jalali receive a fair trial.

Als waarnemend lokaal EU-voorzitter heeft de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Teheran er namens de EU bij de mensenrechtenraad van de Iraanse rechterlijke macht op aangedrongen dat de heer Jalali een eerlijk proces krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over honderdduizenden kinderen die vastzitten in Mosul, in Irak

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about an estimated 350,000 children trapped in west Mosul under ISIS control, lacking aid, and about civilian protection and humanitarian access. The minister confirmed the estimate is plausible but unverifiable, said civilians face unavoidable risks that Iraqi forces and the coalition must minimise, and noted Dutch efforts on protection and aid while stating aid delivery to west Mosul is currently impossible.
The Netherlands remains in discussion with the UN, Red Cross and the Dutch Relief Alliance to see whether humanitarian aid can be delivered to people in west Mosul.
Nederland blijft met de VN, Rode Kruis en de Dutch Relief Alliance in gesprek om te kijken of humanitaire hulp geleverd kan worden aan de mensen in het westen van Mosul.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “het bericht “Kurdish-Turkish war will be triggered if Abdullah Öcalan is harmed”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report that a Kurdish-Turkish war would follow if Abdullah Öcalan were harmed, whether a KCK official claimed AKP and MHP plan to kill him, whether he could face the death penalty if reinstated, and what role he plays in Turkey-Kurdish talks. The minister said the claimed statement cannot be verified, no death penalty bill is before parliament, and Öcalan has no formal role in talks, as he serves a life sentence.
It is not a formal European Parliament event and no record of the conference is available, so it is not possible to verify the quoted statement.
Het betreft geen formeel evenement van het Europees parlement en er is geen verslaglegging van de conferentie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het uitblijven van luchtsteun in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether France, the UK and the US agreed in May 1995 to halt air strikes on Serbian targets without informing the Netherlands, and whether they had access to documents on this. The government answered that a NIOD exploration found no evidence of secret international decision-making, that it had asked allies for information but does not expect release soon, and that it will not renew the request.
The NIOD concludes in its report that the exploration found no evidence or indications of secret international political decision-making, unknown to the Netherlands, on providing such air support.

Het NIOD concludeert in zijn rapport dat de verkenning geen bewijzen of aanwijzingen heeft opgeleverd voor het bestaan van voor Nederland geheime internationale politieke besluitvorming over het verlenen van dergelijke luchtsteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a European Court of Auditors report on EU aid to Ukraine, covering anti-corruption results, the absence of a pre-set strategy for the 2014 aid package, Ukrainian civil society, and the trade agreement's effect on Dutch trade. The minister acknowledged corruption concerns, cited reform progress and EU procedures, and said trade rose 7.5% though causal attribution is uncertain.
The cabinet is convinced that anti-corruption efforts in Ukraine benefit from the entry into force of this association agreement.
Het kabinet is er van overtuigd dat de corruptiebestrijding in Oekraïne gebaat is bij inwerkingtreding van dit associatieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over megaclaims naar aanleiding van brandstofleveranties in Afghanistan

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister about reported NATO-Supreme Group fuel-supply claims in Afghanistan, including whether NATO faces a court case and how much Dutch money is involved, and about oversight and outsourcing. The minister declined to give details on the claims while the court case is pending, confirmed the Netherlands received fuel from Supreme, said control services are adequately equipped, and said Defence still has contracts with Supreme and outsources procurement for cost reasons.
As long as the case is still before the court, the government cannot go into detail on this.
Zolang de zaak nog voor de rechtbank dient, kan de regering hierover niet in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse ambassades in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the use of Dutch embassy buildings abroad after reports that a minister's engagement party was held at the Paris residence. The minister denied a private party took place, said the event was a fundraising activity for the National Musical Instrument Fund, and stated that anyone within the stated framework could have used the residence.
There was no question of an engagement party in a government building.
Er was geen sprake van een verlovingsfeest in een rijksgebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over geweld tegen activisten in Colombia

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported spike in lethal violence against activists in Colombia, including members of Marcha Patriótica, and whether the government would raise this with Colombian counterparts. The minister confirmed the rise, attributed it to shifting power in rural areas after the FARC withdrew, called the 123 killings a realistic estimate, and said the Netherlands and EU have raised concerns and pressed authorities to protect activists and prosecute perpetrators.

On 22 November, the Netherlands together with the EU, EU member states, Switzerland and Norway issued a statement expressing concern about the recent killings of community leaders and human rights defenders.

Nederland heeft op 22 november jl. samen met de EU, de EU-lidstaten, Zwitserland en Noorwegen een verklaring uitgegeven waarin de zorg wordt uitgesproken over de recente moorden op gemeenschapsleiders en mensenrechtenverdedigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Nederlandse bedrijven die door de staat New York op een zwarte lijst zijn geplaatst

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether four Dutch companies were placed on New York State's blacklist for boycotting Israel and whether other US states maintain similar lists. The government confirmed the listing, said the companies deny any boycott, and reports that its ambassador raised the matter with New York, which agreed to an early review of the listings.
The Dutch Ambassador to the United States raised the issue with the authorities of the State of New York.
De Nederlandse Ambassadeur in de Verenigde Staten heeft de kwestie aan de orde gesteld bij de autoriteiten van de staat New York.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een politie-inval in het hoofdkwartier van de Ahmadiyya Moslim Gemeenschap in Rabwah, Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a police raid on the Ahmadiyya headquarters in Rabwah, Pakistan, the arrests of Ahmadis under blasphemy provisions, and the deteriorating position of Ahmadis. The minister described the raid and arrests, confirmed the 2014 Punjab ban on Ahmadi literature, and said the Netherlands raises religious minorities' position bilaterally and multilaterally, including at the Mensenrechtenambassadeur's planned visit.
The Netherlands regularly raises the position of religious minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contexts and will continue to do so.
Nederland stelt de positie van religieuze minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilateraal en multilateraal verband aan de orde en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “EU betaalt nog steeds salaris aan 16 ex-eurocommissarissen”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the EU still pays about 99,996 euros a year to 16 former Commissioners, some of whom have new paid jobs, and whether this undermines transparency and conflict-of-interest safeguards. The minister said the Commission's disclosure process is unknown to the cabinet, described the new 2016 regulation shortening and reducing the transitional allowance, declined to name individuals or amounts paid, and said Commission rules on post-office conduct are being reviewed with Parliament.
The cabinet does not know the precise sequence of events leading to the Commission releasing the information Die Zeit requested and therefore cannot assess it.
De precieze gang van zaken in aanloop naar het vrijgeven van de door Die Zeit gevraagde informatie door de Commissie is het kabinet niet bekend en kan het kabinet derhalve niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een in Rusland veroordeelde activist

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of activist Ildar Dadin in Russia, Amnesty's view that he is a prisoner of conscience, and torture allegations. The minister acknowledged the shrinking space for opposition and shared concerns about due process, but rejected the claim that torture is used systematically, and said the Netherlands would not take additional action for now given Russian investigations and EU coordination.
In view of these developments, the Netherlands, in consultation with EU partners, will for the time being not take additional action towards the Russian authorities.
Gelet op deze ontwikkelingen zal Nederland, mede in overleg met EU-partners, voorlopig geen aanvullende actie richting de Russische autoriteiten ondernemen.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid van Bommel over de arrestatie van Koerdische politici in het zuidoosten van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Kurdish mayors and pro-Kurdish politicians in southeastern Turkey, including how many have been detained or dismissed since July 2015 and whether the government views the repression as undermining the rule of law. The minister confirmed the arrests and charges, gave detailed figures, stated serious concern, said the Netherlands pushed for an EU statement and backed Council of Europe involvement, but made no commitment to raise the issue bilaterally beyond the EU channel.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about these developments.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstig zorgen over deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse staatsmedia een lijst met Gülen-organisaties in Nederland heeft gepubliceerd

Two SP MPs asked the government about a Turkish state media list of Gülen-linked organisations in the Netherlands, including whether agreements were made with Turkey to stop intimidation and political export, whether Zaman Nederland and HOGIAF are labelled terrorist, whether extradition or prosecution requests exist, and whether Dutch research was shared with Turkey. The minister replied that the government firmly rejects such lists, has conveyed that Turkish tensions must not be exported, has received no evidence of direct involvement of the named organisations, has received one extradition request under review, and has not directly shared the Dutch research with Turkish authorities.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating, in whatever form and composition, and by whomever.
Het kabinet keurt het ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm en samenstelling dan ook, en door wie dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Jemen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about Yemen's political situation, the Hadi government's control and legitimacy, and the international approach to the conflict. The minister answered that government control is patchy, that Hadi's mandate was extended pending elections, that Resolution 2216 remains the basis, and that a VN-led inclusive settlement is being pursued.
The cabinet has not expressed support for the intervention by the Saudi Arabia-led coalition in Yemen.
Het kabinet heeft geen steun uitgesproken voor de interventie van de door Saoedi-Arabië geleide coalitie in Jemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over de convenanten met KLM en TUI ter voorkoming van recidive van drugskoeriers

MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked about the convenants with KLM and TUI listing drug couriers, including legal protection, duration of listing and whether the listing amounts to extra punishment. Minister Van der Steur answered substantively on each point, describing the listing as a civil-law measure with rights of access and correction under the Wpg and Wbp and a three-year term, while stating the measure is reasonable and has few complaints.
It concerns a term that can be considered reasonable.
Het gaat om een redelijk te achten termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Rekenkamer EU was in 2007 tegen toetreding Bulgarije, Roemenië”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report that the European Court of Auditors opposed Bulgaria's and Romania's 2007 accession, and about Olli Rehn's remark that the decision was already taken, plus questions on Western Balkan candidates and publication of country reports. The minister replied that the audit report assessed Phare projects rather than accession readiness, that the government upholds a strict, conditionality-based enlargement process, and that accession depends on progress against criteria with parliamentary ratification required.
Ratification of an accession treaty requires parliamentary approval in all EU member states.
Voor ratificatie van een toetredingsverdrag is parlementaire goedkeuring in alle EU-lidstaten vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over een brief van de Turkse consul-generaal

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam to mayors on handling demonstrations by opponents of the Turkish government, and whether this amounts to political interference. The minister says the letter does not request a ban on demonstrations, that interference in Dutch citizens' choices is unacceptable, and that Turkish tensions should not be exported to the Netherlands, which was raised during his visit to Turkey.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over een bezoek van een Turkse minister aan Nederland

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked whether a visiting Turkish minister made inflammatory remarks about Gülen supporters and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that the statements were the Turkish minister's responsibility, that the government had raised concerns with Turkish authorities and that it does not consider entry bans appropriate.
The cabinet does not share that view. We must remain in dialogue with the Turkish authorities.
Het kabinet deelt die opvatting niet. We moeten in gesprek blijven met de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat bedienden van diplomaten uitbuiting op ambassades in Nederland melden

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether exploitation of domestic staff of diplomats at embassies in the Netherlands is acceptable, whether further investigation and sanctions are possible, and whether staff are informed of their rights. The minister replied that Dutch labour law applies, but inspection and enforcement bodies lack legal competence on embassy premises, so BZ relies on semi-annual monitoring interviews, a sanction of withdrawing the domestic-staff privilege, and rights briefings.

Based on the Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations and the headquarters agreements with international organisations, Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate or enforce on the premises of embassies, consulates or international organisations.

Op basis van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Diplomatiek Verkeer, het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Consulaire Betrekkingen en zetelverdragen tussen hier gevestigde internationale organisaties en Nederland hebben Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen op het terrein van ambassades, consulaten en/of internationale organisaties of om daar handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Ngo’s dachten in Nederland veilig te zijn, maar dat pakt anders uit”

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers how they view threats against human rights lawyer Nada Kiswanson and the temporary closure of four NGO offices in The Hague, whether such threats are recurrent, why no official report was made after her complaint, and what protection is provided. The government says it takes the threats very seriously, a criminal investigation is underway, the ministries have convened meetings with NGOs, the ICC, prosecutors and police, and it has activated the host-state consultation mechanism, while stating that organisations bear primary responsibility for their own security and that it will not disclose protection measures.
The government makes no public statements about possible measures, because that could harm her safety.
De overheid doet geen openbare uitspraken over eventuele maatregelen, want dat zou haar veiligheid kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de inzet van Europees ontwikkelingsgeld ten behoeve van buitenlandse krijgsmachten in Afrikaanse landen

MPs asked whether EU development funds would be used to finance foreign armies in African countries, including Sudan's, and whether this is acceptable. The government answered that the Commission proposal would only allow non-ODA funds under the IcSP in exceptional cases, that ODA cannot be used to strengthen foreign armies, that Sudanese army support is not on the table, and that the Netherlands will push to keep development money for development.
Your House will be further informed about this proposal in September via a BNC fiche.
Uw Kamer zal in september nader worden geïnformeerd over dit voorstel via een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een brief over confiscatie van gebouwen in Palestijns gebied

Member Van Bommel (SP) asked whether the Dutch ambassador in Israel signed a letter from eight EU ambassadors protesting Israel's confiscation of donor-funded Bedouin shelters in Area C and why not. The minister confirmed the letter, said the shelters were funded by the UN with donor support rather than Dutch or EU money, explained the group chose not to ask other countries to co-sign, and said the government condemns such demolitions and would consider joining a collective protest if asked.

If countries asked the Netherlands for support, the cabinet would certainly consider it, because the number of project demolitions shows a negative trend and the cabinet favours joint action to send a strong signal against it.

Indien landen Nederland steun zouden vragen, dan zal het kabinet dat zeker overwegen, omdat het aantal gevallen van sloop van projecten een negatieve trend vertoont en het kabinet voorstander is van een gezamenlijk optreden om hier een krachtig signaal tegen af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het pleidooi de uitleveringen aan Turkije te stoppen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked whether extraditions to Turkey should be suspended given doubts about judicial independence, fair trial rights, long pre-trial detention and possible reintroduction of the death penalty after the failed coup. The minister said the government is seriously concerned and urges the rule of law, but that a blanket suspension of extradition and legal assistance would be undesirable, with each request assessed case by case under the treaties and ECHR.

Suspending all extradition and legal assistance to Turkey in advance would mean that all suspects or convicted persons, including for example in human trafficking, sexual or violent offences, could evade their punishment or prosecution.

Het op voorhand volledig opschorten van alle uitlevering en rechtshulpverlening aan Turkije zou tot gevolg hebben dat alle verdachten of veroordeelden, dus ook inzake bijvoorbeeld mensenhandel, zeden- of geweldsdelicten, hun straf(vervolging) kunnen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over marteling in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's concern about torture of detainees in Turkey and whether he will press for a CPT visit there. The minister said the concerns are real, raised them with the Council of Europe Secretary General, and has urged the CPT to visit Turkey and Turkey to receive it, with a follow-up at the Committee of Ministers in September.
The cabinet considers it of the utmost importance that the Turkish authorities treat those accused of involvement in the coup within the framework of the rule of law and transparency.

Het kabinet vindt het van het grootste belang dat de Turkse autoriteiten diegenen die beschuldigd worden van betrokkenheid bij de coup behandelen binnen de kaders van rechtsstatelijkheid en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over toenemende repressie in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government shares Germany's concern about Turkey's state of emergency, judges the post-coup response disproportionate, and will push to suspend EU accession talks at the General Affairs Council. The minister answered that earlier written answers, a Kamerbrief and supplementary replies already addressed these questions adequately, without a substantive new position.

I expect that with the answers contained in the report of a written consultation of 21 July, the letter to parliament on the situation in Turkey of 21 July, and the supplementary answers in the report of a written consultation of 23 July, I have sufficiently answered the questions posed.

Ik verwacht met de antwoorden vervat in het verslag van een Schriftelijk Overleg van 21 juli jl., de Kamerbrief inzake de situatie in Turkije van 21 juli jl. en de aanvullende antwoorden vervat in het verslag van een Schriftelijk Overleg van 23 juli jl. de gestelde vragen afdoende te hebben beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Molukse gevangenen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Moluccan prisoners held far from their families, whether they were jailed for a 2007 dance displaying the RMS flag, whether they were tortured or neglected, and what steps were taken to have them detained closer to home. The minister said the prisoners were arrested for displaying the flag and performing a dance before the Indonesian president, treated as freedom of expression, that official inquiries could not establish torture, and that the issues were raised bilaterally, in EU dialogue and with Indonesian ministers, with Netherlands promising to keep raising the matter.
From the information obtained, it could not be established with certainty that the detainees had been tortured.
Uit de ingewonnen informatie kon niet met zekerheid worden afgeleid dat de arrestanten zijn gemarteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Ten Broeke, Thieme en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een mensenrechtenactivist in Bahrein

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of human rights activist Nabeel Rajab in Bahrain, its charge, and whether the government would raise it with Bahrain. The minister confirmed the arrest on the charge of spreading false news, said the government finds the repression very concerning, and said the EU will make a demarche in Manama seeking clarification.
The European Union will shortly make a demarche in Manama to the Bahraini authorities to raise the recent pressure on human rights defenders and the opposition.
De Europese Unie zal op korte termijn in Manama een demarche uitvoeren bij de Bahreinse autoriteiten om de recente druk op mensenrechtenverdedigers en de oppositie aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bedrijf Supreme Group dat Nederlandse troepen in Afghanistan heeft bevoorraad

SP MPs asked whether Defence knew of overcharging by Supreme Group, whether a whistleblower's report was acted on, and whether audits, repayment and legal action occurred. The minister confirmed the overcharging, said the whistleblower report was handled through audits and the matter was corrected, withheld amounts and audit reports as commercially confidential but offered confidential briefing, and said no civil or criminal action was taken since the company cooperated and repaid.
I am willing to inform you about the reports confidentially.
Ik ben bereid u op vertrouwelijke wijze over de rapporten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het schenden van mensenrechten in Brazilië in de aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about police violence and erosion of protest and expression rights in Brazil ahead of the Olympics, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns with Brazilian authorities and the Olympic Committee. The minister acknowledged serious concern about urban violence and police conduct, said the Netherlands raises human rights issues in bilateral and EU dialogues and at the consulate, and said it would voice concern about the anti-terrorism law if it restricts protest or expression, but did not commit to a specific new initiative with the Olympic Committee.
If application of this law indeed leads to restriction of the right to peaceful protest or freedom of expression, the Netherlands will express its concern about this to the Brazilian authorities.

Indien toepassing van deze wet inderdaad leidt tot inperking van het recht op vreedzame protesten of vrijheid van meningsuiting, zal Nederland zijn zorg hierover uiten aan de Braziliaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de import van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether tomatoes from Western Sahara were sold in Dutch supermarkets labelled as Moroccan, whether origin labelling is misleading, and whether Morocco's economic activity there is lawful after the EU General Court annulled the 2012 trade agreement. The government replied that it does not track the specific production location, that businesses bear responsibility for correct origin labelling, that consumers can complain to the NVWA, that economic activity in Western Sahara is not per se unlawful, and that the EU has appealed the court ruling so no export changes are yet foreseen.
The Dutch government does not keep information on the specific place where foodstuffs are produced.
De Nederlandse overheid houdt geen informatie bij over de specifieke plaats waar levensmiddelen zijn geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops en Grashoff over de vernietiging van Palestijnse waterbronnen door Israël

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, CDA and GroenLinks asked whether Israel plans to destroy water cisterns in Kusra built with Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands could recover damages. The government answered that the cisterns are subject to stop-work orders that owners are contesting legally, that nothing has yet been destroyed so no compensation arises, and that the Dutch representation is intensifying dialogue with Israeli authorities and following legal developments closely.
In this context the Representation has lodged a protest against the latest stop-work orders and will continue to follow the legal developments very actively.
In dit kader heeft de Vertegenwoordiging protest aangetekend tegen de laatste stop-work-orders en zal het de juridische ontwikkelingen zeer actief blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van fosfor in het zuidoosten van Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish forces used phosphorus bombs against civilians in Nusaybin, what international humanitarian law says about such weapons, and whether the minister would raise the matter with Turkish counterparts and support independent investigation. The minister could not confirm the use, said civilians are among the victims, explained that IHL restricts incendiary weapons without banning phosphorus munitions outright (Turkey not party to Protocol III), and said he raises the conflict with Turkish counterparts while urging resumption of the Kurdish peace process.
I regularly raise the conflict with the PKK in contacts with my Turkish colleagues and urge the resumption of the Kurdish peace process.
Ik breng het conflict met de PKK geregeld op in contacten met mijn Turkse collega’s en dring daarbij aan op hervatting van het Koerdische vredesproces
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Bommel over het bericht dat Turkse parlementsleden voortaan vervolgd kunnen worden

MPs Maij and Van Bommel asked whether the Turkish move to lift parliamentary immunity, which mainly affects pro-Kurdish HDP members, is concerning, and whether it breaches the ECHR. The minister said the development is worrying, raised concerns with President Erdogan, and noted that the measure could have a discriminatory effect, while stating that parliamentary immunity is not itself a human right.
The Prime Minister expressed his concern to President Erdogan on 23 May, on the margins of the World Humanitarian Summit, about the lifting of parliamentary immunities.

De premier heeft in zijn gesprek met president Erdoğan op 23 mei jl. en marge van de World Humanitarian Summit zijn verontrusting kenbaar gemaakt over de opheffing van de immuniteiten van de parlementsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over medicijntekort in Suriname

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a medicine shortage in Suriname that could cost lives, including its scale, causes, and whether the Netherlands could help via suspended treaty funds. The minister said there is no general medicine shortage but a shortage of basic consumables in hospitals, that Suriname has made no aid request, and that the suspension of treaty funds since 2012 remains unchanged.
Suriname has not yet submitted an international aid request. Should that happen, the cabinet will look at it seriously, as is customary for such requests.
Suriname heeft vooralsnog geen internationaal hulpverzoek ingediend. Mocht dat komen, dan zal het kabinet daar serieus naar kijken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de situatie van Bhutanese vluchtelingen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands had promised to resettle 500 Bhutanese refugees from Nepal, whether resettlement missions continue, how illiterate refugees can complete integration, whether naturalised refugees can travel to Bhutan, and how many political prisoners Bhutan holds. The government said no numerical promise was made, resettlement missions ran 2008–2011 and were halted after Nepal and Bhutan failed to act, integration allows extended deadlines, refugee travel documents exclude the home country, and no reliable information on political prisoners exists.
There is no unambiguous, reliable information about the presence of political prisoners in Bhutan.
Er is geen eenduidige, betrouwbare informatie over de aanwezigheid van politieke gevangenen in Bhutan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het niet uitvoeren van de motie Servaes inzake een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch delegation to the UN Open Ended Working Group did not act on the Servaes motion calling for negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, and whether it would be instructed to do so. The minister answered that the delegation had followed its existing instruction in the first week, that a nuclear ban was on the agenda only in the second week, that further instructions reflecting the motion were sent, and that Parliament would be informed in writing about the second session.
You will be informed in writing, in line with my earlier commitment, about the progress of this second session of the OEWG.
U zult conform mijn eerdere toezegging schriftelijk nader geïnformeerd worden over het verloop van deze tweede sessie van de OEWG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht dat op Sheremetyevo Airport een vluchteling vast zit in de transit-zone

SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Syrian asylum seeker is stranded in Sheremetyevo airport's transit zone, including Russia's asylum practice, passport handling, how common such stranding is, and whether the Netherlands will intervene. The minister confirmed the case, said Russia rarely grants formal asylum but more often temporary status, described passport handling as standard practice, and said the Dutch embassy works through UNHCR rather than direct action on the specific case.
The Dutch embassy regularly has contact with the local UNHCR office in Moscow on refugee and migration matters.
De Nederlandse ambassade heeft regelmatig contact met het lokale kantoor van UNHCR in Moskou over vluchtelingen- en migratiezaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het opgelaaide geweld om Nagorno-Karabach

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the April 2016 fighting over Nagorno-Karabach, including casualties, its cause, calls for a ceasefire and the state of OSCE Minsk Group mediation. The minister confirmed at least thirty deaths per both sides' figures, said the trigger was unclear, outlined EU and Dutch calls for a ceasefire, and described ongoing support for the Minsk Group talks.
To date it is still unclear what caused the flare-up of the conflict in the night of 1 to 2 April.
Tot op heden is nog onduidelijk wat de aanleiding was voor het oplaaien van het conflict in de nacht van 1 op 2 april.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het verzoek van de RMS voor een gesprek met de president van Indonesië

MP Van Bommel asks whether the government will press for a meeting between the Moluccan government-in-exile (RMS) and Indonesian President Widodo during his Netherlands visit, and raises human rights concerns and the location of Chris Soumokil's grave. The minister says the request is known to Indonesia, that the decision rests with Widodo, and that the Netherlands has raised the grave location request on humanitarian grounds.
The request for a meeting is known to the Indonesian authorities.
Het verzoek tot een onderhoud is bekend bij de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over IMF-programma en hervormingen van de energiesector in Oekraïne

Mr Van Bommel (SP) asks the Foreign Minister about IMF-linked reforms in Ukraine, including energy subsidy cuts, coal mine closures, and a reported assault on a miners' union leader, and whether the reforms cause unemployment and inflation. The minister answers that the IMF reforms aim to stabilise the economy, that tariff rises are cushioned for the poorest, that mine closures are planned, and declines to disclose an oligarch's assets as not the cabinet's matter.
It is not for the Cabinet to make statements about the assets of foreign persons.
Het is niet aan het Kabinet om mededelingen te doen over de bezittingen van buitenlandse personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inname van Palestijns land door Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel annexed about 240 hectares on the West Bank and whether the government would contact Israeli counterparts and push for a strong EU condemnation. The minister confirmed a 234-hectare appropriation, said the EU and the Netherlands have publicly opposed it, and stated that the government regrets the decision as unlawful under international law without announcing a new concrete step.
The government regrets this decision, which constitutes an unlawful appropriation in violation of international law
Het kabinet betreurt dit besluit, dat een onrechtmatige toe-eigening vormt in strijd met internationaal recht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over luchtaanvallen in Irak en Syrië

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Dutch government about civilian casualties from anti-IS coalition airstrikes in Iraq and Syria, Dutch involvement in specific strikes, and transparency. The government said exact civilian casualty numbers cannot be determined, that Dutch involvement cannot be fully ruled out in the cited strikes, that two possible civilian-casualty cases from Dutch strikes are under investigation, and that it will press for greater coalition transparency.
For operational reasons, no details of the individual investigations are released. The House will be informed of the outcomes.
Om operationele redenen worden geen details vrijgegeven van de afzonderlijke onderzoeken. De Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Tonnen voor opinieplatform”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why the 'Raam op Rusland' initiative, which applied for nearly EUR 3 million in subsidy, is not journalism and whether the subsidy risks funding ordinary journalistic work. The minister confirmed the application under the POBB programme, stated the first-three-year budget is EUR 364,000 covering website, staff and freelancers, and said the foundation is a knowledge platform with no journalistic purpose, so no funding of journalism or the Ukraine referendum campaign.
The project proposal Raam op Rusland is not a journalistic or opinion-forming project, but the establishment of a knowledge platform
Het projectvoorstel Raam op Rusland betreft geen journalistiek of opiniërend project, maar de oprichting van een kennisplatform
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een vermiste imam uit Venlo

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Moroccan imam from Venlo reported missing since September 2015 while on pilgrimage to Mecca, including whether Saudi Arabia arrested him, whether there are suspicions against him, and whether the minister will seek clarification from Saudi and Moroccan counterparts. The minister replied that the cabinet lacks further information, that Morocco as the imam's sole nationality state is responsible for consular assistance and inquiries, and that the matter was brought to the Moroccan embassy's attention, without committing to direct inquiries.
It is up to the imam's national state to provide consular or other assistance and to make inquiries about the alleged disappearance.
Het is aan de nationale staat van betrokkene om consulaire of andere vormen van bijstand te verlenen en navraag te doen over de vermeende vermissing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over investeringsbescherming (Investor-State Dispute Settlement, ISDS) in het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether Article 89(2) of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, which mentions investment protection and investor-state dispute settlement, opens the door to ISDS and whether the passage would be dropped after the referendum. Minister Ploumen answered that the agreement contains no investor-state dispute mechanism, that ISDS is ruled out for the Netherlands, and that the cabinet will not anticipate the referendum outcome.
The Association Agreement with Ukraine contains no mechanism for the settlement of disputes between an investor and a state.
Het associatieakkoord met Oekraïne bevat geen mechanisme voor de beslechting van geschillen tussen een investeerder en een staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Europese Commissie voorspelt economische groei voor Oekraïne op basis van gedateerd onderzoek”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether outdated economic studies (Ecorys, German advisory group) still justify the EU-Ukraine association agreement given the conflict since 2013, and about its effects on prices and Ukrainian firms. The government replied that the CGE-based studies remain relevant, a new analysis is informative but not necessary, and the agreement is a sovereign Ukrainian choice with a ten-year phase-in and SME support.
In that sense, the cabinet considers a new analysis informative but not necessary for its assessment of the effects of the association agreement.
In die zin acht het kabinet een nieuwe analyse informatief, maar niet noodzakelijk voor het oordeel over de effecten van het associatieakkoord.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Turkse luchtaanvallen op Koerdische doelen in Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish air strikes on Kurdish targets in Syria, whether he shares the US and French call for them to stop, and whether he will urge Turkey directly. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said the US-Russia ceasefire took effect on 27 February and the government wants it maintained, and stressed that all parties including Turkey must uphold it.
In this regard the cabinet stresses that all parties involved, including Turkey, must take their responsibility to keep this ceasefire in place.
Het kabinet onderstreept in dit verband dat alle betrokken partijen, inclusief Turkije, hun verantwoordelijkheid dienen te nemen om deze wapenstilstand stand te laten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over het bericht ‘€ 5 miljard van Nederland in Oekraïne geïnvesteerd? Bijna de helft is van deze oligarch’

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a report that nearly half of a reported 5 billion euros in Dutch investment in Ukraine belongs to one oligarch, and whether Ukrainian oligarchs avoid tax via Dutch shell companies. The government answered that DNB data show 9.8 billion euros invested in 2014, that tax confidentiality prevents breakdown by individual taxpayers, that anti-abuse measures are being pursued internationally and in a treaty negotiation, and that the trade benefits Dutch firms though job effects cannot be precisely quantified.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents further breakdown based on Tax Authority data on individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen verhindert verdere uitsplitsing op basis van gegevens van de Belastingdienst over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vernielingen door Israël in Palestijns Gebied

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli demolitions of over twenty buildings in Palestinian territory, including EU-funded structures, leaving more than 100 people homeless, and whether the government would protest and press the EU for tougher measures. The minister confirmed the facts, said the demolitions appear not to meet the military-necessity exception under occupation law, and stated the EU has expressed concern and urged transformative steps by Israel, without announcing a concrete new protest or measure.
Based on the available information, these demolitions do not appear to fall under this exception.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie lijken deze vernielingen niet onder deze uitzondering te vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over export van militair materieel aan Saoedi-Arabië

SP MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms export licences to Saudi Arabia breach EU and international law given the Yemen war and blockade, and whether Nederland will restrict such exports. The ministers acknowledge likely violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition, report four licences since March 2015 worth 2.8 million euro, and say they reject most military-related requests and will grant further licences only where no use in Yemen or rights abuses is conceivable.
Only when it is indisputably established that goods cannot be used in the fighting in Yemen or for human rights violations will a licence still be issued.
Alleen wanneer onomstotelijk vaststaat dat goederen niet kunnen worden ingezet in de strijd in Jemen of bij mensenrechtenschendingen zal nog een vergunning worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de situatie in de Turkse stad Cizre en de strafeis tegen twee journalisten

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of wounded civilians in Cizre denied medical care, urging condemnation under international humanitarian law, and about the life sentences sought against two Cumhuriyet journalists under terrorism laws. The minister expressed concern, called on parties to resume peace talks and stressed proportionality and human rights, said the Netherlands and EU raise these issues regularly, and stated that the court must decide while press freedom must improve.
I find these reports and the situation in southeast Turkey very worrying.
Ik vind deze berichten en de situatie in het zuidoosten van Turkije zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht 'Don't mention the Brexit: EU bans Plan B Studie'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether EU economists were banned from studying the economic consequences of a Brexit and whether the Commission's research agenda is independent. The minister said the cabinet knows nothing of such a ban, that impact assessments are publicly available, and that the cabinet sees no reason to challenge the Commission on this.
The cabinet is not aware of this.
Het kabinet is hiervan niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het optreden van Nederlandse special forces in Afrika

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked about Dutch special forces training African militaries in counter-terrorism, the participation in Flintlock exercises since 2007, and a secret marine taskforce against piracy off Somalia that was not reported to parliament. The government answered that training takes place in secured military areas with negligible risk, lists Flintlock deployments year by year, and states that anti-piracy operations were reported via the article 100 procedure without naming this taskforce.
The name of the taskforce in question was not mentioned at the time.
De naam van onderhavige taskforce is destijds niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over executies in Saudi-Arabië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the mass execution of 47 people in Saudi Arabia, including whether the trials were fair and independently observed, and what the government had done bilaterally and through the EU to voice concern. The minister answered that the trials followed local law but independent verification is impossible, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns bilaterally, backed an EU High Representative statement, and will send the human rights ambassador to Riyadh.
However, this is impossible to establish independently, because, as far as is known, no evidence has ever been made public in these cases.
Dit is echter onmogelijk onafhankelijk vast te stellen, omdat er, voor zover bekend, in deze zaken nooit bewijzen openbaar zijn gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse inlichtingen bij een drone-aanval met onschuldige burgerslachtoffers

MPs Hachchi and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch intelligence was used in a US drone strike causing civilian deaths, whether it was an illegal targeted killing, and whether sharing with partners should be reconsidered. The Minister of Defence said the government cannot confirm the strike was illegal, that the MIVD gathered the intelligence in NATO Operation Ocean Shield, that the government will reassess sharing if a partner is shown to carry out illegal targeted killings, and that CTIVD's review timing is for the CTIVD to announce.
As also stated in my reply to the questions of MPs Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak and Sjoerdsma of 10 April 2014, it is not known on the basis of what information such activities are carried out.

Zoals ook gemeld in mijn reactie op de vragen van leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak en Sjoerdsma van 10 april 2014 is niet bekend op basis van welke informatie dergelijke activiteiten worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het toezicht op Polen vanwege de mediawet

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU would strip Poland of voting rights over its media law, whether the Netherlands supports that, and what other pressure tools exist. The minister answered that no voting-rights sanction is on the table yet, that the Commission and Council of Europe have started a dialogue with Poland, and that the Netherlands will await a factual analysis before judging the law.
It is premature to draw definitive conclusions now about the nature, content and possible effects of the new Polish media law.
Het is prematuur nu reeds definitieve conclusies te trekken over de aard, inhoud en mogelijke effecten van de nieuwe Poolse mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vervolging van de Decembermoorden en het bloedbad van Moiwana in Suriname

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about prosecution of the December Murders and the Moiwana massacre in Suriname, including a Surinamese court ruling ordering resumed prosecution of Desi Bouterse and the Inter-American Court's call to prosecute the Moiwana perpetrators. The minister answered factually on the court ruling, the suspension history and the Inter-American Court judgment, and said the Netherlands will raise both cases in the next UPR and EU dialogue.
