The Netherlands will also make recommendations at the upcoming UPR regarding prosecution in the December Murders trial and for the events in Moiwana.
Nederland zal ook bij de komende UPR aanbevelingen doen met het oog op een vervolging in het Decembermoordenproces en voor de gebeurtenissen in Moiwana.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het opgelaaide geweld in Israël en de Palestijnse Gebieden

The MP Van Bommel asks the Minister of Foreign Affairs about Amnesty's findings of possibly extrajudicial killings by Israeli forces, proportionality of force, and attacks on medical personnel in the Palestinian territories. The minister says the Amnesty findings are serious, the government condemns attacks on civilians and expects proportionate Israeli responses, that Israeli authorities are investigating incidents, and that concerns about medical personnel will be raised in regular contacts with Israel.
The situation gives reason to keep following it critically and to raise the concerns on this point in regular contacts with Israel.
De situatie geeft aanleiding om deze kritisch te blijven volgen en de zorgen op dit punt in de reguliere contacten met Israël op te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van Koning Willem-Alexander aan China

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether the King's private holiday in China before the state visit, and his failure to voice human rights concerns personally, undermined the message on human rights in China. The minister replied that the King raised human rights in the banquet speech and at CELAP, that the government consistently prioritises human rights, and that a dialogue is maintained.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze opvatting niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'De kortingsregeling voor een studie aan de Open Universiteit'

The MPs asked whether Surinamese students living in Suriname are excluded from the Open Universiteit's collegegeld discount while Surinamese students in the Netherlands are eligible, and whether the discount should be extended to them. The minister denied the exclusion, explaining that since 2013 residence no longer matters for the statutory fee, so Surinamese students in Suriname can qualify, and she agreed that they should be able to.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over het optreden van de Turkse politie en het leger in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish military and police operations in southeastern Turkey, including civilian deaths, curfews and the Domestic Security Bill. The minister said the Netherlands lacks verified casualty figures, acknowledged concerns about proportionality and mobility restrictions, and said it raised the issue with Turkey and suggested an independent inquiry.
The Netherlands has brought the option of an independent investigation to the attention of the Turkish authorities.
Nederland heeft de optie van een onafhankelijk onderzoek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanslag op kamp Hurriya in Irak

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a rocket attack on Camp Liberty in Iraq, its perpetrators, the government's response, humanitarian conditions and resettlement of residents. The minister condemned the attack, said Iraq was urged to investigate, stated camp conditions meet UN standards, and declined to commit to new demands on Iraq or to admitting camp residents to the Netherlands beyond Dutch nationals.
Within the EU, the Iraqi government has been called upon to investigate the attack and to protect the camp's residents in accordance with the December 2011 agreement with the UN.
In EU-verband is de Iraakse overheid opgeroepen om een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de aanslag en de bewoners van het kamp te beschermen conform de overeenkomst met de VN van december 2011.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de in Suriname vermiste helikopter met een Nederlander aan boord

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked about the status of Dutch assistance in searching for a helicopter missing in Suriname with a Dutch national aboard, and what Dutch help was offered. The minister replied that Dutch search-and-rescue expertise was offered and used, but the Netherlands lacks the requested foliage-penetrating radar and will consider any future Surinamese request.
The Netherlands had to conclude that the request could not be met.
Nederland heeft moeten constateren dat niet aan het verzoek kon worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over de plaatsing van nieuwe kernwapens in Duitsland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about German nuclear-capable upgrades at Büchel, whether Dutch costs for Volkel were estimated, whether modernising B61 weapons conflicts with Global Zero and risks an arms race, and whether the Netherlands should drop modernisation now the JSF will not carry nuclear tasks. The government declined to speculate on Russian reactions, said NATO funds the WS-3 upgrades and gave no cost figures, rejected the view that modernisation conflicts with disarmament, and said it will keep the nuclear task debate open within NATO and not press for abandoning the B61 life-extension.
Under alliance agreements, no statements are made about the Netherlands' nuclear task.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken worden er geen mededelingen gedaan over de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over luchtaanval op het ziekenhuis van Artsen zonder Grenzen in Kunduz

An SP MP asked the ministers about the October 2015 airstrike on the Médecins Sans Frontières hospital in Kunduz, including the death toll, consequences for patients, whether coordinates were shared with parties, and whether an independent international investigation should be called for. The government expressed condolences, said it welcomed ongoing US, Afghan and NATO investigations, and saw no reason yet to call for an extra international inquiry.
The cabinet first wants to await the outcome of ongoing investigations and currently sees no reason to call for an additional international investigation.
Het kabinet wil eerst de uitkomst van lopende onderzoeken afwachten en ziet op dit moment geen reden om te pleiten voor een extra internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht: “Eurozone crosses Rubicon as Portugal’s anti-euro Left banned from power”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Portuguese president's handling of government formation after the 2015 election, including his remarks against an anti-euro Left coalition, and about the effects of Portugal's austerity programme. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects the president's choice following Portuguese custom, sees no reason to doubt constitutional procedures, and described the economic recovery and remaining reform needs.

The Netherlands respects President Cavaco Silva's decision to follow the Portuguese custom for appointing a formateur and has no reason to doubt that the Portuguese democratic and constitutional frameworks were not respected.

Nederland respecteert het besluit van president Cavaco Silva om de Portugese gewoonte voor de benoeming van een formateur te volgen en heeft geen reden om er aan te twijfelen dat de Portugese democratische en grondwettelijke kaders niet zijn gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de door Nederland gedoneerde scanner op de grens tussen Gaza en Israël

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch-donated container scanner at the Gaza-Israel border really serves to boost Gaza exports, and why truck counts and export capacity differ from other reports. The minister confirms the scanner's export and import purpose, explains the differing truck figures, notes that export is still only about 7% of pre-2007 levels, and says the current scanner's capacity is nearly reached, so a second scanner has been requested.
The Netherlands will continue, together with international partners, to work for further expansion of export opportunities.
Nederland blijft samen met internationale partners inzetten op verdere verruiming van export mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over de besteding van een IMF-lening aan Oekraïne

MPs Van Bommel and Merkies asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether IMF loan money to Ukraine was diverted to offshore accounts linked to oligarch Kolomoisky, and sought investigation of beneficial owners and auditor selection. The ministers answered that Dutch funds are pooled and untraceable, that the IMF found no irregularities in the central bank's use of funds, and that since the IMF already supervises its funds no further investigation is needed.
Since it is standard policy that the IMF monitors the use of its public funds and this has recently occurred in the case of Ukraine, we see no need to advocate further investigation.

Aangezien het standaard beleid is dat het IMF de besteding van haar publieke middelen controleert en dit recent is gebeurd in het geval van Oekraïne, zien wij geen noodzaak om voor nader onderzoek te pleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een in Saudi opgelegde doodstraf

The MP asks whether the government knows of the death sentence imposed on Ali Mohammed al-Nimr for offences allegedly committed at age 17, whether it will press Saudi authorities to halt execution, and what it thinks of reported torture and beheading/crucifixion. The minister confirms awareness, condemns the death penalty and the sentencing of a minor as a breach of the UN Children's Rights Convention, says the EU and member states will raise concerns, and states the judge has not yet decided on the method of execution.
From that perspective, the EU and member states will raise their concerns about this case in their contacts with the Saudi authorities.
Vanuit die zienswijze zullen de EU en lidstaten in hun contacten met de Saoedische autoriteiten hun zorgen omtrent deze zaak opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het optreden van het Turkse leger en de politie in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the conduct of the Turkish army and police in southeast Turkey and about casualties, and whether residents are confined by security zones. The minister answered that Turkey may defend itself but measures must be proportionate, that no verified casualty figures are available, and that residents can leave the security zones despite checkpoints and curfews.
The cabinet does not have verified figures on the number of casualties on either side.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde cijfers wat betreft aantallen slachtoffers aan weerszijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over oplopende spanningen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about escalating violence in Turkey between state forces and the PKK, attacks on HDP offices and Kurdish civilians, Turkish cross-border strikes in Iraq, a police shooting law, and the fairness of the November elections. The minister said there are no verified casualty figures, confirmed the attacks and police lateness, called for proportionate responses and a ceasefire, noted the shooting law's scope, and said the elections are proceeding with ODIHR observation planned.
The cabinet does not have verified figures on the number of casualties on either side.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde cijfers wat betreft aantallen slachtoffers aan weerszijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat de fraude binnen de Europese begroting is toegenomen

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about reported rises in EU budget fraud, the suspension of Scottish ESF payments, how to reduce fraud vulnerability, and whether the Dutch Presidency would address it. The minister answered that the figures reflect better detection rather than certainly more incidents, described the OLAF and member-state control framework, and promised further information on the MFK and budget transparency before the 2016 budget debate.
Your House will be informed about this prior to the discussion of the draft 2016 budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Uw Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan de behandeling van de ontwerpbegroting voor 2016 van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verwoesting van landbouwgrond nabij Bethlehem door Israël

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel destroyed Palestinian agricultural land near Bethlehem, the financial damage, whether Dutch-funded projects were hit and whether the government would demand compensation. The minister confirmed the destruction of crops and infrastructure at five sites funded by Dutch programmes worth about EUR 40,000, said the Netherlands has no legal basis to claim compensation since funding had ended, and only protested to Israeli authorities.
The Netherlands therefore has no legal basis to demand compensation.
Nederland heeft daarmee geen juridische basis om een schadevergoeding te eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de praktijk van 'landjepik in Europa'

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about large-scale farmland acquisition by foreign investors in Europe, its effects on local populations, food security, land prices, EU subsidies, and whether EU or national rules can restrict it. The government answered that local populations are not generally harmed, the TNI report's effects are insufficiently substantiated, existing EU rules allow only non-discriminatory and proportionate restrictions, and it sees no reason to raise the issue at EU level.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise this at European level.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit op Europees niveau aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over burgerslachtoffers in de strijd tegen IS

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about an Airwars report on hundreds of civilian deaths from coalition airstrikes against IS, including whether the coalition's figure of two civilian deaths was accurate, and whether Netherlands would disclose where and when it struck. The ministers said the coalition takes civilian casualty reports seriously, that five investigations are completed and seven ongoing, and that they will not say which specific attacks Netherlands carried out for operational and domestic security reasons.
For operational reasons and in the interest of domestic security, we make no statements about specific cases.
Om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid doen wij geen uitspraken over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rol van Nederland in het faciliteren van belastingontwijking vanuit Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands facilitates tax avoidance from Greece through letterbox companies, and about Greek tax collection, the Lagarde list, and the troika's negotiating conduct. The minister denied that Dutch letterbox firms facilitate avoidance, refused to give company-specific or nationality-based information citing tax confidentiality, and gave general answers on Greek reforms and the bailout process.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot provide information on individual taxpayers.
Ik kan op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanslag in Suruç in het zuiden van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Suruç suicide bombing, its suspected IS link, Turkey's measures against foreign fighters transiting its territory, and reports of IS fighters treated in Turkish hospitals. The minister answered that the attack is unclaimed and under investigation, that Turkey cannot fully control its Syrian border, and that the Netherlands cannot confirm treatment of IS fighters or assess the effectiveness of Turkish measures.
The cabinet cannot confirm that ISIS fighters have been treated in Turkey, but it cannot rule out that terrorist fighters also use these facilities.
Het kabinet kan niet bevestigen dat ISIS-strijders in Turkije zijn behandeld, maar het valt niet uit te sluiten dat ook terroristische strijders van deze voorzieningen gebruik maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Van Bommel, Teeven en Taverne over het bericht dat zes Russische leden van de OVSE Parlementaire Assemblee vanwege de voor hen geldende EU-inreisverboden geen visum voor Finland h

MPs asked whether Finland's refusal of visas to six sanctioned Russian OSCE Parliamentary Assembly members, who were barred by EU travel bans, and the absence of a clear exemption for interparliamentary meetings was acceptable and whether the government would seek a formal exception. The minister answered that Finland only had to inform other member states, that the EU travel-ban rules contain only limited exceptions, and that the government values parliamentary dialogue in the OSCE but offered no commitment to seek a new formal exception.
The cabinet cannot comment on any reactions other member states may have given within the confidential Council framework.
Op (eventuele) reacties die overige lidstaten in vertrouwelijk Raadskader hebben gegeven, kan het kabinet niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over excuses van het Japanse bedrijf Mitsubishi aan Nederlanders die dwangarbeid hebben moeten verrichten tijdens WOII

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Mitsubishi's apology to American forced labourers, how many Dutch POWs Mitsubishi employed and died, and whether he would press Mitsubishi to apologise to Dutch victims. The minister answered that roughly 200 to 500 Dutch POWs worked for Mitsubishi-linked firms, that numbers cannot be verified with certainty, and that he would welcome an apology on Mitsubishi's own initiative without committing to pressure the company.
It is not possible to establish this number with certainty.
Het is niet mogelijk dit aantal met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schendingen van het oorlogsrecht sinds de uitbraak van het gewapende conflict in Jemen

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether the government shares Human Rights Watch's concerns about apparent war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition and other parties in Yemen, and whether it supports an international inquiry via the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that the findings are very worrying, that responsibility for investigating violations lies first with the parties themselves, and that the Netherlands is working on a Human Rights Council resolution and will explore an international inquiry if parties fail to investigate.
If the conflict parties fail to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law, the Cabinet will explore the possibility of an international commission of inquiry in this context.

Indien de conflictpartijen het nalaten om vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht te onderzoeken, zal het Kabinet in deze context de mogelijkheid van een internationale onderzoekscommissie verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de civielrechtelijke regeling naar aanleiding van standrechtelijke executies in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the status of civil compensation claims from relatives of victims of summary executions in the former Dutch East Indies, public awareness of the scheme in Indonesia, access to Nationaal Archief name lists, and extending the claim deadline. The ministers reported claim figures, said awareness among eligible persons cannot be estimated, noted the documents are available on request, and agreed to extend the deadline by two years.
Yes, we have decided to extend the deadline for submission by two years.
Ja, wij hebben besloten de termijn voor indiening met twee jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over een uitzending van Brandpunt waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen aan EU-subsidies voor kwetsbare groepen niet goed terecht komen

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked, following a Brandpunt broadcast, why EU subsidies meant for Roma and Sinti were spent improperly, who checks such projects, and whether the EU should prevent this rather than create a European Public Prosecutor. The government answered that the Roemenian authorities and the Commission are responsible for spending and control, that a full audit chain exists, that new 2014-2020 rules stress performance, and that withdrawing subsidies and a European Prosecutor are distinct tools, while declining to judge specific projects before audits conclude.

Before the cabinet can make statements about a specific case or individual project, it is important to await further investigation by the responsible bodies (in this case the European Commission and European Court of Auditors).

Voordat het kabinet uitspraken kan doen over een specifieke casus of een individueel project, is het van belang om nader onderzoek door de verantwoordelijke instanties (in dit geval de Europese Commissie en Europese Rekenkamer) af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het proces tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus in Azerbeidzjan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the trial of Leyla and Arif Yunus in Azerbaijan was starting in early July, whether foreign observers would attend, and whether the trial is public. The minister confirmed the hearing was postponed to 15 July and that the Dutch embassy in Baku monitors such trials and will join an observer rotation with like-minded states.

In line with the EU Guidelines on Human Rights Defenders, the Dutch embassy, together with like-minded states and under coordination of the EU delegation, will take part in the rotation scheme of foreign observers at the trial of Leyla and Arif Yunus.

In lijn met de EU-richtsnoeren inzake mensenrechtenverdedigers zal de Nederlandse ambassade in samenwerking met gelijkgestemde staten en onder coördinatie van de EU-delegatie onderdeel uitmaken van het roulatieschema van buitenlandse waarnemers bij het proces tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executie Mansour Arvan in Iran

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether he could confirm the reported execution of Kurdish prisoner Mansour Arvand in Iran, the basis for the death sentence, and the number of executions in Iran, and whether the government would press Iran for a moratorium. The minister said the execution report is known but unconfirmed, the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, and it will continue to urge Iran to abolish it and to halt executions in the meantime.
The Netherlands will continue, both through the EU and bilaterally, to urge the Iranian authorities to abolish the death penalty.
Nederland blijft, zowel via de EU als bilateraal, bij de Iraanse autoriteiten aandringen op het afschaffen van de doodstraf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de governance gap op het gebied van bedrijfsgerelateerde mensenrechtenschendingen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Foreign Affairs about the global governance gap in preventing business-related human rights abuses, whether a binding Business and Human Rights Treaty would help, why the Netherlands joins TTIP talks but not the treaty talks, and the government's position and EU parameters for the IGWG. The ministers answered that the UN Guiding Principles and the national action plan are the preferred route, that the EU parameters for joining the IGWG have not been met, and that the Netherlands chairs the Council of Europe instrument negotiations.
The cabinet expects companies to respect in other countries the same human rights standards as in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven dat ze in het buitenland dezelfde mensenrechtenstandaarden eerbiedigen als in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Bilderbergconferentie

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister about topics discussed at the 2015 Bilderberg conference, his own contributions, and the travel costs. The Prime Minister answered that the organisers published the main topics, that the Chatham House rule applies so his own input is not disclosed, and that his travel and accommodation cost 1,590 euros borne by the state.
The Chatham House rule applies to the meeting, which ensures a meaningful exchange of views.
Voor de bijeenkomst geldt de Chatham House rule, die een zinvolle gedachtewisseling verzekert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van clustermunitie in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he could confirm reports that the Saudi-led coalition used cluster munitions in Yemen, and how he assessed civilian deaths and possible violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition and the Houthis. The minister could not confirm the cluster munition reports, said UN and US inquiries were ongoing, and said the government lacked the factual information to judge compliance with humanitarian law by either side, while noting the EU and UN had called on the parties to respect it.
The government does not have the necessary factual information to give a well-founded judgment on compliance with international humanitarian law in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie om in dit specifieke geval een gefundeerd oordeel te kunnen geven over de naleving van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over marteling door Indonesische politie in Papua

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the torture of four students, three of them minors, by Indonesian police in Papua, their current condition, and whether the government would press for an independent investigation, prosecution and compensation. The minister confirmed the incident, reported the victims' hospital treatment, and said KomnasHAM conducted an independent inquiry whose findings the police accepted, with disciplinary sanctions promised but unconfirmed and the situation to be monitored.
The Jayapura office of the National Human Rights Commission (KomnasHAM) conducted an independent investigation into this case.
Het kantoor van de Nationale Mensenrechtencommissie (KomnasHAM) in Jayapura, Papua, heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek in deze zaak ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over druk vanuit de VS, Groot-Brittannië en Canada om geen steun te geven aan een verbod op kernwapens

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands supports Austria's call for nuclear disarmament steps and whether allies were pressured to oppose it. The minister confirmed the Austrian call, denied the pressure claims, said Dutch diplomats discuss the pledge with both supporters and opponents, and held that a ban treaty should be the end of disarmament rather than its start, so no new support is given.
The Netherlands therefore sees a treaty with a ban, as proposed in the Austrian Pledge, as the capstone of a disarmament process and not its beginning.
Nederland ziet een verdrag met een verbod, zoals voorgesteld in de «Austrian Pledge», dan ook als het sluitstuk van een ontwapeningsproces en niet als het begin ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Servaes over het militaire optreden van onder meer Saudi-Arabië in Jemen

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths from Saudi-led airstrikes in Yemen, including an attack on a UN refugee camp, and whether these may violate international humanitarian law. The minister acknowledged serious concern and casualty figures, said there is insufficient information to judge legal compliance, and called for a political solution and a return to UN-led negotiations, without committing to a concrete new step beyond raising the issue in EU channels.
There is currently insufficient information available to give a balanced judgment on whether the airstrikes were carried out in accordance with applicable international humanitarian law.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende informatie beschikbaar om een afgewogen oordeel te geven of de luchtaanvallen in overeenstemming met het toepasselijke humanitair oorlogsrecht zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over containers met stenen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked why ten containers returning Defence materiel from Afghanistan arrived at Volkel air base filled with stones. The minister answered that eleven containers were involved, that the seals were intact on arrival, that the military police (KMAR) could not establish how the goods were removed and has closed its investigation, so the materiel must be considered lost.
The KMAR has now closed the investigation. The materiel must therefore be considered lost.
Inmiddels heeft de KMAR het onderzoek gesloten. Het materieel moet daarom als verloren worden beschouwd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een ter dood veroordeelde Iraniër

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saman Naseem, sentenced for an offence committed as a minor, faces imminent execution in Iran, whether execution of juvenile offenders violates treaties Iran is party to, and whether he was tortured during trial, and asked the minister to contact Iranian counterparts. The minister confirmed the reports, that execution of juvenile offenders is prohibited under treaties, denied torture, and said the EU and the Netherlands had demarched Iran and urged it to halt the execution.
Following reports of the imminent execution of Saman Naseem, the EU, with Dutch support, made a demarche to the Iranian authorities.
Naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de op handen zijnde executie van Saman Naseem heeft de EU, met steun van NL, bij de Iraanse autoriteiten gedemarcheerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over visserij voor de kust van de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch-flagged fishing off Western Sahara, including the legal basis for treating the activity as lawful, whether local population consent is required, and how fishing revenues benefit the local population. The minister defended the UN position treating Morocco as de facto administering power, stated that consent of the indigenous population's representatives is not currently required under international law though consultation should occur, and described EU payments and 31 Morocco-reported projects, 13 of them in Western Sahara, with reporting due at the next joint committee.

The Netherlands is of the view that the proceeds of fishing through EU payments for access to, among other waters, the waters of Western Sahara, where Morocco exercises de facto authority, should also benefit the original population of Western Sahara.

Nederland is van oordeel dat de opbrengsten van de visserij via de EU-afdrachten ten behoeve van toegang tot onder meer de wateren van de Westelijke Sahara, waar Marokko feitelijk gezag uitoefent, ook ten goede moeten komen aan de oorspronkelijke bevolking van de Westelijke Sahara.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Verheijen over activiteiten van Turkije in de exclusieve economische zone van Cyprus

MPs Van Bommel and Verheijen asked whether Turkish seismic survey activity in Cyprus's exclusive economic zone is illegal and whether the government will condemn it. The minister said Turkey is not party to UNCLOS, the maritime boundary is disputed, the survey is provocative and unhelpful, and the Netherlands regrets it, but did not call it illegal.
Nederland betreurt de acties van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht ‘Israël draait de geldkraan dicht’

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Israel withheld Palestinian Authority tax revenues as retaliation for the Palestinian ICC membership bid, whether this lacks legal basis or amounts to collective punishment, and what the government will do about it. The minister confirms a temporary suspension tied to the ICC bid, says the legal question is for the Oslo parties, and states the government has urged Israel to resume payments and raised it at EU level, while welcoming Palestinian adherence to international law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat Polen drie spookvliegvelden heeft laten bouwen met subsidie van de EU

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Poland built three barely used airports with EU subsidies, including the amounts, causes, consequences for funding, lessons for the Commission and whether monitoring should be tightened. The minister replied that about 66 million euro went to the named airports under cohesion funds, pointed to a European Court of Auditors report on airport overcapacity, said the matter is for the EU institutions and that Dutch policy favours stricter monitoring of cohesion funds.
I leave such an assessment at project level to the responsible European institutions.
Ik laat een dergelijke beoordeling op projectniveau aan de verantwoordelijke Europese instellingen over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het vonnis van de Saoedische blogger Raif Badawi uitgevoerd zal worden

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Saudi blogger Raif Badawi would receive public flogging, and what the EU and the Netherlands were doing to prevent it. The minister said the EU and the Netherlands have repeatedly raised the case and condemned the punishment, but that it has not yet led to a revision of the sentence, and that the case was referred back to the Supreme Court.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work, both bilaterally and within the EU, to improve the situation of human rights defenders in Saudi Arabia.
Nederland zal zich zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband actief blijven inzetten om de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Saoedi-Arabië te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat een medewerkster van de Nederlandse ambassade in Bagdad gevoelige informatie zou hebben gelekt

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether a local employee at the Dutch embassy in Baghdad had leaked sensitive information to Iraqi intelligence, whether screening of embassy staff is adequate, and whether military personnel could be endangered. The government answered that an investigation found no evidence of leaking or selling information, that screening of local staff is done as well as possible, and that no defence information appears compromised.

The investigation, in which the Ministry of Defence was also involved, has now been completed and no indications were found that the employee in question leaked or sold information to the Iraqi intelligence service.

Het onderzoek, waarbij ook het Ministerie van Defensie betrokken was, is inmiddels voltooid en er zijn geen aanwijzingen gevonden dat betrokken medewerkster informatie heeft gelekt dan wel heeft verkocht aan de Iraakse inlichtingendienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of anti-slavery activists in Mauritania, including their treatment, fair trial prospects and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister replied that the activists remain detained awaiting trial, that Biram Abeid is treated well, that the EU, UN and US press for a fair trial, and that the EU and the Netherlands have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities.
The European Union has expressed its serious concerns about this to the Prime Minister of Mauritania and continues to follow this matter very closely.
De Europese Unie heeft zijn ernstige zorgen hierover uitgesproken bij de Premier van Mauritanië en blijft deze zaak zeer nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de uitvoering van de motie aangaande het tegengaan van straffeloosheid voor genocide in Guatemala

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister how the motion to counter impunity for genocide in Guatemala has been implemented and what the government will do next. The minister answered that legal pressure on prosecutions has grown, lists steps taken (embassy visits, EU statements, plans for an additional staff member and a human rights ambassador visit, and support for extending CICIG's mandate), though the answers stay largely at the level of diplomatic activity.
The Netherlands will advocate bilaterally and within the EU that Guatemala request an extension of CICIG's mandate.
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband bepleiten dat Guatemala een verlenging van het mandaat van CICIG verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een rapport over Amerikaanse aanvallen met onbemande vliegtuigen in Pakistan en Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report claiming US drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen killed up to 1,147 people, many civilians, and about proportionality and US transparency. The minister said the cabinet lacks enough information to judge the strikes, stressed proportionality and transparency efforts, and declined to seek specific clarification from the US, Pakistan or Yemen.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to request further information specifically about this report.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om specifiek over dit rapport nadere informatie te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het Senaatsrapport betreffende CIA detenties en ondervragingen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US Senate torture report proves US torture of terror suspects, whether impunity should be ended, whether the Netherlands extradited suspects to the US, and whether the EU should press for investigation of member states' complicity. The minister answered that the practices violate international standards, that prosecution is for US judicial authorities, that only one terror suspect has been extradited to the US with assurances of ordinary trial, and that Netherlands will raise the matter at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
Since 11 September 2001, one terrorism suspect has been extradited to the US.
Sinds 11 september 2001 is er één verdachte van terrorisme aan de VS uitgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over uitlevering van personen aan landen met de doodstraf

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked whether extradition to Texas, a death-penalty state, was approved for a murder suspect and how extradition to death-penalty countries is handled. The government answered that Texas gave a guarantee via the US federal Justice Department that the death penalty would not be imposed, that the suspect was examined in person by a forensic psychiatrist, that Dutch law requires an unambiguous guarantee against the death penalty, and that it sees no conflict with ECHR Article 3.
Extradition to the United States is permitted after the authorities of the state of Texas guaranteed that the death penalty will not be imposed in this case.
De uitlevering aan de Verenigde Staten (VS) is toegestaan nadat de autoriteiten van de staat Texas hebben gegarandeerd dat het opleggen van de doodstraf in deze zaak niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de richtlijn aangaande registratie van het geboorteland van in Palestina geboren personen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked why the civil registry directive records people born in East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip or West Bank after 14 May 1948 as birthplace 'Onbekend' rather than Palestine, and whether this causes problems. The Minister replied that the Palestine mandate ended on 14 May 1948, the territories are treated as occupied under international law, and the Netherlands has not recognised a Palestinian state, while acknowledging no problems are known and that other EU states use different practices.
For that reason, the birthplace 'Unknown' was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor geboorteland «Onbekend».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van 78 minderjarigen in Egypte

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the sentencing of 78 minors in Egypt for joining pro-Morsi rallies, the scale of repression against opponents, and a draft anti-terrorism law. The minister confirmed the sentencing, said hard figures are lacking, expressed concern, and committed to continued dialogue with Egyptian authorities on human rights.
However, it is not possible to verify the numbers.
Het is echter niet mogelijk aantallen te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een bufferzone aan de Egyptische grens met Gaza

The MP Van Bommel asks about Egypt's buffer zone along the Gaza border, including demolished homes, compensation for affected residents, and effects on Gaza access and cross-border trade. The minister confirms the demolitions (1,156 households), says Egypt has promised compensation, notes the buffer has little effect on Gaza beyond destroying smuggling tunnels, and states the Dutch concern has been conveyed to the Egyptian ambassador.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has already conveyed the Dutch concerns on this matter to the Egyptian ambassador in the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Nederlandse zorgen hieromtrent reeds overgebracht aan de Egyptische ambassadeur in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van clusterbommen in Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether cluster munitions have been used in Ukraine, including reported Ukrainian and separatist use in Donetsk, and whether the government will press parties to stop. The minister says the reports cannot yet be confirmed, that the OSCE will report, that the concern was raised with Ukraine and at UN and treaty fora, and that the cause of a Red Cross worker's death is not yet established.
These reports cannot yet be confirmed.
Deze berichten kunnen vooralsnog niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de berichten dat Koerdische strijders ISIS-strijders zouden executeren

MPs Van Bommel and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Kurdish fighters executed captured ISIS fighters and destroyed the Arab town of Barzan, and whether an independent inquiry into possible war crimes should be pressed for. The minister said the executions could not be confirmed, that executing hors de combat fighters is prohibited, that no further information on Barzan is known, and that the primary duty to investigate lies with Iraqi authorities, with calls already made to Iraqi and Kurdish authorities to treat prisoners humanely.
The duty to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law lies in the first instance with the Iraqi authorities.
De plicht tot het doen van onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht ligt in eerste instantie bij de Iraakse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over busvervoer op de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asks whether a planned Israeli pilot requiring Palestinian workers to return through the same checkpoint effectively excludes them from Israeli buses in the occupied West Bank, and whether the Minister will seek clarification and oppose discriminatory measures. The Minister answers that no official decision has been taken, that Palestinian workers retain the legal right to use public transport, that the embassy has requested an explanation, and that the government awaits Israel's answer to the attorney-general's request while monitoring the situation.
The cabinet is now awaiting the Israeli Minister of Defence's answer to the attorney-general's request in order to obtain more clarity on the announced measure.

Het kabinet is nu in afwachting van het antwoord van de Israëlische Minister van Defensie op het verzoek van de procureur-generaal teneinde meer duidelijkheid te verkrijgen over de aangekondigde maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan bij de Conference of Parties van het United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change

MP Van Bommel asks whether Taiwan should obtain observer status at the UNFCCC Conference of Parties in Lima given Taiwan's relatively high CO2 emissions. Minister Koenders answers that Taiwan cannot become a party due to its status under the one-China policy, that involvement is warranted only in specific cases, and that a pragmatic arrangement already exists via the observer participation of ITRI.
Taiwan's participation may also be important in areas where Taiwan is such a major player that global coordination without Taiwan cannot be effective.
Deelname van Taiwan kan tevens van belang zijn op terreinen waar Taiwan een dermate grote speler is dat mondiale coördinatie zonder Taiwan niet effectief kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht ‘UN envoy urges Turkey to allow Kurds to protect Syria’s Kobani’

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Kobani is surrounded, whether the government will press Turkey to guarantee civilians safe passage, and whether it supports the UN envoy's call for Turkey to admit volunteers to defend the town. The minister said the situation is volatile, Turkey is not blocking civilians fleeing, and the government understands the call but notes Turkey's PKK concerns; it reports Turkish agreement to let Iraqi Kurdish fighters transit to Kobani.
No, according to UNHCR Turkey is not preventing civilians from fleeing to Turkey.
Nee, volgens UNHCR verhindert Turkije niet dat burgers naar Turkije vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 130.000 vluchtelingen naar Turkije

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Turkey had closed border crossings to Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would press Turkey, offer more humanitarian aid, and resettle more refugees. The minister answered that Turkey reduced crossings to two rather than closing all, described Turkish reception and registration, pointed to 30 million euro in extra aid, and said resettlement would continue in 2015 with details to follow.
To prevent further chaos, two border crossings remain open so that Turkey and UNHCR can register the refugees in a controlled manner.
Om verdere chaos te voorkomen blijven vooralsnog twee grensovergangen open zodat Turkije en UNHCR gecontroleerd de vluchtelingen kunnen registreren

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over bericht dat de Saudische blogger Raif Badawi in beroep is veroordeeld tot duizend zweepslagen, 10 jaar gevangenisstraf gevolgd door een 10-jarig uitreisverbod

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked whether the minister is aware of the appeal sentence against blogger Raif Badawi (1,000 lashes, 10 years prison, travel ban and fine) and what steps the government will take, including public pressure on Saudi authorities and an EU statement. The minister confirmed awareness and said the government prefers to raise individual cases within the EU, noting a demarche in May 2014 and that the Netherlands will keep pressing for action to prevent enforcement.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts within the EU for new action towards the Saudi authorities to prevent enforcement of the sentence.
Nederland zal zich in EU-verband blijven inspannen voor nieuwe actie richting de Saudische autoriteiten om uitvoering van het vonnis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over door Israël gevangengenomen Palestijnse parlementariërs

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the deportation-style restriction of Palestinian MP Khalida Jarrar and the detention of Palestinian legislators by Israel, asking whether the government shares concern and will summon the Israeli ambassador. The minister shares concern about the military court's order placing Jarrar under supervision in Jericho without access to evidence, reports 36 PLC members in detention, and sees no reason to summon the ambassador.

The cabinet shares concern about the decision of an Israeli military court to move PLC member Khalida Jarrar to Jericho for security reasons and place her under supervision there for six months, without giving her access to the evidence.

Het kabinet deelt de zorgen over het besluit van een Israëlische militaire rechtbank om PLC-lid Khalida Jarrar vanwege veiligheidszorgen over te brengen naar Jericho en haar daar voor een periode van zes maanden onder toezicht te plaatsen, zonder haar inzage in de bewijslast te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over de dreigende veroordeling van de Tunesische mensenrechtenactiviste Héla Boujneh

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Tunisian human rights activist Héla Boujneh, whether she was held without reasons or lawyer access, and whether the Netherlands would raise her case and send an observer to her trial. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the government is seeking facts, noted her release pending trial, committed to raising the case with his Tunisian counterpart, and said the embassy intends to send an observer, while answering the women's rights question with general praise for Tunisian reforms.
The cabinet is trying to establish the factual circumstances of Héla Boujneh's arrest.
Het kabinet tracht de feitelijke omstandigheden van Héla Boujnehs arrestatie te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het onaanvaardbare geweld van Israël in Gaza

Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's attacks on civilian targets in Gaza would be met with further diplomatic measures, such as summoning the ambassador, whether the government would inform parliament and consider EU Association Agreement consequences and an investigation into possible war crimes, and whether it would support Palestinian accession to the ICC. Minister Timmermans replied that diplomatic contacts had voiced serious concern without summoning the ambassador, favoured an independent investigation via existing UN mechanisms, and said only states can join the ICC and the Netherlands does not recognise Palestine.
The cabinet has chosen not to summon either Israel's or the PA's representative.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om de vertegenwoordiger van Israël noch die van de PA te ontbieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de voortgang van de behandeling van de claims van weduwen van slachtoffers van standrechtelijke executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about delays in handling compensation claims from widows of victims of summary executions in Indonesia, including claim outcomes, deaths of claimants, evidentiary standards and inheritance of claims. The government denied deliberate delay, reported eight claims granted and ten rejected, said evidentiary requirements are less strict than in court, and referred to a separate letter for several answers.
It is incorrect that the payment of a possible compensation is being deliberately delayed.
Het is onjuist dat de uitbetaling van een mogelijke schadevergoeding wordt getraineerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het rapport van United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA)

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UNRWA report on Gaza casualties, the proportionality of Israel's response, a remark by an Israeli minister about temporarily taking over Gaza, and EU efforts toward a ceasefire. The minister confirmed the report, affirmed Israel's right to self-defence within the limits of international humanitarian law, said no Israeli takeover is currently planned, and described ongoing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure for de-escalation.
The Netherlands recognises Israel's right to protect its citizens and territory against rocket attacks by Hamas from the Gaza Strip, subject to the limits international humanitarian law imposes.

Nederland erkent het recht van Israël om zijn eigen burgers en grondgebied te beschermen tegen raketbeschietingen van Hamas vanuit de Gaza-strook, met inachtneming van de grenzen die het oorlogsrecht hieraan stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Tanamal en Van Bommel over gevangenschap van politieke activisten in Indonesië

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about political prisoners in Indonesia, including Johan Teterissa, arrests at a 25 April demonstration, and whether the government would press for their release or transfer closer to family. The minister confirmed awareness of the cases, noted Dutch concerns raised bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and committed to raising transfers of Moluccan prisoners with Indonesia and in the EU.

At the human rights debate on 30 June it was promised that the cabinet will raise the placement of Moluccan prisoners closer to home with the Indonesian government, and that this will also be pursued at EU level.

Tijdens het nota-overleg mensenrechten op 30 juni is toegezegd dat het kabinet de plaatsing van Molukse gevangenen dichter bij huis met de Indonesische regering zal opnemen, en dat dit ook in EU-verband zal worden opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de strafeis tegen de Nederlandse journalist Rena Netjes

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the heavy prison sentences sought against 20 journalists in Egypt, including the Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether the government would seek clarification from Egyptian authorities and whether fair trials are possible in Egypt. The minister confirmed maximum sentences were requested, reported that Netjes was sentenced in absentia to ten years, described diplomatic steps taken including summoning the Egyptian ambassador, and expressed serious concern about Egyptian judicial developments.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about various negative developments in Egyptian judicial practice.
Het kabinet maakt zich grote zorgen over diverse negatieve ontwikkelingen in de Egyptische rechtspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een vertrouwenspersoon voor onderzoek naar de veiligheid van kernwapens in Nederland

MP Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister whether she would respond to Noord-Brabant's concerns about nuclear weapon safety at Volkel and appoint an independent trusted person to investigate, including transport safety. The minister replied the cabinet sees no reason to doubt the safety of US nuclear weapons in Europe, but under alliance agreements no information on numbers or locations can be given, not even to a trusted person.
However, based on alliance agreements, as is well known, no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of these weapons, not even to a trusted person.
Op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken kunnen echter, zoals bekend, geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van deze wapens, ook niet aan een vertrouwenspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Omtzigt, Van Bommel over de vernietiging van 64 kerken in de Chinese provincie Zhejiang

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 64 churches in China's Zhejiang province were demolished or stripped of Christian elements under a demolition campaign, and whether central authorities back it. The minister confirmed the reports, said the campaign targets illegal buildings and anti-corruption, and said Dutch concerns on religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands will continue to raise this worrying development both bilaterally and through the EU.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als via de EU aandacht blijven vragen voor deze zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat Suriname van de Toescheidingsovereenkomst af wil

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views Suriname's wish to terminate the Treaty on Dual Nationality (Toescheidingsovereenkomst), whether talks are ongoing, and whether the Netherlands would go to the International Court of Justice if Suriname unilaterally set the treaty aside. The minister replied that unilateral termination is not possible under treaty law, that the Netherlands opposes ending the treaty while the rights of certain Surinamese-Dutch are not adequately safeguarded, that talks have stalled since 2010, and that the treaty's main goal of settling nationality has been achieved, so recourse to the ICJ is not currently warranted.
Unilateral termination of the Treaty on Dual Nationality (TO) is not possible under treaty law.
Eenzijdige opzegging van de Toescheidingsovereenkomst (hierna: TO) is verdragsrechtelijk niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verlenging van het mandaat van VN-missie MINURSO (Missie van de VN voor het Referendum in de Westelijke Sahara)

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether human rights monitoring should be added to the MINURSO mandate in Western Sahara, and what the Netherlands would do bilaterally or within the EU. The minister answered that monitoring is sensitive, the Security Council lacks support for it, human rights paragraphs were added instead, and that the EU and Morocco's national human rights commission cover monitoring.
The Netherlands will continue to discuss the Western Sahara issue with various European partners.
Nederland blijft de kwestie Westelijke Sahara met verschillende Europese partners bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over in Brunei Darussalam ingevoerde wetgeving

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister for his judgement on Brunei's new Syariah Penal Code, which allows stoning, whipping and amputation, and whether he shares Amnesty's concerns. The minister shared concern, said the EU broadly shares Dutch concerns, and said the EU will await implementing provisions before deciding further.
There is agreement not to initial the agreement until the human rights situation, and in particular the implementation of the SPC provisions, has been reassessed by the EU.

Er bestaat overeenstemming niet tot parafering over te gaan alvorens de mensenrechtensituatie en in het bijzonder de uitwerking van de invoeringsbepalingen van de SPC door de EU opnieuw zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over door Israël vernielde gebouwen in Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel demolished three EU-co-funded buildings in Palestinian territory, whether fifteen more are threatened, and whether Israel should compensate the EU and the government should demand compensation. The government confirmed the facts, said the EU Commission is in talks with Israel and Israel refuses compensation as the demolitions are legal, and that the Netherlands will keep raising demolitions in area C with Israel.
The Netherlands also continues to hold the Israeli government to account for demolishing property in area C.
Ook Nederland blijft de Israëlische regering aanspreken op het slopen van onroerend goed in area C.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een nieuwe nederzetting in Hebron

SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about a new Israeli settlement in Hebron at the Al-Rajabi building, including whether settlers' occupation breaches Israeli law and what the Netherlands and the EU will do to prevent it. The minister confirmed that Israeli defence approval was given and that three Jewish families moved in, expressed serious concern, said the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and pushed for an EU statement, but did not commit to a specific new step beyond that.
Defence Minister Ya'alon gave permission on 13 April for settlers to occupy the building, after which three Jewish families moved in.
Minister Ya’alon van Defensie heeft op 13 april jl. toestemming gegeven voor het betrekken van het gebouw door kolonisten, waarna drie Joodse families zich er hebben gevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een conceptwet over kindhuwelijken in Irak

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a draft Iraqi law that would allow marriage of girls from age nine and permit marital rape, and whether the Netherlands would act. The minister confirmed the draft, said it is not expected before parliament for now, that it conflicts with Iraq's own treaty obligations, and that the Netherlands will raise its concerns with Iraqi authorities and within the EU.
The Netherlands will raise its concerns about this draft legislation with the Iraqi authorities.
Nederland zal zijn zorgen over deze conceptwetgeving aan de orde stellen bij de Iraakse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een schietincident in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked why witness statements from Iraqi ICDC soldiers in the 2004 Ar Rumaythah shooting case were not treated as relevant by the prosecutor and only sent to the European Court now, and whether the prosecution withheld them. The minister answers that the statements' brief content was in the KMAR file and seen by counsel in 2007, that the full statements were only sent to the court in 2012 at the state's initiative, and rejects claims of deliberate concealment and perjury.
The suggestion that these statements were deliberately withheld by the prosecution for years is firmly rejected.
Met kracht wordt de suggestie verworpen dat deze verklaringen jarenlang «opzettelijk door het OM zijn achtergehouden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in Egypte

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about human rights violations in Egypt after the 2013 coup, including Amnesty's call to suspend arms exports, and whether the Netherlands would press this at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister condemned violence, said the EU had adopted an export suspension for goods usable for internal repression, and that Dutch licensing of military exports to Egypt is on hold though assessment may resume depending on developments.
The Netherlands moreover holds all new applications for export of military goods to Egypt in abeyance.
Nederland houdt daarenboven alle nieuwe aanvragen voor export van militaire goederen naar Egypte aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verlenging van het mandaat van de Speciale Rapporteur van de VN voor Burma

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN Human Rights Council will renew the Special Rapporteur mandate on Burma and whether the government will push for renewal given ongoing rights violations. The minister confirmed the March 2014 renewal decision and said the Netherlands will work within the EU to extend the mandate, since no firm agreement on an OHCHR office has yet been reached.

Because firm agreements on opening an OHCHR office are still lacking, the Netherlands will work within the EU during the March Human Rights Council session to extend the mandate of the Special Rapporteur.
