Omdat harde afspraken over de opening van een OHCHR-kantoor vooralsnog uitblijven zal Nederland zich tijdens de Mensenrechtenraad van maart a.s. in EU-verband inzetten voor de verlenging van het mandaat van de Speciaal Rapporteur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een door de vredesmacht United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) gerapporteerd incident in 1980

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a 1980 UNIFIL incident in which Dutch peacekeepers reported Israeli forces blowing up bodies of Palestinian fighters, and whether this was a war crime. The government answered that it took the report seriously, that the UN inquiry found the Dutch acted in good faith but could not verify their observations, and that it sees no reason to revisit its position or to call it a war crime.
The cabinet is aware of the observations voiced in Andere Tijden, but sees no reason to reconsider the position stated above.
Het kabinet is bekend met de observaties, zoals geuit in Andere Tijden, maar ziet geen aanleiding het hiervoor genoemde standpunt te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een luchtaanval in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a December 2013 airstrike in Yemen that killed wedding guests, including whether the strike was a US drone attack, whether the victims were lawfully targeted, and whether the government would seek clarification and accountability. The minister answered that the government lacks specific factual information about the operation, supports transparency and a fact-finding inquiry, and that compensation is under negotiation between the Yemeni government and the families.
The cabinet does not have the requested specific factual information about this operation.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de gevraagde specifieke feitelijke informatie over deze operatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een Turkse wet over het verlenen van eerste hulp

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish law requiring state permission before doctors may give emergency first aid, and whether the government would raise its concerns. The minister confirmed the law was passed but not yet in force, said the government regrets it and will raise it bilaterally and within the EU with Turkey.
The government will therefore raise this bilaterally and within the EU with the Turkish government.
Het kabinet zal dit dan ook bilateraal en in EU-verband bij de Turkse regering aankaarten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over de smeergeldaffaire in verband met bouwprojecten van Ballast Nedam in Saudi-Arabië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the ministry interfered with the criminal investigation into the Ballast-Nedam bribery affair in Saudi Arabia and whether political interference is lawful, and asked about the UK precedent with BAE. The minister denies any involvement by the ministry, says the Public Prosecution Service's post-publication response was correct, and states that the only lawful ministerial intervention is a formal instruction under the Judiciary Organisation Act, subject to parliamentary control.
There has been no involvement, interest or obstruction from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Er is geen sprake geweest van bemoeienis, betrokkenheid of hindering van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the government about EU rules on labelling products from Western Sahara (such as tomatoes) as Moroccan, preferential tariffs, and whether a labelling advisory like the one for Israeli settlement products is needed. The government answered that EU labelling rules have no specific provision for Western Sahara, that an EU-wide approach is preferred, and that it has urged the Commission for more clarity without the Commission yet acting.
The Netherlands has therefore urged the European Commission for more clarity regarding the origin and provenance of products from Western Sahara.
Nederland heeft dan ook bij de Europese Commissie aangedrongen op meer duidelijkheid ten aanzien van de oorsprong en herkomst van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan bij internationale organisaties

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Taiwan's participation in bodies such as the UNFCCC, WHA and ICAO should be encouraged, given its CO2 emissions and growing invitations to meetings. The minister answered that Taiwan cannot become a party to treaties due to its status, that limited involvement such as observer or guest roles can serve international interests, but that the Netherlands will not support Taiwanese membership under its one-China policy.
Therefore the Netherlands will not support Taiwanese membership of international organisations.
Daarom zal Nederland Taiwanese lidmaatschap van internationale organisaties niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse targeted killings in Pakistan en Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch reports on US drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen show unlawful killings, whether the government shares those conclusions, and how the Netherlands prevents contributing to illegal targeted killings. The minister said the government shares the concerns but cannot pre-judge legality without specific facts, that authorities should investigate where there are indications of unlawful conduct, and that the Netherlands will refuse US requests for assistance where cooperation would breach international law.
The cabinet will not grant a possible US request for information or other contribution if there are indications that cooperation would lead to an act in violation of international law.

Het kabinet zal een eventueel verzoek van de VS om informatie of een bijdrage in andere zin niet inwilligen, als er aanwijzingen zijn dat medewerking zou leiden tot een handeling in strijd met het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de door het Openbaar Ministerie gepubliceerde dodenlijsten uit Afghanistan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why no further investigation was carried out into Afghan death lists published by the Public Prosecution Service, whether Afghanistan was consulted before publication, whether the lists are original and complete, and why a partial list was published. The minister answered that the criminal investigation ended in 2012 with the suspect's death, that the Afghan foreign ministry had no objection to publication, that the prosecution holds only copies it is confident are authentic, and that it tried but failed to locate fuller lists.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have the original lists but only copies obtained through a witness from Germany.
Het Openbaar Ministerie beschikt niet over de originele lijsten maar slechts over kopieën die via een getuige uit Duitsland zijn verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over mensenrechtenbeleid met betrekking tot Saudi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the government agrees with Amnesty's finding that Dutch and EU support for persecuted Saudi human rights defenders has been weak and whether quiet diplomacy should be replaced. The minister agrees the human rights situation is serious, defends quiet diplomacy with EU coordination, and says it will consult partners on Amnesty's recommendations, noting some are already practiced.
As promised during the Human Rights Policy consultation on 30 September, the cabinet will consult other member states on this and inform the House of the outcomes.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Notaoverleg Mensenrechtenbeleid op 30 september jl. zal het kabinet zich hierover verstaan met andere lidstaten en de Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over orgaanhandel in China

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Falun Gong practitioners in China were killed for organ trade and whether China's organ trade complies with international norms, and whether the issue would be raised at China's Universal Periodic Review. The minister said independent verification is not possible, that China's 2007 law exists but implementation and organ statistics remain concerning, and that the issue was not raised in the UPR intervention but will be pursued bilaterally.
Falun Gong and organ trafficking were not raised in the Netherlands' intervention during China's second Universal Periodic Review (22/10).
Nederlandse interventie tijdens China's tweede Universal Periodic Review (22/10) zijn Falun Gong en orgaanhandel niet aan de orde gekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether senior Dutch political and civil figures, including Prime Minister Beel, knew of summary executions in the Indonesian war while they were ongoing, and why no co-financing was given for research into the period. The minister confirmed that political and military leaders were informed from late 1946 and by February 1947, acknowledged excesses, but refused to co-finance independent research.
In February 1947 Prime Minister Beel was also informed of this.
In februari 1947 was ook minister-president Beel hiervan op de hoogte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Open Ended Working Group

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Open Ended Working Group on nuclear disarmament and whether the government would vote for renewing its mandate. The minister confirmed Dutch participation as 'friend of the chair' and said it is not yet clear whether a renewal resolution will be tabled, so the voting position depends on the text.
At this moment it is not yet clear whether a new resolution will be submitted to the UN General Assembly to extend the OEWG mandate.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of er bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties een nieuwe resolutie zal worden ingediend om het mandaat van de OEWG te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Bommel over wanbetalende diplomaten

MPs Kooiman and Van Bommel asked whether diplomats unpaid traffic fines can be compelled to pay, given Article 41 of the Vienna Convention, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replies that quarterly reminders and talks with embassies have largely worked, some embassies have agreed to pay, and other coercive measures like withholding plates or parking permits are ruled out by the Vienna Convention.
The Netherlands is bound by the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations and must therefore act within the limits of that convention.
Nederland is gehouden aan het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer en heeft daardoor te handelen binnen de grenzen van dit verdrag
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Camp Ashraf in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the 1 September 2013 attack on Camp Ashraf in Iraq, which reportedly killed 47 or more Iranian exiles, and about investigations into it and earlier attacks. The minister answered that UNAMI counted 52 deaths, that Iraqi authorities announced investigations whose outcomes are unknown, and that the government has urged Iraq to produce results and supports UN efforts to improve safety.
Both the Netherlands and the European Union have stressed the importance of this to the Iraqi authorities.
Zowel Nederland als de Europese Unie hebben het belang hiervan bij de Iraakse autoriteiten onderstreept.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het Poolse onderzoek naar betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Poland's investigation into alleged CIA detention and interrogation sites, including the Council of Europe commissioner's concern about political interference with prosecutors. The minister said the Polish prosecution is conducting an independent investigation, that the Dutch government cannot assess the alleged interference, that he will raise the case with his Polish counterpart, and that the Dutch government has no role in US-Polish cooperation.
As promised during the consultation on Dutch human rights policy (30 September), I will ask my Polish counterpart about the state of affairs when the opportunity arises.
Zoals toegezegd bij het notaoverleg over het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid (30 september jl.) zal ik mijn Poolse collega bij gelegenheid vragen naar de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over geweld in de provincie Xinjiang

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about reported deadly violence between police and Uighurs in Xinjiang, China, including whether the dead were terrorists, whether counter-terrorism is overstated, and whether the Netherlands would press China on restraint and fair trials. The minister said the death toll is disputed and unverifiable, that the cabinet cannot judge the terrorist claim, and that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly raised concerns with China.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make a statement on this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om hierover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over NGO-wetgeving in Indonesië

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about Indonesia's new law on mass organisations, including whether NGOs can be warned, suspended or banned without court involvement, whether anti-corruption and Papua/Maluku activism is restricted, and whether Dutch unions and NGOs face problems. The minister replies that warnings and up to six-month suspensions are possible without a court, dissolution requires a judge, the law is open to interpretation, no problems have been reported, and the Netherlands raises civil society space in bilateral talks.
The authorities can warn an NGO in writing if they consider that the NGO violates the law.
De autoriteiten kunnen een ngo schriftelijk waarschuwen indien zij menen dat de ngo de wet overtreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over handel in zand uit West-Sahara

MP Van Bommel asked whether a Groningen-linked shipping company's transport of sand from Western Sahara breached international law, whether proceeds benefit the local population, and whether the government would act against Dutch firms. The minister confirmed the shipment, said economic activity there is not per se unlawful if proceeds benefit the inhabitants, noted no embargo applies, and declined to take action against the shipping company.
Economic activities in Western Sahara are not per se in violation of international law.
Economische activiteiten in de Westelijke Sahara zijn niet per definitie in strijd met het internationaal recht.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over een nieuw protocol voor de Partnerschapsovereenkomst inzake visserij tussen de EU en Marokko (ingezonden 7 augustus

An SP MP asks the ministers whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers waters off Western Sahara, whether it complies with international law, and whether the Sahrawi population benefits and controls the funds. The government confirms the protocol covers those waters without implying recognition of Moroccan sovereignty, says funds are conditional on agreement in the Joint Committee, and says it will seek further clarification before forming a final view.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to respond to all parts of publications.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op alle onderdelen van publicaties te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de gevolgen van het faillissement en de herstart van Better Place inzake accu-oplaadstations

An SP MP asked the Economics and Foreign Affairs ministers about the consequences of Better Place's bankruptcy and relaunch for EU and Dutch support, possible claw-back of subsidies, and whether Dutch and EU engagement with the company was consistent with due diligence regarding Israeli settlements. The minister answered that the cabinet had no prior notice of the relaunch, that the Dutch state had no financial obligations or direct involvement, that the EU subsidy fell under EU guidelines, and that Dutch settlement policy is unchanged.
The cabinet was not informed in advance of the relaunch.
Het kabinet is niet vooraf op de hoogte gesteld van de doorstart.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering bezwaar heeft aangetekend tegen de herintreding van Bolivia in het Enkelvoudig Verdrag inzake verdovende middelen uit 196

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands objected to Bolivia's re-accession to the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs with a reservation on traditional coca leaf chewing, and why it did not object to Bolivia's earlier amendment proposal. The minister confirmed the objection, said it concerns the procedure of withdrawal and re-accession with a reservation rather than coca use itself, and refused to withdraw it.
The objection lodged by the Dutch government was prompted by concerns about the integrity of the treaty and the proper application of treaty law in general.
Het door de Nederlandse regering aangetekende bezwaar is ingegeven door zorgen omtrent de integriteit van het verdrag en de juiste toepassing van het verdragenrecht in het algemeen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether FRAGO 242, a British order under MND-SE, was known to Dutch contingent command beyond the detachment commanders. The minister answered that archives and personnel were searched and no reference to FRAGO 242 was found.
FRAGO 242 or references to it were not found in this regard.
FRAGO 242 of verwijzingen hiernaar zijn hierbij niet aangetroffen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government would act after the Supreme Court rejected the review request of two conscientious objectors convicted in the 1950s for refusing service in the Dutch East Indies, including whether it would legislate rehabilitation. The Defence minister answered no: judges applied the norms of the time, reassessing conduct by today's standards would not be careful, and no rehabilitation law is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (I

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel ask about two Chinese interpreters removed from the IND interpreter file, their training requirements, integrity checks, use in Uyghur asylum cases and risks to family members in China. The state secretary answers that the IND sets no general training requirements for its interpreters, that the two interpreters were removed, and that Uyghurs' cases and family risks are weighed case by case without informing Chinese authorities.
The IND does not set general further-training requirements for interpreters, partly because training courses for the foreign languages these interpreters speak often do not exist.
De IND stelt geen algemene bijscholingseisen aan tolken, mede daar er op het gebied van de door die tolken gesproken vreemde talen vaak geen tolkenopleidingen bestaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Europese subsidies voor Israëlische bedrijven in de militaire industrie en Israëlische bedrijven die in illegale nederzettingen actief zijn

An MP asked the foreign minister whether EU research subsidies under FP7 went to Israeli defence firms and firms active in illegal settlements, and whether such funding should be excluded under Horizon 2020. The minister confirmed some grants, said the Commission has no overview of settlement-linked grants, and said the Commission is exploring criteria changes, with the Netherlands favouring alignment with EU arms-export criteria.
Once these have led to more clarity on the technical and legal (im)possibilities of adjusting the criteria, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra deze hebben geleid tot meer duidelijkheid over de technische en juridische (on)mogelijkheden van aanpassing van de criteria, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de besteding van hulpgelden voor Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about refugees still waiting in Tuzla for housing in Srebrenica, reconstruction output, the use of about 120 million euros in aid, corruption signals and the effectiveness of spending. The minister answered at length, reporting that funds were spent on the stated goals, that the embassy monitors projects and has received no specific fraud reports, and that aid was overall effective though not for all assistance.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the Koning Willem-Alexander water project in Israel, focusing on the Joods Nationaal Fonds' links to KKL-JNF, its statutes, control over its board, and whether projects are open to all groups. The minister answered that the foundation is statutorily tied to KKL-JNF but says it operates autonomously, the project is run by KKL-JNF and projects are within internationally recognised borders and accessible to all population groups.
The board of the foundation operates autonomously and makes its own considerations.
Het bestuur van de stichting opereert autonoom en maakt zijn eigen afwegingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Iraanse ballingen in Irak

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether a rocket attack killing two Iranian exiles at Camp Hurriya in Iraq warrants an independent investigation and prosecution, and whether the Netherlands will press for resettlement of camp residents. The minister confirmed the attack, said the Netherlands supports independent investigation, noted Iraqi authorities have opened an inquiry without a known outcome, and stated the Netherlands only admits residents who hold Dutch nationality while the EU has no common resettlement policy.
Following the attack on Camp Hurriya in February, the Iraqi authorities launched an investigation whose outcome is not yet known.
Naar aanleiding van de aanval in Kamp Hurriya in februari jl. hebben de Iraakse autoriteiten een onderzoek ingesteld waarvan de uitkomst op dit moment nog niet bekend is.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de administratieve detentie van Ahmad Qatamesh door Israël

An MP asks the foreign minister about the administrative detention of Palestinian writer Ahmad Qatamesh by Israel, including his extended detention without charge, his health, his transfer to an Israeli prison, and whether the Netherlands will press Israel for release. The minister confirms the key facts, says the transfer appears to breach humanitarian law, and states the government follows the matter closely with Israel and in EU contacts without committing to a specific demand for release.
The cabinet is of the view that the situation of Palestinian prisoners in Israeli detention deserves prominent attention.
Het kabinet is van mening dat de situatie van de Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie prominente aandacht verdient.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en De Wit over de vervolging van een van het (mede)plegen genocide verdachte Nederlander van Irakese afkomst

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a Dutch national of Iraqi origin, listed by the Iraqi High Tribunal for alleged genocide-related crimes, has been under Dutch prosecution review since 2007, and whether extradition from Iraq would be sought. The state secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on possible involvement in criminal offences because of investigative and privacy interests.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, because of investigative and privacy interests, no statements can be made about possible involvement in criminal offences by the person named in the article.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat vanwege opsporings- en privacybelangen geen uitspraken kunnen worden gedaan over mogelijke betrokkenheid bij strafbare feiten van de in het artikel genoemde persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking Uyghur interpreters suspected of leaking confidential information to Chinese authorities, whether they face prosecution, how they passed vetting, and what is being done for affected asylum seekers. The state secretary answered that a criminal complaint was filed, the interpreters were excluded from further use, all asylum cases were re-assessed with almost all granted asylum, and no Uyghurs were returned to China.
The IND has filed a criminal complaint against the interpreters concerned.
Er is door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) aangifte gedaan tegen de betreffende tolken.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Indonesië

Two SP MPs asked whether Vulcano 76mm naval gun ammunition, possibly used on frigates being supplied to Indonesia, is designed for ground targets and whether the Netherlands co-funds it, and whether this conflicts with the government's view on internal tensions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is not involved in developing that ammunition, that it contributed about EUR 6.2 million to a different Vulcano 127mm program, that the frigate supply was assessed against the eight export criteria, and that no known involvement of Indonesian navy equipment in repression has occurred since 1998.
These questions will be answered as soon as possible.
Deze vragen worden op de kortst mogelijke termijn beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over recent geweld in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about deadly clashes and protests in Iraq, including reports of dozens killed and detained demonstrators, and whether the government would press Iraqi counterparts for restraint and humane treatment. The minister confirmed the casualty figures, described the Sunni marginalisation and the need for dialogue, and said the Netherlands supports EU efforts for dialogue and prison and justice reform.
Inquiries show that it is not possible to say exactly how many demonstrators are being held.
Navraag leert dat niet precies valt aan te geven hoeveel demonstranten worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse drone aanvallen in Pakistan

An MP asked the foreign minister whether US drone strikes in Pakistan are lawful, given repeated Pakistani objections, a parliamentary resolution and a UN rapporteur's statement that they violate sovereignty, and whether the minister would press the US to stop them. The minister confirmed the cited statements but declined to conclude the strikes are unlawful, calling consent a bilateral matter, and saw no reason to press the US, while noting general engagement on transparency.
Whether consent is given is ultimately a bilateral matter between the US and Pakistan, in which the cabinet does not have full insight.
Het al dan niet geven van toestemming is uiteindelijk een bilaterale aangelegenheid tussen de VS en Pakistan, waarin het kabinet geen volledig inzicht heeft.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het rapport 'Failing to make the grade' over de situatie van de Palestijnse bevolking in area C gebied van de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Oxfam-linked report finding little progress since EU Council conclusions of May 2012 on Palestinian living conditions in Area C of the West Bank, including demolitions, master plan approvals, PA control and donor project permits. The minister acknowledged the lack of progress as regrettable, described Dutch coordination and funding efforts, said no master plans had been approved, and withheld permit data as unavailable.
Information on permits rejected or granted by Israel in Area C is not available.
Informatie over vergunningen die door Israël zijn afgewezen of afgegeven in area C is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Poolse betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Polish involvement in the CIA rendition programme, the Amnesty International report, the long-running Polish criminal investigation and whether Poland meets its international obligations. The minister answered that the investigation is an independent Polish judicial matter, that the government will not speculate on its findings or delays, and that it has no reason to think Poland disregards its international obligations.

Pending the outcome of this independent judicial investigation, the cabinet sees no reason to speculate about its possible findings, or about possible reasons why the investigation has not yet been concluded.

Hangende de uitkomsten van dit onafhankelijke, justitiële onderzoek ziet het kabinet geen reden te speculeren over mogelijke bevindingen daarvan, noch over mogelijke redenen waarom het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister whether the Guardian's claim that directive FRAGO 242 was circulated among coalition troops in Iraq is true, and about Dutch reporting rules, SFIR reports on violations of the laws of war, and US/UK command orders. The minister answered that Dutch detachment commanders were unaware of FRAGO 242, that Dutch rules on reporting suspected offences existed in internal regulations, and that the matter was otherwise handled through national procedures and earlier parliamentary reports.
The successive Dutch detachment commanders operating under the command of the British headquarters MND-SE were not aware of FRAGO 242.
De achtereenvolgende Nederlandse detachementscommandanten die opereerden onder het commando van het Britse hoofdkwartier MND-SE waren niet bekend met FRAGO 242.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en en Van Raak over Nederlandse jihadisten

MPs Van Bommel and Van Raak asked whether the AIVD contacted a Dutch jihadist returnee codenamed 'Salem', whether he was turned away by the Tripoli embassy, and what the government does to gather information from returning jihadists. The minister declined to give concrete public information on AIVD contacts, said the embassy inquiry could not be resolved given the anonymous source, and stated the AIVD prioritises research into jihadist travel and return.
I cannot make any concrete public statements about AIVD contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over contacten van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over het gezag van het Internationaal Strafhof in Afrika

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the government how it responds to African Union accusations that the ICC targets Africans, to the AU call to refer the Kenyatta and Ruto cases to Kenyan courts, and to the effects on the ICC's standing, and what the Netherlands did at the AU summit. The minister rejects the AU claims, notes the ICC acts independently and that half of African situations were referred by states or the UN Security Council, says the Kenyan admissibility challenge was rejected, and describes bilateral and EU efforts to support the ICC in Africa without committing to a new report on the summit.
The cabinet disagrees with the statements of the African Union chairperson, Hailemariam Desalegn, which imply that the ICC is biased.
Het kabinet is het oneens met de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Afrikaanse Unie, Hailemariam Desalegn, waarin wordt geïmpliceerd dat het ICC vooringenomen zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over een werkbezoek aan het Internationaal Strafhof

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the ICC's staffing shortage, the consequences of closing the Scheveningen prison for detainees, and whether witnesses are admitted to the Netherlands long enough. The minister said the Netherlands is in dialogue with the ICC and supports strengthening its investigative capacity, referred the prison question to the Justice State Secretary's earlier answer stating detention for international tribunals continues in Scheveningen, and said he was unaware of witness admission problems, pointing to the host-state agreement.
The Netherlands is aware of the ICC's concerns about limited staffing capacity and is in dialogue with the ICC about it.
Nederland is bekend met de zorgen van het ICC over de beperkte personele capaciteit en is hierover met het ICC in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over betalingen aan krijgsheren, drugsbaronnen en de Taliban in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether CIA cash payments in Afghanistan reached warlords and the Taliban and whether Dutch funds did too. The government said it had no information on the CIA payments, that Dutch aid might not be fully protected from reaching informal power holders, and described its risk analysis and controls.
The government has no information that such payments were made and therefore cannot confirm that there was no critical oversight of the use of such payments.

De regering heeft geen informatie dat dergelijke betalingen zijn gedaan en kan daarom evenmin bevestigen dat er geen kritisch toezicht op de besteding van dergelijke betalingen zou hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about a water project in Mitspe Ramon, Israel, linked to Prince Willem-Alexander and the Jewish National Fund, including alleged land appropriation, activity in settlements and water rights under international law. The minister confirmed the project lies within Israel's internationally recognised borders, uses household wastewater, and that the government is satisfied it has no link to occupied territory or settlements.

The government has satisfied itself that the projects of the Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds in Amsterdam are located exclusively within the so-called Green Line in Israel, and thus not in occupied territory.

De regering heeft zich ervan vergewist dat de projecten van de Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds te Amsterdam zich uitsluitend binnen de zogenaamde «groene lijn» in Israël bevinden, dus niet in bezet gebied.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether a Jewish National Fund water project in Israel harms Bedouin, whether JNF afforestation caused the loss of Palestinian villages and farmland, and whether JNF is an unacceptable partner for the Dutch prince. The minister answered that the project area is undisputed and has no Bedouin residents, that the related Israeli bill is still pending in the Knesset, that the Absentee Lands afforestation was authorised by the Israeli state, and that there is no project partnership.
The Netherlands follows such developments closely.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de betrokkenheid van hoge Amerikaanse militairen bij martelingen in Irak

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about a Guardian report linking senior US military figures to detainee torture in Iraq and about FRAGO 242, which allegedly limited coalition investigation of abuse. The minister answered that after June 2004 Iraqi authorities were responsible for investigating non-coalition conduct, that Dutch commanders did not know of the order, and that incidents had to be reported under Dutch rules.
The obligation to investigate crimes, including war crimes and human rights violations, lies with the authorities that exercise authority or jurisdiction in the area or over the suspects.

De verplichting tot het doen van onderzoek naar misdrijven, waaronder oorlogsmisdrijven en schendingen van de mensenrechten, ligt bij de autoriteiten die het gezag of jurisdictie uitoefenen in het gebied of over de verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de impasse in de zaak tegen Wikileaks oprichter Julian Assange

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about the impasse in the Assange case, including whether Sweden could guarantee against extradition to the United States and whether the Netherlands should mediate. The minister answered that there is no extradition request from the US, that the Swedish legal process is trusted, and that the matter is between the UK and Sweden, so no Dutch role is warranted.
No, this concerns a matter between the United Kingdom and Sweden.
Nee, dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Zweden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Bonis over de arrestatie en vervolgens vrijlating van de Nederlandse journaliste Rena Netjes in Cairo

MPs from VVD, D66, SP and PvdA asked the foreign minister about the arrest and release of Dutch journalist Rena Netjes in Cairo, including whether a citizen's arrest could fuel a witch-hunt against Western journalists. The minister confirmed no formal charge was filed, described ambassador contact with the Egyptian prosecutor leading to her release, and said the Egyptian authorities found the citizen's arrest unlawful.
As far as the embassy in Cairo could verify, there was no official charge against Ms Netjes.
Er is voor zover door de ambassade in Cairo kon worden nagegaan geen officiële aanklacht tegen mevrouw Netjes geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over sponsoring van de viering van de troonsbestijging door de Permanente vertegenwoordigingen bij de Europese Unie en de NAVO

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about corporate sponsorship (Unilever, Shell, ING, Tata Steel) of the king's accession celebration organised by the Dutch Permanent Representations to the EU and NATO, including lobbying risks, openness and whether rules exist. The minister replied that about 53,000 euro in costs is two-thirds covered by sponsorship and entry fees, that sponsorship is common practice, and that general integrity principles apply, referring to the BZ integrity code.
Diplomatic missions must, regarding sponsorship of activities, observe the broader principles of impartiality, transparency and avoidance of conflicts of interest and interference in decision-making.

Diplomatieke vertegenwoordigingen dienen zich m.b.t. het laten sponsoren van activiteiten te houden aan de breder geldende principes van onpartijdigheid, transparantie en vermijding van belangenverstrengeling en inmenging in besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de in India ter dood veroordeelde professor Singh Bhullar

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the death sentence imposed in India on Devender Pal Singh Bhullar, including concerns about TADA detention, lack of counsel, a retracted confession, and India's resumption of executions. The minister confirmed awareness of the Amnesty campaign, said the Netherlands does not interfere in Indian court proceedings, opposes the death penalty in principle, and will keep pressing India on abolition and reinstating the moratorium.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU, for abolition of the death penalty.
Nederland zal zowel in bilateraal als in EU verband bij de Indiase autoriteiten blijven aandringen op afschaffing van de doodstraf
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schending van bestandsafspraken tussen Israël en Palestijnse groepen in Gaza

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about alleged Israeli and Palestinian violations of the November 2012 Gaza ceasefire, citing OCHA and OHCHR casualty data, fishing-boat shootings and land-levelling incursions, and asked whether the international community should verify compliance and obtain legal advice. The minister answered that the government lacks sufficient information for a full overview, says the parties determine violations first with Egypt as mediator, rejects a Dutch legal review, and promises no new reporting beyond urging restraint.
The government has insufficient factual information.
De regering beschikt over onvoldoende feitelijke informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked the foreign minister about Palestinian detainees Samer Issawi and Ayman Sharawneh in Israeli custody, including administrative detention, alleged mistreatment and the death of Arafat Jaradat. The minister replied that there is no administrative detention in these cases, that the Netherlands and the EU monitor the situation and raised it with Israel, and that an independent inquiry into Jaradat's death should follow with findings made public.
There is no question of administrative detention.
Er is geen sprake van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over in Turkije opgepakte vakbondsleden

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked about the arrest of trade union members in Turkey after the February 2013 embassy bombing, including KESK members, and about Turkish union and anti-terrorism law. The minister replied that 68 KESK members remain detained on terrorism membership suspicion without a known charge, that Turkey is reforming its laws, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue in dialogue but not interfere in Turkish legal proceedings.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the Turkish judicial process, but will follow the proceedings with interest.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de Turkse rechtsgang, wel zal Nederland de processen met belangstelling volgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executies in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asks the foreign minister about the recent execution of seven men in Saudi Arabia, alleged unfair trials and torture, possible minors among those executed, and the number of 2012 executions. The minister shares serious concerns, cannot confirm the minority claims, reports no known minors executed in 2012, and says the Netherlands will continue dialogue on the death penalty with Saudi authorities, mainly together with EU partners.
The Netherlands will continue the ongoing dialogue on death penalty policy with the Saudi authorities.
Nederland zet de continue dialoog over het doodstrafbeleid met de Saoedische autoriteiten voort.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht ‘FBI-agenten hacken mee met de Nederlandse politie’ en de detentieomstandigheden van de Nederlander in de Verenigde Staten

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked the Justice Minister about reports that FBI agents work embedded in Dutch police cybercrime units and about the detention of Dutch national David S. in the US, including whether Dutch authorities were informed of his arrest in Romania and whether his transfer back to the Netherlands can be expedited. The minister answered that the Netherlands had no role in the arrest, that no investigative acts took place on Dutch soil without consent, that a liaison officer's role is governed by Dutch law, and that he is willing to contact US authorities to speed up a transfer request once the sentence is final.
I am willing to contact the American authorities in this case to expedite the procedure where possible.
Ik ben bereid in deze zaak met de Amerikaanse autoriteiten contact op te nemen om zo mogelijk de procedure te bespoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two SP MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking interpreters suspected of leaking information to Chinese authorities about Uyghurs in the Netherlands, how interpreters are screened, and what the consequences are. The government answered that an AIVD warning concerned these individuals only, that screening rules apply, that about 1,000 case files used these interpreters with 75 percent granted asylum, and that the Minister of Foreign Affairs asked China for clarification.
In about 75 percent of these files asylum protection was granted.
In ongeveer 75 procent van deze dossiers is asielbescherming toegekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel over vijf vrouwen uit Gaza die niet mogen studeren op de Westoever

An MP asked the foreign minister about five women from Gaza barred from studying at West Bank universities, whether Israel must allow it, whether the travel ban has in effect blocked Gaza students since 2000, whether a separation policy exists, and whether the Netherlands will press Israel. The minister answered that Israel may take security measures but these should not de facto exclude all Gaza students, that only three Gaza students received permits since 2000 (all with foreign scholarships), that the High Court confirmed a humanitarian-only exception policy, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue with Israel within the EU and bilaterally.
The Netherlands continues to press, both within the EU and bilaterally, for an end to the blockade of Gaza and normalisation of the movement of goods and persons.
Nederland zet, zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal, onverminderd in op een einde aan de blokkade van Gaza en normalisering van verkeer van goederen en personen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Eijsink over het bericht “van de heer I.A. betreffende activiteiten die hij in Afghanistan voor Defensie zou hebben verricht”

MPs Van Bommel and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister whether a civilian, I.A., was involved in supplying weapons to Dutch soldiers in Afghanistan, and whether he was offered a 500,000 euro settlement with a limited validity period. The minister confirmed awareness of the claims but declined to discuss operational MIVD matters or individual cases in public, referring to an earlier letter.
I cannot make any public statements about operational matters concerning the MIVD.
Over operationele zaken betreffende de MIVD kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the imprisonment of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, the outcome of an Iranian parliamentary inquiry, the conviction of lawyer Mohammad Ali Dadkhah, and EU action. The minister described her sentence, said the Iranian delegation's findings may not be published, confirmed Dadkhah's sentence and Dutch concern, and reported new EU sanctions and repeated EU calls for release.
If the results of their inquiry are made public, which is not certain, I will share them with your House.
Als de resultaten van hun onderzoek publiek worden gemaakt, wat niet zeker is, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer mededelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van Sahrawi’s in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the military-court convictions of 25 Sahrawis in Morocco, including unexamined torture allegations, lack of independent investigation into the 2010 violence, and whether Netherlands would press Morocco for civilian retrials. The minister answered that military courts for civilians are problematic, that torture allegations should be investigated, and that the Netherlands would discuss possible action at EU level after the Supreme Court appeal outcome.
Depending on the outcome, it will be discussed at EU level whether there is reason to raise this with the Moroccan authorities.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst hiervan zal in EU-verband besproken worden of er aanleiding is om de Marokkaanse autoriteiten hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in de provincie Beloetsjistan in Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged enforced disappearances, killings and torture of Baloch activists, teachers, journalists and lawyers in Pakistan's Balochistan, and about impunity and a humanitarian crisis there. The minister acknowledged the reports and concern, said confirmed data is lacking, noted very low prosecution rates, and stated that the Netherlands and the EU raised the issue bilaterally and in EU conclusions, including through the human rights ambassador's visit.
Confirmed information needed to verify these reports and figures at this level of detail is not available.
Geconfirmeerde informatie die nodig is om deze berichten en cijfers op dit detailniveau te kunnen bevestigen, is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het delen van inlichtingen ten behoeve van drone aanvallen

SP MPs asked whether Dutch intelligence gathered in the region is shared with the United States and could be used for targeted drone killings, and whether Dutch officials risk prosecution. The minister confirmed awareness of a UK lawsuit, declined to say anything publicly about cooperation with foreign intelligence services, and stated that the UK case is not criminal prosecution.
No public statements can be made about cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
Over de samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Iraanse ballingen in Irak

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about a deadly attack on Iranian exiles at Camp Liberty in Iraq, including who was responsible, whether an independent investigation and prosecutions should be pursued, and whether refugee status determination should be accelerated. The minister confirmed seven deaths and about forty injuries, said the perpetrators are uncertain, backed an independent investigation raised by the UN and the EU, and noted that UNHCR is already working as quickly as possible on refugee registration.

During the recent visit of the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to Iraq, she, in line with my commitment to the House of 14 February, urged an independent investigation on behalf of the Netherlands.

Tijdens het recente bezoek van de Secretaris-Generaal van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan Irak heeft zij conform mijn toezegging aan de Tweede Kamer d.d. 14 februari j.l. namens Nederland aangedrongen op een onafhankelijk onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de gevolgen van de sancties tegen Iran

MP Van Bommel asked whether the minister knows of a report finding that Iran sanctions contributed to shortages of medicines, and whether the government will reconsider its position and press for EU measures. The minister acknowledged the report but disagreed with its conclusions, said exemptions for humanitarian trade exist, and saw no need for an oil-for-medicines programme.
I note that the authors of the report reach a different conclusion about the relationship between sanctions and the medicine shortage in Iran than I did in my earlier answers.
Ik constateer dat de auteurs van het rapport tot een andere conclusie komen over de relatie tussen sancties en het medicijngebrek in Iran dan ik in mijn bovengenoemde antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het boek ‘Bikkel’

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether investigation and prosecution of the 1980 mistreatment and death of Fred Ormskerk in Suriname was ever pursued, whether the government pressed for it, and how a suspect living in the Netherlands squares with the policy of denying Surinamese suspects entry. The minister replied that the Netherlands lacks jurisdiction over the Surinamese case, that protest was lodged in 1980, that the suspect does live in the Netherlands, and that the policy did not apply to his situation.
The case concerns Surinamese territory. The Netherlands has no jurisdiction in this matter and therefore cannot start its own criminal investigation into the events.
Het betreft een zaak op Surinaams grondgebied. Nederland heeft terzake geen rechtsmacht en kan dan ook geen eigen strafrechtelijk onderzoek starten naar de gebeurtenissen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over investeringen in bedrijven die communicatieapparatuur aan Syrië leverden

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch banks and pension funds investing in firms that supplied communications equipment to Syria could pressure those firms to stop such exports, and about EU-level export controls on repressive technology. The minister answered that corporate responsibility rests with the financial sector under OECD guidelines, outlined Dutch proposals for an EU human-rights export clause and existing sanctions on monitoring equipment for Syria, and said Nederland supports the European Parliament's Digital Freedom resolution.

The Netherlands has proposed at EU level adding a provision to the dual-use regulation that would allow banning the export of goods and technology where there is suspicion they will be used for human rights violations.

Nederland heeft in Europees verband voorgesteld om een bepaling toe te voegen aan de dual-useverordening die het mogelijk maakt om de export van goederen en technologie te verbieden indien het vermoeden bestaat dat deze zullen worden ingezet voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schendingen van de bestandsafspraken tussen Israël en de Palestijnse groepen in Gaza

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Israel violated the November 2012 Gaza ceasefire terms by restricting Palestinian fishing zones and imposing buffer zones, and requested an overview of violations by both sides. The minister said the incidents are for the parties to judge, Netherlands supports a wider fishing zone to at least 12 nautical miles, and will press Israel on international law.
There is insufficient information available to provide such an overview.
Er is onvoldoende informatie beschikbaar om een dergelijk overzicht te kunnen geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Visserij voor de kust van West Sahara

An SP MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about a Curaçao-flagged refrigerated ship (Nova Florida, Seatrade) reportedly active off Western Sahara, the state of the EU-Morocco fisheries deal, and whether Western Sahara waters should be excluded. The ministers replied that the ship is outside Dutch jurisdiction, that renegotiation of the protocol is ongoing with Dutch conditions, and that a deal covering those waters need not violate international law if conditions are met.
If there is a violation of Dutch or European regulations, the government will hold Dutch companies to account for it.
Indien er sprake is van overtreding van Nederlandse of Europese regelgeving, zal de overheid Nederlandse bedrijven daarop aanspreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de gevolgen van de sancties tegen Iran

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether Western sanctions on Iran are causing shortages of life-saving medicines, deaths, and whether the EU should refrain from new sanctions. The minister answered that the sanctions contain humanitarian exemptions for medicines, blamed Iranian authorities' allocation of foreign currency for the shortages, said he knows of no confirmed deaths but does not exclude them, and committed to the EU discussing how exporters can be made aware of the exemptions.
The EU sanctions regime against Iran contains exceptions for, among other things, medicines.
Het EU-sanctieregime tegen Iran kent uitzonderingen voor o.a. medicijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over EU-subsidie voor multinationals

Mr Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether EU social fund money meant for Polish SMEs went to multinationals such as Unilever, Pepsi, Mercedes Benz and Deutsche Bank, and whether such grants are lawful and should be recovered. The minister replied that the Commission is investigating with the Polish managing authority, that the error rates in the EU budget are unacceptably high, and that the Netherlands will push for clearer rules and more transparency, while rejecting the view that training grants for workers of multinationals defeat the purpose of cohesion funds.
The results of the European Commission's investigation must be awaited before the cabinet can make detailed statements about this situation.
De resultaten van het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie moeten worden afgewacht alvorens het kabinet gedetailleerde uitspraken kan doen over deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de verplaatsing van de inwoners van Kamp New Iraq (voormalig Kamp Ashraf) naar Kamp Hurriya

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that conditions in Kamp Hurriya are very poor, UNHCR's position, the progress of the transfer from Kamp New Iraq and the asylum status of residents. The minister answered that conditions meet UN standards, denied the UNHCR claim, and gave figures on interviews and resettlement options while stating Dutch concern is channelled through the Iraqi government.
Living conditions in Camp Hurriya regarding water, food and electricity meet the conditions of the United Nations (UN).
De leefomstandigheden in Kamp Hurriya op het gebied van water, voedsel en elektriciteit voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de Verenigde Naties (VN).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Europese betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether he knows of the ECtHR ruling against Macedonia for handing a suspect to the CIA, whether this should be welcomed as ending impunity, and whether the Netherlands will prioritise implementation of the European Parliament resolution on CIA secret detention in Europe. The minister confirms the ruling, calls it important and says he will monitor Macedonia's implementation in the Committee of Ministers, and states the Netherlands opposes CIA renditions and supports the resolution's message without committing to specific new steps.
In the Committee of Ministers I will closely monitor how Macedonia will implement the Court's ruling.
In het Comité van Ministers zal ik nauwkeurig toezien op de wijze waarop Macedonië uitvoering zal geven aan de uitspraak van het Hof.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli settlement construction, including whether the Netherlands would recall its ambassador, suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement, and refrain from forming a Netherlands-Israel cooperation council. The minister answered that the government opposes the settlements and has raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador, but rejects recalling the ambassador, isolating Israel, or suspending the Association Agreement, while offering bilateral fora and continued mensenrechtendialoog.
The cabinet considers the Israeli settlements illegal and an obstacle to peace. However, isolating Israel is not an effective way to counter settlement policy.
Het kabinet acht de Israëlische nederzettingen illegaal en een obstakel voor vrede. Het isoleren van Israël is echter geen effectieve manier om het nederzettingenbeleid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Bedreiging van demonstranten door medewerkers van de Iraanse Ambassade

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Iranian embassy staff threatening demonstrators with scissors, whether the incident was reported as required, whether diplomatic immunity blocks prosecution, what diplomatic measures are available, whether the Vienna Convention should change, and whether the ambassador would be summoned. The minister replied that a complaint was filed and police contacted the ministry the same day, that immunity under the Vienna Convention prevents prosecution, that diplomatic steps such as a note or waiver request are possible but weighed against risks to Dutch diplomats, and that the ambassador was summoned pending the police investigation.
Under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, embassy staff with diplomatic status have immunity.
Op grond van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer hebben ambassademedewerkers met een diplomatieke status immuniteit.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de weigering dr. Zegveld toe te laten als lid van de CAVV

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Liesbeth Zegveld was refused membership of the CAVV advisory commission on international law because of her involvement in litigation against the state (Srebrenica, Zorreguieta). The minister answers that she withdrew her 2003 application after being pointed to her Srebrenica involvement, that no link to the Zorreguieta case was found, and that any future application would be assessed on expertise.
No link with the Zorreguieta case has been found.
Er is niet gebleken van een verband met de zaak Zorreguieta.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van Amerikaanse drone aanvallen voor de burgerbevolking van Pakistan

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths and harms from US drone strikes in Pakistan, citing a Stanford/NYU report, and whether the US should compensate, be more transparent, or halt strikes. The minister answered that the US acknowledges some civilian deaths but gives no figures, that Dutch data on civilian deaths cannot be verified, that compensation and proportionality are matters for the US, and that no moratorium will be pursued, though more US transparency is welcomed.
I am in favour of greater openness about such strikes.
Ik ben voorstander van meer openheid over dergelijke aanvallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de rechtmatigheid van en verantwoording over targeted killings

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would share internal legal advice on US targeted killings, condemn such strikes as unlawful, and press the US for transparency and accountability on drone strikes. Minister Timmermans answered that the advice will be submitted to the CAVV, that prohibitions on attacks on protected persons and extrajudicial executions apply, that more openness from the US is welcomed, but that a judgement on specific strikes requires facts the government does not have.

I consider it useful to have the lawfulness and conditions for the use of armed drones further analysed and have decided to refer this question for advice to the Advisory Committee on Issues of Public International Law (CAVV).

Ik acht het nuttig om de rechtmatigheid en voorwaarden voor het gebruik van bewapende drones nader te laten analyseren en heb besloten om dit vraagstuk ter advisering aan de Commissie van Advies inzake Volkenrechtelijke Vraagstukken (CAVV) voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Bonis over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

MPs Van Bommel and Bonis asked the Foreign Minister about Iranian prisoner Nasrin Sotoudeh, her hunger strike, restrictions on family and lawyer access, her medical care, the number of conscience prisoners in Iran, and whether the government will press for her release. The minister confirmed the situation, said the Netherlands and the EU call for her immediate release and have raised it repeatedly with Iran, but could not give reliable figures on prisoners or details of her health.
The EU, partly on Dutch initiative, has repeatedly urged the Iranian authorities to immediately release Ms Sotoudeh.
De EU heeft bij de Iraanse autoriteiten – mede op Nederlands initiatief – herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op onmiddellijke vrijlating van mevrouw Sotoudeh.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over KLM en de no fly list

The MP asks whether KLM refused a passenger on a US no-fly list at Qatar, whether Dutch authorities are involved, whether there is consultation with the US on the list, and whether the government shares concerns about discrimination and the lack of redress. The minister confirms the refusal, states Dutch authorities are not involved and there is no consultation, says the list is a unilateral US decision outside Dutch responsibility, sees no reason to assume discrimination, and points to the DHS-Trip redress procedure.
The decision to place persons on the list is a unilateral decision by the American authorities.
Het besluit om personen op de lijst te zetten is een eenzijdige beslissing van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang over het bericht dat Griekenland de afspraken over vermindering van het aantal ambtenaren schendt

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece hired tens of thousands of new civil servants in 2010-2011 despite agreed reductions, and whether the Troika knew. The minister confirmed that the reduction of civil servants was slower than planned due to hiring offsetting departures, cited the MoU target of 150,000 cuts by 2015, and said the Troika will monitor progress closely.
The Troika concluded in March that the main cause was the lack of effective centralised coordination in the public sector.
De Trojka oordeelde in maart jl. dat de voornaamste oorzaak hiervoor het gebrek aan effectieve gecentraliseerde coördinatie in de publieke sector betrof.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over een Amerikaanse waarschuwing voor Chinese telecombedrijven

SP MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked whether the Netherlands would act on a US warning that Chinese telecom firms Huawei and ZTE pose a security risk and may pass information to China, and what Dutch authorities do about it. The government replied that the public part of the US report gives no reason to change its stance, that the non-public part has not yet been received, that Huawei and ZTE are active in the Netherlands, that no Chinese espionage via this equipment has been established, and that no further US cooperation is currently needed.
We do not yet have access to the non-public part of the report and therefore cannot yet assess the conclusions from it, or their underpinning.
Wij hebben op dit moment nog niet de beschikking over het niet-openbare gedeelte van het rapport en kunnen de conclusies daaruit – en de onderbouwing daarvan – dus nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Omtzigt over executies in Iran

MPs Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked about imminent executions in Iran, the number carried out this year, whether official figures understate them, whether drug offences and political motives play a role, the execution of minors, and whether the government will protest bilaterally and in the EU.
