The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, cites 344 executions by its own count against 262 officially announced, notes no minors executed this year, and says protests have been lodged in Tehran and within the EU.
The Netherlands is fundamentally opposed to the death penalty and states this unequivocally.
Nederland is principieel tegen de doodstraf en draagt dit ondubbelzinnig uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de zaak van de heer Van Bilderbeek

An SP MP asked whether the 2009 confidential lawyer's report on the Colombian trial of Mr Van Bilderbeek would be made available to him and to parliament. The minister answered that the report was refused under the Wob, but in exceptional circumstances it was sent to Mr Van Bilderbeek and made available confidentially to MPs without precedent.
By way of a very exceptional measure, I am prepared to provide the report of the trusted lawyer to Mr Van Bilderbeek
Bij wijze van hoge uitzondering ben ik bereid het rapport van de vertrouwensadvocaat aan de heer Van Bilderbeek te verstrekken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een mogelijke preventieve aanval op Iran

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers whether the Netherlands had been approached about, or assisted in, preparations for a possible preventive attack on Iran, and whether legal advice existed on its legality. Minister Timmermans answered that the Netherlands had not been approached or assisted, that the British internal legal advice is not known to him, and that internal legal advice on pre-emptive action remains confidential.
Internally, written advice has been given on international legal questions concerning possible pre-emptive or preventive action.
Intern is schriftelijk geadviseerd over volkenrechtelijke vragen met betrekking tot mogelijk preëmptief of preventief optreden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over uitbreiding van de nederzettingen door Israël

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's approval of 1,285 new settlement homes, whether he agreed with the British criticism, how many settlement homes had been announced or tendered since January 2012, and what the EU should do. The minister confirmed his condemnation, reported 4,644 homes announced and 3,348 tendered, and said the Netherlands will work with EU partners to dissuade Israel and seek a common EU line.
The Netherlands, in cooperation with other EU member states, will try to dissuade the Israeli authorities from this.
Nederland, in samenwerking met andere EU-lidstaten, zal trachten de Israëlische autoriteiten hiervan te weerhouden.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een mogelijk waarnemerschap van Taiwan bij de UNFCCC

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether Taiwan's bid for observer status at the UNFCCC (Doha, 2012) should be supported given Taiwan's high CO2 emissions. The minister answered yes to the factual questions, but said support for Taiwan's observer request cannot be given under the one-China policy, while practical cooperation remains possible.
However, a request from Taiwan for admission as an observer state cannot be supported on the basis of the one-China policy.
Een verzoek van Taiwan tot toelating als waarnemerstaat kan echter niet worden gesteund op grond van het één-China beleid
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanvallen vanuit Syrië op Turkije

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister whether NATO-made ammunition was used in the deadly Syrian attack on Turkey, whether the Syrian regime was responsible for all cross-border attacks, and whether a de facto buffer zone had arisen. Minister Timmermans answered that details on the munitions and origin were not yet available, that the government lacks full insight into the border situation, and that there is no buffer zone.
Further information is currently not available.
Nadere informatie is op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over onderdrukking in China

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the crackdown on activists, black jails, internet restrictions, travel controls in Tibet and Xinjiang, and whether the government would press China for release of activists detained for their opinions. The minister confirmed restrictions on activists and rights organisations, said black jails give cause for concern raised in EU-China dialogue, and said the government raises individual cases and will do so again in the next bilateral consultations, without committing to a specific demand.
In appropriate cases, direct release is pressed for.
In voorkomende gevallen wordt aangedrongen op directe vrijlating.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de verplichte privatisering van waterbedrijven in ruil voor Europese staatsleningen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Finance whether Greece and Portugal are required to privatise their water utilities as a condition of EU financial support, who sets that condition, and how access to drinking water is guaranteed. The minister answers that privatisation is part of the loan conditionality, that the Memorandum of Understanding for Greece lists water companies for sale, and that the Troika supervises implementation and should ensure full water access for all citizens.

In the case of Greece, more concrete agreements on privatisations were made in the programme agreed in February, and a list of companies to be privatised, including water companies, was also drawn up.

In het geval van Griekenland zijn in het programma zoals overeengekomen in februari, concretere afspraken gemaakt over de privatiseringen en is er ook een lijst opgesteld met te privatiseren bedrijven, waaronder waterbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de toegang van de VS tot data in de cloud

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether the US access to cloud-stored data of Dutch users, including protected data, is a problem and whether the government will advise against cloud use and consult US and EU counterparts. The state secretary replied that the risk is known, that responsibility lies primarily with data controllers, that no advice against cloud use is needed, and that the issue is being raised in EU negotiations on the data protection regulation.
I consider this an undesirable situation. This problem is known within the European Union, and the proposal for a General Data Protection Regulation seeks to offer a solution.
Ik acht dit een onwenselijke situatie. Dit probleem is bij de Europese Unie bekend, en het voorstel voor een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming poogt daarvoor een oplossing aan te reiken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en De Roon over de bloedige onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of lethal force against Papuan demonstrators in Indonesia, whether the government would condemn it, summon the ambassador, support a free press there, and send independent observers. The minister said the 23 October clashes in Manokwari are still under investigation, denied that repression is structural, noted limits on foreign journalists' access, and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights through bilateral contacts and the EU dialogue, but rejected observers and sanctions-style steps.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the human rights situation in Papua and West Papua in bilateral contacts and through the EU human rights dialogue.
Nederland zal in bilaterale contacten en via de EU-mensenrechten dialoog aandacht blijven vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Papua en West-Papua.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Hongerstaking Koerdische gevangenen Turkije

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about a mass hunger strike by about 700 Kurdish prisoners in Turkey, including reports of beatings, isolation, denial of medical access, and whether Kurdish-language defence and education demands are justified. The minister acknowledged the strike, cited the EU Commission's report on uneven prison conditions, relayed Turkish government denials and a ministerial prison visit, supported improving Kurdish minority rights through Turkey's constitutional reform, and promised continued bilateral and EU attention without committing to contacting the Turkish counterpart directly.
The Netherlands will continue to pay attention to the position of the Kurds both bilaterally and together with the European Commission.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als samen met de Europese Commissie aandacht aan de positie van de Koerden blijven besteden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse targeted killings

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the legality of US targeted drone killings in Pakistan, Yemen and Somalia, including signature strikes, attacks on rescuers and funerals, and UN recommendations. The minister said international humanitarian law may apply in an armed conflict with Al Qaida, that the legal framework is clear enough, that internal legal advice was received, and that she would not press US allies for a moratorium.
Regarding specific attacks in the countries concerned, I do not have the factual information needed to give a responsible judgement on their legality.
Ten aanzien van specifieke aanvallen in betreffende landen beschik ik niet over de feitelijke informatie die nodig zou zijn om een verantwoord oordeel te kunnen geven over de rechtmatigheid ervan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper Van Dijk over de Navo oefening Steadfast Noon

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the NATO exercise Steadfast Noon, in which the Netherlands participates at Büchel air base, rehearses procedures for deploying tactical nuclear weapons, and whether Dutch participation conflicts with nuclear disarmament policy. The government declined to give details of the exercise citing international agreements, and argued that NATO remains a nuclear alliance while pursuing a world free of nuclear weapons step by step.
Based on international agreements, no statements are made on this matter.
Op basis van internationale afspraken worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een mogelijke bemiddelende rol in de zaak Assange

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands could mediate in the Assange extradition impasse, including whether Sweden refuses to question Assange in the UK or guarantee against US extradition. The minister confirmed there is no formal charge, explained Swedish law offers no pre-extradition guarantee, and declined any Dutch role, citing trust in the legal process between the UK and Sweden.
No, this concerns a case between the United Kingdom and Sweden.
Nee, dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Zweden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over de uitgezette Libiër A.F.

MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Immigration about the 2004 expulsion of Libyan Abu Farsan to Sudan, his alleged rendition to Libya, the role of the CIA and MI6, and whether an independent Dutch investigation will be held following Human Rights Watch's findings. The government's answer, sent confidentially to MPs, was delivered by Minister Leers on behalf of both ministers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in Bahrein

An MP asked the foreign minister about human rights abuses in Bahrain, including UN review recommendations, convicted opposition members, torture reported by a national commission, and tear gas use. The minister said Bahrain accepted most UN recommendations but not ratifying the Rome Statute, that the Netherlands monitors the cases and supports the commission's findings, and that a special UN Human Rights Council session lacks sufficient support.

The Netherlands closely follows developments concerning the convicted human rights defenders in Bahrain and endeavours to point the Bahraini authorities to the need for a transparent and fair legal process.

Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen inzake de veroordeelde mensenrechtenverdedigers in Bahrein op de voet en spant zich in om de Bahreinse autoriteiten te wijzen op de noodzaak van een transparante en eerlijke rechtsgang.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het Eritrese consulaat Eritrese Nederlanders afperst

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether the Eritrean consulate extorts Eritrean Dutch nationals through a 2% levy and threats, whether it obstructs integration and civil society in Amersfoort, and whether Dutch firms trade with Eritrea. The minister answered that the levy and festival fundraising are not illegal in themselves, that criminal conduct would be investigated on the basis of complaints, that the government will raise the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and that no data exist on Dutch trade with Eritrea.
To establish whether offences such as extortion are at issue, the police and the public prosecution service depend to a large extent on reports and complaints from the victims.

Voor het vaststellen of misdrijven als afpersing en soortgelijke delicten aan de orde zijn, zijn politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door de slachtoffers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Bommel over het martelen van een Molukse demonstrant

MPs Voordewind and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that Moluccan prisoner Johan Teterissa was beaten, denied medical care, moved without notice and held despite peaceful protest. The minister said the mistreatment reports are not confirmed by independent sources, that the government raised past abuse with Indonesia, and that it raises prisoner treatment and sentences bilaterally and within the EU, without committing to a specific request for release.
I raise both bilaterally and within the EU the treatment of prisoners and the heavy sentences imposed on persons who peacefully express their political views, including Mr Teterissa.

Ik vraag zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband aandacht voor de behandeling van gevangenen en de hoge straffen die zijn opgelegd aan personen die op geweldloze wijze hun politieke opvatting ventileren, onder wie de heer Teterissa.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk inzake het bericht ‘MBO’s gokken met derivaten’

SP MPs asked the Education Minister whether MBO colleges speculated with housing funds through risky derivatives, whether this was responsible, whether the sector must pay for buy-outs, and whether governance and inspection oversight should be tightened. The minister said derivatives must be used risk-averse, that the Inspectorate is reviewing the financial picture and will report in autumn, and that action depends on those findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to critically assess the financial picture of all publicly funded MBO institutions.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde mbo-instellingen kritisch te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

Mr Van Bommel asks whether the government will prosecute shipowners who illegally deploy armed private guards on Dutch merchant ships, and what measures it has taken. The government answers that such use is a criminal offence the Public Prosecution Service can pursue, that it has lowered the shipowners' contribution and processes all navy protection requests, and that prosecution decisions and sentencing are for the prosecutor and courts.
The Dutch public prosecution service has jurisdiction over this and can therefore institute criminal prosecution.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft hierover de jurisdictie en kan derhalve strafrechtelijke vervolging instellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Afghaanse politie-eenheid loopt over naar de Taliban”

MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports that an Afghan police unit defected to the Taliban, including numbers, weapons, training links and prevention measures. The government answered that the facts are unclear, eleven Afghan Uniformed Police officers reportedly defected with small arms, it cannot confirm NATO training, gives no explanation, and describes intake and mentoring measures to limit future defections.
It is unclear exactly what happened in Farah province (southwest Afghanistan).
Het is onduidelijk wat zich precies heeft afgespeeld in de provincie Farah (Zuidwest-Afghanistan).
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van de behandeling van alle verblijfsaanvragen door Iraanse vreemdelingen

MPs asked whether the IND had stopped processing residence applications from Iranian students and nationals, and whether this amounted to discrimination. The minister answered that applications are decided, but students in restricted fields need a ministry exemption under UN resolution 1737 and EU regulation 267/2012, and that some applications for work were temporarily held before resuming processing.
It is a misunderstanding that the IND does not process applications from Iranian students.
Het is een misverstand dat de IND geen aanvragen van Iraanse studenten in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over rapport van de Israëlische nederzettingencommissie

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli settlement commission report that deemed settlements legal, questioning its conflict with ICJ and UN positions and asking for diplomatic pressure. The minister replied that the government has consistently stated the Dutch position against settlements, that it will not anticipate an Israeli cabinet decision, and that the Dutch position has been conveyed in contacts with Israel.
I do not wish to anticipate a possible decision by the Israeli cabinet.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op een mogelijk besluit van het Israëlische kabinet.
Vragen van de leden Smits en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het onveranderd hoge aantal laaggeletterden (ingezonden 17 juli 2012).

SP MPs Smits and Van Bommel asked the education minister why the number of functionally illiterate people remains about 1.5 million despite action plans, and questioned the spending and expertise of Stichting Lezen & Schrijven. The minister denied policy failure, defended subsidised activities and the foundation's expertise, and said the ministry, not the foundation, holds the lead role.
The ministry of OCW has the lead on reducing the number of functionally illiterate people, not Stichting L&S.
Het ministerie van OCW heeft de regie over het terugdringen van het aantal laaggeletterden en niet Stichting L&S.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over goudwinning op het eiland Romang in de Molukken

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether gold mining by PT Gemala Borneo Utama on Romang polluted drinking water and destroyed crops, whether 418 protesters were arrested, and whether the ambassador would be asked for clarification. The minister confirmed the local conflict and the allegations but had no independent information, said 27 arrested residents were released after processing, and saw no reason to approach the Indonesian ambassador.
I do not have information from other sources that supports or contradicts this accusation.
Ik beschik niet over informatie uit andere bronnen die deze beschuldiging ondersteunt of weerspreekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Iraanse gewetensgevangene Kabudvand

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether detained Iranian journalist Kabudvand is a prisoner of conscience, whether his health has deteriorated and lacks adequate medical care, and whether the Netherlands will back an NGO call for his release and inform Iran. The minister answered that sources conflict on the reason for his arrest, his current health cannot be verified, and the Netherlands raises fair trial and treaty compliance bilaterally and through the EU without committing to a specific individual demand.

The Netherlands presses Iranian authorities bilaterally and multilaterally (for example through statements by EU High Representative Ashton) to uphold a fair and transparent legal process and to respect international treaties Iran has signed.

Nederland dringt bilateraal en multilateraal (bijvoorbeeld via verklaringen van EU Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton) bij de Iraanse autoriteiten aan op het handhaven van een eerlijke en transparante rechtsgang en het eerbiedigen van internationale verdragen die Iran heeft ondertekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht 'Surinamers 'belegeren' Nederlandse ambassade'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a large backlog in visa processing at the Dutch embassy in Paramaribo, and whether capacity was insufficient despite the known summer peak. The minister denied any backlog, stating complete applications are handled within five working days, and pointed to extra equipment and staff added for June to August.
There is no backlog. Every visa application, provided it is complete and in order when submitted by the applicant, is processed within five working days.
Er is geen achterstand. Iedere visumaanvraag, mits compleet en in orde door de indiener aangeleverd, wordt binnen vijf werkdagen afgehandeld.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over misleidende berichtgeving met betrekking tot het label Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether products from Western Sahara sold in Dutch supermarkets under a 'Morocco' label are misleading, and whether this breaches EU consumer rules and contributes to occupation. The minister said the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive does not apply because the food labelling directive governs, that misleading origin labelling is prohibited, and that the EU-Morocco agreement covers only Moroccan territory, so Western Sahara products cannot claim preferences.
Under the Labelling of Foodstuffs Decree it is not permitted to place misleading information, including on the origin or provenance of a product, on the label.
Op basis van het Warenwetbesluit Etikettering van levensmiddelen is het niet toegestaan om misleidende informatie, onder meer over de oorsprong of herkomst van een product, op het etiket te plaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over het asielbeleid voor Somaliërs

MPs Van Bommel and Gesthuizen asked the minister how the Council of State ruling on asylum for Somalis affects long-resident Somalis at risk from Al-Shabaab, and whether they should be exempt from return and given shelter. The minister said the ruling is applied by testing whether Somalis from south/central Somalia have lived under Al-Shabaab rules, rejected the claim that Somalis cannot return through no fault of their own, and refused a standard non-fault procedure or shelter, while noting that new asylum applications are possible.
Of course I will give effect to the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State (the Division).
Uiteraard geef ik invulling aan de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (de Afdeling).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over foto’s over executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked whether photos showing Dutch soldiers near executed Indonesians implicate Dutch forces, and whether archives and a new research programme on the 1945-1949 Indonesian war should be commissioned. The minister answered that the photos do not establish responsibility, that the institutes hold similar images already in the public domain, and that independent research is for the institutes, not the cabinet.
On the basis of the photographs it cannot be concluded that these soldiers are responsible for the deaths of the victims shown.
Op basis van de foto's kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat deze militairen verantwoordelijk zijn voor de dood van de slachtoffers op de foto.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitlevering van een Nederlandse hacker David S. aan de Verenigde Staten door Roemenië

MP Van Bommel asked ministers how Dutch authorities were involved in the US investigation of Dutch hacker David S., who was arrested in Romania and extradition-bound to the US, and why he was not arrested in the Netherlands. Teeven answered that Dutch authorities received US information but took no investigative action, were not informed of the arrest in advance, received only a pending US mutual legal assistance request, and cannot discuss details of the Romanian extradition proceedings.
I cannot go into the further content of that request, because doing so could harm an ongoing foreign criminal investigation.
Op de verdere inhoud van dat verzoek kan ik niet ingaan, omdat daardoor een lopend buitenlands opsporingsonderzoek zou kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over 'vernieling van EU-projecten in de bezette Palestijnse Gebieden'

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about Israeli destruction of EU- and Dutch-funded development projects in the occupied Palestinian territories, including whether a full 2001-2011 damage overview would be provided and whether compensation had been obtained. The minister answered that only current-project damage is listed, that a complete record of handed-over projects is not kept, that compensation has not been obtained, and that Dutch interests in preventing destruction are pursued through bilateral and EU channels.

It is not possible to provide a complete overview of damage to completed projects for the following reasons: the Dutch government does not keep a register of damage inflicted on projects already handed over.

Het is niet mogelijk om een volledig overzicht te geven van schade aan de afgeronde projecten om de volgende redenen: – De Nederlandse regering houdt geen register bij van schade berokkend aan reeds overgedragen projecten;
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Afzetting president Paraguay

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the removal of President Lugo of Paraguay was a coup and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification from Paraguay's ambassador. The minister answered that the constitution allows congressional removal, that the Supreme Court and electoral body found it constitutional, and that no reason currently exists to request clarification, while the EU is analysing events with the OAS.
At this moment there is no reason to ask the Paraguayan ambassador for clarification.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om de Paraguyaanse ambassadeur om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen Van Bommel over het frustreren van het gebruik van het Europees burgerinitiatief

Van Bommel (SP) asked why no European Citizens' Initiative had started collecting signatures, whether the Commission's online system was ready, whether the Commission was adequately assisting citizens, and why a nuclear phase-out initiative was rejected as outside Commission competence. The State Secretary replied that software problems delay online collection, that the Commission has provided information and a helpdesk, that the initiative fell outside Euratom competence with appeal routes available, and that the Commission must judge admissibility independently.
Therefore I have the impression that the Commission is taking its task seriously.
Ik heb daarom de indruk dat de Commissie haar taak serieus oppakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over honderden opgepakte Tibetanen

The SP MP Van Bommel asked whether hundreds of Tibetans were detained in and around Lhasa after self-immolations, whether tourists and others were expelled, and whether China labelled the self-immolators terrorists, and whether the minister would press China on the detainees. The minister replied that reliable first-hand information is impossible to obtain because Tibetan areas are not freely accessible, that the EU has repeatedly demanded access and raised the issue in dialogue, that no Dutch nationals are known to have been expelled, and that the Netherlands follows the case closely and raises human rights obligations with China.
It is impossible to obtain reliable first-hand information, because various Tibetan areas are not freely accessible to foreign journalists and diplomats.
Het is onmogelijk uit eerste hand betrouwbare informatie te verkrijgen, omdat verschillende Tibetaanse gebieden niet vrij toegankelijk zijn voor buitenlandse journalisten en diplomaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 'de situatie van kinderen in Gaza'

An MP asked the foreign minister about the situation of children in Gaza, including a report on water contamination and the impact of the blockade, and whether the Netherlands should press Israel and the Palestinian Authority on children's rights. The minister answered that the Netherlands and the EU call for open border crossings, that children's rights can be raised in EU human rights dialogues, and that concrete economic support such as a container scanner was agreed.
Treaty parties can hold each other to account for their obligations under the convention.
Verdragspartijen kunnen elkaar aanspreken op de verplichtingen onder het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel inzake Nederlandse oorlogsmisdaden op Zuid-Celebes

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about alleged Dutch war crimes in South Sulawesi in 1946-47 (summary executions, knowledge at top levels, the 1954 decision not to prosecute, and release of the Van Rij/Stam report). The government answered that over 3,000 people died in the actions, that political and military leadership were informed from December 1946, that the 1954 non-prosecution decision was based on the information available, that the facts are now time-barred, and that the report has been deposited for Chamber inspection with personal data caveats.
The report is deposited at the Tweede Kamer registry for the Chamber's inspection, though it should be noted that the report may contain names of still-living persons whose private life is protected.

Tegen deze achtergrond wordt het rapport ter kennisname door de Kamer ter griffie van de Tweede Kamer neergelegd, waarbij moet worden aangetekend dat in het rapport namen van nog levende personen kunnen voorkomen waarvan de persoonlijke levenssfeer beschermd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over homoseksualiteit in Ethiopië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a Ethiopian newspaper article and a national anti-homosexuality conference warning of a gay 'infestation', including whether the government was involved, whether the conference was funded from abroad, and what Dutch funding supports LGBTI rights in Ethiopia. The government replied that the Ethiopian government was not involved, funding origin is unknown, the Netherlands made no contribution to the conference, and it supports SRGR and LGBTI-related work through its embassy and a planned ambassador visit.
It is unknown whether and by whom this conference was sponsored.
Het is onbekend of en door wie deze conferentie werd gesponsord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het nieuwe detentieregime in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Afghanistan, under US pressure, is adopting a detention regime allowing indefinite administrative detention similar to Bagram, and how this fits international and Afghan law. The minister answered that details of the new regime are not yet known to the government, that a Joint Monitoring Board will oversee compliance, and that the Dutch embassy will continue to press for detention in line with international law.
Concrete details about this regime are not currently known to the government.
Concrete details over dit regime zijn de regering op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported surge in US arms and ammunition imports by Greece in February 2012 amid its social crisis, and whether this threatens political stability and whether the government will raise it abroad. The minister answered that the purchases appear to be by the Greek government, that no structural import increase is evident given defence budget cuts, that there is no reason to think weapons will fall into the wrong hands, and that the government sees no reason to raise arms supply with the US or in EU/UN forums.
The government sees no reason to raise arms supply.
De regering ziet geen reden om wapenlevering aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de dreigende executie van vier homoseksuelen in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the threatened execution of four men in Iran over alleged homosexual conduct, whether the sentence rests on rape rather than consensual same-sex acts, whether appeal is possible, and whether the Iranian ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed the reports, said HRANA cites a rape conviction with the defendants claiming consent, noted appeal to the Supreme Court may be possible, and stated the EU position against the death penalty will be raised at the next EU statement.
I will make efforts to raise attention to this case as well in the next EU statement.
Ik zal mij inspannen om bij de volgende EU verklaring ook voor deze zaak aandacht te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de destructie door Israël van door de EU gefinancierde ontwikkelingsprojecten in de bezette Palestijnse Gebieden

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli destruction of EU- and Dutch-funded development projects in the occupied Palestinian territories, including damage totals, Dutch protests and compensation, and a threatened solar energy project. The government answered that it raised liability for the damage with Israeli authorities, that about EUR 65,000 damage hit one Dutch-funded project, that no compensation has been received, and that talks with COGAT have not yet produced a settlement.
This consultation has not yet led to a damage settlement.
Dit overleg heeft nog niet geleid tot een schaderegeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een overeenkomst van de Europese Commissie inzake het gebruik van luxe privéjets

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a European Commission framework contract with Abelag for private jets and charter flights capped at EUR 12.68 million, and whether this fits austerity. The government answered that the contract imposes no purchase obligation, the average hourly cost is about EUR 5,000, the amount is not higher than before, and that it leaves the Commission's spending to the Commission, though it favours EU administrative savings.
This amount is not higher than in previous years; the European Commission expects this new contract to actually yield significant savings.
Dit bedrag is niet hoger dan in voorgaande jaren; de Europese Commissie verwacht dat dit nieuwe contract juist significante besparingen oplevert.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het tegenhouden van reizigers naar Israël

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Israel asking European airlines to deny boarding to activists travelling to Bethlehem, the identification of travellers, criteria used, and Israeli security staff at airports. The minister answered that states may refuse entry, that criteria and lists are not public and not held by the Dutch government, that El Al staff have licensed additional security tasks at Schiphol, and that the Dutch government does not track refusals based on foreign rules.
Due to the heightened threat against Israeli flights, El Al employees have been designated to carry out additional security tasks on top of the regular security process.

In verband met de verhoogde dreiging gericht tegen Israëlische vluchten, zijn er medewerkers van El Al aangewezen om aanvullende beveiligingstaken uit te voeren, bovenop het reguliere beveiligingsproces.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het legaliseren van buitenposten door Israël

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's decision to legalise three West Bank outposts conflicts with international law and the peace process, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it. Minister Rosenthal answered that settlements are illegal under international law and an obstacle to peace regardless of Israeli status, that the step is unilateral and unhelpful, and that the Netherlands has conveyed its position to Israel and the EU condemned the move.
Settlements are illegal under international law and an obstacle to peace.
Nederzettingen zijn illegaal onder internationaal recht en een obstakel voor vrede.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het uitreiken van de Four Freedoms Award  aan de heer Al-Shahristani, minister van energie van Irak, op 12 mei 2012.

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would present the Four Freedoms Award to Iraq's energy minister Al-Shahristani, given accusations of corruption and a no-confidence motion in Iraq's parliament. The government answered that the award is chosen by the Roosevelt Institute and will be presented by another official, then stated the Prime Minister will not present it himself, leaving Iraqi parliament to judge the corruption allegations.
As stated in the answer to question 1, I will not present this award.
Zoals vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 1 zal ik deze prijs niet uitreiken.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en van Bommel over de zaak Van Bilderbeek

MPs Paulus Jansen and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister whether she endorses the account in the book 'De Olievlek' about the Van Bilderbeek case in Colombia, and what the government did to assist the brothers humanitarian, diplomatically and legally, why the passport took so long, and for an update on actions since 2008. The minister declined to comment on the book beyond matters within her own remit, detailed consular, diplomatic and legal steps, explained the passport refusal under past policy and the court-ordered issuance in January 2011, and gave an update.
I can only give a judgment on matters that concern me.
Ik kan slechts een oordeel geven over zaken die mij regarderen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk en Van Bommel over de verkoop van tanks aan Indonesië

SP MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether the cabinet approved a 200 million euro tank sale to Indonesia and an Egypt defence deal, how these fit human rights concerns and earlier parliamentary motions, and whether the minister misled parliament on timing. The ministers answered that a cabinet discussion took place with follow-up agreements referred to an earlier letter, no decision had been taken on Egypt, the Indonesia question was addressed in that letter, and they denied the allegations of strategic delay and ignored advice.
Given the cabinet's current caretaker status, we wish to weigh these matters with the utmost care before presenting them to your House.
Mede gezien de huidige demissionaire status van het kabinet willen wij deze aangelegenheden met de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wegen, alvorens ze aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Karabulut over de mishandeling van Koerdische kinderen in Turkse gevangenissen

Two SP MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of sexual abuse and beatings of Kurdish juveniles in the Pozanti detention centre in Turkey, and about related oversight and Dutch influence. The minister answered that the Turkish justice ministry has investigated, closed the youth wing, transferred detainees, and is preparing criminal measures, while stating that Dutch and EU pressure on Turkey continues through accession channels.
I will continue to follow this situation closely, also within the framework of the EU accession process.
Ik zal deze situatie, ook in het kader van het EU -toetredingsproces, met aandacht blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van vijf Papua’s in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of five Papuans in Indonesia for a peaceful independence declaration, including the fairness of the trial, alleged police violence, deaths at the demonstration, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia and reconsider tank sales. The minister answered that the appeal is pending, that Indonesian and NGO inquiries confirmed three deaths but left circumstances unclear, that some disciplinary sanctions were imposed, and that a motion on tank sales is under consideration.
I am awaiting the appeal ruling.
Ik wacht de uitspraak in hoger beroep af.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over 'de invoer van producten uit nederzettingen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever'

MP Van Bommel asked ministers about imports of products from West Bank settlements under the EU-Israel Association Agreement, including labelling, preferential-origin controls, a blacklist of firms, and enforcement. Minister Rosenthal answered that such misuse is very rare, that origin checks are conducted with the Commission moving toward publishing a settlement postcode list, that blacklisting is for the Commission, and that no import ban exists in line with the international position.

Partly at the urging of the European Parliament, the European Commission is currently considering publishing this list with the aim of preventing settlement products from using the tariff preferences.

Mede op aandringen van het EP overweegt de Europese Commissie (EC) momenteel openbaarmaking van deze lijst met als doel om te voorkomen dat nederzettingenproducten gebruik maken van de tariefpreferenties.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie haar personeel verbiedt te vliegen met goedkope luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MP Van Bommel asked whether the European Commission bans its staff from flying with low-cost airlines, and whether the Dutch government would press the Commission to reconsider given budget savings. The State Secretary replied that the Commission does not exclude low-cost carriers; staff may book them themselves and claim costs, and he saw no reason to press the Commission, while also explaining the Dutch government's ticket-booking criteria.
No, the European Commission does not exclude low-cost airlines.
Nee, de Europese Commissie sluit goedkope vliegtuigmaatschappijen niet uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Van Gerven over marteling en mishandeling in Israëlische detentiecentra

MPs Van Bommel and Van Gerven asked the government about a report alleging torture and ill-treatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres with medical staff involvement, and whether the government would press Israel for independent investigation and accountability. The minister said the government cannot assess the report's findings, leaves judgement and investigation to Israeli authorities and the UN Committee against Torture, and noted Israel's Health Ministry had set up a review commission.
The cabinet does not have the information that would make it possible to form a judgement on the content of the report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de informatie die het mogelijk maakt een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud van het rapport.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de opgepakte Nederlander van Marokkaanse afkomst in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Morocco of a Dutch national of Moroccan descent, Yuba Zalen, whether he was tortured and whether protests in the Rif were suppressed harshly. The minister answered that Zalen was arrested for photographing a demonstration, received consular assistance from an honorary consul and was released pending trial, and described the protests and police response as involving tear gas and water cannons without condemning the conduct.
Mr Zalen has been released pending the court hearing.
De heer Zalen is in vrijheid gesteld in afwachting van de rechtszitting.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de toekenning van een prijs van het Prins Claus Fonds aan Tsering Woeser

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Tibetan writer Tsering Woeser was placed under house arrest, preventing her from collecting a Prins Claus Fund award, and whether the government would press China to lift it. The minister confirmed she had asked not to attend the dinner, noted China denies house arrest, and said the award stands and the money was transferred, without committing to press Beijing.
The obstruction of Ms Woeser's attendance changes nothing about the fact that she was awarded the prize by the jury of the Prins Claus Fund.
De belemmering van aanwezigheid van mevrouw Woeser verandert niets aan het feit dat haar de prijs is toegekend door de jury van het Prins Claus Fonds.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over Europese wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of claims that France and Germany pressed Greece to spend EU aid on arms contracts and tied aid to submarine-type purchases. The minister confirmed awareness of both claims and said they gave him no reason to revise his earlier answers.
The statement by Mr Cohen Bendit and the anonymous remarks from a former Papandreou aide give me no reason to revise these answers.
De verklaring van de heer Cohen Bendit en de anonieme uitspraken van een medewerker van voormalig premier Papandreou geven mij geen aanleiding deze antwoorden ter herzien.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanschaf van 500 Google Apps-accounts door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (ing

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel (SP) asked why the Foreign Affairs ministry bought 500 Google Apps accounts without a pilot as a fallback for emergency email, and how privacy and security were safeguarded given AIVD warnings about cloud services. The minister confirmed the purchase, justified it by open standards, low cost and reliability, said no other ministry uses it, and said confidential information may not be shared via these accounts.
In the event of emergencies, the normal, non-classified email communication of Foreign Affairs with the Dutch missions abroad must in any case be able to continue.

Indien calamiteiten zich voordoen dient in elk geval de normale, niet-gerubriceerde, e-mailcommunicatie van Buitenlandse Zaken met de Nederlandse vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland door te kunnen gaan.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel en Peters over het ILO rapport 'Burried in Bricks' en de betrokkenheid van NAVO/ISAF bij dwangarbeid in steenbakkerijen

MPs Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel and Peters asked the government about the ILO report 'Buried in Bricks' on bonded child and adult labour in Afghan brick kilns and whether NATO/ISAF supply chains use such bricks. The government answered that it shares the aim of ending child labour, that NATO/ISAF can not fully trace brick supply lines, and that NATO agreed four concrete follow-up steps while Afghanistan bears primary responsibility.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Libische opstandelingen

MP Van Bommel asked whether the Canadian ship HMCS Charlottetown, under NATO command, was ordered to let a vessel carrying arms to Libyan rebels pass, and whether the government knew of arms deliveries to rebels and acted against them. The government answered that NATO judged the transfer within Libya not to breach the arms embargo, that it does not consider the ship's conduct contrary to Dutch policy, and that interpreting UN resolutions is for each member state to decide.
The government shares this view and does not consider the conduct of the Canadian ship to be contrary to Dutch policy.
De regering deelt deze opvatting en acht het optreden van het Canadese schip niet strijdig met het Nederlandse beleid.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het terughalen van een Lynx-helikopter van Libië naar Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Defence Minister whether it is true that a Lynx helicopter stranded on the Libyan coast at Sirte will be brought back to the Netherlands and then dismantled, why this serves a national interest, and whether scrapping it in Libya would be cheaper. The minister confirmed the plan, citing national security and strategic defence material rules that Libya cannot meet, and gave an estimated additional cost of EUR 21,000 funded from the crisis operations budget.
Bringing back the helicopter is a national responsibility and serves a national security interest.
Het terughalen van de helikopter is een nationale verantwoordelijkheid en dient een nationaal veiligheidsbelang.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de voortgang van de oorlog in Afghanistan

SP MP Van Bommel asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a US officer's critical article on the Afghan war, including whether insurgents control most land beyond ISAF bases and whether Afghan security forces make non-fire pacts with insurgents. The minister answered that the article reflects limited observations, that the security transition is on plan, that the government disagrees the Taliban controls territory, and that such pacts are only isolated incidents, with a fuller picture to come in a forthcoming progress letter.
In the forthcoming progress letter you will be informed further about the current security situation.
In de komende stand-van-zakenbrief wordt u nader geïnformeerd over de actuele veiligheidssituatie.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het ambtsbericht van de Nederlandse ambassade in Kabul

An SP MP asked why the NATO general's warning about low trainee numbers in Kunduz was not shared with parliament, and whether the Kabul embassy report could be disclosed. The minister confirmed the statements, said parliament was kept informed through successive letters, gave an uncertain estimate of police trainees, and released the report with its internal commentary and names withheld.
Under the Government Information (Public Access) Act, the official commentary at the end of this report and its annex are not made public.
Op basis van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur worden het ambtelijke commentaar aan het slot van dit bericht en de bijlage niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitzending “KRO reporter internationaal”

An SP MP asked three ministers about a KRO broadcast on Dutch private security contractors operating abroad, including the absence of registration of firearms incidents, screening of personnel, and liability for offences. The government replied that Dutch firms operating only abroad fall under the law of the host country, that MFA-contracted guards are screened by the AIVD and meet strict criteria, and that liability depends on the facts and host-country criminal law.
The principle that for security activities the law of the country of deployment, not of origin, applies, I consider logical and correct.
Het uitgangspunt dat voor het uitvoeren van beveiligingswerkzaamheden niet de wetgeving van het land van herkomst maar die van het land van inzet leidend is acht ik logisch en juist.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Hachchi over Flintlock

MPs Van Bommel and Hachchi asked the defence minister about the Flintlock 2012 training exercise in Mali, including security risks, changed locations, and who decided to cancel it. The minister answered that AFRICOM cancelled the exercise in consultation with Malian authorities and the US ambassador, that Dutch planners were kept informed, and that no date for a future exercise has been set.
The commander of AFRICOM, in consultation with, among others, the commander of JSOTF-TS, the Malian minister of Defence and the US ambassador in Bamako, decided to cancel the exercise.
De commandant van AFRICOM heeft in overleg met onder meer de commandant van JSOTF-TS, de Malinese minister van Defensie en de Amerikaanse ambassadeur in Bamako besloten de oefening af te gelasten.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het bericht “Opstandige regio roert zich weer’

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about reports of violence against Tibetan protesters in Draggo, arrests, monasteries under siege, labelling of self-immolators as terrorists, dialogue with the Tibetan government in exile, and Han Chinese settlement in Tibet. Minister Rosenthal said the facts cannot be verified because the area is closed to EU representatives and journalists, and that the EU is preparing a demarche calling for dialogue and access.
It is not possible to establish precisely what happened.
Het is niet mogelijk precies na te gaan wat er is gebeurd.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over Amerikaanse National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether the US NDAA section 1021 on indefinite detention shifts power from courts to the executive and endangers Dutch residents, and whether it undermines Western criticism of rights violations elsewhere. The minister answered that it is premature to judge the law's effects, that the EU will raise concerns with the US, and that the US remains bound by international human rights and humanitarian law.

A number of provisions in the NDAA referred to by the ACLU, in particular those on detention of terrorism suspects and the possible geographic and temporal extension of the applicability of international humanitarian law, are not consistent with the Dutch and EU view of international law.

Een aantal bepalingen in de NDAA waaraan de ACLU refereert, met name die over de detentie van terrorismeverdachten en de mogelijke geografische en temporele oprekking van de toepasselijkheid van het humanitair oorlogsrecht, strookt niet met de Nederlandse en EU opvatting over het internationaal recht.
Antwoord vragen Irrgang en Van Bommel over wapenleveranties aan Griekenland

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Finance whether Greece will buy costly, unnecessary weapons during its bailout, whether the Dutch government issued export licences and lobbied for German arms sales, and whether Greek defence spending is excessive. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets have fallen since 2007, that the Dutch licence concerns frigate radar components for a Greek shipbuilding programme unrelated to the Die Zeit report, and that Greek procurement is a matter for Greece, declining to confirm several reported claims.
It is for the Greek government to shape its security policy and to set the priorities for its armed forces, and therefore also for its investments.
Het is aan de Griekse regering om haar veiligheidsbeleid vorm te geven, alsook de prioriteiten vast te stellen voor de strijdkrachten en daarmee ook in het doen van investeringen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een geheim NAVO rapport over samenwerking tussen Taliban en de Afghaanse politie

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about a reported secret NATO report on Taliban cooperation with Afghan police, including questions on Taliban popular support, Kunduz transition and Pakistan's ISI. The minister declined to comment on the content of classified NATO documents, stated the transition is on schedule, and gave substantive but general answers on the other points.
In line with NATO regulations, the government does not make statements about the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.
Vragen van de leden Roemer en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Palestijn sterft door traangasgranaat» (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

SP MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that a Palestinian demonstrator in Nabi Saleh died after a tear-gas canister was fired at him directly, and whether this breaches Israeli rules, and whether the Netherlands will condemn it. The minister replied that Israeli authorities are investigating, that no soldier has been charged for tear-gas misuse in recent years according to Israel, and that the Netherlands will weigh its position after the investigation's results.
The IDF is currently investigating the incident in Nabi Saleh. Following the results of this investigation, I will make a further assessment on the matter.
Het IDF doet momenteel onderzoek naar het voorval in Nabi Saleh. Naar aanleiding van de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik een nadere afweging terzake maken.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verzachting van de sancties tegen Birma (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Van Bommel and Ormel asked whether the EU should ease sanctions on Burma (except the arms embargo and travel bans) in response to reforms, and whether Burma should regain GSP trade preferences. The minister said the EU will review sanctions in April 2012 based on progress, and that GSP reinstatement depends on proven improvements on forced labour, to be proposed by the Commission.
In April 2012 the European foreign ministers will assess whether sufficient progress has been made to justify further easing of the sanctions.
In april 2012 zullen de Europese ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken beoordelen of dan voldoende voortgang is gemaakt om een verdere verzachting van de sancties te rechtvaardigen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Turkije doodt per ongeluk dertig burgers» (ingezonden 30 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Turkey's airstrike that killed 35 civilians near the Turkish-Iraqi border, whether the EU has responded, whether drone intelligence was involved, and how victims will be compensated. The minister answered that Turkey called it a tragic mistake, expressed regret, promised compensation and a thorough investigation, and said the Netherlands wants that investigation completed carefully and quickly.
The announced thorough investigation will have to show whether this was the case.
Het aangekondigde diepgaande onderzoek zal moeten uitwijzen of dit het geval is geweest.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over geheime CIA-gevangenis in Roemenië (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

Mr Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister whether the government would revise its position that there was no CIA secret prison in Romania after media reports citing former CIA staff, and whether it would push for a UN investigation into secret detention and torture allegations. Minister Rosenthal replied that the reports rest on anonymous claims, that Romania denies any CIA site, and that the government sees no reason to press for additional international investigation.
Against this background I see no reason to press for additional international investigation.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding aan te dringen op aanvullend internationaal onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks), van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse zaken over de gerechtelijke uitspraak die de Staat

MPs from several parties asked whether the government would drop cassation against the Hague appeals court ruling holding the State liable for the deaths of three men during the Srebrenica genocide, and whether it would apologise to the victims' relatives. The minister answered that the ruling is an interim judgment so cassation is not yet possible, and reaffirmed the 2002 Kok cabinet statement on Dutch political co-responsibility rather than apologising.
The appeals court ruling is, technically speaking, an interim judgment.
De uitspraak van het hof is juridisch-technisch gezien een tussenarrest.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Turkse aanval op Noord-Irak (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

The MP asks the foreign minister about the size and duration of Turkey's 2011 military operation against Kurdish PKK fighters in northern Iraq, NATO notification, the legality under international law, Kurdish political solutions, and US drone support. The minister answers that the operation was a limited, ended response to a PKK attack involving about 10,000 troops, that NATO was not informed as the action was outside NATO, that self-defence may apply, and that the government urges a political solution and regional dialogue.
The Turkish military offensive was a response to a PKK attack on 19 October and was ended on 27 October.
Het Turkse militaire offensief was een reactie op een aanslag van de verboden PKK op 19 oktober jl. en is op 27 oktober jl. beëindigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over bekentenis over 120 executies in december 1947, West Java (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a reported confession of executions of about 120 men at Rawagede in December 1947, and whether witnesses could be summoned and a new historical or legal inquiry launched. The minister replied that prosecution is no longer possible, that the 3-9 R.I. unit is named in documents, that the survivors cannot be identified, and that no new inquiry is needed.
No new facts or circumstances have become known that give reason to revise the finding in those answers that prosecution of the summary executions in Rawagede in 1947 is no longer possible.

Er zijn geen nieuwe feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden die aanleiding geven tot bijstelling van de in die antwoorden opgenomen vaststelling dat vervolging van de standrechtelijke executies in 1947 in Rawagede niet meer mogelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijkhoff (VVD), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van tientallen Turkse journalisten, acad

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the government judges the Turkish police arrest of dozens of journalists, writers and publishers, whether the charges link to publications on the Armenian genocide, and what Dutch steps and EU accession consequences follow. The minister answered that detainees are held pending a formal indictment under anti-terror law, that press freedom is under growing pressure, and that the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, with Turkey unable to join until it meets the accession conditions.
The Netherlands raises with the Turkish government, both bilaterally and through the EU, the importance of press freedom and freedom of expression for Turkey's democratic reform process.
Nederland spreekt zowel bilateraal als via de EU de Turkse regering aan op het belang van persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting voor het democratisch hervormingsproces in Turkije.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verdenking van spionage van een Russische diplomaat (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

MP Van Bommel asks whether a Russian diplomat suspected of contact with a Dutch F-16 pilot was arrested in March 2011, released after one hour to avoid diplomatic friction, and whether legal grounds existed to hold him longer, plus questions on Russian contact and his current status. The minister confirms an arrest on 17 March 2011, says the detention was used to establish diplomatic status and he was released under the Vienna Convention, and states he has since left the Netherlands after a request for withdrawal.
During the period of his detention, this person was not heard.
Gedurende de termijn van zijn aanhouding is deze persoon niet gehoord.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verkoop Duitse tanks aan Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU arms export criteria rule out a possible sale of over 200 German Leopard tanks to Saudi Arabia, whether the minister would urge Germany not to deliver, and whether Dutch tanks being retired could be sold to Saudi Arabia. The minister said Germany had not confirmed the sale, that such decisions are taken in secret by Germany's Federal Security Council, that Germany was asked to note the closed procedure, and that no talks on Dutch tanks with Saudi Arabia are taking place.
Deliberations on the approval of arms exports take place in Germany in secret sessions of the Federal Security Council.
Beraadslagingen over de goedkeuring van wapenexporten vinden in Duitsland plaats in geheime zittingen van de Bundessicherheitsrat.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over recente zelfverbrandingen in Tibet (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister to confirm reported self-immolations by Tibetan monks and a nun near the Kirti monastery, whether these stemmed from restricted freedoms, whether the government would press China on detention and religious freedom before an EU-China summit, and what steps were taken to revive the Tibet dialogue. The minister said the reports matched his information but could not be verified due to restricted access, that the protests reflected discontent with Chinese policy, that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in the EU human rights dialogue, that the summit was postponed, and that it has urged dialogue between Beijing and the Tibetan exile government.
Due to a lack of information from official Chinese sources and limited access to the area for independent (international) observers, I cannot verify this information further.
Door een gebrek aan informatie van officiële Chinese zijde en beperkte toegang tot het gebied voor onafhankelijke (internationale) waarnemers kan ik deze informatie niet nader verifiëren.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het opleidingsprogramma van Afghaanse politieagenten in Kunduz (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MP Van Bommel asks whether Afghan police authorities in Kunduz want to limit training for Afghan Uniformed Police to two mornings (eight hours) and whether they want the whole force rather than only new recruits trained, and whether literacy courses will be held at police posts and how the training plans will be guaranteed. The government answers that Dutch training covers recruits and active officers with a full curriculum, that the ten-week supplementary training will be split into modules over at least five months to avoid operational strain, and that literacy training will be held at the training centre or secured classrooms with GIZ, with the Afghan government having agreed to cooperate.
The curriculum is fixed, but the timetable is adapted to the officers' duties.
Het curriculum staat vast, maar het lesrooster wordt aangepast aan de werkzaamheden van de agenten.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over invasieplannen in Suriname in 1986 (ingezonden 23 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the government whether the Netherlands had requested or planned a military intervention in Suriname in 1986 to arrest Bouterse, and related questions on US involvement, withheld information and the expulsion of the Dutch ambassador. The government acknowledged that contingency planning for a possible evacuation operation with the US existed, that planning documents were never politically decided or executed, and that its 2007 answer had been incomplete, but said it saw no reason for further action against Suriname.
The cabinet believes it would have been better had this approach been followed already in 2007.
Het kabinet meent dat het beter zou zijn geweest als deze benadering al in 2007 zou zijn gevolgd.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over elektronische terreur tegen Syrische oppositie in Nederland (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

MP Van Bommel asked ministers whether the Syrian government was behind coordinated hacking and intimidation of Syrian opposition activists in the Netherlands and what the government would do to protect their online free expression. Minister Rosenthal answered that the government takes the signals seriously, will raise intimidation with the ambassador and is considering preventive action, while noting general internet freedom priorities and that the Mensenrechtenfonds is open to media projects.
What I can do is tell the ambassador that intimidating Syrians is unacceptable.
Wat ik kan doen is de ambassadeur zeggen dat het intimideren van Syriërs ontoelaatbaar is.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over Tulpenbollen (ingezonden 21 september 2011

An SP MP asked whether Romanian authorities blocked Dutch tulip and flower shipments at the Hungarian border over alleged bacteria, whether this was exceptional, and whether it was retaliation for the Dutch position on Romania's Schengen accession. The state secretary confirmed 25 trucks were held, explained the checks were a fiscal police campaign with no quarantine organisms found, said there was no link to Schengen, and noted the situation had normalised.
Holding trucks with Dutch products at the Romanian border can be considered exceptional.
Het tegenhouden van vrachtwagens met Nederlandse producten aan de Roemeense grens is uitzonderlijk te noemen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederlandse Iraniërs in detentie in Iran (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether 20 to 30 Dutch-Iranians are imprisoned in Iran, how the government obtains information on detained Dutch nationals, what consular assistance it can give, and how it will inform and protect a named woman, Sahar Nahrvar. The minister replied that three dual-nationality Dutch citizens are known to be detained, that a consular dialogue with Iran is ongoing, that Iran does not recognise Dutch consular assistance for dual nationals, and that Nahrvar will be kept informed while her family's safety is prioritised.
As far as is known, three dual-nationality Dutch citizens are in detention in Iran.
Er bevinden zich voor zover bekend drie bipatride Nederlanders in detentie in Iran.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld in Syrië (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether all diplomatic means, EU sanctions, economic measures and an EU arms embargo should be used against the Syrian regime, and what Assad's loss of legitimacy means for diplomatic ties. The minister answers that the Netherlands advocates sanctions, that the EU has imposed an oil embargo, investment ban, travel bans and a full arms embargo, and that diplomatic ties are maintained to keep information and pressure channels open.
The Netherlands advocates sanctions and other measures against the Syrian regime so that violence against the population stops and the way is cleared for a lasting political solution.
Nederland pleit voor sancties en andere maatregelen tegen het Syrische regime, opdat het geweld tegen de bevolking wordt gestaakt en de weg voor een duurzame politieke oplossing wordt vrijgemaakt.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Financiën over Defensie in Griekenland (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

MPs Irrgang and Van Bommel asked the Finance Minister about reported Greek defence spending despite fiscal crisis, a US offer of tanks, F-16 purchases and reserve-part contracts, and whether France and Germany use the crisis to push arms sales. The minister replied that Greek defence budgets were cut under EU/IMF terms through postponed and cancelled investment plans and salary measures, that the tank transfer did not go ahead, that F-16 numbers and reserve-part volumes were estimated, and that he could not confirm the arms-sales claim, noting the Troika monitors defence spending.
The Troika closely monitors all expenditure by Greece, including expenditure in the field of defence.
De Trojka houdt nauw toezicht op alle uitgaven door Griekenland, inclusief de uitgaven op het terrein van defensie.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Turkse bombardementen in Noord-Irak (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in northern Iraq, including civilian deaths, damage to infrastructure, Iranian involvement, and whether the attacks violate international law and should be stopped. The minister answers that the strikes respond to PKK attacks, that civilian deaths are reported in media, that the attacks may invoke self-defence if proportionate, and that the government will keep raising the Kurdish question with Turkey.
I cannot yet confirm any damage to Iraqi infrastructure.
Eventuele beschadiging van de Iraakse infrastructuur kan ik vooralsnog niet bevestigen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van 850 000 euro

MPs from several parties asked why the 850,000 euro promised in 2009 for Balongsari (Rawagede) has not been fully disbursed, how much went via Hivos and an agreement with Indonesia's Interior Ministry, and whether the funds will be released quickly. The ministers explained a 250,000 euro microcredit project run by Hivos is operating, the school/market/health project is delayed in Indonesian administrative procedures, and funds will be transferred once preparations are complete, with Dutch monitoring.
Embassy funds can only be transferred to the Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs once the aforementioned preparations are completed.
Fondsen van de ambassade kunnen pas naar het Indonesische ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken worden overgemaakt als eerdergenoemde voorbereidingen afgerond zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Palestijnse kinderen in gevangenschap (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's detention and interrogation of Palestinian children in the West Bank breaches international law, including the Fourth Geneva Convention and the anti-torture convention, and whether the Netherlands will press Israel to reform juvenile military courts, repeal Military Order 1651, and address mistreatment. The minister disagreed that detention of minors is inherently unlawful, noted improvements such as trained juvenile judges and separate detention for under-16s, declined to call for repealing Order 1651, and said the matter belongs in Israel's own courts and EU dialogue.
Objections to non-compliance with national or international legal obligations can be raised before the national court.
Tegen niet nakomen van nationaal- of internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen kan bezwaar worden gemaakt bij de nationale rechter.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Hachchi (D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Israëlische antiboycotwet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).
