Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli anti-boycott bill, which would make calling for boycotts a civil wrong and allow damages without proof of harm, conflicts with freedom of expression and whether it shields settlements. The minister said the law may conflict with freedom of expression, that the Israeli Supreme Court is reviewing it, that settlements are contrary to international law, and that the Dutch government opposes boycott calls in this context while noting Israel's democratic debate.
I am not anticipating the judgment of the Court.
Ik loop niet op het oordeel van het Hof vooruit.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over inzet politie Kunduz in de bestrijding van de Taliban (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Van Bommel (SP) asks whether Afghan police in Kunduz may now conduct offensive operations against the Taliban rather than only self-defence, whether this breaches the mandate agreed with parliament, and about a firefight and a related operation. The ministers answer that the police strategy does not provide for offensive military action, that the police may act in self-defence, that the government obtained reaffirmed assurances from Afghan officials, and that Dutch soldiers were not involved in the firefight.
The strategy does not provide for the deployment of the AUP for offensive military actions.
De strategie voorziet niet in de inzet van de AUP voor offensieve militaire acties.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de politieke situatie in Syrië en in het bijzonder de situatie van politieke gevangenen (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the political situation in Syria and the detention of political prisoners, including hunger strikers, and whether the government would demand their release. The minister said political freedoms are not in sight, condemned the violent crackdown, and noted the EU and Foreign Affairs Council have repeatedly called for release of all political prisoners.
The embassy has tried to obtain information on this matter but has not yet succeeded.
De ambassade heeft getracht informatie te achterhalen over deze kwestie maar is daarin nog niet geslaagd.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister-president en de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de website www.crisis.nl (ingezonden 27 juli 2011).

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister and ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about the cost, failures, and planned replacement of the government crisis website www.crisis.nl. The minister answers that the first three years cost about 373,000 euro and later years about 615,000 euro, describes a QuickScan-based fix, and says the new site's costs are not yet known.
The costs of the new crisis.nl are not yet known.
De kosten van het nieuwe crisis.nl zijn nog niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de humanitaire ramp in de Hoorn van Afrika (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the famine in the Horn of Africa, including the funding gap, whether the Netherlands will give additional emergency aid, and whether it will match donations via Giro 555. The government confirms the scale of the crisis, reports about 400 million of 1.4 billion dollars received and a remaining gap of over 1 billion, says it does not rule out extra funding while considering requests, and points to 240 million of the 250 million euro emergency budget already spent.
I do not rule out that an additional contribution will be given and I am currently considering the requests that have been received.
Ik sluit niet uit dat een extra bijdrage gegeven zal worden en ik beraad mij momenteel op de verzoeken die zijn binnengekomen.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks), Timmermans (PvdA) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Wetsvoorstel om schade aan de Staat Israël te voorkomen als gevolg van boycot (ingezonden 18 m

MPs Peters, Timmermans and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli anti-boycott bill, including its territorial reach, civil-wrong liability, its possible link to protecting settlements, and its effect on free expression. The minister replied that the law adopted in July differs from earlier drafts and referred to answers given to other MPs' questions on the adopted law.
The bill was adopted by the Israeli parliament on 11 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 11 juli jongstleden in het Israëlische parlement aangenomen.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Hoornaar vast in kliniek Israël» (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Bommel and Bouwmeester asked the foreign minister what the government had done for a Dutch national held in an Israeli psychiatric clinic, whether he could be repatriated, and how Dutch citizens abroad needing acute psychiatric care are handled. The minister answered that the embassy had visited, facilitated family contact and liaised with doctors, that the insurer's alarm centre had taken over the case, and that repatriation and aftercare decisions rest with the treating doctors and alarm centre.
However, it is for the treating doctors in the Netherlands and Israel, in consultation with the alarm centre, to assess whether and when the person can be repatriated.
Het is echter aan de behandelend artsen in Nederland en Israël, in overleg met de alarmcentrale, om te beoordelen of en wanneer betrokkene gerepatrieerd kan worden.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Van Bommel (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de eigenstandige positie van Taiwan (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

Four MPs asked the foreign minister how the EU, US and China stance on Taiwan's international standing is changing and what Dutch support for Taiwan's participation in international bodies would look like. The minister answered that the policies of the US, EU and member states have not changed, that Dutch policy follows the one-China principle, and that Taiwan's membership of international organisations is supported only where all parties agree.
The Netherlands and the other EU member states recognise the government in Beijing as the lawful government of China (one China policy).
Nederland en de andere lidstaten van de EU erkennen de regering in Peking als wettige regering van China (één China beleid).
Vragen van de leden Timmermans (PvdA) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ontvoering in Libanon van Amsterdammer Priit Raistik (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the March 2011 kidnapping in Lebanon of Priit Raistik, an Amsterdam resident, and what the Netherlands was doing to locate and free him and his companions. The minister answered that the seven Estonians were freed on 14 July through cooperation between Estonia, Lebanon and other partners, and that Dutch embassies had been in contact with Estonian authorities throughout and offered all available means.
The seven Estonian nationals were freed on the morning of 14 July as a result of cooperation between Estonia, Lebanon and other partners.
De zeven Estse staatsburgers zijn in de ochtend van 14 juli bevrijd als gevolg van samenwerking tussen Estland, Libanon en andere partners.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitsluiting verkozen parlementsleden in Turkije (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

MP Van Bommel asks whether the exclusion of elected independent Hatip Dicle and of jailed CHP deputies Balbay and Haberal from Turkish parliament violates democratic rights, whether the Turkish government arbitrarily excludes elected deputies, and whether a pattern of arrests of journalists, candidates and mayors exists. Minister Rosenthal answers that candidate eligibility is for the Turkish electoral board and courts, that exclusion conflicts with the Copenhagen criteria, that the Netherlands has raised these concerns bilaterally and through the EU, and that the arrests are a negative development being closely monitored.
The Cabinet has previously shared this message with the Turkish government and continues to do so in bilateral contacts.
Het Kabinet heeft deze boodschap eerder met de Turkse regering gedeeld en blijft dit in bilaterale contacten doen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bouw door een Nederlandse werf van tankland

Two SP MPs asked whether a Dutch-linked shipyard in Cuba (DAMEX, a joint venture with Damen Shipyards) builds tank-landing-type ships for the Venezuelan navy with possible military use, and whether Dutch arms export policy applies. The state secretary answered that the ships are unarmed RoRo cargo vessels not classified as military, that the joint venture falls under Cuban law and outside Dutch arms export policy, and that the government shares concern only about military deliveries that threaten regional stability, which it does not see here.
These ships do not fall under Dutch arms export policy.
Deze schepen vallen niet onder het Nederlandse wapenexportbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over zijn deelname aan de Bilderbergconferentie 2011 (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about his attendance at the 2011 Bilderberg conference, including who invited him, who paid, whether he promised secrecy, and whether he missed a cabinet meeting on Libya. The minister confirmed attendance as Foreign Minister, said the state paid costs, referred to Chatham House rules, and said a deputy represented him at the Libya cabinet decision.
By taking part I accepted that.
Door deel te nemen heb ik dat aanvaard.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Defensie over NAVO-trainers in Afghanistan (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether at least 36 NATO trainers in Afghanistan were killed by recruits or impostors since 2009, how infiltration of the Dutch police training mission will be prevented, whether the security situation has worsened, and whether a new assessment will occur before deployment to Kunduz. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, described recruitment controls and monitoring, said the security situation fits earlier reporting, and stated no new decision point is needed now beyond the existing condition for reviewing the contribution if a serious structural deterioration occurs.
Reliable figures on this are not available.
Betrouwbare cijfers hierover zijn niet voorhanden.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over investeringen van Shell in Syrië (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil and gas investments in Syria, including its role in the sector, possible use of fuel by security forces, EU sanctions compliance, and whether Dutch firms should halt production. The government answer (Rosenthal, on behalf of the ministers) addresses these points, which are primarily about corporate conduct and sanctions rather than a check on executive power.
These questions were answered in a letter dated 4 July 2011 (Parliamentary paper 32 734, no. 12).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 4 juli 2011 (Kamerstuk 32 734, nr. 12 ).
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse zaken over een schadeclaim (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about a damages claim of at least five million euro by a former MIVD informant in Uruzgan, including alleged Taliban contacts, weapons orders, a prevented attack, the death of a mullah and the suspension of MIVD staff. The minister replied that operational matters of the MIVD cannot be discussed publicly and offered a confidential briefing to the IVD committee, and that information from protected sources cannot be disclosed.
No public statements can be made about the operational matters of the MIVD. If requested, the IVD committee of your House can be informed.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over operationele aangelegenheden van de MIVD. Desgevraagd kan de commissie IVD van uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over recente arrestaties in Irak (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the Netherlands will protest to Iraqi authorities over the arrests of young political activists, and whether it will raise individual cases and Amnesty International's recommendations. The minister answers that the Netherlands will keep urging Iraq to respect human rights, will raise concerns and specific cases with Iraqi foreign minister Zebari at the next meeting, and will point to Amnesty's report while noting that follow-up is for the government itself.
At a next conversation between the Dutch ambassador and minister Zebari he will express his concern about reports of human rights violations including torture
Bij een volgend gesprek van de Nederlandse ambassadeur met minister Zebari zal hij zijn zorg uitspreken over berichten over mensenrechtenschendingen inclusief marteling
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een geheime CIA-gevangenis in Polen (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Polish authorities are obstructing an investigation into alleged CIA torture on Polish soil, and whether the Dutch government still rejects transfers of terrorism suspects without legal safeguards and secret detention centres. The minister denied obstruction, noting the Polish prosecutor's independent investigation, confirmed the Dutch rejection of such practices, and agreed the investigation should be completed.
The Polish government refrains from any intervention in this ongoing investigation and therefore makes no statements about it.
De Poolse regering onthoudt zich van enige interventie in dit lopende onderzoek en doet daarover dan ook geen mededelingen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Van Bommel (SP) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bewering dat in Afghanistan producten met kinder- en slavenarbeid worde

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether NATO/ISAF-funded construction in Afghanistan uses bricks made with child and slave labour, and what NATO and the Afghan government are doing about it. The government answered that NATO screens contractors on child labour, that direct contractors can reasonably be assumed to use no child or slave labour though firm guarantees are impossible given security, that an ILO study is planned, and that a contract clause on child labour is used in Kunduz.
However, firm guarantees cannot be given given the security situation and the resulting limited possibilities for control.
Harde garanties zijn gezien de veiligheidssituatie en de daardoor beschikbare mogelijkheden tot controle echter niet te geven.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitsluiting kandidaten algemene verkiezingen in Turkije op 12 juni 2011 (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the exclusion of 12 candidates, including Leyla Zana and non-Kurdish candidates, from Turkey's June 2011 general election breaches OSCE standards, whether this hinders democratisation, the status of EU accession chapters 23 and 24, and whether Turkey should be pressed to readmit the candidates or postpone the election. The minister answered that exclusion violates OSCE and Copenhagen norms, that seven of the twelve were later admitted, that individual candidacy is for the Turkish electoral board, and that the Netherlands will raise election concerns bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands will, where necessary, raise concerns about the elections in Turkey bilaterally and in multilateral settings.
Nederland zal zorgen over de verkiezingen in Turkije zonodig bilateraal en in multilateraal verband aan de orde stellen.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de inzet Nederlandse militairen in Sahel-landen (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

SP MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch participation in the Flintlock exercises in the Sahel, linked to US counter-terrorism operations, was disclosed to parliament, why no artikel 100 procedure was used, and whether the operation militarises Sahel problems. The minister answered that Flintlock is a training exercise, not an operation, that parliament is not informed of such exercises, and that the programme does not militarise the region's political problems.
Since the Dutch military deployment concerns an exercise, the House of Representatives is not informed about it.
Aangezien de Nederlandse militaire inzet betrekking heeft op een oefening wordt de Kamer daarover niet geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over geweld in Tibet (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about Chinese police operations near the Kirti monastery in Tibet, reports of mass detentions, a 'legal education' campaign, and the health of imprisoned Jigme Gyatso, and whether the Netherlands would press Beijing directly. The minister said the Netherlands lacked independent information due to travel restrictions, that the EU had raised concerns and called for access, that the Netherlands raised human rights concerns in contacts, and that the EU had asked for Gyatso's release on health grounds.
Since travel restrictions apply to foreigners in the area around the Kirti monastery, I do not have factual information from my own sources.
Aangezien in de omgeving van het Kirti klooster reisbeperkingen gelden voor buitenlanders, beschik ik niet over feitelijke informatie uit eigen bronnen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vermissing van een Nederlander in Egypte (ingezonden 16 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the long-term detention of Dutch-Egyptian Hisham Diab after his 2004 release date, and about reports of prisoners being shot in Egyptian prisons, asking for pressure and accountability. The minister replied that the embassy had repeatedly raised his case, that Diab was reportedly released in 2011 and confirmed free, and that the Netherlands supports prosecution of those responsible for violence during the unrest, but gave no new commitment on the shooting reports.
The Netherlands has, both within the EU and in bilateral contacts with the Egyptian authorities, advocated prosecution of those who committed violence during the recent unrest in Egypt.

Nederland heeft zowel in EU-verband als in bilaterale contacten met de Egyptische autoriteiten gepleit voor berechting van hen die zich schuldig hebben gemaakt aan het gebruik van geweld tijdens recente onlusten in Egypte.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanval op kamp Ashraf in Irak (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about the Iraqi army's April 2011 assault on Camp Ashraf, including reported deaths, use of live fire and vehicles, and whether the government would demand release of detainees, avoid their extradition to Iran, and support an independent inquiry. The minister said the Iraqi authorities cited the camp's illegal expansion and terrorism grounds, that independent facts are lacking, that the action violated humanitarian standards, that detainees were released and the Iraqi government pledged no return to Iran, and that Nederland supports an independent investigation and prosecution by Iraqi authorities.
I support the call by the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Pillay for an independent international investigation.
Ik steun de oproep van de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten van de Verenigde Naties Pillay tot een internationaal onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) Van Bommel (SP) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een aanslag op koptische christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether authorities had failed to arrest and prosecute the perpetrators of a killing of Coptic Christians in Egypt, and about the role of the Muslim Brotherhood and their stance toward it. The minister answered that the killing stemmed from a family feud with the perpetrators arrested, and that the government will judge all parties, including the Muslim Brotherhood, against democratic and rule-of-law principles.
Both the Netherlands and the EU call for Egypt's transition to a full democratic constitutional state.
Nederland als de EU pleit voor een transitie van Egypte naar een volwaardige democratische rechtsstaat.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) en Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse zaken en van Defensie over eventueel gebruik van munitie met verarmd uranium en clust

MPs from SP and PvdA asked the Foreign and Defence ministers how Dutch support for UN resolution 65/55 on depleted uranium translates into action, whether a moratorium is considered, whether the US, UK, Israel and Russia will be asked to release strike coordinates, whether depleted uranium or cluster munitions were used in Libya, and whether non-signatories will be urged to stop using cluster munitions. The government answered that it supports further health research and protective guidelines but sees no basis for a moratorium, will not repeat the request for coordinates, found no confirmed US depleted uranium use in Libya and uses none itself, and will urge non-signatories to join the cluster munitions convention.
The government takes note of such research with interest and appreciates the efforts undertaken in this area by international organisations and research institutions.
De regering neemt met belangstelling kennis van dergelijk onderzoek en waardeert de inspanningen die op dit gebied door internationale organisaties en onderzoeksinstellingen worden verricht.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederlands mensenrechtenbeleid (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister what was meant by reducing the number of resolutions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and by refraining from a one-sided approach in a UN Human Rights Council speech. The minister answered that the Netherlands considers the number and tone of such resolutions unhelpful, proposed streamlining six Council resolutions, and said Dutch policy is balanced rather than one-sided.

The government has repeatedly stated that both the number of resolutions in the UN Human Rights Council and the General Assembly on the Middle East situation, and their tone, do not contribute to a climate conducive to international law.

De regering heeft meermaals te kennen gegeven dat zowel het aantal resoluties in VN-Mensenrechtenraad (MRR) en in de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (AVVN) over de situatie in het Midden-Oosten als de toonzetting daarvan niet bijdraagt aan een klimaat dat bevorderlijk is voor het internationaal recht.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse belangen van Kadhafi (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about Gaddafi-linked Libyan investments in the Netherlands, asset freezes, conservatory seizure, and EU sanctions. The government said it does not register foreign shareholdings, described the EU asset freezes and their effects on Dutch firms, saw no short-term route to conservatory seizure, and said EU-level freezing without a request from another state is possible but should be done collectively.
The government does not register which foreign persons or entities invest in Dutch companies.
De overheid registreert niet welke buitenlandse personen/entiteiten investeren in Nederlandse bedrijven.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over persvrijheid in Turkije (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of journalists in Turkey, including Ahmet Sik and Nedim Sener, violate press freedom, whether 68 journalists are jailed, whether the EU candidate status is consistent with these arrests, and whether Turkey should be pressed on democratisation and on Fethullah Gülen's role. The minister replied that the arrests fall within the Ergenekon investigation, that the Netherlands monitors the cases together with the EU and insists on fair trials, that Turkey's restrictions on media and prosecutions under other penal articles are a concern, and that the government raises these issues bilaterally and through the EU.
The Cabinet does not comment on individual charges.
Het Kabinet gaat niet in op individuele tenlasteleggingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestaties in Irak (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

MP Van Bommel asks the foreign minister whether at least ten people were arrested after a March 2011 Baghdad protest, whether the government shares Amnesty's fear of torture, and whether it will press Iraq to release them, investigate, and reform. The minister says dozens of arrests occurred but could not be confirmed, that torture is widespread in Iraqi prisons, and that the Netherlands has raised human rights concerns bilaterally and through the EU and UN without committing to specific release demands.
The Dutch government will continue to hold Iraq to account for its responsibilities regarding guaranteeing human rights and will also call for the release of wrongfully detained protesters.

De Nederlandse regering zal Irak blijven aanspreken op zijn verantwoordelijkheden inzake het waarborgen van de mensenrechten en zal daarbij ook pleiten voor het vrijlaten van ten onrechte vastgezette demonstranten.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechtensituatie van de Oeigoerse bevolkingsgroep in China (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the human rights situation of the Uyghurs in China will be raised at the March 2011 UN Human Rights Council session, how, and which of the World Uyghur Congress's ten requests the government will pursue. The minister replies that the EU, partly on Dutch initiative, raised minority rights, the death penalty, freedom of expression and torture in its statement, and that the points match Dutch human rights policy.

On 14 March the EU, partly on Dutch initiative, called on China in its statement during the Human Rights Council session to respect the rights of ethnic and religious minorities such as the Uyghurs and Tibetans.

De EU heeft op 14 maart jl. tijdens de zitting van de Mensenrechtenraad, mede op initiatief van Nederland, in haar verklaring China opgeroepen de rechten van etnische en religieuze minderheden, zoals de Oeigoeren en de Tibetanen, te respecteren.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over Nederlandse belangen in Wit-Rusland (ingezonden 21 febr

Two SP MPs asked ministers about Dutch economic and financial interests in Belarus, including ABN AMRO and Gazprom deals, Dutch imports of Belarusian-origin oil and gas, and Dutch support for the Lukashenko regime. The government answered that it has no insight into the commercial activities of the companies concerned, that the state played no role in those projects, and that the EU has tightened sanctions on the regime.
The cabinet has no insight into the commercial activities of the Belarussian Oil Company, Gazprom or Shell in the countries mentioned.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de commerciële activiteiten van de Belarussian Oil Company, Gazprom of Shell in de genoemde landen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over doodstraffen voor Oeigoeren in China (ingezonden 28 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Chinese Supreme Court's approval of death sentences for four Uyghurs was known, whether the trials were open and fair, and whether China will be pressed to stop executions. The minister confirms the approvals, says reliable information on the trials is hard to obtain, notes EU concern, and restates that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and will keep urging abolition or a moratorium.
There is no good overview of the status of the proceedings against persons held in connection with the July 2009 disturbances in Xinjiang.
Er bestaat geen goed overzicht van de stand van zaken van de processen tegen personen die worden vastgehouden in verband met de ongeregeldheden in juli 2009 in Xinjiang.
Vragen van de lid Tony van Dijck (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over Marokkaanse banken (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Moroccan banks entering the Dutch market would be fully supervised by DNB, whether they should be excluded from the deposit guarantee scheme, and whether their Islamic banking products hinder integration. The minister replied that EEA branches fall under home-country prudential supervision and are not covered by the Dutch DGS, and referred the integration question to the Interior Minister.
This means that EEA banks can, among other things, open branches in other EEA member states without applying for a new banking licence in the host member state.
Dat betekent dat EER-banken onder andere bijkantoren kunnen openen in andere EER-lidstaten zonder in de «lidstaat van ontvangst» een nieuwe bankvergunning aan te vragen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP) en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over wapenuitvoer naar Noord-Afrika en het Mid

MPs Van Bommel and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms exports to Libya occurred in 2008-2009, why the 2004 EU arms embargo was lifted, whether export criteria and embargoes should be tightened for Arab states, and whether Dutch firms should be discouraged from exhibiting at IDEX 2011. The minister answered that some licences (helicopter parts swap, night-vision devices) were granted but not actually executed, that the UN and EU imposed an embargo on Libya, and that new export applications to Bahrain, Yemen, Tunisia and Egypt are on hold.
For Libya, Syria and Iran, no arms export licences are being issued.
Voor Libië, Syrië en Iran geldt dat geen wapenexportvergunningen worden afgegeven.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Iran: Christians imprisoned without charge» (ingezonden 1

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether four Christians held in Iran without charge, including a Dutch-Iranian dual national, could be helped through consular and legal assistance and whether the government would inform parliament. The minister answered that the embassy had not obtained formal confirmation from Iranian authorities, that Iran refuses consular access to dual nationals, and that Nederland has raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU while promising to keep parliament informed.
I will keep the House regularly informed of developments.
Ik zal de Kamer met regelmaat op de hoogte houden van ontwikkelingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een exportbeperking van middelen die in de Verenigde Staten (VS) worden gebruikt bij het uit

An SP MP asked the ministers about a shortage of sodium thiopental used in US executions, Italian and UK export restrictions, and whether the Netherlands would guarantee no exports for capital punishment and advocate an EU export ban. The state secretary answered that the Dutch Hospira subsidiary does not produce or export the drug, and that the Netherlands will push for an EU export licensing requirement, with a national licence as fallback, rather than a全 outright ban because the drug is medically important.
If the introduction of a licensing requirement at European level cannot be realised, I will introduce a national licensing requirement for exports.
Indien de invoering van een vergunningplicht op Europees niveau niet gerealiseerd kan worden zal ik nationaal een vergunningplicht voor uitvoer introduceren.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over wapenhandel naar Egypte (ingezonden 15 februar

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch arms exports to Egypt, including whether licences were granted for armoured vehicle parts, whether France and Germany suspended exports, whether YPR vehicles were used against protesters, and whether pending licences would be refused. The government confirmed a 2009 licence of about 1.2 million for YPR and M-113 parts, said it does not monitor end-use of goods delivered to foreign governments, and stated that one new licence was issued in 2011 with its export temporarily postponed at the company's request while remaining applications will be assessed case by case.
It is not usual to monitor goods supplied to another government.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om toezicht te houden op aan een andere overheid geleverde goederen.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over het verband tussen de Amerikaanse aanval op Falluja in 2004 en geboorteafwijkingen in die stad (ingezonden 11 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about a reported 15% rise in severe birth defects in Fallujah since 2003, possibly linked to US munitions, and asked whether Iraqi authorities should be pressed, US military data shared, and further Dutch research commissioned, plus the status of an Iraqi human rights commission study and US accession to certain protocols. The government replied that the research does not establish a health link, saw no reason to press Iraq or the US or commission new research, said it had repeatedly sought the Iraqi study results without success, and noted that Netherlands itself is party to the relevant protocols and will encourage others to join.
The Netherlands continues to press for the results of this study by a committee of the Ministry of Human Rights to be made public.
Nederland blijft aandringen op het bekendstellen van de resultaten van dit onderzoek door een commissie van het Ministerie van Mensenrechten.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de onderschepping van twee Russische vliegtuigen (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether they still hold that Russian bombers should report before entering internationally controlled airspace, what was done since an earlier similar incident, and whether the Russian ambassador will be summoned. The Defence minister confirmed the position, said the flights are not considered provocations, and said the Netherlands will raise flight-safety concerns bilaterally and within NATO.

The Netherlands will make its position on flight-safety aspects of military use of parts of international airspace where air traffic control is provided known in bilateral and allied contact with the Russian Federation.

Nederland zal zijn standpunt over vliegveiligheids aspecten bij het militair gebruik van delen van het internationale luchtruim waarbinnen luchtverkeersleiding wordt verzorgd kenbaar maken in bilateraal en bondgenootschappelijk contact met de Russische Federatie.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over sociale protesten in Egypte (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about violent suppression of peaceful protests in Egypt, including casualty and arrest figures, demanding release of peaceful demonstrators, and whether EU-Egypt economic ties should be suspended absent human rights improvement. The minister reported that exact figures are unknown (over 300 dead, 700 arrested reported), supported calling for releases in the EU Council, and said reforms should shape the form and extent of EU support.
At the Foreign Affairs Council of 31 January I therefore argued that the EU should call on the Egyptian authorities to do so.
Ik heb er tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken, van 31 januari jl. dan ook voor gepleit, dat de EU de Egyptische autoriteiten hiertoe oproept.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Breda EU-subsidie wil voor achterstandswijken (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

MP Van Bommel asked the state secretary whether Breda's EU subsidy bid for youth nuisance and deprived-area projects is appropriate, given that such matters are primarily national and that co-financing and exchange-based cooperation may be weak. The state secretary acknowledged the bid, stated that the projects involve real co-financing and that strict Interreg criteria apply, and said the Netherlands opposes spreading EU cohesion money thinly, while keeping a role for cross-border projects.
The Netherlands is against spreading money around.
Nederland is tegen het rondpompen van geld.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over buitenlands beleid dat is afgestemd op Shell (ingezonden 25 januari 20

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch foreign policy on Iran sanctions was shaped to protect Shell, whether Shell deserved preferential treatment over other Dutch firms, and whether a Foreign Affairs secondment to Shell created conflicts of interest. The ministers replied that the leaked US cables are the US's responsibility, that the Netherlands backs strict EU sanctions, that the secondment serves sector knowledge, and that government economic diplomacy serves Dutch business as a whole.
Where the interests of Dutch companies are disproportionately affected by this, we will stand up for them.
Wanneer belangen van Nederlandse bedrijven hierdoor onevenredig geraakt worden, zullen wij hiervoor opkomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bomaanslag op Kopten in Alexandrië (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the root causes of religious intolerance in Egypt, whether the EU-Egypt Association Agreement can address them, and whether undemocratic practice fuels tensions. The minister identified discriminatory rules on places of worship and weak state protection of minorities as root causes, said more progress is needed, and committed to raising the issue at the EU Foreign Affairs Council and in the upcoming EU action plan review.
Indeed, more progress should be made in removing the underlying root causes of religious intolerance in the Middle East.
Inderdaad zouden er meer vorderingen moeten worden gemaakt bij het wegnemen van de achterliggende oorzaken («root causes») van religieuze intolerantie in het Midden-Oosten.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een massaproces tegen Turks-Koerdische politici (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about a mass trial in Diyarbakir of 74 elected Kurdish mayors and council members and over 1,900 activists charged with membership of the KCK, and whether it is political and contrary to the Copenhagen criteria. The minister answers that the trial must be judged on its merits, that the Dutch embassy attended the first day, and that the Netherlands will raise rights violations bilaterally and in the EU if they occur, without committing to specific action now.
It will have to become clear whether there is a political process.
Het zal moeten blijken of sprake is van een politiek proces.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gewelddadigheden Gaza (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the minister would press for stronger diplomatic intervention to prevent escalation of violence around Gaza, including whether the US and EU should act more forcefully. The minister acknowledged the escalation, said the conflict receives continuous diplomatic attention with the US leading the process, and stated there was currently no reason for the Netherlands to take further steps since all parties know the Dutch and European position.
I see no reason to do so at this time, since all parties are aware of the European and Dutch position that the use of violence must end.
Hiertoe zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding, aangezien alle partijen bekend zijn met het Europese en Nederlandse standpunt dat geweldsgebruik moet worden beëindigd.

Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie naar de rapporten van Van den Bergh en de Commissie van To

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked whether British forces tortured detainees handed over by Dutch troops in Iraq and whether the Public Prosecution Service investigated the Van den Bergh and CTIVD reports. The government answered that Dutch responsibility passed to the receiving party, found no indication the detainees were tortured, and reported that the prosecution service concluded no prosecutable offences existed and saw no reason for further investigation.
Based on the results of this investigation, the prosecution service in Arnhem concluded that there is no possible prosecutable criminal offence.
Op basis van de resultaten van dit onderzoek heeft het OM te Arnhem geconcludeerd dat geen sprake is van mogelijke vervolgbare strafbare feiten.

Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de inzet van de Hare Majesteit (Hr Ms) Amsterdam voor de kust van Ivoorkust (ingezonden 23 december 2010)

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the legal basis, mandate, rules of engagement and tasks of the frigate Hr Ms Amsterdam deployed off Ivory Coast for possible evacuation of EU citizens. The government answered that the deployment is a bilateral logistics support request from France under national command, not a UN or EU operation, with no territorial entry planned and no article 100 procedure needed.
As far as is known, only the Netherlands has been asked to provide support.
Voor zover bekend is alleen Nederland gevraagd om ondersteuning te verlenen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Defensie over gezondheidsklachten militair personeel in Uruzgan (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister whether health complaints among soldiers in Uruzgan were linked to emissions from waste incinerators at Kamp Holland, and whether investigations would be shared. The minister answered that studies found only occasional elevated pollutant levels and no likely lasting health damage, promising to inform the House after measurements in Afghanistan are completed.
After the completion of the measurements in Afghanistan, I will inform the House about the Dutch research and the results of British and American studies.
Na de voltooiing van de metingen in Afghanistan zal ik de Kamer informeren over het Nederlandse onderzoek en de resultaten van Britse en Amerikaanse onderzoeken.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het wijzigen van gegevens in de gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a person's birth date recorded as XX-XX-1992 in the municipal population register and passport can be corrected, and why fictitious dates are not used. The minister confirmed about 77,000 people lack a full birth date, explained that correction requires reliable source documents and that partial dates are permitted by regulation, and said a solution for foreigners is being studied.
Against a decision by the college not to record a data item in the GBA, the citizen concerned can lodge an objection or appeal under the General Administrative Law Act.
Tegen een besluit van het college om een gegeven niet op te nemen in de GBA kan door de betrokken burger bezwaar c.q. beroep worden aangetekend op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gedragsregels voor voormalige EU-commissarissen (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether former EU commissioners Ferrero-Waldner and Verheugen moved into lobbying or related activities in breach of EU post-mandate ethics rules, whether confidential information is protected, and whether the rules should be tightened and the transition allowance reduced. The state secretary answered that the Commission itself judged the activities compatible with the Treaty, that supervision is primarily the Commission's responsibility, that lobbying is not banned per se, and that the allowance is substantial but Dutch pressure on EU administrative costs continues.
The cabinet considers supervision of compliance with this rule to be primarily a responsibility of the Commission itself.
Toezicht op de naleving van deze regel vindt het kabinet in eerste instantie een verantwoordelijkheid van de Commissie zelf.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over gevechten in Uruzgan in september en oktober 2007 (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government had known about and disclosed a large 1 October 2007 battle near Deh Rawod reported by Wikileaks with 60 Taliban dead, and why the Chamber was not informed, plus details of Dutch units involved. The minister confirmed the battle, said the 60 figure was an unconfirmed early estimate, declined tactical details for security reasons, and defended Defence's communication and transparency policy.
Tactical details of combat operations are not made public for operational and security reasons.
Tactische details over gevechtsoperaties worden uit operationele- en veiligheidsoverwegingen niet openbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over een subsidieaanvraag van ABN Amro bij het Europees Globaliseringsfonds (EGF) (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance whether ABN AMRO's application to the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for retraining 1,350 dismissed workers should be refused, given that the state is sole shareholder and the restructuring stems from the Fortis integration rather than the crisis, and whether the state had been informed. The minister replied that the application is lawful under the EGF rules, that the company co-finances EUR 2.78 million itself, that the restructuring was caused by the financial crisis, and that the state as shareholder does not interfere in operations, while he was informed as subsidy applicant rather than as shareholder.
On 5 October 2010 the Netherlands submitted an EGF application for ABN AMRO.
Op 5 oktober 2010 heeft Nederland een EGF aanvraag voor ABN AMRO ingediend.

Vragen van de leden Ormel (CDA), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (CU), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een ten dood veroordeling in Pakistan (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister about the death sentence imposed on Asia Bibi in Pakistan for blasphemy, whether it increases threats to Christians, how many others are detained on similar charges, where Pakistan's blasphemy and Hudud laws conflict with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister condemned the sentence, noted an appeal is possible, said blasphemy laws are misused and fall hardest on religious minorities, and reported that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly raised concerns with Pakistani authorities, including a planned joint letter to the prime minister.
The Netherlands has repeatedly expressed its concerns about the blasphemy legislation to the Pakistani authorities over the past year.
Nederland heeft in het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zijn zorgen over de blasfemiewetgeving aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten kenbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Koerdische zender Roj TV (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about Denmark's move to revoke Roj TV's broadcasting licence, frozen bank accounts, alleged Turkish pressure, and whether Dutch government would press Denmark and Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Danish case is a matter for Danish authorities and courts, Denmark acted independently with no Turkish pressure found, and the Netherlands will keep raising press freedom in Turkey bilaterally and through the EU.
It is not for the Dutch government to comment on the content of TV channels established in Denmark.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om de inhoud van in Denemarken gevestigde TV-zenders te becommentariëren.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een akkoord over de uitleg van de Toescheidingsovereenkomst (Ingezonden 15 oktober 2010)

MP Van Bommel asks whether the Suriname-Netherlands civil servant committee has agreed on interpreting the Toescheidingsovereenkomst, whether an interpretive declaration will be submitted to parliament, and how the Surinamese-Dutch community is involved. The minister replies that talks in January 2010 were inconclusive, no agreement at official level exists, any protocol will be sent to parliament for approval, and the community is kept informed via associations.
If a protocol is reached, it will, as usual, be sent to parliament for approval.
Indien het tot een protocol komt, dan zal dat zoals gebruikelijk voor goedkeuring aan het parlement worden toegezonden.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanval van de International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) in Pakistan (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

Van Bommel (SP) asked whether the ISAF strike in Pakistan on 25 September 2010 violated the ISAF mandate, how often cross-border attacks occur, and whether the Netherlands would urge an end to such strikes. The minister replied that the mandate permits only self-defence outside Afghanistan, that no mandate change is planned, that the NAVO investigation is pending, and that no Dutch units were involved.
After the incident of 25 September, the Netherlands requested clarification within NATO.
Nederland heeft na het incident van 25 september jl.in de NAVO om opheldering gevraagd.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks), Van Dam (PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over de mensenrechtensit

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked whether the human rights situation in Indonesia, including the Moluccas, is serious, and whether the Indonesian president's visit to the Netherlands would be used to raise it and be reported to parliament. The minister replied that human rights have improved but concerns remain, that the Netherlands raises them bilaterally and in the EU, and that the presidential visit did not take place, so the follow-up questions were not answered.
The Netherlands closely follows the human rights situation in Indonesia, both bilaterally and within the EU, and permanently raises the concerns with the Indonesian authorities.
Nederland volgt de mensenrechtensituatie in Indonesië nauwlettend, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband, en vraagt permanent aandacht voor de zorgpunten bij de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over dood Molukse activist (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

The SP MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about the death in custody of Molukan activist Yusuf Sipakoly, alleged torture by the Densus 88 unit, poor health of other political prisoners, and whether political prisoners should be released before the Indonesian president's visit. The minister responds that the circumstances are not known, that the official investigation should clarify them, that Nederland has raised prisoner health and free expression with Indonesian authorities, and declines to answer before the visit date.
The exact circumstances of his death are not known to me.
De exacte omstandigheden van zijn dood zijn mij niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de nettobijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese Unie (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

The SP MP Van Bommel asks whether the Netherlands is among the largest net EU contributors and whether a lower contribution would be compensated by new EU own resources such as European taxes. The minister confirms the Netherlands is among the top three net payers as a share of GNI, that alternative accounting puts it first, and that the government opposes EU taxes, favouring a GNI-based financing.
The cabinet argues that in the EU the strongest member states should bear the heaviest burdens.
Het kabinet pleit ervoor dat in de EU de sterkste lidstaten de zwaarste lasten dragen
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over vraag van Amerikaanse generaal om meer troepen naar Afghanistan te sturen (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

Opposition MP Van Bommel asks the Defence Minister whether US General Petraeus requested Dutch instructors for Afghanistan and whether that request was made in writing. The minister confirms the issue was raised during a visit, says the decision on future Dutch involvement rests with the incoming cabinet, and states the Netherlands is expected to contribute to training without a large-scale lead-nation role.
General Petraeus raised his request during the Minister of Defence's visit to Afghanistan, and the minister explained the government's position.
Generaal Petraeus stelde zijn vraag tijdens het bezoek van de Minister van Defensie aan Afghanistan en de minister heeft het regeringsstandpunt toegelicht.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over ontwikkelingen in Kashmir (ingezonden 8 september 2010).

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about unrest in Kashmir, alleged Indian rights abuses, UN observer interference, dialogue, independent investigation of complaints, Gilgit-Baltistan democracy and Chinese infrastructure involvement. The minister answered that the situation is noted, could not confirm UN interference, that the international community urges dialogue, that India should investigate abuses thoroughly, and that Pakistan's constitutional reforms have not given Gilgit-Baltistan federal representation.
I am aware of the recently increased unrest in Kashmir.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de recent toegenomen onrust in Kasjmir.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over beweringen dat Turkije chemische wapens heeft ingezet tegen Koerdische opstandelingen (ingezonden 17 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey used chemical weapons against Kurdish fighters, including a claimed Hamburg forensic finding and whether autopsy results are kept secret. The minister denied the forensic institute confirmed chemical weapons use, said autopsy reports are available to next of kin, and said there is no reason to believe Turkey possesses or used such weapons, promising to raise doubts under the Chemical Weapons Convention if information emerges.

Should information come to Netherlands' attention that raises doubts about Turkey's compliance with the Chemical Weapons Convention, clarification will be requested in accordance with the treaty's provisions.

Mocht aan Nederland informatie bekend worden die twijfel doet rijzen over naleving van het Chemische wapensverdrag door Turkije dan zal om opheldering worden gevraagd conform de bepalingen van het verdrag.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over kanker en kindersterfte in Fallujah (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the government accepts a University of Ulster study linking the 2004 assault on Fallujah to elevated child mortality, birth defects and cancer, and whether it will press the US for disclosure of weapons used and support a ban on depleted uranium weapons. The minister says the study does not establish that depleted uranium causes the health effects, that the government still supports further objective research, and that it sees no reason to change its position or seek a ban.
I see no reason to endorse the conclusions of the Busby et al report.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de conclusies van het rapport van Busby et al te onderschrijven.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanstaande voorstellen van eurocommissaris Lewandowski voor de invoering van Europese belastingen (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether the European Commission plans Europe-wide taxes following remarks by Commissioner Lewandowski, and whether the government will stop such proposals. The minister replied that no official Commission proposal exists yet, that taxation is a member-state competence limited by the treaties, and that the Netherlands opposes an EU tax and will keep stating this position.
Taxation is a sovereign competence of the member states of the European Union.
Belastingheffing is een soevereine bevoegdheid van de lidstaten van de Europese Unie.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over schending van het Venezolaanse luchtruim door een Nederlands vliegtuig (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister whether Venezuela complained about a Dutch aircraft violating its airspace, whether a defence spokesperson dismissed the complaint as nonsense, what the diplomatic response was, which Dutch aircraft operate near Venezuela, and whether US aircraft were involved. The minister answered that the complaint concerned the Maiquetiá flight information region rather than airspace, that the claim was rejected, that dialogue was agreed, and that the helicopter operated partly in international airspace.
Specifically regarding the FIR, technical consultations will be held in the short term to prevent misunderstandings in the future.
Specifiek ten aanzien van de FIR zal op korte termijn technisch overleg worden gevoerd om misverstanden in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestatie in Italië van Nederlander van Turks-Koerdische komaf (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Italy of a Dutch national of Turkish-Kurdish origin, whether the Italian authorities gave reasons, whether legal aid was offered, and his political role in Turkey and Europe. The minister answered that Italy acted on an Ankara arrest warrant, that consular rather than legal aid was provided with a consular visit, that the Dutch government does not interfere in foreign legal proceedings, and that Turkish Kurdish rights are raised bilaterally and within the EU.
The Dutch government does not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
De Nederlandse regering treedt niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het lot van politieke gevangenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Foreign and Interior ministers about political prisoners in Indonesia, including Human Rights Watch recommendations, release of non-violent activists, torture, police training and Densus 88. The minister answers that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue, will again urge amendment of the relevant articles, but gives no figures and leaves the US and Australia to decide on training.
The Indonesian authorities do not publish figures on this.
De Indonesische autoriteiten maken geen cijfers hierover bekend.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Amerikaans-Israëlische overeenkomsten over Israëls kernwapenambiguïteit (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew of US-Israeli agreements on Israel's nuclear ambiguity, whether Obama's endorsement of Israel's right to determine its own security needs conflicts with the NPT, and how a Middle East nuclear-weapon-free zone conference could succeed. The minister said he knew of the reports but not the agreements' contents, that Israel is not bound by the NPT, and that Netherlands will support regional confidence-building initiatives ahead of the 2012 conference.
I am not aware whether these agreements will be made public, nor am I familiar with their contents.
Mij is niet bekend of deze overeenkomsten openbaar gemaakt zullen worden, evenmin ben ik bekend met de inhoud ervan.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over nieuwe gevangenisstraf Israëlische atoomklokkenluider Mordechai Vanunu (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the foreign minister whether the government will support Nobel laureate Mairead Maguire's call for release of Israeli nuclear whistleblower Mordechai Vanunu, jailed for three months for speaking to foreign journalists, and whether it considers this a violation of free expression. The minister answers that the Netherlands trusts Israeli legal process, follows the case closely, and sees no reason to press the Israeli government for Vanunu's release.
I see no reason to press the Israeli government for the release of Mr Vanunu.
Ik zie geen reden bij de Israëlische regering aan te dringen op vrijlating van de heer Vanunu.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een salarisverhoging voor Keniaanse parlementsleden (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MPs Van Bommel and Irrgang asked the Foreign Minister whether Kenyan MPs had voted a 25% salary rise, whether this was excessive given Dutch aid to Kenya, and whether Dutch aid would continue. The minister confirmed the decision is not yet implemented, referred to a planned independent salary commission in the draft constitution, and said good governance programmes address accountability and the issue has been raised in EU political dialogue.

Moreover, civil society organisations in Kenya, supported by the Netherlands and other members of the international community, have long argued that setting MPs' salaries and emoluments is best done by an independent and broadly composed commission rather than by the interested parties themselves.

Overigens hebben maatschappelijke organisaties in Kenia, hierin gesteund door Nederland en andere leden van de internationale gemeenschap, al langer bepleit dat de vaststelling van de hoogte van salarissen en emolumenten voor parlementsleden het best gedaan kan worden door een onafhankelijke en breed samengestelde commissie, en niet door de belanghebbenden zelf.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het lot van Koerdische kinderen in gevangenissen in Turkije (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's anti-terror law still applies to children despite a promised exemption, and urged faster reform and EU attention to Kurdish minors' treatment. The minister confirmed the law still applies, said Turkey is expected to prioritise amending it, and stated the Netherlands will keep raising Kurdish minority rights bilaterally and via the EU.
Improving the social, economic, cultural and political rights of the Kurdish minority in Turkey is an important priority for the Dutch government.
Verbetering van de sociale, economische, culturele en politieke rechten van de Koerdische minderheid in Turkije is voor de Nederlandse regering een belangrijke prioriteit.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over uitlatingen van de voormalige minister van Buitenlandse Zaken De Hoop Scheffer over het onderzoek naar de steun aan de oorlo

Parliamentarian Van Bommel asks the Prime Minister whether the former foreign minister De Hoop Scheffer's call for a public inquiry into Dutch support for the Iraq war and for publication of his conversation with the Davids Commission is shared, and whether the interview records will be released. The Prime Minister answers that the commission was free to set its own method and chose a closed inquiry, and that the interview records will not be published to protect confidentiality promised to witnesses and their privacy.
I will not make the interview records public.
De gespreksverslagen maak ik niet openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het besluit van het Directoraat-Generaal voor Gezondheids- en Consumentenbescherming van de Europese Commissie om gedupeerde reizigers min

An SP MP asks the Minister of Transport whether the European Commission's health and consumer directorate was right to inform stranded passengers less prominently about their right to compensation from airlines, and whether the Netherlands will seek reversal. The minister points to existing information links and the airline duty under EU Regulation 261/2004, sees no reason to approach the Commission, and refers back to his answer on information provision.
I therefore see no reason at this time why the European Commission could be called to account on this.
Ik zie derhalve op dit moment geen reden dat de Europese Commissie hierop zou kunnen worden aangesproken.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een hulpgoederenkonvooi over zee naar Gaza (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Freedom Flotilla' sailing to Gaza with aid, Israel's announced blockade of it, the earlier Spirit of Humanity incident, and whether the government would press Israel to admit the flotilla. The answer, sent by letter on 1 June 2010, was a reference to a separate letter answering these questions, so the substance is not in this document.
These questions have been answered in a letter dated 1 June 2010.
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 1 juni 2010
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over executies van politieke gevangenen in Iran (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether five Kurds were executed in Evin prison on 9 May 2010, what they were charged with, whether their trials met fair-trial standards, whether families and lawyers were informed, and whether the government would seek clarification and protest. The minister confirmed the executions, said a full assessment of fair trial was not possible given closed proceedings, and reported that the ambassador and EU High Representative condemned them and called for a moratorium.
Because of the closed nature of these court cases, it is not possible to give a complete judgment on the extent to which the proceedings meet international standards for a fair trial.

Door het gesloten karakter van genoemde rechtszaken is het niet mogelijk een compleet oordeel te geven over de mate waarin de processen voldoen aan de internationale maatstaven voor een eerlijke procesgang.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gevangenisstraf voor een Turks-Koerdische politica (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about the cumulative prison sentence of Kurdish politician Leyla Zana in Turkey, including a sentence based on a 2007 Newroz speech, and whether the Netherlands will affirm free speech and send diplomatic representatives to Newroz celebrations. The minister confirms the facts, reaffirms that free expression including political speech is a fundamental right, notes Dutch advocacy with Turkey and the EU, and says the embassy follows the Kurdish issue closely and will raise EU participation at the Heads of Mission meeting.
Freedom of expression is a fundamental right and also includes political statements insofar as they do not incite hatred or violence.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting is een fundamenteel recht en omvat ook politieke uitspraken voor zover deze niet aanzetten tot haat of geweld.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over huidige nucleaire activiteiten van Iran o.a. naar aanleiding van een brief van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken d.d. 24 maart 2010 (ingezon

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about Iran's nuclear and missile activities, the IAEA Additional Protocol, enrichment levels, alleged weaponisation studies, US unilateral sanctions and the reliability of intelligence sources. Minister Verhagen answers that Iran's missile tests are publicly known, that enrichment figures indicate more efficient but fewer centrifuges, that the IAEA holds consistent information on alleged studies, and that he opposes extraterritorial unilateral sanctions while urging sanctions that spare the population.
For the rest, I refer you to the Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services.
Voor het overige verwijs ik u naar de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen en Veiligheidsdiensten.
qn: Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Armeense genocide (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the 1915 Armenian events constitute genocide under the 1948 Convention, why the government does not use that term, and whether its letter departs from the Rouvoet motion calling for recognition in EU talks with Turkey. The minister answered that the 1948 Convention does not apply retroactively, pointed to joint archive access and mixed commissions, and said recognition is not a Copenhagen criterion while continuing to press Turkey on free expression and the Zurich protocols.
To that end I will continue to use my contacts with my Turkish and Armenian counterparts.
Ik zal daartoe de contacten met mijn Turkse en Armeense counterparts blijven aanwenden.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over het opzetten van een sociaal netwerk door Europees Commissaris Kroes (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked ministers whether the EU Commission's social network 'Me & EU' launched by Commissioner Kroes was unclear about its origin, its costs, its distinctiveness from commercial networks, its fairness of competition, and its reach and evaluation plans. The questions were withdrawn ('ingetrokken') and therefore no answers were given.
These questions may be considered withdrawn and do not require an answer.
Deze vragen mogen als ingetrokken worden beschouwd en behoeven geen beantwoording.

m: Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over middelen voor het Klimaatfonds ten behoeve van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie
Amendment restores 118 million euro to the Klimaatfonds in the energy budget so the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie can reopen this winter, reversing the cabinet's planned withdrawal.
With this amendment this choice of the caretaker cabinet is reversed.
Met dit amendement wordt deze keuze van het demissionaire kabinet teruggedraaid.
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een apart tarief voor privévliegtuigen
Amendment adds a higher per-passenger flight tax rate from 2030 for private planes with 19 or fewer seats, by destination distance band.
With this amendment a separate rate in the flight tax is introduced for private aircraft.
Met dit amendement wordt een apart tarief in de vliegbelasting geïntroduceerd voor privévliegtuigen.
Amendement van de leden Stultiens en Kröger over een apart tarief voor privévliegtuigen
Amends the environmental tax on flights to introduce a separate, higher per-passenger rate for flights on aircraft with 19 or fewer seats from 2030.
With this amendment a separate rate in the aviation tax is introduced for private aircraft.
Met dit amendement wordt een apart tarief in de vliegbelasting geïntroduceerd voor privévliegtuigen.
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over middelen uit het Klimaatfonds alleen gebruiken voor het behalen van de reductiedoelen uit de Klimaatwet
Asks the government to use Climate Fund money only for measures that help meet the emission-reduction targets in the Climate Act, not for other budget purposes.
Requests the government, in budget decisions toward the Budget Memorandum, to use Climate Fund resources only for measures that contribute to the Climate Act reduction targets.

verzoekt de regering om in de besluitvorming richting de Miljoenennota middelen uit het Klimaatfonds alleen te gebruiken voor maatregelen die bijdragen aan het behalen van de reductiedoelen uit de Klimaatwet
Motie van het lid Kröger over het aandeel van de industrie in de energietransitie niet afwentelen op burgers en mkb
Asks the government not to shift the industry's share of the energy transition onto citizens and small businesses after negotiations are halted and the CO2 levy is suspended.
requests the government not to shift the industry's share of the energy transition onto citizens and small businesses
verzoekt de regering om het aandeel van de industrie in de energietransitie niet af te wentelen op burgers en het mkb
Amendement van het lid Kröger over middelen voor een op te richten regeling voor zonnepanelen op daken van woningbouwcorporaties
Adds 140 million euro to a budget article to fund a future subsidy scheme for solar panels on social housing roofs.
This amendment concerns a first deposit into a scheme to be established for solar panels on housing corporation roofs.
Dit amendement betreft een eerste storting in een op te richten regeling voor zonnepanelen op daken van woningbouwcorporaties.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 45 over de mogelijkheid voor infrastructuurbedrijven om actief te zijn op de warmtemarkt als zij niet zijn aangewezen als warmtebed
Amends the heat law so grid infrastructure companies that are not designated heat companies may act as heat service providers, with limits on contracts and group ties.
regulates that infrastructure companies, formerly network companies, may also become active on the heat market if they are not designated as heat companies
regelt dat infrastructuurbedrijven, voorheen netwerkbedrijven, ook actief mogen worden op de warmtemarkt als zij niet zijn aangewezen als warmtebedrijf
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 41 over een evaluatie met betrekking tot een heffing bij restwarmte
Amends the bill so the minister must report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the duties on residual heat producers.
within five years of this act entering into force the minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects
Onze Minister zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 108 over een evaluatie na vijf jaar met betrekking tot een heffing bij restwarmte
Adds a requirement that the minister report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness of the obligations for waste-heat producers, as an evaluation clause.
This amendment therefore provides an evaluation clause under which, within five years, it will be assessed whether the collection right in articles 6.1 and 6.2 of the act functions adequately.
Dit amendement regelt daarom een evaluatiebepaling op basis waarvan binnen vijf jaar geëvalueerd zal worden of het ophaalrecht uit de artikelen 6.1. en 6.2 van de wet afdoende functioneert.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 64 over inzage in de meetgegevens voor verbruiker
Gives consumers and their representatives direct access to heat meter data and cost-allocation calculations under the new heat law.
What is missing in articles 2.40 to 2.42 is the right of the consumer or their representative to have direct access to the metering data.
Wat ontbreekt in de artikelen 2.40 t/m 2.42 is het recht van de verbruiker of een gemachtigde daarvan om direct toegang te hebben tot de meetgegevens.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 67 over ondersteuning voor warmtegemeenschappen en het betrekken van warmtegemeenschappen bij het vaststellen van een warmtekavel
Amendment adds to the heat law that municipalities must support heat communities in organising themselves and involve them when setting a heat zone.
The college provides heat communities with support where needed to organise themselves.
Het college biedt warmtegemeenschappen waar nodig ondersteuning zich te organiseren.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 61 over het opnemen van democratische zeggenschap als voorwaarde in de definitie van warmtegemeenschappen.
Amendment adds equal voting rights among members as a condition in the definition of heat communities, to secure democratic control and autonomy.
With this amendment the submitter aims to include democratic control as a condition in the definition of heat communities.
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener democratische zeggenschap als voorwaarde op te nemen in de definitie van warmtegemeenschappen.
Motie van de leden Flach en Kröger over onderzoek naar publieke minderheidsaandelen in warmtebedrijven van warmtegemeenschappen

Asks the government to examine, with heat community representatives and the European Commission, whether public minority stakes in heat companies of heat communities are possible, and to report within six months.

requests the government to further examine the possibility of a public minority stake in heat companies of heat communities in consultation with representative organisations and the European Commission

verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheid van een publiek minderheidsaandeel in warmtebedrijven van warmtegemeenschappen in overleg met representatieve organisaties van warmtegemeenschappen en de Europese Commissie nader te onderzoeken
