Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over binnen vier jaar na inwerkingtreding overgaan naar op kosten gebaseerde tarieven
Asks the government to move to cost-based heat tariffs within four years and develop affordability safeguards such as price guarantees.
requests the government to do everything to move to phase 2 cost-based tariffs within four years of the law taking effect
verzoekt de regering om alles in het werk te stellen om binnen vier jaar na ingaan van de wet naar fase 2 (op kosten gebaseerde tarieven) over te gaan
Amendement van het lid Kröger over het opnemen van democratische zeggenschap als voorwaarde in de definitie van warmtegemeenschappen.
Makes equal voting rights among members a condition in the definition of heat communities to secure democratic control and prevent corporate capture.
With this amendment the submitter aims to include democratic control as a condition in the definition of heat communities.
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener democratische zeggenschap als voorwaarde op te nemen in de definitie van warmtegemeenschappen.
Motie van het lid Postma c.s. over uitbreiding en verlenging van de Stimuleringsregeling aardgasvrije huurwoningen
Asks the government to map the extra subsidy need caused by the oversubscribed scheme for gas-free rental homes and explore extending it.
requests the government to map the additional subsidy need resulting from the oversubscription of the gas-free rental homes scheme
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen wat de aanvullende behoefte aan subsidie als gevolg van het overtekenen van de Stimuleringsregeling aardgasvrije huurwoningen is
Motie van het lid Kröger over onderzoek naar het effect van ETS2 op de gasreferentie en de kosten
Asks the government to study the effect of ETS2 on the gas reference price and heat company costs, and to explore correction if heat tariffs rise.
requests the government to research the effect of ETS2 on the gas reference and the costs of heat companies
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen naar het effect van ETS2 op de gasreferentie en de kosten van warmtebedrijven
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over een faciliterend kader en een waarborgfonds voor warmtegemeenschappen
Asks the government to design the national guarantee fund for heat communities and to produce a quick action plan for an enabling framework for them.
requests the government, in consultation with heat communities, to shape the national guarantee fund so that it fits the characteristics of heat communities
verzoekt de regering in overleg met warmtegemeenschappen het nationale waarborgfonds zo vorm te geven dat deze aansluit op de karakteristieken van warmtegemeenschappen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 57 over een faciliterend kader inzake de bevordering van de ontwikkeling van warmtegemeenschappen
Requires the minister, after consulting representative heat community organisations, to set a facilitating framework for heat communities, updated every three years.
The minister, after consultation with representative heat community organisations, establishes a facilitating framework
Onze Minister stelt na overleg met de representatieve organisaties van warmtegemeenschappen een faciliterend kader vast
Motie van het lid Kröger over een heffing of verbod op het lozen van restwarmte
Asks the government to prepare a legal basis for a levy or ban on discharging residual heat, a energy-efficiency measure without bearing on checks on the executive.
requests the government to prepare a legal basis for a levy or ban on discharging residual heat
verzoekt de regering een grondslag voor te bereiden op een heffing of een verbod op het lozen van restwarmte
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 50 over inzage in de meetgegevens voor verbruiker
Asks that a designated heat company give an individual consumer or their authorised representative direct access to meter data and the cost-allocation calculation.
What is missing in articles 2.40 to 2.42 is the right of the user or an authorised representative to have direct access to the meter data.
Wat ontbreekt in de artikelen 2.40 t/m 2.42 is het recht van de gebruiker of een gemachtigde daarvan om direct toegang te hebben tot de meetgegevens.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Kröger ter vervanging van nr. 51 over ondersteuning voor warmtegemeenschappen en het betrekken bij het vaststellen van een warmtekavel
Requires municipalities to support heat communities in organising themselves and to involve them when setting a heat zone.
The municipal executive offers heat communities support where needed to organise themselves.
Het college biedt warmtegemeenschappen waar nodig ondersteuning zich te organiseren.
Amendement van het lid Kröger over een faciliterend kader inzake de bevordering van de ontwikkeling van warmtegemeenschappen
Adds a provision requiring the Minister, after consulting representative heat community organisations, to set a facilitating framework with funding for heat communities, updated annually.
The Minister, after consulting representative organisations of heat communities, establishes a facilitating framework
Onze Minister stelt na overleg met de representatieve organisaties van warmtegemeenschappen een faciliterend kader vast
Amendement van het lid Kröger over het laten vervallen van het vetorecht voor warmtebedrijven bij het opstarten van energiegemeenschappen
Removes the heat companies' veto over starting energy community projects within their allotted area, giving the municipality the decisive vote instead.
This amendment removes the veto of heat companies when energy communities want to start a project within a plot assigned to a heat company.
Dit amendement ontneemt warmtebedrijven het vetorecht als energiegemeenschappen een project willen starten binnen een kavel dat aan een warmtebedrijf is toegewezen.
Amendement van het lid Kröger over het betrekken van lokale initiatieven bij het vaststellen van een warmtekavel
Amendment requires municipalities to involve local consumer initiatives in determining a heat zone and to support them in organising where needed.

MPs Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder and Grinwis asked about the G4 call to support high-energy-cost households via the Temporary Emergency Energy Fund (TNE) and whether a publicprivate route can be revived this winter. The State Secretary answers that private co-financing fell short, so the route is not responsible; instead €30 million goes via the Municipal Fund to existing local services, with no direct income support, citing legal and state-aid risks.
It has been established that it is not feasible to realise a public-private construction this coming winter.
Er is geconstateerd dat het niet haalbaar is om aankomende winter een publiek-private constructie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over levering militair materieel aan Indonesische marine

An MP asked the State Secretary whether arms exports to the Indonesian navy, which reportedly played a role in human rights abuses in West Papua, should be reconsidered, and raised questions on drones and dual-use licences. The government answered that no clear risk of use for serious human rights violations was found for the licences granted, that existing export policy suffices, and that it does not intend to reassess current licences.

To arrive at a negative assessment there must be a clear risk that the specific item to be exported will be used by the end user to commit serious violations of human rights or international humanitarian law.

Om te komen tot een negatieve toetsing moet sprake zijn van een duidelijk risico dat specifiek het uit te voeren goed door de eindgebruiker gebruikt wordt voor het begaan van ernstige schendingen van de mensenrechten of van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Kröger over het artikel 'Door creatief boekhouden hoeven we voorlopig geen euro extra te betalen voor klimaatschade in arme landen'

MPs Hirsch and Kröger asked the ministers about a Follow the Money article claiming the Netherlands pushed for a low, vague climate finance target at COP29 to avoid paying extra. The government denied this characterization, stated its position was a broad target with a public core, rejected the idea of a burden-sharing key, and said it will consider the questions in its legal analysis of the ICJ advisory opinion.
This is not a correct representation of the Dutch position.
Dit is geen juiste weergave van de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Kröger over het bericht dat wetenschappers twijfelen aan de maatregelen tegen stank en zoutzuur van het bedrijf ICL

MPs Gabriëls and Kröger asked the State Secretary about reports that scientists doubt ICL's measures against odour and hydrochloric acid emissions, including repeated exceedances of permit limits and possible cancer links. The State Secretary answered that enforcement lies with the province of Noord-Holland and the Omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied, which imposed a penalty of 500,000 euro and will tighten permit conditions, while declining to commission a cancer study and pointing to the responsibility of the competent authority.
It is for the competent authority to assess this.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over winningsvergunningen

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to explain the government's position on the 'hand-on-the-tap' principle for gas and salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether extraction could be intensified or new permits granted. The minister replied that the principle is unchanged for now, that a future cabinet must decide on the new scientific findings, that new permits in the Wadden Sea Natura 2000 area have not been granted since 1 May 2024, and that the principle is conservative so subsidence is compensated by natural sedimentation.
For now, the hand-on-the-tap principle is therefore not being changed.
Vooralsnog wordt het hand-aan-de-kraan-principe dus niet aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Kröger en Teunissen over de verplichtingen van staten met betrekking tot klimaatverandering

MPs Hirsch, Kröger and Teunissen asked the government how the ICJ's July 2025 climate advisory opinion affects Dutch fossil fuel subsidies, corporate regulation, adaptation finance, loss and damage funding, and EU climate commitments. The government answered that the opinion does not create new obligations, that its fossil support and climate policies comply with international law, that it sees no need for a new analysis of fossil support, and that it will share a fuller legal reaction later.
The ICJ advisory opinion requires a careful legal analysis, which is currently taking place.
Het advies van het IGH vergt een zorgvuldige juridische analyse, die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat de uitbreiding van het hoogspanningsnet is vertraagd

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that the expansion of the high-voltage grid in Gelderland, Utrecht and Flevopolder is delayed by at least four years, and about measures to prevent further delays, grid congestion in Noord-Holland and Vijfhuizen, reserved but unused capacity for data centres, and the prioritisation code. The minister acknowledges the delay, attributes it to planning, land-acquisition and technical problems, and lists existing and planned measures, committing to continued efforts while offering no new binding guarantees.
The cabinet is making every effort, together with all parties involved, with TenneT and the province of Utrecht in the lead, to seize every opportunity to accelerate the realisation of this project.

Het kabinet spant zich tot het uiterste in om, samen met alle betrokken betrokken partijen, TenneT en de provincie Utrecht voorop, iedere mogelijkheid om de realisatie van dit project te versnellen aan te grijpen.

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the adopted motion to abolish the industrial CO2 levy, covering its impact on companies, revenue, legal consequences, the Herstel- en Veerkrachtplan funding, and climate policy credibility. The government replied that the levy will be temporarily suspended for the period up to 2030 pending further study, an independent Overlegtafel will advise on post-2030 options by 1 November, and it will assess legal, revenue and funding consequences and explore alternative measures.
The cabinet will investigate the extent of the negative impact that a possible suspension of the industrial CO2 levy would have on companies that have already invested in sustainability.

met de Kamer is gedeeld gaat het kabinet onderzoeken in welke mate er sprake is van een negatieve impact van het eventueel opschorten van de CO 2 -heffing industrie op bedrijven die reeds hebben geïnvesteerd in verduurzaming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het voorkeurstracé voor de aansluiting van windpark Doordewind (DDW)

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the government prefers the western cable route through the Wadden area over less harmful eastern alternatives, and how it handles the Commission for EIA's critical advice, the 287 objections, Germany's refusal of a route, UNESCO obligations and Natura 2000 concerns. The minister answers that three routes are permittable, that the Schiermonnikoog-Wantij route is the only feasible one in time, that an addendum will address the Commission's points, and that objections and German consultations will be shared with the House.
It was agreed with the Commission that an addendum to the environmental impact report is sufficient to provide the requested information.
Met de Commissie is afgesproken dat een addendum bij het milieueffectrapport voldoende is om de gevraagde informatie te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en De Hoop over het artikel 'Premier Schoof moet mogelijk ingrijpen om stroomkabel door Schiermonnikoog tegen te houden'

MPs Kröger and De Hoop asked why the government could not secure German agreement for a cable through the Eems-Dollard area and why it signed a gas-field treaty with Germany while the Schiermonnikoog cable remains blocked. The minister explains that the gas treaty is separate from the Eems-Dollard treaty, that German authorities refuse the cable route on shipping-safety grounds, and that the treaty is planned for signature in August with provisional application, without parliamentary debate first.

Because provisional application serves the general interest of gas production, energy supply, security of supply and reducing import dependence for both the Netherlands and Germany, the Council of Ministers also approved such provisional application on 20 September 2024.

Omdat de voorlopige toepassing in het algemeen belang is van de gaswinning, de energievoorziening, de leveringszekerheid en het beperken van de importafhankelijkheid van Nederland en Duitsland, is tevens met een dergelijke voorlopige toepassing ingestemd in de ministerraad van 20 september 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Postma over het tekort aan installatiehavens voor wind op zee

MPs Kröger, Thijssen and Postma asked the minister about a shortage of installation ports for offshore wind, the government's position relative to other North Sea countries, and support for the Energiehaven IJmond project, including whether the state would close an unprofitable business case gap before summer recess. The minister acknowledged the port capacity shortage and said the cabinet supports the project and signed a convenant committing to seek solutions, but will only inform parliament on concrete state support around Prinsjesdag.

As soon as there is clarity on whether the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth and the Ministry of Economic Affairs can support the project, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is of het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken het project kunnen ondersteunen zal het kabinet daar de Kamer over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Kröger over “het sluiten van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie”

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about the closure of the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie after a rush of applications, technical problems, and the mandatory DigiD requirement. The State Secretary acknowledged the frustration and access problems, but said no additional public or third-party funds were available, the fund had to close, and a DigiD was required to verify income.
To prevent administrative risks, the central government can only contribute funds when third parties also contribute more than one third of the total sum.
Het Rijk kan om bestuurlijke risico's te voorkomen enkel middelen inleggen wanneer derde partijen ook meer dan één derde van de totale som financieel bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over het bericht dat er meer 'zombiebranden' zijn door klimaatverandering

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government about reports that climate change is causing more 'zombie fires' and what the Netherlands is doing on climate adaptation, drought, water management and spatial planning. The minister replied that such overwintering fires have not been documented in the Netherlands, cited existing funding and planned measures including a new National Climate Adaptation Strategy due in 2026, and gave substantive answers on most questions while declining to provide the strategy draft before year-end.
According to the current planning, the draft NAS will be opened for public consultation at the end of this year.
Volgens de huidige planning zal de ontwerpNAS eind dit jaar opengesteld worden voor publieke consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de veiligheid van klimaatwetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth what is being done at European level to protect climate science and climate data threatened by US federal cuts, and what options exist for Europe and the Netherlands. The minister answered that consultations are ongoing with European colleagues and national institutions, that the US situation is still unclear so no concrete action can yet be decided, and that options such as copying datasets and supporting IPCC work are being explored.
Due to (commercial) confidential information, the cabinet cannot yet make statements about Dutch and European institutions and organisations engaged in climate science and using this data.

Vanwege (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijke informatie kan het kabinet op dit moment nog geen uitspraken doen over Nederlandse en Europese instituties en organisaties die zich bezighouden met, klimaatwetenschap en gebruik maken van, deze data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Grinwis over de hoge warmtetarieven

MPs Kröger and Grinwis asked why heat tariffs stayed high in 2025 despite the emergency heat-tariff law, and whether the government fulfilled its earlier commitment on maintenance-cost calculation. The minister answered that the amended methodology lowered the total heat bill, that the fixed-cost reduction was smaller than estimated and the all-in maintenance benchmark was deliberately chosen to protect heat companies' returns, and that further measures will follow the Wet collectieve warmte.
The cabinet is of the view that the intention of the 'emergency law' has been followed, but that further steps are needed in the reform of tariff regulation.
Het kabinet is van mening dat de bedoeling van de «spoedwet» is gevolgd, maar dat er verdergaande stappen nodig zijn in de hervorming van de tariefregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over extra klimaatmaatregelen naar aanleiding van de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning 2024

MPs asked whether extra climate measures are being drafted, whether any measures fall outside the IBO report, and whether ministry fiches and PBL/TNO reflections on the Meerjarenprogramma can be shared before the KEV debate. The Minister answers that the cabinet is still deciding alternative policy for the spring Voorjaarsnota, that it draws on many sources including the IBO and a pricing study, and that fiches and PBL/TNO reflections will be shared with the concept-Meerjarenprogramma.
The cabinet will share these fiches with the Chamber when it presents the draft Meerjarenprogramma.
Deze fiches zal het kabinet bij het aanbieden van het concept-Meerjarenprogramma met de Kamer delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport "Dutch financial institutions decarbonising their energy portfolios. Analysing financial flows to fossil fuels and renewable energy" van de Eerlijke

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a report showing Dutch financial institutions invest only about 20 cents in renewables per euro in fossil fuels, and how the 6:1 renewable-to-fossil ratio by 2030 will be achieved, including prudential supervision, disclosure and reporting obligations. The Minister, Heinen, answered that the government relies on climate policy, the Klimaatcommitment and existing EU rules, rejects additional national obligations, says prudential supervisors already expect climate risk management, and argues full public disclosure of portfolios is disproportionate due to commercial and privacy concerns.
Mandatory full public disclosure on a large scale is also not proportionate because commercial, business-sensitive information could end up in the public domain.
Verplichte algehele openbaarmaking op grote schaal is ook niet proportioneel omdat commerciële, bedrijfsgevoelige informatie op straat kan komen te liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Lahlah en Postma over private financiële middelen met betrekking tot een energiefonds

MPs asked why private funding for an energy fund for low and middle income households could not be secured and what efforts were made, including the gap with the amount sought and the future of the Noodfonds infrastructure. The government explains that energy suppliers have agreed to an energy fund for 2025 but the state will carry more than two thirds of the funding to avoid state aid risks, and that the fund will open once the energy sector's contribution is settled.
The Chamber will be informed about this as soon as possible.
De Kamer wordt hier zo snel mogelijk nader over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Hirsch over de uitkomsten van de COP29

Two MPs asked the Climate and Foreign Trade ministers whether they were satisfied with COP29's outcomes, including the climate finance goal, fossil fuel phase-down, and the protection of human rights and gender equality. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is partly satisfied, commits to the Paris goals and to a meaningful climate finance contribution, and points to further discussion in 2025 without committing to new funding.
The cabinet has chosen to first send the letter to the Chamber appraising the outcomes of COP29.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om eerst de Kamerbrief met de appreciatie van de uitkomsten van COP29 te versturen.
Beantwoording op vragen van de leden Kröger c.s. over het gaswinningsproject bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, PvdD and D66 asked why the government will not share TNO and Mijnraad advice, the official appraisal of those advice, the Wnb permit, and why not all relevant documents were published under Awb 3:11 and the Aarhus Convention, plus questions on Waddenzee World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value. The minister refused to publish the advice before the decision, citing negotiating position with NAM and protection of a careful decision-making process, offering only confidential inspection by the Kamer, and asserted procedures were correctly followed.
Once the decision-making is complete, the cabinet will of course make the advice public and inform the Kamer about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming is afgerond zal het kabinet de adviezen uiteraard openbaar maken en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Teunissen en Rooderkerk over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over de rechtszaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and D66 asked the minister how the Hague appeal court's ruling in the Milieudefensie v. Shell climate case affects climate targets, corporate duties, and whether new oil and gas fields should be restricted. The minister replied that the case is a private civil dispute, that corporate responsibility is addressed through EU CSDDD and existing climate policy, and that no new measures on new fossil licences will be taken.
This concerns a civil case between private parties. The government is not a party to this case.
Het betreft een civielrechtelijke zaak tussen private partijen. De overheid is geen partij in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Beckerman, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over gaswinning bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, D66 and PvdD asked whether the gas extraction permit at Ternaard was properly re-tested in light of SodM advice, Waddenacademie and UNESCO warnings, MER commission input and undisclosed advice, and whether all studies would be shared. The minister replied that the permit was granted in February 2024 under the Nature Protection Act, that the relevant advice gave no reason to revoke or amend it, that the Landsadvocaat advised UNESCO's position falls outside the legal test, and that the government would share some advice confidentially and publish others after final decision-making.

In line with my commitment in the debate of 11 December, I am willing to make the advice of TNO, SodM and Mijnraad available confidentially for inspection, so that committee members can read the content of this advice.

Conform mijn toezegging in het debat van 11 december, ben ik bereid de adviezen van TNO, SodM en Mijnraad vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen, zodat de commissieleden van de inhoud van deze adviezen kennis kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘BBB geeft signaal aan provincies en is tegen windmolens op het land: ‘Wij gaan tot het gaatje’’

Kröger (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a BBB MP's claim that the coalition agreement rules out new onshore wind and whether the government will accelerate wind turbine construction to meet climate targets. The minister denies the coalition agreement bans onshore wind, states onshore wind is necessary for climate and energy-security goals, acknowledges the RES targets are out of reach, and commits to ongoing consultation with local governments and RED III acceleration areas.
No agreements were made in the coalition programme to stop onshore wind.
In het regeerprogramma zijn geen afspraken gemaakt om te stoppen met wind op land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gabriëls en Stultiens over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government to respond to remarks by the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management that the Valencia floods could not be directly linked to climate change and that climate science is not fully settled, and whether this conflicts with IPCC findings and the collective-government principle. The Minister of Climate and Green Growth answered that climate change increased the rainfall but flood damage depends on several factors, that the minister's remarks are not to be addressed as they were made on behalf of the cabinet, and that the answers were delayed due to a climate summit.
Statements made by ministers are always on behalf of the cabinet, unless explicitly indicated otherwise.
Uitspraken gedaan door bewindspersonen zijn altijd namens het kabinet, tenzij expliciet aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the minister's remarks on the Valencia floods in a November 2024 water committee meeting, which questioned the link to climate change, amounted to climate disinformation and undermined government commitments. The government answered that it does not know the Valencia situation, denies sowing doubt on climate change, affirms support for science, and says it will provide reliable information via independent institutions.
No. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management states that he does not know the situation in Valencia and makes no specific statements about the situation and possible explanations.
Nee. De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geeft aan de situatie in Valencia niet te kennen en doet geen specifieke uitspraken over de situatie en de mogelijke verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Kröger en Rooderkerk over de kosten van de bouw van twee kerncentrales die volgens experts aanzienlijk hoger uitpakken dan de kostenraming van het kabinet

MPs Teunissen, Kröger and Rooderkerk asked the minister why cost estimates for two new nuclear plants (potentially 35-40 billion euro according to Follow the Money) differ from the cabinet's figure, and about financing, risk allocation and cost comparisons. The minister replied that no construction cost estimate has been made, only a reservation for the state share, that a cost indication will follow in spring 2025 after third-party review, and that cost commitments and risk allocation will be settled only in contract negotiations, while largely deflecting comparisons and the sunk-cost question.
The cabinet has not estimated costs for the construction of the nuclear power plants, but has set aside money for the government contribution to financing the total costs.
Het kabinet heeft geen kosten geraamd voor de bouw van de kerncentrales, maar heeft geld gereserveerd voor de overheidsbijdrage in de financiering van de totale kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de salderingsregeling

The MP Kröger asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the planning agency PBL warned of the climate impact of abolishing the net-metering scheme and whether assessments were made of its effects on rooftop solar and CO2 emissions. The minister answers that the KEV does not model individual measures, that no CO2 impact estimate is possible, that rooftop solar growth will slow but not stop, and that the cabinet will decide on alternative measures in spring.
The cabinet maintains the agreed climate targets and will therefore decide on alternative measures in the spring.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan de afgesproken klimaatdoelen en neemt daarom in het voorjaar een besluit over alternatieve maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

MPs Kröger, Rooderkerk and Teunissen asked the climate minister about a newspaper report that her own policy would not be sufficient to meet the 2030 climate target, and why this was not stated in parliament, and about the expected CO2 effects of several scrapped or retained measures. The minister confirmed the warning, said the impact of individual measures cannot be quantified separately, deferred the full assessment to the KEV projection and the Klimaatnota, and declined to name new measures before the spring decision-making.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate the political decision-making in spring 2025 on possible alternative climate measures.
Het kabinet wil niet op de politieke besluitvorming in het Voorjaar 2025 over mogelijke alternatieve klimaatmaatregelen vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Afkicken van Russisch gas blijkt lastiger dan gedacht: één lng-tanker per maand werden er plots twee'

MPs Klaver and Kröger asked whether the 14th sanctions package has increased Russian LNG imports into the EU and the Netherlands, how sanctions are enforced, and whether the government will press for tighter measures. The minister answered that Russian LNG imports into the Netherlands have doubled monthly since July, that this reflects rerouting rather than new purchases, that enforcement and sanctions are limited until March 2025, and that stronger EU-wide measures depend on a forthcoming Commission roadmap.
This concerns commercially confidential information on which I cannot make statements.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht 'Russisch staatsbedrijf sluist honderden miljoenen aan uraniumwinst door Nederland'

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the government about reports that Russian state company Rosatom earns hundreds of millions from uranium trade through the Netherlands, and how Russian dependence in nuclear energy and medical isotopes can be ended. The minister answered that the government opposes this revenue, pushes for EU sanctions on Russia's civil-nuclear earnings and LNG imports, notes residual dependence through legacy contracts and enriched ytterbium for medical isotopes, and says alternatives are being explored.
In line with the Klaver et al. motion, the cabinet advocates at EU level for sanctions that hit Russia's earnings in the civil-nuclear domain.
Het kabinet pleit conform de motie Klaver c.s. (Kamerstuk 36 476, nr. 3 ) in Europees verband voor sancties die het Russische verdienvermogen in het civiel-nucleaire domein raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bushoff en Kröger over gaswinning nabij de Wadden

MPs Chakor, Bushoff and Kröger asked about the gas drilling at field N05-A near the Wadden Sea, including the suspended German cable permit, alternatives to the cable, biodiversity impacts and UNESCO risks. The minister answered that ONE-Dyas is seeking an amended permit, that no alternative powering the platform is feasible in time, that the project is judged not to significantly affect the Wadden Sea, and that ONE-Dyas will proceed with preparatory work regardless of pending procedures.
The goal is still to be able to produce the first natural gas this winter.
Het doel is nog steeds om deze winter het eerste aardgas te kunnen produceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het vonnis van het EHRM over de Klimaseniorinnenzaak

Kröger (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the ECtHR Klimaseniorinnen judgment requires a carbon budget, CBDR-based allocation, and certainty on meeting the 55% 2030 target, and asked about the PBL reports and the ITLOS advisory opinion. The minister answered that the judgment does not require a quantified cumulative budget or certainty on the 2030 target, pointed to existing EU instruments and the annual monitoring cycle, and said the KEV 2024 will assess whether new measures are needed.
No. The ECtHR judgment does not impose an obligation on states to limit cumulative emissions with a budget.
Nee. Uit de EHRM-uitspraak volgt niet de verplichting voor staten om met een budget de cumulatieve uitstoot te begrenzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Maatoug over het bericht «650 miljoen belastingschuld en toch dividend uitkeren: zo werkt kunstmestfabriek Yara»

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about reports that fertiliser producer Yara pays dividends despite a large tax debt, receives green subsidies, and used transfer pricing to shift profit abroad. The minister answered that companies are free to decide their profit use within legal frameworks, that subsidies are capped to avoid overcompensation via claw-back mechanisms, and that the Tax Authority rejects profit shifting without real activity changes.
Nevertheless, the maatwerk agreements aim to prevent oversubsidy of projects, for example by including a claw-back mechanism.
Wel wordt er binnen de maatwerkafspraken op ingezet oversubsidiëring van projecten tegen te gaan, bijvoorbeeld door het opnemen van een terugvorderingsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht Energieleveranciers misleiden klanten met CO2-gecompenseerd gas

MP Kröger asked the minister whether energy suppliers mislead customers with 'CO2-compensated gas' claims, whether a ban is needed, and what the ACM and EU do to regulate voluntary carbon markets. The minister answered that EU rules from 2026 will ban such claims, that the ACM already enforces against misleading claims, and that the Netherlands is pushing for better regulation of the voluntary carbon market.

This legislation, which takes effect in mid-2026, prohibits companies from claiming that a product or service has a neutral, reduced or positive environmental effect thanks to compensating greenhouse gas emissions through carbon certificates.

Deze wetgeving, die medio 2026 ingaat, verbiedt bedrijven onder meer te beweren dat een product of dienst dankzij de compensatie van broeikasgasemissies via koolstofcertificaten een neutraal, verminderd of positief milieueffect heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het afzwakken van de klimaatdoelen door Shell

MP Kröger asked the minister about Shell weakening its carbon intensity target for 2030, falling renewables investment share, non-implementation of the court ruling on emissions, and government contacts with Shell. The minister confirmed awareness, said renewables investment rose, declined to comment on the pending appeal, and stated the government discusses climate goals with Shell and holds it to the Expression of Principles.
Hearings on the appeal take place in April. I refrain from commenting as long as the ruling is pending before the court.
In april vinden zittingen plaats over het hoger beroep. Ik onthoud mij van een reactie zolang de uitspraak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering een pauze heeft afgekondigd van de uitbouw van verdere LNG-fabrieken

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the Dutch government would pause expansion of LNG infrastructure after the US paused new LNG export approvals, citing methane leakage and health impacts, and asked for further environmental and health studies. The minister answered that the existing environmental assessment procedures are sufficient, no pause is needed because Dutch LNG is import-only, and continued LNG import capacity is necessary for security of gas supply, with reuse of terminals for sustainable carriers planned.
I therefore do not consider additional research necessary.
Ik acht aanvullend onderzoek daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat netbeheerders een obstakel vormen voor ondernemers die energie willen delen

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why grid operators' unclear capacity information led entrepreneurs to halt an energy-sharing hub project, and what the government will do about it. The Minister says TenneT found limited grid room in Utrecht, promises clearer capacity information and more talks with grid operators, but gives no binding deadline beyond an expected update in Q2 2024.
I have asked TenneT to provide clarity as quickly as possible on what capacity remains in these regions, and elsewhere.
Ik heb TenneT gevraagd zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven over welke ruimte er in deze regio's, maar ook elders, nog is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat tien Nederlandse bedrijven bijna 9 miljard euro aan fossiele subsidies krijgen

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister whether it is fair that ten large fossil-fuel companies receive nearly 9 billion euros in subsidies while household energy bills rise, and what is being done to make climate policy fairer and to phase out fossil subsidies in company agreements. The minister responded that the government favours carbon pricing and regulation, lists recent tax measures and EU emissions-trading changes, says the phase-out scenarios are being prepared by an independent chair, and confirms the energy tax gap between gas and electricity is being narrowed.
The cabinet has asked the independent chair of the official report Building Blocks for a Better and Simpler Tax System to work out the requested phase-out scenarios for fossil subsidies.

Het kabinet heeft aan de onafhankelijk voorzitter van het ambtelijk rapport Bouwstenen voor een beter en eenvoudiger belastingstelsel verzocht om de gevraagde afbouwscenario's voor «fossiele subsidies» uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over onverklaarbare hoge kosten bij blokverwarming

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about unexplained high heating bills in block heating caused by heat cost allocators, asking who is responsible for checking them, how tenants can obtain redress, and how transparency and tariffs are ensured. The minister says he is shocked, will consult stakeholders, explains the legal framework, complaint routes via the ACM and the rent commission, and that tariff regulation will be adjusted with the new Wcw law, though housing associations and owners' associations are largely excluded from tariff rules.

I will engage with representatives of owners' associations, the Woonbond, landlords, the heat sector and the Dutch association for consumption-based energy billing (NLVVE) to discuss these situations and examine whether policy can be improved.

Ik ga in gesprek met vertegenwoordigers van VvE's, Woonbond, verhuurders, de warmtebranche en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Verbruiksafhankelijke Energieafrekening (NLVVE) om deze situaties te bespreken en te onderzoeken of het beleid kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance

An MP asked the government whether it recognises the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance call for a fossil fuel phase-out in line with 5-degree IPCC scenarios, how this differs from its commitment to a 1.5-degree phase-out path, why the Netherlands has not joined, and whether the answers could come before the climate debate. The minister answered that the government pursues phase-out but keeps domestic small-field gas production, declines to join the alliance as it does not fit national policy, and admitted the answers came too late for the debate.
Because the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance insufficiently aligns with the Netherlands' national policy, this cabinet currently does not intend to join this initiative.
Omdat de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance onvoldoende aansluit op het nationale beleid van Nederland, is dit kabinet nu niet voornemens om bij dit initiatief aan te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Nijboer over de vergunningverlening locatie Schoonebeek van NAM

MPs Kröger and Nijboer asked whether a temporary carbon-filter installation permit for NAM at Schoonebeek signals a resumption of oil extraction and Twente water injection, and about decommissioning costs, e-boiler plans, state subsidies and grid use. The state secretary answered that the permit is only valid until 31 December 2023, that water injection in Twente will not resume under an agreement, and gave cost, subsidy and e-boiler details while noting some matters are NAM's responsibility.
Furthermore, I have agreed with NAM that water injection in Twente will not be resumed, and I will hold NAM to this agreement.
Daarnaast heb ik met de NAM afgesproken dat de waterinjectie in Twente niet zal worden hervat en ik zal de NAM houden aan deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Kröger over de Kamerbrief ‘Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie’

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD and Kröger, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the unorthodox grid-congestion measures in the letter 'Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie', covering why these were not chosen earlier, port electrification, grid permits, prioritisation, flexibility subsidies, metering and budget. The Minister answered most questions on substance, explaining the rationale, the ACM prioritisation code due March 2024, and commitments to report back on the laagspanningsnet action agenda and flexibility options, while declining to say more on some budget and metering points yet to be worked out.
It is not expected that changes to the Energy Act will be necessary as a result of the announced measures.
Het is niet de verwachting dat er wijzigingen nodig zijn in de Energiewet als gevolg van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gebruik van Russisch uranium door de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the ministers about EPZ's long-term contract with a European supplier that uses a Russian subcontractor for reprocessing Borssele's uranium, and why earlier answers said no such dependence existed. The government acknowledged an indirect relationship with Russia, said no short-term alternative exists, and committed to examining how to break the dependence and to reviewing EPZ's evaluation, while declining to discuss confidential details of the Russian subcontractor.
We will among other things look at developing alternatives to reuse as much used uranium as possible, and the consequences of possibly not reprocessing will be further mapped out.

Wij zullen onder meer kijken naar het ontwikkelen van alternatieven om zoveel mogelijk gebruikt uranium te hergebruiken en ook de consequenties van eventueel niet-opwerken zullen nader in beeld gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel “Yara tekent voor 1,5 megaton CO2-reductie in 2030”

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked why the Expression of Principles with Yara was signed without first being shared with parliament, and about its legal status, timing, CCS share, green electricity deals and government obligations. The minister answered that the EoP is non-binding, will be followed by a JLoI reviewed by an independent advisory committee and shared with parliament, and that the government's contribution will be analysed, while giving only high-level detail on several points.
In line with this reasoning, the EoP with Yara, like other EoPs signed before the cabinet became caretaker, was not shared with your House first.
In lijn met deze redenering is de EoP met Yara, net als bij andere EoP’s die zijn gesloten voordat het kabinet demissionair werd, niet eerst met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel 'Vrees voor stijging gasprijs: Nederland onderschat de risico's'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the government underestimates gas price risks, at what price it would intervene in the market, what alternative to the price cap is planned, how households could be protected, and how to reduce dependence on the spot market. The Minister replied that the market has calmed, supply risks are limited, no intervention is currently needed, the monitoring will continue, and the budget and buyback measures will follow later, without committing to specific figures.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to intervene in the market, but I of course keep the situation under observation.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen reden om in te grijpen in de markt, maar ik houd uiteraard de situatie in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kroger en Piri over de berichtgeving rondom de Tunesië-deal

MPs Kroger and Piri asked about the formal status, accountability and human rights safeguards of the EU-Tunisia memorandum of understanding on migration and partnership. The government answered that the MoU is a non-binding political commitment agreed by the European Commission, with no formal role for the European Parliament, and that existing human rights obligations are unchanged, while committing to press Tunisia on rights and to keep the House informed on implementation and funding.
There is no formal role for the European Parliament in the drafting of MoUs.
Er is geen formele rol van het Europees parlement bij de totstandkoming van MoU’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de dood van een drie maanden oude baby in het aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about the death of a three-month-old baby at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including unhygienic conditions, why the mother had to travel to Ter Apel despite holding a residence permit, and steps to prevent recurrence. The State Secretary acknowledged the poor conditions, said no causal link to the death could be established, and listed measures such as ending use of the sports hall for vulnerable residents and expanding capacity, though several answers were delayed or deferred to later policy responses.
Unfortunately I have not managed to answer your questions within the usual timeframe, as not all necessary information has yet been received.
Helaas is het mij niet gelukt om binnen de gebruikelijke termijn uw vragen te beantwoorden, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over Zeer Zorgwekkende Stoffen (ZZS)

MP Kröger asked why Schiphol measures ultrafine particles but not ZZS such as benzene and formaldehyde, whether workers are protected, and about FNV's exit from the emissions taskforce, claims exposure, and enforcement. The minister answered that Arbo rules already require employers to assess and minimise exposure to harmful substances, that the Arbeidsinspectie enforces this with deadlines and fines, and that exposure research (including possibly ZZS) is being explored with IRAS.
Schiphol and the handling companies must comply with the Arbo rules and the Labour Inspectorate's requirements within the set deadlines.
Schiphol en de afhandelingsbedrijven hebben aan de Arboregels en de eisen van de Arbeidsinspectie te voldoen binnen de gestelde termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het gebrek aan opvangplekken

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a looming shortage of asylum reception places, including whether 8,000 places would be missing by April and what concrete steps are being taken. The State Secretary answered that a shortage has been averted for now through coordinated measures, that many places are still needed, that ongoing monitoring and talks with municipalities and COA continue, and that the Spreidingswet is pending in parliament.
I have therefore asked the provincial coordination tables to coordinate the reception and housing needs.
Ik heb daarom aan de provinciale regietafels gevraagd om de opvang- en huisvestingsbehoefte te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het aantal minderjarigen in (crisis)noodopvangvoorzieningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the promised overview of minors in crisis emergency shelters, showing locations and access to education and care, had not been sent, and for the latest figures before a debate. The State Secretary apologised for the delay, citing logistical issues from the 1 July closure of crisis shelters, gave a headcount of about 980 children across 89 locations, and declined to provide a location-by-location breakdown because it could be traced to individuals, promising a separate letter on conditions and access to education and care.
A concrete overview broken down by which locations children stay at would contain information that can be traced back to the individual, and for that reason I cannot provide it to you.
Een concreet overzicht waarbij is uitgesplitst op welke locaties kinderen verblijven zou informatie bevatten welke tot de persoon te herleiden is en kan ik u om die reden niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over een betaalbare energierekening

Two MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how an affordable energy bill will be secured for 2024, including targeted income support, lessons from the price cap process, and relief for tenants in low-label housing. The Minister answered that options are being prepared for the August purchasing-power decision, that targeted support is still under review, and pointed to planned energy-label phase-outs, a new lower first tier for gas energy tax, and extra funding for municipalities.
Decision-making on purchasing power will take place in August.
Besluitvorming over de koopkracht zal plaatsvinden in augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over graaiflatie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether 'greedflation' (profit-driven price increases) is occurring in the Netherlands, whether market power concentrations are being monitored, and whether the ACM should get more powers. The Minister denies that greedflation is present, attributes price rises mainly to overheating and supply disruptions, says the ACM is adequately engaged and that the ministry is examining whether additional market-supervision instruments are needed.
These are average values and do not rule out that there are sectors where concentration and/or markups may have increased.
Dit betreft gemiddelde waarden en neemt niet weg dat er sectoren zijn waar de concentratie en/of markups kunnen zijn toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger naar aanleiding van een artikel in de Stentor getiteld 'Overlast snelwegen ondanks elektrische auto’s: Ze produceren soms zelfs meer geluid'

MP Kröger asks whether road noise reduction from electric cars and quieter tyres falls short of predictions, and how calculations relate to measured noise. The State Secretary acknowledges quieter tyres had less effect than expected, that calculation methods will be adjusted with the Omgevingswet, and describes validation, monitoring and complaint routes while stating that electric cars are too few yet to change averages.
This insight has already led to adjustments in the calculation methodology that will apply under the Environment and Planning Act.
Dit inzicht heeft al geleid tot aanpassingen in de rekensystematiek zoals die onder de Omgevingswet zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Voorjaarsbesluitvorming Klimaat

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Climate and Energy Minister why several IBO-Klimaat measures were left out of the spring climate package, and questioned the feasibility, biomass use, and effects of numerous individual measures. Minister Jetten answered at length, explaining deliberate choices, sometimes milder calibrations, planned follow-up decisions, and a commitment to answer timing and PBL analysis questions.
Because the talks on the Agricultural Agreement are still ongoing, the concrete implementation of measures L10-L13 will become known at a later date.
Omdat de gesprekken over het Landbouwakkoord nog gaande zijn, wordt de concrete invulling van de maatregelen L10-L13 op een later moment bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Audiovisuele Media Richtlijn

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive ban on advertising inciting behaviour harmful to the environment is implemented, and why the environmental advertising provision was removed from the new sustainability advertising code. The State Secretary answered that self-regulation via the Advertising Code Foundation and the Commissariaat covers this, and that the provision will be re-inserted in the code around 1 July 2023.
The Advertising Code Foundation intends to re-add this prohibition to the revised code.
De Stichting Reclame Code is voornemens om deze verbodsbepaling weer toe te voegen aan de herziene code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger voer het bericht 'Verhoging van energietarieven was mogelijk jarenlang onwettig'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a court ruling that a price-change clause in an energy supplier's general conditions was too vague, potentially making mid-contract tariff increases unlawful, and whether the same clause appears in the model contract used across the sector. The Minister declined to assess the ruling, noted the appeal, explained the model contract rules and the consumer protections in place, and said the wider consequences depend on the appeal outcome.
It is not for me as Minister to assess court rulings.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om rechterlijke uitspraken te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het alleen voor Chinees riet aanvragen van subsidie

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why the ISDE insulation subsidy's product listing covered Chinese reed but not Dutch reed, raising level-playing-field, sustainability and EU state-aid concerns. The minister answered that a registration code was granted only because Chinese reed met the insulation threshold, that Dutch reed can apply once its performance declaration is ready, and that sustainability criteria for bio-based inputs are being developed.
It is correct that a registration code was requested and granted for Chinese reed and not yet for Dutch reed.
Het klopt dat er een meldcode is aangevraagd en verleend voor Chinees riet en nog niet voor Nederlands riet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over strengere regels voor schepen die migranten redden op de Middellandse Zee

An MP asked whether Italy's new rules and fines on NGO rescue ships in the Mediterranean, and the Dutch absence of a humanitarian exemption in people-smuggling law, are compatible with international law and should be challenged. The State Secretary answered that Italian law is a matter for Italy and the courts and the Commission, that NGO rescue is valued but private ships should not aid smugglers, and that existing criminal-law defences suffice without an explicit humanitarian exemption.
It is not for the cabinet to judge whether this Italian law is compatible with European and international treaties; that is reserved for a judge.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de verenigbaarheid van deze Italiaanse wet met Europese en internationaalrechtelijke verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kröger over het bericht ‘Studenten eisen dat UvA banden verbreekt met Shell, bezetten universiteitsgebouw’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether fossil-industry research funding (Shell at UvA) is compatible with research integrity codes, what frameworks govern public-private partnerships, and whether universities should cut ties with Shell. The minister answered that universities are autonomous under academic freedom, cited the NGWI code under evaluation and existing independence frameworks, and declined to set content-based restrictions on partnerships.
On the basis of these freedoms, it is not possible to steer substantively the public-private partnerships universities enter into, and no frameworks can be set that infringe on academic freedom.

Op basis van deze vrijheden kan niet inhoudelijk gestuurd worden op de publiek-private samenwerkingen die universiteiten aangaan en kunnen geen kaders gesteld worden die inbreuk maken op de academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het voortduren van het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger, Westerveld and Piri asked about the continuing shortfall in education for children in asylum reception facilities, including delays, placement policy and whether gaps are structurally addressed. The State Secretary answered that data on children missing schooling is not yet available, that placement of families in crisis emergency shelters is undesirable but cannot always be refused, and that a bill and evaluations are in preparation.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Kröger, Van Esch en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Vervuilende Kooksfabriek 2 van Tata Steel blijkt verkeerd gebouwd: rookt en lekt vanaf eerste dag 'aan alle kanten'’

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdD asked the government about reports that Tata Steel's Coke Plant 2 was built with defects and emits pollutants, and about enforcement, permit revision, closure and related subsidies. The State Secretary answered that the competent authority (province and Omgevingsdienst NZKG) is investigating defects, has issued a third penalty payment order, and is examining permit withdrawal, while closure would be discussed in the maatwerk negotiations; several questions were referred to other bodies or withheld for tax confidentiality.
The OD NZKG asked EenVandaag and the reporters for further information; the information provided in the broadcast is insufficient to establish whether there are actually construction defects.

De OD NZKG heeft EénVandaag en de melders verzocht om nadere informatie; de in de uitzending aangereikte informatie is onvoldoende om vast te kunnen stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van constructiefouten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Boucke over het initiatief voor energiebesparing op De Zuidas en het voorzien van alle straatverlichting van een led-lichtbron

Two MPs asked the ministers about a campaign to switch off night-time office lighting on the Zuidas and about fully converting street lighting to LED, including whether the government would support the initiative and how energy savings could be mandated. The ministers confirmed support for the campaign, pointed to the energy-saving obligation and the updated measures list, and said about 32% of motorway lighting is LED with the rest to be replaced at natural replacement moments, rather than accelerating full conversion.
Almost all provinces will fit the remaining street lighting with LED lamps in the coming years.
Vrijwel alle provincies gaan de komende jaren de resterende straatverlichting van ledlampen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het afbouwpad van fossiele subsidies

GreenLeft MPs asked why a 2018 motion to phase out fiscal incentives undermining climate goals has not been fully implemented, why many fossil-energy exemptions remain, and for details on the largest emitters' benefits, the refinery exemption, free ETS allowances and related schemes. The government answered that it is phasing out some exemptions and plans a transparency action plan, cited treaty and double-taxation constraints, but declined to disclose company-level benefits citing confidentiality.
Regarding individual companies' entitlement to exemptions, subsidies and other benefits, as far as known, I cannot go into it due to confidentiality.
Op de aanspraak van individuele bedrijven op vrijstellingen, subsidies en andere voordelen, voor zover bekend, kan ik uit hoofde van vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het actualiseren van de efficiënte CO2-prijs uit de WLO studies en de maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyse (MKBA) oliewinning Schoonebeek

An MP asks about updating the efficient CO2 price from the WLO studies, the delayed new WLO study, and whether the Schoonebeek oil extraction cost-benefit analysis should be tested against the two-degree scenario rather than only the WLO low and high scenarios. The minister answers that the new WLO study will appear in 2024, that the two-degree scenario is used only as a supplementary sensitivity check, and that multiple scenarios are kept deliberately to test robustness.
It is precisely important to use multiple scenarios because the future is uncertain and this allows checking whether policy measures are robust.
Het is juist van belang meerdere scenario's te hanteren omdat de toekomst onzeker is en zo gecheckt kan worden of de beleidsmaatregelen robuust zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over de aanhouding van klimaatactivisten

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the preemptive arrest of climate activists for incitement was proportionate, whether it chilled the right to demonstrate, and what concrete threat justified it. The Minister answered that the eight people were arrested for incitement that had already occurred, released the same day with a area ban that courts partly upheld, and that the police acted under the prosecutor's authority, while not addressing the preventive-arrest and proportionality concerns in detail.
The eight arrests were made because of the suspicion of a criminal offence, namely incitement.
De acht aanhoudingen zijn verricht als gevolg van de verdenking tot een strafbaar feit, namelijk opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over enkele berichten over de stand van zaken van energieprijzen en de energiemarkt

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked the minister about energy price declines, variable and dynamic contracts, ACM investigations into suppliers, and market liberalisation. The minister answered that consumers should benefit from falling prices through switching, that ACM oversees tariff reasonableness independently, and that a 12-month fixed-contract obligation will be introduced in the Energy Act.
I do not think the duration of these contracts is long enough and I consider it desirable that fixed contracts have a term of at least 12 months.
Ik vind de duur van deze contracten niet lang genoeg en vind het wenselijk dat vaste contracten in ieder geval een looptijd van 12 maanden kennen.

Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht ‘Asieldeal wéér onder vuur van rechter: uitspraak hekelt nu ook ander onderdeel van het akkoord’ en de uitspraak van rechtbank Den Haag

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Den Haag court ruling that the generic six-month extension of asylum decision deadlines was not lawfully adopted, and about why IND backlogs persist despite staff growth. The State Secretary attributed high intake to multiple factors, explained that training takes about a year, said the extension will continue while an appeal is filed, and promised a further update on financial risks of penalty payments.
I am in continuous discussion with the IND about the measures needed to clear the backlogs.
Ik ben continu met de IND in gesprek over de benodigde maatregelen om de voorraden weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Schiphol gaf al ruim 16 miljoen euro uit in jacht op stikstofrechten'

GroenLinks MPs asked whether Schiphol's purchases of farms for nitrogen rights (over EUR 16 million) were known to ministries, whether more purchases are planned, and how this relates to parliamentary motions and state-aid rules. The minister confirms awareness, says ministries were not involved, says Schiphol's external netting is allowed under current rules, and promises new policy to gain more regie over nitrogen space.
Private transactions have been concluded. I cannot comment on those.
Er zijn private transacties gesloten. Ik kan daar niet in treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Kröger, Sylvana Simons en Akerboom over ongedocumenteerde mensen in Nederland

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the size and composition of the undocumented population in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch policy could adopt German, Irish or city-level measures such as regularisation or city ID cards. The State Secretary answered that return remains the central policy, that existing support (LVV, minors' rights, medical care) suffices, and that he is reluctant to add broader facilities or a new education convention.
I am therefore, unlike the initiatives mentioned in question 3, reluctant to provide additional facilities such as a city pass.
Derhalve ben ik, in tegenstelling tot de in vraag 3 genoemde initiatieven, terughoudend in het faciliteren van aanvullende voorzieningen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Piri en Sylvana Simons over geheime gevangenissen langs de EU-buitengrenzen

MPs Kröger, Piri and Simons asked the state secretary whether reports of secret detention facilities at the EU external border in Bulgaria, funded with EU money and involving beatings and pushbacks, are true, what Frontex's role is, and what the Netherlands will do. The government said it cannot verify the reports, expects the Commission and national monitoring mechanisms to investigate, stated Frontex's role is limited to surveillance support, and said no signals of abuse came from Dutch Frontex staff.
The cabinet is of the view that reports of abuses at the external borders should be investigated by the Member States concerned.
Het kabinet is van mening dat berichtgeving over misstanden aan de buitengrenzen onderzocht moeten worden door de betrokken lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de voorgenomen verkoop van het Zeeuwse energiebedrijf PZEM aan het Tsjechische energiebedrijf EPH

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the ministers about the planned sale of the publicly owned Zeeland energy company PZEM to Czech firm EPH, raising concerns about privatisation, fossil fuel assets, climate targets and risk allocation. Minister Jetten answered that the province as shareholder may decide on the sale, that he raised no objection under the Electricity Act while noting climate concerns, that the government will respond to the Segers-Marijnissen motion next year, and that the transaction structure is for the shareholders to decide.
As a shareholder, the province of Zeeland is free to decide on its own shareholding.
Als aandeelhouder staat het de provincie Zeeland vrij om over het eigen aandeelhouderschap te beslissen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van der Lee en Thijssen over de intentieverklaring tussen Nederland en met Oman over samenwerking op het gebied van groene waterstof

MPs Kröger, Van der Lee and Thijssen asked why the Dutch-Omani green hydrogen memorandum lacks safeguards on human rights, environment and labour rights, given Oman's weak labour record and the port of Sohar joint venture. The government answered that MoUs are non-binding, that Dutch companies must apply OECD due diligence, that an IMVO risk analysis on hydrogen chains is under way, and that future MoUs may refer to the SDGs.
A letter of intent does not create legally binding agreements from which safeguards, rights or obligations can be derived.
In een intentieverklaring worden geen juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt waaraan waarborgen, rechten of plichten kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Grutte fragen by Waadferiening: wat betsjut ferkeap NAM foar gaswinning?

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether a planned sale of NAM's gas-extraction activities, including the Ternaard field under the Wadden Sea, would leave unclear which company would operate there and how permits and oversight would apply. The State Secretary answered that the buyer would take over the permit holder's rights and duties under the Mining Act, that the minister must consent to any transfer and test the new holder's technical and financial capacity, and that the same enforcement applies.
In this regard I note that my consent is required for the transfer of the permit and that I test the proposed new permit holder against the requirements of the Mining Act.
Daarbij merk ik op dat voor de overdracht van de vergunning mijn toestemming nodig is en ik daarvoor de beoogde nieuwe vergunninghouder toets aan de eisen van de Mijnbouwwet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about children in asylum reception being moved to a cruise ferry without education in place, and why this happens, how often, and what measures will prevent repetition. The government admits the move should not have happened, acknowledges pressure on newcomer education, and points to planned legislation and a flexibilisation agenda to reduce relocations.
Since not all necessary facilities in Velsen were ready for the group, this group should not yet have been moved.
Aangezien voor de groep nog niet alle noodzakelijke voorzieningen in Velsen gereed waren, had deze groep echter nog niet verhuisd moeten worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bewuste stellingname van Shell geen plannen te maken om net zero emission te bereiken binnen de komende tien à twintig jaar en doorgaat met het zoeken naar nieuwe olie en gas

MP Kröger asks the government how it views Shell's stated lack of plans to reach net zero within 10 to 20 years and its continued search for new oil and gas, including the court ruling requiring a 45% CO2 cut by 2030 and Scope 3 emissions. The minister answers that the government holds Shell to EU and national climate targets, declines further comment while the appeal is pending, notes Shell's low-carbon initiatives, and states the government remains committed to the Paris goals.
As long as the appeal is before the court, I refrain from further comment.
Zolang het hoger beroep onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van verder commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
