The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over ‘Nederland kan weer migranten uitzetten naar Marokko - maar mag geen kritiek meer geven op het land’

MPs Piri and Kröger asked whether the Netherlands has stopped publicly criticising human rights abuses in Morocco in exchange for renewed cooperation on migrant returns, and about a possible extradition treaty. The minister replied that the relationship is constructive, denied any agreement to refrain from public criticism, said human rights are discussed case by case and that exploring an extradition treaty is at official level, while committing only to keep the Chamber informed.
No agreements have been made that the Netherlands will no longer publicly voice criticism regarding human rights.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt dat Nederland niet langer openbaar kritiek uit ten aanzien van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het bericht 'Krappe roosters en mondige patiënten: steeds drukker op huisartsenposten in Overijssel'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked the Health Minister about reports of overstretched GP out-of-hours posts in Overijssel, who is responsible for solving the GP shortage, what steps have been taken, and whether GP practices refusing Ukrainian refugees will be addressed. The minister acknowledges pressure on GP access, outlines causes and measures under the Integraal Zorg Akkoord, and points to insurers' duty of care and regional/local options while stating that the State Secretary for Justice has no reports that opening stops led to care being refused.
Health insurers have a duty of care towards their insured and must ensure that an insured person receives the care they are entitled to.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht voor hun verzekerden en moeten zorgen dat een verzekerde de zorg krijgt waar hij of zij recht op heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Nijboer en Kröger over hoge energietarieven voor nieuwe klanten

MPs Thijssen, Nijboer and Kröger asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether it is acceptable that new customers pay up to three times more for energy than existing customers, and whether energy suppliers shift risks onto new customers or use postcode-based risk assessments. The minister acknowledged the unfairness, said the ACM is revising early-termination fee rules and suppliers will offer fixed contracts again in 2023, and referred to general income-support measures, while denying knowledge of postcode-based risk profiling.
I share the view that it is galling when people who have to move pay three times as much for energy as existing customers.
Ik deel de mening dat het wrang is als mensen die moeten verhuizen drie keer zo veel moeten betalen voor energie als bestaande klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Maatoug over de arbonormen van het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

GroenLinks MPs Kröger and Maatoug asked the ministers about occupational health standards for Schiphol baggage handlers, why the labour inspectorate had not inspected since 2009, and whether Schiphol and the handling firms should compensate workers. The ministers answered that the inspectorate has started an investigation, that employers bear primary responsibility, that Schiphol should take a larger role and is pursuing a social accord, and that compensation is a matter between workers and employers.
The Minister of SZW has asked the Labour Inspectorate to consider whether improvements are possible.
De Minister van SZW heeft de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Van der Lee over door de Nederlandse regering erkende MTCS-certificaten voor Maleisisch hout

Greens MPs asked the state secretary about a lawsuit by timber firm Samling against the NGO SAVE Rivers over MTCS-certified timber, whether MTCS should be suspended, and related Tropical Timber Organisation funding. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the lawsuit and said TPAC would be asked to discuss the complaints with PEFC International, while stating TPAC has no independent power to act beyond the minister's request.
I will ask TPAC to discuss with PEFC International, following the signals I have received about MTCS, the signals and how they were handled.
Ik zal TPAC verzoeken om, naar aanleiding van de door mij ontvangen signalen over MTCS, in gesprek te gaan met PEFC International 3 over de signalen en de wijze waarop deze zijn opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het KiM rapport ‘De zakelijke reiziger centraal’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a KiM report and UK and German evidence on frequent flyer programmes, including how many extra flights and emissions they cause, whether points should be taxed, and their climate impact. The minister answered that the extra flights and emissions are unknown, that the Finance Minister is responsible for taxing points, and that the government sees no need to make these programmes less attractive, while promising to answer for the next aviation debate.
How many additional flights to and from the Netherlands, and how much emissions, are caused by frequent flyer programmes is unknown.
Hoeveel extra vluchten van en naar Nederland en hoeveel uitstoot wordt veroorzaakt door frequent flyer programma’s is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en De Hoop over het bericht Acht boerderijen (deels) dicht voor extra stikstof door verbreding A27 en A12 bij Utrecht

MPs Thijssen, De Hoop, Bromet and Kröger asked why nitrogen capacity is being allocated to widening the A27 and A12 near Utrecht while an alternative is being developed, which other projects could use that capacity, and whether road widening really reduces congestion. Minister Harbers answered that the Raad van State appeal cannot be paused, that other projects such as the A28/A1 junction may need the capacity, that a 2020 traffic study shows congestion more than halved, and that the government is committed to sustainable mobility alongside road investment.
When the region has an alternative ready, I will enter into discussion with them.
Als de regio een alternatief gereed heeft, ga ik met hen in gesprek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de subsidieregeling Indirecte kostencompensatie ETS die zij stelden naar aanleiding van berichtgeving van de Europese Commissie over haar goedkeuring van deze regel

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the government sought EU approval for an indirect ETS cost compensation scheme worth up to €835 million for about 62 energy-intensive firms without first consulting parliament, and whether firms should bear carbon price risk themselves. The minister answered that the scheme is delegated legislation not requiring parliamentary involvement, that only the 2022 budget is currently covered, and that the scheme carries a 3% CO2 reduction obligation with clawback if firms fail to comply.
The reason the subsidy scheme was not submitted to the House is that this concerns delegated legislation in which parliament has no formal involvement.
De reden dat de subsidieregeling niet aan de Kamer is voorgelegd is dat dit gedelegeerde wetgeving betreft waarbij het parlement in casu geen formele betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de aanpak van de inhumane situatie bij Aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about the government's plans to address the inhumane situation at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the 20,000 status-holder housing target, 225 extra crisis shelter places per safety region, the limited supervision of unaccompanied minors, basic facilities, and whether the armed forces should be deployed. The State Secretary answered that the housing and shelter measures are additional, that shelter places are being created in the short and medium term, that a temporary forecourt facility opened on 10 September, and that the armed forces already support reception and will prepare further aid, while not addressing the minors' supervision directly.
Thanks to the Ministry of Defence and the municipality of Hogeland, the forecourt facility on the Marnewaard site was brought into use on 10 September 2022.
Met dank aan het Ministerie van Defensie en de gemeente Hogeland is op 10 september 2022 het voorportaal op het terrein van de Marnewaard in gebruik genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kröger over de doorwerking van groothandelprijzen in gas en energie bij huishoudens en de weerslag hiervan op koopkracht

MPs Maatoug and Kröger asked how the government monitors hardship from high energy prices, and why the CPB will not update its cost-of-living box or model uneven inflation across income groups. The minister points to CPB stress tests, a TNO energy-poverty programme, forthcoming CBS and Divosa monitors, and says the CPB judges such updates methodologically infeasible, with extra instruments promised in the Prinsjesdag purchasing-power letter; answers to questions 1-8 are deferred.
The request was to answer these questions before Prinsjesdag. Full answers are not yet possible within that timeframe.
Het verzoek was om deze vragen voor Prinsjesdag te beantwoorden. De volledige beantwoording van de vragen is nog niet mogelijk op die termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de problemen met zorg voor mensen in CNO-locaties

MPs Kröger and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health how healthcare for asylum seekers at crisis emergency shelters (CNO) is coordinated, supported and funded, and whether the Minister would take a coordinating role. The Minister confirmed awareness of the NGO letter, explained that COA organises care through contracted partners and that the Minister declines a coordinating role because the legal duty lies with COA under the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
No, because the statutory obligation to organise care for asylum seekers rests with COA under the responsibility of the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
Nee, omdat de wettelijke verplichting voor de organisatie van zorg aan asielzoekers is belegd bij het COA onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over de intentie om het recht van statushouders op gezinshereniging te beperken

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the planned restriction of family reunification rights for refugees with status, and whether it complies with the Children's Rights Convention and EU law. The State Secretary answered that the best interests of the child remain central, that reunification is only postponed by up to six months, and that the measure was chosen as necessary to address the reception crisis, while the courts would ultimately judge its legal tenability.
In every situation it is ultimately up to the judiciary to rule on the legal tenability.
In elke situatie is het uiteindelijk aan de rechtspraak om te oordelen over de juridische houdbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht dat er 8 olietankers met Russische fossiele brandstof op weg zijn naar de havens van Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether eight tankers carrying Russian fossil fuels bound for Rotterdam and Amsterdam could be refused entry, and whether the government would act against such vessels. The government answered that Dutch law under current EU sanctions does not allow refusal of non-Russian-flagged tankers, that an EU oil import ban will take effect after transition periods, and that it has no further legal grounds to block the ships.
At present it is not possible for the government to refuse non-Russian-flagged ships carrying Russian oil products.
Van regeringswege is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om niet-Russisch gevlagde schepen met Russische olie(producten) te weren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de Klimaatcrisis-Index van Milieudefensie

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the Minister for Climate and Energy to react to Milieudefensie's Climate Crisis Index, which found no major polluter adequately addressing climate change, and asked about tackling scope 3 emissions and imposing climate obligations on firms receiving public green funds. The minister responded that the responsibility lies with companies and financial institutions supported by government instruments such as the EU ETS, CO2 levy, the planned EU due diligence directive and sector agreements, that scope 3 is addressed through subsidies and EU state-aid reform, and that subsidised firms are already bound by emission-reduction conditions.
When companies receive public funds for sustainability, these are already tied to conditions such as greenhouse gas emission reduction or circularity.
Als bedrijven publieke middelen ontvangen voor verduurzaming, zijn deze reeds gerelateerd aan voorwaarden zoals bijvoorbeeld broeikasgasemissiereductie of circulariteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over een reis per vliegtuig m.b.t. het staatsbezoek van de Koning en Koningin aan Oostenrijk

GroenLinks MPs asked why the royal state visit to Austria used a plane rather than a train, whether the royal carriage could be used for international rail travel, and how this fits sustainable transport policy. The minister replied that a train took over 12 hours versus about 1.5 hours by plane, that trains are considered but not always suitable, and that the royal carriage is already internationally approved and was last used abroad years ago.
For the route from the Netherlands to Austria, the train unfortunately was not (yet) a full alternative.
Voor het traject van Nederland naar Oostenrijk bleek de trein helaas (nog) geen volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de helmplicht voor snorfietsers

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the government did not adopt SWOV's advice to permit only the motorcycle helmet for snorfiets riders, and questions the safety, enforcement and effects of allowing the speed-pedelec helmet. The minister defends allowing the speed-pedelec helmet on TNO research, says enforcement is feasible, and rejects delaying the rule.
Permitting the speed-pedelec helmet for the snorfiets rider is a well-considered choice based on thorough TNO research into road safety.
Het toestaan van de speed-pedelec-helm voor de snorfietser is een weloverwogen keuze op basis van gedegen onderzoek door TNO naar de verkeersveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over asielopvang op cruiseschepen op zee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether housing asylum seekers on cruise ships at sea is being seriously pursued, and about its legal feasibility, humane conditions and the failure of talks with safety regions. The State Secretary replied that the option was examined but dropped due to disadvantages, that humane treatment is a criterion, and that the national asylum-capacity plan will be accelerated.
This option is therefore currently not being investigated further, as reported to your House on 28 July 2022.
Deze optie wordt daarom momenteel dan ook niet verder onderzocht, zoals aan uw Kamer gemeld dd. 28 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Romke de Jong en Kröger over het bericht ‘Sociaal ondernemen groeit (te) langzaam naar volwassenheid’

Three MPs asked the economy minister about a news report saying social enterprises grow too slowly, covering macro-economic weight, financing, local government procurement, scale-up barriers and the planned social-enterprise company form (BVm). The minister answered that data on their economic contribution is limited, financing is generally available, PIANOo and the City Deal support local governments, and the BVm bill will likely go to consultation end 2022 or early 2023 and reach parliament during 2023.
This means the bill can only be sent to the House for consideration in the course of 2023 at the earliest.
Dit betekent dat niet eerder dan in de loop van 2023 het wetsvoorstel voor behandeling naar de Kamer zal kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland geen gezonde leefomgeving biedt aan kinderen

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a UNICEF report finding that the Netherlands does not offer children a healthy living environment, covering air pollution, energy poverty, breakfast, noise, lead, pesticides and damp/mould. The government replied that the situation is not 'very worrying' but that there are attention points, pointed to the forthcoming National Environmental Programme, the Clean Air Agreement, energy allowances, lead-pipe measures and a broad mould-prevention approach, and promised to answer each question individually.
For that reason I would not call the situation in the Netherlands very worrying, although there are certainly points of attention that the Netherlands wants to address.
Om die reden zou ik de situatie in Nederland niet zeer zorgelijk willen noemen, al zijn er zeker aandachtspunten waar Nederland een been bij wil trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over het bericht ‘Verdriet en onbegrip over starre aanmeldprocedure in Ter Apel: 'Niemand kan dit uitleggen''

MPs Piri and Kröger asked why newly arriving family members (nareizigers) of asylum status holders must still register at the Ter Apel reception centre despite the shortage of places, and whether the obligation could be dropped. The Secretary of State answered that registration is needed for BRP enrolment, TB screening and identity checks, that a separate Zevenaar route exists for some groups, and that COA and IND are working towards a change by end 2022 without yet committing to scrapping the obligation.
I agree that it would be good if the process for family members whose sponsor takes part in the guest arrangement or hotel arrangement no longer burdened the reception in Ter Apel.

Ik deel dan ook dat het goed zou zijn als het proces voor nareizigers van wie de referent deelneemt aan de logeerregeling of de hotelregeling en de verblijfplaats van de vreemdeling ook opvangmogelijkheden biedt voor de nagereisde familieleden, niet meer de opvang in Ter Apel zou belasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer sterfgevallen door Groningse aardbevingsstress'

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the government about a report linking Groningen earthquake stress to possible deaths, and about actions taken, the link to research, psychological effects on residents and children, and the implementation of a motion on children's wellbeing. The state secretary said he was shocked, committed to ending gas extraction in 2023 or 2024, listed funding for social-emotional support and the Commission for Special Situations, and said the child-wellbeing motion was implemented through a research project and follow-up actions.
I am shocked by these figures and will meet with the researchers in July.
Ik ben geschrokken van deze cijfers en ga in juli met de onderzoekers in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen over de gasopslag in Bergermeer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister and State Secretary about Gazprom's control rights over the Bergermeer gas storage, whether the contracts will be shared with parliament, whether Gazprom can delay filling, why no filling obligation was imposed, what steps are being taken to end Gazprom's 40% usage right, and what additional measures will follow German escalation. The government answers that Gazprom holds a 5% participating interest with limited decision rights, the agreements are confidential and under discussion, Gazprom cannot block filling, a filling obligation was judged risky, legal options are being examined with the state advocate, and weekly fill-level updates will be provided.
The Gas Storage Agreement and Joint Operating Agreement were provided to me confidentially by EBN because they contain commercially confidential information.
De Gas Storage Agreement en Joint Operating Agreement zijn vertrouwelijk door EBN aan mij verstrekt omdat deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de onveilige omstandigheden voor kinderen in noodopvanglocaties zoals in Leeuwarden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about unsafe conditions for children in emergency asylum reception locations such as Leeuwarden, citing UNICEF and school staff warnings on stress, privacy, lack of support and suicidal thoughts. The State Secretary acknowledged the situation is undesirable, pointed to a shortage of reception capacity and listed child-support measures, privacy limits and planned structural solutions with municipalities.
It is undesirable that asylum seekers, and certainly children, stay in emergency reception locations.
Het is onwenselijk dat asielzoekers, en zeker kinderen, in noodopvanglocaties verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van de Raad van State over de overdracht van vreemdelingen aan Kroatië

Rep. Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the consequences of Council of State rulings that Dublin transfers to Croatia cannot proceed without further investigation, and about Frontex involvement in pushbacks and its leadership resignation. The government answered that it will gather additional information on Croatia, suspends Dublin transfers there, admits asylum applications where deadlines lapse, and says it actively opposes pushbacks while noting member states are primarily responsible for border control.
Until then, no asylum seekers will be transferred from the Netherlands to Croatia under the Dublin Regulation.
Tot die tijd worden vanuit Nederland geen asielzoekers op grond van de Dublinverordening overgedragen aan Kroatië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de opvang van Oekraïense ontheemden, asielzoekers en vergunninghouders

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the number of unused reception places for Ukrainian displaced persons, whether municipalities were asked to make them available for asylum seekers and status holders, and whether talks would be reopened given conditions at Ter Apel. The State Secretary replied that about 6,500 places were free, that the choice of locations rests with municipalities and that there is no overview of talks held, and that a further 150 places per safety region were agreed for asylum seekers, with no commitment to new talks beyond ongoing efforts.
The final choice to make a location available for displaced persons or asylum seekers/permit holders lies with the municipalities and not with me.
De uiteindelijke keuze om een locatie beschikbaar te stellen voor ontheemden of asielzoekers/vergunninghouders ligt bij de gemeenten en niet bij mij.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Lee, Kröger, Piri en Thijssen over het bericht dat Rusland stopt met het leveren van aardas aan Polen en Bulgarije

MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Russia halting gas supplies to Poland and Bulgaria, Dutch firms' dealings with Gazprom and Gazprombank, EU and Dutch preparedness for next winter, and whether Russian state firms like Gazprom can be sanctioned out of the Dutch energy system. The minister answered that Dutch firms' use of Gazprombank and new Gazprom contracts is unknown, that the Dutch plans are set out in earlier letters, that the Bergermeer storage cost levy is still being designed, and that the legal options to exclude Russian firms are under study with a further letter promised.
The House will be further informed about this.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk asielzoekers een enkele reis Rwanda geeft

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether the government shares concerns about the UK plan to send some asylum seekers one-way to Rwanda, including human rights and refugee convention compliance, and whether it would confront the UK. The government answered that the UK is outside EU asylum law but bound by the Refugee Convention and ECHR, that Rwanda's human rights concerns depend on implementation, and that it would raise the matter bilaterally or internationally only if international law were shown to be breached.
Should it turn out that the UK is thereby violating international law, the cabinet will raise this both bilaterally and internationally.
Wanneer zou blijken dat het VK hiermee internationaal recht schendt, zal het kabinet dit aankaarten op zowel bilateraal als internationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de onaanvaardbare toestanden op Aanmeldcentrum Ter Apel

An MP asks why structural solutions for the asylum reception shortage at Ter Apel have not been found, whether vacant Ukrainian reception places can be used, and whether people can be spared sleeping outside. The State Secretary acknowledges the night outside as unacceptable, points to a flexibilisation agenda, crisis emergency shelter and new locations, but gives no guarantee it will not recur.
I therefore consider it undesirable and inappropriate that we were unable for several hours to provide these people with a roof over their heads, and I regret this.
Ik vind het dan ook ongewenst en ongepast dat wij deze mensen een aantal uren geen dak boven het hoofd hebben kunnen bieden en dat betreur ik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over racisme aan de grens tussen Polen en Oekraïne

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about reports that non-white refugees were refused entry or mistreated at the Poland-Ukraine border and in Ukraine, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that no evidence of discrimination on the EU side was found, that border authorities say everyone is admitted, and that the government raised the issue with international organisations and will keep monitoring the situation.
After verification of the reports, the available information provided no indications of discrimination on the EU side of the border.
Na verificatie van de berichtgeving zijn er op grond van de beschikbare informatie geen aanwijzingen gevonden dat er sprake is van discriminatie aan de EU zijde van de grens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gasopslag in Bergermeer

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether Gazprom's non-use of its 40 percent storage right at Bergermeer threatens gas security, whether it lets money flow to Russia, whether Gazprom counts as a storage operator, and whether its right can be removed under the Gas Act. The government answered that Gazprom used little of its rights, that it earns no operating revenue, that TAQA is the operator, that the Gas Act offers no basis to revoke Gazprom's rights, and that it plans subsidies and designating EBN to fill the storage without nationalisation.
No, to fill the Bergermeer gas storage sufficiently for winter 2022/23 the cabinet intends to take the following two measures.
Nee, om de gasopslag Bergermeer voor de winter ’22/23 voldoende te vullen is het kabinet voornemens de volgende twee maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het onafhankelijk worden van Russisch gas

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about the EU's independence from Russian gas, including energy-saving scenarios, the Nationaal Isolatieprogramma, enforcement of existing energy-saving duties, SDE++ subsidies, and Gazprom's activities and contracts in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports ambitious EU energy-saving targets, announced a campagne and insulation programme, gave limited commitments on new duties while rejecting some proposals, and explained the sanctions framework that limits action against Gazprom entities.
It is undesirable that we as European countries contribute in this way to the Russian state coffers.
Het is onwenselijk dat we als Europese landen op deze manier bijdragen aan de Russische staatskas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kröger over verdrinkingen bij «pushbacks» bij de Egeïsche eilanden

MPs Piri and Kröger asked the Foreign Minister about alleged violent pushbacks in the Aegean that led to drownings, and what the government would do to stop them and to press Greece and the Commission. The minister answered that the Netherlands actively raises concerns about alleged pushbacks bilaterally and with the Commission, that the Commission can start infringement proceedings, that a Greek prosecutor's investigation is pending, and that a state visit to Greece is postponed.
The cabinet therefore actively takes a position against alleged pushbacks and raises this both in multilateral and bilateral contexts.
Het kabinet neemt dan ook actief stelling tegen vermeende pushbacks en kaart dit, zowel in multilateraal als bilateraal verband aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kroger over capaciteit en bereidheid van Nederland voor de opvang van eventuele vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Ellemeet and Kroger asked about Dutch capacity and willingness to receive refugees from Ukraine, including EU solidarity, reception numbers at COA, and activation of the Temporary Protection Directive. The government answered that Afghan evacuees are being transferred despite capacity concerns, that municipalities and safety regions are preparing thousands of reception places, and that the Temporary Protection Directive was activated at the JBZ Council.
The cabinet is receiving the first reports that surrounding countries are reaching the limits of their reception capacity.
Het kabinet ontvangt de eerste berichten dat omringende landen aan de grenzen van de opvangcapaciteit zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de zorgelijke situatie bij de voormalige kerncentrale in Tsjernobyl

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about the Chernobyl plant's staffing, power supply and radiation monitoring, and what diplomatic routes exist to fix them. The minister answered that the IAEA coordinates on-site risk mitigation, that the plant's grid connection was restored on 14 March, and that short-term radiological risk is considered low, with no new staff rotation yet possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Rotterdam woest over oliewinning onder de stad: 'Totaal ridicuul''

Green-left MP Kröger asked the minister about plans by NAM to continue oil extraction under Rotterdam, including the permit process, consultation with Rotterdam and Barendrecht, subsidence, new techniques such as hydraulic stimulation, and consistency with climate goals. The state secretary answered that municipal advice was partly adopted, that the draft decision remains open to objections, and that the subsidence and environmental risks are considered minimal, while leaving some questions, such as the total remaining reserves, only loosely answered.
The advice of the municipality of Rotterdam, together with all other advice I requested, has been weighed in the draft decision and has been partly adopted.
Het advies van de gemeente Rotterdam heb ik, samen met alle andere door mij gevraagde adviezen, meegewogen in het ontwerpbesluit en is gedeeltelijk overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kröger over het containerverlies van de Marcos V boven de Waddeneilanden

MPs De Hoop and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of 26 containers from the Marcos V above the Wadden islands, including salvage costs, Kustwacht powers during storms, the Julietta D incident, and protection of offshore infrastructure. The minister answered that the shipowner pays for salvage, that the Kustwacht can advise but cannot forbid routes or intervene generically under the Wbmo, and that Dutch-German-Danish proposals to the IMO are underway, with further letters promised before the summer recess.
I therefore cannot apply the intervention power in a generic sense, for example to a certain category of ships or in certain circumstances.
Ik kan de interventiebevoegdheid dus niet in generieke zin toepassen, bijvoorbeeld op een bepaalde categorie schepen, of in bepaalde omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de tv-uitzending 'Energierekening óók fors omhoog als je huis niet met gas wordt verwarmd'

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a broadcast claiming heat-network households pay high prices because heat tariffs are linked to the gas price, and about options to regulate energy prices, the gas crisis plan, and gas use by industry. The Minister said cost-based tariff regulation is being prepared, that ACM has new powers and closer oversight, and that the government is preparing crisis measures and examining Groningen gas output limits.
I therefore agree with ACM's warning to heat suppliers not to raise their tariffs.
Ik sluit me dan ook aan bij de waarschuwing van de ACM aan warmteleveranciers om de tarieven niet te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de verblijfsprocedure van de Haarlemse Amine

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Dutch-born young adult, Amine, still lacked residence rights and whether the IND should decide or refer the case to a judge. The State Secretary said the application had already been granted, declined to discuss individual cases, and pointed to the general assessment criteria in the published work instruction.
As agreed with your House, I will not go into individual cases in substance.
Zoals met uw Kamer is afgesproken ga ik niet inhoudelijk in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Kröger en Bouchallikh over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Climate and Education about labour shortages blocking climate ambitions, retraining routes, support for career changers and a proposed work-guarantee fund. The ministers answered that labour market shortages are broad, that government role is limited and employers and workers bear primary responsibility, that existing retraining schemes and a forthcoming Action Plan for Green Jobs are being developed, and they rejected a work-guarantee fund as not efficient.
The cabinet does not have an overview of all retraining routes for career changers aimed at the energy transition.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van alle opleidingstrajecten voor zij-instromers, die gericht zijn op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Van Raan over het bericht 'Shell moet reclame over 'miljoenen schone kilometers' direct aanpassen'

Three MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that Shell must amend misleading 'clean kilometres' advertising, and about whether fossil fuel advertising slows the energy transition, whether the Commission is effective, and whether a ban on fossil advertising is warranted. The Minister welcomed the Commission's scrutiny of advertising accuracy, said advertising is permitted if not misleading, and declined to assess the Commission's functioning or to commit to a fossil advertising ban, citing existing climate instruments.
In this capacity I have no view on the conduct or functioning of the Reclame Code Commissie.
Ik heb in deze hoedanigheid geen oordeel over het optreden of het functioneren van de Reclame Code Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het winnen van extra gas uit het Groningenveld

GroenLinks MP Kröger asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about how much extra gas might be extracted from the Groningen field, German supply rights, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, Groningen subsidy problems, and appeal options. The State Secretary largely deferred decisions to a 1 April 2022 choice on production levels and promised further letters, while describing the supply and crisis-plan arrangements and the subsidy increases.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a final decision on the production level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de restricties die veel landen nu opleggen aan Aeroflot en andere Russische luchtvaartmaatschappijen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether KLM should keep code-sharing with Aeroflot and whether the Netherlands will close its airspace to Russian civil aviation. The minister answered that KLM has suspended the code-sharing with Aeroflot and that Dutch airspace has been closed to Russian aviation, but did not address whether the alliance choice was otherwise desirable beyond citing commercial reasons.
KLM has suspended the code sharing with Aeroflot and is working on the technical implementation of this.
KLM heeft de code sharing met Aeroflot opgeschort en is bezig met de technische verwerking daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Grote problemen op stroomnet, provincies willen kiezen wie aansluiting krijgt'

MPs Kröger and Bontenbal asked the minister about reports that provinces want to choose which companies get grid connections, and about giving provinces a bigger role in energy infrastructure. The minister sympathised with prioritisation but said priority-setting at connection stage conflicts with EU non-discrimination rules, so he will explore prioritisation earlier via spatial planning and objective, transparent investment criteria, and report by summer.
I am examining whether provinces and municipalities can set priorities and make selections at an earlier stage, via the zoning plan and other instruments of environmental law.
Zo onderzoek ik of provincies en gemeenten in een eerder stadium kunnen prioriteiten en selecteren via het bestemminsplan en andere instrumenten uit de omgevingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de uitzending van de Keuringsdienst van Waarde over 'Bij-vriendelijke planten'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast showing pesticide residues on plants sold as bee-friendly was true, whether this misleads consumers and harms insects, and whether labelling warnings should be required. The minister answered that pesticides are approved only after risk assessment including insects, that misleading claims are for the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie to judge, and that warning labels are not needed.

Pesticides are only authorised in the Netherlands if a scientific risk assessment by the College for the Authorisation of Plant Protection Products and Biocides shows that they are safe for humans, animals and the environment when used according to the rules.

Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden in Nederland alleen toegelaten als uit een wetenschappelijke risicobeoordeling van het College voor de Toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en Biociden blijkt dat ze volgens de voorschriften veilig zijn voor mens, dier en milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Nijboer, Thijssen en Kröger over de rode loper voor datacenter Zeewolde

MPs asked whether ministries actively courted Facebook/Meta for a Zeewolde data centre, gave it priority on the high-voltage grid, and whether the data centre's energy, heat and diesel backup impacts were addressed. The ministers answered that NFIA was approached by Meta, that the connection was legally permissible without priority, and that many questions on energy, heat and jobs are left to the municipality or are unknown, while promising a national data centre strategy later.
There is no question of "priority" for Meta's connection to the high-voltage grid.
Er is geen sprake van «voorrang» voor aansluiting van Meta op het hoogspanningsnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kröger over de uitzending van het programma Hofbar op 2 februari 2022

MPs Omtzigt and Kröger asked why the state secretary took part in a TV broadcast on wastewater injection in Twente while questions on the same issue were still pending, and why the ministry published a 'milieuneutral' permit change that loosened toluene limits. The state secretary answered that the broadcast reflected transparency toward media, that the injection was halted by the regulator and operator, that the permit application was withdrawn, and that the motion would be implemented via a separate letter.
The manner in which the motion by Member Mulder et al. will be implemented will be communicated to the House today by letter.
Over de wijze waarop de motie van lid Mulder c.s. wordt uitgevoerd wordt uw Kamer heden via een brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Afvalwaterinjectie in Twente gaat ondanks motie gewoon door’

An MP asked why the wastewater injection in Twente continues despite a parliamentary motion, and what legal grounds exist to suspend the permits and when research results will be published. The Staatssecretaris answered that no legal basis currently allows suspension, that a re-evaluation is due by 1 July 2022 with a decision afterwards, and that research results on wells ROW-2 and ROW-7 will be made public.
As long as NAM complies with the conditions of the permit, there is no legal basis to halt the activities covered by the permit.
Zolang NAM zich aan de voorschriften in de vergunning houdt, is er geen rechtsgrond om de activiteiten die onder de vergunning vallen stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Stop op boorvergunningen moet einde tijdperk olie en gas inluiden'

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked whether the government will coordinate with Germany and Denmark on Wadden Sea World Heritage management, the UNESCO letter, and a joint halt to fossil extraction there. The minister said the trilateral conference is planned for late 2022, the UNESCO reply was coordinated with partners, and she is willing to explore extending the coalition's no-new-licences ambition to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

I am willing to explore together with Germany and Denmark whether the coalition agreement's ambition to issue no new gas extraction licences under the Wadden Sea after the Ternaard procedure is completed can also apply to the trilateral Wadden Sea.

Ik ben bereid om samen met Duitsland en Denemarken te verkennen of de ambitie uit het coalitieakkoord 2 om na afronding van de procedure voor Ternaard geen nieuwe vergunningen voor gaswinning onder de Waddenzee af te geven ook kan gelden voor de trilaterale Waddenzee.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het strafproces tegen een Nederlander voor zijn hulp aan vluchtelingen op Lesbos

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about the Greek criminal prosecution of a 73-year-old Dutch volunteer for rescuing and aiding refugees on Lesbos, including whether Nationally consular help was given and whether EU law forbids criminalising such aid. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual case, said the Netherlands will not interfere in Greek proceedings, outlined consular assistance, and argued that the Commission's guidance is not binding and that the government disagrees with its reading on NGO sea rescue.
The Netherlands cannot and will not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country, just as the Netherlands expects other countries not to do so in our legal proceedings.
Nederland kan en wil zich niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land mengen, net zoals Nederland verwacht dat andere landen dat niet doen in onze rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de sluiting van de Onyx-centrale

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the 212.5 million euro subsidy for closing the Onyx coal plant is so high, whether it could be corrected for market developments, how the workers' social plan is secured, and whether ETS allowances and sensitive documents will be withdrawn or disclosed. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was checked for overcompensation, is conditional on a social plan and state-aid approval, that a letter on ETS allowances will follow, and that confidential business information prevents publication of the subsidy decision, though the documents were made available to parliament confidentially.
Because of business-confidential information, I cannot make the subsidy decision and the underlying advice public.
Vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik het subsidiebesluit en de onderliggende adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over de onveilige situatie in Georgië voor asielzoekers met een LHBTI-achtergrond

MPs Kröger, Van Dijk and Teunissen asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether Georgia remains unsafe for LHBTI asylum seekers and whether it should stop being treated as a safe country of origin for this group, including whether removals should be halted. The State Secretary replied that the designation of Georgia as a safe country of origin continues, with heightened attention for LHBTI cases, that no change in the situation is seen, and that no halt to removals is warranted, while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over de brief van UNESCO inzake de voorgenomen gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

Three MPs asked whether UNESCO had sent a letter on protecting the Wadden Sea and possible gas extraction beneath it, and whether it could be shared with a cabinet appraisal. The State Secretary confirmed UNESCO letters of 7 May and 30 November 2021, said the Ternaard gas production is assessed under UNESCO principles with a decision expected in March 2022, and that the cabinet plans to reply to UNESCO in January 2022.
The cabinet intends to send a letter to UNESCO with a response in January 2022.
Het kabinet is voornemens om in januari 2022 een brief te sturen aan UNESCO met een reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over “de Mijnbouwregeling”

An MP asked whether the 2019 Mining Regulation sets maximum earthquake levels that trigger ministerial intervention in the Groningen gas production plan, and questioned the regulation's value if no consequences follow from exceeding its norms. The minister replied that the regulation only sets monitoring parameters and reporting duties for NAM, not binding maxima, that the minister intervenes on the basis of the Mining Act and SodM advice, and that SodM sees no further short-term measures available.
The purpose of the monitoring is to keep track of the development of seismicity.
Het doel van de monitoring is om de ontwikkeling van seismiciteit in de gaten te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel ‘Injectie van afvalwater in Rossum wordt over twee weken hervat’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the inspection history and continued use of water injection well Rossum 7 in Twente, including whether its cement casing was checked and whether economic interests influenced keeping it in use. The minister answered that NAM inspected the well in November 2021, that SodM supervises the tests and decides when injection may resume, and that SodM alone decides on closures for safety and environmental reasons.
SodM is authorised to close a well if there are safety or environmental reasons to do so.
SodM is bevoegd om een put te sluiten als er met betrekking tot veiligheid en of het milieu daartoe redenen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over 'Geef jongeren nu toegang tot de sneltesten'

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the health minister about an opinion piece calling for youth access to rapid tests, and about OMT advice and the reopening of secondary schools in February 2021. The minister confirmed the questions were put to the OMT, that a generic framework exists for secondary education, and listed the OMT advice issued, but could not answer each question one by one in time due to a system migration.
The cabinet bases itself on the adopted OMT advice.
Het kabinet baseert zich op de vastgestelde OMT adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Runderen langs Waal zitten vol gif, verkoop van ‘oervlees’ stilgelegd’

MPs Kröger and Dik-Faber asked about reports of high dioxin levels in cattle grazing along the Waal and whether the sale of their meat, and swimming in contaminated rivers, poses health risks. The State Secretary answered that dioxin in riverbed sediment was not routinely tested, that NVWA-initiated research into grazing cattle is pending (expected mid-2021), that swimming exposure is below health limits, and that no general sales stop or new disposal measures are currently warranted.

After the NVWA-initiated research is completed, the departments involved will assess whether further research into dioxins in the riverbed near the floodplains is needed at locations that are frequently flooded.

Na afronding van door de NVWA geïnitieerd onderzoek wordt met betrokken departementen bezien of nader onderzoek van dioxinen in de waterbodem in de nabijheid van de uiterwaarden nodig is op locaties waar frequent overstroming plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the ministers whether the government would honour the House's controversial declaration on Lelystad Airport and refrain from irreversible steps, including continuing the permit procedure, given the statutory decision deadline. Minister Schouten answered that the permit is a legally required individual procedure separate from political decision-making, that the deadline is an order term but binding and cannot be suspended, and that she will not pause the procedure.
A controversial declaration by the House of Representatives does not constitute grounds for me to invoke force majeure in the case of this permit application.
Een controversieel-verklaring door de Tweede Kamer vormt geen grond om mij te mogen beroepen op overmacht in het geval van deze vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Bospaden worden verhard met plastic bouwafval'

Green Left MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about reports that Staatsbosbeheer surfaces forest paths with plastic-contaminated construction waste, and whether the 1% contamination limit is respected and what harms result. The State Secretary answered that certified suppliers are used, that the limit applies by weight and volume, that the impact on nature is not yet fully known (RIVM research expected early 2022), and that the government will study tighter regulation of recycled granulate and engage stakeholders.
However, I will investigate whether there are possibilities to better regulate the use of recycled granulate.
Ik ga echter onderzoeken of er mogelijkheden zijn om de toepassing van recyclinggranulaat beter te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'MEPs pressure France and Britain to save Eurostar'

MP Kröger asked the state secretary about the current situation of Eurostar, the state of talks with Belgium, France and Britain, and whether the Netherlands would contribute financially or ask NS to compensate. The state secretary replied that the situation is unchanged, talks on possible state support are ongoing, Eurostar received a NOW subsidy of €20,152, further support is primarily for shareholders, and NS and Eurostar are discussing their cooperation terms.

I am closely following my colleagues' discussions on this matter, particularly where developments could affect the continuity of the direct link between Amsterdam and London, and will act appropriately if necessary.

Ik volg de gesprekken van mijn ambtgenoten over deze kwestie nauwgezet, in het bijzonder waar het ontwikkelingen betreft die zouden kunnen raken aan de continuïteit van de directe verbinding tussen Amsterdam en Londen en zal indien nodig passend acteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de artikelen ‘Nieuw onderzoek 'probleemkanaal' Almelo-De Haandrik:’Provincie was grip van begin af aan kwijt’ en ‘Provincie: rapport naar probleemkanaal Almelo-De Haa

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Deltares and Van Baars reports on damage to homes caused by deepening the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, about who is responsible for compensation and whether the Rijk has a role. The Minister answered that the canal is a provincial waterway, that the Rijk has no role in the project or its compensation, and that the province is responsible for the necessary steps.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway for which the province carries out waterway management.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg waar de provincie het vaarwegbeheer uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger, Moorlag, Schonis en Van Esch over het vervangen van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de aangenomen motie-Laçin c.s. (Kamerstuk 35570-A, nr. 30)

MPs asked the minister about the replacement of the Paddepoelsterbrug in Groningen, including whether agreements for a low movable bridge still stand after a 2021 motion. The minister said talks with residents and stakeholders continue, that a 2020 MIRT agreement provides for a fixed bridge at 9.10 metres with ramps and a €8.6 million federal contribution, and that the agreement is on hold pending the motion, while defending the drawbacks of a low bridge.
After concluding an administrative agreement, I will transfer the financial resources and implementation by the municipality of Groningen can begin.
Na het sluiten van een bestuursovereenkomst zal ik de financiële middelen overdragen en kan de uitvoering door de gemeente Groningen beginnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Smeulders over de onderbetaling van medewerkers bij de Coronacallcenters

MPs Smeulders and Kröger asked why the government again contracted Teleperformance for the corona callcenters, whether working conditions and pension accrual were tender criteria, and whether the government would intervene on underpayment and pensions. The minister replied that GGD GHOR chose Teleperformance because no other party could deliver in time, that the contract required compliance with labour law and any applicable CAO, and that the government is not the formal employer so it will not intervene or meet Teleperformance.
As far as I am aware, there are no signals that Teleperformance does not comply with the applicable laws and regulations or fails to apply any applicable CAO.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen signalen dat Teleperformance niet voldoet aan de geldende wet-en regelgeving en een eventueel geldende cao niet toepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Esch over het bericht 'Bewoners op achterstand gezet in strijd tegen verbreding A27: ‘Hoort niet zo in een democratie’

MPs asked whether the A27/A12 Utrecht route decision was taken without updated traffic and nitrogen analyses, without the Commission for EIA's full review, and whether the Crisis- and Recovery Act's limits on local government appeals are compatible with democracy. The minister declined to discuss the substance because an appeal is pending, defended the procedure and the Act's restriction on decentralised appeals, and pointed to the publicly available reports.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing, I cannot go into the substance of the decision towards your House.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt, kan ik richting uw Kamer niet op de inhoud van het besluit ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het EMK-terrein (Exploitatie Maatschappij Krimpen) in Krimpen aan den IJssel toekomen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the condition of the sheet-pile walls around the contaminated EMK site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, the PFAS in groundwater, the scope of contamination, citizen and business participation, the sanitation costs and the cost-benefit of partial cleanup. The State Secretary answered that the walls are in reasonable to good condition and sufficient to isolate contamination, while acknowledging that they do not meet current stricter safety standards and that reinforcement will follow, and gave cost figures and a commitment to consult the working group before any revised plan.

Although the sheet piles may deviate in parts from the original design and do not meet current, stricter safety standards, the measurement results show that the sheet piles together with groundwater extraction sufficiently isolate the contamination

Hoewel de damwanden mogelijk op onderdelen afwijken van het oorspronkelijke ontwerp en niet aan de huidige, strengere, veiligheidsnormen voor damwanden voldoen, blijkt uit de meetresultaten dat de damwanden in combinatie met de grondwateronttrekking, de verontreiniging voldoende isoleren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over vervuilende dieselauto’s

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the government studied the air quality, public health and social cost effects of loosening the emission test rules for polluting diesel cars, including the new APK test and transition period. The state secretary answered that a structural reduction of 121 thousand kg of fine particles is expected, about 7% less than the earlier estimate, with health benefits of 20.6 million euro, that the health effects will be assessed later by RIVM, and that the new test complies with EU rules and the Schone Lucht Akkoord.
The effect of the new APK test on public health will be included in the biennial calculation of the health indicator, which RIVM will carry out under the Clean Air Agreement.

Het effect van de nieuwe APK-test voor de volksgezondheid wordt meegenomen in de tweejaarlijkse doorrekening van de gezondheidsindicator, die in het kader van het Schone Lucht Akkoord door het RIVM zal worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van den Berge over de vaccinatiestrategie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Health how homeless people, undocumented residents, unmanaged-budget recipients, informal carers and children of undocumented parents will be reached, informed, registered and vaccinated under the COVID-19 vaccination strategy. The Minister answered all 13 questions one by one, giving timing based on expected supply and Health Council risk groups, outlining outreach through organisations like the Leger des Heils, and stating that children under 18 are not yet being vaccinated.
We will soon discuss with the organisations where these groups are known (including the Salvation Army) how this harder-to-reach target group can best be informed.
We gaan binnenkort met de organisaties waar deze groepen bekend zijn (o.a. het Leger des Heils) in gesprek over de vraag hoe deze moeilijker bereikbare doelgroep het beste geïnformeerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over luchtvaart en corona

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the minister about RIVM sewage monitoring at Schiphol for coronavirus, why the data is not public, flight passenger numbers from the UK and South Africa, and refusals of non-Schengen arrivals. The minister answered that the Schiphol sampling continues but is not published because it cannot be compared with municipal sites, that passenger data and refusal statistics are provided, and that some data (variant testing, nationality of all travellers) is unavailable.
Schiphol cannot provide country-specific passenger figures because the information is highly competitively sensitive.
Schiphol kan, in verband met de zeer concurrentiegevoelige aard van de informatie, geen landenspecifieke cijfers over passagiersaantallen verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'VK scherpt inreisregels aan'

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister how the Netherlands would prevent spread of the new Brazilian COVID-19 variant, including flight numbers from affected areas, rapid tests before departure and quarantine compliance. The minister answered that flight bans were imposed on the UK, South Africa, Brazil and other countries, that travellers need negative PCR or rapid test results, that a quarantine obligation is being examined, and that Schiphol flights from Brazil were zero per day while Portugal averaged three.
The cabinet is currently examining whether a quarantine obligation can be introduced.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel of er een quarantaineplicht kan worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel ‘Pollutionwatch: fine particles affect lungs of those near airports’

An MP asked the government about a study on ultrafine particles near Schiphol, why its results were not shared with parliament, and what follow-up is planned. The minister answered that the interim report was sent to parliament in June 2019, that the study covers short-term exposure only, and that final reports are expected at end 2021.

By letter of 27 June 2019, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, on behalf of the Minister, sent parliament an interim report of the RIVM study on ultrafine particles at Schiphol.

337 ) heeft de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat mede namens de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat een tussenrapportage van het «RIVM-onderzoek ultrafijn stof Schiphol» aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de vaccinatiestrategie

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Health Minister why the COVID-19 vaccination rollout in the Netherlands is slower than abroad, why GGDs started site planning late, and about the invitation system, staffing, testing capacity and vaccine wastage. The minister answers that the first vaccinations were given on 6 January, that central sites were chosen on RIVM advice because of cold-storage and wastage concerns, and that most questions are answered by reference to earlier letters.

Because of the deep-frozen storage conditions combined with the limited shelf life after thawing, the specific delivery method, and to prevent as much wastage as possible, the cabinet opted in early December, on RIVM advice, to administer the BioNTech/Pfizer vaccine at central locations.

Vanwege de diepgevroren bewaarcondities in combinatie met de beperkte houdbaarheid na ontdooien, de specifieke wijze van levering, én om zo veel mogelijk spillage te voorkomen, heeft het kabinet begin december op advies van het RIVM gekozen voor toediening van het BioNTech/Pfizer vaccin via centrale locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over sneltesten

An MP asked the health minister how many rapid COVID-19 tests are in stock broken down by manufacturer and type, the forecast for rapid test procurement, the estimated number of private rapid tests, and for answers before 19 November. The minister listed five validated antigen test manufacturers, reported about 6.8 million tests in stock at end November, said procurement would be increased toward 10 million tests per month, said private test numbers are unknown, and said answers before 19 November were not possible.
The numbers of antigen (rapid) tests administered there are not known to me.
De aantallen antigeen(snel)testen die daar worden afgenomen zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Stoffer en Van Raan over stikstofberekeningen

MPs asked the minister about a 2014 review by Arcadis and NLR of nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport, including the review's findings, its commissioning, and the NLR role, with documents to be shared within a week. The minister answered that the concept memo was attached, that flagged points were corrected in a June 2014 addendum, that the commissioning contract is withheld as commercially confidential, and that new project-specific assessments will be done with updated models.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over de berichtgeving ‘Gommers en Kuipers: 'Begin maandag met vaccineren ziekenhuispersoneel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister whether he would heed calls by intensivist Gommers and hospital director Kuipers to start vaccinating essential hospital staff immediately, given rising sick leave and postponed treatments, and when staff such as ICU, emergency and ambulance workers would be eligible. The minister replied only by referring to a broader letter on the COVID-19 vaccination strategy update.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 vaccination strategy update status'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 vaccinatiestrategie update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Export verarmd Urenco-uranium naar Rusland in strijd Europese sancties'

An MP from GroenLinks asks whether exporting depleted uranium from Urenco Gronau via the Netherlands to Russia violates EU sanctions, whether an export permit is required, and how the Netherlands ensures no goods are exported in breach of sanctions. The minister replies that the export is permitted for civil end use under the NPT and NSG guidelines, that the Netherlands cannot take over the German permitting authority's role, and that customs and the ministry supervise sanctions compliance.
There are no indications that Russia does not comply with its international obligations under the NPT.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat Rusland zich niet houdt aan zijn internationale verplichtingen onder het NPV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Klaver over het COVID-19 virus

MPs Kröger and Klaver asked the Health Minister about the RIVM guidance distinguishing 'vluchtig' from 'niet-vluchtig' contact for protective equipment in care, the delay in revising it, mask stocks and prices, regional versus national COVID measures, and whether the OMT should be reconvened. The minister answered that the guidance was a risk-based set of principles that could be departed from professionally, that the revision in August reflected practical problems rather than new science, that masks stocks were sufficient, and that regional measures were preferred with national action when needed.
The Ministry of VWS has no substantive role in determining the guidelines.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen inhoudelijke rol bij het vaststellen van de uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kröger over het mogelijk instellen van een (regionale) avondklok-maatregel

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would use the Coordination Act on states of emergency or the Act on extraordinary powers of civil authority to impose a (regional) evening curfew during the COVID-19 pandemic, and why it now considered this after earlier saying a state of emergency was not necessary. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a curfew is not currently on the table, that it would be based on article 8 of the Wbbbg without declaring a state of emergency, that parliament would be informed in advance by royal decree, and that no substantive weighing of curfew measures has yet been made.
Of an intention to do so, notice will be given to the States General, so that views can be exchanged between government and States General if desired, unless urgency prevents it.

Van een voornemen daartoe zal mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld, tenzij de vereiste spoed zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het COVID-19 reproductiegetal (R)

An MP asked the health minister whether incomplete reporting of positive results from commercial test sites undermines the reliability of the COVID-19 reproduction number R, and how it is calculated. The minister answered that under-reporting is limited, that inspection and reporting duties are enforced, and that R is checked against hospital-admission-based estimates.
My efforts are therefore aimed at receiving all positive results from commercial test sites.
Mijn inspanningen zijn er dus op gericht om alle positieve uitslagen van commerciële teststraten te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over het bericht ‘Asbest gevonden in make-up van Douglas en Hema’

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked whether the minister would act after asbestos was found in make-up sold by Douglas and Hema, and whether a broad investigation into talc use in cosmetics would be launched. The minister called asbestos in cosmetics unacceptable, said the NVWA is checking whether further investigation or enforcement is needed, but declined a broad new investigation, citing a 2018 study that found asbestos in only 2 of nearly 300 samples.
The NVWA supervises compliance with the legislation and enforces where necessary.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving en treedt zo nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Betalen ziekenhuizen de rekening van het afval van de kerncentrale Borssele?'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked about reports that hospitals may bear costs of radioactive waste from Borssele and whether COVRA discriminates against small waste producers. The state secretary answers that COVRA applies uniform tariffs for standard waste, that the ANVS withdrew its intended penalty after COVRA provided information, and that a regulatory framework for financing waste management still needs to be developed.
From my department, consultation on this elaboration will be started with, in the first instance, the Ministry of Finance and the ANVS.
Vanuit mijn departement wordt het overleg over deze uitwerking opgestart met in eerste instantie het Ministerie van Financiën en de ANVS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Schaarste testmaterialen dreigt, Nederlandse producten verdwijnen naar buitenland’

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the Health Minister whether shortages of PCR test materials are looming, why Dutch-based producer Bioplastics supplies only two percent of its output to the Netherlands, and whether shortages can be ruled out. The minister answered that stocks of tubes, swabs and cartridges are adequate, that filter tips are a critical item being actively sourced, and that a Dutch cartridge production line and alternative tests are being pursued, though individual laboratories may still face shortages.
I note that there is currently no need for the centrally purchased cartridges.
Ik constateer dat aan de centraal ingekochte cartridges momenteel geen behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de export van plasticafval en gesjoemel met recyclingdoelstellingen

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about plastic waste exports to Turkey, unverifiable downstream recycling, and possibly inflated recycling statistics, and whether the EU should ban plastic waste exports. The state secretary confirms export volumes rose to 34 kton in 2019, says Dutch oversight stops at the EU border and in Turkey, points to stricter EU measurement rules from 2021, and rejects the claims of deliberate misreporting while rejecting a full export ban as not feasible.
However, the Netherlands has no means to supervise in Turkey the actual useful application on site.
Nederland heeft echter geen mogelijkheden in Turkije toezicht te houden op de daadwerkelijke nuttige toepassing ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kröger en Van den Berge over maatregelen tegen verspreiding COVID-19 op scholen

MPs from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about poor school ventilation, school closures due to COVID-19 infections, online education for quarantined pupils, mask rules and related guidance. The minister answered that schools are responsible for ventilation improvements supported by €100 million short-term and €260 million long-term funding, and outlined existing monitoring, advice and guidance without committing to new binding measures.
In addition, I call on schools to share the results with staff and parents.
Daarnaast roep ik op de resultaten te delen met het personeel en de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gif terrein in Krimpen aan den IJssel toekomen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the EMK chemical waste site in Krimpen aan den IJssel, including why it was isolated rather than cleaned in the 1980s, the costs of groundwater management, the sheet-pile condition, and the stalled remediation. The state secretary answered that the IBC isolation approach was chosen for cost and feasibility reasons, that the site is now being reoriented because of additional contamination, PFAS and disposal problems, and that the partners are reviewing options including the stakeholder group.
For that reason, the administrative partners have jointly decided to reorient the implementation of the project.
Daarom hebben de bestuurlijke partners gezamenlijk besloten tot een heroriëntatie op de uitvoering van het project.
