Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht ‘Provincie Noord-Brabant: wie een weg wil aanleggen, mag nu de stikstof van een boer kopen’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about provinces allowing external netting of nitrogen rights from livestock farms, concerns about wealthy buyers, the 30% nature share, leasing of nitrogen space, and the SRM2 road-modelling method criticised by the Hordijk advisory committee. The minister answered that the provincial opening follows agreed policy, that monitoring and evaluation control the risks, that AERIUS remains the basis for permits, and that a reaction to the advisory committee is forthcoming.
The cabinet takes the advice of all advisory committees extremely seriously, and therefore also that of the Advisory Committee on Measuring and Calculating Nitrogen.
Het kabinet neemt de adviezen van alle Adviescolleges uiterst serieus, en dus ook die van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gemaakte kosten voor Lelystad Airport

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister to confirm costs of Lelystad Airport, the Schiphol dividend effect, government spending on information and advocacy, and subsidies to pro-airport bodies such as the Lelystad Airportkrant and a foundation supporting the airport. The minister answers that the costs were shared with Follow the Money, that dividend impact cannot be determined ex post, that the Lelystad Airportkrant and the foundation receive no ministry funding, and that the public is informed objectively.
I cannot make any statements about that.
Daarover kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Onnodig veel gevaarlijke stoffen in rivieren: lozingsvergunningen flink verouderd’

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that hazardous substances such as benzene, lead and vinyl chloride still enter rivers under outdated discharge permits, asking about drinking water effects, how many permits are outdated, BBT compliance, monitoring, and Rijkswaterstaat's capacity and priorities. The minister answered that the three substances did not exceed EU water norms in 2017-2019, that about three quarters of roughly 800 permits need adjustment, that a multi-year structural approach with periodic review every 4 to 8 years will be implemented, and that the advisory report is attached.
In about 50% of the permits reviewed in the pilot, there were discharges of ZZS.
Bij circa 50% van de vergunningen die in de pilot zijn bezien, was er sprake van lozingen van ZZS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over de stikstofberekeningen 2014 Lelystad Airport

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 2014 nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport's environmental impact report (MER) were corrected, covering routes, study area, time units, deposition summation and software. The minister answered in detail, attributing the discrepancies to a units error, an enlarged study area, a summation error on a computer system, and stating that the corrected deposition is at most 0.4 mol/ha/year and that the result files have been made public under the Wob.
This correction led to an increase in emissions by a factor of 5 (rounded).
Dit herstel heeft geleid tot een toename van de emissies met een factor 5 (afgerond).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

MP Kröger asked the state secretary why the government had not yet committed to investigating the link between air pollution and COVID-19 infection risk, and why the review covered only livestock farming rather than industry and traffic. The state secretary answered that RIVM has been asked to scope research options, that the government will decide on commissioning research and inform parliament in autumn, and that air-quality measures and monitoring under the Clean Air Agreement continue.
Once the research options have been mapped out, my colleagues at LNV and VWS and I will decide whether, and if so which, studies to commission from RIVM.
Nadat de onderzoeksmogelijkheden in kaart zijn gebracht zullen mijn collega's van LNV en VWS en ikzelf besluiten of en zo ja, welke onderzoeken we willen uitzetten bij het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

An MP asks whether widening motorways can proceed under nitrogen rules given a claim that traffic emissions beyond 5 km are excluded, and whether the 100 km/h speed-limit reduction is double-counted and attributed to nature. The minister replies that SRM2 with a 5 km maximum range is used for project calculations, that long-range emissions are captured in national monitoring, that the 30% nature allocation is a policy starting point, and that the government will proceed with existing legal frameworks while legal staff are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over ammoniumnitraat

A GroenLinks MP asked the Infrastructure and Water Management ministry about a ship carrying 7,009 tonnes of ammonium nitrate moored in Rotterdam's Merwehaven, including whether it met limits, why it called at Rotterdam, and why the Yara site is not listed as explosive on the risk map. The state secretary answered that the cargo was a non-explosive oxidising substance, that the ship and packaging met legal requirements, that sea transport is governed by the IMDG code, and that no changes to port planning policy were planned.
The ship in question and the packaging complied with the statutory requirements.
Het desbetreffende schip en de verpakking voldeed aan de wettelijke voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over overschrijdingen van de geluidsnormen bij Schiphol

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister why Schiphol exceeded noise norms in 2019 under the new standards, whether enforcement is possible, and how the new regime will be legally anchored. The minister answered that exceedances at 6 of 35 enforcement points stem from strict preferential runway use under the new regime, that the ILT will not sanction such exceedances, and that legal anchoring awaits environmental and nature assessments.
Enforcement of the rules and limit values of the NNHS as such is only possible after they are legally anchored in the LVB.
Handhaving van de regels en grenswaarden van het NNHS als zodanig is pas mogelijk na wettelijke verankering daarvan in het LVB.

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Duitsland spoort veel besmettingen op', 'Van nieuwe Duitse virusdragers werd 40% besmet in het buitenland'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked the health minister about the share of new Dutch infections acquired abroad, why Schiphol testing is limited to daytime hours and a daily cap, and whether overland travellers and other airports are tested. The minister answered that about 5 to 12 percent of recent cases had a travel history, that the Schiphol testing trial was running at a limited scale and is being evaluated by RIVM, and that future testing decisions will follow those results.
Based on the results from RIVM, we will consider how to proceed with testing incoming travellers at airports.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van het RIVM zullen we bezien hoe we verder gaan met het testen van inkomende reizigers op luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether air pollution raises COVID-19 infection risk and what research and measures would follow, citing World Bank and Harvard studies. The state secretary answered that the studies are only ecological signals without proof of causation, that human-to-human transmission drives spread, and that research on air quality and COVID-19 is being scoped with RIVM before decisions are taken.
RIVM has been asked to carry out an exploration of research options on the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderijen en COVID-19.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Onverkochte ‘kledingbergen’ door corona, maar ook roep om duurzame herstart’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of unsold clothing stockpiles caused by COVID-19, the scale of disposal, the status of research on destruction of unsold goods, and steps toward a circular textile sector. The State Secretary answered that sales fell sharply, that industry bodies deny a stockpile exists and report under 1% destruction, that research is ongoing with results expected before the budget debate, and that policy measures such as recycled-content requirements and extended producer responsibility are planned.
I aim to inform your House about this before the budget debate.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover voor de begrotingsbehandeling te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Op 38 vluchten op Schiphol passagiers met corona'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that 38 flights to Schiphol carried passengers with COVID-19, including how cases were identified, how contacts are notified, whether origin countries are informed, and how the motion on flight restrictions is being implemented. The ministers largely answered by pointing to GGD contact tracing protocols, withheld flight details to avoid unnecessary public concern, and deferred on the motion and on flight-necessity judgments.
The House will be informed by letter soon about the implementation of this motion.
Over de uitvoering van deze motie wordt uw Kamer spoedig per brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Verhoogde concentraties radioactieve stoffen gemeten boven Scandinavië’

An MP asked the state secretary whether elevated radioactive substances detected over Scandinavia, possibly from a reactor leak in West Russia, were a serious concern and when the source would be identified. The government answered that the source is uncertain, the levels pose no health risk and no measures were needed, that the source is not established as West Russia, and that existing international nuclear safety frameworks apply.
It has not been established that the origin of the measured radionuclides lies in West Russia.
Het is niet vastgesteld dat de oorsprong van de gemeten radionucliden in West-Rusland ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kröger over niet-essentiële reizen naar risicogebieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Kröger asked why Dutch nationals may still travel for holidays to non-EU risk areas while residents of those countries cannot enter the Netherlands, and how the travel advice and quarantine recommendation are enforced. The minister answered that the entry ban was lifted for 15 countries from 1 July, that holiday travel is treated as non-essential but the decision is left to the traveller under the principle of own responsibility, and that enforcement relies on airlines and border checks while quarantine advice cannot be enforced.
Quarantine at home after visiting a risk area is indeed an urgent recommendation and in that sense cannot be enforced.
Thuisquarantaine na bezoek aan een risicogebied is inderdaad een dringend advies en is in die zin niet handhaafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Staatssecretaris in de maag met tonnen plastic afval'

An MP asks the state secretary about the collapse in demand for recycled plastic during the COVID-19 crisis, the recyclers' distress call, and possible EU minimum-content rules, export bans and a plastic tax. The secretary answers that demand must recover, outlines measures including pursuing an EU mandatory recycled-content target and an EU-level Basel amendment, and treats the plastic tax as largely a national or EU budget matter.
My aim is for the European Commission to come within a year with a proposal for a mandatory use of a percentage of recycled plastic in European regulation.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht dat de Europese Commissie binnen een jaar komt met een voorstel tot een verplichte toepassing van een percentage plastic recyclaat in Europese regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte en Kröger over het rapport Evaluatie stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport (advies 3456) van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. d.d. 31 maart 2020

Three MPs asked the ministers whether AERIUS applies SRM2 to road traffic deposition and OPS to other sectors, and why SRM2 is cut off at 5 km, given the Commission's evaluation and TNO's 2015 audit. The minister confirmed the SRM2/OPS split and defended the 5 km cut-off as consistent with the NSL tool and past Raad van State acceptance, while promising a broader cabinet response after the summer.

The cabinet will come after the summer with a more extensive substantive cabinet response to both the final advice of the Nitrogen Problem Advisory Committee and the final report of the Nitrogen Measurement and Calculation Advisory Committee.

Het kabinet komt na de zomer met een uitgebreidere inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie op zowel het eindadvies van het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek als het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de berichten dat KLM weer wil gaan vliegen op diverse Europese steden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether KLM's plan to resume flights to European cities, including COVID-19 hotspots, was sensible given travel restrictions, and about cabin safety, masks and staff protection. The minister answered that entry rules, RIVM-based airline protocols, travel advice and mask guidance address the risks, and that KLM had not consulted RIVM or the OMT.
As far as I am aware, KLM has not held consultations with the RIVM and OMT about expanding flights to European cities.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft KLM geen overleg gevoerd met het RIVM en OMT over uitbreiding van vluchten naar Europese steden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Westerveld en Renkema over het openbaar vervoer

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about public transport access during COVID-19, including the OV protocol, student timing, support for people with disabilities, and bicycle policy. The state secretary answered that the protocol protects all users, that Reisassistentie is fully available again from 1 June, and that a further letter on accessibility for people with disabilities will follow.
How accessibility will be further guaranteed for this group is a topic of discussion in the OV protocol working group.
Hoe toegankelijkheid verder wordt gewaarborgd voor deze groep is onderwerp van gesprek in de werkgroep OV-protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de richtlijnen voor reizen per vliegtuig in coronatijd

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the ministers why aviation COVID-19 rules differ from those for public transport, hospitality and culture, and how the rules are enforced, along with related questions on refunds, EASA guidance and whether the sector is left to self-regulate. The minister answered that sector-specific risk assessments, RIVM advice, airline protocols, and enforcement by airports, safety regions and the Marechaussee justify the approach, while largely deferring details to earlier letters.

If in the view of the chair of the Safety Region insufficient measures are taken or irresponsible health situations arise, additional restrictive measures can be imposed, such as closing parts of certain locations.

Als naar het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Veiligheidsregio onvoldoende maatregelen worden getroffen of er vanuit oogpunt van gezondheidszorg onverantwoorde situaties ontstaan, kunnen aanvullende beperkende maatregelen getroffen worden, zoals het sluiten van delen van bepaalde locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het aantal vliegbewegingen vanaf Schiphol

The MP asks whether night flights from Schiphol are increasing again, why night flights are allowed when daytime capacity exists, and what preventive and enforcement measures apply to flights against COVID-19 spread. The minister replies that operations are limited and monitored, that Schiphol's 24-hour status and the 32,000 night-flight cap under slot rules are maintained, that noise-reduction instruments are being pursued, and that airport and airline protocols, enforced by safety regions and the Marechaussee, apply.
My ministry does not keep track of this percentage.
Mijn ministerie houdt dit percentage niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de diverse OMT adviezen met betrekking tot luchtvaart

An MP asked whether commercial parties such as KLM were involved in OMT advice on aviation during the coronavirus crisis, why a KLM Health doctor sat on the OMT, how conflicts of interest were guarded against, and how aircraft ventilation and transmission risks were assessed. The minister replied that a KLM doctor attended only the 24 January OMT meeting under a signed declaration of interests, that the 12 June advice came from RIVM with no commercial parties, that OMT members serve in personal capacity with published declarations, and that the questions could not be answered in time for the committee debate.
To be transparent and prevent conflicts of interest, every member completes a declaration of interests for each OMT.
Om transparant te zijn en belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen, vult elk lid voor een OMT een belangenverklaring in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het Zweedse rapport ‘Nattågstrafik till Europa’ en 2 deel rapporten met betrekking tot Europese nachttreinen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a Swedish report on night trains to Europe, including whether Dutch subsidies for the Vienna night train extension, a possible Malmo-Amsterdam connection and a future HSL line were considered. The State Secretary answers all twelve questions, noting contact with Sweden, a planned subsidy for the Amsterdam-Zevenaar-border section, and willingness to consider concessions where needed, but largely defers next steps to the Swedish government.
Certainly. Contact has already been made to arrange a conversation with my Swedish colleague.
Zeker. Er is reeds contact gelegd voor een gesprek met mijn Zweedse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins en Van Raan over het basisjaar van CORSIA

Four MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether moving CORSIA's baseline year to 2019, possibly delaying offsetting obligations until 2023, is desirable given climate goals, and what the Dutch position is. The Minister answered that Netherlands prefers keeping the current baseline, treats baseline change as a fallback, that the Council decision is only a negotiating mandate, and that the 2019 baseline would be evaluated in 2022.
The starting point for the Netherlands is preserving the current ambition.
Het uitgangspunt voor Nederland is behoud van de huidige ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Schonis over het toetsingsadvies van de commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage over A27/A12 ring Utrecht

MPs Kröger and Schonis asked the minister about the environmental assessment committee's critical review of the A27/A12 Utrecht ring road project, including delays, corona-related traffic changes, construction method risks, nitrogen permits and housing priority. The minister answered that the tracébesluit will be adopted after summer 2020 with a renewed committee review, that nitrogen effects will be handled via a project-specific assessment and the speed reduction, and that further studies on noise and construction are underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de stikstofberekeningen inzake Lelystad Airport

Three MPs (Van Raan, Kröger, Laçin) asked 28 questions about stikstof (nitrogen) calculations for Lelystad Airport, including why new calculations were commissioned after the Council of State ruling against the PAS, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the MER 2018 was complete. The minister answered that the new work follows the PAS annulment, that the Chamber was informed in September 2019 and February 2020, that results are not yet final, and that the Commission for the MER and RIVM advice was obtained, while declining to share the commissioning assignments citing commercial confidentiality.
It is not customary to share commissioning assignments with the House of Representatives because of their commercially confidential nature.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om opdrachtverstrekkingen te delen met de Tweede Kamer vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bonus voor de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Air France-KLM tied its CEO's bonus to securing state aid and whether Dutch support would be conditional on bonus, dividend, buyback and sustainability limits, with retroactive effect. The minister said a bonus increase does not fit the crisis, that aid conditions (no bonuses or dividends while aid is outstanding, emissions and night-flight commitments) are being negotiated, and that the Dutch state learned of the bonus proposal only when the AGM documents were published.
Thus the cabinet wants that, if the company receives aid, no bonuses and dividends are paid out as long as the aid has not yet been repaid.
Zo wil het kabinet indien de onderneming steun ontvangt dat er geen bonussen en dividenden worden uitgekeerd zolang de steun aan de onderneming nog niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over veilig schoolverkeer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister how school traffic can be made safe as schools reopen under the 1.5-metre rule, covering extra space for cyclists and pedestrians, public transport capacity, local government support and good practices. The minister replied that a protocol for urban mobility, communication campaigns and temporary measures such as school streets have been prepared with local authorities and CROW, with decisions left to local road managers.
A guide has been prepared for road managers to take measures suited to the local situation.
Voor wegbeheerders is een handreiking gemaakt om maatregelen te treffen passend bij de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Zonne-energiesector laat doos van Pandora gesloten: ‘Producent van morgen betaalt recyclingkosten voor producent van gisteren’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether solar panel recycling costs are financed by current producers paying for past panels, and whether a funding shortfall could arise. The state secretary answered that producers and importers bear recycling costs under extended producer responsibility, that the pay-as-you-go system avoids a shortfall, and that an AVV application by Stichting OPEN has been submitted for assessment.
I will assess the application and publish a draft decision for public comment in the Staatscourant as soon as possible.
Ik zal de aanvraag beoordelen en zo spoedig als mogelijk is een ontwerpbeschikking voor zienswijze publiceren in de Staatscourant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Kröger en Buitenweg over geweld en seksuele intimidatie in de trein en op het spoor

MPs asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers about sexual harassment in trains and on platforms, including the number of incidents, advice to travellers, cooperation with international carriers and use of expertise from the national sexual violence centre. The government answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers in 2019 but figures may be incomplete, that there is no specific traveller advice beyond general reporting channels, and that NS cooperates internationally and with specialist organisations, with no specific new commitments.
The police currently have no additional figures on sexual harassment specifically in trains and on platforms.
De politie heeft op dit moment geen aanvullende cijfers met betrekking tot seksuele intimidatie specifiek in de trein en op het perron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Brenk over granuliet

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Brenk asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the classification of granuliet as soil and the use of granuliet with flocculant (polyacrylamide) in the Over de Maas project, including ecological and environmental risks. The minister answers that granuliet has been classed as soil since 2009 under the Soil Quality Decree, that tests show no harmful effects, and that an independent review will be carried out with the municipality and province.

To remove this concern, I will, in consultation with the municipality and province, have an independent study carried out into the consequences for people and the environment of using granuliet in the Over de Maas project.

Om deze ongerustheid weg te nemen zal ik, in overleg met de gemeente en provincie, een onafhankelijk onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de gevolgen voor mens en milieu van het gebruik van granuliet in het project Over de Maas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitzending van EenVandaag over biomassa uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the ministers about an EenVandaag broadcast on US wood pellets and whether whole trees are used for biomass sold to the Netherlands. Minister Wiebes said he lacked 2019 data, would not name companies citing commercial confidentiality, and argued that sustainability criteria apply regardless of origin and of US Paris Agreement membership.
I cannot say which companies these are, because this is commercially confidential information.
Ik kan niet aangeven om welke bedrijven dit gaat, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Miljoenen koffiebekers Rijk niet gerecycled maar verbrand’

MPs asked whether about 85 million government coffee cups were incinerated instead of recycled, contrary to policy ambitions, and what steps would prevent this. The minister acknowledged this breaches the contracts, said the contractor was contacted, and committed to new contracts from 2021 with direct recycler arrangements.
However, this is not in line with the concluded contracts.
Dit is echter niet in overeenstemming met de afgesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over De stikstofdepositie van Schiphol

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's nitrogen deposition on Natura 2000 areas, including whether assessments had been made since 2004 and whether the emission limits and permits were adequate. The minister answered that Schiphol is making a new deposition calculation, that no absolute emission ceiling exists yet, and that several questions fall under the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality or are still under review.
The Ministry of LNV will, in the context of the enforcement requests, rule on whether, and if so when, Schiphol should have applied for a nature permit.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van de handhavingsverzoeken een uitspraak doen of, en zo ja, wanneer Schiphol een natuurvergunning had moeten aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Kröger over de berichten dat containerschepen ook tijdens de storm de zuidelijke Waddenzeeroute hebben genomen en containers hebben verloren

MPs Van der Graaf and Kröger asked whether warnings from the Dutch coastguard for large container ships on the southern Wadden Sea route apply only eastbound, whether Germany warns westbound ships, and whether a closure of the route in high waves is possible. The minister replied that Germany does not actively warn ships and awaits investigation outcomes, that a permanent closure cannot be imposed unilaterally and would require an IMO proposal, and that MARIN research on smaller ships and the MSC Zoë investigation results are expected in spring 2020.
In the short term I will contact my German counterpart to agree that, once the main investigations are completed, the Netherlands and Germany will discuss joint follow-up actions towards the IMO.

Op korte termijn zal ik contact opnemen met mijn Duitse ambtgenoot om met hem af te spreken dat na het gereedkomen van de belangrijkste onderzoeken Nederland en Duitsland gezamenlijke vervolgacties richting IMO zullen bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Sienot en Kröger over berichten dat containerschepen ook tijdens de storm de zuidelijke Waddenzeeroute hebben genomen en containers hebben verloren

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that container ships, including the OOCL Rauma during storm Ciara, took the southern Wadden Sea route and lost containers, and what the Coast Guard, liability and route closure options involved. The minister answered that the Coast Guard warned nine ships, that the owner was held liable for clean-up under the Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen, that the OVV and MARIN investigations are pending, and that closing the southern route requires IMO decision-making, with further steps to follow after the OVV report.
I will respond to the report as soon as possible and inform your House about it.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk reageren op het rapport en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de EuroStar trein naar London

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked about the status of the four-country border control and security treaties for the Eurostar service to London, the reported shortage of Marechaussee capacity for a third daily train, remaining obstacles, implementation of their motions, and earlier commitments on capacity. The State Secretary replied that the treaties are concluded and due for signing by 30 April 2020, that Marechaussee capacity is being arranged for the extra trains, and that provisional application will proceed without blocking the direct service.
The aim is that the treaties will be signed by 30 April 2020 at the latest.
De inzet is dat de ondertekening van de verdragen in ieder geval voor 30 april 2020 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Laçin en Kröger over Emissieregistratie

MPs Bruins, Laçin and Kröger asked whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported as a memo item under the NEC Directive, and whether the Netherlands has reported them. The minister answered that such emissions fall outside the Directive's scope and need not be reported, so the Netherlands has complied.
The Netherlands has not reported aviation emissions above 3,000 feet, which the Directive also does not require.
Nederland heeft de emissies van de luchtvaart boven de 3.000 voet niet gerapporteerd, hetgeen op grond van de richtlijn ook niet verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Vraag naar elektrische bouwmachines groeit, aanbod blijft nog achter’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether electric construction machinery can reduce nitrogen and greenhouse emissions, how tender procedures weigh e-machinery, and whether financial incentives exist. The minister answered that electrification helps air quality and emissions, that a roadmap to zero-emission machinery is being prepared, and that tax schemes (MIA/Vamil) and the DKTI subsidy support adoption.
The national government, together with construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers of construction equipment, is mapping the developments needed to speed up the pace.
Het Rijk brengt samen met bouwbedrijven, fabrikanten en leveranciers van bouwmaterieel de benodigde ontwikkelingen in kaart om het tempo op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het AO 'Vliegen over Conflictgebieden'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked who decides on suspending flights to China, whether it is right that airlines make that call commercially, what information airlines use, the roles of the UK and German governments, when the Dutch state could suspend flights, whether KLM cut mainly unsold flights, and whether arriving passengers can be medically screened. The Minister answered that airlines decide under advice from RIVM, WHO, EU and ICAO and the foreign ministry travel advice, that the Minister of Medical Care could impose targeted emergency measures under the Public Health Act but no flight-ban is warranted now, and that entry screening is not effective.
Transport permits that airlines hold under aviation treaties can only be withdrawn when operators do not comply with national rules on the admission, stay and departure of passengers and cargo.

Vervoerstoestemmingen die luchtvaartmaatschappijen op grond van de luchtvaartverdragen hebben, kunnen alleen worden ingetrokken wanneer exploitanten de nationale voorschriften voor de toelating, verblijf en vertrek van passagiers en vracht niet opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan, Laçin  en Kröger over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a correction letter on the validation of noise-calculation appendices for regional airports, including when the error was found, why the correction came late, and whether the appendices were externally validated. The minister answered that the error was discovered on 17 October 2019, that there was no legal basis or regulation requiring external validation before 2010, and that external validation was introduced from 2010 and formalised in 2018, while declining to commit to re-validating the appendices for shielding and atmospheric attenuation.
After receiving the email, I unfortunately had to establish that the word 'geen' had been dropped from the relevant sentence in the Verzamelbrief.
Na ontvangst van de mail heb ik helaas moeten constateren dat in de Verzamelbrief in de betreffende zin het woord «geen» is weggevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte en Bruins over het artikel 'Vliegveld Lelystad onveiliger door komst luchtverkeersleiding'

MPs Kröger, Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of two near-collisions at Lelystad Airport after air traffic control arrived, and whether aviation safety has worsened. The minister answered that the incidents are being investigated, that monitoring is ongoing, that the route design meets international standards, and that the airport will only open to commercial traffic once the break-in period is complete, without committing to new independent investigation.
There is no reason for additional investigation.
Er is dus geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'Vliegers Lelystad slaan alarm'

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked about reports that general aviation firms at Lelystad Airport face job losses and forced flight cuts, and whether the cost-benefit analysis accounts for them. The minister denies that 300 jobs are at risk or that flights will be halved, says at most 30 jobs could move, and states the MKBA was done from a national perspective with job figures of about 2,000 direct jobs at the airport.
There is no question of halving the number of aircraft movements or of 300 jobs being at risk.
Van de halvering van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen of 300 banen die op de tocht zouden staan is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het gedogen van overtredingen naar aanleiding van de PAS-uitspraak

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government's plan to legalise nitrogen-permit-exempt activities after the PAS ruling means existing Nature Conservation Act violations will be tolerated indefinitely, and how this fits enforcement policy and the duty to enforce. Minister Schouten answered that enforcement is paused pending legalisation through regional approaches and assessments, that this counts as a special circumstance with concrete prospect of legalisation, and that grazing and manuring are handled separately.
Until then, the national government and provinces, in their role as competent authority, will not actively enforce against these notifications.
Tot die tijd zullen Rijk en provincies in haar rol als bevoegd gezag niet actief handhaven op deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over emissieregistratie

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Dutch emissions register, including whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet are omitted from reporting and what this means for air quality and deposition figures. The minister answered that reporting follows the NEC Directive, which excludes aviation emissions outside the landing and take-off cycle, that the guidebook does not determine reporting scope, and deferred the exact emission amounts pending follow-up on a motion, while the answer to one question was delayed by third-party input.
On how I will implement this motion, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze waarop ik deze motie uitvoer, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Toxic PFAS Chemicals Found in Artificial Turf’

An MP asked the government about reports that PFAS chemicals were found in artificial turf, whether Dutch turf has been tested, and the exposure and environmental risks from it and its recycling. The minister answered that no specific knowledge exists on PFAS risks in artificial turf, pointed to ongoing Rijkswaterstaat and Arcadis studies on PFAS sources and products, and said the risks of recycling will await those studies.
Specific risks of PFAS in artificial turf are currently not known in the scientific literature or at RIVM and ECHA.
Over risico's specifiek van PFAS in kunstgras is in de wetenschappelijke literatuur en bij het RIVM en ECHA op dit moment niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de mogelijkheid om de trein naar de klimaattop in Madrid te gaan

An MP asked the minister whether a special climate train could be organised to the Madrid climate summit, including a sleeper train option, and whether the obstacles could be mapped. The minister answered that a direct or reduced-transfer train was not feasible on this short notice, due to missing compatible rolling stock, Spain's different track gauge, and the operational complexity across four countries.
A direct train to Madrid turns out not to be possible, and a train with fewer transfers also brings such complex problems within this timeframe that, unfortunately, this is not feasible either.
Een directe trein naar Madrid blijkt niet mogelijk en ook een trein met minder overstappen brengt op deze termijn dusdanig complexe problemen met zich mee dat ook dit helaas niet uitvoerbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de Raad van State vragen ingediend over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het PAS

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she meant a legal 'trick' (list) to get around the Council of State's ruling on the PAS, and how this squares with respect for the judiciary. The minister says the government is researching how to implement the ruling within legal requirements, without intending to evade it, and refuses to retract the remark, calling it a popular expression not to be taken literally.
Within the framework of the Council of State's ruling, executive choices must be made that do justice to both the letter and the spirit of the ruling.
Binnen het kader van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zijn uitvoerende keuzes te maken die recht moeten doen aan zowel de letter als de geest van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over het handhavingsverzoek van Mobilisation for the Environment met betrekking tot Schiphol en de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the minister about an enforcement request by Mobilisation for the Environment claiming Schiphol lacks a Wet natuurbescherming permit and that about 100,000 flights are illegal. The minister answered that Schiphol holds no Wnb permit, that the ministry of LNV, as competent authority, will assess the request, and that details on emissions and nitrogen deposition will follow via a new calculation and the MER for the revised airport decree.
In the context of the enforcement request, the Ministry of LNV will gather the necessary information and request views.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van het handhavingsverzoek de benodigde informatie verzamelen en zienswijzen opvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger en Van Raan over het bericht dat provinciale staten van Overijssel zich niet serieus genomen voelen door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdD asked whether air traffic from 7 November 2019 must use the B+ routes to and from Lelystad Airport, why these routes are opened before expansion is certain, and whether the minister will heed Overijssel's call to drop low-flying routes. The minister confirmed that an inregelperiode starts on 7 November for existing small aviation only, stressed the B+ routes are the least noisy option, and declined to postpone, pointing to consultations and planned route improvements.
The routes are not open to commercial traffic because the political decision-making on that has not yet been completed.
De routes zijn niet open voor handelsverkeer want de politieke besluitvorming daarover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Concrete aanpak stikstof kan maanden duren’

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a report that a concrete nitrogen (stikstof) plan could take months, and about speed limits, livestock farms near Natura 2000 areas, natural restoration measures, the AERIUS calculator and missing permits for airports. The ministers answered that a area-based approach and a threshold for small projects will be prepared, with a package by year-end, but gave few numbers and deferred several points (speed-limit effects, farm counts, airport permits, AERIUS scope) to later dates.
The cabinet will come by the end of the year with a worked-out package on the basis of which decision-making can take place at the start of the new year.
Het kabinet komt voor het einde van het jaar met een uitgewerkt pakket op basis waarvan in het begin van het nieuwe jaar besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Dik-Faber over het bericht ’Plastic theezakjes blijkt bron van microplastic’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that plastic tea bags release microplastics, including how many are used, whether plastic should be banned, legal options, other sources, and whether they fall under EU single-use plastics rules. The State Secretary answered that data are lacking, health effects are still under study, existing EU rules on migration limits apply, no new ban is currently considered necessary, and tea bags are not covered by the single-use plastics directive.
The cabinet currently sees no need for that.
Daar ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de geplande kap van gezonde bomen langs de A9

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why thousands of healthy trees must be felled along the A9 for widening and a relocated fuel station, whether this fits climate and nitrogen rules, and about fuel station lease terms. The minister confirms awareness, explains the tree removal is tied to widening and the rest-stop relocation with one-for-one compensation planned, says the fuel station is a relocation not an addition, cites a 15-year lease, and states the nitrogen (PAS) rules do not apply because no Natura 2000 area lies along the route.
It has been demonstrated that widening the A9 has no effect on nitrogen deposition in Botshol.
Aangetoond is dat de verbreding van de A9 geen invloed heeft op de stikstofdepositie in Botshol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het Tracébesluit A27/A12

MP Kröger asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Council of State's annulment of the A27/A12 route decision following the PAS ruling, including emission reduction, alternatives to road widening, the 80 km/h speed option, project costs and the fate of funds and other projects. The Minister confirms the annulment flows from the PAS ruling, says work will continue on a new route decision, rules out a safe 80 km/h option within the existing trench, and gives a partial account of costs and affected projects.

Within the project objectives and the requirements of nature legislation, work will therefore continue on a solution to the nitrogen problem for the Ring Utrecht, and I am preparing a new route decision.

Binnen de projectdoelstellingen en de eisen van de natuurwetgeving zal daarom verder gewerkt worden aan een oplossing voor de stikstofproblematiek voor de Ring Utrecht en bereid ik een nieuw Tracébesluit voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Gemeenten geven vervuilde compost gratis weg aan bewoners’

MPs Kröger and Gijs van Dijk asked whether municipalities gave away plastic-contaminated compost and whether compost rules are adequate. The State Secretary answered that the compost was certified Keurcompost meeting stricter-than-legal standards, that plastics cannot be fully filtered out, and that the government is pursuing a source-based action plan for garden waste rather than tightening rules.

That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat, the NVRD and the Vereniging Afvalbedrijven to implement the garden waste action plan to reduce the presence of foreign materials through a source-based approach.

Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat, de NVRD en de Vereniging Afvalbedrijven gevraagd uitvoering te geven aan het Aanvalsplan gft-afval om via een brongerichte aanpak onder andere de aanwezigheid van bodemvreemde materialen te verminderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de impact van de vernietiging van de PAS door de Raad van State op de besluitvorming omtrent Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the minister how the Council of State's annulment of the PAS nitrogen programme affects the status of Lelystad Airport as a priority project, the required permitting and studies, and whether new research is needed before any decision. The minister answered that the reserved development space for Lelystad has lapsed, that the Wet Natuurbescherming now applies and consequences are still being examined, and that careful study is needed, so opening in April 2020 is no longer feasible.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform the House.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de berichten 'Uitstoot vervuilend lachgas Chemelot jaren niet gemeld' en 'Lachgas: het stille klimaatprobleem van Limburg'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about reports that Chemelot's Anqore plant had emitted large amounts of nitrous oxide unmeasured and unreported for decades, and about oversight and accountability for that. The minister acknowledged the omission, said Limburg province is the competent authority responsible for monitoring, and said the emissions have been corrected in the registry and that a one-off financial incentive of €42 million is being provided to Fibrant to reduce nitrous oxide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het bericht dat  KLM medeoprichter is van een maatschappij die vluchten tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil verzorgen

MPs Kröger and Snels asked whether the government knows KLM co-founded Air Antwerp, a Antwerp-London flight venture, and how this fits KLM's talks on phasing out short flights. The minister confirms awareness, says the Antwerp-London route falls outside the Dutch phase-out process, and promises to urge the sector to favour rail on short routes.
The fact that KLM holds a minority interest in the new airline Air Antwerp, which wants to (re)open the Antwerp-London route, does not detract from the above process.

Het feit dat de KLM een minderheidsbelang heeft in de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Air Antwerp – die de route tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil (her)openen – doet geen afbreuk aan het bovengenoemde proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over ongerustheid over een grote militaire oefenzone

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked about concerns over a large military exercise zone in the north of the Netherlands, its consultation, decision-making roles, environmental and Wadden Sea effects, and links to Lelystad Airport. The ministers answered that the zone is still being designed within the Luchtruimherziening programme, that participation and Plan-MER procedures will follow, and that the decision is due in 2020.
It is too early in the design process to give clarity on the positioning of the exercise area and the consequences for airspace use.
Het is te vroeg in het nog te doorlopen ontwerpproces om al duidelijkheid te geven over de positionering van het oefengebied en de gevolgen hiervan voor het luchtruimgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over enkele onderwerpen met betrekking tot Lelystad Airport

An MP asks the minister to explain the partial rejection of a freedom-of-information request about the Schiphol-Lelystad traffic distribution rule, why legal advice and shared-vision commission advice are withheld, the cost-benefit analysis, and noise impacts for Noord-Veluwe municipalities. The minister defends withholding documents on grounds of protecting decision-making and third-party (Schiphol) interests, describes the commission's completed work, and promises an independent analysis and a later reply.
Both the interest in a careful and effective decision-making process and Schiphol's interest weigh, in my view, more heavily in this case than the public interest in disclosure.

Zowel het belang van een zorgvuldig en effectief proces van besluitvorming alsmede het belang van Schiphol wegen naar mijn overtuiging in dit geval zwaarder dan het publieke belang van openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht 'Steeds meer biomassacentrales, goed of slecht voor het klimaat?'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether biomass power plants should be paused, given air quality and sustainability concerns, and when sustainability and cascading criteria will be set. The minister replied that the sustainability framework is expected in Q1 2020, that emission standards for smaller plants are under review, that the government will not intervene in specific projects, and that it sees no legal basis to refuse permits when all rules are met.
The cabinet is not involved in the development of specific projects and intervention is therefore not an option.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de totstandkoming van specifieke projecten en een interventie is dus niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitfasering van fluorescentiebuizen

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked why the mercury exemption for fluorescent tubes under the RoHS directive has been extended beyond its five-year term, citing LED alternatives, mercury content, CO2 savings and WHO concerns. The State Secretary answered that the Commission has not yet decided on the extension requests, that a socio-economic study is nearly ready, and that the government supports a phase-out weighed against overall environmental effects and will keep pressing the Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het rondetafelgesprek inzake MSC Zoe

MPs Kröger, Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister about inspection of container ships, cargo securing, confidentiality of cargo manifests, shipping routes and container tracing after the MSC Zoe incident. The minister answered that inspections led to few detentions, that extra cargo-securing checks shift inspection effort from other topics, that certain cargo data is confidential under the Wob, and that international rule changes depend on investigation outcomes.
There has been contact between the Dutch police and Port of Sines in Portugal. This was the last port the MSC Zoe called at before the accident occurred.
Er is contact geweest tussen de Nederlandse politie en Port of Sines in Portugal. Dit was de laatste haven die de MSC Zoe aandeed voor het ongeval plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht ‘35 vissers willen lading MSC Zoe uit zee halen, maar ze mogen niet’

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why fishing vessels were reportedly barred from helping recover containers lost from the MSC Zoe and how quickly the recovery of the remaining containers would proceed. The minister replied that fishers may assist under conditions set by the ILT for safety and that the shipping company MSC is legally responsible for recovery, with Rijkswaterstaat monitoring progress.
However, this may not be a reason for shipowner MSC to not take its own responsibilities but to shift them onto others.
Het mag echter geen reden zijn dat reder MSC haar eigen verantwoordelijkheden niet op zich neemt maar afwentelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de mogelijke inzet van niet-duurzame biobrandstoffen zoals palmolie binnen het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord

An MP asked how the draft Climate Agreement ensures that palm and soy biofuels are not used in the Netherlands, whether RED II sustainability criteria apply to all transport biofuel use, and how deforestation is prevented. The state secretary answered that the current practice of not using such biofuels will continue, that existing rules apply until 2020, that all transport biofuels must meet RED II criteria, and that post-2020 additional food-crop biofuels will be capped at 2020 levels.
The draft Climate Agreement stipulates that the current practice of not using biofuels produced from palm and soy oil in the Netherlands will be continued.
In het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord is afgesproken dat de huidige praktijk waarbij geen inzet plaatsvindt van biobrandstoffen geproduceerd uit palm- en sojaolie in Nederland, wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over de 40dB-contour

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a changed departure route near Wezep affects the 40dB contour used as the MER study area, and whether the sensitivity analysis can legitimately substitute for assessing alternatives. The Minister replied that the 40 dB(A) contour is shown for information only without spatial restrictions, that the route variants differ in location not height, and that the effects on inhabitants were compiled and published, though the government did not commit to a new MER assessment of the altered route.
The aim of a possible route change is that less built-up area is overflown.
Het doel van een mogelijke routewijziging is dat er minder over bebouwd gebied wordt gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Een woonwijk tussen dijk en rivier? 'Dan kun je net zo goed op ijs bouwen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether planned riverside housing in Arnhem meets modern flood-safety norms, whether the Rhine design discharge should be raised to 22,000 m3/s, what the upstream and downstream effects are, and whether the municipality's climate stress test covered the project. The minister answered that the project meets the Rijn river-bed frameworks, that flood safety for riverside housing is the municipality's responsibility, that the design discharge of 18,000 m3/s is confirmed, and that the project was not included in the municipal stress test because it lies outside the dike.
For activities and buildings (such as housing) in the riverside area, no statutory safety standards apply for protection against high water.
Voor activiteiten en bebouwing (zoals woningen) in buitendijks gebied gelden geen wettelijke veiligheidsnormen voor bescherming tegen hoogwater.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten ’Deze omstreden afvalberg mag van de provincie blijven liggen. Bewoners maken zich zorgen' en 'Gedeputeerde Tekin geeft verkeerde informatie over af

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the oxykalkslik waste heap at Tata Steel, why it was allowed to remain, the health and environmental risks, and why enforcement lapsed after 2010. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, that monitoring showed no groundwater risks, that the matter was handled through the province, and that a letter to parliament on enforcement at Tata Steel would follow in May.
The competent authority lies with the province of Noord-Holland.
Het bevoegd gezag ligt bij de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de berichten ‘Microplastics bewust in diervoeding gestopt’ en ‘ECHA proposes to restrict intentionally added microplastics’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about reports on intentionally added microplastics in animal feed and an ECHA proposal to restrict them. The minister answered that microplastics are not used in animal feed, that effects on soil and water are possible, and that restriction proposals are underway at EU level with a process of about one year.
The Netherlands considers it important that a broad look is taken at how the spread of microplastics in the environment can be curbed.
Nederland vindt het belangrijk dat breed wordt gekeken hoe de verspreiding van microplastics in het milieu kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Sea-Watch 3 op last van Nederland aan ketting gelegd'

MPs Kröger and Van Ojik asked why the Dutch government requested Italy to detain the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship, whether this conflicted with earlier assurances to NGOs, and about rescue capacity in the Mediterranean. The minister answered that the ILT inspection followed Italian port-state findings, that safety comes first, that the inspection was not caused by foreign pressure, and that the ship is not chained, while largely refusing to explain policy-change timing and deferring to the letter for detailed conclusions.
The Netherlands asked Italy not to grant the ship permission to sail while the investigation was ongoing.
Nederland heeft Italië verzocht het schip geen toestemming te verlenen om uit te varen zolang het onderzoek liep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de wijze waarop zal worden omgegaan met de constateringen van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol in het toekomstige luchtvaartbeleid

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she will take into account the Schiphol Environmental Council's finding that there is no support for further growth before improvements are made, how she reconciles public statements about growth and Lelystad with that advice, and how safety, climate and the 50-50 noise/growth rule will be handled in the upcoming Luchtvaartnota. The minister answered that she is pursuing two amendments to the Schiphol airport traffic decree (one to legally anchor the 500,000 movement cap, one for post-2020 development), will send the Chamber a response before summer, and that safety and climate will be addressed through the planMER process with a draft Luchtvaartnota after summer.
In preparation, I will send the Chamber a response to the chair's report of the ORS before summer, including a proposal for how this LVB will be shaped and how the environment will be involved.

Ter voorbereiding daarop zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een reactie op het verslag van de voorzitter van de ORS sturen, inclusief een voorstel voor de manier waarop dit LVB wordt vormgegeven en de omgeving wordt betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de stikstofdepositie bij luchthaven Lelystad

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about nitrogen deposition from Lelystad Airport on Natura 2000 areas, why the AERIUS study was not published, whether construction and traffic emissions were included, and whether sufficient PAS deposition space is available. The ministers answered that the detailed calculations are available on request and a reader's guide was added, that construction and road traffic were assessed with negligible or no effect on sensitive areas, and that the project fits within reserved priority-project capacity via a notification.
This approach was chosen because the information is very extensive and technical in nature.
Er is gekozen voor deze werkwijze omdat de informatie zeer omvangrijk en technisch van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het recente onderzoek ‘Taxing Aviation Fuels in the EU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about a CE Delft study on taxing aviation fuel in the EU, including legal obstacles, revenue estimates, CO2 effects and synthetic kerosene. The State Secretary answered that Chicago Convention and EU energy tax rules constrain a kerosene tax, estimated revenue of roughly 500-750 million euro, and said effects on demand depend on many factors requiring further study.
At the international conference on CO2 pricing and flight taxes that I am organising on 20 and 21 June, a kerosene tax will also be discussed.
Tijdens de internationale conferentie over CO 2 -beprijzing en vliegbelastingen die ik organiseer op 20 en 21 juni a.s. zal ook over een kerosinebelasting worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over het bericht dat ‘de vliegroutes voor Lelystad Airport gewijzigd zijn tijdens de lopende zienswijzenprocedure’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flight route changes for Lelystad Airport were made during an ongoing public comment procedure without involving municipalities such as Kampen, and whether residents' objections would be affected. The minister replied that the Wezep route is still only a proposal under consultation with neighbouring municipalities, that the amended MER already covers a possible route change without altering legal noise contours, and that no extension of the comment period is planned.
Partly on the basis of this advice, I will take a decision on a possible adjustment of the route.
Mede op basis van dit advies zal ik een besluit nemen over een mogelijke aanpassing van de route.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over de presentatie van het Rocky Mountain Institute (RMI) met betrekking tot luchtvaartemissies tijdens het World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos met het onderligg

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the sector can meet its own aviation emissions targets, given RMI and European agency findings, and whether CORSIA, fuel options, emissions pricing, Lelystad Airport and growth plans are adequate. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the emissions trajectory depends on policy, defended CORSIA and ICAO processes, and said no decisions on Lelystad or future tax changes were pre-empted, while promising to raise the issue in ICAO and EU fora.
I am aware of both reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over het bericht 'Demonstranten in Harlingen willen sluiting afvaloven'

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked about frequent malfunctions at the Harlingen waste incinerator (REC), whether these threaten health and the environment, and whether monitoring, emission norms, or the permit should be tightened. The state secretary answered that emission rules and the 60-hour annual malfunction limit apply, that the province of Fryslân enforces the permit, and that new BAT conclusions and a RWS-Infomil study on malfunction management are forthcoming, but declined to pursue permit revocation.
I am having RWS-Infomil examine whether, when the final BAT conclusions are implemented, the obligation to draw up a malfunction management plan is feasible and desirable as a general rule.

Ik laat door RWS-Infomil onderzoeken of bij implementatie van de definitieve BBT-conclusies de verplichting om een management plan voor storingen op te stellen in algemene regels haalbaar en wenselijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked the ministers about the large-scale sand extraction plans in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, covering alternative sites, drinking water effects, cumulative impacts on Natura 2000, the Habitats Directive ADC test, the Commission m.e.r. advice, and consistency with provincial plans. The minister answered that the chosen Gaasterland site was the most suitable after alternatives were considered, that drinking water effects are negligible, that no significant effects on Natura 2000 are expected so no ADC test is required, and that the municipality makes the final zoning decision.
This means that an important (final) assessment is left to the municipality De Fryske Marren.
Daarmee wordt een belangrijke (finale) afweging gelaten aan de gemeente De Fryske Marren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Brand bij kerncentrale Lingen: brand geblust, geen gewonden'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a fire at a fuel fabrication plant about 1 km from the Lingen/Emsland nuclear plant in Germany, and whether Dutch authorities were informed promptly. The government answered that no radiation escaped, no Dutch notification duty arose under the bilateral arrangements, the incident is being evaluated, and the topic will be discussed in the Dutch-German commission.

Because the fire was handled operationally in line with procedures and there was at no point a risk to the Dutch population, there was no obligation for the German authorities to immediately inform the Dutch authorities.

Omdat de brand operationeel is afgehandeld conform de procedures en er (mede door de heersende Westenwind) op geen enkel moment een risico voor de Nederlandse bevolking is geweest, was er voor de Duitse autoriteiten geen verplichting tot het terstond informeren van de Nederlandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over luchtvervuiling en overlast door Tata Steel

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about dust and air pollution from Tata Steel and Harsco, including whether the province granted permits after the fact and whether oversight and enforcement are adequate. The state secretary said oversight of provincial permitting falls to provincial states, that the ILT plays an advisory role, that the province is responsible for enforcement, and that the RIVM will study health effects.
Oversight of the province's permit granting runs through the provincial states.
Controle op de vergunningverlening door de provincie verloopt via de provinciale staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten dat prijsvechter Level vanaf Schiphol gaat vliegen en dat Ryanair stunt met prijzen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about low-cost airline Level planning flights from Schiphol and Ryanair's €5 fares to London, including whether slot rules could prioritise mainport-serving and cleaner flights. The minister answered that slot allocation is the slot coordinator's responsibility, that current rules offer no way to prioritise such flights, and that a future air passenger tax and slot-rule changes are being pursued.

Because I consider it desirable that government gets more options to stimulate flights that strengthen Schiphol's (inter)continental network, I am working on creating additional possibilities for future steering.

Omdat ik het wenselijk vind dat de overheid meer mogelijkheden krijgt om vluchten die het (inter)continentale netwerk van Schiphol versterken te stimuleren, zet ik in op het creëren van aanvullende mogelijkheden voor toekomstige sturing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het gemeentelijk beleid ten aanzien van de circulaire economie

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked the ministers about a StartCirculair/SUBtracers study finding many municipalities state circular economy ambitions without concrete implementation, and about knowledge gaps, support measures, regulatory obstacles and procurement progress. The government answered that it has noted the study, supports municipalities through workshops, networks, procurement programmes, the Versnellingshuis and the Omgevingswet, is reviewing regulatory obstacles via a taskforce, and will report on procurement progress in the first half of 2019.

Regarding the first two recommendations, which call for raising awareness, creating knowledge and facilitating networks of entrepreneurs and organisations, the cabinet supports municipalities, provinces and water boards by organising a series of workshops

Ten aanzien van de eerste twee aanbevelingen, die oproepen om bewustzijn te vergroten, kennis te creëren en netwerken van ondernemers en organisaties te faciliteren ondersteunt het kabinet gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen door middel van het organiseren van een reeks workshops
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de besluiten en het proces rondom de rol van biomassa en de duurzaamheidscriteria binnen het Klimaatakkoord

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister how biomass policy and sustainability criteria are being shaped within the Climate Agreement, who decides, and how biomass is prioritised and how much it will be used. The minister answered that the Visie Biomassa 2030 was translated into the draft Climate Agreement, that an independent sustainability framework will first be drafted technically and then advised on by the SER, that the cabinet decides after consulting stakeholders, and that PBL estimates additional biomass demand of 340–570 PJ by 2030, while the timing of some answers could not be met.
The cabinet decides on the sustainability criteria for biomass.
Het kabinet beslist over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de met perfluoroctaansulfonzuur (PFOS) en perfluoroctaanzuur (PFOA) verontreinigde grond bij Schiphol
