An MP asks the State Secretary about PFOS and PFOA contaminated soil stored near Schiphol and Rijsenhout, the municipal soil policy, national risk limits, and drinking water monitoring. The answers say the soil is lightly contaminated, stored temporarily pending reuse or cleaning, that soil policy is decentralised, and that the Rijk will work with local authorities on a national method for substances of concern.
I have asked the RIVM to derive risk limit values for PFOS and PFOA.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om risicogrenswaarden af te leiden voor PFOS en PFOA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over aanloopsteun voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen die opereren op luchthaven Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether state aid from northern provinces and municipalities to Groningen Airport Eelde (start-up aid and non-economic services costs) complies with EU state aid rules, including notification to the European Commission, discrimination between airports, and market economy investor tests. The Minister answered that responsibility for compliance lies with the airport's shareholders, declined to answer the substantive questions, and said the ministry would assess the economic basis when the airport applies for an airport decree.
Responsibility for compliance with and correct application of the state aid rules lies with the shareholders themselves.
De verantwoordelijk voor de naleving en correcte toepassing van de staatssteunregels ligt bij de aandeelhouders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a large-scale sand extraction plan in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, its effects on Natura 2000 nature, landscape, drinking water, restoration and whether less harmful locations were considered. The government answered that responsibilities are spread across Rijk, province, municipality and water boards, that environmental and appropriate assessments were carried out, and that no further talks with the province are planned.
In my view a careful weighing has taken place.
Naar mijn mening heeft een zorgvuldige afweging plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over het bericht dat de Raad van State zich heeft laten misleiden door het ministerie van I&W

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Council of State was misled by the ministry about Schiphol noise norms, and whether the 10,000-homes norm was binding and required a PKB procedure to change. The minister answered that the criteria figures are outcomes of a calculation rather than absolute limits, that the actualisation was communicated to parliament and was lawful, that no PKB procedure or law change was needed, and that the norm still applies.
In this respect, therefore, no homes have been built that should not have been built according to the norm.
Er zijn in dit opzicht dus ook geen woningen gebouwd die volgens de norm niet gebouwd hadden mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel 'Akkers vervuild door plastic in compost: 'Te veel rotzooi in de gft-bak''

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports of plastic contamination in compost, including whether a plastic norm exists, health and environmental risks, and who is responsible for preventing contamination. The state secretary answers that preliminary Rijkswaterstaat findings vary, that the legal limit of 0.5 percent non-biodegradable foreign matter applies, that private quality marks are stricter, that it sees no signs of large-scale serious contamination, and that a plan with stakeholders is being developed while municipalities can help by communicating what belongs in the green-waste bin.
The preliminary, not yet published, results give a varying picture of the extent to which compost contains plastic particles.
De voorlopige, nog niet gepubliceerde, resultaten geven een wisselend beeld van de mate waarin compost plastic deeltjes bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan en Van Brenk over kritiek op motie Lelystad Airport

MPs Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan and Van Brenk asked whether completing the airspace redesign by 2023 is realistic, whether low-flying routes from Lelystad Airport will be gone by then, how low-flying routes are defined, and whether a plan MER is needed. The minister says the 2023 target stands, a start decision follows in spring 2019 and a preferred variant in 2020, but gives no guarantee that low-flying routes disappear by 2023, offers no definition, and leaves the plan MER question open.
As agreed in the Coalition Agreement, the Cabinet will implement the planned adjustment of the airspace by 2023.
Zoals is afgesproken in het Regeerakkoord gaat het Kabinet de voorgenomen aanpassing van het luchtruim per 2023 realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de voorbereidingen voor de aanbesteding en uitvoering van de A27 Lunetten Rijnsweerd

A GroenLinks MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about preparations for tendering the A27 Lunetten-Rijnsweerd widening, including technical risks to the tank and foil structure, groundwater and nearby nature, contractor interest, liability for damage, repair costs and lessons from the A4 leak. The minister answered that tendering is planned for the first half of 2019, that risks are manageable under contract requirements, that liability is allocated to the contractor, and that exact methods are not yet known.
The contractor is responsible for carrying out these measures.
De aannemer is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de recent gepubliceerde factsheet Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad Airport

An MP asked the minister whether Lelystad Airport really relieves Schiphol and its neighbours, given that freed capacity will be refilled with new, noisier intercontinental flights, and whether the factsheet was misleading. The minister explained the relief in terms of the 2008 Aldersakkoord framework and the freed slots for network flights, and agreed to revise the factsheet's wording.
Because, despite my explanation in the previous answer, the word 'relieve' evidently causes confusion, I have amended the factsheet on this point.
Omdat ondanks datgene dat ik in het voorgaande antwoord heb toegelicht het woord «ontlasten» blijkbaar voor onduidelijkheid zorgt, heb ik de factsheet op dit punt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele in strijd met verdrag van Aarhus’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether the Aarhus Committee's finding that Borssele's lifetime extension breached the Aarhus Convention, and related questions on public participation, environmental impact assessment and the safety benchmark, were accepted. The State Secretary rejected a general Aarhus breach, argued the 2013 licence update required no MER, and said the second safety benchmark report is expected by the end of the year.
That is why I will study in the coming months whether additional (legal) measures need to be taken to increase citizen participation.
Daarom zal ik de komende maanden nog bestuderen of er aanvullende (wettelijke) maatregelen getroffen moeten worden om inspraak van burgers te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Rutte in gesprek met Alibaba over Europees distributiecentrum’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked about reports that the Prime Minister met Alibaba about a European distribution centre near Maastricht-Aachen Airport, with questions on jobs, environmental and noise impacts, the RLI mainport report, Belgian airspace arrangements and whether the government would reconsider. The minister declined to disclose details of the meeting as commercially confidential, called environmental effects a matter for future permit procedures, and reaffirmed general support for logistics investment.
It is not for the cabinet to disclose information from conversations with individual companies, as these are often commercially confidential in nature.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om informatie uit de gesprekken met individuele bedrijven openbaar te maken, omdat deze veelal bedrijfsvertrouwelijk van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de brandbrief van de gemeente Aalsmeer m.b.t. de nachtvluchten vanaf de Aalsmeerbaan

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why night flights from the Aalsmeerbaan were permitted during the control tower renovation, whether affected municipalities were consulted, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The Minister answered that LVNL requested a temporary exemption, that the runway would be used only in exceptional situations with monitoring and notification, and that the exemption was published in the Staatscourant.
The ministry has agreed with LVNL that during the works the use of the Aalsmeerbaan will be monitored and that LVNL will report on the BAS website whenever the exemption is used.

Het ministerie heeft met LVNL afgesproken dat gedurende de werkzaamheden de inzet van de Aalsmeerbaan wordt gemonitord en dat LVNL op de website van het Bewonersaanspreekpunt Schiphol (BAS) melding maakt als er gebruik wordt gemaakt van de vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het interview ‘De Wending’ met Dhr. Leon Adegeest

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether ministry officials intimidated Leon Adegeest, a Lelystad Airport critic, and about contacts with him and other stakeholders. The minister denied recognizing the intimidation picture, described the stakeholder contacts as part of the MER and advisory process, and stated no known cases of pressuring critics.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the interview.
Het in het interview geschetste beeld herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bijmengen van afvalstoffen aan brandstoffen en het ILT-rapport ‘Stookolie voor zeeschepen - Autobrandstoffen voor West-Afrika’

An MP asked the State Secretary about ILT findings that fuels blended with harmful substances are exported to West Africa, the health impact, enforcement, and why action has been slow. The government says REACH and Basel/Rotterdam rules largely do not reach such exports, that enforcement and prosecution referrals are underway, and that it will press for stricter norms in African countries and through international and EU channels.
I cannot provide further information about these signals.
Over deze signalen kan ik geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over de uitzending van Zembla getiteld “De Kunstgrasberg”.

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on illegal handling and stockpiling of artificial turf waste, inspection frequency, responsibility for disposal, and sustainable alternatives. The state secretary answered that municipalities and provinces are the competent authorities for licensing and enforcement, that the ILT inspected three firms and issued warnings, and that ownership of the matter remains with local authorities, while committing to follow up with Gelderland and Dongen and to work on sustainability through the sports accord.
I have asked the Province of Gelderland and the municipality of Dongen to keep me informed of the follow-up steps and will actively monitor their implementation.
Ik heb de Provincie Gelderland en gemeente Dongen verzocht mij op de hoogte te houden over de vervolgstappen en zal de uitvoering daarvan actief volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Shell krijgt subsidie voor bouw waterstofstations’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why Shell received about EUR 4 million from RVO's DKTI-Transport subsidy for four hydrogen stations, whether hydrogen from natural gas is sustainable, and why battery-electric charging stations received less support. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is technology-neutral, that the four stations received EUR 3.28 million in cofinancing under the programme's rules, and that both hydrogen and battery-electric vehicles are needed for climate goals.

The DKTI-Transport is a technology-neutral scheme that supports solutions for the development of climate technologies and innovations in the transport sector as well as the rollout of infrastructure for alternative fuels.

De DKTI-Transport is een technologie-neutrale regeling die oplossingen ondersteunt van de totstandkoming van klimaattechnologieën en -innovaties in de sector transport alsmede de uitrol van infrastructuur voor alternatieve brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Man smokkelt wapenonderdelen uraniumfabriek Gronau binnen’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether a smuggled weapon part at Urenco's Gronau enrichment plant could happen at Almelo, whether Almelo has been checked, what extra measures were taken, and what the regulator ANVS did. The state secretary answered that Almelo has had no weapons or parts found, daily checks are done, no extra measures were needed beyond awareness programmes, and ANVS asked all nuclear sites to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Following the Gronau incident, the ANVS asked Dutch nuclear facilities to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenis in Gronau heeft de ANVS de Nederlandse nucleaire inrichtingen gevraagd extra aandacht te besteden aan detectie van ongeoorloofde voorwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat liet vrijwilligers op eigen risico zwanen schoonmaken na olieramp’

An MP asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat wrongly had volunteers sign waivers of damage claims and whether it would monitor long-term health and ecological effects of the Bow Jubail oil spill, and who bears long-term costs. The minister acknowledged the waiver form was wrong, said RIVM found irritant substances with temporary symptoms, reported no evidence of chemical admixture, and explained the shipowner is liable under international conventions, though a limitation procedure is pending.
That should not have been in there.
Dat had er niet moeten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de belevingsvlucht

An MP from GroenLinks asked why the Lelystad Airport experience flight produced much more noise than the MER predicted, whether the MER and its noise profiles remain representative, and whether the project should be reconsidered. The minister deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming response, stated the MER meets legal requirements and was positively advised by the Commission for EIA, and said trend validation and expert advice on measurement versus calculation are underway.
I expect to be able to send this response to your House at the end of September.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer deze reactie eind september te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de wijziging van het Tracébesluit voor de Ring Utrecht

An MP asked the minister why a 2018 amendment to the Ring Utrecht route decision was needed, why outdated 2016 data forced removal of 28 hectares of green, and why the amendment was not opened to objections and appeals as with other route decisions. The minister said the data error affected only a small part of the basis, the green will be fully compensated locally, and that appeal is possible for six weeks after publication of the amended decision.
To formally arrange compensation for the additional green, an amended route decision is therefore needed.
Voor het formeel regelen van de compensatie van het extra groen is daarom een wijzigingstracébesluit nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar groei vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt’

An MP asked the minister whether the MKBA supporting growth at Rotterdam The Hague Airport was methodologically sound, whether it should be transparent, and how environmental and health costs, climate damage, compensation and local benefits are valued. The minister answered that the airport will update the MKBA incorporating prior critiques and publish its methods, that the ministry will review the economic underpinning before any airport decision, and that noise-related harm is valued through house price declines while residents may claim compensation, but gave only general answers on local benefits and declined to commit to a second opinion beyond existing reviews.
I am awaiting an application for an airport decision from the airport and will then make a substantive assessment based on all the information available.
Ik wacht een aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit van de luchthaven af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het rapport 'Hoogspanningslijnen en gezondheid deel I: kanker bij kinderen'

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the Health Council report linking long-term exposure to magnetic fields with childhood leukaemia and brain tumours should prompt precautionary measures extended to underground cables and existing housing. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said magnetic fields cannot be shielded, and committed to an evaluation of the current precautionary policy and an exploration of extending it, without prejudging outcomes.
It will be evaluated how the precautionary policy for overhead lines has been implemented so far and what its societal effects are.
Er zal worden geëvalueerd hoe het voorzorgbeleid voor bovengrondse lijnen tot nu toe is uitgevoerd en wat hiervan de maatschappelijke effecten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het project Over de Maas en Vonkelplas

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the Over de Maas and Vonkelplas sand-extraction projects, concerning oversight of deep lakes, soil-quality rules, imported contaminated soil, and archaeological risks. The government answered that it will evaluate the framework for deep lakes and oversight, that municipalities bear responsibility for private agreements while Rijkswaterstaat supervises the soil-quality rules, and that the extraction permit extension poses no archaeological threat.
The content of any private-law agreements is the responsibility of the municipality.
De inhoud van eventuele privaatrechtelijke afspraken is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel “Reductie van broeikasgas blijft achter, biomassa is slechte energiebron”

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the Ministers whether they share concerns that growing biomass energy use worsens air quality and health, and asked about integrating climate and air quality policy and tightening emission rules for medium-sized boilers. The government answered that biomass does not necessarily worsen air quality, referred to the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a stookalert under development, said emission rules are already in place and to be reviewed in the 2019 ISDE evaluation, but declined to fully integrate climate and air quality policy.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include the effects on (local) air quality as one of the criteria in assessing the scheme.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over lichthinder bij de A27

An MP asked the minister about light pollution from 18-metre highway lamps on the widened A27 that stay on all night during construction, and whether this breaches agreements with residents and harms nocturnal badgers. The minister confirmed the lamps stay on at night during the works for safety, acknowledged communication should have been clearer, and said lights will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 once the road is open, but declined to lower the masts.
It was not discussed in advance that the lighting would remain on at night during the construction period.
Er is vooraf niet besproken dat de verlichting in de nacht tijdens de bouwperiode blijft branden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten “NS waarschuwt voor verbouwing Amsterdam CS” en “Iedereen wil openbaar vervoer, niemand wil het betalen”

An MP asked the state secretary about cost overruns of roughly €200 million for rebuilding Amsterdam Centraal and whether a track should be dropped. The state secretary answered that €150 million extra will be added from the rail investment room, with nine instead of ten through-tracks and a possible later tenth track, and that the government committed to a decision on the Amsterdam rail infrastructure.
I have asked ProRail to get a better grip on the cost developments and to map what can be learned from the cost increase that occurred.
Ik heb ProRail verzocht om beter grip te krijgen op de kostenontwikkelingen en in beeld te brengen wat men kan leren van de opgetreden kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked why Amsterdam Centraal was chosen for nine tracks rather than ten or nine-and-a-half, what a future tenth track would require and cost, and how the Zuid station and the Noord/Zuidlijn handle demand. The state secretary answered that nine tracks plus six at Zuid free the western line for high-frequency service, that a tenth track would cost about €100 million more now and similar costs later, and that the chosen layout is expected to suffice to 2030 and largely 2040 with room left for a later tenth track.
The decision does leave room to take a later decision on this in order to respond to any changed insights.
Met het besluit wordt wel ruimte gelaten om hierover later een besluit te nemen om in te kunnen spelen op eventuele gewijzigde inzichten.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht 'Ryanair reveals worst gender pay gap in airline industry'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about reports that Ryanair has a very large gender pay gap and whether KLM and Transavia, in which the state is a shareholder, have similar gaps. The minister said the Ryanair situation cannot be addressed specifically, offered to suggest a quick scan to KLM and Transavia, and said the government has no legal means to force gender balance across functions.
We do not have specific information about a gender pay gap at KLM and Transavia.
Wij beschikken niet over specifieke informatie over een loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen bij KLM en Transavia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over de berichten dat asbest in make-up is aangetroffen

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked how many shops sold make-up containing asbestos, how many products were sold, the health risk for children, why no consumer warning was issued sooner, which products tested clean, whether Claire's US test results would be shared, and the scope of a broader investigation. The government answered that 22 and 25 shops sold the two affected products, the health risk is probably limited though asbestos levels were undesirably high, a warning was issued within a reasonable time, the ILT obtained but cannot publish Claire's test results, and the NVWA and ILT are testing over 250 talc-containing cosmetics.
Claire's commissioned this research and is not obliged to make this research public.
Claire's is opdrachtgever van dit onderzoek en is niet verplicht om dit onderzoek openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over Schiphol en Lelystad Airport

MP Kröger (GreenLeft) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about enforcing the 10,000-movement cap at Lelystad Airport, the EU slot allocation rule, environmental impact assessment gaps, noise and cumulation calculations, route deviations, the transparency of Wob-withheld documents, and the balance between military and civil airspace use. The minister answered that the cap reflects airspace limits, that the MER update will be amended into the Luchthavenbesluit, that many numbers are not broken down by municipality, and that withheld Wob information is justified in the decision letter.
The inventory list that forms part of the decision indicates for each document which exemption grounds apply.
In de inventarislijst die deel uitmaakt van het besluit is per document aangegeven welke uitzonderingsgronden hierop van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over windenergie en luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asked ministers whether reopening Lelystad Airport for small aviation and its flight-path restrictions would obstruct planned wind parks in Flevoland and the Energy and Climate Agreements, and what the cost and compensation implications would be. The minister answered that the government is seeking spatial solutions for both aviation and wind energy, that exact routes and turbine heights are still under review, and that cost allocation is still being discussed without concrete figures.
I will keep you informed of the progress of this.
Over de voortgang hiervan zal ik u op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de douane controle Eurostar

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked why preparations for border controls at Dutch stations for a direct Eurostar service to London were not started sooner, what faster bilateral options exist, how much Marechaussee capacity is needed, and why a transfer in Brussels is safer than Dutch controls. The government replied that a Four-Party Treaty and related agreements are being pursued with a target of 2019 and a direct service from the 2020 timetable, with Marechaussee staffing still to be recruited and passengers transferring in Brussels until then.
The Dutch government's aim is to have all international agreements realised by the end of 2019, so that Eurostar can expect to offer a direct Amsterdam-London connection from the 2020 timetable.

De inzet van de Nederlandse overheid is alle internationale afspraken eind 2019 gerealiseerd te hebben, zodat Eurostar naar verwachting vanaf dienstregeling 2020 een directe verbinding van Amsterdam naar Londen kan gaan aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten over verontreinigde grond met PFOS en PFOA bij Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of PFOS and PFOA contaminated soil at Schiphol, including why it was not treated earlier, the risks, whether a national norm is needed, and whether firefighting foam with PFOA is still used. The state secretary answered that the contamination is mostly light and below RIVM risk limits, that soil policy is decentralised to municipalities and provinces, that a national norm was not pursued, and that EU rules will ban PFOA in foams from June 2020.
In the 2008 incident a leak releasing firefighting foam was the cause of the contamination, not the use of firefighting agents.
Bij het incident in 2008 was een lekkage waarbij blusschuim vrijkwam de oorzaak van de verontreiniging, en niet het gebruik van brandblusmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat Nederland het verbod op pulsvissen over zich heeft afgeroepen

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the Netherlands delayed research into pulse fishing for years, whether the Commission was consulted, and why 84 vessels were licensed for the research. The minister denied any delay, listed Commission contacts and vessel licence timing, and defended the scale of the research programme.
No. Research has been carried out from the very beginning of issuing permits.
Nee. Er is vanaf het begin van de afgifte van toestemmingen onderzoek uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over luchthaven Lelystad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cap of 45,000 flight movements at Lelystad Airport, how the usable capacity is set and enforced by the ILT, noise measurement and the 60,000-movement sensitivity calculation, and whether the limits will be legally anchored. The Minister answered that the 45,000 maximum will be written into the forthcoming amendment of the Luchthavenbesluit, that the ILT enforces noise limits at handhavingspunten, that a 10,000 large-commercial-traffic ceiling will also be fixed in agreements, and that an evaluation at 7,000 movements is planned, while declining to give some answers in time for the debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Özütok over “de oproep van een toxicoloog dat werknemers van Custom Powders moeten worden getest op omstreden stof GenX”

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Custom Powders employees exposed to GenX should be tested, and whether the labour inspectorate had engaged the company. The State Secretary answered that exposure assessment and any blood testing are the employer's responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that the inspectorate visits such firms on a risk basis without discussing individual inspection results, and that it sees no reason to raise blood testing with the employer.
I will not go into the results of individual inspections.
Ik ga niet in op resultaten van individuele inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten in de media “GenX aangetroffen in afvalwater ATM Moerdijk” en “Bron GenX op zuivering Bath gevonden”

An MP asked about media reports that GenX was found in wastewater from ATM Moerdijk and at the Bath treatment plant, asking when ATM reported it, whether it may continue discharging, whether air and soil research is done, sanctions, worker protection and Chemours' disclosure of recipients. The minister answered that concentrations were very small, ATM voluntarily stopped accepting Chemours waste, the permit allows discharge, air/soil research is underway elsewhere, and the ILT requested Chemours' data.
The competent authority sees no reason to prohibit ATM from using this permit.
Het bevoegd gezag ziet geen aanleiding om ATM te verbieden gebruik te maken van deze vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Nederlands echec rond pulsvisserij is eigen schuld'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the European Commission ever formally approved the large Dutch expansion of pulse fishing permits, whether other member states were consulted, and what was done about EU complaints. The minister replies that the permits rest on three categories of approval (regular rules, a bilateral research agreement, and facilitation of the landing obligation), that the Commission confirmed them, and that other member states were only informed at official level.
From the above it appears that the European Commission cooperated in the expansion of experimental pulse fishing.
Uit bovenstaande blijkt dat de Europese Commissie medewerking heeft gegeven aan de uitbreiding van de experimentele pulsvisserij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over windenergie en luchthaven Lelystad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the expansion of Lelystad Airport could harm wind energy sites and turbine heights in Flevoland, and whether the wind plans were protected and excluded from the airport's cost-benefit analysis. The Minister confirmed the conflict, said the parties are seeking ways to accommodate both projects, and stated that the cost-benefit analysis did not include effects on renewable energy.
The cost-benefit analysis concerns the social costs and benefits of the airport decision for expanding Lelystad Airport for international air traffic.
De MKBA heeft betrekking op de maatschappelijke kosten en baten van het luchthavenbesluit voor uitbreiding van Lelystad Airport voor het internationale vliegverkeer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over de berichten dat make-up asbest bevat

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked the state secretary about reports that Claire's children's make-up contained asbestos, including whether ILT and NVWA had tested the products, how they relied on FDA and Health Canada data, and whether talc-related products are monitored. The government replied that ILT tested 28 Claire's products and found no asbestos, that NVWA relied on FDA findings and manufacturers bear primary responsibility, and that it would not request the private analysis reports but would act if asbestos-contaminated talc products were found.
I therefore see no reason at this time to request these reports.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om deze rapporten op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over het MAA-besluit

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the minister about the Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) decision to allow more cargo flights, including the effects on residents, noise and air quality, compensation for planning damage, and whether residents were misled about flight numbers and should get a new objection period. The minister answered that the corrected noise inputs will be assessed in an amended procedure with a new m.e.r. notice and a draft amendment placed before parliament, that damage claims will be handled under the existing compensation policy, and that residents were correctly informed about annual flight numbers, so no new objection period is planned.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht ‘Driekwart gemeenten koopt nog vervuilend vervoer’

MPs Özütok and Kröger asked whether municipalities have the expertise and priority to buy sustainable vehicles, after a Natuur & Milieu benchmark found most municipalities lag behind national procurement criteria. The State Secretary attributes gaps to limited knowledge, priority and divided responsibility, points to existing MVI support tools, and says she will discuss stimulating municipalities with the VNG and PIANOo without making binding commitments.
I am happy to discuss with the VNG and PIANOo how we can further encourage municipalities to improve this.
Ik ben er graag toe bereid om met de VNG en PIANOo te bespreken hoe we gemeenten nog meer kunnen stimuleren om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het RIVM-onderzoek naar GenX in het drinkwater

An MP asked the minister about the RIVM finding of a possible additional source of GenX contamination, what measures are being taken to trace it, whether DuPont/Chemours is involved, which other firms use GenX technology, and when the Chamber will get results on bioaccumulation and a surface water quality standard. The minister answered that drinking water is safe, source investigations are ongoing with results expected early 2018, the Chamber will be informed, and a bioaccumulation study was approved with RIVM advice to follow.
At the legislative consultation of 27 November I indicated that the results of the further source investigation are expected in early 2018.
Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg van 27 november heb ik aangegeven dat de uitkomsten van het nadere onderzoek naar de bron(nen) begin 2018 worden verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van Raan en Kröger over de Jonge Klimaatagenda

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Young Climate Agenda, including how young people can be involved in climate policy and how its themes of work and education will be reflected in implementation. The minister acknowledged youth's importance, pointed to past support for youth participation and a Climate Envoy, and said work and education themes will be explored in coming months, including via a forthcoming SER advisory report.

In the coming months I will, together with relevant cabinet colleagues and in consultation with social partners and education, examine how these themes can be incorporated into the further elaboration of the plans.

In de komende maanden zal ik in samenwerking met de relevante collega’s uit het kabinet en in overleg met sociale partners en het onderwijs, bezien op welke wijze deze thema’s kunnen worden meegenomen in de verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het risico van 'bird-strikes' bij luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asked whether military radar data on bird movements at altitude, and Sovon bird observations, could support a more detailed bird-strike risk analysis for the flight routes to and from Lelystad airport, and whether the Air Force and air traffic control coordinate on bird-strike prevention en route. The minister answered that a baseline survey up to 6 km around the airport is underway, that Air Force radar data will be used for a risk analysis of the approach routes, and that Air Force information is shared with air traffic control, which notes that nearly all bird strikes occur below 3,000 feet.
In addition, the bird radar data of the Royal Netherlands Air Force will be used for a risk analysis of bird strikes on the approach routes to and from Lelystad airport.

Daarnaast zullen de vogelradargegevens van de Koninklijke Luchtmacht worden gebruikt voor een risicoanalyse met betrekking tot vogelaanvaringen op de aansluitroutes van en naar de luchthaven Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het inspraakproces luchthaven Lelystad

Kröger (GroenLinks) asks why the Lelystad Airport flight-route internet consultation site was reportedly unreachable, how input from the consultation and the Alderstafel is handled, and how affected municipalities and provinces are involved. The minister answers that the site was working but showed an incorrect error message due to duplicate-submission and certificate issues, that input is registered as formal responses with an advisory committee review and a summary to follow, and that the Alderstafel's mandate is unchanged while a stakeholder-management plan and an exploration of strengthening the Alderstafel are promised.
It is expected that from the end of November 2017 a summary of the input to the internet consultation, with a response, will be posted on the internet consultation page.
Naar verwachting zal vanaf eind november 2017 op de internetconsultatiepagina een samenvatting van de inbreng op de internetconsultatie, voorzien van een reactie, worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Kröger over het bericht 'Minister Schultz in beeld als nieuwe baas Schiphol'

GreenLeft MPs Van Tongeren and Kröger asked whether a minister moving to a state-owned company (Schiphol) in his own policy field is acceptable, and about the cooling-off rules, the Schiphol CEO succession and any contacts with the Finance Minister. The government replied that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field, that former ministers decide on their own integrity, and that the minister had not been approached and had no contacts about the succession.
Cabinet policy is that a two-year cooling-off period applies to lobbying in one's own policy field.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dat er een afkoelingsperiode van twee jaar geldt voor het lobbyen op het eigen beleidsterrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Haven stoot meer CO2 uit dan ooit’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government about reports that the Rotterdam port emits more CO2 than ever, whether it will help the port's climate ambitions, and how it will address the CCS project and local air quality. The state secretary answered that the transition is a multi-step process, pointed to existing port decarbonisation projects, and deferred most concrete choices to the incoming cabinet, while confirming the CCS ambition remains and alternative talks are ongoing.
It is up to the new cabinet, based on the coalition agreement presented on 10 October, to further shape the climate and energy transition in the Netherlands, and therefore also in the Rotterdam port.

Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om op basis van het op 10 oktober jl. gepresenteerde regeerakkoord de klimaat- en energietransitie in Nederland, en dus ook in de Rotterdamse haven, verder vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Kröger over de bloedtest die beschikbaar gesteld wordt voor omwonenden van chemieconcern Chemours

MPs Van Eijs and Kröger asked why the Chemours blood test for residents is limited to the RIVM blue zone, whether financial barriers exist, and whether former workers and wider residents can participate. The State Secretary defends the zone as based on the RIVM sample, states there are no costs, promises to ask municipalities to offer tests to former workers without a traceable employer, and says municipalities will communicate the offer.

To prevent these people from having no opportunity to be tested, I will ask the municipalities of Dordrecht, Sliedrecht and Papendrecht to also make a test available for those cases where no former employer can be traced.

Om te voorkomen dat deze mensen geen mogelijkheid hebben om zich te laten testen, zal ik de gemeenten Dordrecht, Sliedrecht en Papendrecht vragen om, voor die gevallen waarin geen voormalige werkgever meer traceerbaar is, ook een test beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport 'Wordt de 25% emissiereductie van broeikasgassen in 2020 gehaald?'

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government whether the CE Delft report showing the 25% CO2 reduction target for 2020 is uncertain should be accepted, what concrete measures will ensure it is met, and why each factor (wind yield, ROAD cancellation, lower electricity imports) pushes emissions higher. The state secretary referred to earlier answers, said the NEV 2017 will give an integrated overview expected in October, promised the ROAD status update for the 2018 budget, and offered no new concrete measures.
The NEV 2017, expected in October, will give an integrated overview of the effects of all relevant energy developments affecting greenhouse gas emissions in the Netherlands.

De NEV 2017, die naar verwachting in oktober uitkomt, zal een integraal overzicht geven van de effecten van alle relevante ontwikkelingen op energiegebied die van invloed zijn op de broeikasgasuitstoot in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘weer paraffine gevonden op Noord- en Zuid-Hollandse stranden’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of paraffin washing up on North and South Holland beaches, including volumes and cleanup costs, prevention measures, IMO negotiations and public warnings. The minister withheld current volume and cost figures pending a contract negotiation, described existing controls and an IMO discharge-ban push with decisions expected in 2018, and said no extra at-sea checks are currently planned.
I cannot yet inform you about the quantity of paraffin washed ashore in recent months and the cleanup costs.
Over de hoeveelheid aangespoelde paraffine van de afgelopen maanden en kosten voor het ruimen ervan kan ik u nog niet informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht “Greenpeace spant kort geding aan om biomassameestook RWE te stoppen”

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Greenpeace's kort geding to stop RWE's biomass co-firing, whether substantive agreements on sawdust origin existed before subsidy payment, and whether the subsidy should be withdrawn. The minister confirmed awareness, said the sustainability criteria are set in the SDE+ scheme, that the dispute falls under a private convenant the government is not party to, and that he will not interfere, declining to withdraw the subsidy.
Given the private-law nature of the agreements in the convenant, I do not wish to interfere in this discussion.
Gelet op het privaatrechtelijke karakter van de afspraken uit het convenant, wil ik mij niet mengen in deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over overlast vliegverkeer in Zuid-Limburg

An MP asked whether new agreements or a treaty on aircraft noise over South Limburg (Liège airport approaches over Eijsden) were progressing, whether routes and volumes had changed, why monitoring is limited, and whether the ministry measures itself. The state secretary replied that a Memorandum of Cooperation with Belgium is planned for late 2017, a treaty is a longer-term goal, existing operational agreements remain in force, the ministry runs its own Fanomos monitoring, and monitoring covers all radar registrations up to 15,000 feet within a fixed area in four time periods.
I expect to be able to conclude the Memorandum of Cooperation in the second half of 2017.
Ik verwacht het Memorandum of Cooperation in de tweede helft van 2017 te kunnen afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de Nederlandse industrie in 2016 niet is gedaald

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why industrial CO2 emissions stayed flat in 2016, whether this conflicts with the Urgenda ruling and Paris commitments, and whether ETS alone is insufficient so national measures are needed. Ministers Kamp and Dijksma attributed the flat figure to higher production and shifts in the power sector, agreed deep cuts are needed, and said the government is consulting industry on additional measures under the Energy Agenda.
Yes, as also indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the cabinet is in discussion with various societal parties and companies on the further elaboration of the Energy Agenda.
Ja, zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen is het kabinet in gesprek met diverse maatschappelijke partijen en bedrijven over de verdere uitwerking van de Energieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether coal plant operators and other Energieakkoord parties still lack agreement on biomass sustainability criteria, whether RWE will co-fire biomass at AMER9 and whether SDE+ subsidies for co-firing with non-FSC-equivalent certificates are permitted. The minister replied that agreement was reached in 2015, only implementation talks remain, a transitional reporting regime applies, and an independent advisory committee will assess certificates, with its composition to be announced soon.
An independent advisory committee will advise me on the extent to which certificates meet the Dutch sustainability criteria after the transitional regime.
Een onafhankelijke adviescommissie zal mij gaan adviseren in hoeverre certificaten na het overgangsregime voldoen aan de Nederlandse duurzaamheidscriteria.

Motie van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het ondersteunen van de Belarussische oppositie in de Baltische staten
Asks the government to contact the Belarusian opposition in the Baltic states, identify its needs for opposition work and exposing regime abuses, and support those needs.
requests the government to contact the Belarusian opposition in the Baltic states at very short notice
verzoekt de regering op zeer korte termijn in contact te treden met de Belarussische oppositie in de Baltische staten
Motie van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over sancties tegen Belavia en organisaties die zakendoen met Belavia
Asks the government to push within the EU for secondary sanctions against Belavia and organisations doing business with it, over migrant trafficking.
requests the government to advocate within the EU for secondary sanctions against Belavia
verzoekt de regering binnen de EU te pleiten voor secundaire sancties tegen Belavia
Motie van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over een plan om te voorkomen dat Afghanistan een uitvalsbasis wordt voor internationaal terrorisme
Asks the government to work within NATO on a plan to prevent Afghanistan from again becoming a base for international terrorism and to report progress to parliament.
requests the government to work within the alliance on a plan to prevent Afghanistan from again becoming a base for international terrorism, propose ideas for it, and inform the House of progress

verzoekt de regering zich in bondgenootschappelijk verband in te zetten voor een plan om te voorkomen dat Afghanistan opnieuw een uitvalsbasis wordt voor internationaal terrorisme, hier voorstellen voor aan te dragen, en de Kamer te informeren over de voortgang hierop
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over middelen voor het vergroten van de sanctiecapaciteit
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign ministry budget from a UN crisis-operations contribution to staff, to add sanctions-drafting capacity at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Motie van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over een draaiboek in verband met cyberaanvallen en voor een bondgenootschappelijke reactie
Asks the government to draw up and exercise a playbook for cyberattack scenarios, including diplomatic response, and to push for an allied response plan.
requests the government to draw up and practise a playbook for cyberattack scenarios, including a diplomatic response
verzoekt de regering een draaiboek op te stellen en te oefenen met scenario's voor cyberaanvallen, inclusief diplomatieke reactie
Motie van het lid Brekelmans over in 2022 voorstellen doen voor een openbaar register voor "agents of foreign influence"
Asks the cabinet to propose a public register in the Netherlands for agents of foreign influence, modelled on Australia.
requests the cabinet, based on these experiences, to make proposals in 2022 for a public register in the Netherlands for agents of foreign influence.
verzoekt het kabinet op basis van deze ervaringen in 2022 voorstellen te doen voor een openbaar register in Nederland voor «agents of foreign influence»
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over handelsstromen tussen Belarus en de EU inzichtelijk maken en mazen in de wet aanpakken
Asks the government to make trade flows between Belarus and the EU and the Netherlands transparent and to close legal loopholes in EU sanctions.
Asks the government to make trade flows between Belarus and the EU and between Belarus and the Netherlands transparent.
verzoekt de regering de handelsstromen tussen Belarus en de EU en tussen Belarus en Nederland inzichtelijk te maken
Amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. over middelen voor het beschermen en ondersteunen van slachtoffers van religieuze vervolging
Moves budget from the security and stability article to the international legal order article to fund a rapid response fund protecting victims of religious persecution.
The increase in article 1 benefits article 1.2 Protection and promotion of human rights.
De verhoging in artikel 1 komt ten goede aan artikel 1.2 Bescherming en bevordering van mensenrechten.
Amendement van het lid Brekelmans c.s. over middelen voor een taskforce tegen afhankelijkheid van autoritaire grootmachten
Shifts funds within the security budget to create a taskforce reducing strategic dependence on authoritarian powers such as China.
Preparations are made to set up a Taskforce.
Daarbij worden voorbereidingen getroffen om een Taskforce in te richten.
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over middelen voor het vergroten van weerbaarheid tegen statelijke cyberdreigingen
Shifts EUR 500 thousand within the defence and security budget from the Stabiliteitsfonds to combating international crime and terrorism, with multi-year earmarking.
In article 2 Security and stability, the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by EUR 500 (x EUR 1,000).
In artikel 2 Veiligheid en stabiliteit worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 500 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Sjoerdsma c.s. over middelen voor het vergroten van de sanctiecapaciteit
Shifts 1 million euro within the foreign ministry budget from UN crisis-operations contributions to staff capacity for EU sanctions work.
Coverage is found by reducing article 2.4 Promotion of security, stability and rule of law internationally (UN contribution for crisis management operations) by 1 million euro.

De dekking wordt gevonden door artikel 2.4 Bevordering van veiligheid, stabiliteit en rechtsorde in internationaal verband (VN-contributie voor crisisbeheersingsoperaties) te verlagen met € 1 miljoen.
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Agnes Mulder over een goede balans in het opkomen voor de verschillende belangen van Nederland in het noordpoolgebied
Asks the government to continuously seek a good balance between climate, environment, security and economic interests in the Arctic, working with international partners.
requests the government to continuously pursue a good balance in defending Dutch interests in the Arctic region
verzoekt de regering, doorlopend een goede balans na te streven in het opkomen voor de belangen van Nederland in het noordpoolgebied
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Nieuw beeld van daders seksuele uitbuiting: bijna 90 procent heeft migratieachtergrond en ze vallen na straf terug in oud gedrag’

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked about a report on perpetrators of sexual exploitation (predominantly with migration background, reoffending after sentence), including attention to people with mild intellectual disability, the effects of the LVB policy study, attachment problems in youth care, and further research. The state secretary points to the LVB-proof criminal justice agenda, existing youth care guidelines, planned research and the forthcoming reinforced anti-trafficking action plan, without committing to a new specific measure.
Your House was informed by letter of 23 April about, among other things, the recent research of the National Rapporteur
Uw Kamer is per brief van 23 april jl. geïnformeerd over onder meer het recentelijk onderzoek van de Nationaal Rapporteur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over de levering van Patriot-systemen en raketten aan Oekraïne

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about supplying Patriot systems and missiles to Ukraine, including use of Dutch stocks, production acceleration, interoperability and NASAMS. The minister answered that the government is actively examining options, committed funds for air defence, and is pursuing joint procurement and production efforts, though it gave no firm decisions on several points.
In weighing this, the impact on operational readiness, international obligations and the ability to keep training Dutch military personnel is critically examined.
Hierbij wordt in de afweging kritisch gekeken naar de gevolgen voor de operationele gereedheid, internationale verplichtingen en de mogelijkheid om Nederlandse militairen te blijven trainen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet moet alerter zijn op spionage met Chinese scanners bij douane’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government should reconsider using Nuctech scanners at Dutch customs given espionage risks, and why Nuctech has not been excluded as other countries did. The state secretary answered that a TNO-led study found current use does not endanger national security, that a retest is underway because of planned algorithm integration, and that the government will share results around summer recess.
The conclusions of the TNO-led study were submitted to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
De conclusies van het onderzoek onder regie van TNO zijn vertrouwelijk aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Brekelmans en Erkens over het artikel ‘Russische schepen die bijtanken bij Vlissingen’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a NRC report that Russian-linked shadow fleet ships refuel and anchor at Everingen near Vlissingen, raising sanctions evasion, safety and enforcement concerns. The minister answered that anchorage fees are not charged, ship numbers have not risen sharply, no Russian-flagged ships anchored there, the ILT is still assessing accident risk, and enforcement and EU coordination are being strengthened, while rejecting a ban on anchoring and ruling out a mayoral enforcement role.
It is undesirable that ships can circumvent the European sanctions rules and may also pose a danger to people and the environment.
Het is onwenselijk dat schepen de Europese sanctieregels kunnen omzeilen en daarbij ook mogelijk een gevaar zijn voor mens en milieu.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over de ministeriële regeling tot aanwijzing van evacués uit het Midden-Oosten met een Nederlandse verblijfsstatus wier huisvesting bijzondere zorg van rijkswe

Two VVD MPs asked why a ministerial regulation was needed to house non-self-sufficient evacuees from the Middle East with Dutch status, how many are affected, and whether it will burden municipal housing quotas and social rental waiting lists. The minister answered that the rule covers a very small group of evacuees who cannot arrange housing themselves, that it is applied case by case, and that municipalities can count these cases toward their statushouder quota; he also agreed to answer urgently and to refrain from irreversible steps until parliament can debate it.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de Kamerbrief over de inzet voor de jaarlijkse Vergadering van verdragspartijen van het Statuut van Rome

MP Brekelmans asked the government about its stance on possibly amending Article 15bis of the Rome Statute to extend ICC jurisdiction over the crime of aggression, including risks to relations with the US, interaction with Article 8bis(2)(f), and the Responsibility to Protect. Minister Bruins Slot answered that the Dutch position is unchanged, that the government will assess in 2024 whether to propose an amendment with like-minded partners, and that it will inform parliament before any formal diplomatic step.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over een overleg met de Iraakse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a December 2023 meeting with Iraq's foreign minister addressed cooperation on returning rejected Iraqi asylum seekers, and what leverage the government would use. The minister confirmed migration cooperation, including returns, was raised, outlined ongoing dialogue and operational work, and said visa and aid measures are one instrument among several, without committing to specific pressure.
Unfortunately this was not achieved in time for the budget debate.
Helaas is dit niet gelukt voor de begrotingsbehandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Erdogan: Hamas is geen terroristische organisatie'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about President Erdogan calling Hamas a liberation group, whether Turkish-funded mosques and schools spread such views, and how the government counters foreign influence and antisemitism. The ministers condemned Hamas as terrorist, said they raised the issue with Turkey and monitor foreign interference, but declined to investigate specific mosques or schools, citing lack of competence and absence of signals.
The Ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and of Foreign Affairs are not authorised to investigate persons or organisations.
De Ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Buitenlandse Zaken zijn niet bevoegd onderzoek naar personen of organisaties te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het alleen schriftelijk beoordelen van asielaanvragen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the IND's use of written hearings for asylum applications from Syrians and Yemenis, which Nederland appears to be the only EU state to use, and about the reliability, risks and approval rates of the procedure. The State Secretary answered that written hearing was a temporary measure to reduce backlogs, with safeguards, and that the IND has since stopped written hearings following a motion adopted by the House.
The House of Representatives adopted on 10 October a motion by MPs Brekelmans and van den Brink asking the government to abolish written hearings for promising asylum seekers.

Inmiddels heeft de Tweede Kamer op 10 oktober jl. een motie van de leden Brekelmans (VVD) en van den Brink (CDA) aangenomen waarin de regering wordt verzocht om schriftelijk horen voor kansrijke asielzoekers af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het rapport 'Stormbreak: Fighting through Russian defences in Ukraine’s 2023 offensive'

MPs Brekelmans and Valstar asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the RUSI report 'Stormbreak' on Ukraine's 2023 offensive, including whether NATO/EU safety rules limit realistic training, whether training is too focused on individual tactics, and whether brigade staff training is deficient. The Minister largely rejected the report's analysis, saying training is adapted to Ukraine's needs within safety requirements and that NATO doctrine is taught where useful, while committing only to continue existing coordination efforts.
I do not recognise this picture.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Gündoğan en Brekelmans over het bericht 'België verbiedt aankoop van Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane, Nederland (nog) niet'

MPs Rajkowski, Gündoğan and Brekelmans asked whether Dutch customs should stop using Chinese Nuctech scanners after Belgium's Council of State upheld exclusion of Nuctech from a tender, and whether this and EU and intelligence warnings should prompt a rethink. The state secretary answered that about 70 of roughly 100 customs scanners are Nuctech, that national security is not currently endangered under a TNO study, that procurement law limits exclusion of EU suppliers, and that stricter security requirements, a supplier-diversification effort and further research are underway.

The first part of the study indicated that national security is currently not endangered if the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the customs scan and detection processes is not compromised.

In het eerste deel van het onderzoek is aangegeven dat de nationale veiligheid op dit moment niet in gevaar komt als de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit of beschikbaarheid van scan- en detectieprocessen van de Douane worden aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Valstar over het artikel ''You don’t survive that': Ukraine sappers dice with death to clear Russian mines'

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Ukrainian demining needs, Dutch deliveries of mine-clearance systems, and funding for cheap local demining innovation. The government answered that it supplies demining capabilities in line with Ukraine's requests, supports local production and humanitarian demining, and that EU instruments are not open to Ukrainian participation.
The cabinet gives as much as possible effect to Ukrainian requests for the delivery of (additional) mine-clearing systems, in line with the Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma motion.
Het kabinet geeft zo veel mogelijk gehoor aan de Oekraïense verzoeken tot de levering van (aanvullende) mijnruimsystemen, in lijn met motie Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over het artikel ‘Internationale boksbond gaat olympische status verliezen om Russische invloeden’

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the ministers about the IOC withdrawing recognition of the boxing body IBA over Russian influence, and whether the Netherlands should back World Boxing and cut ties with the IBA. The minister agreed on excluding Russian athletes, officials and trainers, supported the IOC decision, but said it is not yet clear whether World Boxing will gain Olympic recognition and only committed to keeping in contact with NOC*NSF.
It is currently not yet clear whether World Boxing already has prospects of Olympic recognition; that is a matter for the IOC.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of World Boxing al zicht heeft op de Olympische erkenning, daar gaat het IOC over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Peters over het alleen schriftelijk beoordelen van asielaanvragen

MPs Brekelmans and Peters asked whether written-only asylum hearings for Syrian, Yemeni and Turkish applicants risk carelessness, wrongful grants and missed security risks, and whether they are reconsidered. The State Secretary defends written hearings as a careful, voluntary IND procedure needed to raise output, notes no evidence they attract more applicants, and states Turkish applicants are dropped from the procedure because it proved less suitable.
For that reason, written hearings are no longer applied to Turkish asylum seekers and are limited to asylum seekers from Syria and Yemen.
Om die reden wordt schriftelijk horen niet langer toegepast op Turkse asielzoekers en beperkt tot asielzoekers uit Syrië en Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het bericht 'Eindhovense toeleverancier van Philips en ASML opent vestiging in China'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a Dutch chip-supplier opening a plant in China could evade US restrictions, whether export controls, EU Chips Act goals, IP protection and screening of outward investment were adequate, and what sanctions were possible. The government answered that production abroad is not bound by Dutch law, that dual-use exports remain licensable, that outward-investment screening is awaiting an EU Commission analysis, and that no concrete measures against the firm were planned.
The cabinet has taken note of the European Commission's intention to examine the risks that may arise from outbound investments.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het voornemen van de Europese Commissie om de risico’s die mogelijk voortkomen uit uitgaande investeringen te gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Turkse Nederlanders mogen opnieuw in Amsterdam stemmen, extra aandacht voor veiligheid’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports that Turkish voters in Amsterdam could vote again amid safety concerns, including who organised the polling locations, the role of Turkish and Dutch authorities, campaign rules and possible foreign interference. The government answered that foreign states organise their own elections with local authorities advising on safety, that Turkish consulates submitted security plans, that campaigning by foreign officials is restricted, and that it would not commit to changing how voting is organised.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was informed in a timely and complete manner, both in writing and orally, by the Turkish embassy about how the voting process for the 2023 Turkish presidential and parliamentary elections would be organised in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is tijdig en volledig, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling, door de Turkse ambassade op de hoogte gebracht van de wijze waarop het stemproces voor de Turkse presidentiële en parlementaire verkiezingen van 2023 in Nederland wordt georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Statushouders niet tevreden met flexwoning: weigeren contract te tekenen'

MPs De Groot and Brekelmans asked about refugees in Rijswijk refusing flex housing contracts, how many are in reception, and what measures the government will take. The minister says refusal is unacceptable, that under 3% of refusals led to eviction, that no ultimatum can be set since municipalities decide, and that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared.
The cabinet is not in a position to set such an ultimatum in situations such as in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om een dergelijk ultimatum te stellen in situaties zoals in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Erkens over het bericht ‘Gezonde leefomgeving als grondrecht’

MPs Brekelmans and Erkens asked the Foreign Minister about adding a right to a healthy environment to the European Convention on Human Rights, the Reykjavik summit outcome, Dutch positions, and risks of politicised ECtHR rulings and competence conflicts with the EU Court. The minister answered that Dutch positions await the CDDH-ENV feasibility study due in 2024, declined to pre-judge ECtHR rulings, and saw no risk of competence conflict regarding the EU's accession.
Only once the need for and feasibility of a further instrument on human rights and environment, including climate change, have been mapped can the cabinet formulate a well-informed position.

Pas wanneer de noodzaak en haalbaarheid van een nader instrument op het gebied van mensenrechten en milieu, waaronder klimaatverandering, in kaart zijn gebracht, kan het kabinet een goed geïnformeerd standpunt formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Zelensky wil actie tegen Russische gokbedrijven op Curaçao’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Ukraine sanctioned Curaçao-based online gambling firms, and about oversight of those firms. The minister answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and supervision, that Nederland has no direct role, and that a new independent gaming regulator is planned under the Landspakket with a target of end-2023.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom and has its own gambling legislation and regulations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk en heeft eigen kansspelwet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over toegang tot DigiD voor Nederlanders in het Buitenland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch citizens abroad struggle to obtain DigiD access and why only AOW recipients abroad were proactively informed about login changes. The government acknowledged the problems, described expanded video-call appointments and planned fixes for ID activation, but declined to mail letters to citizens abroad because their addresses are unreliable.
I share the view that Dutch nationals abroad must have access to (digital) government services.
Ik deel de mening dat Nederlanders in het buitenland toegang moeten hebben tot (digitale) overheidsdienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over overlast en criminaliteit op het AZC in Gilze

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about crime, nuisance and safety problems at the Gilze asylum reception centre, including whether illegal residents are kept out and whether residents are punished for harbouring them. The State Secretary answered that nuisance has declined thanks to cooperation between COA, municipality, police and security, that staff feel safe, and that measures such as expedited procedures, removal and sanctions are applied, while largely not addressing the specific question on punishing residents or the reason for not transferring offenders to the HTL.
The picture that there is serious, structural nuisance is not recognised by the municipality of Gilze and Rijen and the COA.
Het beeld dat er sprake is van ernstige, structurele overlast, wordt door de gemeente Gilze en Rijen en het COA niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies.
