The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Brekelmans over het bericht 'ISU brengt Nederland in verlegenheid: Overleg met Russische bondsvoorzitter tijdens WK Afstanden in Heerenveen wekt wrevel’

VVD MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether it is acceptable that the Russian skating federation chairman attended an ISU meeting during the World Single Distance Championships in Heerenveen despite calls to exclude Russia and Belarus from international sport. The government replied that the ISU, not the KNSB, was responsible for the invitation, that the KNSB protested in writing, and that international sport is autonomous so it has no means to block such decisions.
The ISU was therefore responsible for the invitation, not the KNSB.
De ISU was dan ook verantwoordelijk voor het uitnodigen, niet de KNSB.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Ukraine accuses Hungary of funding Russian war crimes with energy deals'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hungary's new Russian gas and oil deals fund Russian war crimes, and how the government responds to Hungary's position in the EU. The minister says the government consistently presses Hungary bilaterally and in the EU to reduce energy dependence on Russia, while noting the gas deal is not contrary to EU rules and that no concrete sanctions or conditionality tools are available beyond continued pressure.
The financial instruments offer no basis for attaching conditions to the disbursement of funds to promoting strategic autonomy.
Het financiële instrumentarium biedt geen aanknopingspunten om voorwaarden te stellen om de uitkering van fondsen te koppelen aan het bevorderen van strategische autonomie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten ‘Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters’, ‘Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024’ en ‘D

MPs Heerema and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government will suspend visas for Russian athletes while Russia wages war in Ukraine, and how many visas were issued. The minister answered that two short-stay visas were granted in July 2022 for sports events, that each application is assessed individually under the Schengen visa code, and that no separate visa policy for Russian athletes exists.
There is no separate visa policy for this category of applicants.
Er is geen sprake van apart visumbeleid voor deze categorie aanvragers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Brekelmans over de berichten 'Nederlands standpunt Russische sporters', 'Aziatische sluiproute voert Russische sporters wellicht alsnog naar Olympische spelen 2024', en '

Two VVD MPs asked the government what role it can play in excluding Russian sports officials and sports-governing bodies, and whether it knows the international boxing federation is dominated by Russian officials, sponsored by Gazprom and allows Russian athletes under their own flag. The minister answered that the government has spoken out with international partners, confirmed awareness of these facts, said the Dutch boxing federation will skip certain IBA events, and stated that Dutch athletes will suffer no disadvantage.
I have, together with my international colleagues, expressed myself on this in several statements to international sport.
Ik heb mij samen met mijn internationale collega’s daar in meerdere statements richting de internationale sport voor uitgesproken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Treasury Targets Global Sanctions Evasion Network Supporting Russia’s Military-Industrial Complex’.

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a US Treasury sanctions action against a network evading Russia sanctions, including whether EU rules are violated, why the persons were not listed by the EU, and what Cyprus and Bulgaria have done. The minister answered that enforcement is a national competence, that the cabinet has no separate information on the specific cases, and that it cannot comment on specific listing proposals, while describing EU mechanisms and the proposed harmonisation of criminal penalties.
Enforcement is a national competence of the individual member states and their relevant authorities, as well as the decision to proceed with enforcement and prosecution.
Handhaving is een nationale competentie van de individuele lidstaten en hun relevante autoriteiten, evenals het besluit om over te gaan tot handhaving en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Brekelmans over moorden in Nederland en de Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde

MPs Ellian and Brekelmans asked whether investigations into the 2015 Almere and 2017 The Hague killings of Iranian-origin Dutchmen could qualify for EU terrorist listing of the IRGC, and whether the government would act on Iranian involvement. The government said the AIVD had strong indications of Iranian involvement and expelled two embassy staff in 2018, but that criminal investigations contain no proof of Iranian involvement, so the IRGC cannot currently be listed, and it continues to press for listing where legally possible.
In public, the AIVD cannot go into the nature of these indications.
In het openbaar kan de AIVD niet ingaan op de aard van deze aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Brekelmans over het artikel ‘Serbia calls on Russia to stop recruiting its citizens as mercenaries for war in Ukraine’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Serbian citizens fight for Russia in Ukraine and that the Wagner Group opened a 'cultural centre' in Serbia. The minister answered that Serbian law bans fighting abroad, some returnees have been prosecuted, the Wagner centre's presence is not confirmed, and the Commission is studying conditionality for Serbia's EU accession over weak CFSP alignment.

Question 2: How many Serbians have reportedly joined the Russian side since February 2022? Answer 2: The cabinet is aware of reports that Serbians are fighting for Russia in Ukraine but has no independent information on the numbers.

Vraag 2 Hoeveel Serviërs hebben zich naar schatting sinds de Russische aanval op Oekraïne in februari 2022 bij de Russische zijde van de strijd aangesloten? Antwoord 2 Het kabinet heeft kennis genomen van de berichten dat er Serviërs aan Russische zijde meevechten in Oekraïne, maar heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Strien en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Chipmaker Nexperia koopt Delftse start-up’

MPs asked the government about the acquisition of Delft start-up Nowi by Nexperia, a Chinese-owned chipmaker, and how the pending Wet Vifo investment screening law applies, including comparisons with UK and German blocking decisions. The minister said the Wet Vifo is not yet in force so no assessment of the Nowi takeover has been made, that it will examine the deal once the law takes effect given its retroactive reach, and that the government is not commenting on UK or German decisions.
Because there is no legal basis yet, I have not been able to carry out any investigations under this law, and therefore no assessment of the Nowi takeover has taken place.
Vanwege het ontbreken van een wettelijke basis, heb ik op dit moment nog geen onderzoeken kunnen doen op grond van deze wet en heeft er dus geen beoordeling plaatsgevonden van de overname van Nowi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri en Omtzigt over de podcast uitzending ‘Kim Lane Scheppele on Viktor Orbán’s Hungary’

Four MPs (Van Wijngaarden, Brekelmans, Piri, Omtzigt) asked the Foreign Minister about a podcast on Hungary's democratic decline, covering rule of law, EU sanctions, Russian diplomats, the IIB bank, Ukrainian refugees, EU funds, the state of emergency, EPPO membership and the EU's rule-of-law toolkit. The Minister answered that Hungary is not currently a fully democratic rule-of-law state, that the Commission should use all EU instruments, and that the Netherlands has consistently raised concerns and urged EPPO accession, while noting several questions fall to member states or the Commission.
Hungary violates fundamental values set out in Article 2 of the EU Treaty.
Hongarije schendt fundamentele waarden genoemd onder artikel 2 van het EU Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over de migratieroute via Servië

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the rise in irregular migration via the Western Balkan route through Serbia, including EU pressure on Serbia's visa regime and possible consequences for its visa-free arrangement. The government shares concern, reports Serbia's recent visa changes after EU diplomatic pressure, says it will monitor progress, and supports EU steps such as Frontex status negotiations and an action plan for the route.
The cabinet will closely monitor progress on this commitment and continue to press for progress.
Het kabinet zal de voortgang op deze toezegging nauwlettend monitoren en op voortgang blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien, Rajkowski en Brekelmans over de Chinese investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

VVD MPs asked the ministers about Chinese investments in Dutch firms, the risk of espionage, screening tools such as the Vifo Act, and the EU foreign subsidies regulation. The government answered that existing tools are being strengthened, that it keeps no active overview of ownership structures, and that the Rotterdam port issue is under study, with a country-neutral approach preferred.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder en Kuzu over de modernisering van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and DENK asked about the coalition agreement's plans for a private register of unwanted nationality and for revising the automatic loss of Dutch nationality after thirteen years abroad. The government answered that the register is a societal initiative the state would only support if taken up, and that it will draft a bill in the first quarter of 2023 amending the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap to revise the loss rule and add a recovery option.
I am preparing a bill that amends the Netherlands Nationality Act on these two points.
Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap op deze twee onderdelen wijzigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘UK to issue ‘threat alert’ over China’s attempts to recruit RAF pilots’

MPs Valstar and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government knows of former military pilots training Chinese forces, whether Dutch personnel are linked to a South African flight school, and whether current law can prosecute former military personnel who work for foreign states. The minister answered that the matter is concerning and under investigation by the MIVD, that details cannot be given publicly, that the government is in contact with UK authorities and is considering further measures, and that existing laws (including Articles 101 and 205 of the Criminal Code) offer possibilities.
Because of the classified nature of this investigation, no statements can be made publicly about its nature and content.
Vanwege het gerubriceerde karakter van dit onderzoek kunnen over de aard en inhoud in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Erkens, Brekelmans over het bericht 'Norway oil safety regulator warns of threats from unidentified drones'en het bericht 'Duitse media: lek Nord Stream vrijwel zeker sabotage 'do

MPs Valstar, Erkens and Brekelmans asked the government about reports of unidentified drones near Norwegian offshore gas infrastructure and reports that sabotage by a state actor was likely behind the Nord Stream leak, including questions on Russian vessel activity and NATO protection. The Foreign Minister answered that a real threat to vital undersea infrastructure exists but declined to disclose suspicious activity, said the Baltic and Nordic investigations must determine responsibility, and described NATO and Norwegian protective measures and Dutch work on mapping vulnerabilities.
For security reasons, the Netherlands in principle never makes statements about suspicious activities.
Nederland doet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen in principe nooit mededelingen over verdachte activiteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het reisadvies voor Rusland

MP Brekelmans asks the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands keeps its Russia travel advice at orange rather than red, as the US and UK have done, and whether it will urge Dutch nationals to leave Russia more actively. The minister answers that orange fits the specific, non-nationwide risks, that the Netherlands coordinates with EU partners and has been in contact with the US and UK, and that Dutch nationals have been advised to leave since February via the travel advice and embassy channels.
For the Dutch travel advice, the orange colour code is currently the most appropriate.
Voor het Nederlandse reisadvies geldt dat de oranje kleurcode op dit moment het meest passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over de dood van Mahsa Amini en de protesten in Iran

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it condemns the death of Mahsa Amini and the repression of protests in Iran, and what it is doing on demonstrators' rights, an independent inquiry, sanctions, women's rights, the nuclear deal and travel advice. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly condemned the violence and urged Iran bilaterally and multilaterally to respect peaceful protest and conduct an impartial inquiry, and that it supports EU human rights sanctions while not pre-announcing specific measures.
In principle, however, the cabinet does not comment on concrete proposals for new sanctions, so as not to undermine the element of surprise and thus the effectiveness of such measures.

Het kabinet doet in beginsel echter geen uitlatingen over concrete voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties, om zo het verrassingseffect en daarmee de effectiviteit van dergelijke maatregelen niet te ondermijnen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Strolenberg, Sjoerdsma en Sneller over de mogelijkheid tot online stemmen voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

Four MPs from VVD and D66 asked whether Dutch citizens abroad could be allowed to vote online, citing France's online voting for expats. The Minister of Interior replied that internet voting is rejected because it creates cyber risks to secrecy, freedom, and integrity of elections, that no steps are planned, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Introducing internet voting makes the electoral process vulnerable to cyber risks that put these safeguards at risk, such as ballot secrecy, freedom of voting and integrity.
Het introduceren van internetstemmen maakt het verkiezingsproces kwetsbaar voor cyberrisico's waarbij er risico's zijn voor deze waarborgen, zoals het stemgeheim, de stemvrijheid en de integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Brekelmans over het indienen van een VN-resolutie bij de Emergency Special Session over Oekraïne

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Russia's blockade of the Black Sea ports, which keeps Ukrainian grain from leaving, is a deliberate form of starvation and whether the government will convene an Emergency Special Session of the UN General Assembly to adopt a resolution condemning it and declaring a humanitarian corridor. The minister condemned the blockade and said it is not yet clear the government will call such a session, pointing instead to ongoing Turkish and UN negotiations and promising to sound out other UN members.
In addition, I will explore with other UN General Assembly members whether and how convening such a session has a chance of success.
Daarnaast zal ik onderzoeken bij andere AVVN-leden of en hoe het bijeenroepen van een dergelijke sessie kans van slagen heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Omstreden Chinese camera’s hangen overal in Nederland, ook bij ministeries'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Chinese Hikvision and Dahua cameras are used at government buildings, including police and ministries, and what security checks apply when procuring them. The government answered that it does not know how many Chinese cameras are in use, that procurement follows general information-security rules with each organisation assessing national-security risks itself, and that a cross-government study into such risks will be carried out.
It is not known how many cameras this specifically concerns.
Het is niet bekend om hoeveel camera's het specifiek gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Brekelmans over de afhankelijkheid van Russisch gas voor Poetins oorlogsdrift

MPs Erkens and Brekelmans asked how dependent the Netherlands is on Russian gas and oil, who owns or operates related infrastructure, and how quickly dependence could be cut. The government answered that Russian gas is an estimated 15% of consumption, that Gazprom holds a usage right and gas cushion gas at Bergermeer storage but no ownership of key infrastructure, that commercial data cannot be shared, and that it will inform the House further on Bergermeer and work with EU partners and the REPowerEU plan.
The share of Russian gas in the purchasing portfolios of European energy companies is private commercially sensitive information and not publicly accessible.
Het aandeel Russisch gas in de inkoopportefeuilles van Europese energiebedrijven is private commercieel gevoelige informatie en niet publiekelijk toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht dat 45 miljard euro Russisch vermogen van personen en organisaties op sanctielijsten in Nederland staat

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the government about a report that EUR 45 billion of Russian assets held by sanctioned persons and entities sits in the Netherlands, and why freezes have been limited, how other countries compare, what has been done to clarify sanctions implementation, and how evasion is prosecuted. Minister Hoekstra rejected the EUR 45 billion estimate as overstated because ownership runs through layered foreign structures, stated that over half a billion euro has been frozen and that prosecutors and the FIOD act on evasion, and described outreach to businesses and a new steering group, while noting that some implementation questions remain.
Twenty yachts under construction are also under enhanced Customs supervision.
Ook staan er twintig jachten in aanbouw onder verscherpt toezicht van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Rajkowski inzake berichten omtrent cyberaanvallen op Oekraïne en Nederlandse servers

Two VVD MPs asked whether Russia used Dutch servers to launch cyberattacks on Ukraine, whether hosting firms screen tenants, and what police can do. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that hosting firms have no legal duty to screen clients, police lack screening powers, and the government supports EU Digital Services Act rules for notice-and-takedown and reseller abuse, while ruling out stricter police checks on hosters.
Screening of clients by hosting providers is not a legal obligation.
Het screenen van klanten door hostingproviders is geen wettelijke verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over medische zorg en vaccinatie t.b.v. vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked the Health Minister and Justice State Secretary how medical care and vaccination for Ukrainian refugees is arranged in other European countries and in the Netherlands, including access for those arriving independently. The minister replied that many EU states link care to existing asylum schemes or adopt special rules, that the ministry coordinates with GGD, GHOR, COA and others, and referred to earlier correspondence on vaccination; care is available via the local GP and COVID vaccination without registration, while costs for non-working, non-asylum Ukrainians are covered by an SOV subsidy limited to basic-package care.
Anyone in the Netherlands who needs acute medical care can go to the local GP, including Ukrainians who arrive on their own.
Iedere persoon in Nederland die acute medische zorg nodig heeft kan zich melden bij de plaatselijke dokter, dus ook Oekraïners die op eigen gelegenheid naar Nederland komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over de participatie van Oekraïense vluchtelingen in onze samenleving

MPs Becker and Brekelmans asked the government about the reception, municipal costs, income support, integration and work of Ukrainian refugees, including whether mayors could be made legally responsible for reception. The minister answered that the mayors were given a statutory reception duty from 1 April 2022, that municipal costs will be fully reimbursed by central government, that Ukrainians are not subject to the civic integration obligation, and that further proposals on language and work are still being developed.
Your House has been informed about this by letter of 30 March.
Uw Kamer is hierover per brief van 30 maart jl. geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Strien over het bericht 'Streep door Haarlems Tsjaikovski en Stravinsky-festival: 'Dit lijken wel Sovjetpraktijken''

MPs Brekelmans and Van Strien asked whether the government would distinguish between state-linked Russian cultural institutions and independent Russian culture when Dutch venues reprogram Russian art after the invasion of Ukraine. The State Secretary answered that sanctions should target the Russian state, not Russian culture or people, and that formal cooperation with state-linked institutions is being suspended while individual artists remain welcome.
At this moment I leave it to Dutch institutions themselves to adjust their programming or not, as they see fit.
Ik laat het op dit moment aan Nederlandse instellingen zelf om hun programmering al dan niet aan te passen naar eigen inzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Superjachten van rijke Russen in beslag genomen door Frankrijk en Duitsland’

MPs Kamminga and Brekelmans asked whether Russian oligarchs' superyachts in Sint Maarten waters should be seized as France and Germany had done, and why the Kingdom had not acted. The Minister replied that the Kingdom must implement EU sanctions, that action would follow if listed owners' vessels were found there, that no such case currently exists, and that the government is in contact with Sint Maarten and monitors the situation.
If vessels owned by persons on the EU individual sanctions list are located in Sint Maarten waters (or other parts of the Kingdom), action will be taken.

Indien schepen van eigenaren, die voorkomen op de EU-sanctielijst voor individuen, zich bevinden in de wateren van Sint Maarten (of andere delen van het Koninkrijk) zal hiertoe actie worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over de verplichte MY2022 app bij de Olympische Spelen

VVD MPs asked whether data from the mandatory MY2022 Olympic app could be used for surveillance, whether it is securely transmitted and shared with third parties, whether the government will press the IOC and Chinese authorities to make it compliant or optional, and what measures the Netherlands will take. The minister answered that the risks fit a broader picture of Chinese data collection, that the app's encryption lacks authenticity checks, that data is shared with Chinese companies, that Dutch athletes are not obliged to use the app but must use the HMS function (which can be used online), that concerns were raised with the Chinese ambassador, and that briefings for NOC*NSF will be repeated.
Our concerns about this app were therefore conveyed to the Chinese ambassador in The Hague prior to the Games.
Onze zorgen over deze app zijn dan ook voorafgaand aan de Spelen overgebracht aan de Chinese ambassadeur in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Mali expels Paris envoy over 'hostile and outrageous' French comments'

VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about Mali's expulsion of France's envoy, the junta's postponed elections, and the effects on Dutch participation in MINUSMA and Takuba. The ministers answered that the junta is illegitimate, that Takuba will be withdrawn, and that the impact on Dutch missions and EU coordination is under close review.
The cabinet is also holding intensive consultations with partners in the UN and EU on the possible consequences of the deteriorating conditions in Mali for the UN mission MINUSMA.
Het kabinet voert daarnaast intensief overleg met partners in de VN en de EU over de mogelijke gevolgen van de verslechterende omstandigheden in Mali voor de VN-missie MINUSMA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de laatste ontwikkelingen in Oekraïne

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the security risks for Dutch citizens in Ukraine, the absence of planned state evacuation, and evacuation routes, following a US advisory to leave. The minister answered that the travel advice was raised to red for all of Ukraine, that no government-organised evacuation would take place if the situation deteriorated, and gave road and registration details.
Dutch citizens were informed that if they decide to stay and the situation deteriorates, no government-organised evacuation will take place.
Nederlanders zijn geïnformeerd dat als ze besluiten te blijven en de situatie zou verslechteren er geen door de overheid georganiseerde evacuatie zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

MPs Van der Woude and Brekelmans asked whether the VU's China-funded human rights research centre (CCHRC) was transparent about its Chinese funding, whether ministers knew, and whether such funding threatens academic independence and Uyghur safety in the Netherlands. The minister answered that funding was recorded internally but not individually in external reports, that the ministries were unaware, that academic independence must be safeguarded through risk assessment without blanket exclusion, and that a foreign-agent register like Australia's is not the answer, while the motion on such a register is still being implemented.
The Ministry of OCW and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs were not aware of this funding.
Het Ministerie van OCW en het Ministerie van BZ waren niet op de hoogte van deze financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands is not withdrawing embassy staff and families from Ukraine while the US, UK and Australia are, and about the risk assessments and travel advice. The minister answered that the situation in Kyiv is calm, that the Netherlands follows EU-aligned policy, withheld the other countries' risk analyses as confidential, and tightened travel advice.
I have not been given full insight into these countries' risk analyses, which is also not customary.
Van deze landen heb ik geen volledige inzage gekregen in hun risicoanalyse, dat is ook niet gebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Van Wijngaarden en Koerhuis over de actuele veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlanders in Oekraïne

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure about security risks for Dutch nationals in Ukraine, including travel advice, evacuation preparations and airspace safety. The government answered that there is no reason yet to speak of a threatening situation, kept the current travel advice, said evacuation is not being organised, and pointed to existing EU and national airspace risk assessments.
That number need not be representative of the actual number of Dutch nationals in Ukraine, because there is no registration obligation for Dutch nationals abroad (due to privacy).
Dat getal hoeft niet per se representatief te zijn voor het daadwerkelijke aantal Nederlanders in Oekraïne, omdat er geen registratieplicht is voor Nederlanders in het buitenland (vanwege privacy).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het persbericht van het Duitse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken inzake gesprekken in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a German Foreign Ministry press release on talks in Afghanistan, including whether Dutch funding of teacher and health-worker salaries via international organisations amounts to disguised budget support to the Taliban and whether humanitarian aid carries hard conditions. The ministers answered that funding of basic services is only considered under strict conditions (no Taliban involvement, equal access for women and girls, delivery via multilateral bodies or NGOs), that humanitarian aid is subject to softer conditions monitored by the UN and EU, and that the EU has earmarked funds for basic services.

Support must only be provided via multilateral organisations or NGOs, not (directly or indirectly) via the Taliban; there may be no substantive interference by the Taliban regarding policy, implementation and management

Zo dient steun alleen via multilaterale organisaties of ngo’s te worden verstrekt, niet (direct of indirect) via de Taliban; mag er geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis van de Taliban plaatsvinden m.b.t. beleid, uitvoering en management
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Rajkowski over het bericht Hoe China met de Nederlandse politie meekijkt

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans and Rajkowski asked whether the Dutch police use Chinese DJI drones, whether this was preceded by a security and privacy risk analysis, and whether the government will act given Chinese cyber and data-access risks. The Minister answers that the police use DJI drones only for routine tasks and not for confidential operations, that a security check and data protection impact assessment were done, that mitigating measures are in place, and that no further investigation is planned.
Given the steps the police have already taken, I see no reason to order an investigation.
Ik zie, gezien de stappen die de politie al heeft gezet, geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Brekelmans en El Yassini over het bericht 'FBI raids ZPMC delivery vessel'

MPs Valstar, Brekelmans and El Yassini (VVD) asked about reports of FBI raids on ZPMC (a Chinese state-owned shipbuilder) over suspected espionage, whether Dutch authorities had contact with US and Chinese authorities, how work-residence permits via recognised sponsor status are vetted for firms from China, Russia and Iran, and whether that status should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to comment on intelligence knowledge or diplomatic contacts, said fewer than five work permits were issued to ZPMC Netherlands staff since 2015 with none revoked, described the IND's sponsor vetting and the limited role of intelligence services, and said the government is critically reviewing the sponsor scheme with a later update promised.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Wordt Evergrande China’s Lehman Brothers’

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the risks of the Evergrande debt problems for Chinese and global financial markets, Dutch institutions and Dutch crisis scenarios, and about contact with China. Minister Hoekstra answered that risks are mainly contained in China with limited direct Dutch exposure, outlined DNB and CPB scenario analyses, and said there was no reason yet to contact China beyond FSB discussions.
My ministry has no insight into individual (foreign) exposures of Dutch institutions.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in individuele (buitenlandse) blootstellingen van Nederlandse instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Heinen over het bericht dat Belarus bijna USD1 miljard krijgt toegekend van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF), in de vorm van speciale trekkingsrechten

MPs Brekelmans and Heinen (VVD) asked why Belarus would receive nearly USD 1 billion in IMF special drawing rights when countries like Venezuela and Myanmar do not, and whether the government would oppose or block this allocation given sanctions. The government answered that the SDR allocation was generic, proportional to quota, and followed IMF procedures recognizing the Belarusian executive, so Belarus is eligible; it said it cannot revoke the allocation for one country and would instead work with partners to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs into hard currency, though it made no firm commitment to block conversion.

In contacts with the EU, the US and other international partners, the Netherlands is working to limit as much as possible Belarus's options for converting SDRs, in line with existing sanctions policy.
Nederland zet in contacten met de EU, de VS en andere internationale partners erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, de mogelijkheden daartoe voor Belarus zoveel mogelijk te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma over de pilot voor DigiD-activeringscode ontvangen via videobellen en toegankelijkheid van het Digitaal Corona Certificaat voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma asked about extending the pilot for issuing DigiD activation codes via video call to Dutch citizens abroad, its lessons, and access to the Digital Corona Certificate for citizens without BSN or DigiD. The minister said the pilot continues until structural arrangements, targeted for early 2022, are in place, reports strong demand and satisfaction, and notes the system does not record citizens' nationality or residence, so usage by group cannot be given.
The system used for the DCC does not record, for privacy reasons, to whom the DCC is issued, and therefore also not nationality or place of residence.
Het systeem dat voor DCC wordt gebruikt slaat in verband met privacy niet op aan wie het DCC wordt uitgegeven en dus ook niet de nationaliteit en woonplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Pride optocht Georgië afgeblazen na bestorming LHBTI-kantoor

MPs Brekelmans and Van der Woude asked the government how it judged the violence against the Tbilisi Pride march, what it had done to protect participants and journalists, and what it would do next. The Minister condemned the violence, said police deployment was insufficient, described diplomatic demarches and joint statements calling for protection and investigation, and promised continued pressure on Georgia.
The Netherlands will continue to press bilaterally and within the EU for an investigation by the Georgian authorities into the violence of 5 July.
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband blijven aandringen op onderzoek door de Georgische autoriteiten naar de gewelddadigheden op 5 juli.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de berichten ‘Severe financial crisis threatens the STL’s ability to fulfil its mandate’ en ‘Start of trial in the Ayyash case (STL-18-10) on 16 June cancelled due to lack o

MP Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Special Tribunal for Lebanon faces a severe funding shortfall that threatens three related cases (Hamade, Hawi and Murr), and why the government would fund only the Hariri main case and closure. Minister Kaag answered that the related cases were suspended by the Tribunal itself due to lack of funds, that Nederland and other donors added money to finish the main appeal, and that no further voluntary contributions are currently feasible.
Over the coming months the Netherlands will work with the other donors and the STL to achieve an orderly completion.
Nederland zal de komende maanden samen met de andere donoren en het STL werken aan een ordentelijke afronding.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Ellian, Brekelmans en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker waarschuwde voor moordplan Iraanse geheime dienst'

VVD MPs asked whether the IND and AIVD were warned in advance about an Iranian-directed assassination plot and what Dutch and EU responses to Iran and to Iranian dissidents are. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases or on AIVD working methods, pointed to existing reporting structures and the sanctions and diplomatic measures already taken, and gave no concrete new commitment.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘EU-leiders willen sancties tegen Wit-Rusland en eisen vrijlating Protasevitsj’

MPs Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would go further than the EU's announced measures against Belarus after the forced landing and arrest of Roman Protasevich, including sanctions on state firms, diplomats, airlines and airspace. The minister answered that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions, sectoral sanctions, a flight ban on Belarusian airlines, and that Dutch law was amended, while further national unilateral measures were judged ineffective.
The cabinet cannot share information on the total number of Belarusian diplomats accredited in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan geen informatie delen over het totaalaantal Belarussische diplomaten dat in Nederland geaccrediteerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het zesde rapport van UNITAD

An MP asked the foreign minister about the sixth UNITAD report, which points to clear evidence of ISIS genocide against the Yezidis, and about prosecution of ISIS fighters in Iraq and Syria. The minister answered that the government regards ISIS as having 'most likely' committed genocide, notes that Iraq's pending law does not yet meet international standards, and says Netherlands continues diplomatic efforts and support for UNITAD despite the absence of a Security Council mandate.
The cabinet therefore states, partly on the basis of detailed information in reports such as UNITAD's sixth report, that ISIS most likely committed genocide against the Yezidis.

Het kabinet stelt daarom – mede op basis van uitgebreide en gedetailleerde informatie in rapporten zoals het zesde rapport van UNITAD – dat ISIS «hoogstwaarschijnlijk» genocide heeft gepleegd jegens de Yezidi's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Ellian over stemmen door Nederlanders in het buitenland

Two VVD MPs asked why only about 9-10% of the estimated one million Dutch citizens abroad registered to vote, why only 63,549 of 92,772 registered voters cast a ballot, and why proxy voting and invalid votes were so low or high, and whether surveys or evaluations would be run. The minister answered that registration barriers are mostly lack of reliable postal addresses and disengagement, that an online survey of 30 expat associations is ongoing, that a survey of registered voters will be conducted, and that the full evaluation will be sent before the summer recess.
I am willing to conduct a survey among all voters included in the permanent registration and ask them whether they voted in the last House of Representatives election and, if not, why not.

Ik ben bereid een enquête te houden onder alle kiezers die zijn opgenomen in de permanente registratie en aan hen te vragen of zij hebben gestemd bij de afgelopen Tweede Kamerverkiezing en zo nee, waarom niet.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Heera Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland moet zich uitspreken tegen grote militaire actie in Cariben

MPs Ceder and Heera Dijk asked the government how it responds to the US military operation 'Southern Spear' against alleged drug boats in the Caribbean, whether it will call for independent investigation, whether US use of Curaçao facilities played a role, and whether it will inform the House. The government says the Kingdom is not involved in the US national operation, stresses adherence to international law without judging the US self-defence claim, notes only unarmed surveillance flights are covered by the 2000 facilities treaty, and leaves independent investigation primarily to the US while referring to diplomatic channels.
The Kingdom is not involved in the national US deployment in international waters and international airspace.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de nationale inzet vanuit de VS in de internationale wateren en het internationale luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Kabinet trekt toch 700 miljoen euro extra uit voor Oekraïne'

MP Vermeer asked whether using 700 million euros of underspending to fund extra Ukraine aid breaches budget rules, how this fits the cabinet's earlier position, and for overviews of Dutch and EU aid, refugee costs and oversight of aid spending. The government answered that underspending may be redirected, that it is a first step on the Chamber's motion, and provided aid tables, EU instrument details and an account of the procurement and audit controls in place.
The cabinet will then consider at the beginning of the new year how further follow-up to the motion can be given.
Het kabinet beziet vervolgens in het begin van het nieuwe jaar hoe verdere opvolging aan de motie gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat ‘als je bij de geheime dienst solliciteert, Google dat als eerste weet’

MP Boswijk asked whether job applications to the AIVD and MIVD leak to US tech firms via Google Analytics on werkenvoornederland.nl, and why earlier answers denied this. The minister acknowledges the earlier answers were insufficient, says applications occur in a separate environment without Google Analytics, says there is no indication of a data leak, and declines to commit to revising the application process beyond ongoing reviews.
I understand that the earlier answer was not sufficient.
Ik begrijp dat eerdere beantwoording niet toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Lanschot, Piri, Van der Werf, Belhirch, Van der Burg, Ceder en Dassen  over een gat in de steun aan Oekraïne

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Bedrijfjes van Nederlandse universiteiten werken met Israël aan omstreden technologie'

The MP Dassen asked the ministers about reports that Dutch technical universities hold stakes in companies developing dual-use technology with Israeli firms, and about whether the government would condemn or halt such ties. The minister replied that universities are responsible for their own partnership assessments, that export licences are assessed case by case, that companies must respect existing legal and OECD frameworks, and refused to meet the universities about ending their ties.
It is up to knowledge institutions to follow the requirements set within that framework regarding the civilian nature of the research.
Daarbij is het aan kennisinstellingen om de eisen op te volgen die daarbinnen worden gesteld rondom de civiele aard van de onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Werf over de beveiliging van de Israëlische delegatie door een voormalig legerofficier met illegale wapens

MPs Paternotte and Van der Werf asked about an armed private security guard, a former Israeli army officer, who was caught at Schiphol with illegal pistols while guarding an Israeli delegation, and about checks, prior notification, and possible training of Dutch police by him. The minister answered that armed guards require prior government permission, that no request was received for this visit, that individual cases are not discussed publicly, that police and army used the guard's company for training in the past, and that no other similar incidents are known.
I never make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri en Nordkamp over Nederlandse onderdelen in Russische drones en raketten

MPs Timmermans, Piri and Nordkamp asked whether the government knew Dutch components were used in Russian drones and missiles, what concrete action was taken, whether the parts are covered by sanctions, and which Dutch firms are involved. The State Secretary answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, that the parts are already sanctioned, that enforcement rests with Customs and the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government cannot give insight into concrete actions against individual companies.
The cabinet cannot give insight into concrete actions that may be taken with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in concrete acties die mogelijk worden gedaan bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht 'Als trans persoon gevlucht voor Trumps beleid, maar is dat genoeg voor asiel? ‘Het is niet veilig voor haar’'

An MP from Volt asks the Asylum and Migration Minister and colleagues whether transgender US asylum claims can succeed given the Trump administration's policies, whether the 2024 US country report should be revised, and whether transgender people should be designated a risk group. The government answers that US developments do not currently justify presuming a well-founded fear of persecution for transgender Americans, that each claim is judged individually on recent sources, that no general country report is planned, and that discretionary residence permits will be reviewed after a Council of State ruling.
By letter of 27 August I informed your House about the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Bij brief van 27 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het mijnbouwbedrijf dat sneller wil beginnen met het mijnen in de Stille Oceaan

MP Teunissen asked the government about commercial deep-sea mining plans in the Clarion Clipperton Zone, the ecological risks, Dutch involvement (Allseas), sanctions for unlicensed mining, and critical metals supply. The government answered that the science is not yet sufficient, that Dutch involvement is not known beyond Allseas which it cannot comment on individually, that it opposes licences before a mining code exists, and that it has discussed the integrity of UNCLOS with Allseas without committing to specific sanctions.
Of course, the cabinet will, should developments give rise to it, consider possible steps to take, within the framework of the Authority.
Uiteraard zal het kabinet zich, wanneer de ontwikkelingen daar aanleiding toe geven, beraden op eventuele te nemen stappen, binnen de kaders van de Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Pool over nieuwe aanvallen op vrachtschepen in de Rode Zee

MPs De Roon and Pool asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about renewed Houthi attacks on shipping in the Red Sea, including a sinking, and whether the Houthis should be listed as terrorists, whether threat levels and protection measures should change, and what sanctions target Iran. The government confirmed the attacks, condemned them as violating international law, said there is no EU support yet for a terrorist listing but it keeps pursuing that option, noted the highest threat level has applied since December 2023, pointed to ongoing EUNAVFOR Aspides contributions and existing Iran UAV sanctions, but withheld details of further sanctions for confidentiality reasons.
Due to confidentiality, no further sanctions will be discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid wordt niet ingegaan op eventuele verdere sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Nederland laat Russische schaduwvloot ongemoeid, terwijl zeven landen wel controleren’

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough to check Russian shadow-fleet vessels, given that other North Sea and Baltic states inspect them, and whether legal, technical or capacity barriers are being removed. The minister replied that Dutch jurisdiction on the high seas is limited, that inspections are being prepared with the Coast Guard and ILT, and that capacity expansion is a priority but its funding is still under discussion.
It is impossible to check all shadow-fleet ships, especially since the Netherlands has no jurisdiction over ships sailing on the open sea.
Het is onmogelijk alle schepen uit de Russische schaduwvloot te controleren, temeer daar Nederland geen rechtsmacht heeft bij schepen die varen op open zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers

Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Kröger en Teunissen over de verplichtingen van staten met betrekking tot klimaatverandering

MPs Hirsch, Kröger and Teunissen asked the government how the ICJ's July 2025 climate advisory opinion affects Dutch fossil fuel subsidies, corporate regulation, adaptation finance, loss and damage funding, and EU climate commitments. The government answered that the opinion does not create new obligations, that its fossil support and climate policies comply with international law, that it sees no need for a new analysis of fossil support, and that it will share a fuller legal reaction later.
The ICJ advisory opinion requires a careful legal analysis, which is currently taking place.
Het advies van het IGH vergt een zorgvuldige juridische analyse, die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Unicef: duizenden ondervoede kinderen dreigen te sterven in belegerde stad in Sudan’

Paternotte (D66) asked the foreign minister about UNICEF warnings of starving children in besieged El Fasher, Sudan, and whether Netherlands could add sanctions on the RSF, aid, evidence-gathering for war crimes, and funding for humanitarian relief and tracing missing persons. Minister Van Weel answered that the Netherlands backs EU sanctions and a third package, funds humanitarian aid and the Fact Finding Mission, and supports the ICRC, but that national sanctions are of limited effect and access to El Fasher remains blocked.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Freedom Flotilla actie en de bescherming van Nederlandse burgers

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Freedom Flotilla's attempt to break Israel's blockade of Gaza, Dutch citizens aboard, possible Israeli interception, and consular assistance. The minister said the government shares humanitarian concerns, argues that professional aid organisations need land access, notes the flotilla's aid is largely symbolic, and reports having warned Israel and informed it of Dutch nationals aboard without committing to further concrete action.
At this moment there is insufficient information about the interception of the ship to reach a definitive judgement.
Op dit moment is onvoldoende bekend over de onderschepping van het schip om tot een definitief oordeel te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de belastingkwestie rond kerkelijke vastgoed in Jeruzalem

MP Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the Foreign Minister about Jerusalem's municipal property tax claims on church-owned properties, the freezing of the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate's bank accounts, and reported enforced sales against Armenian Church property, asking about Dutch diplomatic action. Minister Van Weel answered that the Dutch embassy raised the bank freeze with the municipality urging negotiation, and that the government is concerned and raises religious freedom with Israel, but gave no concrete new commitment.
The cabinet has no knowledge of a report of an enforced sale of property belonging to the Armenian Apostolic Church.
Het kabinet heeft geen kennis van een bericht over een executieverkoop voor bezit van de Armeens-apostolische kerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland via Centraal- Aziatische landen

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked whether Dutch exports to Kyrgyzstan, which appear to be transshipped to Russia, would be investigated, what sanctions consequences apply to firms, and how transshipment via Central Asia will be prevented. The minister answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, enforced by Customs with prosecution of deliberate evaders, and that the Netherlands is pushing for measures in the 19th sanctions package.
Countering sanctions evasion is an important priority for both the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Customs.
Het tegengaan van sanctieomzeiling is een belangrijke prioriteit voor zowel het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken als de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over bericht dat er plannen zijn voor militaire inzet in Oekraïne

MP Dobbe asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports of detailed plans for military deployment in Ukraine, including NATO involvement, conditions, UN mandate, parliamentary consent and exit strategy. The government confirmed Dutch participation in military planning via the Coalition of the Willing, said any deployment is conditional and subject to parliamentary information under Article 100 of the Constitution, and declined to commit to prior parliamentary consent.
Once there is agreement between the parties on ending hostilities and implementation comes into view, your House will be informed in accordance with Article 100 of the Constitution.

Op het moment dat er sprake is van overeenstemming tussen de partijen over een beëindiging van vijandelijkheden en tenuitvoerlegging in zicht komt, zal uw Kamer conform artikel 100 van de Grondwet worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oostenbrink over Europese plannen voor troepeninzet in Oekraïne aan de hand van het artikel 'Europe has 'pretty precise' plan to send troops to Ukraine, von der Leyen says'

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about von der Leyen's claim of 'pretty precise' EU plans for troops in Ukraine, and whether this bypasses national sovereignty and parliamentary consent. The government answered that the planning is within the multinational Coalition of the Willing rather than an EU initiative, that Nederland's deployment requires an article 100 briefing to parliament before implementation, and that no new EU funding proposals currently exist.
Once there is agreement between the parties on ending hostilities and implementation comes into view, your House will be informed in accordance with article 100 of the Constitution.

Op het moment dat er sprake is van overeenstemming tussen de partijen over beëindiging van vijandelijkheden en tenuitvoerlegging in zicht komt, zal uw Kamer conform artikel 100 van de Grondwet worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Klaver over de schending van het Poolse luchtruim door Russische drones

MPs Timmermans and Klaver asked whether the government would convene an extra EU Council, form a leaders' group with Poland, push for a sanctions package banning Russian energy imports, accelerate REPowerEU, pressure blocking member states on frozen Russian assets, and explain remaining Russian oil and gas imports via Dutch ports and port-access powers. The government answered that NATO and EU channels are primary, that a separate leaders' group is not appropriate, that negotiations are ongoing, that Dutch oil imports from Russia have ceased and LNG imports are limited, and that port refusal rests on EU sanctions law and with ports and municipalities rather than the national government.
The cabinet regrettably cannot go further into detail on the Dutch position in ongoing negotiations.
Het kabinet kan helaas niet verder in detail ingaan op de Nederlandse positie in lopende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veltman en Ellian over mogelijke Nederlandse bijstand bij natuurbranden in Zuid-Europa

Two VVD MPs asked the Defence Minister about Dutch assistance for wildfires in Southern Europe, including why requests were not met and whether helicopters could be sent. The minister answered that two Chinook helicopters were deployed to Spain from 19 to 31 August, dropping nearly 3 million litres of water, and described Defence's general readiness for such requests.
Following the Spanish request, the cabinet decided to provide two Chinook transport helicopters to help fight the wildfires.
Naar aanleiding van het Spaanse verzoek heeft het kabinet besloten om twee Chinook-transporthelikopters te leveren om te helpen bij het bestrijden van de natuurbranden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘NAVO-doelstellingen en Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten’

An MP from FvD asked the Defence Minister whether secret NATO resilience objectives, classified by NATO, are known to the parliamentary intelligence oversight committee and whether they can be shared confidentially with the full chamber. The minister declined to confirm what the committee knows, and said the document is non-public and NATO's consent is needed for disclosure, but promised the Justice Minister would consult NATO in autumn about providing additional information.
Because it is classified state secret what is discussed with the Intelligence and Security Services Committee, I cannot comment on this publicly.
Het staatsgeheim gerubriceerd is wat er met de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten wordt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO ‘Resilience Objectives’

An MP asked whether any ministries are not involved at all in meeting NATO's secret Resilience Objectives. The government answered that resilience policy is a cabinet-wide effort coordinated by the Justice and Security, Defence and State Secretary of Defence, and that the other relevant ministries are involved as needed.
Resilience policy is a cabinet-wide effort.
Het weerbaarheidsbeleid betreft een kabinetsbrede inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Negen Nederlandse universiteiten doen gezamenlijk onderzoek met defensie-industrie van Israël'

MP Dassen asked ministers about reports that Dutch universities collaborate on dual-use research with Israeli defence industry partners under Horizon Europe, and whether the government would act or stop such funding. The government answered that universities decide on partnerships within their autonomy, that it cannot fully assess the scope of dual-use research, and that it supports the Commission's proposal to suspend Israel's participation in the European Innovation Council.
The cabinet cannot, however, independently determine the scope of that.
Het kabinet kan de reikwijdte daarvan echter niet eigenstandig vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Oekraïne wapenexporteur wil worden.

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Ukraine wants to become a weapons exporter, the risks of human rights violations, possible Dutch investments in Ukrainian arms production, and whether the export criteria should now apply. The minister answered that export policy is a national competence, that the Dutch MoU covers only purchases for the Ukrainian armed forces with use and transfer restrictions, and that Dutch export criteria and weapons treaties still apply.
Arms export policy is a national competence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Palantir’

An FvD MP asked the Defence Minister which units use Palantir software, whether other projects like the 'Raffinaderij' share data with it, and whether the answers could come within three weeks. The State Secretary declined to name the Defence units for confidentiality reasons, said Palantir is used only for NATO interoperability in military operations, and stated that Raffinaderij falls outside Defence and that the answers would be sent after the summer recess.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot share which specific organisational units within Defence use the Palantir software.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid kan ik niet delen welke specifieke organisatieonderdelen binnen Defensie gebruik maken van de Palantir-software.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Der Werf en Bamenga over de mobilisatie in Venezuela en de veiligheidsontwikkelingen nabij Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about US naval deployment near Venezuela, its implications for the ABC islands (Cooperative Security Location, Kustwacht, NOTAMs, travel advice, involvement of Aruba and Curaçao) and whether Parliament would be informed. The government answered that the US deployment is nationally directed and the Kingdom is not involved, that existing defence and aviation arrangements remain unchanged, and that it will inform Parliament promptly if the security situation changes.
If the situation in the region leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, the government will inform your House without delay.
Indien de situatie in de regio leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal de regering uw Kamer daarover onverwijld informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het met 3D printers maken van wapenonderdelen voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Danish volunteers making weapon parts for Ukraine with 3D printers, whether Dutch civilians could contribute similarly, and whether a centralised 3D-printing programme should be set up. The government answered that producing weapon parts without recognition under the Weapons and Ammunition Act is a criminal offence, that only licensed manufacturers may produce such parts, that Defence sees no quick opportunity for a centralised programme, and that the Weapons Act is under revision.
Taking the initiative to print such a weapon or part without the required permit is therefore a criminal offence and is treated as such by the authorities.

Het initiatief nemen tot het afdrukken van een dergelijk wapen of onderdeel zonder de vereiste vergunning te hebben verkregen, leidt derhalve tot een strafbaar feit en wordt door de autoriteiten als zodanig aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Podt over stikstofbelemmeringen op defensielocaties

MPs from D66 asked the government about nitrogen (stikstof) rules blocking expansion of Dutch military training sites and air bases, including the consequences for NATO readiness and the specific permit barriers at each location. The State Secretary for Defence answered that a TNO study finds the impact on operational readiness 'enormous', that defence sites mostly lack nature permits, that permit procedures are slow and complex with no generic defence exemption under the Habitat and Birds Directives, and that the ministerial commission and an EU defence readiness omnibus are being used to find solutions.
The management summary of the TNO study and the Haskoning research report were sent to your House on 3 July 2025.
Het managementuittreksel van het onderzoek van TNO en het onderzoeksrapport van Haskoning zijn op 3 juli 2025 aan uw Kamer verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over militaire oefeningen met bekabelde drones in Natura 2000-gebieden

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether military exercises with fibre-optic-controlled drones take place in Natura 2000 areas, what environmental damage and cleanup arrangements apply, and whether Defence will ensure gentle treatment of nature. The State Secretary answered that Defence does not currently possess fibre-optic drones and has not exercised with them in Natura 2000 areas, that environmental effects are considered in procurement and cleanup rules exist, and that Defence balances military use with nature conservation.
No, Defence currently does not possess fibre-optic controlled drones and has not exercised with them in Natura 2000 areas.
Nee, Defensie beschikt op dit moment niet over glasvezel aangestuurde (ook wel fiber optic ) drones en heeft hier niet mee geoefend in Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Verkuijlen en Kisteman over de storing bij de radiosystemen van de Kustwacht op 1 juli jl.

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a July 2025 radio system failure at the Kustwacht, its cause, whether lives were endangered, its link to the 2024 NAFIN outage, backup and cyber protection. The government answered that the radio systems are operational again, the cause was investigated with measures taken, no critical situations arose, but it withheld details on cyber protection for security reasons and gave limited detail on the causes.
For security reasons I cannot go into this any further.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik hierop verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Pentagon gaat duizenden transgender militairen ontslaan’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government how it views the US Pentagon's plan to discharge transgender military personnel, whether it will condemn this, and whether it will offer asylum or other protection. The minister answered that Dutch defence values diversity, expressed concern, declined to condemn the US decision citing sovereignty, and said there is no basis for a special asylum scheme for transgender Americans, with each asylum claim judged individually.
All countries enjoy sovereignty and make decisions based on their own specific national priorities.
Alle landen genieten soevereiniteit en zij nemen beslissingen op grond van hun eigen specifieke nationale prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht dat de tweelingbroer van de staatsecretaris van Defensie directeur wordt van een drone-bedrijf

SP MPs asked the Defence minister whether the Defence state secretary's twin brother taking a job at a drone company, while the army invests millions in drones, creates a conflict of interest, and what safeguards exist. The minister answered that the appointment was known within Defence, cited existing post-employment and integrity rules, and promised the state secretary would be cautious in direct contacts with AI Armaments.

Furthermore, the State Secretary will be restrained in direct contacts with AI Armaments, and specific communication about and/or specific cooperation with AI Armaments falls under the responsibility of the Minister.

Verder geldt dat de Staatssecretaris terughoudend zal zijn in directe contacten met AI Armaments en dat specifieke communicatie over en/of specifieke samenwerking met AI Armaments onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen over de NAVO Resilience Objectives

An FVD MP asks the Defence Minister why he refused to co-sign answers to earlier written questions, even though a health ministry decision note said Defence handled most of those answers. The Defence Minister replies that questions are normally signed by the minister they are addressed to, that interdepartmental coordination is customary, and that Defence contributed where possible.
Parliamentary questions are as a rule signed by the Minister to whom the questions are addressed.
Kamervragen worden in de regel ondertekend door de Minister aan wie de vragen zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO Resilience Objectives

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO set the classification level of the NAVO Resilience Objectives, whether the Netherlands could publish them without NATO consent, and who set the classification if not NATO. The minister confirmed NATO set the classification and that the Netherlands cannot publish them without NATO's consent.
No, the Dutch state cannot decide without NATO's consent to make the NATO Resilience Objectives public at the request of the House of Representatives.
Nee, de Nederlandse staat kan niet zonder toestemming van de NAVO besluiten om op verzoek van de Tweede Kamer de NAVO Resilience Objectives openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Nederlandse militairen samen met Israëlische troepen deelgenomen hebben aan een door de VS geleide militaire oefening

An SP MP asked whether Dutch soldiers exercised alongside Israeli forces in the US-led African Lion 25 exercise, and whether defence cooperation with Israel should stop given alleged war crimes in Gaza. The minister replied that Dutch units trained in Senegal while Israeli units trained in Morocco without interaction, that defence cooperation is limited to materiel and knowledge exchange within pre-1967 borders with combat training excluded, and that the Israel status agreement is suspended in the Senate while arms export and import decisions are assessed case by case.
