The cabinet has no insight into the precise manner in which the knowledge present within the Israeli defence industry is developed, as is the case for the defence industry in any country.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de precieze wijze waarop de aanwezige kennis binnen de Israëlische defensie-industrie tot stand komt, zoals dat geldt voor de defensie-industrie in ieder land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over het artikel ‘Vechten om te overleven middelgrote defensiebedrijven in Nederland dreigen ten onder te gaan’.

An MP asks whether medium-sized defence firms are being squeezed out by large contracts, tiering of suppliers, and strict down-payment and bank guarantee rules. The Minister of Defence replies that there is no preferential policy, that large firms win complex and framework contracts on capability and supply security, that alternatives to bank guarantees are being examined case by case, and that government support for failing firms is considered only in exceptional, conditional situations.
There is no question of a preferential policy in this scale-up.
Bij deze opschaling is geen sprake van een voorkeursbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Bikker over de uitbreiding van militaire trainingsfaciliteiten op ’t Harde

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked how long permit procedures for expanding military training facilities take, whether this slows defence readiness, and how regulations, nature protection and noise concerns will be handled. The government acknowledges lengthy permit procedures and the tension with defence urgency, outlines short- and long-term steps such as accelerating existing permits, the NPRD programme and a planned bill, but gives no average processing time.
An average processing time for permit procedures for expanding Dutch military facilities cannot be given.
Een gemiddelde doorloopsnelheid van vergunningsprocedures voor uitbreiding van de Nederlandse militaire faciliteiten is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Werf en Boswijk over het samen met de Denen direct investeren in de Oekraïense defensie-industrie

MPs Paternotte, Van der Werf and Boswijk asked why the Netherlands did not join Denmark's mechanism for funding Ukrainian defence-industry investment, how much has been contracted, and how it ensures alignment with Ukraine's needs. The minister answered that the Dutch direct-procurement model gives the Netherlands control over the process, that over EUR 1.4 billion has been allocated, that contracts are still in negotiation with no amounts yet, and that answers to individual questions were not provided in time.
It is not yet possible to indicate which amounts are involved.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het screenen van wetenschappers en studenten door hogeronderwijsinstellingen omwille van de nationale veiligheid en wie dit moet bekostigen

An MP asked several ministers whether universities should bear the costs of the proposed screening of researchers and students for national security reasons, and whether this is a shared national responsibility. The minister answered that knowledge security is a cabinet-wide shared responsibility, that funding is partly shifted from Justice and Security to OCW, and that the screening law is a national policy choice, while stating that the government will not provide further legal grounding beyond the existing funding framework.
Yes, universities and colleges are responsible for keeping security in order and mitigating these risks.
Ja, hogescholen en universiteiten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor het op orde hebben van beveiliging en het mitigeren van deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over het nieuws dat de directieleden van Damen Schipyards worden vervolgd voor omkoping, valsheid in geschriften, witwassen en sanctieontwijking

An MP asked the Defence Minister how the prosecution of Damen Shipyards directors for bribery, forgery, money laundering and sanctions evasion affects existing and future defence contracts, and whether the company's integrity conduct was considered. The state secretary answered that prosecution is not an exclusion ground under procurement law, so there are no consequences yet for current or future contracts, and declined to judge the company's conduct.
Defence adheres to European procurement rules, which provide that parties should be excluded from participating in European tenders if they have been irrevocably convicted by a criminal court.

Defensie houdt zich aan de Europese aanbestedingsregelgeving waarin is geregeld dat partijen behoren te worden uitgesloten van deelname aan Europese aanbestedingen indien zij onherroepelijk zijn veroordeeld zijn door de strafrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Olger van Dijk over de bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding en de conclusies van het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘De derde hoofdtaak van de krijgsmacht’

MPs Heite and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers of Defence and Justice and Security about the Court of Audit report on the armed forces' third main task (disaster relief), the cuts, coordination with civil services, and civilian resilience. The ministers answered that Defence met all 447 civil assistance requests, that the Court's concerns mainly concern wartime capacity, that civil-military coordination will be strengthened, and that a resilience campaign is planned, but gave no firm guarantees on future capacity shortfalls.
Defence stated in its administrative response that it will adopt the recommendations made by the Court of Audit.
Defensie heeft in haar bestuurlijke reactie gemeld de door de Algemene Rekenkamer gedane aanbevelingen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het leveren van gebruikte visnetten aan Oekraïne

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the government would support and remove regulatory obstacles to collecting and exporting used fishing nets to Ukraine for drone protection. The minister replied that defence does not fund civilian initiatives but is open to facilitating transport if Ukraine's defence ministry states a need, and that EU waste rules and extended producer responsibility cannot be unilaterally changed, though nets that reach end-of-waste status may be exported.
The Ministry of Defence is nevertheless open to examining how a contribution could be facilitated, for example for the transport of used fishing nets.
Het Ministerie van Defensie staat evenwel open voor het onderzoeken op welke manier wel een bijdrage gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld voor het transport van gebruikte visnetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nordkamp en Kathmann over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens van militairen op apps

MPs Nordkamp and Kathmann asked the Defence ministry how it protects soldiers' personal and location data from fitness and dating apps such as Strava, and what it has done about the risk. The state secretary answered that Defence bans certain apps on its own devices, trains personnel, and has no power over private phones, while acknowledging the risk and saying effectiveness is hard to measure.
Defence, however, has no control over private equipment and private use of the internet.
Defensie heeft echter geen zeggenschap over privéapparatuur en het privégebruik van het Internet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Boswijk over ‘Het traceren van militairen via fitness-apps

MPs Van der Werf and Boswijk asked whether Dutch soldiers can be traced via the Strava fitness app and what Defence is doing about the operational security risk. The government answers that the app is banned on defence devices, personnel receive cyber-awareness training and a handbook, a defence fitness app was introduced, and security protocols are reviewed as technology changes.
To mitigate this risk, the application in question, like comparable fitness applications, is not permitted on defence devices.
Om dit risico te mitigeren, is de betreffende applicatie, net als vergelijkbare fitness-applicaties, niet toegestaan op defensieapparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over de wijziging in eigenaarschap van Fox Crypto en het prioriteitsaandeel van Invest-NL

An MP asked the Defence Minister why a priority share in Fox Crypto was acquired via Invest-NL rather than the Finance Minister, its size, and whether other strategic companies are targeted. The minister justified the choice by urgency and Invest-NL's expertise, described the nominal 1 euro non-tradable priority share as mainly non-financial, and said other strategic dependencies are monitored with the Kamer informed when relevant.
Because of the urgency and the necessary speed of action linked to the already started sale process, I chose to ask Invest-NL to acquire a priority share in Fox Crypto.

Ik heb vanwege de urgentie en de daarmee samenhangende noodzakelijke snelheid van handelen, in relatie tot het reeds gestarte verkooptraject, gekozen om aan Invest-NL het verzoek te doen om een prioriteitsaandeel te verwerven in Fox Crypto.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over steun aan maatschappelijke initiatieven voor levensreddende steun en de wederopbouw Oekraïne

An MP asked about government support for civil-society life-saving aid and reconstruction initiatives in Ukraine, including whether drone initiatives were considered and why Dutch audit rules slow military production contracts with Ukrainian industry. The minister answered that EUR 2.5 million was allocated to three projects via the embassy, that other support runs through the Ukraine Partnership Facility, that drone initiatives were not in the study scope, and that direct procurement from Ukrainian industry is currently preferred for speed.
In this study, civil-society drone initiatives were not taken into account; the focus was primarily on humanitarian aid and reconstruction.
In dit onderzoek zijn maatschappelijke drone-initiatieven niet meegewogen, maar is de focus primair gericht geweest op humanitaire hulp en wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘concrete weerbaarheidsdoelen’

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Defence whether the NATO resilience objectives, which the AIV advisory body reportedly saw, should be made available to the House and if so, when. The minister confirmed the AIV had seen them, said they are not public and that the underlying NATO documents were not shared, and promised only a later letter with concrete national resilience policy.
No, the AIV was not able to inspect the underlying documents of the NATO resilience objectives.
Nee, de AIV heeft de onderliggende documenten van de NAVO weerbaarheidsdoelen (NAVO Resilience Objectives) niet kunnen inzien.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Bamenga over het bericht ‘Bonaire bezorgd om militaire dreiging vanuit Venezuela’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Bonaire fears a military threat from Venezuela, including whether activity was observed, threat levels, contacts with Venezuela and Bonaire, and protective measures. The minister answered that no recent Venezuelan military activity near Bonaire has been observed, that there is no reason to assume a heightened threat, that routine intelligence monitoring and regional Defence presence continue, and that Parliament will be informed if the situation changes.
If the situation in Venezuela leads to a different security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, I will, also on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, inform your House about it.
Indien de situatie in Venezuela leidt tot een andere veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk zal ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over steun aan Oekraïne

Paternotte (D66) asked the defence and foreign affairs ministers about Dutch medical, training and drone support for Ukraine, including field hospitals, blood plasma, Sanquin knowledge-sharing and an aquadrone. The government answered that it has supplied medical equipment and 33 field hospitals, declined a hospital 'adoption' model and in-country training for now, and said it would not acquire the aquadrone.
We do not intend to organise the support in an 'adoption' form.
Wij zijn niet voornemens om de steun te organiseren in een «adoptie»-vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de uitvoer van honden door defensie

An MP asked the Minister of Defence whether the ministry supplies service dogs to foreign armed forces, including Israel, and whether dog use by Israeli forces against civilians implies Dutch complicity. The minister answered that defence supplies no dogs to third parties, that retired dogs go under strict contracts to individuals with a VOG, and that there is no cooperation with Israel on dog training or activities.
Defence does not supply dogs to third parties.
Defensie levert geen honden aan derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Wal, Van der Werf, Nordkamp, Dassen en Olger Van Dijk over de (dreigende) afhankelijkheid van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht van Starlink

MPs asked whether the Dutch armed forces risk dependence on Starlink, whether alternative European satellite systems exist for command, communication, positioning and ISR, and whether the Netherlands will invest in autonomous capacity. The minister replied that Defence is not dependent on Starlink, that it spreads suppliers and is building sovereign ISR and PNT capacity over time, but withheld details of specific systems and command systems on operational and national security grounds.
No statements are made about specific alternatives for Defence in connection with operational interests and national security.
Over specifieke alternatieven voor Defensie worden geen uitspraken gedaan in verband met operationele belangen en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over een Amerikaanse ‘kill switch’ in de F-35

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of a US 'kill switch' in F-35 jets, its implications for Dutch operational sovereignty over US-origin weapons, access to source code, and supply dependence. The state secretary answered that Defence knows of no kill switch, that the F-35 Joint Program Office confirmed none exists, that the Netherlands retains operational sovereignty with US control only possible through blocking spare parts, and that source code access would require costly licences.
No. To gain access to the source code, Defence would have to obtain a licence.
Nee. Om toegang tot de broncode te krijgen zou Defensie hiervoor een licentie moeten verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van der Wal over het bericht ‘Politie en defensie worstelen met 'soevereine' collega's die overheid niet erkennen’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van der Wal asked how many police and defence staff hold sovereign-movement views, whether such staff can be disciplined or removed, and what the government is doing against anti-institutional thinking among employees. The ministers answer that signals are taken seriously, that disciplinary and security-clearance measures exist, that reporting channels are available, and that responsibility is shared across ministries, while declining to give detailed numbers for reasons of confidentiality.
The MIVD, given its statutory duty of secrecy, does not discuss its sources, current knowledge level and/or its modus operandi.
De MIVD gaat gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding, niet in op haar bronnen, het actuele kennisniveau en/of de modus operandi van de dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over verdachte Russische schepen in onze wateren

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers about suspicious Russian ships in Dutch waters, the shadow fleet, espionage around North Sea infrastructure and European sales of tankers to Russia. The government describes sanctions listings, IMO and port-state measures, NATO and regional cooperation, and promises a confidential briefing on the legal analysis of additional powers while declining to detail planned measures.

As promised in the NATO Defence Ministerial committee debate of 5 February 2025, you will be informed through a confidential technical briefing about the outcomes of the legal analysis into additional options to intervene in maritime espionage and sabotage activities.

Zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat NAVO Defensie Ministeriële op 5 februari 2025, zal u middels een vertrouwelijke technische briefing worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van de juridische analyse
Antwoord op het lid Pool over het nieuws dat veteranen te vaak en te lang moeten wachten op een beslissing over schadevergoeding

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that traumatised veterans wait too long for compensation decisions, and whether the 60% miss rate on the two-year target is acceptable. The minister agrees the delays are unacceptable, lists measures such as expanding the claims team and a new ICT system, and promises to report to parliament by end 2025.
I will inform the House at the end of 2025 about the progress of the various measures in line with the recommendations of the Netherlands Court of Audit and the Veterans Ombudsman.
Ik zal de Kamer eind 2025 informeren over de voortgang van de verschillende maatregelen conform de aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Veteranenombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over het vervolgrapport van de Veteranenombudsman

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Veterans Ombudsman's February 2025 follow-up report on the slow handling of full compensation claims (RVS) and whether earlier recommendations were implemented. The minister acknowledged that the two-year target is missed in 60% of cases, listed steps such as more staff, a new ICT system and clearer communication, and promised a fuller reply and a progress letter by end 2025.
I will inform the House by the end of 2025 about the progress of the various measures in line with the recommendations of the Netherlands Court of Audit and the Veterans Ombudsman.
Ik zal de Kamer eind 2025 informeren over de voortgang van de verschillende maatregelen conform de aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Veteranenombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van der Wal over uitvoering van de motie Van der Wal en Mohandis en eerder onbeantwoorde schriftelijke vragen over de bevrijdingsfestivals in het kader van 80 jaar vrijheid

MPs Mohandis and Van der Wal asked whether the government would fund Bevrijdingsfestivals in 2025 through a guarantee scheme, given a Chamber-adopted motion. The state secretary replied that interdepartmental talks ended with a one-off, final contribution of EUR 700,000 for 2025 but explained that a guarantee scheme would imply a structural relationship the government does not intend.
The cabinet, however, sees the contribution as incidental.
Het kabinet ziet de bijdrage echter als incidenteel.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht “Rendement innovatie defensie erg groot: ‘magnetron, mobieltje en ducttape met dank aan leger" en het daaraan gerelateerde onderzoek ‘The economic returns on defense

An MP asked the ministers of Defence about a RaboResearch study finding high economic returns on defence R&D, and about whether Europe should build a DARPA-like agency and reach a 2% R&T benchmark. The government acknowledges the study's relevance, outlines increased R&D budgets since 2022 and 2024, and rejects a DARPA-like institute and a fixed 2% growth path for now.

At this moment no added value is seen in setting up an additional DARPA-like institute at European or national level, because existing institutes and instruments fulfil this role in cooperation as desired.

Op dit moment wordt er geen meerwaarde gezien in het oprichten van een aanvullend DARPA-achtig instituut op Europees of nationaal niveau, omdat de al aanwezige instituten en instrumenten deze rol in samenwerking naar wens vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ’Onbekend clubje van NAVO-landen richt zich op tegen de Russen’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the relationship between the Joint Expeditionary Force and NATO, Dutch tasks and contribution, and protection of undersea infrastructure. The minister answered that the JEF is complementary to NATO, participation is voluntary (opt-in), and the Dutch focus is maritime protection of vital infrastructure, without committing to expansion or new capacity steps.
Participation in JEF activities only takes place when it does not conflict with Dutch NATO obligations.
Deelname aan JEF-activiteiten vindt alleen plaats wanneer dit niet strijdig is met de Nederlandse NAVO-verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de toepassing van de Tijdelijke Wet nu het huisvestingsvraagstuk van de CTIVD (voorlopig) opgelost is

An MP asked whether, now that the CTIVD's housing problem is provisionally resolved, the intelligence services' suspended powers under the Temporary Act can be resumed and from when. The government answered that some powers are already being applied under the Temporary Act through agreements with the CTIVD, that a shift to CTIVD oversight is planned, and that full application will follow as CTIVD staffing grows, without giving a firm date.
The starting point is and remains full application of the Temporary Act under the necessary independent oversight, within the shortest possible term that is feasible for all parties.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft volledige toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet onder het noodzakelijke onafhankelijke toezicht, op de kortst mogelijke en voor alle partijen uitvoerbare termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Bamenga over de plannen voor (intensievere) controles aan de landsgrenzen

An MP asked the ministers about intensified border controls, whether checks occur without individual suspicion, what safeguards prevent ethnic profiling, and related use of number plates and sensors. The government answered that the Marechaussee is bound by non-discrimination rules, no longer uses ethnicity in selection, complaints go to the KMar, Inspectie JenV and the Nationale ombudsman, and that controls are risk- and information-driven rather than random.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security supervises the conduct of the KMar.
De Inspectie van Justitie en Veiligheid houdt toezicht op het handelen van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van der Werf over de gevolgen voor veiligheid van de aangekondigde grenscontroles

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Migration, Defence and Justice how border controls would affect security, given KMar staff shortages, whether extra funding helps, and whether border municipalities were consulted. The government answered that controls run within existing KMar capacity, that funding is being worked out, that there was consultation with border regions, and that impacts on the economy will be kept to a minimum.
The internal border checks will be carried out on the basis of the KMar's existing capacity.
De uitvoering van de binnengrenscontroles zullen plaatsvinden op basis van de bestaande capaciteit van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de invoering van interne grenscontroles in Nederland

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government about the reintroduction of internal border controls, including costs, justification under EU rules, personnel impact on the Royal Marechaussee, and whether controls will facilitate people smuggling. The minister answered that controls will be risk-based and non-systematic, that no significant extra costs are expected, that irregular migration and secondary flows justify the measure, and that controls are temporary and not expected to increase smuggling.
The cabinet is taking all possible measures to prevent further disruption of the migration system, because this could lead to distressing situations and a greater threat to public order.
Het kabinet neemt alle mogelijke maatregelen om verdere verstoring van het migratiesysteem te voorkomen, omdat dit kan leiden tot schrijnende situaties en een grotere dreiging voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de demonstratie waarbij de Kromhout Kazerne urenlang werd geblokkeerd

An MP asked the Defence and Interior ministers about a protest that blockaded the Kromhout barracks in Utrecht for hours, forcing cancellation of an NIDV defence-industry event, and whether the mayor and authorities should have intervened and whether restrictive rules are needed. The minister answered that the event was cancelled, that the mayor is responsible for public order and that a WODC study on demonstration law is underway, while stating that blanket bans on demonstrations at military sites are not possible under current law.
It is not possible to ban demonstrations in public spaces in advance as a standard measure.
Het is niet mogelijk om demonstraties op openbaar terrein vooraf standaard te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over de productiecapaciteit van munitie en defensiematerieel

MP Wijen-Nass asked whether the government would take a strategic stake in defence start-ups and whether it would contact the German economics minister to produce shortfall munitions in German industry. The State Secretary replied that a stake remains an option under the economic security instrument, with a letter promised in Q1 2025, and that Defence already discusses production scaling with Germany, which decides on its own industrial capacity.
Your House will be informed in Q1 2025 about how Defence and the Ministry of Economic Affairs will further strengthen the strategic position of the defence industry in the long term.
Uw Kamer wordt in Q1 2025 geïnformeerd over hoe Defensie en Economische Zaken (EZ) de strategische positie van de defensie-industrie verder gaan versterken op de lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over de aanwezigheid van Israëlische wapenbedrijven bij NEDS NIDV 2024

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Israeli arms firms, including IAI, will exhibit at NEDS NIDV 2024, what the fair's admission policy is, and whether Israeli firms should be excluded given alleged rights violations in Gaza. The minister confirmed IAI's participation, said the organiser sets admission under the government's trade policy, and rejected exclusion, citing the value of Israeli systems to Dutch defence.
No, the cabinet does not share this view.
Nee, deze mening deel het kabinet niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Aan Oekraïne geleverde NAVO-wapens in beslag genomen die in criminele circuit waren beland'

An MP from JA21 asked the Justice and Defence ministers how NATO weapons supplied to Ukraine could end up in Dutch criminal circles and what safeguards exist. The ministers answered that the risk of diversion is acknowledged and weighed against Ukraine support, citing the EU list of actions, a national Firearms Focal Point and export checks, and gave only general or partial answers on some questions.
The risk of diversion is not in proportion to Ukraine's urgent needs and the Dutch interest in continuing to support Ukraine with military goods.
Het risico op omleiding staat niet in verhouding tot de urgente behoeftes van Oekraïne en het Nederlandse belang Oekraïne met militaire goederen te blijven steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger Van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minister van Defensie: Nederlandse wetten ongeschikt voor ‘grijze zone’ tussen oorlog en vrede’

MPs Van Dijk and Six-Dijkstra asked the government about Russian vessels mapping North Sea infrastructure, military transport routes, conscription and reservists, a single cyber contact point, and cybersecurity governance. The government answered that it does not pre-announce responses, outlines Defence's North Sea tasks and the Action Plan, says military route specifics are confidential, notes a voluntary enquiry and more reservists, and describes the NLCS and the planned Cyberweerbaarheidsnetwerk.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

Three D66 MPs asked the government about reports of systematic Russian espionage and sabotage preparation in the North Sea, including legal options, coordination, protection measures, AIS switch-offs and oversight. The government answered that the threat is current, cited new protection measures and international cooperation, but declined to share intelligence assessments, case numbers or diplomatic communications.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of the MIVD and AIVD.

Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD) en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over het persbericht «Rusland bespioneert systematisch onze wateren»

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the government about a broadcast report that Russia systematically spies on Dutch waters, and how the North Sea is monitored, whether responses are proportionate, joint NATO measures, intensification, and tougher measures in coastal areas and ports. The minister answered that a range of agencies monitor the North Sea, that Navy escorts Russian vessels, that an action plan on North Sea infrastructure is being expanded with sensors and satellite capacity, and that a bill on espionage offences is pending, while declining to pre-announce specific responses.
The cabinet does not make public statements in advance about how the Dutch government will act in specific incidents, to prevent malicious parties from anticipating Dutch conduct.

Het kabinet doet publiekelijk op voorhand geen uitspraken over hoe de Nederlandse overheid handelt bij specifieke voorvallen, om te voorkomen dat kwaadwillende partijen in hun handelen kunnen anticiperen op Nederlandse handelwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Een munitiedepot middenin bevingsgebied, dat is onmenselijk'

An MP (Beckerman, SP) asks the government about the plan to site a military ammunition depot in earthquake-affected Groningen, citing the health and social harm to residents and the lack of prior communication about candidate locations. The State Secretary replies that the government recognises its debt to Groningen and that social context and local support will weigh in the choice, but declines to drop candidate sites, pointing to the planMER process and promising to share results and consult the region.
The outcomes of the research will be shared with your House and with residents.
De uitkomsten van het onderzoek zullen met uw Kamer en inwoners worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van der Werf over gaten in de beveiliging van defensiecomplexen

MPs Van Kent and Van der Werf asked about security gaps at defence sites, including turnstiles that allowed intruders to slip onto bases, and what has been done about them. The State Secretary answered that emergency measures were in place before the broadcast, a permanent fix by the supplier would be complete by year end, and that the most sensitive assets are protected by stricter tiers, while withholding details of those measures as highly classified.
The supplier of the turnstiles was also immediately instructed to develop a lasting solution so that intrusion in this way is no longer possible.
Ook is direct aan de leverancier van de tourniquets opdracht gegeven een duurzame oplossing te ontwikkelen zodat insluipen op deze manier niet meer mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over de uitspraak dat Oekraïne Nederlandse F-16’s in mag zetten in Rusland

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Ukraine may use Dutch F-16s on Russian territory, including the decision process, escalation risks, sanctions, frozen assets and peace talks. Minister Brekelmans confirmed Ukraine may use them within international law, declined to disclose cabinet deliberations or escalation analyses, and gave general, largely non-specific answers on sanctions and peace efforts.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are secret.
De beraadslagingen van de Ministerraad zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Nederlandse leveranciers van gevechtshonden aan het Israëlische leger

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister whether Dutch firms supply attack dogs used by the Israeli military in Gaza, whether such exports are regulated and monitored, and whether they should be banned. The government answered that dogs are not controlled as strategic goods, it has no overview of dog exports and does not comment on individual firms, and a ban would require international agreement, as a 2016 study concluded.
Information on the export declarations of individual companies is commercially sensitive and therefore confidential.
Informatie over de exportaangiftes van individuele bedrijven is bedrijfsgevoelig en daarom vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zwaarbeveiligd Defensie-netwerk wist even niet meer hoe laat het was’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a multi-hour outage of the NAFIN defence network, including the cause, vulnerability to sabotage, the 15-hour restoration time, preventive measures and scenarios. The state secretary attributed the outage to a software fault in a standard vendor component, said no sign of malicious involvement was found, and gave partial answers, citing security reasons, promising a fuller evaluation only by year-end.
For security reasons, however, Defence does not provide further substantive information on whether vulnerabilities are present.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen verstrekt Defensie echter geen nadere inhoudelijke informatie over het al dan niet aanwezig zijn van kwetsbaarheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Wal over het artikel ‘Vrijwillig dienjaar is succes, zegt Defensie: bijna driekwart wil blijven’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the voluntary service year, including vacancies, rejected applicants, bottlenecks and plans to expand places faster. The State Secretary answered that roughly 11,600 vacancies exist, that the service year will be expanded to about 1,000 places in 2025 with ambitions to go further, and listed investments and planned measures.
For 2025 an expansion to 1,000 service-year military personnel is foreseen.
Voor 2025 is een uitbreiding voorzien naar 1.000 dienjaarmilitairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder over het bericht dat een Iraniër in Duitsland veroordeeld is voor brandstichting in opdracht van de Iraanse staat

MPs Ceder and Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister whether a German court ruling convicting an Iranian for arson on a synagogue on Iranian state orders could support listing the IRGC as a terrorist organisation, and whether the government would use it in its efforts. The minister said the EU Legal Service advice is confidential, that several member states support listing but there is no Council consensus, and that the Netherlands strongly supports listing and will use all available avenues.
The advice of the Legal Service of the Council of the European Union is confidential.
Het advies van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het opblazen van de Nord Stream

The MP asks whether Ukraine was involved in the Nord Stream sabotage, whether Dutch infrastructure was attacked, whether it is an act of aggression, and why the Ukrainian flag was raised at the Defence Ministry. The minister declines to speculate on the cause pending German investigation, states Nord Stream 1 is not Dutch infrastructure, and explains the flag as solidarity with Ukraine.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and awaits the results of the German investigation into the cause.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek naar de toedracht af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het reizen van Nederlandse militairen met civiele vluchten naar conflictgebieden

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Defence whether Dutch soldiers flew to Iraq on a Turkish Airlines civil flight on 2 August 2024, whether using civil flights to conflict zones is usual, and why no military aircraft (including MRTT capacity) was used. The Minister confirmed the flight, said civil transport is common for rotations and individual travel when security allows, and noted MRTT tankers were engaged in a major exercise elsewhere at the time.
For the transport of military personnel, civil flights are more often chosen, provided security allows it.
Voor de verplaatsing van militairen wordt, mits de veiligheid dit toestaat, vaker gekozen voor civiele vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Wilders, Pool en De Roon over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that a German court issued an international arrest warrant against a Ukrainian suspected in the Nord Stream sabotage, and whether Ukraine might be behind it and what Dutch intelligence knew. The government declined to speculate on the German investigation's outcome, did not disclose intelligence details, and said Parliament would be informed through the usual channels.
The cabinet does not state publicly anything about the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our intelligence services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze inlichtingendiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over Nord Stream 2

MPs Kahraman and Omtzigt asked the government about the Nord Stream sabotage, prior consultations with Ukraine and Russia, MIVD warnings, Gasunie write-offs, and internal memos. The ministers answered that they await the German investigation, that no Dutch-Ukrainian consultations on Nord Stream are known for 2020-2021, that no specific government-level Nord Stream talks with Russia took place, and declined to comment on intelligence matters while promising an inventory of documents by end of September 2024.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over Nord Stream

An FVD MP asked the Defence Minister whether Russia blew up Nord Stream, whether Ukraine was involved, when intelligence knew, and whether Netherlands would treat the attack as aggression. The government repeatedly declined to speculate on the cause, said it awaits the German investigation, and would not disclose intelligence sources or knowledge levels, only saying the House is informed through proper channels.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of our services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Roon en Pool over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that President Zelensky knew of and approved the Nord Stream sabotage were accurate, and what the consequences would be. The government answered that it does not speculate on the cause of the explosions and will await the outcome of the German investigation.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and is awaiting the results of the German investigation.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over het landenbeleid Ethiopië

An MP asked the State Secretary about asylum policy for Ethiopia, including whether Fano members accused of human rights abuses can be excluded under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention and whether Dutch companies harmed by Fano-linked crimes warrant policy changes. The Minister explained the 1F framework and IND procedures, said the ministry sees no need to change country policy now, but will ask about crimes against Dutch companies in the next Terms of Reference.

However, in the next Terms of Reference that form the basis for a new general country report on Ethiopia, I will ask questions about signals of crimes against Dutch companies in Fano-controlled parts of Ethiopia.

Wel zal ik in de eerstvolgende Terms of Reference die de basis vormen voor een nieuw algemeen ambtsbericht inzake Ethiopië vragen stellen ten aanzien van signalen van misdrijven tegen Nederlandse bedrijven in Fano-gecontroleerde delen van Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Wilders over het feit dat de MIVD de wettelijk verplichte notificatieplicht bij afluisteren, aftappen en andere bijzondere bevoegdheden niet nakomt

MPs Omtzigt and Wilders asked why the MIVD has not fulfilled its statutory duty to notify people subjected to special powers, and about the status of its notification backlog since the CTIVD's 2017 report. The minister acknowledged a backlog from 2019 to November 2023, said measures are underway with full repair targeted by 1 April 2025, but declined to give figures on targets, politicians, lawyers or journalists and did not disclose compliance incidents to Parliament.
The aim is for the MIVD to have fully cleared the backlog by 1 April 2025.
Het streven is dat de MIVD de achterstand voor 1 april 2025 volledig heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over de olieramp door een Houthi-aanval op olietanker Chios Lion

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the potential environmental damage from a Houthi attack on the tanker Chios Lion, its effect on Operations Prosperity Guardian and Aspides, and whether the EU or Netherlands should send a cleanup vessel. The minister replied that the risk of damage was limited, no military obstruction exists, Aspides has no mandate for oil cleanup, and no EU contribution appears necessary.
Cleaning up an oil spill does not fall within the mandate of EU operation Aspides.
Het opruimen van een olievlek behoort niet tot het mandaat van EU-operatie Aspides.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Volkskrant-artikel ‘AIVD en MIVD rekruteerden journalisten als agent, ‘ondermijning geloofwaardigheid’ van het vak’

An FVD MP asked the Defence and Interior Ministers about a Volkskrant report that the AIVD and MIVD recruited journalists as agents, including how many, whether it continues, and whether the public may know their names. The government confirmed the legal possibility under the Wiv 2017 with extra safeguards, but refused to disclose numbers, current use, or any list of journalists citing source protection and secrecy duties.
The heads of the services are, under Article 23 of the Wiv 2017, responsible for keeping their sources and the safety of agents secret.
De diensthoofden zijn, conform artikel 23 van de Wiv 2017, verantwoordelijk voor de geheimhouding van hun bronnen en de veiligheid van agenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Brekelmans over het optreden van de Russische propagandisten Vladimir Pozner en Ivan Urgant in Theater Amsterdam op 28 mei 2024

MPs Martens-America and Brekelmans asked the government about a Dutch theatre performance by Russian propagandists Pozner and Urgant, including its risk of spreading Russian disinformation and how it fits EU and Dutch sanctions and anti-interference policy. The government answered that free expression weighs heavily, that theatres decide their own programming, and that no coercion by a state actor was identified, while promising no specific new step beyond restating existing policy.
In a democratic constitutional state freedom of expression is a great good and must weigh heavily alongside protection of the democratic constitutional state.
In een democratische rechtstaat is vrijheid van meningsuiting een groot goed en deze dient zwaar te wegen naast de bescherming van de democratische rechtsstaat

m: Motie Peters c.s. over tariefdifferentiatie en tarifering
Motion asking the government to have an independent evaluation of the collective rights management supervision law and to expand ex ante price supervision if tariff practice does not improve.
requests the government, if there is no significant improvement in current practice after the evaluation, to expand ex ante supervision of tariffs
verzoekt de regering tevens bij uitblijven van significante verbetering van de huidige praktijk en na ommekomst van de evaluatie het ex ante toezicht op de tarifering uit te breiden
Amendement van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over het verbreden van de ex-ante toetsing van de tarieven door het College van Toezicht en het geven van nadere criteria voor deze ex-ante toetsing
Widens the College van Toezicht's ex-ante approval of collective rights management tariffs to all tariff setting and adds fairness criteria for that review.
This amendment widens this ex-ante review of tariffs and provides further criteria by which the supervisory board will review the tariffs.
Dit amendement verbreedt deze ex-ante toetsing van de tarieven en geeft nadere criteria waarlangs het college van toezicht de toetsing op de tarieven zal uitvoeren.

Amendement van het lid Peters ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het bij amvb regels geven voor het beheer van de gelden waarvoor geen rechthebbenden gevonden zijn en de aanwending van de gelden voor ande
Peters amendment would have the College van Toezicht oversee and rules set by decree for unclaimed collective rights money held by collecting societies.
rules are given for managing funds for which no rightsholders have been found and for using the funds for purposes other than payment to rightsholders.
regels worden gegeven voor het beheer van de gelden waarvoor geen rechthebbenden gevonden zijn en de aanwending van de gelden voor andere doeleinden

Amendement van het lid Peters aangaande het bij amvb regels geven voor het beheer van de gelden waarvoor geen rechthebbenden gevonden zijn en de aanwending van de gelden voor andere doeleinden dan uit
Amendment has the collective rights management body's supervisor oversee use of unclaimed funds and sets rules by general administrative order for their management.
further rules are set by general administrative order on the management and use of these funds
bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels worden gesteld over het beheer en de aanwending van deze gelden
Motie Jasper van Dijk c.s. over uitbreiding van de overgangstermijn naar één jaar
Asks the government to give the temporary benefit scheme for former WWik recipients a one-year transition period instead of six months, for artists with long-term commitments.
requests the government to provide the temporary benefit scheme for former WWik recipients with a transition period of one year
verzoekt de regering de tijdelijke regeling uitkering aan voormalig WWik-gerechtigden te voorzien van een overgangstermijn van één jaar
Motie Jasper van Dijk en Peters over vergoeding van de frictiekosten
Asks the government to fully compensate the advisory institution for friction costs arising from the withdrawal of the WWik scheme.
requests the government to fully compensate the advisory institution for the friction costs resulting from the withdrawal of the WWik
verzoekt de regering de frictiekosten als gevolg van de intrekking van de WWik, volledig te vergoeden aan de adviserende instelling
Motie Peters c.s. over het in stand houden van flankerend beleid
Asks the government to keep funding for supplementary policy supporting artists' professional practice at the same level.
requests the government to maintain the supplementary policy supporting artists and creatives at the same level
verzoekt de regering het flankerend beleid ter ondersteuning van de opbouw van een renderende beroepspraktijk van kunstenaars en creatieven op hetzelfde niveau in stand te houden
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over Nederlands drama en documentaire
Asks the minister to agree with the public broadcaster to keep the current budget share for Dutch drama and documentaries.
requests the minister to make agreements with the public broadcaster on maintaining the current budget share for Dutch drama and documentaries
verzoekt de minister met de publieke omroep afspraken te maken over het handhaven van het huidige budgetaandeel voor het Nederlands drama en de Nederlandse documentaire
Motie Van der Ham en Peters over splitsing van de omroepverenigingen en het omroepbedrijf
Asks the government to study whether broadcasting associations should be split into a membership association and a broadcasting company.
requests the government to conduct a study into the desirability and possibility of splitting the broadcasting associations
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek te doen naar de wenselijkheid en de mogelijkheid om binnen de omroepen een splitsing te maken
Motie Peters c.s. over de inhoudelijke autonomie van de publieke omroep
Asks the government to investigate how to better safeguard the editorial autonomy of the public broadcaster against political interference and report to the Chamber.
requests the government to investigate how the editorial autonomy of the public broadcaster can be better safeguarded

Asks the state secretary to submit the Training and Education blueprint to the House by September 2009 rather than vaguely 'in time for the budget debate'.
requests the government to submit the Training and Education blueprint to the House no later than September 2009
verzoekt de regering de blauwdruk Opleiding & Training uiterlijk in de maand september 2009 aan de Kamer aan te bieden
qa: Antwoord vragen Peters over het juridische advies van de Externe Volkenrechtelijke Adviseur (EVA) inzake het risico dat bedrijven of instellingen in nederzettingen bij samenwerkingsactiviteiten betrokken raken die uit de

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether the government would share the EVA legal advice on the risk that companies or institutions in settlements become involved in cooperation stemming from intensified Netherlands-Israel relations, and why earlier answers did not mention it. The minister confirmed the advice existed and was known, but declined to share its content or conclusion, citing the agreed EVA reporting arrangements, and said the policy reflects a broad assessment including international law.
In my view the underlying advice does not fall within the category of advice for which it was promised that the House would be informed of its conclusion.
Onderliggend advies valt naar mijn oordeel niet onder de categorie van adviezen waarvan is toegezegd dat de Kamer geïnformeerd zal worden over de conclusie ervan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over de uitspraak van de Turkse premier Erdogan dat abortus moord is

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister how the government reacted to Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remarks calling abortion murder, and whether the minister would raise this during the royal visit to Turkey. The minister replied that Dutch law permits abortion under conditions reflecting a fundamentally different view, and that women's rights are regularly raised with Turkey, including in EU conclusions, without committing to a specific statement on the visit.
The importance of women's rights is regularly a point of attention in discussions with the Turkish government, including within the framework of the European Commission's progress reports.
Het belang van vrouwenrechten is regelmatig punt van aandacht in gesprekken met de Turkse regering, ook in het kader van de voortgangsrapportages van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over het opnemen van verzekeringen voor wapentransporten in de sancties tegen Syrië

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked whether insurance for arms shipments to Syria is covered by EU sanctions, whether this should be tightened like the Iran oil-insurance ban, how enforcement works, and whether financial sectors are aware of the rules. The minister answered that EU sanctions ban insuring arms cargo bound for Syria, that Dutch customs (POSS) enforces this and will remind businesses, that at least one ship apparently turned back after insurance was withdrawn, but that many insurers still cover arms cargo and enforcement by insurers is limited.
Given the importance of this matter, these services will again actively bring the information on the sanctions against Syria to the attention of Dutch business.
Gezien het belang van deze materie zullen genoemde diensten de informatie over de sancties tegen Syrië nogmaals actief onder de aandacht van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “NMa heeft andere prioriteiten dan muziekauteurs”

MP Peters asked ministers whether the NMa's refusal, on priority grounds, to investigate a complaint by Stichting Platform Makers about NPO conduct was acceptable, whether the minister would talk with the NMa, whether competition law is applied evenhandedly in culture, and when a copyright contracts bill would be submitted. The minister answered that the NMa is an independent body setting its own priorities, that appeal remedies exist, that competition law applies to creators, and that the bill would be submitted shortly.
It is therefore up to the NMa to set its own priorities.
Het is dan ook aan de NMa om haar prioriteiten vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Klaver en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van de notulen van de onderraad

MPs Klaver and Peters asked why the government will not release minutes of the subcommittee (onderraad) on Olympic Games information, despite the health minister saying she would like to send them. The Prime Minister replied that confidentiality under the Council rules of procedure (art. 26) applies, that no waiver will be granted, and that the government's information duty is not to be read broadly.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over situatie van Khader Adnan en administratieve detentie van Palestijnen door Israël

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the hunger strike and administrative detention of Khader Adnan, the treatment of Palestinian administrative detainees, due process, torture allegations and Israel's detention of Palestinian MPs and minors. The minister answered that Adnan ended his hunger strike and was released, that the EU and the Netherlands raise detention safeguards and the prohibition of torture in dialogue with Israel, and that Israel is bound by its treaty obligations, while declining to pass judgement on contested reports.
The Netherlands conducts a human rights dialogue with Israel, bilaterally and through the EU, including on compliance with international humanitarian law and human rights treaty obligations.

Nederland voert bilateraal en via de EU een mensenrechtendialoog met Israël, onder meer over de naleving van internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het humanitair oorlogsrecht en mensenrechtenverdragen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.

Antwoord vragen Peters en El Fassed over de gebrekkige medewerking van de NAVO bij het onderzoek van de rapporteur van de Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa naar de omgekomen bootvluchtelingen uit Libië

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers why NATO failed to cooperate fully with the Council of Europe rapporteur investigating the deaths of 63 boat migrants from Libya, and why no rescue was offered after a distress alert. The ministers replied that NATO cooperated to the extent possible, that some information lies with member states, that NATO did not command the sea area, and that the alert was a search request rather than a distress call, so NATO bore no rescue obligation.
Part of the requested information can only be provided by member states. It concerns a national competence.
Een deel van de gevraagde informatie kan alleen door lidstaten worden aangeleverd. Het betreft een nationale bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Peters, Pechtold en Timmermans over intensivering van de bilaterale relatie met Israël

MPs Peters, Pechtold and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the Netanyahu visit, the planned intensification of Dutch-Israeli relations, the expected bilateral cooperation agreement and its transparency, and whether settlement-based firms could benefit. The minister answered that the visit was routine, a first Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council is set for 7 June 2012 with a non-binding founding document to be shared after the meeting, and that consular services to settlement firms are refused without legal advice being needed.
The cabinet first wants to reach agreement with Israel on the content of the document.
Het kabinet wil eerst overeenstemming bereiken met Israël over de inhoud van het document.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Peters over de ontslagvergoeding van een directielid van Buma/Stemra

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether the very high severance pay of a former Buma/Stemra legal director, paid from funds meant for artists, was acceptable, and whether the College van Toezicht or the minister could claw it back. Minister Teeven answered that the payment predates the supervision law and the salary norm, that there is no legal basis for clawback in this case, and that the forthcoming WNT and wetsvoorstel 31 766 will allow future recovery and salary caps.
This concerns an employment contract concluded some time ago, long before the Supervision of Collective Management Organisations Act came into force.
Het betreft hier een arbeidscontract dat geruime tijd geleden tot stand is gekomen, lang voordat de Wet toezicht collectieve beheersorganisaties in werking was getreden
Antwoord vragen Klavers en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht van de notulen van de onderraad

Klaver and Peters asked whether the confidentiality rules of the ministerial council (artikel 26 Reglement van Orde) justify withholding the minutes of the onderraad on the Olympic Games, and whether the minister would grant a waiver. The government confirmed the rule allows waiver but answered that confidentiality of council deliberations is a state interest limiting parliamentary information, and gave no commitment to release the minutes.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen Peters over voltrekking van de doodstraf door India

An MP asks the foreign minister about India's plan to lift its death penalty moratorium and execute Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana, and about Sikh concerns of discrimination. The minister answers that the execution has been postponed pending a new clemency request, that religious minorities face some discrimination but no anti-Sikh violence like in the 1980s and 1990s, and that the EU has made a demarche to India opposing the death penalty.
After the Indian intention to execute Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana became known, the Netherlands pressed within the EU for a demarche against it with the Indian authorities.
Nadat het Indiase voornemen om Bhai Balwant Singh Rajoana te executeren bekend werd, heeft Nederland zich in EU-verband hardgemaakt voor een demarche hiertegen bij de Indiase autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Peters over geweld door kolonisten en Palestijnen op de Westbank

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about settler violence against Palestinians on the West Bank, including OCHA and Yesh Din findings on weak prosecution, the Netanyahu measures announced in December 2011, the EU note on enforcement, and incident statistics. The minister answers that the Israeli authorities should first respond, that the government will inform parliament on the measures, that it agrees with the report's findings, and gives OCHA incident figures while noting no comparable data exist for Palestinian violence.
The cabinet is of the view that it is primarily up to the Israeli authorities to respond to this.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het in eerste instantie aan de Israëlische autoriteiten is daarop te reageren.
Antwoord vragen Peters en Jasper Van Dijk over de optelsom van bezuinigingen op cultuur

MPs Peters and Van Dijk asked the state secretary for an aggregate picture of cultural budget cuts across national, provincial and municipal government, including effects on supply, attendance, employment, the Geefwet and the WWIK abolition. The secretary answered that the aggregate cannot yet be given because decisions are unfinished and data are not comparable, and that effects cannot reliably be predicted, though some figures (WWIK saving of 10 million, VAT rise of 90 million, transition costs up to 138 million) were provided.

Partly because decisions on cultural subsidies for 2013–2016 at national, municipal and provincial level are not yet concluded, it is not possible to state how much is cut in culture by national, provincial and municipal government together.

Mede omdat de besluitvorming over de cultuursubsidies voor de periode 2013–2016 bij zowel Rijk, gemeenten als provincies nog niet is afgerond, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel er door Rijk, provincies en gemeenten gezamenlijk wordt bezuinigd op cultuur.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel en Peters over het ILO rapport 'Burried in Bricks' en de betrokkenheid van NAVO/ISAF bij dwangarbeid in steenbakkerijen

MPs Voordewind, De Lange, Van Bommel and Peters asked the government about the ILO report 'Buried in Bricks' on bonded child and adult labour in Afghan brick kilns and whether NATO/ISAF supply chains use such bricks. The government answered that it shares the aim of ending child labour, that NATO/ISAF can not fully trace brick supply lines, and that NATO agreed four concrete follow-up steps while Afghanistan bears primary responsibility.

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about the Koran burning at Bagram, the riots in Kunduz, police conduct, the suspension of Dutch mission activities, and President Karzai's reaction. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, described police action as effective, and reported that Dutch training activities resumed from late February and early March 2012.
A joint Afghan-ISAF investigation into the precise background of the burning is ongoing.
Een gezamenlijk Afghaans-ISAF onderzoek naar de precieze achtergrond van de verbranding is gaande
Antwoord vragen Peters en Van Gent over de geheimhouding van de agenda's van de ministerraad

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Prime Minister whether he intends to remove agenda items from cabinet meetings to prevent ministers from publicising news early, and whether cabinet agendas should be published in advance as other bodies do. The Prime Minister confirmed only that items may be removed, rejected publishing agendas in advance, saying the agenda's function is to facilitate internal cabinet deliberation.
Publication of the agenda items would hinder open and unconstrained deliberation among the council members, which benefits decision-making.
Openbaarmaking van de geagendeerde onderwerpen belemmert de open en ongedwongen beraadslaging tussen de leden van de raad die de besluitvorming ten goede komt.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi (beiden D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks), en Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bevordering van politieke vrouwenparticipatie in

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would back a gender quota for Libya's new constitution-making body, and how it funds women's political participation in the MENA region. The minister said the Netherlands supports women's participation, will remind the NTC of its commitments, has earmarked EUR 2 million for 2011 and 2012, and will take a lead role within the EU, but did not commit to requesting a quota.

I follow developments in Libya closely and where necessary I remind the NTC and the interim government of their commitments in the draft Constitutional Charter regarding the democratic transition, including women's rights.

Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Libië nauwgezet en waar nodig herinner ik de NTC en de interim-regering aan hun toezeggingen in the draft Constitutional Charter ten aanzien van de democratische transitie inclusief vrouwenrechten.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de disproportionele kosten die non-profit organisaties moeten betalen aan de Buma en SENA (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Peters asks the state secretary why a carnival association was charged disproportionate fees by Buma and SENA, whether the error was handled too slowly, and whether other non-profit organisations are wrongly invoiced. The state secretary says the fees were corrected after complaint, the error stemmed partly from the association's own information, and he sees insufficient reason for a broader investigation of non-profit invoicing.
I see insufficient reason in the above for further investigation into incorrect invoicing of not-for-profit organisations
Ik zie in het voorgaande onvoldoende aanleiding voor een nader onderzoek naar onjuiste facturering van not-for-profit organisaties
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de fact-finding van NCH naar Birma (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asked ministers about a NCH trade fact-finding mission to Burma, its consistency with the government's discouragement policy, the participating sectors, and stakeholder and MVO safeguards. The ministers answered that the mission is a private NCH initiative, that EU sanctions and OECD guidelines apply, and that the NCH is responsible for the mission's preparation, programme, evaluation and reporting.
The fact-finding mission is a private initiative of the NCH.
De fact-finding missie is een privaat initiatief van het NCH.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over het Palestijns lidmaatschap van UNESCO (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Peters asked the foreign minister about Palestinian UNESCO membership, Israeli retaliatory measures, the cultural heritage protection and the resumption of peace talks. The minister answered that Dutch opposition rested on the need for a negotiated state first, that Israel's reaction was unhelpful, that no evidence of Hague Convention breaches was found, and that talks had resumed in principle.
These questions have been answered as quickly as possible.
Deze vragen zijn zo snel mogelijk beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een lading Amerikaans traangas in de Suezhaven (ingezonden 9 december

An MP from GroenLinks asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether a US shipment of tear gas to Egypt's interior ministry was arriving, why the US approved it, whether the government would condemn it, which countries supply riot-control equipment to Egypt, and whether such goods could transit the Netherlands. The minister answered that the US reports two deliveries arrived on 25 November 2011 with no further requests, that the US will review possible misuse, that the government sees no reason to doubt US export practice, that it does not know which other countries export such goods, and that the Netherlands would refuse transit of equipment for human rights abuses.
If military goods such as anti-riot and crowd-control equipment could be used in Egypt for human rights violations, the Netherlands will not grant a transit licence for such equipment.

Indien militaire goederen zoals «anti riot en crowd control» materieel in Egypte mogelijk zouden worden ingezet voor mensenrechtenschendingen, zal Nederland geen vergunning geven voor de doorvoer van dergelijk materieel.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Afghaans president Karzai (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that President Karzai plans to stay in power after 2014, the Dutch intelligence contacts on it, and whether the Netherlands will press Karzai to respect the constitution. The minister replied that Karzai said publicly he will leave office in 2014, declined to comment on the German intelligence report or intelligence exchanges, and said the Netherlands will keep raising rule of law with the Afghan government.
I cannot provide information about reports of the German intelligence service BND.
Ik kan geen informatie verschaffen over rapporten van de Duitse inlichtingendienst BND.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks), van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Pechtold (D66) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse zaken over de gerechtelijke uitspraak die de Staat

MPs from several parties asked whether the government would drop cassation against the Hague appeals court ruling holding the State liable for the deaths of three men during the Srebrenica genocide, and whether it would apologise to the victims' relatives.
