The minister answered that the ruling is an interim judgment so cassation is not yet possible, and reaffirmed the 2002 Kok cabinet statement on Dutch political co-responsibility rather than apologising.
The appeals court ruling is, technically speaking, an interim judgment.
De uitspraak van het hof is juridisch-technisch gezien een tussenarrest.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over mogelijke corruptie van een bestuurslid van Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a Buma/Stemra board member allegedly tied mediation over about 1 million euro in withheld royalties owed to a composer to receiving one third of that sum, and whether Buma/Stemra wrongly withheld royalties while using the work in its own advertising. The state secretary called the report disturbing, said the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten was asked to investigate with priority, that the board member has resigned, and that the supervisor's powers over Stemra will be strengthened by a pending bill.
Following the broadcast, I contacted the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten with the request to investigate the matter with priority.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending heb ik contact opgenomen met het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten met het verzoek de zaak met voorrang te onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over aanvallen op Kachin in Birma (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about Burmese army offensives and human rights abuses against the Kachin minority, including reported group rape, and what the EU and the Netherlands were doing about humanitarian access, aid, China's role and violence against women. The minister confirmed awareness, cited EU raising of the issue and a Commissioner's visit, explained that restricted access and accountability concerns limit direct Dutch aid to local organisations, postponed the EU-China summit where Burma would be raised, and pointed to the UN resolution and an NGO project.
An important bottleneck is that access for aid workers in Kachin is limited.
Een belangrijk knelpunt is dat in Kachin de toegang voor hulpverleners beperkt is.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de economische betrekkingen tussen Nederland en Israel (ingezonden

MPs Peters and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch economic ties with Israel, including settlement businesses, the Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council, and Gaza gas fields. The government restated its policy of discouraging economic relations with businesses in occupied territories, said it does not actively check trade with settlement firms, and declined to see evidence of unlawful Israeli use of Gaza gas.
In general, the government discourages economic relations with businesses in the occupied territories.
In zijn algemeenheid ontmoedigt de regering economische relaties met bedrijven in de bezette gebieden.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over Egypte (ingezonden 2 november 2011).

An MP asks whether the minister knows that activist Alaa Abdel-Fattah was detained by the army and faces a military trial over criticism of violence against Copts, and whether the minister will raise his detention and the military trials of civilians with Egyptian authorities. The minister confirms awareness, says concerns about the detention of bloggers and the trial of civilians in military courts were raised with Egyptian counterparts, and states that the Netherlands opposes civilian trials in military courts.
I have expressed my concerns to the Egyptian authorities about the trial of civilians by military courts.
Ik heb bij de Egyptische autoriteiten mijn zorgen geuit over berechting van burgers door militaire rechtbanken.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, El Fassed en Peters (allen GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Shell oil paid Nigerian military to put d

MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Shell paid the Nigerian military to suppress protests, and whether the government would press for independent investigation of human rights abuses and require Shell to clean up and compensate in Ogoniland. The ministers answered that the events concern the 1990s, that the UNEP report calls for joint action by all parties, that the Nigerian government must decide on independent inquiry, and that Shell's subsidiary SPDC has engaged on remediation without committing to a specific government-led action.
It is up to the Nigerian government to decide whether independent research should be carried out in addition to the UNEP report.
Het is aan de Nigeriaanse overheid om te bepalen of er in aanvulling op het UNEP-rapport onafhankelijk onderzoek moet komen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van 850 000 euro

MPs from several parties asked why the 850,000 euro promised in 2009 for Balongsari (Rawagede) has not been fully disbursed, how much went via Hivos and an agreement with Indonesia's Interior Ministry, and whether the funds will be released quickly. The ministers explained a 250,000 euro microcredit project run by Hivos is operating, the school/market/health project is delayed in Indonesian administrative procedures, and funds will be transferred once preparations are complete, with Dutch monitoring.
Embassy funds can only be transferred to the Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs once the aforementioned preparations are completed.
Fondsen van de ambassade kunnen pas naar het Indonesische ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken worden overgemaakt als eerdergenoemde voorbereidingen afgerond zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Hachchi (D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Israëlische antiboycotwet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli anti-boycott bill, which would make calling for boycotts a civil wrong and allow damages without proof of harm, conflicts with freedom of expression and whether it shields settlements. The minister said the law may conflict with freedom of expression, that the Israeli Supreme Court is reviewing it, that settlements are contrary to international law, and that the Dutch government opposes boycott calls in this context while noting Israel's democratic debate.
I am not anticipating the judgment of the Court.
Ik loop niet op het oordeel van het Hof vooruit.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (Christen Unie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het RTL Nieuwsinterview met de politiecommandant Samiullah Qatra (ingezonden 30 augustus

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether trained Afghan police in Kunduz would be drawn into fighting, as the provincial police chief suggested on RTL, and whether this fits agreements with Afghan authorities. The government answered that the trained police are only for civilian tasks, that agreements with Afghan authorities exclude offensive military use, and that it would take appropriate measures if they were involved in offensive action.
If Dutch-trained police were nevertheless drawn into offensive military actions, that would breach the agreements made and the government will take appropriate measures, as agreed with your House.

Als door Nederland opgeleide agenten toch betrokken zouden worden bij offensieve militaire acties, zou dat in strijd zijn met de gemaakte afspraken en zal de regering passende maatregelen nemen, zoals is afgesproken met uw Kamer.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het verbod voor vrouwen in Saudi-Arabie om auto te rijden (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the arrest of activist Manal Al Sharif over the Saudi ban on women driving, whether they would press Saudi authorities for her release and the ban's removal, and about trade, investment and CSR in Saudi Arabia. The minister said the driving ban is part of the structural discrimination against women and will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, but declined to take further concrete steps such as legal aid since she had been released.
The ban on women driving cars is part of the structural disadvantage of women in Saudi Arabia.
Het verbod voor vrouwen om auto's te besturen is onderdeel van de structurele achterstelling van vrouwen in Saudi-Arabië.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks), Timmermans (PvdA) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Wetsvoorstel om schade aan de Staat Israël te voorkomen als gevolg van boycot (ingezonden 18 m

MPs Peters, Timmermans and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli anti-boycott bill, including its territorial reach, civil-wrong liability, its possible link to protecting settlements, and its effect on free expression. The minister replied that the law adopted in July differs from earlier drafts and referred to answers given to other MPs' questions on the adopted law.
The bill was adopted by the Israeli parliament on 11 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 11 juli jongstleden in het Israëlische parlement aangenomen.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de staatssecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spijt van de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wete

An MP asks the state secretary what he regrets about the cabinet's tone on cultural cuts and why the VAT increase for performing arts was implemented as an allegedly unfinished measure, and whether it would be reversed if alternative funding were found. The government answers that it regrets the heated tone, defends the VAT measure as properly deliberated and adopted by parliament, says it sees no reason to reverse it, and states that talks with the Raad voor Cultuur have since been constructive.
In the democratic decision-making process an intensive weighing of the various arguments has taken place.
In het democratisch besluitvormingsproces heeft een intensieve weging van de verschillende argumenten plaatsgehad.
Vragen van de leden Peters en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister about the Moroccan authorities' handling of protests, expected royal reforms, whether the Netherlands would press for democratisation and non-violent policing, and press freedom. The minister answered that the constitutional reform was a step toward democracy and that the Netherlands would keep encouraging reform bilaterally and through the EU, while noting mixed signs on repression.
The Dutch government is closely following the reforms in Morocco and will continue to encourage the Moroccan government directly and through the EU to take steps toward further democratisation.
De Nederlandse regering volgt de hervormingen in Marokko op de voet en zal rechtstreeks en via de EU de Marokkaanse regering blijven aanmoedigen stappen naar verdere democratisering te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks), Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mediasituatie in Arabische landen, en

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and PvdA asked the government about internet and media restrictions in Yemen and Bahrain during protests, including whether the Netherlands would condemn these as strongly as Libya, and what it would do to secure internet access. The government answered that it condemns the restrictions wherever they occur, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU, supports media projects, and declined to answer the questions before the scheduled debate.
This has unfortunately not proved possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Syrië (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about EU diplomatic pressure on Syria, including suspending aid, sanctions, travel bans, asset freezes, Turkey's role, and ICC referral. The minister reported that the EU suspended most aid, adopted sanctions and an arms embargo, and that the ICC lacks jurisdiction, so Netherlands would not press for an investigation.
I am of the view that the efforts of the EU and Turkey can reinforce each other in the region.
Ik ben van mening dat de inspanningen van de EU en Turkije elkaar in de regio kunnen versterken.
Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken en de minister van Defensie over criminele bendes in Kunduz (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether criminal gangs and radical Islamist groups in Kunduz change the security assessment and threaten Dutch police trainers, and whether Afghan police can handle them. The government answered that the security situation fits earlier assessments, that the training mission can proceed as planned, and that training covers dealing with the complex local security environment, without committing to new concrete steps.
The government has confidence that the police training mission will be able to carry out its activities as planned.
De regering heeft er vertrouwen in dat de politietrainingsmissie haar activiteiten zal kunnen uitvoeren zoals voorzien.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, Defensie en Veiligheid en Justitie over het mogelijke negatieve advies van de Nederlandse Politiebond inzake d

MPs Peters and Voordewind asked whether the Dutch police union's possible negative advice on the Afghanistan police training mission reflects worsening security in Kunduz, whether German signals of concern are accurate, whether trainers' safety and training plans still hold, whether security information will be shared with police unions, and whether there is concern about willingness to volunteer. Minister Opstelten answered that the security situation fits earlier briefings, that EUPOL assesses it twice daily and the government has confidence in the mission, that unions are regularly informed, and that volunteer supply is currently sufficient.
The government has confidence that the police officers in the EUPOL mission can carry out their tasks responsibly under these circumstances and closely monitors the general security situation.

De regering heeft er vertrouwen in dat de politiefunctionarissen in de EUPOL missie onder deze omstandigheden hun taken op een verantwoorde wijze kunnen uitvoeren en houdt de algemene veiligheidssituatie nauwlettend in het oog.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO) die Nederlandse series niet wil delen met derden (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the NPO refuses to let third parties such as Ximon.nl distribute older Dutch public-broadcaster series online, despite public funding and ministry investment. The minister says the NPO board has decided to allow a 1.5-year trial with Ximon for series five years or older, with terms still under discussion, while maintaining that the NPO board's coordinating role is needed for the public broadcasting strategy.
My department has spoken with the NPO on several occasions about cooperation with Ximon.
Mijn departement heeft diverse malen met de NPO over samenwerking met Ximon gesproken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Van Bommel (SP) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bewering dat in Afghanistan producten met kinder- en slavenarbeid worde

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether NATO/ISAF-funded construction in Afghanistan uses bricks made with child and slave labour, and what NATO and the Afghan government are doing about it. The government answered that NATO screens contractors on child labour, that direct contractors can reasonably be assumed to use no child or slave labour though firm guarantees are impossible given security, that an ILO study is planned, and that a contract clause on child labour is used in Kunduz.
However, firm guarantees cannot be given given the security situation and the resulting limited possibilities for control.
Harde garanties zijn gezien de veiligheidssituatie en de daardoor beschikbare mogelijkheden tot controle echter niet te geven.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het factureren door Buma/Stemra van websites die een radiostream op hun site embedden (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether Buma/Stemra charging websites for embedding radio streams is justified, whether embedding is a new communication to the public or reproduction, and whether the law should be amended, plus how this compares to the 2010 YouTube controversy. State Secretary Teeven answered that the parties should resolve it through negotiation or the courts, that legal clarity is lacking, and that he sees no reason to amend the Copyright Act now.
I believe it is up to the parties involved to reach an arrangement through consultation.
Ik vind het aan de betrokken partijen om in overleg tot een regeling te komen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de informatievoorziening aan het parleme

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the cabinet's information provision to parliament is adequate: whether risks and counter-indications must be disclosed, whether publicly funded commissioned research must be accessible and published, and whether documents should be provided five days before debates. The minister denied a recurring pattern of deficient information, said the active duty covers relevant facts and arguments including contra-indications, reaffirmed publication of commissioned research by default, and declined a fixed five-day deadline because parliament sets its own agenda.
The government endeavours to inform the House as timely and as fully as possible.
De regering tracht de Kamer tijdig en zo volledig mogelijk te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de veroordeling van een blogger in Egypte (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the military court conviction of Egyptian blogger Maikel Nabil, whether it was an unfair trial, whether appeal remained open, whether Netherlands would intervene, and about Egyptian media restrictions on military coverage. The minister confirmed the conviction was upheld, said military courts cannot guarantee a fair trial, and committed to raising free-expression concerns bilaterally and via the EU, though the EU and Netherlands chose quiet diplomacy over a public statement.
Given the nature of military courts in Egypt, a fair trial cannot be guaranteed when civilians are tried by military courts.
Gezien de aard van militaire rechtbanken in Egypte, kan een eerlijk proces niet worden gewaarborgd wanneer burgers door militaire rechtbanken worden berecht.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over genderbeleid in de Arabische Regio (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Hachchi and Peters asked the foreign minister and state secretary what concrete consequences a joint US-Dutch statement on women in emerging democracies has for Dutch gender policy in the MENA region, which concrete joint actions are planned, how Dutch funding for women's organisations works, and whether gender and UNSCR 1325 will be raised with regional authorities. The government answered that joint follow-up is being arranged, outlined existing funding through the MDG3 fund and embassies (including new budget of 2 million euros for women's participation), and said 1325 will be included in the forthcoming National Action Plan.
Yes, the forthcoming National Action Plan 1325 for 2012-2015 will include the elaboration for the MENA region.
Ja, in het momenteel in voorbereiding zijnde Nationaal Actieplan 1325 voor de periode 2012 – 2015 zal de uitwerking voor de MENA regio worden meegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke Amerikaanse strafvervolging van Rop Gonggrijp (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the foreign and justice ministers whether the government's answers on Bradley Manning's detention and on possible US prosecution of Rop Gonggrijp were credible, and what safeguards applied to any extradition request. The ministers replied that Manning's detention conditions were deemed adequate, a UN rapporteur had requested access, and no indictment or extradition request against Gonggrijp existed, so no assessment was possible; they also said the embassy had clarified his mention in a Twitter court order did not make him a suspect.
At present, as far as we are aware, there is no indictment against Mr Gonggrijp, and therefore no extradition request from the United States that can be assessed.
Op dit moment is, voor zover ons bekend, geen sprake van een aanklacht tegen de heer Gonggrijp, en is er dus ook geen verzoek tot uitlevering van de Verenigde Staten dat beoordeeld kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de NAVO-operatie in Libië (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP asks whether Dutch AWACS and F-16 support for NATO's Libya operation, which feeds targeting of ground targets, is consistent with a mandate excluding bombing, and seeks an overview of Dutch contributions, the status of NATO legal interpretation on arms and training, arrest procedures, and Dutch positions on the Contact Group and the African Union mediation. The ministers answer that Dutch aircraft provide intelligence to the NATO command, that Dutch units do not bomb ground targets, that a full overview is not possible for operational reasons, that NATO did not reach agreement on arms supplies, and that a letter on detainees will follow.
For operational reasons it is not possible to provide a current and complete overview of all international military actions to which the Netherlands has contributed directly or indirectly.

Het is om operationele redenen niet mogelijk om een actueel en volledig overzicht te geven van alle internationale militaire acties waaraan Nederland direct dan wel indirect een bijdrage aan heeft geleverd.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de NAVO (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about a joint proposal with Germany, Norway and Poland on nuclear transparency between NATO and Russia, and about public and parliamentary access to NATO documents such as the Posture Review. The minister described the proposal as a step to build mutual trust, said publication of the review's outcome is intended while some underlying documents will stay classified, and noted that transparency among allies already exists.
Some underlying documents of the review will however remain classified.
Sommige onderliggende documenten van de review zullen echter geclassificeerd blijven.
Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van bloggers in de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked the foreign minister about the arrest of bloggers Ahmad Mansoor, Fahad Salem al-Shehhi and Nasser bin Ghaith in the UAE, and whether the government would raise their detention, seek their release and voice concern over restrictions on expression and association. The minister confirmed awareness of press reports, said their whereabouts were unknown and that no signs of torture were known, and said the Dutch missions were told to stay alert and the issue would be raised at EU level.
I have therefore told the Dutch missions in the UAE to remain alert on this matter and I will raise the issue within the EU.
Ik heb de Nederlandse vertegenwoordigingen in de VAE daarom gezegd terzake alert te blijven en ik zal de kwestie in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse relatie met Israël (ingezonden 8 november 2010).

MP Peters asks the Foreign Minister what the coalition agreement's pledge to invest further in ties with Israel means, how Europe views it, how bilateral relations are being intensified, and whether human rights criticism and the arms export policy still apply. The minister answers that deepening ties strengthens Israel's legitimacy and enables dialogue, that a human rights subcommittee under the EU-Israel Association Agreement will be set up, and that arms exports remain restrictively assessed case by case, with some ongoing intensification plans still to be developed.
The coalition agreement states that the Netherlands stands up for the protection of human rights worldwide.
Het regeerakkoord stelt dat Nederland opkomt voor de bescherming van mensenrechten wereldwijd.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulpverlening in Afghanistan (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the kidnapping of a Dutch aid worker in Afghanistan, who was released, the rescue leadership, trends in abductions of aid workers, and the effect of Karzai's ban on private foreign security firms. The minister said the worker was freed without violence, declined to disclose details of the release process for security reasons, saw no trend of rising abductions, and described ongoing consultations on implementing the decree.
In the interest of the safety of all those involved, I cannot provide further information about the process that contributed to his release.
In het belang van de veiligheid van alle betrokkenen kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen over het proces dat heeft bijgedragen aan zijn vrijlating.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de samenwerking met Frankrijk voor internetvrijheid (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

MP Peters asked whether the Netherlands would attend the 29 October 2010 Paris conference on internet freedom, whether the outcomes would be reported to parliament, and whether the French three-strikes proposal is compatible with freedom of expression and privacy, and if the previous government's rejection of such a regime still stands. The minister replied that France postponed the conference, the Netherlands will seek a new date and insists on freedom of expression as its theme, and that the Netherlands does not support the Hadopi/three-strikes approach and will keep saying so.
The Netherlands will soon enter into discussions with France about a possible new date, location and modalities for the planned conference.
Nederland zal spoedig in gesprek gaan met Frankrijk over een mogelijke nieuwe datum, locatie en modaliteiten van de beoogde conferentie.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over internetfilters (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the government's role in the planned internet blocking of child pornography, including access to negotiation records, the status of agreements, blocklist criteria, appeal procedures, and effectiveness. The minister said the ministry follows the process closely via a platform, that negotiation minutes are unnecessary, that blocklist criteria derive from a 2009 study, and that further advice and a progress letter will follow, with no agreements yet signed.
Meeting minutes are not necessary for that.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about excessive director salaries at development organisation SNV, how the government will recover the excess against subsidies, whether other non-MFS organisations also pay above the cap, and whether a salary ceiling will be enforced. The state secretary answered that differences will be settled retroactively against the subsidy, that specific arrangements will be made with SNV, that other organisations will be referred to a separate letter, and that a salary cap will be agreed with non-MFS organisations largely funded by government.
Established differences between director salaries and the DG norm can be settled afterwards against the subsidy fixed afterwards for a given year.
Vastgestelde verschillen tussen directiesalarissen en de DG-norm kunnen achteraf worden verrekend met de eveneens achteraf vastgestelde subsidie over een bepaald jaar.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de werkzaamheden van Midden-Oosten Kwartetvertegenwoordiger Tony Blair (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

MPs El Fassed and Peters asked the foreign minister about Quartet envoy Tony Blair's work on the Wataniya telecom deal, his JP Morgan links, Dutch support, and his office's funding and accommodation. The minister answered that Blair acts within his Quartet mandate, that the Netherlands is not a donor to his office and sees no conflict of interest or need to investigate, and declined to press Blair on his finances or housing.
The Netherlands is not a donor and also sees no need to look into the financial position of the Quartet Representative himself.
Nederland is geen donor en ziet ook geen noodzaak zich te verdiepen in de financiële positie van de Kwartetvertegenwoordiger zelf.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de EU-toetredingsaanvraag van Servië en de besluitvorming daaromtrent tijdens de Raad van Buitenlandse Zaken op 25 oktober

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Belgian EU presidency would still table Serbia's EU membership application at the 25 October Council, and whether the request for a Commission opinion should be treated as a political point requiring unanimity. The minister confirmed the item is on the agenda, said the Netherlands expects consensus while the Treaty does not specify unanimity, and argued the presidency has not yet decided the voting procedure.
The cabinet considers that any further steps in Serbia's rapprochement with the European Union should be conditional on full cooperation by Serbia with the Yugoslavia tribunal.
Het kabinet meent dat eventuele verdere stappen in de toenadering van Servië tot de Europese Unie in het teken moeten staan van volledige samenwerking door Servië met het Joegoslavië-tribunaal.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Economische Zaken over de nulmeting Wet Bewaarplicht Telecommunicatiegegevens (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that telecom providers struggle to meet data retention security rules and whether state agencies breach privacy rules. The minister answered that most providers meet baseline security standards, denied structural breaches by officials, and described follow-up supervision and an internal investigation into interception procedures.
I do not have the requested overview.
Ik beschik niet over het gevraagde overzicht.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de weigering door Kenia om de Soedanese president Al-Bashir op te pakken (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

MPs Peters and Irrgang asked why Kenya hosted Sudanese president Al-Bashir despite an ICC arrest warrant, whether the Netherlands pressed Kenya, and whether it will protest when Al-Bashir visits other ICC states. The minister says Nederland and the EU have strongly urged Kenya to comply, summoned Kenyan ambassadors, and will press for a united EU reaction to future visits, but gives no account of Kenya's own reasoning beyond what Kenya stated.
The Netherlands did this on 2 September.
Nederland heeft dit op 2 september jl. gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam (PvdA) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur Wetenschappen over het overdag afsluiten van uitzendinggemist.nl (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the Minister why uitzendinggemist.nl would be made unavailable during daytime hours for programmes rated 12+, asking whether the Commissariaat voor de Media's position and the law support this, whether it is circumventable, and whether the law should be changed. The state secretary answered that the Mediawet 2008 obliges the public broadcaster to protect minors on all platforms, that time-slot protection under Kijkwijzer is the default, that no legislative change is desired, and that consultation on technical alternatives such as a family lock is underway.
Vragen van de leden Peters en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Advies over PVV voor diplomaten» (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister whether a report that diplomats had been advised on how to handle the PVV was accurate. The minister answered that there was no instruction to embassies, only an informative message to a small group of posts about the coalition formation process, usable on a passive basis.
There is no question of an instruction to the Dutch posts abroad.
Er is geen sprake van een instructie aan de Nederlandse posten in het buitenland.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de onderhandelingsronde over het ACTA-verdrag in Washington van 16 tot 20 augustus 2010 (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the August 2010 ACTA negotiation round in Washington, including the topics discussed, the lack of transparency, the possible effects on internet providers, privacy, generic medicines and Dutch law. The minister answered that the negotiation text cannot be published under participants' confidentiality rules, though participants agreed to publish the full text before signature, and that ACTA is not expected to require new Dutch legislation or go beyond the existing EU acquis.
The Netherlands cannot unilaterally break the agreements on limited disclosure, but the Netherlands has always strongly pushed for publication of the draft text.
Nederland kan de afspraken over beperkte openbaarheid helaas niet eenzijdig doorbreken, maar Nederland heeft zich altijd sterk gemaakt voor openbaarmaking van de concept-tekst.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over het recent verschenen eindrapport Audit CIOT 2009 (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Justice why the 2009 CIOT audit was a follow-up rather than a full audit, why recommendations were largely not followed, and how personal data protection will be ensured. The Minister defends using the departmental audit service and the follow-up model, reports no total numbers of unlawful queries, lists measures requested from the BIOD's, and says a regular annual audit resumes in 2010.
I consider it inefficient and undesirable to carry out a regular audit over 2009 on top of this already completed audit.
Ik acht het ondoelmatig en onwenselijk om bovenop deze reeds uitgevoerde audit nog een reguliere audit over 2009 uit te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse vrouw die sinds eind 2009 gevangen zit in Iran (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister what crimes a Dutch-Iranian woman detained in Iran since late 2009 is suspected of, whether consular access, a fair trial and legal support are being pursued, and whether the EU will press Iran. The minister answered that Iran refuses to confirm charges, trial date or consular access, treats her only as Iranian, and that the Netherlands is pressing for a fair trial and an EU demarche is being prepared.
In practical terms, however, this non-cooperative attitude of the Iranian authorities means that at this moment I have no formal confirmation of the reasons for the arrest of the person concerned
In praktische zin betekent deze non-coöperatieve houding van de Iraanse autoriteiten echter op dit moment dat ik geen formele bevestiging heb van de redenen van de arrestatie van betrokkene
Vragen van de leden Peters en Voortman (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over de dood van een zwangere Somalische vrouw in het asielzoekerscentrum van Leersum (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

MPs Peters and Voortman asked the Justice Minister about the death of a pregnant Somali asylum seeker at the Leersum reception centre, a researcher's view on risks in the new medical care system, phone access for asylum seekers, incidents linked to the new protocols, quality monitoring, and an additional study. The minister answered that the OM and IGZ are investigating, that the researcher's remarks were personal, that a direct phone line exists, that IGZ has received few reports with no significant increase, and that IGZ's regular 2010 study covers asylum healthcare quality.
The Public Prosecution Service has started an investigation following the woman's death.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is een onderzoek gestart naar aanleiding van het overlijden van de vrouw.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de conferentie over internetvrijheid in Parijs van 8 juli 2010 (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the outcomes of the July 2010 internet freedom expert meeting in Paris, progress on an EU censorship-export code, the EU Global Online Freedom Act motion, the planned follow-up conference, and funding for Iranian and Burmese internet/media freedom. The minister answered that existing initiatives should be used more effectively, that the EU export restriction awaits technical research, that a European GOFA is not feasible, and that funds were granted to the listed projects.
The Netherlands organised with France on 8 July an expert meeting on internet freedom, in preparation for establishing a so-called Leading Group in this area.
Nederland heeft met Frankrijk op 8 juli een expertbijeenkomst over internetvrijheid georganiseerd, ter voorbereiding op de oprichting van een zogenoemde Leading Group op dit gebied.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand (PvdD), El Fassed en Peters (beiden Groen Links) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de rechtmatigheid van het proces t

MPs asked the government how it followed the trial of two Greenpeace activists in Japan, whether it would press Japan on fair process, and why it judged no breach of international treaties, despite UN criticism. The minister replied that the embassy follows the case, that the government does not interfere in another country's internal legal process, and that the UN findings do not justify discrediting the proceedings.
I will raise their situation in the run-up to the next EU human rights dialogue with Japan.
Ik zal hun situatie in de aanloop naar de volgende EU-mensenrechtendialoog met Japan doen op brengen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Pechtold (D66), Peters (GroenLinks), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Venezolaanse rechter A

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the detention of Venezuelan judge María Lourdes Afiuni, whether it has raised concerns with Venezuela, and whether it will raise the case at EU level. The minister called the detention an infringement on judicial independence, supported the UN call for her release, said the Netherlands will follow the case in UN and EU contexts and will ask the High Representative to raise it with Venezuelan authorities.
I will check whether High Representative Ashton has raised this with the Venezuelan authorities, and advocate that she does.
Ik zal nagaan of Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton dit bij de Venezolaanse autoriteiten heeft aangekaart, en bepleiten dat zij dat doet.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Israëlische inname van de humanitaire vloot voor Gaza (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MP Peters asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's seizure of the humanitarian flotilla bound for Gaza was lawful under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, San Remo Manual and Fourth Geneva Convention. The minister answered that the naval law of armed conflict applies, that neutral vessels may be inspected, and that the inspection of the cargo was intended, while not addressing the questions on blockade-breaking and humanitarian access in full detail.
Under the law of naval warfare, belligerent parties are entitled to examine neutral vessels to establish whether they are indeed neutral.
Onder het zeeoorlogsrecht zijn strijdende partijen bevoegd neutrale schepen te onderzoeken om vast te stellen of deze inderdaad neutraal zijn.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de beperkte uitleenmogelijkheid van e-books door bibliotheken (ingezonden 28 april 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the one-loan-at-a-time restriction on e-books in public libraries is illogical and whether the law should provide lending remuneration for e-books as it does for print books. The government answers that publishers apply the print model by licence, that Dutch copyright law and EU directive rules require rightholder consent for online lending, and that the market and sector must agree arrangements rather than the state legislating.
This means that for lending e-books via online making available, the consent of rightholders is always required.
Dit betekent dat voor de uitleen van e-books via online terbeschikkingstelling dus steeds toestemming van rechthebbenden is vereist.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GL) aan de minister-president en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de herdenking van het drama in Srebrenica (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would attend the 15th anniversary commemoration of Srebrenica and whether the request was desirable given Dutch historical involvement. The government answered that Defence Minister Van Middelkoop will represent the government at the commemoration, which it considers a clear gesture of continued Dutch commitment.
On behalf of the Dutch government, Defence Minister Eimert van Middelkoop will attend the commemoration in Srebrenica marking the events there 15 years ago.
Namens de Nederlandse regering zal op de bijeenkomst in Srebrenica ter herdenking van de gebeurtenissen aldaar 15 jaar geleden, de Minister van Defensie, de heer Eimert van Middelkoop, aanwezig zijn.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over nadere informatie over de betrokkenheid van het fregat Van Nes en van het Korps Commandotroepen bij de illegale inval in

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the frigate Van Nes escorted US weapons shipments for the 2003 Iraq invasion, whether a file on this was withheld from the Davids inquiry, and whether a Dutch Special Forces colonel was placed at US Central Command. The government answered that the information was available to the Davids inquiry, that the frigate did not breach its rules of engagement, and that the colonel's liaison posting had no role in Iraq operations, while declining to share the file with the Chamber beyond what was already provided.
The information has been shared with the Davids committee and the Chamber.
De informatie is gedeeld met de commissie Davids en de Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Heerts, Eijsink (beiden PvdA) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Defensie over de rol van Nederlandse militairen bij een actie op 7 augustus 2002 (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

MPs Heerts, Eijsink and Peters asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the role of Dutch soldiers in a 7 August 2002 shooting incident in Afghanistan, including reporting procedures, the OM investigation, KCT involvement, and access to the full dossier. The government answered that reporting went to the ISAF command, that the OM investigated Dutch involvement, that KCT units were not involved in the incident, and that only partial, anonymised documents could be released due to classification and identifiability.
The documents mentioned under 5 and 6 cannot be made public due to their classification.
De onder 5 en 6 genoemde documenten kunnen vanwege de rubricering niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het VNG-advies inzake de kosten voor een WOB-verzoek (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about municipal fees for handling Freedom of Information (WOB) requests, after a court ruled such handling is not a service that can be charged for and the VNG advised municipalities to disregard the ruling. The state secretary says municipalities set their own fee rules, expects them to follow court rulings, notes the Council of Europe Tromsø convention allows only reproduction costs, and says talks with the VNG on amending the WOB are ongoing.
A prerequisite, however, is that the municipality ensures that access to public information is not effectively made impossible by the height of the fees.
Randvoorwaarde is daarbij wel dat de gemeente zorgt dat de toegang tot openbare informatie door de hoogte van de leges niet feitelijk onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Israëlische inname van de humanitaire vloot voor Gaza (ingezonden 31 mei 2010).

MP Peters asked the Foreign Minister how the government views Israel's violent seizure of the Gaza aid flotilla that left casualties, whether it condemns the action as disproportionate, how Israel's claimed naval-blockade legal basis holds under international law, whether it will press Israel to end the Gaza blockade and call for an independent inquiry, and what is being done for the two Dutch passengers. The minister said the events shocked him, conveyed that the Netherlands expects Israel to investigate, declined to judge proportionality before facts are known, outlined the laws of naval warfare Israel invokes, supported immediate humanitarian access and reopening of crossings, and said Israel and flag states should investigate first and that the two Dutch detainees receive standard consular assistance.
This investigation will have to be carried out by Israel; the flag states concerned are also competent to conduct an investigation, because it is primarily their rights that are at stake.
Dit onderzoek zal uitgevoerd moeten worden door Israël; ook de betrokken vlaggenstaten zijn bevoegd onderzoek uit te voeren, want het zijn primair hun rechten die in het geding zijn.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het behoud van analoge tv (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MP Peters asks the economics and culture ministers whether cable operators may force customers from analogue to digital TV, whether other operators plan to stop analogue carriage, how many households are affected, and whether dropping the analogue signal conflicts with the must-carry rule. The minister replies that analogue distribution is inefficient, that the Mediawet 2008 does not oblige cable operators to carry analogue, that Caiway and Rekam will stop analogue carriage (Rekam from 10-10-2010), that affected households are mostly already digital, and that the must-carry minimum is met.
The Mediawet 2008 contains no obligation for a cable company to carry an analogue programme offer.
De Mediawet 2008 bevat geen verplichting voor een kabelbedrijf om een analoog programma-aanbod door te geven.

m: Amendement van het lid Veltman c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het verduidelijken welke bio-ethanol als vloeibare biobrandstof meetelt
Clarifies that only bio-ethanol with GN code 2207 10 00 counts toward the renewable energy obligation in transport, excluding imported ethanol under other codes.
does not concern ethanol, except ethanol with GN code 2207 10 00.
betreft geen ethanol, met uitzondering van ethanol met GN-code 2207 10 00.
Amendement van het lid Van Groningen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over dat de correctiefactor tot in ieder geval 2030 op 1 staat
Amends the hydrogen law to fix the refining correction factor at 1.0 until at least 2030 and bars lowering it through lower-level regulation, removing executive discretion.
until at least 2030 the correction factor is 1.0 and it cannot be lowered by lower-level regulation
tot in ieder geval 2030 bedraagt de correctiefactor 1,0 en kan deze niet bij lagere regelgeving worden verlaagd
Motie van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman over de investeringshorizon onder de RED III-wetgeving verlengen tot 2035
Asks the government to extend the investment horizon under RED III renewable fuel rules to at least 2035.
requests the government to extend the investment horizon under the RED III legislation to 2035 at least
verzoekt de regering om de investeringshorizon onder de RED III-wetgeving in ieder geval te verlengen tot 2035
Amendement van de leden Veltman en Van Groningen over het verduidelijken welke bio-ethanol als vloeibare biobrandstof meetelt
Clarifies which bio-ethanol counts toward the renewable energy transport obligation by limiting it to a specific customs code, a technical trade rule.
This amendment clarifies which bio-ethanol can count as liquid biofuel
Met dit amendement wordt verduidelijkt welke bio-ethanol als vloeibare biobrandstof kan meetellen
Amendement van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman over dat de correctiefactor tot in ieder geval 2030 op 1 staat
Fixes the hydrogen correction factor at 1.0 until at least 2030 in the law itself, so lower-level regulation cannot reduce it.
until at least 2030 the correction factor is 1.0 and it cannot be lowered by lower regulation
tot in ieder geval 2030 bedraagt de correctiefactor 1,0 en kan deze niet bij lagere regelgeving worden verlaagd
Motie van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman over een jaarlijkse evaluatie van de verschillen met de buurlanden op het gebied van wegvervoer, zeevaart en binnenvaart
Asks the government to evaluate every year the differences with neighbouring countries for road, sea and inland shipping CO2 rules and inform the House.
requests the government to evaluate annually which differences exist with neighbouring countries
verzoekt de regering om jaarlijks te evalueren welke verschillen er zijn met buurlanden
Motie van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman over zo snel mogelijk toestaan dat bio-lng via de massabalanssystematiek toegepast kan worden
Motion asks government to allow bio-LNG under the mass balance system as soon as the European Commission permits it and to inform the sector and parliament.
requests the government, if the mass balance system is found to be permitted in Europe, to allow it as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om indien blijkt dat de massabalanssystematiek Europees is toegestaan zo snel mogelijk toe te staan
qa: Antwoord op van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman-Kamp over de aanpak van lawaaibakken en verkeersaso’s

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise-camera poles targeting noisy motorcycles and how to enforce noise rules, including legal, privacy and European anti-tampering aspects. The minister replied that existing traffic rules already allow enforcement, that no law change is currently planned, that municipalities must first produce a plan and privacy assessment before the Public Prosecution Service can approve digital enforcement, and that new European exhaust rules will be enforced via visual checks.
Since no legislative amendment has been initiated, it is also not possible to send the Chamber a timeline for it.
Aangezien er geen wetswijziging in gang is gezet, is het ook niet mogelijk hiervan een tijdlijn aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Groningen en Veltman over de Spaanse plicht dat een auto met Spaans kenteken voorzien moet worden van een V-16 noodlamp

MPs Van Groningen and Veltman asked the minister whether the Netherlands would consider adopting Spain's mandatory V-16 hazard light, which replaces warning triangles from 1 January 2026, and whether it would coordinate with other member states. The minister answered that the V-16 offers no clear advantage over the car's own hazard lights and phoning emergency services, that the Netherlands has no current plans to adopt it or study it, and that the matter is not on the agenda of international working groups.
There is currently no reason to prescribe an emergency lamp such as the V-16 emergency lamp.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om een noodlamp zoals de V-16 noodlamp voor te schrijven.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri en Nordkamp over Nederlandse onderdelen in Russische drones en raketten

MPs Timmermans, Piri and Nordkamp asked whether the government knew Dutch components were used in Russian drones and missiles, what concrete action was taken, whether the parts are covered by sanctions, and which Dutch firms are involved. The State Secretary answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, that the parts are already sanctioned, that enforcement rests with Customs and the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government cannot give insight into concrete actions against individual companies.
The cabinet cannot give insight into concrete actions that may be taken with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in concrete acties die mogelijk worden gedaan bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het plotse uitstel van de deadline over spreiding van vluchtelingen i.v.m. de Europese Top op 23 en 24 oktober 2025

An MP asked why the Commission suddenly postponed the 15 October 2025 deadline for the annual migration report and refugee distribution decision, whether it was linked to Dutch elections, whether the government asked for the delay, and how Poland's exemption could be announced before the report existed. The minister answered that the Commission needs more time, denied any link to the elections, said no new date was communicated, and said the government only raised timing concerns in July without asking for a delay since.
Since then no one in the cabinet has raised this, and the cabinet has indicated it will leave the publication date to the Commission.
Sindsdien heeft niemand van het kabinet hiervoor aandacht gevraagd en heeft het kabinet aangegeven de publicatiedatum aan de Commissie te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de kwestie van de Armeense genocide

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked why the government still refers to 'the question' of the Armenian genocide despite a motion asking it to use the term genocide, and whether fear of Turkish reaction drives the stance. The minister replied that the government keeps the legal Genocide Convention definition, sees positive but precarious developments in the Armenia-Azerbaijan and Armenia-Turkey normalisation, and does not comment on other countries' motives.
As stated in the letter of last April, the cabinet maintains 'the question of the Armenian genocide'.
Zoals in de brief van afgelopen april vermeld staat, houdt het kabinet vast aan «de kwestie van de Armeense genocide».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Begaat oud- minister Faber in haar recente boek een ambtsmisdrijf? Lekken uit de ministerraad is verboden (geheimhoudingsplicht)’

Sneller (D66) asked the Prime Minister whether former minister Faber's book describing a cabinet meeting breaches the confidentiality duty and whether a criminal complaint will be filed. The Prime Minister answered that the book contains personal recollections and no cabinet minutes, the Landsadvocaat found no confirmation the passages were discussed in cabinet, so no complaint will be filed; most follow-up questions were answered only by referral.
Taken together, this means I do not currently arrive at a reasonable suspicion that a criminal offence has been committed.
Dat bij elkaar maakt dat ik nu niet kom tot een redelijk vermoeden dat er een strafbaar feit is gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bezoek van de Indonesische president aan Nederland en mensenrechtenschendingen in West-Papoea

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would meet the Indonesian president during his visit, whether the Netherlands bears a duty of care toward West Papua, and how Indonesia is pressed on human rights abuses there. The minister denied a meeting with the Prime Minister, described the human rights situation as worrying, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral channels, while declining to say whether the King would raise the issue because such talks are confidential.
The Royal Couple received the president at Huis ten Bosch Palace; it is customary that conversations the Royal Couple holds at the Palace are confidential.
Het Koninklijk Paar heeft de president ontvangen op Paleis Huis ten Bosch; het is een goed gebruik dat de gesprekken die het Koninklijk Paar op het Paleis voert vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en De Hoop over het negeren van de Grondwet door een kabinetslid

Opposition MPs Timmermans and De Hoop ask why Minister Keijzer will not amend a bill banning priority housing for status holders despite a severe Council of State advisory opinion that it conflicts with equal treatment under the Constitution, and whether the cabinet backs submitting it unchanged. The minister answers that she is still studying the advice, will send a further report to parliament shortly, and that the bill's draft report has yet to be discussed in cabinet.
I expect to send a further report to the House shortly addressing the advice.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een nader rapport naar de Kamer te sturen waarin wordt ingegaan op het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Ambtenaren Buitenlandse Zaken: Veldkamp wilde niet meer doen tegen Israël'

MP Eerdmans asked the government how civil servants of the Foreign Ministry could leak a letter to the media, damaging former minister Veldkamp, and what measures would prevent leaks and restore trust. Minister Van Weel answered that leaking confidential information is not allowed and an investigation is launched, that the letter was internal and not formal advice, and that existing rules and internal debate channels apply.
When there is a suspicion of leaking confidential information, an investigation is launched and the Public Prosecution Service is informed.
Bij (een vermoeden) van lekken van vertrouwelijke informatie wordt onderzoek ingesteld en het Openbaar Ministerie geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat de koning aanwezig was bij loftuitingen over het Israëlische leger

An MP from DENK asked the Prime Minister whether he approved of prayers praising the Israeli army, and of the King's presence, at a Portuguese Synagogue event in Amsterdam, given alleged war crimes in Gaza. The Prime Minister answered that the King attended a religious anniversary, has no influence over liturgical content, that such prayers have no political meaning, and that the government rejects the premise that the event served a political purpose.
The King attended the celebration of the 350th anniversary of the Portuguese Synagogue in Amsterdam on Sunday 7 September.
De Koning woonde op zondag 7 september in Amsterdam de viering bij van het 350 jarig bestaan van de Portugese Synagoge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het krantenartikel van de Volkskrant “Powerplay bewindspersonen BBB: landbouwpost in Rome blijft voorlopig leeg”

An MP asked why the Permanent Representative post in Rome (FAO, WFP, IFAD) has stayed unfilled since December 2024, whether agriculture ministers rejected selection-committee candidates, and what this means for Dutch influence. The government said the selection procedure is still ongoing after reopening to candidates outside the civil service, declined to comment on candidates or internal ministerial discussions, and acknowledged reduced visibility and influence while the post is vacant.
The discussions of the Council of Ministers and the appointments before it are not public, and what is discussed is confidential.
De besprekingen van de ministerraad en de benoemingen die voorliggen zijn niet openbaar en hetgeen besproken wordt, is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Klaver over de schending van het Poolse luchtruim door Russische drones

MPs Timmermans and Klaver asked whether the government would convene an extra EU Council, form a leaders' group with Poland, push for a sanctions package banning Russian energy imports, accelerate REPowerEU, pressure blocking member states on frozen Russian assets, and explain remaining Russian oil and gas imports via Dutch ports and port-access powers. The government answered that NATO and EU channels are primary, that a separate leaders' group is not appropriate, that negotiations are ongoing, that Dutch oil imports from Russia have ceased and LNG imports are limited, and that port refusal rests on EU sanctions law and with ports and municipalities rather than the national government.
The cabinet regrettably cannot go further into detail on the Dutch position in ongoing negotiations.
Het kabinet kan helaas niet verder in detail ingaan op de Nederlandse positie in lopende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het opstappen van de Staatssecretaris van Financiën (Herstel en Toeslagen)

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister what message toeslagen victims receive when a responsible state secretary resigns, whether restoration will be delayed, and for the planning of each restoration route. The Prime Minister replied that Ms Palmen was sworn in again as state secretary on 5 September and that delays were expected to be kept to a minimum.

I am pleased that she was willing to take on this responsibility again and expect that, despite the political situation that has arisen, delays in the handling of restoration have been limited as much as possible.

Ik ben blij dat zij bereid is geweest om deze verantwoordelijkheid wederom te aanvaarden en verwacht dat hiermee de vertraging op de afhandeling van het herstel, ondanks de ontstane politieke situatie, zo veel mogelijk beperkt is gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op van de leden Westerveld en Timmermans over de voorgedragen nieuwe demissionaire minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs Westerveld and Timmermans asked the Prime Minister about past remarks by the proposed incoming acting Minister of Education, Culture and Science comparing rainbow zebra crossings to swastikas, and how such a figure could lead the ministry responsible for emancipation, asking 12 questions. The Prime Minister declined to comment on the candidate, stating that the appointment procedure is still ongoing and that he cannot make statements about candidate ministers until it is completed, referring to a general emancipation letter for other matters.
Until the appointment procedure has been completed, I cannot make any statements about candidate ministers and the process outlined above.
Tot het moment dat de benoemingsprocedure is afgerond, kan ik over kandidaat-bewindspersonen en het proces zoals hierboven geschetst geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op het lid Van Waveren over de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid en de ontwikkeling van de Rijksdienst

An MP asked whether the government still backs its targets for regional distribution of central government jobs, how the coordinating role of the Minister of Interior has been implemented, what concrete relocations have resulted, and how the budget cut (taakstelling) affects regional spreading. The minister answers that the government continues the effort, cites examples and an upcoming annual report, but says concrete results are limited so far and that the cut is left to individual ministers, with a principle that shrinkage happens mainly in the Randstad.

In the annual report on the state of the regional distribution of central government jobs (letter to parliament to be sent in early September), an overview of cases worked on over the past year will be presented, as promised in the committee debate of 5 February 2025.

In de jaarlijkse rapportage over de stand van de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid (Kamerbrief te verzenden begin september) wordt, zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat Regio's en grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van 5 februari 2025, een overzicht gepresenteerd van casussen waaraan het afgelopen jaar is gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ouwehand en Teunissen over ‘Israël dat verdere stappen neemt in etnische zuivering’

MP Ouwehand asked the government to condemn Israel's reported plan to confine 600,000 Gazans and expel them as ethnic cleansing, to use sanctions and pressure, to support an international protection mechanism, to intervene in the ICJ genocide case, and to answer each question. Minister Brekelmans answered that such a closed zone would be unacceptable and a violation of humanitarian law, that the government relies on a mix of pressure and dialogue, that protection mechanisms are unlikely given the UN/party consent required, and that joining the ICJ case is legally limited to intervention.
Creating a military-sealed area would be unacceptable.
Het creëren van een door militairen afgesloten gebied zou onacceptabel zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over dat visumvrij reizen voor Turken wordt versoepeld

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether visa rules for Turkish citizens were being loosened and whether this could bring millions of Turks to the Netherlands. Minister Brekelmans answered that the change only adjusts the Schengen cascade model for repeat, bona fide travellers, that visa conditions are unchanged, and that visa liberalisation for Turkey is not on the table because Turkey still has to meet six outstanding conditions.
It concerns an adjustment of the existing Schengen cascade model for Turkish travellers who have previously used their visa correctly.
Het gaat om een aanpassing van het bestaande Schengen cascademodel voor Turkse reizigers die eerder op de juiste manier gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun visum
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over briefings op het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken

An FVD MP asked the Prime Minister who took the initiative for briefings held at the Ministry of General Affairs, given that it was not the Prime Minister himself. The government answered that civil servants are tasked with actively informing ministers and that the involved ministries jointly took the initiative.
It is the task of the civil service to actively inform ministers about relevant matters.
Het is de taak van de ambtelijke dienst bewindslieden actief te informeren over relevante aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Timmermans en het lid Piri over de aankondiging van Frankrijk om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen

MPs Timmermans and Piri asked whether the government welcomes France's announced recognition of a Palestinian state, whether the international community should pressure Israel, and whether Nederland should recognise Palestine. The minister said recognition must be part of a political process toward a two-state solution, that the occupation is unlawful per the ICJ, and that the Netherlands currently has no plans to recognise Palestine.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering recognising the Palestinian state.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet niet om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte en Boswijk over een lijst met mogelijke sanctiemaatregelen tegen Israël

MPs Piri, Paternotte and Boswijk asked the government about a list of possible sanctions against Israel leaked to the press, including whether arms and national boycott options were considered, whether the list would be shared with parliament, and why the military export reporting was delayed and which dual-use licences remain valid. The minister confirmed the list was shared with participants, refused to disclose the internal note citing cabinet unity and diplomatic interests, said the export reports were delayed by workload and published up to May 2025, and argued that a boycott of settlement goods is more effective at EU level.
The cabinet will not share the note prepared for the ministerial consultation with the House and invokes the protection of the unity of cabinet policy and the protection of diplomatic interests.

Het kabinet zal de opgestelde notitie voor het bewindspersonen overleg niet met de Kamer delen en beroept zich daarbij op de bescherming van de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid en de bescherming van diplomatieke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en De Hoop over het artikel 'Premier Schoof moet mogelijk ingrijpen om stroomkabel door Schiermonnikoog tegen te houden'

MPs Kröger and De Hoop asked why the government could not secure German agreement for a cable through the Eems-Dollard area and why it signed a gas-field treaty with Germany while the Schiermonnikoog cable remains blocked. The minister explains that the gas treaty is separate from the Eems-Dollard treaty, that German authorities refuse the cable route on shipping-safety grounds, and that the treaty is planned for signature in August with provisional application, without parliamentary debate first.

Because provisional application serves the general interest of gas production, energy supply, security of supply and reducing import dependence for both the Netherlands and Germany, the Council of Ministers also approved such provisional application on 20 September 2024.

Omdat de voorlopige toepassing in het algemeen belang is van de gaswinning, de energievoorziening, de leveringszekerheid en het beperken van de importafhankelijkheid van Nederland en Duitsland, is tevens met een dergelijke voorlopige toepassing ingestemd in de ministerraad van 20 september 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het overleg met maatschappelijke partijen in het kader van stikstof

An MP asked how the 3 July 2025 consultation with societal parties on the nitrogen (stikstof) policy went, whether a measures package was on the table, and whether the measures on the MCEN long list had been costed and could be shared with parliament. The minister answered that no package was presented, that four knowledge institutes are analysing the measures and results will be shared only after cabinet decision-making, and that the questions were answered within three weeks.
As usual, the underlying documents from external parties containing relevant analyses, facts, risks and explanations will be shared with the House and made public after cabinet decision-making.

Zoals gebruikelijk worden de onderliggende documenten van externe partijen die relevante analyses, feiten, risico's en toelichtingen bevatten na besluitvorming in het kabinet gedeeld met Uw Kamer en openbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat Denemarken en Italië steun zoeken om de bevoegdheden van het Europese Hof van de Rechten van de Mensen op het gebied van asiel en immigratie te be

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether the government would co-sign a letter by Denmark and Italy seeking to limit the European Court of Human Rights' reach on asylum and immigration, and whether it had been approached to support it. The government answered that it supports the letter's general call for a dialogue on expelling convicted foreigners but will not co-sign because the call to debate the Court's interpretation of the ECHR touches judicial independence, and that it will pursue this via other channels.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression that it wishes to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Wrijving in kabinet over migratiebeleid: Faber wil handtekening Schoof onder kritische brief'

An MP asked the Prime Minister and ministers about a reported cabinet dispute over a letter by Denmark and Italy criticising European Court of Human Rights interpretation of migration removal rules, including the timeline, reasons for not co-signing, and whether criticism of the ECtHR undermines the rule of law. The government answered that it supports dialogue on removing convicted foreigners but declined to co-sign the part questioning ECtHR interpretation, citing judicial independence, and said it would pursue other routes.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression of wanting to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boomsma over strafbaarstelling illegaliteit

MP Boomsma asked about the consequences of the Vondeling amendment criminalising unlawful residence and assistance to unlawfully resident foreigners, including implementation consequences and humanitarian aid. The Minister answered that the amendment will be executed, that enforcement capacity is limited so priority will go to foreigners causing nuisance or crime and those not cooperating with return, and that aid by churches or the Salvation Army is unlikely to be prosecuted soon.
Should choices need to be made due to limited capacity, the cabinet will ask the partner organisations to prioritise enforcement in practice.
Mocht het zo zijn dat er keuzes gemaakt moeten worden vanwege beperkte capaciteit, zal het kabinet de betrokken ketenpartners vragen om in de praktijk prioriteit te geven aan de handhaving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontslag van de bewindspersonen

An MP asked the Prime Minister who decided that all PVV-nominated ministers and state secretaries should be dismissed, whether they agreed, and whether a constitutional rule prevents them from continuing as caretakers without a party. The Prime Minister answered that after the PVV withdrew support on 3 June, the ministers and state secretaries it nominated offered their resignations, and that no constitutional rule prevents caretaker ministers from continuing; he referred back to that answer for the question on continuing without party affiliation.
There is no constitutional rule that prevents continuing the work as a caretaker minister.
Er is geen staatsrechtelijke regel die zich verzet tegen het voortzetten van het werk als demissionair bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Timmermans over de erkenning van de Palestijnse Staat

Opposition MPs Timmermans and Piri asked the government about recognition of a Palestinian state, Israeli threats of annexation, and Israeli settlement expansion. The minister answered that no contact with Israel on recognition has occurred, that the government condemns settlements and supports EU measures, and that recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Erkenning is voor Nederland op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een nieuw uitgesproken fatwa

MP Wilders asked the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government would act against a new fatwa by a convicted Pakistani cleric calling for his killing and whether it would press Pakistan to cooperate with enforcement of a prior Dutch sentence.
