The government condemned the fatwa, said it had conveyed its view to Pakistani authorities, and stated that Dutch authorities depend on other states' cooperation for cases abroad, while not announcing new concrete action.

As reported in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions from MP Wilders, the cabinet is making maximum efforts to get the Pakistani authorities to cooperate with the requests concerning the persons convicted in the Netherlands.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen van het lid Wilders, spant het kabinet zich maximaal in om de Pakistaanse autoriteiten te laten meewerken aan de verzoeken met betrekking tot de in Nederland veroordeelde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Sneller over het financieel verslag inzake het faillissement van KHN Rekenwerk

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked about the financial report on the bankruptcy of KHN Rekenwerk, the causes and responsibility for its financial problems, and whether Minister Beljaarts was liable, including the 550,000 euro paid by his D&O insurer and his use of a private spokesperson. The minister answered that the curator is responsible for investigating the bankruptcy, declined to draw conclusions on liability or the insurer's motives, and said the matter is private and predates his appointment.
It is for the curator to draw a conclusion on that basis and possibly assess the conduct of the directors in this matter.
Het is aan de curator om op basis daarvan een conclusie te trekken en daarmee eventueel een beoordeling te geven over het handelen van de bestuurders in deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het financieel verslag inzake het faillissement van KHN Rekenwerk

MPs Thijssen and Sneller asked the Prime Minister why his answers to earlier questions on the KHN Rekenwerk bankruptcy report were referred to the minister involved, and when he would send his reflection on financial and business interests of incoming ministers. The Prime Minister said ministers answer for their own personal matters, that the earlier answers were sent on his behalf on 17 March 2025, and that a reflection letter will come by Q3 2027 at the latest.
As I noted in the letter, my aim is to review the existing framework ahead of a next formation.
Zoals ik heb opgemerkt in de genoemde brief is mijn oogmerk het bestaande kader tegen het licht te houden ten behoeve van een volgende formatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitlevering van drie veroordeelde Pakistanen

An MP asked whether three Pakistani nationals convicted in the Netherlands for serious offences against him had been extradited, what concrete steps had been taken with Pakistan, and insisted on nothing less than extradition. The government answered that Pakistan has been formally asked to extradite, that the matter is raised repeatedly at all levels, but it declined to give details of diplomatic contacts and said the response is up to Pakistan.
As to which specific efforts have been made, given the confidential nature of diplomatic communications with foreign authorities, we will make no further statements.
Over welke inspanningen precies zijn gepleegd, doen wij gezien de vertrouwelijke aard van het diplomatieke verkeer met buitenlandse autoriteiten, geen verdere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Waveren en Van Campen over het bericht “EU betaalt voor 'groene promotie'; Subsidie aan milieuclubs in ruil voor lobby”

MPs Omtzigt, Van Waveren and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister whether EU Commission subsidies to NGOs for lobbying MEPs on climate plans ("lobbycontracten") were known to the Dutch government, whether the Commission should be pressed for disclosure, and whether Dutch ministries have similarly commissioned lobbying. The minister answered that the Dutch government had no knowledge of these contracts, that no transparency rules were reported broken, that the government awaits the Commission's follow-up, and that no central overview of Dutch subsidies for lobbying is kept.
The cabinet awaits further steps from the Commission.
Het kabinet wacht nadere stappen van de Commissie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State naar de media zijn gelekt

An MP asked the Asylum and Migration Minister whether leaks of Raad van State advisory opinions to the media were unusual, whether only the ministry received the opinions, and whether the leak would be reported to the police. The minister said the leaked content was unusual and undesirable but declined to qualify it as criminal, said no criminal complaint would be filed for lack of grounds, and noted the opinions were later published by the Raad van State on schedule.
I consider it undesirable when statements are made about Raad van State advisory opinions before they are made public by the Raad van State.
Ik vind het onwenselijk wanneer mededelingen worden gedaan over adviezen van de Raad van State, voordat deze openbaar zijn gemaakt door de Raad van State.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsrea

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the government about the ADR report on security failures at the NCTV and police, including oversight, the BVA's role, and a leak. This follow-up letter answers question 5 by stating that a search found documents on the NCTV's security situation, that these are being assessed, and that some passages will be withheld for state and privacy reasons, with further documents to follow.
This has led to certain passages in the documents not being made public because they may harm the interests of the State.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid bepaalde passages uit de documenten niet openbaar te maken omdat deze de belangen van de Staat kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Baarle over de juridische stappen van vicepremier Mona Keijzer inzake het besluit van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om haar niet te vervolgen voor groepsbelediging

An MP asked whether Deputy PM Keijzer's legal challenge to the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to prosecute her for group insult was coordinated in cabinet, whether it is appropriate for her to pursue it, and whether the government agrees with her statements about Islam and antisemitism. The minister answered that everyone may use legal rights, that the cabinet does not judge the OM's independent decision, and that it will not pre-empt pending court procedures or comment on her statements.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to anticipate the possible outcome of ongoing procedures, nor to comment on Ms Keijzer's statements.
Het past het kabinet niet om vooruit te lopen op de eventuele uitkomst van lopende procedures en ook niet om zich uit te spreken over de uitlatingen van mevrouw Keijzer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het artikel 'Ongrijpbaar voor haar ambtenaren, onbereikbaar voor de buitenwereld: minister Faber opereert ‘volstrekt ongebruikelijk’'

MPs Sneller and Podt asked about reports that a political assistant to the Minister of Asylum and Migration had not passed an AIVD security screening, whether they had access to sensitive information via WhatsApp groups, and about staff departures and the absence of spokespersons at that ministry. The government declined to discuss the individual case, described the general screening procedure and rules on messaging apps, and said an independent advice on extra rules for political assistants had been requested.
Due to the confidential nature of personnel information of this type, I will not make any statements about individual cases.
In verband met het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter van dit type informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over het artikel 'Rechter wijst meer dan ?500.000 toe aan gedupeerde vader in toeslagenaffaire'

Three NSC MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling awarding over 500,000 euros to a victim of the childcare benefits scandal, and about the handling of supplementary damages claims, appeals, lawsuits and payouts. The State Secretary answered in detail with figures on claims, decisions, appeals, pending cases and penalty payments, while noting the Van Dam advisory commission's findings are still awaited and the ruling is under study.
The cabinet has made agreements with municipalities, OTB and IPW for referring parents for urgent assistance.
Het kabinet heeft afspraken gemaakt met gemeenten, OTB en IPW voor het aandragen van ouders voor urgentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsreactie d

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the Audit Dienst Rijk report on classified information security at the NCTV and police, including management oversight, USB sticks possibly unaccounted for, and whistleblower protection. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, listed measures taken and promised further reviews, while declining to give some information (e.g. full documentation, an exact count of affected citizens) as ongoing investigation or unavailable.
Your House will be informed at a later point and in any case before the debate.
Uw Kamer wordt op een later moment en in ieder geval voor het debat nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de toepassing van de Tijdelijke Wet nu het huisvestingsvraagstuk van de CTIVD (voorlopig) opgelost is

An MP asked whether, now that the CTIVD's housing problem is provisionally resolved, the intelligence services' suspended powers under the Temporary Act can be resumed and from when. The government answered that some powers are already being applied under the Temporary Act through agreements with the CTIVD, that a shift to CTIVD oversight is planned, and that full application will follow as CTIVD staffing grows, without giving a firm date.
The starting point is and remains full application of the Temporary Act under the necessary independent oversight, within the shortest possible term that is feasible for all parties.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft volledige toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet onder het noodzakelijke onafhankelijke toezicht, op de kortst mogelijke en voor alle partijen uitvoerbare termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de 54ste bijeenkomst van het WEF

An MP asked why the Dutch cabinet sends a relatively large delegation to the WEF annual meeting in Davos, what sessions it will attend, and whether any agreements will be made without prior parliamentary approval. The minister answered that three ministers will attend, that no agreements or treaties will be concluded there, and that no decisions requiring parliamentary consent are taken, though the programmes were not yet finalised.
During the WEF annual meeting no political decisions are taken or international agreements made for which approval of the House of Representatives is required.
Tijdens de jaarlijkse vergadering van het WEF worden er geen politieke besluiten genomen of internationale afspraken gemaakt, waarvoor instemming van de Tweede Kamer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de brief van de NORTH group

An MP from FVD asks the Minister-President and the State Secretary for Health about a NORTH group letter claiming COVID-19 mRNA vaccines were never tested for stopping transmission, caused excessive serious adverse effects and deaths, contained residual plasmid DNA, and asks whether the vaccines should be halted, recalled, independently investigated, and whether there is proof that human DNA cannot be harmed. The State Secretary answers that the vaccine policy rests on independent advice, refers to earlier answers, rejects stopping or recalling the vaccines and extra investigation, rejects the DNA claims, and explains why the vaccines cannot alter human DNA.
I see no reason to commission additional research into the manner of approval and use of COVID-19 vaccines.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om extra onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de wijze van goedkeuring en het gebruik van COVID-19-vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Staatssecretaris Jansen en de veiligheid op de werkvloer op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MP Bamenga asks ministers about a letter from 175 civil servants at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management protesting Staatssecretaris Jansen's remarks about Moroccans, the reported sick leave of advisers, and how ministers will restore a safe working climate and address institutional racism in the civil service. The government answers that it takes the concerns seriously, that talks with staff are ongoing, that a broader integrated anti-discrimination approach and reporting model are planned, and declines to give individual personnel details.
We do not comment on internal individual personnel matters.
Over interne individuele personele aangelegenheden doen wij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Tseggai en Lahlah over het bericht 'Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los', en het verzoek van het lid Timmermans om een brief te o

MPs Timmermans, Tseggai and Lahlah asked the cabinet whether it still stands by its statement that no opinions of people with a migration background would be recorded, given the Becker motion requiring research into people with a migration background, and how this fits with the non-discrimination principle. The cabinet answered that the SCP research will cover the whole population without distinguishing by migration background, that it sees no break in cabinet policy, and that it will consider how to provide the requested information within legal frameworks.
The cabinet observes no break in the unity of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet constateert geen breuk in de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Congres VS eist inzage in ASML-export naar China'

An MP asks the government about a US House committee's request to ASML and other chip-equipment makers for details of their China export sales, and about Dutch export-control and sanctions policy. The minister answers that the US request is a matter for ASML, that contacts with US authorities take place but their content is confidential, and that the Netherlands takes its own export-control measures for security reasons.
I will not comment on the content of those conversations for reasons of confidentiality.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken doe ik omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het niet uitnodigen van zzp-vertegenwoordigers bij het Catshuis-overleg met de sociale partners van 21 november jl.

MP Aartsen asked why self-employed (zzp) organisations were not invited to the Catshuis consultation with social partners on 21 November 2024, and whether they are treated as full social partners. The minister answered that the consultation was with the central employer and employee organisations and the SER chair, that self-employed interests are handled through other consultations, and that no agreements were made on the labour market package, DBA enforcement, BAZ, Vbar or pensions.
However, no organisations representing only self-employed persons were invited to this consultation.
Er zijn voor dit overleg echter geen organisaties uitgenodigd die enkel zelfstandigen vertegenwoordigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vroonhoven over antisemitische incidenten

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about the number of antisemitic incidents in 2022-2024, convictions for antisemitism, sentences, and whether such convictions lead to refusal or withdrawal of certificates of good conduct (VOG), including for taxi drivers. The minister provided incident and prosecution figures for 2022-2023, said 2024 figures will follow in 2025, declined to break down sentences without separate research, and explained VOG screening is case-by-case.
For 2024 there are no figures yet. These will be sent to the House in the course of 2025.
Voor 2024 zijn er nog geen cijfers. Deze worden in de loop van 2025 naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over tijdens de aankomende informele Europese Raad aandringen op veiligheidsgaranties voor Oekraïne naar aanleiding van de verkiezingen in de Verenigde Staten.

MP Klaver asked whether the Netherlands would push at the informal European Council for EU security guarantees for Ukraine after the US election, and how the government views possible shifts in US policy. The Prime Minister answered that the EU and partners will keep supporting Ukraine, that no conclusions should be drawn prematurely about US policy, and that the EU lacks a mandate to give security guarantees, while pointing to a ten-year security arrangement with Ukraine.
The European Union does not have the mandate to give security guarantees.
De Europese Unie heeft niet het mandaat om veiligheidsgaranties af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het (niet) openbaar maken van zakelijke belangen

MP Sneller asked whether the State Secretary for Finance holds shares in listed companies and whether the formateur approved not disclosing them, and whether integrity rules for ministers are adequate, citing GRECO and the Huberts critique. The government answered that all ministers declared their interests under the fixed rules, that the decision to name companies rests with the minister concerned, that a recusal rule covers conflicts, and that no external sanction mechanism will be created.
It is up to the minister approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be made public.

12 ) is het aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen openbaar gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de kabinetsreactie op de parlementaire enquête fraude en dienstverlening (PEFD)

MP Stultiens asked why the cabinet has not yet responded substantively to the PEFD enquiry report on the childcare benefits scandal, and whether it will respond to all 19 recommendations before the autumn recess. The minister answers that the cabinet deferred its substantive response to the next cabinet, that a response is being prepared, and that it expects to send it before the Christmas recess.
After the coalition agreement was published on 16 May 2024, the caretaker cabinet chose to leave a substantive cabinet response to the next cabinet.
Het demissionaire kabinet heeft na verschijnen van het hoofdlijnenakkoord op 16 mei 2024 ervoor gekozen om een inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie aan het volgende kabinet te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitspraak van de minister van VWS ‘Als het staatsnoodrecht in gaat, wil ik nog wel eens zien wie zo stoer is om het tegen te houden’

An MP asks whether a minister's remark that she would like to see who dares to stop emergency powers (staatsnoodrecht) from taking effect is a threat to parliament or the courts and whether it conflicts with collective cabinet responsibility and the rule of law. The minister says it was not meant as a threat, expresses respect for parliament, and states that parliament has the final word on emergency powers.
Parliament has the last word on the use of emergency powers.
Het parlement heeft het laatste woord over de inzet van het staatsnoodrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Kathmann over het archiveren van zakelijke appjes

MPs Chakor and Kathmann asked how ministries ensure that business WhatsApp messages are properly archived, why compliance with the 2023 guidelines is inconsistent, and how oversight and responsibility are organised. The state secretary answers that compliance has improved, that oversight rests with the Inspectie OE and CIO Rijk monitoring, that a Rijksbrede chat-archiving facility is being built, and that the government will respond to the ADR audit report with the Algemene Zaken budget.
The aim is to provide the response to the ADR audit report before the Algemene Zaken budget debate.
Gestreefd wordt om de reactie op het ADR-onderzoeksrapport voor de behandeling van de begroting van Algemene Zaken te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het Koninklijk Huis, de belastingvrijstelling en nevenfuncties

An MP asked the Prime Minister about tax treatment of royal family members, whether the constitutional exemption for functional assets is implemented, and whether the RVD asked journalists to avoid royal topics. The government answered that the functional assets are held in foundations and are not taxed, that all entitled royal members pay box 3 tax, and that no such RVD requests occurred.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de hernieuwde fatwa van imam Jalali

Wilders asked whether the government knew of imam Jalali's renewed fatwa against him, whether it condemns the threats, what it has done to get the imam imprisoned, and what consequences non-cooperation by Pakistan would have. The minister said AIVD and NCTV information cannot be discussed publicly, condemned the threats, described diplomatic and legal-assistance efforts with Pakistan, and declined to pre-empt consequences for relations with Pakistan.

As is known to your House, no public statement can be made about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat casuistry and security measures for individuals.

Antwoord 2 Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan er over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigingscasuïstiek en beveiligingsmatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het artikel «Koninklijke Horeca Nederland vordert 1,3 miljoen van failliet bedrijf Beljaarts»

An MP asked the Prime Minister about KHN's 1.3 million claim against a bankrupt KHN subsidiary and about Minister Beljaarts' former role as director, including potential conflicts of interest with his current economic affairs portfolio. The minister replied that the claim is a KHN decision, that he and the PM do not contact the curator, that the curator's report will be made public in due course, and that his past work raised no obstacle to his appointment.
The curator's report will be made public in due course.
Het rapport van de curator zal te zijner tijd openbaar worden gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Omtzigt over de problemen met de WIA-keuringen en de vaststelling van de hoogte van de uitkeringen, die niet terug te vinden zijn in de vele verslagen, Kamerbrieven en andere zake

MPs Saris and Omtzigt asked about discrepancies in UWV's error and uncertainty figures for WIA benefits and why problems in WIA assessments and benefit calculations were absent from UWV reports and the Minister's letters. The Minister defended the provisional figures, acknowledged UWV failed to report internal findings, and said a legislative proposal on benefit recovery and the 'reasonably clear' criterion is being considered.
UWV has so far not reported on the inaccuracies found in internal samples in calculating and determining WIA benefits.
UWV heeft tot dusverre niet gerapporteerd over de bij interne steekproeven geconstateerde onjuistheden bij het berekenen en vaststellen van de WIA-uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over nieuwe problemen bij het UWV

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister and the Prime Minister about reported long-running errors at UWV affecting about 53,000 files, requesting a full overview of known problems and restoration operations, and whether these were reported. The government answered that the issues were shared with parliament via letters and that UWV is working on several restoration operations, while declining to withdraw earlier reports and stating no further massive errors beyond those already communicated.
Through the Stand van de Uitvoering we periodically inform the House of restoration actions with a large (societal) impact.
Via de Stand van de Uitvoering informeren we uw Kamer periodiek over de herstelacties met een grote (maatschappelijke) impact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de Kamerbrief van de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether a state secretary's letter distancing himself from a 'minder, minder' remark, while still personally standing by it, is consistent with cabinet unity and acceptable given a court ruling that the remark was punishable. The Prime Minister answers that the state secretary has retracted the remarks and will not repeat them, that personal views do not apply in office, and that the matter is closed.
Rightly, the letter states that these views in no way reflect cabinet policy.
Terecht wordt in de brief gesteld dat deze opvattingen op geen enkele manier het kabinetsbeleid reflecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de Belastingdruk op middenhuurwoningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven asked the government to calculate the costs and returns of a private landlord's rental home in box 3 for 2016 to 2025, including the effects of tax and rent regulation measures, and whether mid-rent housing is in shortage and how box 3 burdens could be eased. The government answered that the example is illustrative only, showed the 2023 and 2024 figures, explained the box 3 tax rate rise to 36%, the updated leegwaarderatio and the Wet betaalbare huur, and said the Supreme Court's June 2024 rulings will lead to a counter-evidence scheme for actual returns.
No figures are kept on the number of homes rented out in box 3.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aantal woningen dat in box 3 wordt verhuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Kent over het stopzetten van het Programma Schoolmaaltijden

MPs Dijk and Van Kent asked the Prime Minister about halting the School Meals Programme, citing a letter from 2,100 schools, the Red Cross and the Jeugdeducatiefonds, and asked how the government would secure funding. The state secretary replied that the programme will be continued structurally after 2024 with €135 million per year, with details to follow.
That is why the cabinet has decided to continue the programme structurally after 2024.
Daarom heeft het kabinet besloten het programma structureel voort te zetten na 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Wilders, Pool en De Roon over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that a German court issued an international arrest warrant against a Ukrainian suspected in the Nord Stream sabotage, and whether Ukraine might be behind it and what Dutch intelligence knew. The government declined to speculate on the German investigation's outcome, did not disclose intelligence details, and said Parliament would be informed through the usual channels.
The cabinet does not state publicly anything about the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our intelligence services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze inlichtingendiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Kahraman over Nord Stream 2

MPs Kahraman and Omtzigt asked the government about the Nord Stream sabotage, prior consultations with Ukraine and Russia, MIVD warnings, Gasunie write-offs, and internal memos. The ministers answered that they await the German investigation, that no Dutch-Ukrainian consultations on Nord Stream are known for 2020-2021, that no specific government-level Nord Stream talks with Russia took place, and declined to comment on intelligence matters while promising an inventory of documents by end of September 2024.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Roon en Pool over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that President Zelensky knew of and approved the Nord Stream sabotage were accurate, and what the consequences would be. The government answered that it does not speculate on the cause of the explosions and will await the outcome of the German investigation.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and is awaiting the results of the German investigation.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de omstreden verkiezingsuitslag in Venezuela

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister which countries recognise opposition candidate González as winner of the disputed Venezuelan election, whether US claims of 'irrefutable evidence' are accepted, why the Netherlands and EU have not explicitly recognised the opposition win, and what sanctions or support are planned. Minister Veldkamp answered that many states use careful wording, that the Netherlands and EU avoid explicit recognition to support a negotiation process, and that new EU sanctions are not currently on the table.
At this moment, the introduction of additional European restrictive measures is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is het instellen van aanvullende Europese restrictieve maatregelen niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Wilders over het feit dat de MIVD de wettelijk verplichte notificatieplicht bij afluisteren, aftappen en andere bijzondere bevoegdheden niet nakomt

MPs Omtzigt and Wilders asked why the MIVD has not fulfilled its statutory duty to notify people subjected to special powers, and about the status of its notification backlog since the CTIVD's 2017 report. The minister acknowledged a backlog from 2019 to November 2023, said measures are underway with full repair targeted by 1 April 2025, but declined to give figures on targets, politicians, lawyers or journalists and did not disclose compliance incidents to Parliament.
The aim is for the MIVD to have fully cleared the backlog by 1 April 2025.
Het streven is dat de MIVD de achterstand voor 1 april 2025 volledig heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de status van Koningin Maxima bij het World Economic Forum

A Freedom Party MP asked the Prime Minister about Queen Máxima's current status at the World Economic Forum. The government answered that she has been a member of the WEF's Edison Alliance since 2021 in her role as UN special advocate for inclusive finance, and referred to earlier answers on roles of cabinet members and royals at the WEF.
Queen Máxima, in her role as special advocate of the UN Secretary-General for inclusive finance for development (UNSGSA), has been a member of the WEF's Edison Alliance since 2021.

Koningin Máxima is in haar functie van speciale pleitbezorger van de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties voor inclusieve financiering voor ontwikkeling (UNSGSA) sinds 2021 lid van de Edison Alliance van het Wereld Economisch Forum (WEF).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Sneller over het betrekken van deTweede Kamer bij de budgettaire besluitvorming

D66 MPs Vijlbrief and Sneller asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the role of the Prime Minister, the cabinet's budget decision-making and how parliament would be involved before Prinsjesdag 2024. The government answered that decisions are taken collectively in the Council of Ministers, promised talks with parliament's financial spokespeople and the Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen, and said the budget would be presented on Prinsjesdag, but gave limited concrete detail on timing and content.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are therefore secret.
De beraadslagingen van de ministerraad zijn derhalve geheim.
